Koeʻuhi ʻi he tāpuaki, te u tāpuakiʻi koe, pea ʻi he fakatokolahi, te u fakatokolahi ho hako ke tatau mo e ngaahi fetuʻu ʻoe langi, mo e ʻoneʻone ʻoku ʻi he matātahi; pea ʻe maʻu ʻe ho hako ʻae matapāʻo honau ngaahi fili.
Pea ʻe monūʻia ʻi ho hako ʻae puleʻanga kotoa pēʻo māmani; ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻo tuitala ki hoku leʻo.”
Pea naʻe toe haʻu ʻa ʻEpalahame ki heʻene ongo talavou, pea naʻa nau tutuʻu ki ʻolunga ʻo nau fononga fakataha ki Peasipa, pea naʻe nofo ʻa ʻEpalahame ʻi Peasipa.
¶Pea hili ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, naʻe fakahākia ʻEpalahame, ʻo pehē, “Vakai, kuo fanauʻi foki ʻe Milika ʻae fānau kia Nehoa, ko ho tokoua.
Ko Husa hono ʻuluaki, mo Pusa ko hono tehina, pea mo Kemueli, ko e tamai ʻa ʻElami.
Mo Keseti, mo Hesoa, mo Pilitasi, mo Sitilafi, mo Petueli.
Pea naʻe tupu ia Petueli ʻa Lepeka ko e toko valu ni naʻe fanauʻi ʻe Milika kia Nehoa, ko e tehina ʻo ʻEpalahame.
Pea ko hono sinifu naʻe hingoa ko Liuma, naʻa ne fanauʻi foki ʻe ia ʻa Tepa, mo Kehami, mo Tehasi, mo Meeka.
23: PEA naʻe teau mauofulu ma fitu ʻae taʻu ʻa Sela; ko e ngaahi taʻu eni ʻoe moʻui ʻa Sela;
Pea naʻe pekia ʻa Sela ʻi Kesa ʻAlipa; ʻaia ko Hepeloni ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani pea naʻe haʻu ʻa ʻEpalahame ke tēngihia ʻa Sela, mo tangi koeʻuhi ko ia.
¶Pea naʻe tuʻu ki ʻolunga ʻa ʻEpalahame ʻi he ʻao ʻo hono pekia, ʻo ne lea ki he fānau ʻa Heti, ʻo pehē,
“Ko e muli au mo e ʻāunofoʻiate kimoutolu, tuku mai ha potu faʻitoka meiate kimoutolu, koeʻuhi ke u tanu ai hoku pekia mei hoku ʻao.”
Pea leaange ʻae fānau ʻa Heti kia ʻEpalahame, ʻo pehēkiate ia:

“E ʻEiki, ke ke fanongo mai kiate kimautolu, ko e ʻEiki lahi koe ʻiate kimautolu; ke ke faʻiteliha ki homau ngaahi fonualoto, ke fai ai ho pekia; ʻe ʻikai ha maʻu tokotaha ʻe taʻofi meiate koe hono fonualoto, ka ke fai ʻi ai ho pekia.”
Pea tuʻu hake ʻa ʻEpalahame, ʻo tuloloia ki he kakai ʻoe fonua, ʻio ki he fānau ʻa Heti.
Pea lea ia kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “Kapau ko homou loto ke u tanu hoku pekia mei hoku ʻao, pea mou fanongo mai; pea mou kole kia ʻEfilone ko e foha ʻo Sohaʻa, koeʻuhi ko au.
Koeʻuhi ke ne tuku mai ʻae ʻana ʻi Makipila ʻoku ʻaʻana, pea ʻoku ʻi he potu ʻo ʻene ngoue; ke ne fakatau ia kiate au, ki he paʻanga ʻoku tatau mo ia, ke u maʻu ia ko hoku faʻitoka ʻiate kimoutolu.”

Pea naʻe nofo ʻa ʻEfilone fakataha mo e fānau ʻa Heti; pea leaange ʻa ʻEfilone ko e tangata Heti kia ʻEpalahame ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi fānau ʻa Heti, ʻio, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai kotoa pēnaʻe hūʻi he matapāʻoe kolo, ʻo pehē,

“Ko ʻeku ʻeiki, ʻe ʻikai; ka ke fanongo mai: ʻoku ʻoʻou ʻae ngoue, pea mo e ʻana ʻoku ʻi ai, te u foaki ia kiate koe; ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fānau ʻa hoku kakai ni, ʻoku ou foaki ia kiate koe, ke ke tanu ai ho pekia.”
Pea toe tuloloʻa ʻEpalahame ki he kakai ʻoe fonua.

Pea lea ia kia ʻEfilone ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai ʻoe fonua, ʻo pehē, “Kapau ko ho loto ia, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe fanongo mai kiate au: te u ʻatu kiate koe ʻae paʻanga ki he ngoue; ke ke maʻu ia, pea teu tanu hoku pekia ʻi ai.”
Pea lea ʻa ʻEfilone kia ʻEpalahame, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia,
“Ko ʻeku ʻeiki, ke ke fanongo mai; ʻoku tatau ʻae konga fonua mo e sikeli siliva ʻe fāngeau; ka koeʻumaʻāia kiate au mo koe? Ko ia, ke ke tanu pe ho pekia.”

Pea tokanga ʻa ʻEpalahame kia ʻEfilone; pea naʻe fua ʻe ʻEpalahame ʻae siliva kia ʻEfilone, ʻaia naʻa ne tala ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fānau ʻa Heti, ko e sikeli siliva ʻe fāngeau, ʻo hangēko e lau ʻe he kau fakatau.
¶Pea ko e ngoue ʻa ʻEfilone, ʻaia naʻe ʻi Makipila, pea ofi ki Mamali, ko e ngoue, pea mo e ʻana ʻi ai, pea mo e ngaahi ʻakau ʻoku ʻi ai, ʻaia naʻe ʻi he veʻe ngoue kotoa pē, naʻe fakapapau ia,
Kia ʻEpalahame ko e tofiʻa, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fānau ʻa Heti, ʻi he ʻao ʻo kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe hūʻi he matapāʻo hono kolo.
Pea hili ia, naʻe tanu ʻe ʻEpalahame hono ʻunohoko Sela ʻi he ʻana ʻi he ngoue ʻo Makipila ʻoku hangatonu ki Mamili, ʻaia ko Hepeloni, ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani.
Pea ko e ngoue, mo e ʻana naʻe ʻi ai naʻe fakapapau ia kia ʻEpalahame, ʻe he ngaahi foha ʻo Heti, ke ne maʻu ko hono faʻitoka.
24: PEA naʻe motuʻa ʻa ʻEpalahame, pea lahi ʻaupitoʻa hono ngaahi ʻaho; pea naʻe tāpuaki ʻe Sihova ʻa ʻEpalahame ʻi he meʻa kotoa pē.
Pea pehēʻe ʻEpalahame ki ke motuʻa tamaioʻeiki ʻi hono fale, ʻaia naʻe pule ki heʻene meʻa kotoa pē, “ʻOku ou kole ke ke ai ho nima ʻi hoku lalo tenga:
He ko hoku loto, ke ke fuakava ʻia Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻoe langi, pea ko e ʻOtua ʻo māmani, ke ʻoua naʻa ke fili ha ʻunohoki hoku foha ʻi he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻoe kakai Kēnani, ʻaia ʻoku ou ʻāunofoki ai.
Ka te ke ʻalu ki hoku fonua, ki hoku kāinga, mo ke fili mai ha ʻunohoki hoku foha ko ʻAisake.”
Pea pehēange ʻe he tamaioʻeiki kiate ia, “Kapau ʻe ʻikai fie haʻu mo au ʻae fefine ki he fonua ni; ʻe fēfē, te u toe ʻave ho foha ki he fonua naʻa ke haʻu mei ai?”
Pea talaange ʻe ʻEpalahame kiate ia, “Vakai, ʻoua ʻaupitonaʻa ke toe ʻave hoku foha ki ai.

Ko Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻoe langi, ʻaia naʻe ʻomi au mei he fale ʻo ʻeku tamai, mo e fonua ʻo hoku kāinga, pea naʻa ne lea kiate au mo ne fuakava kiate au, ʻo pehē, Te u foaki ki ho hako ʻae fonua ni: te ne fekau ʻene ʻāngelo ke muʻomuʻa ʻiate koe, pea te ke ʻomi mei ai ha ʻunohoki hoku foha.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai loto ʻae fefine ke haʻu mo koe, te ke ʻataʻatāai mei he ʻe ta fuakava ni: kaeʻoua naʻa ke toe ʻave hoku foha ki ai.”
Pea naʻe ai ʻe he tamaioʻeiki hono nima ki he lalo tenga ʻo hono ʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame, pea ne fuakava kiate ia, koeʻuhi ko e meʻa ni.

¶Pea naʻe fili mai ʻe he tamaioʻeiki ʻae kāmeli ʻe hongofulu ʻi he fanga kāmeli ʻa ʻene ʻeiki, pea ʻalu; he naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pēʻa ʻene ʻeiki, pea tuʻu hake ia ʻo ʻalu ki Mesopōtemia, ki he kolo ʻo Nehoa.
Pea naʻa ne fakatūʻulutui ʻene fanga kāmeli ʻi he tuaʻākolo ʻi he veʻe vaikeli, ʻi he feituʻulaʻāefiafi, ʻio, ʻi he feituʻulaʻāʻoku ʻalu ai ʻae kau fefine ke utu vai.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “E Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku ʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke fakamonūʻia au he ʻaho ni, pea ke fakahāhoʻo ʻofa ki heʻeku ʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame.
Vakai, ʻoku ou tuʻu ʻi heni, ʻi he veʻe vaikeli; pea ʻe haʻu ʻae ngaahi ʻofefine ʻoe kakai ʻoe kolo ke utu vai.

Tuku ke hoko ʻo pehē, ke ʻilonga ʻae taʻahine, ʻaia te u pehēki ai, ‘ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, tuku hifo hoʻo hina, ke u inu; pea te ne pehēmai, Inu, pea te u fakainu hoʻo fanga kāmeli foki;’ko ia ia kuo ke fili maʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ko ʻAisake: pea te u ʻilo ai kuo ke fakahāʻae ʻofa ki heʻeku ʻeiki.”

¶Pea naʻe hoko, ʻo pehē, ʻi he teʻeki ai ʻosi ʻene lea, vakai naʻe haʻu mo ʻene hina vai ʻi hono uma, ʻa Lepeka ʻaia naʻe tupu ia Petueli, ko e tama ʻa Milika, ko e ʻunohoʻo Nehoa, ko e taʻokete ʻo ʻEpalahame.
Pea naʻe hoihoifua ʻae taʻahine ke sio ki ai, pea ko e tāupoʻou ia, he naʻe teʻeki ʻiloʻi ia ʻe ha tangata; pea ne ʻalu hifo ia ki he vai, ʻo fakafonu ʻene hina pea toe ʻalu hake.
Pea lele ʻae tamaioʻeiki ke fakafetaulakikiate ia, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia: “ʻOku ou kole ke u inu ha vai siʻi ʻi hoʻo hina.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia, “Ko ʻeku ʻeiki ke ke inu;”pea fakatoʻotoʻo ia ʻo tuku hifo ʻae hina ki hono nima, ʻo ne fakainu ia.
Pea hili ʻene fakainu ia, pea pehēʻe ia, “Te u utu ki hoʻo fanga kāmeli foki ke ʻoua ke nau fiu.”
Pea fakatoʻotoʻo ia, pea lingi ʻae vai mei he hina ki he tukuʻanga vai, pea toe lele ki he vai ke utu, pea naʻa ne utu ki heʻene fanga kāmeli kotoa pē.
Pea naʻe ofo ʻae tangata kiate ia, kae fakalongo pe, ko ʻene vakai pe kuo fakamonūʻia ʻe Sihova hono fononga pe ʻikai.

Pea naʻe hoko ʻo pehē, ʻi he hili ʻae inu ʻae fanga kāmeli, naʻe toʻo ʻe he tangata ʻae hau koula, ko e vaheua ʻoe sikeli siliva hono mamafa, pea mo e lelu koula ʻe ua ki hono nima, ko e sikeli ʻe hongofulu hono mamafa.
Pea ne pehē, “Ko e ʻofefine ʻohai koe? ʻOku ou kole ke ke tala mai, pe ʻoku ʻataʻatāʻae ʻapi ʻo hoʻo tamai ke mau ʻapitanga ai.”
Pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Ko e ʻofefine au ʻo Petueli ko e tama ʻa Milika, ʻaia naʻa ne fāʻeleʻi kia Nehoa.”
Pea ne pehēfoki kiate ia, “ʻOku mau maʻu ʻae mohuku mo e meʻakai lahi pea ʻoku ʻataʻatāhomau ʻapi kemouʻapitanga ki ai.”
Pea tulolohifo ʻae tangata hono ʻulu, pea hūia kia Sihova.

‌ʻO ne pehē, “ʻOku monūʻia ʻa Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻa ʻeku ʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai te ne fakamasiva ʻeku ʻeiki ʻi heʻene ʻaloʻofa mo ʻene moʻoni; naʻaku ʻi he hala, pea kuo tataki au ʻe Sihova ki he fale ʻoe kāinga ʻo ʻeku ʻeiki.”
Pea naʻe lele ʻae taʻahine, ʻo fakahāki he fale ʻo ʻene faʻē, ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni.
¶Pea naʻe ʻi ai ʻae tuongaʻane ʻo Lepeka ko Lepani hono hingoa; pea lele kituʻa ʻa Lepani ki he tangata, ʻi he vaikeli.

Pea naʻe hoko ʻo pehē, ʻi heʻene mamata ki he hau, mo e lelu ʻi he nima ʻo hono tuofefine, pea mo ʻene fanongo ki he ngaahi lea ʻa Lepeka ko hono tuofefine, ʻo pehē, naʻe lea pehēmai ʻae tangata kiate au; pea haʻu leva ia ki he tangata; pea vakai naʻe tuʻu ia ʻo ofi ki he fanga kāmeli ʻi he veʻe vaikeli.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Haʻu ki heni, ʻa koe ko e monūʻia ʻo Sihova; ko e hāʻoku ke kei tuʻu ai ʻi tuaʻā? He kuo ʻosi ʻeku teu ʻae fale, mo e potu ki he fanga kāmeli.
¶Pea naʻe hūʻae tangata ki he fale; pea ne vete ʻae fanga kāmeli, pea ne ʻatu ʻae mohuku mo e meʻakai ki he fanga kāmeli, mo e vai ke fufuluai hono vaʻe mo e vaʻe ʻoe kau tangata naʻe ʻiate ia.
Pea naʻe tuku ʻi hono ʻao ʻae meʻakai: ka naʻe pehēʻe ia, “E ʻikai te u kai, kaeʻoua muʻa ke u fakahāʻeku fekau,”pea ne pehē, “Ke ke lea.”
Pea ne pehēʻe ia, “Ko e tamaioʻeiki au ʻa ʻEpalahame,

Pea kuo tāpuaki lahi ʻe Sihova ʻeku ʻeiki; pea kuo hoko ia ʻo lahi: pea kuo ne foaki kiate ia ʻae fanga sipi, mo fanga manu, mo e siliva, mo e koula, mo e kau tamaioʻeiki mo e kau kaunanga, mo e fanga kāmeli, mo e fanga ʻasi.
Pea ko Sela, ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻeku ʻeiki naʻa ne fanauʻi ki heʻeku ʻeiki ʻae tama heʻene motuʻa; pea kuo ne tuku ʻa ʻene meʻa kotoa pēkiate ia.
Pea naʻe fekau ʻe heʻeku ʻeiki kiate au ke u fuakava, ʻo pehē, ‘E ʻikai te ke fili ha ʻunohoki hoku foha mei he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻoe kakai Kēnani, ʻaia ʻoku ʻonautoluʻae fonua ʻoku ou nofo ai;’
Ka ke ʻalu ki he fale ʻo ʻeku tamai mo hoku kāinga, ʻo ʻomi mei ai ha ʻunohoki hoku foha.
Pea naʻaku pehēki heʻeku ʻeiki, ‘Ka e fēfēʻoka ʻikai fie haʻu ʻae fefine mo au?’

Pea pehēmai ʻe ia kiate au, ‘Ko Sihova ʻaia ʻoku ou ʻalu ʻi hono ʻao, te ne fekau ʻene ʻāngelo ke ʻalu mo koe ʻo fakamonūʻia hoʻo ʻalu; pea te ke ʻomi ha ʻunohoki hoku foha mei hoku kāinga mo e fale ʻo ʻeku tamai:
Pea te ke ʻataʻatāmei heʻeku fuakava ni, ʻoka ke ka hoko ki hoku kāinga, pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te nau tuku ha tokotaha kiate koe, pea te ke ʻataʻatāmei he ʻe tāfuakava ni.’
Pea naʻaku haʻu he ʻaho ni ki he vaikeli pea u pehē, ‘E Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku ʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame, kapau ʻoku ke fakamonūʻia hoku hala, ʻaia ʻoku ou ʻalu ai:
Vakai ʻoku ou tuʻu ʻi he veʻe vaikeli pea te u pehē, ʻoka haʻu ha taʻahine ke utu vai, te u pehēkiate ia, ‘ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, tuku mai ha vai siʻi ʻi hoʻo hina ke u inu:’
Pea kapau te ne pehēmai kiate au, ‘Inu koe, pea te u utu ha vai ki hoʻo fanga kāmeli foki,’ʻofa ko e fefine ko ia kuo fili ʻe Sihova ki he foha ʻo ʻeku ʻeiki.
Pea naʻe teʻeki ai ʻosi ʻeku lea ʻi hoku loto, mo ʻene hoko mai ʻa Lepeka mo ʻene hina ʻi hono uma: pea hifo ia ki he vai, ʻo utu, pea ne u pehēkiate ia, ‘ʻOku ou kole kiate koe tuku mai ke u inu.’
Pea naʻe fakatoʻotoʻo ia ʻo tuku hifo ʻene hina mei hono uma, ʻo ne pehē, ‘Inu, pea te u fakainu hoʻo fanga kāmeli foki; pea u inu, pea naʻa ne fakainu ʻae fanga kāmeli foki.

Pea naʻaku fehuʻi kiate ia ʻo pehē, ‘Ko e ʻofefine ʻohai koe?’Pea pehēʻe ia, ‘Ko e ʻofefine ʻo Petueli, ko e foha ʻo Nehoa ʻaia naʻe fanauʻi ʻe Milika kiate ia: pea naʻaku ai ʻae hau ki hono mata, mo e lelu ki hono nima.’
Pea punou hifo hoku mata ʻo hūmo e fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku ʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame, ʻaia naʻe tataki au ʻi he hala totonu ke ʻave ʻae ʻofefine ʻoe tokoua ʻa ʻeku ʻeiki ki hono foha.
Pea ko eni, kapau te mou fai ʻofa mo totonu, ki heʻeku ʻeiki, tala mai, pea ka ʻikai, tala mai, koeʻuhi ke u afe ki he nima toʻomataʻu, pe ki he toʻohema.”
Pea lea ʻa Lepani mo Petueli, ʻo pehēange, “ʻOku haʻu ʻae meʻa ni meia Sihova; pea ʻoku ʻikai te ma faʻa lea ʻaki kiate koe ʻae kovi pe ko e lelei;
Vakai, ʻoku ʻi ho ʻao ʻa Lepeka, toʻo ia, pea ʻalu, pea ke hoko ia ko e ʻunohoki he foha ʻo hoʻo ʻeiki, ʻo hangēko e folofola ʻa Sihova.”
Pea ʻi he fanongo ʻae tamaioʻeiki ʻa ʻEpalahame ki he ngaahi lea ni, naʻe hūia kia Sihova, ʻo ne punou ki he kelekele;
Pea toʻo ʻe he tamaioʻeiki ʻae ngaahi teunga siliva, mo e ngaahi teunga koula, mo e ngaahi kofu, ʻo ne foaki ia kia Lepeka; pea ne foaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa mahuʻinga ki hono tuongaʻane, mo ʻene faʻē.
Pea naʻa nau kai mo inu, ko ia mo e kau tangata naʻe ʻiate ia, pea nau mohe ʻi he pōko ia: pea nau tuʻu hake ʻi he pongipongi, pea naʻa ne pehē, “Tuku au ke u ʻalu ki heʻeku ʻeiki.”
Pea pehēange ʻe hono tuongaʻane mo ʻene faʻē, “Tuku muʻa ke mau nonofo mo e taʻahine ʻi he ʻaho niʻihi, ʻae ʻaho ʻe hongofulu nai; pea hili ia ʻe toki ʻalu atu.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinaua, “ʻOua te mo taʻofi au, he kuo fakamonūʻia ʻe Sihova hoku hala: tuku au ke u ʻalu ki heʻeku ʻeiki.”
Pea naʻa na pehē, “Te ma ui ʻae taʻahine ʻo fehuʻi mei hono ngutu.”
Pea naʻa na ui ʻa Lepeka, ʻo pehēkiate ia, “Te ke ʻalu mo e tangata ni?”Pea pehēange ʻe ia, “Te u ʻalu.”
Pea naʻa nau tuku ʻa Lepeka ko honau tuofefine ke ne ʻalu mo hono fefine tauhi, mo e tamaioʻeiki ʻa ʻEpalahame, mo ʻene kau tangata.

Pea naʻa nau tāpuaki ʻa Lepeka ʻo pehēkiate ia, “Ko homau tuofefine koe, ʻofa ke ke hoko koe ko e faʻēʻoe ngaahi toko afe taʻefaʻalaua, pea ke maʻu ʻe ho hako ʻae matapāʻonautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate koe.”
¶Pea naʻe tuʻu hake ʻa Lepeka mo hono kau fefine, pea nau heka ʻi he fanga kāmeli ʻo muimuiki he tangata; pea ʻave ʻa Lepeka ʻe he tamaioʻeiki, pea fononga ʻi hono hala.
Ka naʻe haʻu ʻa ʻAisake ʻi he hala mei he vai ko Lehai-Loʻai; he naʻa ne nofo ʻi he potu tonga.
Pea ʻalu atu ʻa ʻAisake ki he ngoue ʻi he efiafi, ke ne lotu; pea ne hanga hake hono mata ʻo sio, pea vakai ʻoku haʻu ʻae fanga kāmeli.
Pea hanga hake ʻe Lepeka hono mata, pea ʻi heʻene mamata kia ʻAisake, naʻe ʻalu hifo ia mei he kāmeli.

He kuo ʻosi ʻene fehuʻi ki he tamaioʻeiki, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko hai ʻae tangata ko ia ʻoku haʻu ʻi he ngoue ke fakafetaulakimai kiate kitautolu?”Pea naʻe pehēange ʻe he tamaioʻeiki, “Ko ʻeku ʻeiki ia: ko ia naʻa ne toʻo ai ʻae pulupulu, ʻo fakapulou ʻaki ia.”
Pea naʻe fakamatala ʻe he tamaioʻeiki kia ʻAisake ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pēnaʻa ne fai.

Pea naʻe ʻomi ia ʻe ʻAisake ki he fale fehikitaki ʻo ʻene faʻēko Sela, pea ne maʻu ʻa Lepeka, pea hoko ia ko hono ʻunoho: pea ʻofa ia kiate ia; pea naʻe fiemālie ʻa ʻAisake ʻi he hili angeʻae pekiao ʻene faʻē.
25: PEA toe maʻu ʻe ʻEpalahame ʻae ʻunoho, ko hono hingoa ko Ketula.
Pea ne fanauʻi kiate ia ʻa Similani, mo Sokesani, mo Metani mo Mitiani: mo ʻIsipaka, mo Suaa.
Pea naʻe fānau kia Sokesani ʻa Sipa mo Titani, pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Titani ko ʻAsuli, mo Litusi mo Leumi.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Mitiani: ko ʻEfaa, mo ʻEfee, mo Henoke, mo ʻApaita, mo Elitaa. Ko e ngaahi fānau eni ʻa Ketula.
¶Pea naʻe foaki ʻe ʻEpalahame ʻene meʻa kotoa pēkia ʻAisake.

Ka ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻEpalahame ʻi hono sinifu, naʻe ʻatu ki ai ʻe ʻEpalahame ʻae ngaahi foaki, pea ʻi heʻene kei moʻui naʻa ne fekau ke nau ʻalu ki he feituʻu hahake, koeʻuhi ke ʻataʻatāʻo hono foha ko ʻAisake.
Pea ko e ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe ngaahi taʻu naʻe moʻui ai ʻa ʻEpalahame, ko e taʻu ʻe teau mo e taʻu ʻe fitungofulu ma nima.
Pea naʻe tukuangeʻe ʻEpalahame hono laumālie, pea pekia ia ʻi he motuʻa lelei, ko e tangata motuʻa kuo aʻu; pea naʻe fakataha ia ki hono kakai.
Pea naʻe tanu ia ʻe hono ongo foha ko ʻAisake mo ʻIsimeʻeli, ʻi he ʻana ʻi Makipila, ʻi he ngoue ʻa ʻEfilone, ko e foha ʻo Sohaʻa, ko e Heti, ʻaia ʻoku fehangai mo Mamili.
Ko e ngoue ia naʻe fakatau ʻe ʻEpalahame mei he ngaahi foha ʻo Heti; naʻe tanu ʻi ai ʻa ʻEpalahame mo hono ʻunohoko Sela.
¶Pea hili ʻae pekia ʻa ʻEpalahame, naʻe tāpuakiʻi ʻe he ʻOtua hono foha ko ʻAisake: pea naʻe nofo ʻa ʻAisake ʻo ofi ki he vaikeli ko Lehai-Loʻai.
¶Pea ko e hako eni ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli, ko e foha ʻo ʻEpalahame, ʻaia naʻe fanauʻi kia ʻEpalahame ʻe Hekaʻāko e ʻIsipite, ko e kaunanga ʻa Sela.
Pea ko e hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli, ko honau hingoa ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata; ko e ʻuluaki ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli, ko Nepeoti; mo Keta, mo ʻAtieli, mo Mipisami,
Mo Misima, mo Tumaʻāmo Masa:
Ko Hetaʻa, mo Tima, mo Situa, mo Nefisi, mo Kitema.
Ko e ngaahi foha ia ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli, pea ko honau hingoa ia, ʻi honau ngaahi kolo, ʻi honau ngaahi fale: ko e ʻeiki ʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ua, ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi puleʻanga.
Pea ko e ngaahi taʻu eni ʻoe moʻui ʻa ʻIsimeʻeli, ko e taʻu ʻe teau mo e tolungofulu ma fitu: pea tukuangeʻe ia hono laumālie, pea pekia ia, pea fakataha ia ki hono kakai.
Pea naʻa nau nofo mei Havila ʻo aʻu ki Sua, ʻaia ʻoku ofi ki ʻIsipite, ʻi he hala ki ʻAsilia; pea naʻe pekia ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo hono ngaahi kāinga kotoa pē.
¶Pea ko e hako eni ʻo ʻAisake ko e foha ʻo ʻEpalahame: naʻe fānau kia ʻEpalahame ʻa ʻAisake.
Pea naʻe fāngofulu taʻu ʻae motuʻa ʻo ʻAisake, ʻi heʻene maʻu ʻa Lepeka ko hono ʻunoho, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Petueli, ko e Silia ʻa Petanalami, ko e tuofefine ʻo Lepani ko e Silia.
Pea naʻe hūfia ʻe ʻAisake hono ʻunohokia Sihova, he naʻe paʻa ia; pea tui kiate ia ʻa Sihova, pea feitama hono ʻunohoko Lepeka.
Pea naʻe fengaueʻi ʻae fānau ʻiate ia; pea pehēʻe ia, “Kapau ʻoku moʻoni, ko e hāʻoku ou pehēai?”Pea ʻalu ia ke fehuʻi kia Sihova.
¶Pea ʻi heʻene kakato hono ngaahi ʻaho ke fāʻele, pea vakai, naʻe ai ʻae māhanga ʻi hono manāva.
Pea fāʻele ʻae ʻuluaki kuo kulokula kotoa pē, ʻo hangēha kofu fulufulu: pea ne nau ui hono hingoa ko ʻIsoa.
Pea toki fāʻeleʻi hono tehina, pea naʻe puke ʻe hono nima ʻae mui vaʻe ʻo ʻIsoa; pea naʻe ui hono hingoa ko Sēkope; pea naʻe onongofulu taʻu ʻa ʻAisake ʻi he fanauʻi ʻakinaua.
Pea tupu ʻae ongo tama: pea naʻe poto ʻa ʻIsoa ʻi he tuli manu, ko e tangata taka ʻuta; ka ko e tangata angamalūʻia ʻa Sēkope, pea naʻe nofo ia ʻi he ngaahi fale fehikitaki.
Pea ʻofa ʻa ʻAisake kia ʻIsoa, he naʻa ne kai ʻa ʻene kanoʻi manu, ka naʻe ʻofa ʻa Lepeka kia Sēkope.
¶Pea naʻe fei haka ʻa Sēkope; pea haʻu ʻa ʻIsoa mei he vao, pea kuo vaivai ia;
Pea pehēʻe ʻIsoa kia Sēkope, “ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke fafanga au ʻaki ʻae lūkulokula na, he kuo u vaivai; ko ia naʻe ui ai hono hingoa, ko ʻItomi.”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sēkope, Fakatau kiate au he ʻaho ni, ʻae ʻinasi ʻoe ʻuluaki foha.
Pea pehēʻe ʻIsoa, “Vakai, kuo u teitei mate: pea ko e hāhono ʻaonga kiate au ʻoe ʻinasi ʻoe ʻuluaki foha?”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sēkope; “Fuakava mai kiate au he ʻaho ni; pea ne fuakava kiate ia:”pea naʻa ne fakatau ʻae ʻinasi ʻoe ʻuluaki foha kia Sēkope.
Pea toki ʻatu ai ʻe Sēkope kia ʻIsoa ʻae māmo e haka lū; pea kai ia mo inu, pea ne tuʻu hake ʻo ʻalu ʻi hono hala; naʻe pehēʻae siʻaki ʻe ʻIsoa ʻae ʻinasi ʻoe ʻuluaki foha.
26: PEA naʻe tōʻae honge ki he fonua: ka ʻoku taha kehe ʻae ʻuluaki honge ʻaia naʻe hoko ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻEpalahame. Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa ʻAisake ki Kela kia ʻApimeleki ko e tuʻi ʻoe kakai Filisitia.
Pea naʻe hāmai ʻa Sihova kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOua naʻa ke ʻalu hifo ki ʻIsipite: nofo ʻi he fonua ʻaia te u fakahākiate koe.

Ke ke nofomaʻu ʻi he fonua ni, pea teu ʻiate koe, pea te u tāpuakiʻi koe; he te u foaki kiate koe mo ho hako ʻae ngaahi fonua ni kotoa pē, pea te u fakamoʻoni ʻae fuakava ʻaia naʻaku fuakava ʻaki ki hoʻo tamai ko ʻEpalahame.
Pea te u fakatupu ho hako ke tokolahi, ʻo hangēko e ngaahi fetuʻu ʻoe langi; pea te u foaki ki ho hako ʻae ngaahi fonua ni kotoa pē; pea ʻe monūʻia ʻi ho hako ʻae puleʻanga kotoa pēʻo māmani;
Koeʻuhi naʻe talangofua ʻa ʻEpalahame ki hoku leʻo, mo ne maʻu ʻeku tala, mo ʻeku ngaahi fekau, mo ʻeku tuʻutuʻuni, mo ʻeku ngaahi fono.”
¶Pea naʻe nofo ʻa ʻAisake ʻi Kela.

Pea fehuʻi kiate ia ʻae kakai tangata ʻoe potu ko ia, ki hono ʻunoho: pea pehēʻe ia, ko hoku tuofefine ia; he naʻe manavahēia ke pehēatu, ‘Ko hoku ʻunohoia;’he naʻa ne pehē, telia naʻa tāmateʻi au ʻe he kau tangata ʻoe potu ni, koeʻuhi ko Lepeka; he naʻe hoihoifua ia ke mamata ki ai.
Pea naʻe nofo ia ʻi ai ʻo fuoloa; pea ʻiloange, naʻe fakasio ʻa ʻApimeleki ko e tuʻi ʻoe kakai Filisitia, mei he tupa, ʻo ne mamata ʻoku fakavāʻa ʻAisake mo Lepeka ko hono ʻunoho.

Pea fekau ʻe ʻApimeleki ke haʻu ʻa ʻAisake, ʻo ne pehē, “Vakai, ko e moʻoni ko ho ʻunohoia; pea ko e hānaʻa ke pehēai, ko hoku tuofefine ia?”Pea talaange ʻe ʻAisake kiate ia, “Koeʻuhi naʻaku pehē, telia naʻaku mate koeʻuhi ko ia.”
Pea pehēʻe ʻApimeleki, “Ko e hāʻae meʻa ni kuo ke fai kiate kimautolu? Ka ne mohe faainoa ha tokotaha mo ho ʻunoho; pehēkuo ke ʻomi ʻae kovi lahi kiate kimautolu.”
Pea fai fono ʻe ʻApimeleki ki hono kakai, ʻo pehē, “Ko ia ʻe ala ki he tangata ni, pe ko hono ʻunoho, ko e moʻoni ʻe tāmateʻi ia.”
Pea naʻe toki tōtaʻu ʻe ʻAisake ʻi he fonua ko ia, pea ne utu ʻi he taʻu ko ia hono tupu ʻe tātuʻo teau: pea naʻe tāpuaki ia ʻe Sihova.
Pea naʻe tupu pe ʻae tangata, pea fakaʻaʻau ki muʻa ia, pea ne tupu ʻo lahi ʻaupito.
He naʻa ne maʻu ʻae fanga sipi lahi, mo e fanga manu, mo e kau tamaioʻeiki tokolahi; pea naʻe meheka ʻae kakai Filisitia kiate ia.
He ko e ngaahi vai kehekehe naʻe keli ʻe he kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa ʻene tamai, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻEpalahame, naʻe mapuni ia ʻe he kakai Filisitia ʻi hono tanu ʻaki ʻae kelekele.
Pea pehēʻe ʻApimeleki kia ʻAisake, “Ke ke ʻalu ʻiate kimautolu; he ʻoku ke mālohi hake koe ʻiate kimautolu.”
Pea ʻalu mei ai ʻa ʻAisake, pea fokotuʻu hono fale fehikitaki ʻi he teleʻa ʻo Kela, pea nofo ai ia.

Pea naʻe toe keli ʻe ʻAisake ʻae ngaahi vai, ʻaia naʻa nau keli ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene tamai ko ʻEpalahame: he naʻe tanu ia ʻe he kakai Filisitia, hili ʻae pekia ʻa ʻEpalahame: pea ne ui ʻaki ia ʻae ngaahi hingoa, ʻaia naʻe fakahingoa ʻaki ia ʻe heʻene tamai.
Pea naʻe keli ʻe he kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa ʻAisake ʻi he teleʻa ʻo nau ʻilo ai ʻae matavai moʻui.
Pea fakakikihi ʻe he kau tangata tauhimanu ʻa Kela, mo e kau tauhimanu ʻa ʻAisake, ʻo nau pehē, “ʻOku ʻamautoluʻae vai;”pea ne ui hono hingoa ʻoe vai, ‘ko Eseki;’ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau ke mo ia.
Pea naʻa nau keli ʻae vai ʻe taha, pea nau fakakikihi ki ai foki; pea ne ui hono hingoa ʻo ia ko Sitina.

Pea hiki mei ai ia ʻo keli ʻae vai ʻe taha; pea naʻe ʻikai te nau fakakikihi ki ai; pea ne ui hono hingoa ʻo ia ko Leopote; pea ne pehē, “He ko eni, kuo fakaʻataʻatāʻe Sihova ha potu kiate kitautolu, pea te tau tupu ʻi he fonua.”
Pea naʻe ʻalu ia mei ai ki Peasipa.

Pea hāmai ʻa Sihova kiate ia ʻi he pōko ia, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Ko e ʻOtua au ʻo hoʻo tamai ko ʻEpalahame; ʻOua naʻa ke manavahē, he ʻoku ou ʻiate koe, pea te u tāpuaki koe, pea fakatokolahi ho hako, koeʻuhi ko ʻeku tamaioʻeiki ko ʻEpalahame.”
Pea fokotuʻu ʻe ia ʻi ai ʻae ʻesifeilaulau ʻo ne hūkia Sihova, pea fokotuʻu ʻe ia hono fale fehikitaki ʻi ai; pea keli ʻi ai ʻe he kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa ʻAisake ʻae vai.
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa ʻApimeleki kiate ia mei Kela, pea mo hono kāinga ʻe taha ko ʻAhusate, mo Fikoli ko e ʻeiki ʻo ʻene kautau.
Pea pehēʻe ʻAisake kiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou haʻu ai kiate au, ka ʻoku mou fehiʻa kiate au, pea kuo mou kapusi au meiate kimoutolu.”
Pea naʻa nau pehē, “Naʻa mau mamata pau kuo ʻiate koe ʻa Sihova; pea naʻa mau pehē, ‘Ke tau fefuakavaʻaki mo koe, ʻio, ʻiate kitautolumo koe, pea ke tau fai ʻae fuakava mo koe;’
Ke ʻoua naʻa ke fai kovi kiate kimautolu, ʻo hangēko ʻemau taʻeala kiate koe, pea kuo mau fai lelei pe kiate koe, pea mau tuku koe ke ke ʻalu fiemālie: pea ko eni, ko e monūʻia koe ʻia Sihova.”
Pea naʻe teu ʻe ia hanau kātoanga, pea naʻa nau kai mo inu.
Pea nau tuʻu hengihengi hake mo nau fefuakavaʻaki: pea naʻe tukuangeʻakinautoluʻe ʻAisake, pea naʻa nau ʻalu ʻiate ia ʻi he fiemālie.
Pea naʻe hoko ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻae haʻu ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa ʻAisake, ʻo nau fakahākiate ia ʻae vai kuo nau keli, ʻo nau pehēkiate ia, “Kuo mau ʻilo ʻae vai.”
Pea ne ui ia ko Sipa; ko ia ʻoku ui ai ʻae kolo ko ia ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho ni, ko Peasipa.
¶Pea naʻe fāngofulu ʻae taʻu ʻa ʻIsoa, pea ne maʻu kiate ia ʻa Sutitiko hono ʻunoho, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Peli ko etangata Heti, mo Pasimati ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻElone ko etangataHeti.
Ko e meʻa ko ia, naʻe mamahi ai ʻae loto ʻo ʻAisake mo Lepeka.
27: PEA naʻe hoko ʻo pehē, ʻi heʻene motuʻa ʻa ʻAisake, pea kuo kui hono mata, pea naʻe ʻikai te ne faʻa sio, naʻa ne ui ki hono ʻuluaki foha ko ʻIsoa, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, Ko hoku foha: pea ne pehēkiate ia, Vakai, ko au eni.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Vakai mai, kuo u motuʻa, pea ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻilo ʻae ʻaho ʻo ʻeku mate.
Pea ko eni, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke toʻo hoʻo nāunau, ʻa hoʻo tangakaho, mo hoʻo kaufana, pea ke ʻalu ki he vao mo ke kumi maʻaku ha manu.
Pea ke ngaohi maʻaku ha meʻakai ifo lelei, ʻo hangēko ʻeku manako, pea ke ʻomi ia kiate au ke u kai; koeʻuhi ke tāpuaki koe ʻe hoku laumālie, ʻi he teʻeki ai teu mate.”
Pea naʻe fanongo ʻa Lepeka ki he lea ʻa ʻAisake ki hono foha ko ʻIsoa. Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa ʻIsoa ki he vao ke kumi ha manu mo ʻomi ia.
¶Pea lea ʻa Lepeka ki heʻene tama ko Sēkope, ʻo pehē, “Vakai mai, naʻaku fanongo naʻe lea hoʻo tamai ki ho tokoua ko ʻIsoa, ʻo pehē,
‘Omi maʻaku ha manu, mo ngaohi maʻaku ʻae meʻakai lelei, koeʻuhi ke u kai ia, mo tāpuaki koe ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ʻi he teʻeki ai teu mate.’
Pea ko eni, ʻeku tama, Ke ke talangofua ki hoku leʻo, ʻo hangēko ia te u fekau kiate koe.
‌ʻAlu leva ki he fanga kosi, mo ke ʻomi mei ai ʻae ongo ʻuhikiʻi kosi lelei ʻe ua: pea te u ngaohi ʻaki ia ki hoʻo tamai, ʻae meʻakai lelei, ʻo hangēko ʻene manako.
Pea te ke ʻave ia ki hoʻo tamai, koeʻuhi ke ne kai, pea koeʻuhi ke ne tāpuaki koe ʻi he teʻeki ai te ne pekia.”
Pea naʻe pehēange ʻe Sēkope ki heʻene faʻēko Lepeka, “Vakai mai, ko e tangata fulufuluʻa ʻIsoa ko hoku tokoua, pea ko e tangata molemole au.
E ala nai ʻe heʻeku tamai kiate au, pea te u hāatu kiate ia ko e kākā; pea te u ʻomi kiate au ha malaʻia, kae ʻikai ha tāpuaki.”
Pea pehēange ʻe heʻene faʻēkiate ia, “Ko ʻeku tama, ke ʻiate au pe ho malaʻia, ka ke tui pe ki hoku leʻo pea ke ʻalu ʻo ʻomi ia kiate au.”
Pea naʻe ʻalu ia ōfetuku mo ʻomi ia ki heʻene faʻē; pea ngaohi ai ʻe heʻene faʻēʻae meʻakai lelei, ʻo hangēko e manako ʻa ʻene tamai.
Pea toʻo ʻe Lepeka ʻae ngaahi kofu lelei ʻo ʻene ʻuluaki tama ko ʻIsoa, ʻaia naʻe ʻiate ia ʻi he fale, pea ne ai ia ki heʻene tama ki mui ko Sēkope.
Pea ne ai ʻae kiliʻi kosi ki hono nima mo epotumolemole ʻo hono kia.
Pea ne ʻatu ʻae meʻakai lelei, mo e mākuo ne ngaohi, ki he nima ʻo ʻene tama ko Sēkope.
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu ia ki heʻene tamai, ʻo ne pehē, “Ko ʻeku tamai;”pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko au eni; ka ko hai koe hoku foha?”

Pea pehēʻe Sēkope ki heʻene tamai, “Ko au ʻIsoa, ko ho ʻuluaki; kuo u fai ʻo hangēko hoʻo fekau kiate au; pea ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke tuʻu hake, pea ke nofo ʻo kai mei heʻeku manu, koeʻuhi ke ke tāpuaki au.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ʻAisake ki hono foha, “Hoku foha naʻe fēfeeʻi hao maʻu vave pehēmai ia?”Pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Koeʻuhi naʻe ʻomi ia kiate au ʻe Sihova ko ho ʻOtua.”
Pea pehēʻe ʻAisake kia Sēkope, “Ko hoku foha ʻoku ou kole ke ke ʻunuʻunu mai, koeʻuhi ke u ala kiate koe ke u ʻilo pe ko hoku foha ko ʻIsoa moʻoni koe, pe ʻikai.”
Pea ʻunuʻunu atu ʻa Sēkope ki heʻene tamai ko ʻAisake; pea ne fāfāia ʻo ne pehē, ‘Ko e leʻo, ko e leʻo ʻo Sēkope, ka ko e nima ko e nima ʻo ʻIsoa.”
Pea naʻe ʻikai te ne ʻilo ia, koeʻuhi naʻe fulufuluhono nima, ʻo hangēko e nima ʻo hono taʻokete, ko ʻIsoa: pea naʻa ne tāpuaki ia;
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko hoku foha ko ʻIsoa moʻoni koe?”Pea pehēange ʻe ia, “Ko au ia.”

Pea pehēʻe ia, “Omi ke ofi ia kiate au, pea te u kai ʻae kanoʻi manu ʻa hoku foha, koeʻuhi ke tāpuaki koe ʻe hoku laumālie.”Pea ne ʻomi ia ʻo ofi kiate ia, pea ne kai ai: pea ne ʻomi kiate ia ʻaeuaine, pea ne inu ai.
Pea pehēʻe heʻene tamai ko ʻAisake kiate ia; “Ko hoku foha ke ke ʻunuʻunu mai, ʻo uma kiate au.”

Pea ʻunuʻunu atu ia, pea uma kiate ia; pea ne nanamu ki he nanamu ʻo hono ngaahi kofu, ʻo ne tāpuaki ia, ʻo pehē,
“Vakai, ko e nanamu ʻo hoku foha,
ʻoku tatau mo e nanamu ʻoe ngoue kuo tāpuakiʻi ʻe Sihova:

Ko ia ke foaki kiate koe ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae hahau mei langi,
mo e mahu ʻoe kelekele,
pea mo e koane, mo euaine, ʻo lahi:
Pea pehē, kuo hili ʻae tāpuaki ʻe ʻAisake ʻa Sēkope, pea naʻe teʻeki ke meimei ʻalu ia mei he ʻao ʻo ʻene tamai ko ʻAisake, mo ʻene haʻu ʻa hono taʻokete ko ʻIsoa, mei heʻene tuli manu.

Pea kuo ngaohi ʻe ia foki ʻae meʻakai ifo lelei, pea ne ʻomi ia ki heʻene tamai, pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene tamai, “Ke tuʻu hake ʻeku tamai, mo kai ʻae kanoʻi manu ʻa hono foha, pea ke tāpuaki au ʻe ho laumālie.”
Pea pehēange ʻe heʻene tamai ko ʻAisake kiate ia, “Ko hai koe?”Pea talaange ʻe ia, “Ko au, ko ho foha, ko ho ʻuluaki ko ʻIsoa.”

Pea tetetete lahi ʻaupitoʻa ʻAisake, ʻo ne pehē, “Ko hai? Kofaʻāia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae kanoʻi manu, ʻo ʻomi kiate au, pea naʻaku kai ʻi he meʻa kotoa pē, pea naʻaku tāpuaki ia ʻi he teʻeki ai te ke haʻu koe? ʻIo pea ko e moʻoni ʻe monūʻia ia.”
Pea kuo fanongo ʻa ʻIsoa ki he ngaahi lea ʻa ʻene tamai, pea tangi ia ʻi he leʻo lahi mo fakamamahi, ʻo ne pehēki heʻene tamai, “Ke ke tāpuaki au, ʻio, ko au foki, ʻa ʻeku Tamai.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia, “Naʻe haʻu ʻa ho tehina ʻi he kākā, pea kuo ne faʻao ʻo ʻave ʻa ho tāpuaki.”

Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻIkai kuo totonu ʻae fakahingoa ia ko Sēkope? He kuo tuʻo ua ʻene muʻakiʻi au: naʻa ne toʻo ʻo ʻave ʻae lelei ʻoe taʻokete ʻiate au; pea ko eni kuo ne toʻo hoku tāpuaki. Pea pehēʻe ia, “Kuo ʻikai ha tāpuaki te ke tuku maʻaku?”

Pea talaange ʻe ʻAisake kia ʻIsoa, ʻo ne pehē; “Vakai mai, kuo u ngaohi ia ko hoʻo ʻeiki, pea ko hono ngaahi kāinga kuo u foaki kiate ia ko ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki: pea kuo u tokoni ʻaki ia ʻae koane mo euaine: pea ko eni, ko e hāte u fai kiate koe hoku foha?”
Pea pehēange ʻe ʻIsoa ki heʻene tamai, “He ʻoku taha pe hoʻo tāpuaki ʻa ʻeku tamai? Ke ke tāpuaki au, ʻio, ko au foki ʻa ʻeku tamai. Pea hiki hake ʻe ʻIsoa hono leʻo, pea tangi.”

Pea pehēange ʻe heʻene tamai ko ʻAisake kiate ia,
“Vakai, ko ho nofoʻanga ʻe ʻi he lelei ʻoe kelekele,
pea mo e hahau ʻoe langi mei ʻolunga.

¶Pea naʻe fehiʻa ʻa ʻIsoa kia Sēkope, koeʻuhi ko e tāpuaki naʻe tāpuaki ʻaki ia ʻe heʻene tamai; pea pehēʻe ʻIsoa ʻi hono loto, Ko eni kuo ofi ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ke tēngihia ʻa ʻeku tamai, pea te u toki tāmateʻi hoku tehina ko Sēkope.

Pea naʻe fakahākia Lepeka ʻae ngaahi lea ʻa ʻene ʻuluaki tama ko ʻIsoa: pea fekau ia ke ui ʻa ʻene tama ki mui ko Sēkope ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Vakai, ko ho taʻokete ko ʻIsoa, ʻoku ne fakafiemālieʻi ia, ʻi heʻene pehē, ke ne tāmateʻi koe.
Pea ko eni ʻeku tama, ke ke muitala ki hoku leʻo; pea ke tuʻu ʻo hola ki hoku tuongaʻane ko Lepani, ʻi Halani;
Pea ke nofo mo ia ʻi he ʻaho niʻihi, ke ʻoua ke ʻosi ʻae ʻita ʻa ho taʻokete.

Ke ʻoua ke afe ʻae ʻita ʻa ho taʻokete meiate koe, pea ʻe ngalo ʻiate ia, ʻaia kuo ke fai kiate ia; pea te u toki fekau ʻo ʻomi koe mei ai: he koeʻumaʻāʻeku masiva ʻiate kimoua ʻosi pe, ʻi he ʻaho pe taha?”

Pea pehēʻe Lepeka kia ʻAisake, “Kuo u fiu ʻi heʻeku moʻui, koeʻuhi ko e ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Heti; he kapau ʻe fili ʻe Sēkope ha ʻunohoʻi he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Heti, ʻo hangēko kinautoluni ʻae ngaahi ʻofefine ʻoe fonua, ko e hāhono ʻaonga ʻo ʻeku moʻui kiate au?”
28: PEA ui ʻe ʻAisake ʻa Sēkope ʻo ne tāpuaki ia, ʻo ne naʻinaʻi kiate ia, mo ne pehēki ai, “ʻOua naʻa ke fili ho ʻunohomei he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Kēnani;
Ka ke tuʻu ʻo ʻalu ki Petanalami, ki he fale ʻo Petueli ko e tamai ʻa hoʻo faʻē; pea ke fili hao ʻunohomei he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Lepani, ko e tuongaʻane ʻo hoʻo faʻē.
Pea ke tāpuaki koe ʻe he ʻOtua Māfimafi, pea fakatupu mo fakatokolahiʻi koe, koeʻuhi ke ke hoko ko e fuʻu kakai tokolahi.
Pea ke tuku kiate koe ʻae tāpuaki ʻo ʻEpalahame, pea ki ho hako foki; koeʻuhi ke ke maʻu ʻae fonua ʻaia ʻoku ke ʻāunofoki ai, ʻaia naʻe foaki ʻe he ʻOtua kia ʻEpalahame.”
Pea naʻe fekau ʻe ʻAisake ʻa Sēkope ke ne ʻalu: pea ʻalu ia ki Petanalami kia Lepani, ko e foha ʻo Petueli ko etangataSilia, ko e tuongaʻane ʻo Lepeka, ko e faʻēʻa Sēkope mo ʻIsoa.

¶Pea ʻi he mamata ʻa ʻIsoa kuo tāpuaki ʻe ʻAisake ʻa Sēkope, ʻo ne fekau ia ke ʻalu ki Petanalami, ke fili moʻona ha ʻunohomei ai; pea mo ʻene tāpuaki ia mo naʻinaʻi kiate ia, ʻo pehē, ʻoua naʻa ke fili ha ʻunohomei he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Kēnani:
Pea mo ʻene talangofua ʻa Sēkope ki heʻene tamai mo ʻene faʻē, pea kuo ʻalu ia ki Petanalami;
Pea ʻi he mamata ʻa ʻIsoa ʻoku ʻikai fiemālie ʻene tamai ko ʻAisake, ʻi he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Kēnani;
Pea ʻalu ʻa ʻIsoa kia ʻIsimeʻeli, ʻo ne fakatokolahi ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻunohonaʻa ne maʻu ʻa Mehalate, ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli, ko e foha ʻo ʻEpalahame, ko e tuofefine ʻo Nepeoti, ke ʻunohomo ia.
¶Pea ʻalu atu ʻa Sēkope mei Peasipa, monefononga ki Halani.
Pea hoko ia ki he potu ʻe taha, pea ne nofo ai ʻi he pōko ia, he kuo tōʻae laʻā; pea ne toʻo ʻae ngaahi maka ʻoe potu ko ia, ke ne ʻolunga ʻaki, pea naʻa ne tokoto ʻi he potu ko ia, ʻo mohe.
Pea misi ia, pea vakai, kuo fokotuʻu ha tuʻunga ki he funga kelekele, pea tau hake hono potu ki he langi, pea vakai, naʻe feʻaluʻaki hake mo hifo ʻi ai ʻae kau ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua.

Pea vakai, naʻe ʻafio ʻa Sihova mei ʻolunga ʻi ai, pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko au ko Sihova, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻEpalahame ko hoʻo tamai, pea ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻAisake: ko e fonua ʻoku ke tokoto ai, te u foaki ia kiate koe, mo ho hako.
Pea ʻe tatau ho hako mo e efu ʻoe kelekele, pea te ke mafola koe ki he lulunga mo e hahake, pea ki he tokelau mo e tonga: pea ʻe monūʻia ʻiate koe mo ho hako, ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga kotoa pēʻo māmani.
Pea vakai, ʻoku ou ʻiate koe, pea te u tauhi koe ʻi hoʻo fononga kotoa pē, pea te u toe ʻomi koe ki he fonua ni: koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai te u siʻaki koe, ka te u fai ʻaia kuo u lea ai kiate koe.”
¶Pea ʻāhake ʻa Sēkope mei heʻene mohe, pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ʻi heni ʻa Sihova; pea naʻe ʻikai te u ʻilo ia.”
Pea naʻe manavahēia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOku fakamanavahēʻae potu ni! ʻOku ʻikai ko ha potu kehe eni, ka ko e fale ʻoe ʻOtua, pea ko eni ʻae matapāʻoe langi.”
Pea tuʻu hengihengi hake pe ʻa Sēkope, pea ne toʻo mai ʻae maka naʻa ne ʻolunga ʻaki, pea ne tōia ko e pou, pea lilingi ʻe ia ʻae lolo ki ai.
Pea ne ui ʻae hingoa ʻoe potu ko ia ko Peteli: ka ko hono hingoa ʻi muʻa ʻoe kolo ko ia ko Lusa.
Pea fai ai ʻe Sēkope ʻae fuakava, ʻo pehē, “Kapau ʻe ʻiate au ʻae ʻOtua, pea ne tauhi au ʻi he hala ni ʻoku ou ʻalu ai, pea ne foaki kiate au ʻa ʻeku meʻakai, mo e ngaahi kofu ke u ai,
Koeʻuhi ke u toe hoko ki he fale ʻo ʻeku tamai ʻi he fiemālie, pehē, te u ʻOtua ʻaki ʻa Sihova;
pea ko e maka ni, ʻaia kuo u tōko e pou, ʻe hoko ia ko e fale ʻoe ʻOtua; pea ʻi he meʻa kotoa pēte ke tuku mai kiate au, te u ʻatu moʻoni hono vahe hongofulu kiate koe.”
29: PEA toe ʻalu ʻa Sēkope ʻi hono fononga, pea naʻe haʻu ia ki he fonua ʻoe kakai hahake.

Pea sio ia, pea ne ʻilo ʻae vai ʻi he ngoue, pea vakai, naʻe ai ʻae vāhenga fanga sipi ʻe tolu, naʻe tokoto ʻo ofi ki ai, he naʻe fakainu ʻae fanga manu mei he vai ko ia: pea naʻe tāpuni ʻaki ʻae ngutu vai ʻae fuʻu maka lahi.
Pea naʻe fakataha ki ai ʻae ngaahi vāhenga sipi kotoa pē: pea nau filifilihi ʻae maka mei he ngutu vai, pea fakainu ʻae fanga sipi, pea naʻe toe ai ʻae maka ki hono potu, ki he ngutu vai.
Pea pehēʻe Sēkope kiate kinautolu, “Kāinga, ʻoku mei fēʻakinautolu?”Pea nau pehē, “Ko e kau Halani ʻakimautolu.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku mou ʻilo ʻa Lepani, ko e foha ʻo Nehoa?”Pea naʻa nau pehē, “ʻOku mau ʻilo ia.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku moʻui ia?”Pea nau pehēange, “ʻOku mālōlōpe: pea vakai, ko Lesieli ko hono ʻofefine, ʻoku haʻu mo e fanga sipi.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Vakai, ʻoku kei hoʻatāpe, pea ʻoku teʻeki ai hokosia ʻae feituʻulaʻāke fakataha ai ʻae fanga manu: ko ia mou fakainu ʻae fanga sipi, pea ʻalu ʻo fafanga.”
Pea naʻa nau pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te mau faʻa fai, kaeʻoua ke fakataha mai ʻae vāhenga sipi kotoa pē, pea ʻoua ke filifilihi ʻae maka mei he ngutu vai; pea te mau toki fakainu ʻae fanga sipi.”
¶Pea lolotonga ʻenau alea mo e haʻu ʻa Lesieli mo e fanga sipi ʻa ʻene tamai, he naʻa ne tauhi ki ai.

Pea ʻi he mamata ʻa Sēkope kia Lesieli ko e ʻofefine ʻo Lepani, ko e tuongaʻane ʻo ʻene faʻē, mo e fanga sipi ʻa Lepani, ko e tuongaʻane ʻo ʻene faʻē, naʻe ʻunuʻunu atu ʻa Sēkope ʻo ne tekaʻi ʻae maka mei he ngutu vai, pea ne fakainu ʻae fanga sipi ʻa Lepani, ko e tuongaʻane ʻo ʻene faʻē.
Pea uma ʻa Sēkope kia Lesieli, pea hiki hake hono leʻo, pea tangi.
Pea talaange ʻe Sēkope kia Lesieli, “Ko e kāinga ia ʻo ʻene tamai, pea ko e tama ia ʻa Lepeka:”pea naʻe lele ia ʻo fakahāki heʻene tamai.

Pea kuo fanongo ʻa Lepani ki he talanoa kia Sēkope, “Ko e tama ʻa hono tuofefine,”pea naʻe lele ia ke fakafetaulakikiate ia, pea ne fāʻufua ia, ʻo ʻuma kiate ia, mo ne ʻomi ia ki hono fale. Pea talanoa ʻe ia kia Lepani, ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē.
Pea pehēʻe Lepani kiate ia, Ko e moʻoni ko hoku hui koe, mo hoku kakano. Pea naʻa ne nofo kiate ia ʻi he māhina ʻe taha.
¶Pea pehēʻe Lepani kia Sēkope, “He ʻoku totonu koāke ke ngāue kiate au taʻehatotongi koeʻuhi ko hoku kāinga koe? Tala mai, ko e hāʻae totongi ʻe fai kiate koe?”
Pea naʻe toko ua ʻae ʻofefine ʻo Lepani; ko e hingoa ʻoe ʻuluaki ko Lia, pea ko e hingoa ʻoe kimui ko Lesieli.
Naʻe mata kuikuiʻa Lia, ka naʻe hoihoifua ʻa Lesieli, mo matamatalelei.
Pea naʻe ʻofa ʻa Sēkope kia Lesieli, pea ne pehē, “Te u tauhi ko e ʻi he taʻu ʻe fitu, ka ke tuku mai ʻa Lesieli, ko ho ʻofefine kimui.”
Pea pehēʻe Lepani, “ʻOku lelei lahi ʻeku foaki ia kiate koe, ʻi heʻeku foaki ia ki ha tangata kehe: ke ta nonofo mo au.”
¶Pea naʻe ngāue ʻa Sēkope ʻi he taʻu ʻe fitu, ke ne maʻu ʻa Lesieli; pea naʻe tatau ia kiate ia mo e ʻaho siʻi pe, koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻofa lahi kiate ia.
Pea naʻe pehēʻe Sēkope kia Lepani, “Tuku mai hoku ʻunohokoeʻuhi ke u ʻalu atu kiate ia, he kuo kakato ʻa hoku ngaahi ʻaho.”
Pea fakataha ʻe Lepani ʻae kau tangata kotoa pēʻoe potu, pea ne fai ʻae kātoanga.
Pea ʻi heʻene hoko ki he pō, naʻa ne ʻave hono ʻofefine ko Lia, ʻo ne ʻomi ia kiate ia; pea ʻalu ia kiate ia.
Pea ne foaki ki hono ʻofefine ko Lia, ʻa ʻene kaunanga ko Silipa, ke kaunangakiate ia.
Pea pongipongi hake ai, pea vakai, pea tāko Lia ia: pea pehēʻe ia kia Lepani, “Ko e hāeni kuo ke fai kiate au? ʻIkai naʻaku ngāue kiate koe koeʻuhi ko Lesieli? Pea ko e hākuo ke kākaaʻi ai au?”
Pea pehēʻe Lepani, “E ʻikai fai ha meʻa pehēʻi homau fonua, ke tomuʻa foaki ʻae kimui ʻi he ʻuluaki.
Ka ke fakakakato ʻa hono uike, pea te mau foaki ia foki kiate koe, ʻoka ke ka toe ngāue kiate au, ʻi ha taʻu ʻe fitu kehe.”
Pea naʻe fai ia ʻe Sēkope; ʻo ne fakakakato hono uike: pea ne foaki kiate ia hono ʻofefine ko Lesieli, ko hono ʻunohofoki.
Pea foaki ʻe Lepani ki hono ʻofefine ko Lesieli ʻa Pila, ko ʻene kaunanga, ke kaunanga kiate ia.
Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa Sēkope kia Lesieli, pea ʻofa lahi hake ʻe ia kia Lesieli ia Lia, pea naʻa ne toe ngāue kiate ia ʻi he taʻu ʻe fitu.
¶Pea ʻafioʻi ʻe Sihova kuo fehiʻanekina ʻa Lia, pea naʻa ne ngaohi ia ke faʻa fānau; ka naʻe paʻa ʻa Lesieli.
Pea feitama ʻa Lia, pea ne fāʻeleʻi ʻae tama, pea ui hono hingoa ko Lupeni; he naʻe pehēʻe ia, “Ko e moʻoni kuo ʻafioʻi ʻe Sihova ʻeku mamahi; pea ko eni ʻe ʻofa hoku ʻunohokiate au.”
Pea naʻe toe feitama ia pea fāʻeleʻi ʻae tama: ʻo ne pehē, “He kuo fanongo ʻa Sihova kuo fehiʻanekina au, ko ia kuo ne foaki kiate au ʻae tama ni foki: pea ne ui hono hingoa ko Simione.”

Pea toe feitama ia, pea fāʻeleʻi ʻae tama: pea pehēʻe ia; “Ko eni ʻe tokanga hoku ʻunohokiate au ʻi he kuongani, koeʻuhi kuo u fanauʻi kiate ia ʻae tama ʻe toko tolu; ko ia naʻe ui ai hono hingoa ko Livai.”
Pea toe feitama ia, pea fāʻeleʻi ʻae tama: pea pehēʻe ia, Ko eni te u fakafetaʻi kia Sihova: ko ia naʻa ne ui hono hingoa ko Siuta: pea naʻe ngata ai ʻene fānau.
30: PEA ʻi he mamata ʻa Lesieli ʻoku ʻikai haʻa ne fānau kia Sēkope, naʻe meheka ia ki hono taʻokete: pea pehēʻe ia kia Sēkope, “Tuku mai ha fānau kiate au, telia naʻaku mate.”
Pea tupu ai ʻae loto ʻo Sēkope kia Lesieli: pea pehēʻe ia, “He ko e ʻOtua au, ʻaia kuo ne taʻofi meiate koe ʻae fua ʻoe manāva?”
Ka naʻe pehēange ʻe ia, “Vakai ki heʻeku kaunanga ko Pila, ke ke ʻalu kiate ia: pea te ne fānau ʻi hoku ongo tui koeʻuhi ke u maʻu ha fānau ʻiate ia.
Pea ne foaki kiate ia ʻene kaunanga ko Pila ko hono ʻunoho, pea ʻalu ʻa Sēkope kiate ia.
Pea naʻe tuituʻia ʻa Pila, pea fānau kia Sēkope ʻae tama.”
Pea pehēʻe Lesieli, “Kuo fakamaau au ʻe he ʻOtua, mo ne fanongo ki hoku leʻo, pea kuo ne foaki kiate au ʻae tama ko ia naʻa ne ui ai hono hingoa ko Tani.”
Pea toe feitama ʻa Pila, ko e kaunanga ʻa Lesieli, pea ne fānau kia Sēkope ʻae tama ko hono tokoua.
Pea pehēʻe Lesieli, “ʻI he ʻahiʻahi lahi, naʻa ma ʻahiʻahi mo hoku taʻokete, pea kuo u lavaʻi: pea ne ui hono hingoa ko Nafitalai.”
Pea ʻi he mamata ʻa Lia kuo ngata ʻene fānau, pea ʻave ʻe ia ʻene kaunanga ko Silipa, ʻo ne ʻatu ia kia Sēkope ko hono ʻunoho.
Pea ko Silipa, ko e kaunanga ʻa Lia, naʻa ne fānau kia Sēkope ʻae tama.
Pea pehēʻe Lia, “ʻOku haʻu ʻae tokolahi: pea ne ui hono hingoa ko Kata.”
Pea ko Silipa ko e kaunanga ʻa Lia, naʻa ne fānau kia Sēkope ʻae tama ʻe taha.
Pea pehēʻe Lia, “ʻOku monūʻia au, ʻe ui au ʻe he ngaahi ʻofefine ko e monūʻia pea ne ui hono hingoa ko ʻAseli.”

¶Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa Lupeniʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻoeututaʻu uite, pea ne ʻilo ʻae ngaahi tutai ʻi he ngoue, pea ne ʻomi ia ki heʻene faʻēko Lia. Pea pehēʻe Lesieli kia Lia, “ʻOku ou kole ke ke tuku mai foki, mei he ngaahi tutai ʻa hoʻo tama.”

Pea talaange ʻe ia kiate ia, “He ko e meʻa siʻi ia, hao faʻao hoku ʻunoho? Pea te ke toʻo mo e ngaahi tutai ʻa ʻeku tama foki?”Pea pehēʻe Lesieli, “E mohe ia mo koe he poōni, koeʻuhi ko e tutai ʻa hoʻo tama.”

Pea haʻu ʻa Sēkope mei he ngoue ʻi he efiafi, pea ʻalu ʻa Lia ke fakafetaulakikiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “Ke ke haʻu kiate au; he ko e moʻoni kuo u fakatau koe ʻaki ʻae ngaahi tutai ʻa ʻeku tama.”Pea ne na mohe ʻi he pōko ia.
Pea naʻe ʻafio ʻae ʻOtua kia Lia, pea feitama ia, pea ne fāʻeleʻi kia Sēkope ʻae tama ʻe taha, ko hono toko nima ia.
Pea pehēʻe Lia, “Kuo tuku mai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae totongi, koeʻuhi ʻi heʻeku foaki ʻeku kaunanga ki hoku ʻunoho: pea ne ui hono hingoa ko ʻIsaka.”
Pea toe feitama ʻa Lia, pea fānau kia Sēkope ʻae tama ko hono toko ono ia.
Pea pehēʻe Lia, “Kuo ʻomi ʻe he ʻOtua kiate au ʻae koloa lelei; ko eni ʻe toki fie nofo hoku ʻunohokiate au, koeʻuhi kuo u fanauʻi kiate ia, ʻae tama ʻe toko ono: pea ne ui hono hingoa ko Sepuloni.”
Pea ne toki fānau kiate ia ʻae taʻahine, pea ne ui hono hingoa ko Taina.
¶Pea naʻe manatuʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa Lesieli, ʻo ne tokanga kiate ia, pea ne ngaohi ia ke ne faʻa fānau.
Pea feitama ia, pea fanauʻi ʻae tama; pea pehēʻe ia, “Kuo toʻo ʻo ʻave ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa hoku manukia:”
Pea naʻa ne ui hono hingoa ko Siosefa: ʻo ne pehē, “E ʻomi kiate au ʻe Sihova ʻae tama ʻe taha.”
¶Pea kuo fāʻeleʻi ʻe Lesieli ʻa Siosefa, pea lea ʻa Sēkope kia Lepani, ʻo pehē, “Tuku au ke u ʻalu, koeʻuhi ke u ʻalu ki hoku potu, mo hoku fonua.
Tuku mai hoku ngaahi ʻunoho, mo ʻeku fānau, ʻakinautolunaʻaku ngāue ai kiate koe, pea ke tuku ke u ʻalu: he ʻoku ke ʻilo ʻae ngāue kuo u fai kiate koe.”
Pea kole ʻa Lepani, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia: “Kapau kuo u ʻofeina ʻi ho ʻao, ke ke nofo pe; he kuo u ʻilo pau kuo tāpuakiʻi au ʻe Sihova, koeʻuhi ko koe.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, ”Tala mai hao totongi, pea te u ʻatu ia.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate ia, “ʻOku ke ʻilo pe naʻe fēfēʻeku ngāue kiate koe, pea mo e ʻiate au ʻa hoʻo fanga manu.”
He naʻa ke maʻu siʻi pe, ʻi he teʻeki ai te u haʻu au pea ko eni kuo tupu ia ʻo lahi ʻaupitopea kuo tāpuaki koe ʻe Sihova talu ʻeku haʻu: pea ko eni, teu tokonaki afe, ki hoku fale foki ʻoʻoku?”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e hāte u foaki kiate koe?”Pea pehēʻe Sēkope, “E ʻikai te ke foaki mai ha meʻa ʻe taha: ka ko eni kapau te ke fai ʻae meʻa ni kiate au, te u toe fafanga mo tauhi hoʻo fanga manu:

Te u ʻalu ki hoʻo fanga manu he ʻaho ni, ʻo vaheʻi mei ai ʻae ilaila mo e pulepule, pea mo e fanga manu kelo mei he fanga sipi, pea mo e ilaila mo e pulepule mei he fanga kosi: pea ʻe ʻi he fanga manu pehēʻa ʻeku totongi.

Pea ʻe hāai ʻa ʻeku angatonu ʻamui, ʻoka hoko ia ko ʻeku totongi ʻi ho ʻao; ko ia kotoa pēʻe ʻiate au ʻoku ʻikai ilaila mo pulepule ʻi he fanga kosi, mo ia ʻoku ʻikai kelo ʻi he fanga sipi, ʻe lau ia ko ʻeku kaihaʻa.”
Pea pehēange ʻe Lepani, “Ko hoku loto ke fai ʻo hangēko hoʻo lea.”

Pea ne vaheʻi ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻae fanga kosi tangata naʻe ilaila mo pulepule, pea mo e kosi fefine naʻe lavatea mo pulepule, pea ko ia kotoa pēnaʻe hinehina hano potu, pea mo e kelo kotoa pēmei he fanga sipi, pea naʻa ne tuku ia ki he nima ʻo hono ngaahi foha.
Pea naʻa ne fakamamaʻo mo Sēkope, ʻi he fononga mei ai ʻi he ʻaho ʻe tolu; pea tauhi ʻe Sēkope hono toe ʻoe fanga manu ʻa Lepani.
Pea naʻe toʻo mai ʻe Sēkope ʻae ngaahi vaʻa ʻakau hinehina mo mata, ko e ʻakau ko e futu pea mo e ifi; pea ne fohifohiʻi hono kili, koeʻuhi ke hāmai ʻae ngaahi potu hinehina ʻi he ʻakau.
Pea naʻa ne tuku ʻae ngaahi vaʻa ʻakau naʻa ne fohifohiʻi ʻi he tafeʻanga vai, mo e ngaahi tukuʻanga vai, ʻi he haʻu ʻae fanga manu ke inu, koeʻuhi ke nau tuituʻia ʻi heʻenau haʻu ke inu.
Pea naʻe tuituʻia ʻae fanga manu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi vaʻa ʻakau, pea fanauʻi ʻae ʻuhikikuo lavatea mo pulepule, mo ilaila.

Pea vavahe ʻe Sēkope ʻae fanga lami, pea ne fakahanga ʻae mata ʻoe fanga manu ki he lavatea, pea mo e faʻahinga kelo kotoa pēʻi he fanga manu ʻa Lepani; pea ne tuku kehe pe ʻene fanga manu ʻaʻana, mei he fanga manu ʻa Lepani.
Pea naʻe pehē, ʻi he tuituʻia ʻae manu mālohi, naʻe tuku ʻe Sēkope ʻae ngaahi vaʻa ʻakau ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fanga manu ʻi he tafeʻanga vai, koeʻuhi ke nau tuituʻia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi ʻakau.
Ka naʻe ʻikai te ne ai ʻae ʻakau ki he ʻao ʻoe fanga manu vaivai: ko ia naʻe ia Lepani ʻae vaivai, pea naʻe ia Sēkope ʻae mālohi.
Pea naʻe tupu ke koloaʻia ʻaupitoʻae tangata, pea lahi ʻene fanga manu, mo e kau kaunanga, mo e kau tamaioʻeiki, mo e fanga kāmeli, mo e fanga ʻasi.
31: PEA fanongo ia ki he lea ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Lepani, ʻo pehē, “Kuo toʻo ʻe Sēkope ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pēʻa ʻetau tamai; pea kuo ne maʻu ʻae nāunau ni kotoa pēʻi he meʻa ʻa ʻetau tamai.”
Pea naʻe mamata ʻa Sēkope ki he mata ʻo Lepani, pea vakai, naʻe ʻikai lelei ia kiate ia ʻo hangēko ia ʻi muʻa.
Pea pehēʻe Sihova kia Sēkope, “Foki atu ki he fonua ʻo hoʻo ngaahi tamai mo ho ngaahi kāinga; pea te u ʻiate koe.”
Pea ʻalu ʻa Sēkope ʻo ne ui mai ʻa Lesieli mo Lia kiate ia ki he ngoue, ki he fanga manu.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinaua, “ʻOku ou sio ki he mata ʻo hoʻomo tamai ʻoku ʻikai kei ʻiate au, ʻo hangēko ia ʻi muʻa; ka kuo ʻiate au ʻae ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku tamai.
Pea ʻoku mo ʻilo naʻaku ngāue ki hoʻomo tamai, ʻaki ʻa ʻeku mālohi kotoa.
Pea kuo kākaaʻi au ʻe hoʻomo tamai, mo ne fakakehe ʻeku totongi ʻo liunga hongofulu; ka naʻe ʻikai tuku ia ʻe he ʻOtua ke u kovi ai.

Kapau naʻa ne pehēʻe ia, ‘Ke ʻoʻou ʻae pulepule ko hoʻo totongi,’pea fānau leva ʻae fanga manu kotoa pēko e pulepule: pea kapau naʻa ne pehē, ‘Ko hoʻo totongi ʻae ilaila;’pea fānau leva ʻae fanga manu kotoa pēko e ilaila.
Ko ia kuo toʻo ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae fanga manu ʻa hoʻomo tamai ʻo foaki ia kiate au.
“Pea ʻi he tuituʻia ʻae fanga manu, naʻaku hanga hake hoku mata, ʻo mamata ʻi he misi, pea vakai, ko e fanga sipitangata, naʻe hopo ki he fanga manu naʻe ilaila mo e pulepule mo e kelo.
Pea lea ʻae ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua kiate au ʻi he misi, ʻo pehē, ‘Sēkope:’pea naʻaku pehē, ‘Ko au eni.’

Pea pehēʻe ia, “Hanga hake eni ho mata”, ʻo vakai, ‘Ko e fanga sipitangata ʻoku hopo ki he fanga manu, ko e ilaila mo e pulepule, mo e kelo; he kuo u mamata ki he meʻa kotoa pēʻoku fai ʻe Lepani kiate koe.
Ko au ko e ʻOtua ʻo Peteli, ʻaia naʻa ke fakatapui ai ʻae pou, mo ke fai ʻae fuakava kiate au; pea ko eni, ke ke tuʻu, pea ke ʻalu ʻi he fonua ni, ʻo toe ʻalu ki he fonua ʻo ho ngaahi kāinga.’|”
Pea pehēange ʻe Lesieli mo Lia kiate ia, “He ʻoku kei ai ha ʻinasi pe tufakanga kiate kimaua ʻi he fale ʻoe ma tamai?
‌ʻIkai kuo ne lau ʻakimaua ko e ongo muli? He kuo ne fakatau ʻakimaua, pea kuo ne fakaʻosiʻosi foki ʻe ma paʻanga.
He ko e koloa kotoa pēkuo toʻo ʻe he ʻOtua mei heʻetau tamai ʻoku ʻatautoluia, pea mo e tau fānau: pea ko eni, ko e meʻa kotoa pēkuo lea ʻaki ʻe he ʻOtua kiate koe, ke ke fai.”
Pea tuʻu hake ʻa Sēkope, ʻo ne fakaheka ʻa ʻene fānau, mo hono ngaahi ʻunohoki he fanga kāmeli;

Pea naʻa ne ʻave ʻene fanga manu kotoa pē, mo ʻene meʻa kotoa pēʻaia naʻa ne maʻu, ʻae fanga manu naʻe tupu kiate ia, ʻaia naʻa ne maʻu ʻi Petanalami, ke ʻalu ia ki heʻene tamai ko ʻAisake ki he fonua ko Kēnani.
Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa Lepani ke kosi ʻene fanga sipi: pea naʻe kaihaʻasi ʻe Lesieli ʻae ngaahi tamapua ʻa ʻene tamai.
Pea ʻalu fakafufūpe ʻa Sēkope meia Lepani, ko etangataSilia, he naʻe ʻikai te ne tala kiate ia ʻene hola.
Ko ia naʻe hola ia mo ʻene meʻa kotoa pē: pea tuʻu hake ia ʻo ne laka ʻi he vaitafe, pea hanga hono mata ki he moʻunga ko Kiliate.
¶Pea ʻi hono tolu ʻoe ʻaho, naʻe fakahākia Lepani, ʻae hola ʻa Sēkope.
Pea naʻa ne ʻalu mo hono kāinga tangata, pea nau tuli ia ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu; pea naʻa nau maʻu ia ʻi he moʻunga ko Kiliate.
Pea naʻe hāʻele mai ʻae ʻOtua kia Lepani ko etangataSilia, ʻi he misi ʻi he pō, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Vakai, ʻoua naʻa ke lea kia Sēkope ʻi he lelei pe ʻi he kovi.”
¶Pea maʻu ʻe Lepani ʻa Sēkope. He naʻe fokotuʻu ʻe Sēkope hono fale fehikitaki ʻi he moʻunga; pea pehēfoki ʻa Lepani mo hono kāinga, naʻa nau fokotuʻu fale fehikitaki ʻi he moʻunga ko Kiliate.
Pea pehēʻe Lepani kia Sēkope, “Ko e hāeni kuo ke fai, koeʻuhi kuo ke ʻalu fakafokifāpe, mo ke ʻave hoku ngaahi ʻofefine, ʻo hangēko e ngaahi pōpula kuo maʻu ʻaki ʻae heletā?
Ko e hākuo ke hola fakafufūai, hangēha kaihaʻa meiate au: pea naʻe ʻikai te ke tala kiate au, koeʻuhi ke u tuku ko e ke ʻalu ʻi he fiefia, mo e fai hiva, mo e tāʻae lali mo e haʻape?
Pea naʻe ʻikai te ke tuku ke u uma ki ho ngaahi foha, mo hoku ngaahi ʻofefine? Kuo ke fai vale ʻi hoʻo fai pehē.
‌ʻOku ai ʻae mālohi ʻi hoku nima ke fai kovi kiate koe: ka ko e ʻOtua ʻo hoʻo tamai naʻa ne folofola mai kiate au ʻanepō, ʻo pehē, ‘Vakai, ʻoua naʻa ke lea kia Sēkope, ʻi he lelei, pe ʻi he kovi.’
Pea ko eni, naʻe totonu hoʻo holi ke ʻalu, he ʻoku ke holi ki he fale ʻo hoʻo tamai, ka ko e hākuo ke kaihaʻa ai hoku ngaahi ʻotua?”
Pea lea ʻa Sēkope, ʻo ne pehēkia Lepani, “Koeʻuhi naʻaku manavahē, he naʻaku pehē, telia naʻa ke toʻo fakamālohi pe, ʻa ho ngaahi ʻofefine ʻiate au.

Pea ko ia te ke ʻilo ki ai ʻa ho ngaahi ʻotua ke ʻoua naʻa moʻui ia; ʻi he ʻao ʻo ho ta kāinga, ke ke vakai ʻae meʻa ʻaʻau, pea ke toʻo ia kiate koe.”He naʻe ʻikai ʻilo ʻe Sēkope kuo kaihaʻasi ia ʻe Lesieli.

Pea hūatu ʻa Lepani ki he fale fehikitaki ʻo Sēkope, mo e fale fehikitaki ʻo Lia, pea mo e fale fehikitaki ʻe ua ʻoe ongo kaunanga; ka naʻe ʻikai te ne ʻilo ia. Pea ʻalu ia mei he fale fehikitaki ʻo Lia, mo ne hūki he fale fehikitaki ʻo Lesieli.
Ka kuo toʻo ʻe Lesieli ʻae ngaahi tamapua, ʻo ne ʻai ia ki he nāunau ʻoe fanga kāmeli, pea heka ai ia. Pea kumi ʻe Lepani ʻi he potu kotoa pēʻoe fale fehikitaki, ka naʻe ʻikai te ne ʻilo ia.

Pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene tamai. “Ke ʻoua naʻa tuputāmaki ʻa ʻeku ʻeiki, koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻikai te u faʻa tuʻu; he ʻoku ʻiate au ʻae anga fakafefine.”Pea naʻe kumi ia, ka naʻe ʻikai te ne ʻilo ʻae ngaahi tamapua.
Pea naʻe ʻita ʻa Sēkope ʻo lea lahi kia Lepani: pea lea ʻa Sēkope ʻo pehē, kia Lepani, “Ko e hāʻeku fai kovi? Pea ko e hāʻeku angahala koeʻuhi ke ke tuli ai au ʻi he lili ni?
He kuo ke kumi ʻi heʻeku meʻa kotoa pē, pea ko e hāhao meʻa kuo ke ʻiloʻi? Fokotuʻu ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo hoku kāinga, mo ho kāinga, koeʻuhi ke nau fakamaau kiate kitaua.
Naʻaku ʻiate koe ʻi he taʻu ʻeuofulu ni, naʻe ʻikai ʻuhimate ʻa hoʻo fanga sipi fefine, mo e fanga kosi fefine, pea ko e sipitangata ʻo hoʻo fanga manu, naʻe ʻikai te u kai.
Ko ia naʻe kai ʻe he manu fekai naʻe ʻikai te u ʻomi kiate koe: naʻaku totongi ia; naʻa ke maʻu ʻae totongi ʻo ia ʻi hoku nima, kapau naʻe kaihaʻa ia ʻi he ʻaho, pe ʻi he pō.
Naʻaku pehēau, pea naʻe fakavaivai au ʻe he pupuhaʻi he ʻaho, mo e momoko ʻi he pō; pea mahuʻi ʻae mohe mei hoku mata.

Kuo u pehēni ʻi he taʻu ʻeuofulu ʻi ho fale; naʻaku tauhi koe ʻi he taʻu ʻe hongofulu ma fā, koeʻuhi ko ho ongo ʻofefine, mo e taʻu ʻe ono ki hoʻo fanga manu; pea kuo ke fakakehe ʻeku totongi ʻo liunga hongofulu.

Ka ne ʻikai ʻiate au ʻae ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku tamai, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻEpalahame, mo e manavahēkia ʻAisake, pehēkuo ke fekau au ke u ʻalu taʻehaʻakumeʻa.”Kuo ʻafioʻi ʻe he ʻOtua hoku tautea, mo e ngāue ʻa hoku nima, pea ne valoki ko e ʻanepō.

¶Pea pehēmai ʻa Lepani kia Sēkope, “Ko e ngaahi ʻofefine ni, ko hoku ngaahi ʻofefine, pea ko e tamaiki ni, ko ʻeku fānau, pea ko e fanga manu ni, ko ʻeku fanga manu, pea ko e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ke mamata ki ai ʻoku ʻaʻaku ia: pea ko e hānai te u fai he ʻaho ni, ki hoku ongo ʻofefine ni, mo e na fānau kuo na fanauʻi?
Ko eni ke ke haʻu, ke ta fai ʻae fuakava, ʻa koe mo au; pea tuku ia ko e fakamoʻoni kiate kitaua.”
Pea toʻo ʻe Sēkope ʻae maka, ʻo ne fokotuʻu ia ko e pou.
Pea pehēʻe Sēkope ki hono kāinga, “Tānaki ʻae ngaahi maka; pea naʻa nau toʻo ʻae ngaahi maka ʻo fokotuʻu; pea naʻa nau kai ʻi ai, ʻi he fanga maka.”
Pea ui ia ʻe Lepani, ko Sekaa Satuta; ka naʻe ui ia ʻe Sēkope, ko Kaleti.
Pea pehēʻe Lepani, “Ko e fokotuʻunga maka ni, ko e fakamoʻoni kiate koe mo au he ʻaho ni. Ko ia naʻe ui ai hono hingoa ko Kaleti mo Misipa.”
He naʻe pehēʻe ia, “Ke leʻohi ʻe Sihova kiate au mo koe, ʻi he ʻe ta māvae.
Kapau te ke fakamamahi hoku ongo ʻofefine, pea kapau te ke toʻo maʻau ha ʻunohokehe, mo hoku ongo ʻofefine, ʻoku ʻikai ha tangata ʻi heni; kae vakai, ko e fakamoʻoni ʻae ʻOtua kiate kitaua:”
Pea pehēʻe Lepani kia Sēkope, “Vakai ki he ngaahi maka ni, mo e pou ʻaia kuo tuku ʻi ho ta vahaʻa;
Ke fakamoʻoni ʻe he ʻesi ni, mo e pou ni, ʻe ʻikai te u laka ʻi he potu ʻoe ʻesi ni kiate koe, pea ʻe ʻikai te ke laka ʻi he ʻesi ni kiate au, ke fai ha kovi.
Ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻEpalahame, mo e ʻOtua ʻo Nehoa, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻena tamai, fakamaau kiate kitaua.”Pea naʻe fuakava ʻa Sēkope, ʻi he manavahēʻo ʻene tamai ko ʻAisake.
Pea feilaulau ʻa Sēkope ʻi he moʻunga, pea naʻa ne ui hono kāinga ke nau kai: pea naʻa nau kai ʻae mā, pea nau mohe ʻi he moʻunga ʻi he pōko ia.
Pea tuʻu hengihengi hake pe ʻa Lepani, mo ne uma ki hono ngaahi foha, mo hono ongo ʻofefine, ʻo ne tāpuaki ʻakinautolu; pea ʻalu ʻa Lepani, ʻo toe foki ki hono potu.
32: PEA naʻe ʻalu ʻa Sēkope ʻi hono hala, pea fakafetaulakimai kiate ia ʻae kau ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua.
Pea kuo mamata ʻa Sēkope kiate kinautolu, pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e kau tau eni ʻae ʻOtua: pea naʻa ne ui ʻae hingoa ʻoe potu ko ia, ko Mehanemi.”
¶Pea fekau ʻe Sēkope ʻae kau talafekau ke muʻomuʻa ʻiate ia ki hono taʻokete ko ʻIsoa, ʻi he fonua ko Seia, ʻi he fonua ko ʻItomi.
Pea ne fekau kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “Te mou lea pehēki hoku ʻeiki ko ʻIsoa; ʻoku pehēmai ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ko Sēkope, Naʻaku nofo ʻāunofomo Lepani peau nofo mo ia ʻo aʻu ki he kuongani.
Pea kuo u maʻu ʻae fanga pulu mo e fanga ʻasi mo e ngaahi fanga manu, mo e kau tangata tauhi, mo e kau fefine tauhi, pea kuo u fekau ke fakahāia ki hoku ʻeiki, koeʻuhi ke u lelei ʻi ho ʻao.”
¶Pea toe liu mai ʻae kau tangata kia Sēkope, ʻo nau pehē, “Naʻa mau hoko ki ho taʻokete ko ʻIsoa, pea vakai, ʻoku haʻu ia foki ke fakafetaulakimai kiate koe, mo e kau tangata ʻe fāngeau.”
Pea naʻe manavahēai ʻa Sēkope, ʻo mamahi lahi: pea ne vaeua ʻae kakai naʻe ʻiate ia, pea mo e fanga sipi, mo e fanga manu lalahi, pea mo e fanga kāmeli.
Pea ne pehē, “Kapau ʻe haʻu ʻa ʻIsoa ki he kakai ʻe taha ʻo taaʻi ia, pea ko e kakai ʻe toe te nau hao.”
¶Pea pehēʻe Sēkope, “E ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku tamai ko ʻEpalahame, mo e ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku tamai ko ʻAisake, ko e ʻEiki naʻa ke pehēmai kiate au, ‘Toe ʻalu ki ho fonua mo ho kāinga, pea te u fai lelei kiate koe:’

‌ʻOku ʻikai te u taau au, mo e siʻi hifo ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻofa kotoa pē, mo e moʻoni kotoa pē, ʻaia kuo ke fakahāki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki: he naʻaku ʻalu mo hoku tokotoko pe ʻi he Sioatani ni; ka ko eni, kuo u hoko ko e kakai ʻe ua.
‌ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, fakahaofi au mei he nima ʻo hoku taʻokete mei he nima ʻo ʻIsoa: he ʻoku ou manavahēkiate ia, telia naʻa ne haʻu ʻo taaʻi au, pea mo e fale mo e fānau.
Pea naʻa ke pehē, ‘Te u fai lelei kiate koe, ʻo ngaohi ho hako ke tatau mo e ʻoneʻone ʻoe tahi, ʻaia ʻe ʻikai faʻa lau hono lahi.’|”
¶Pea mohe ia ʻi ai ʻi he pōko ia pea naʻa ne fili mai ʻaia naʻe ofi kiate ia, ko e meʻaʻofa ki hono taʻokete ko ʻIsoa;
Ko e kosi fefine ʻeuangeau mo e kosi tangata ʻeuofulu, mo e sipi fefine ʻeuangeau, mo e sipitangata ʻeuofulu.
Ko e kāmeli huhu ʻe tolungofulu mo honau ʻuhiki, mo e fanga pulu fefine ʻe fāngofulu, mo e pulu tangata ʻe hongofulu, mo e ʻasi fefine ʻeuofulu mo e ʻuhikiʻe hongofulu.
Pea ne tuku fakafaʻahinga ia ki he nima ʻoe kau tauhi, pea ne pehēki heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, “Mou muʻomuʻa ʻiate au, ʻo fakavahavaha ʻae faʻahinga manu taki taha.”
Pea fekau ia ki he ʻuluaki, ʻo pehē, “ʻOka fakafetaulakimai hoku taʻokete ko ʻIsoa kiate koe, ʻo fehuʻi kiate koe, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko hai koe?’pea, ‘ʻOku ke ʻalu ki fē?’Pea ʻoku ʻa hai ʻena ʻi ho ʻao?
Pea ke lea ʻo pehē, ‘Ko e meʻa ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ko Sēkope, pea ko e meʻaʻofa ia kuo ne fekau ki hoku ʻeiki ko ʻIsoa; pea vakai, ʻoku ne muimuimai.’|”
Pea naʻa ne fekau pehēki hono toko ua, mo hono toko tolu, mo kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe muimuiki he fanga manu, ʻo pehē, “Te mou lea pehēki hoku ʻeiki ko ʻIsoa, ʻoka mou ka fetaulakimo ia.

Pea te mou pehēfoki, ‘Vakai, ʻoku muimuimai ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ko Sēkope.’|”He naʻe pehēʻe ia, “Te u fakafiemālieʻi ia ʻaki ʻae meʻaʻofa, ʻe muʻomuʻa ʻiate au, pea te u toki mamata ki hono mata; heiʻilo pe te ne maʻu lelei au.”
Ko ia naʻe ʻave ai ʻae meʻaʻofa, ʻo nau muʻomuʻa ʻiate ia ki he kauvai ʻe taha; pea mohe ia ʻi he pōko ia mo e kakai.
Pea tuʻu hake ia ʻi he pōko ia ʻo ne ʻave hono ongo ʻunoho, mo ʻene ongo kaunanga, mo hono ngaahi foha ʻe toko hongofulu ma tokotaha, pea nau aʻa ʻi he aʻaʻanga ko Sapoki.
Pea naʻa ne ʻave ʻakinautoluʻo fekau ke nau aʻa ki he kauvai ʻe taha, pea ne ʻave mo ʻene meʻa kotoa pē.
¶Ka naʻe nofo tokotaha pe ʻa Sēkope; pea naʻe ai ʻae tangata naʻa na fefaʻuhi mo ia ʻo aʻu ki he mafoa ʻae ata.
Pea ʻi heʻene mamata ʻoku ʻikai te ne mālohi kiate ia, naʻa ne alasi ʻae tefito tupu ʻo Sēkope: pea naʻe homo ʻae tenga ʻo Sēkope, ʻi he ʻena fefaʻuhi mo ia.
Pea naʻa ne pehē, “Tuku au ke u ʻalu, he kuo maʻa ʻae ʻaho;”pea ne pehē, “E ʻikai te u tukuangekoe ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai te ke tāpuaki au.”
Pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Ko hai ho hingoa?”Pea ne pehē, “Ko Sēkope.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “E ʻikai toe ui ho hingoa ko Sēkope, ka ko ʻIsileli: he ʻoku hangēko ha ʻeiki ʻa hoʻo fai mālohi ki he ʻOtua, mo e tangata, pea kuo ke lavaʻi.”
Pea fehuʻi ʻe Sēkope kiate ia, ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke tala mai ho hingoa. Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e hāʻoku ke fehuʻi ai ki hoku hingoa?”Pea naʻa ne tāpuaki ia ʻi ai.
Pea ne ui ʻe Sēkope ʻae hingoa ʻoe potu ko ia, ko Penieli. He kuo u mamata ki he ʻOtua, ko e mata ki he mata, ka ʻoku ou kei moʻui.
Pea ʻi heʻene ʻalu ʻi Penieli, naʻe hopo ʻae laʻā, pea naʻe ketu ia koeʻuhi ko hono tenga.
Ko ia naʻe ʻikai kai ai ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻae uoua naʻe alasi, ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he aoʻi tenga, ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho ni: koeʻuhi naʻa ne alasi ʻae aoʻi tupu ʻo Sēkope ʻi he uoua naʻe mingi.
33: PEA hanga hake ʻa Sēkope ʻo sio, pea vakai, naʻe haʻu ʻa ʻIsoa, mo e kau tangata ʻe toko fāngeau. Pea vaheʻi ʻe ia ʻae fānau, kia Lia, mo Lesieli, pea mo e ongo kaunanga.
Pea ne fakamuʻomuʻa ʻae ongo kaunanga mo ʻena fānau, pea hoko ʻa Lia mo ʻene fānau, pea fakamuimuiʻa Lesieli mo Siosefa.
Pea ne muʻomuʻa ia ʻiate kinautolu, pea punou hifo ia ʻo tuʻo fitu ki he kelekele, ʻi heʻene ʻunuʻunu atu ki hono taʻokete.
Ka naʻe lele ʻa ʻIsoa ke fakafetaulakikiate ia, pea ne fāʻofua ia ki hono kia, pea uma kiate ia: pea naʻa na fetāngihi.

Pea hanga hake hono mata, ʻo ne sio ki he kau fefine mo e tamaiki: pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko hai ʻakinautoluni ʻoku ʻiate koe?”Pea pehēange ʻe ia, “Ko e fānau, kuo foaki ʻe he ʻOtua ʻaloʻofa ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki.”
Pea naʻe toki ʻunuʻunu mai ʻo ofi, ʻae ongo kaunanga, ʻakinaua mo ʻena fānau, pea naʻa nau punou.
Pea haʻu ʻo ofi ʻa Lia foki mo ʻene fānau, pea punou ʻakinautolu: pea haʻu fakamui ʻa Siosefa mo Lesieli ʻo ofi, pea punou ʻakinaua.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e hāhono ʻuhinga ʻoe ngaahi fanga manu naʻa mau fehikitaki mo au?”Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e meʻa ke ʻofeina ai au ʻi he ʻao ʻo hoku ʻeiki.”
Pea pehēʻe ʻIsoa, “Ko hoku tehina, kuo lahi ʻeku meʻa; ke ʻiate koe pe, ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻau.”

Pea pehēange ʻe Sēkope, “ʻOua, ko eni, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, kapau ʻoku ou lelei ʻi ho ʻao, pea ke maʻu ʻeku meʻaʻofa mei hoku nima; he ko ia kuo u mamata ai ki ho mata, ʻo hangēko e fofonga ʻoe ʻOtua, pea kuo ke lelei kiate au.
‌ʻOku ou kole ke ke maʻu ʻeku tāpuaki, ʻaia kuo ʻomi kiate koe; koeʻuhi kuo fai lelei ʻe he ʻOtua kiate au, pea kuo u maʻu ʻo lahi.”Pea naʻa ne fakalotoʻi ia, pea ne toʻo ia.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ke tau fononga pea tau ō, pea te u muʻomuʻa ʻiate koe.”

Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate ia, “ʻOku ʻilo ʻe hoku ʻeiki ʻoku vaivai ʻae tamaiki, pea ʻoku ʻiate au ʻae fanga manu feitama: pea kapau ʻe fakateka mālohi ʻakinautoluʻe he kau tangata, ʻi he ʻaho pe taha, ʻe mate ai kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, ke muʻomuʻa ʻa hoku ʻeiki ʻi heʻene tamaioʻeiki; pea te u muimuiatu ʻo fakatuotuai, ʻo fakatatau ki he faʻa fai ʻe he fanga manu, mo e tamaiki, ʻa ʻenau muʻomuʻa ʻiate au, ke ʻoua ke u hoko ki hoku ʻeiki ʻi Seia.”
Pea talaange ʻe ʻIsoa, “Tuku ke nofo kiate koe hāniʻihi ʻiate kinautoluʻoku ʻiate au:”pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e hāhono ʻaonga?”Tuku ke u lelei ʻi he ʻao ʻo hoku ʻeiki.
¶Pea tafoki ʻa ʻIsoa ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ke ʻalu ki Seia.
Pea fononga ʻa Sēkope ki Sukote, pea langa ai hono fale louʻakau ʻo ne ngaohi ai ʻae ngaahi fale louʻakau ki heʻene fanga manu: ko ia ʻoku ui ai ʻae potu ko ia ko Sukote.
¶Pea hoko lelei pe ʻa Sēkope ki he kolo ko Sikemi, ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani, ʻi heʻene haʻu mei Petanalami; pea naʻa ne fokotuʻu hono fale fehikitaki ʻo ofi ki he kolo.
Pea ne fakatau ʻae potu ngoue, ʻaia ne ne folahi ai hono fale fehikitaki, mei he nima ʻoe fānau ʻa Hemoa ko e tamai ʻa Sikemi, ʻaki ʻae paʻanga ʻe teau.
Pea naʻa ne fokotuʻu ʻi ai ʻae ʻesifeilaulau, ʻo ne ui ia ko ʻEle-ilohe-ʻIsileli.
34: PEA ko Taina ko e taʻahine ʻa Lia, ʻaia naʻa ne fanauʻi kia Sēkope, naʻe ʻalu ia ke ʻaʻahi ki he kau fefine ʻoe fonua.
Pea ʻi he mamata kiate ia ʻa Sikemi ko e foha ʻo Hemoa ko e tangata Hevi, ko e ʻeiki ʻoe fonua, naʻa ne puke ia ʻo na mohe, ʻo ne fakahalaʻi ia.
Pea pikitai hono laumālie kia Taina ko e ʻofefine ʻo Sēkope, pea ʻofa ia ki he taʻahine, ʻo ne lea lelei ki he taʻahine.
Pea lea ʻa Sikemi ki heʻene tamai ko Hemoa, ʻo pehē, “Ke ke maʻu mai ʻae taʻahine ni ke ma ʻunoho.”
Pea fanongo ʻa Sēkope kuo ne fakahalaʻi hono ʻofefine ko Taina; ka naʻe ʻi he ngoue ʻa hono ngaahi foha, mo ʻene fanga manu: pea longo pe ʻa Sēkope kaeʻoua ke nau haʻu.
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa Hemoa ko e tamai ʻa Sikemi kia Sēkope, ke na alea mo ia.

Pea ʻi he fanongo ki ai ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Sēkope, naʻa nau haʻu mei he ngoue; pea mamahi ʻae kau tangata ʻo nau ʻita lahi, koeʻuhi ko ʻene fai meʻa kovi ʻi ʻIsileli, ʻo mohe mo e ʻofefine ʻo Sēkope; ʻae meʻa naʻe ʻikai ngofua ke fai.
Pea naʻe lea ʻa Hemoa ki ai, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku holi ʻae laumālie ʻo hoku foha ko Sikemi ki ho ʻofefine: ʻoku ou kole kiate kimoutolu, foaki mai ia kiate ia, ke na ʻunoho.
Pea mou fai mali mo kimautolu, pea foaki mai homou ngaahi ʻofefine kiate kimautolu, pea mou maʻu homau ngaahi ʻofefine kiate kimoutolu.
Pea ke tau nonofo; pea ʻoku ʻi homou ʻao ʻae fonua: mou nofo ki ai, mo fai hoʻomou fakatau, pea mou maʻu ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi ʻapi moʻomoutolu.”
Pea pehēʻe Sikemi ki he tamaiʻae fefinemo hono ngaahi tuongaʻane, “ʻOfa ke u lelei ʻi homou ʻao, pea ko ia ʻoku mou tala te u foaki.
Tala mai ʻae totongi lahi, pe ko e foaki, pea te u ʻatu ʻo hangēko ia te mou tala kiate au, kae kehe ke foaki mai ʻae fefine ke ma ʻunoho.”
Pea naʻe lea fakakākāʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Sēkope kia Sikemi, mo ʻene tamai ko Hemoa, ʻo nau pehē, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene fakahalaʻi ʻa Taina, ko honau tuofefine:
Pea naʻa nau pehēkiate kinaua, “ʻOku ʻikai te mau faʻa fai ʻae meʻa ni, ke foaki homau tuofefine ki ha tokotaha ʻoku taʻekamu; he ko e meʻa kovi ia kiate kimautolu.
Ka ʻi he meʻa ni te mau loto kiate kimoutolu: ʻo kapau te mou hoko ʻo hangēko kimautolu, koeʻuhi ke kamu ʻae tangata kotoa pēʻoku ʻiate kimoutolu.
Pea te mau toki foaki homau ngaahi ʻofefine kiate kimoutolu, pea te mau maʻu homou ngaahi ʻofefine kiate kimautolu, pea te tau nonofo, pea te tau hoko ko e kakai pe taha.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou tokanga kiate kimautoluke mou kamu: pea te mau toʻo homau ʻofefine, ka mau ʻalu.”
Pea naʻe leleiʻia ʻa Hemoa, mo Sikemi ko e foha ʻo Hemoa, ʻi heʻenau lea.
Pea naʻe ʻikai fakatuai ʻae talavou ke fai ʻae meʻa ko ia, koeʻuhi naʻe lahi ʻene ʻofa ki he ʻofefine ʻo Sēkope; pea naʻe tuʻu ki muʻa ia ʻi he fale kotoa pēʻo ʻene tamai.
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻa Hemoa mo hono foha ko Sikemi ki he matapāʻo ʻenau kolo, ʻo nau alea mo e kau tangata ʻo ʻenau kolo, ʻo pehē,

“ʻOku nofo fiemālie pe ʻae kau tangata ni mo kitautolu; ko ia tuku ke nau nofo ʻi he fonua mo fai ʻenau fakatau ʻi ai: he vakai, ʻoku lahi ʻae fonua kiate kinautolu; ke tau maʻu honau ngaahi ʻofefine ke ʻunoho, pea tau foaki kiate kinautoluhotau ngaahi ʻofefine.

Ka ko e meʻa pe taha ʻe loto ai ʻae kau tangata kiate kitautolu, ke nofo mo kitautolu, ke tau hoko ko e kakai pe taha, ʻo kapau ʻe kamu ʻae tangata kotoa pēʻoku ʻiate kitautolu, ʻo hangēʻoku nau kamu.
‌ʻIkai ʻe hoko ai ʻenau fanga pulu, mo e nau fanga manu kotoa pē, mo e nau ngaahi meʻa, ko e tau ngaahi meʻa? Kae kehe ke tau loto kiate kinautolu, pea te nau nofo mo kitautolu.

Pea naʻe tokanga kia Hemoa mo Sikemi ko hono foha, ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ʻalu kituaʻāʻi he matapāʻo ʻena kolo; pea kamu ʻae tangata kotoa pē, ʻio, ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe hūkituaʻāʻi he matapāʻo ʻena kolo.”

¶Pea ʻi heʻene hokosia hono ʻaho tolu, kuo nau mamahi, pea naʻe taki taha toʻo ʻae heletāʻe he ongo foha ʻe toko ua ʻo Sēkope, ko Simione mo Livai, ko e ongo tuongaʻane ʻo Taina, ʻo na hūmālohi ki he kolo, ʻo tāmateʻi ʻae kau tangata kotoa pē.
Pea naʻa na tāmateʻi ʻa Hemoa mo hono foha ko Sikemi ʻaki ʻae mata ʻoe heletā, pea na toʻo mai ʻa Taina mei he fale ʻo Sikemi, pea nau ōai.
Pea naʻe haʻu ai ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Sēkope ki he kakai mate ʻo nau maumauʻi ʻae kolo, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau fakahalaʻi honau tuofefine.
Ne nau ʻave ʻenau fanga sipi mo e nau fanga pulu, mo e nau fanga ʻasi, mo e meʻa kotoa pēʻi he kolo, mo e meʻa ʻi he ngoue,
Mo ʻenau koloa kotoa pē, mo nau ʻave fakapōpula ʻenau fānau iiki, mo honau ngaahi ʻunoho, pea naʻa nau maumauʻi ʻae meʻa kotoa pēʻi he ngaahi fale.

Pea pehēʻe Sēkope kia Simione mo Livai, “Kuo mo fakamamahiʻi au, ke fakanamukūʻi au, ki he kakai ʻoe fonua, ko e kakai Kēnani mo e kakai Pelesi: ʻoku ou tokosiʻi au, pea te nau fakataha kotoa pē, ke tāmateʻi au, pea te u ʻauha, ko au, mo hoku fale.”
Pea naʻa na pehēange kiate ia, “He naʻe lelei ʻa ʻene fai ki homa tuofefine ʻo hangēko ha muitau?”
35: PEA naʻe folofola ʻe he ʻOtua kia Sēkope, “Tuʻu hake ʻo ʻalu ki Peteli, pea nofo ai; pea ke ngaohi ʻi ai ʻae ʻesifeilaulau ki he ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻe hākiate koe ʻi hoʻo hola mei he ʻao ʻo ho taʻokete ko ʻIsoa.”
Pea fekau ai ʻe Sēkope ki hono kau nofoʻanga, pea mo kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ʻiate ia, ʻo pehē; “Tukuangeʻae ngaahi ʻotua kehe ʻoku ʻiate kimoutolu, pea mou maʻa, pea fetongi homou ngaahi kofu.
Pea ke tau tuʻu hake, ʻo ʻalu ki Peteli: pea te u ngaohi ai ʻae ʻesifeilaulau ki he ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻe tali ʻeku hū, ʻi he ʻaho ʻo ʻeku mamahi, pea naʻe ʻiate au ʻi he hala naʻaku ʻalu ai.
Pea naʻa nau tuku kia Sēkope honau ngaahi ʻotua kehe kotoa pēnaʻe ʻi honau nima, mo honau ngaahi hau, naʻe ʻi honau telinga; pea naʻe fufūia ʻe Sēkope ʻi he laloʻakauko e oke naʻe ofi ki Sikemi.”
Pea naʻa nau fononga; pea ko e manavahēki he ʻOtua, naʻe ʻi he ngaahi kolo kotoa pēnaʻe tuʻu takatakai ʻiate kinautolu, pea naʻe ʻikai te nau tuli ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Sēkope.
¶Pea hoko ʻa Sēkope ki Lusa, ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani, ʻaia ko Peteli, ko ia mo e kakai naʻe ʻiate ia.
Pea naʻe fokotuʻu ʻe ia ʻi ai ʻae ʻesifeilaulau, ʻo ne ui ʻae potu ko ia, ko ʻElepeteli: koeʻuhi naʻe hāai ʻae ʻOtua kiate ia, ʻi heʻene hola mei he ʻao ʻo hono taʻokete.
Pea naʻe pekia ai ʻa Tepola ko e tauhi ʻo Lepeka, pea naʻe tanu ia ʻi Peteli, ʻi he lalo oke; pea naʻe fakahingoa ʻae potu ko ʻAlonipakuti.
¶Pea naʻe toe hāʻae ʻOtua kia Sēkope, ʻi heʻene haʻu mei Petanalami, ʻo ne tāpuaki ia.
Pea pehēʻe he ʻOtua kiate ia, “Ko ho hingoa ko Sēkope: ka e ʻikai toe ui ho hingoa ko Sēkope, ka ko ʻIsileli ho hingoa: pea ne ui hono hingoa ko ʻIsileli.”
Pea pehēʻe he ʻOtua kiate ia, “Ko e ʻOtua Māfimafi au ke ke monūʻia, ʻo tupu ke tokolahi ko e puleʻanga, mo e ngaahi puleʻanga ʻe tupu ʻiate koe, pea ʻe tupu ʻiate koe ʻae ngaahi tuʻi.
Pea ko e fonua naʻaku tuku kia ʻEpalahame mo ʻAisake, ʻoku ou foaki ia kiate koe, pea mo ho hako ʻamui ʻiate koe, te u foaki ki ai ʻae fonua.”
Pea naʻe hāʻele hake ʻae ʻOtua meiate ia, mei he potu naʻa ne folofola ai kiate ia.
Pea naʻe fokotuʻu ʻe Sēkope ʻae pou ʻi he potu naʻa ne folofola ai kiate ia, ʻio, ʻae pou maka: pea ne lilingi ki ai ʻae feilaulau inu, pea ne lilingi ki ai ʻae lolo.
Pea naʻe ui ʻe Sēkope ʻae hingoa ʻoe potu ko ia naʻe folofola ai ʻae ʻOtua kiate ia, ko Peteli.
¶Pea naʻa nau fononga mei Peteli pea naʻe toetoe siʻi pe, ke nau hoko ki ʻEfelata, pea naʻe langāai ʻa Lesieli, pea naʻe faingataʻa.
Pea ʻi heʻene kei langā, naʻe lea ʻae māʻuli kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻOua te ke manavahē; he te ke maʻu ʻae tama ni foki.”
Pea ʻi he tei ʻalu hono laumālie, (he naʻe pekia ia,) pea ne ui hono hingoa ko Penioni; ka naʻe ui ia ʻe heʻene tamai ko Penisimani.
Pea naʻe pekia ʻa Lesieli, pea tanu ia ʻi he hala ʻoku tau ki ʻEfelata, ʻaia ko Petelihema.
Pea naʻe fokotuʻu ʻe Sēkope ʻae pou ki hono tanuʻanga; pea ko e pou ia ʻoe tanuʻanga ʻo Lesieli, ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho ni.
¶Pea naʻe fai fononga ʻa ʻIsileli, pea folahi hono fale fehikitaki ki kōatu ʻoe fale māʻolunga ko ʻEta.

Pea ʻi he kei nofo ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi he fonua ko ia, naʻe ʻalu ʻa Lupeniʻo na mohe mo Pila, ko e sinifu ʻo ʻene tamai; pea fanongo ki ai ʻa ʻIsileli. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sēkope naʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ua.
Ko e ngaahi tama ʻa Lia: ko Lupeni, ko e ʻuluaki ʻo Sēkope, mo Simione, mo Livai, mo Siuta, mo ʻIsaka, mo Sepuloni.
Ko e ongo tama ʻa Lesieli: ko Siosefa mo Penisimani.
Pea ko e ongo tama ʻa Pila, ko e kaunanga ʻa Lesieli, ko Tani, mo Nafitali.
Pea ko e ongo tama ʻa Silipa, ko e kaunanga ʻa Lia; ko Kata mo ʻAseli; ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Sēkope, naʻe fanauʻi kiate ia ʻi Petanalami.
¶Pea naʻe haʻu ʻa Sēkope ki heʻene tamai ko ʻAisake ʻi Mamili, ki he kolo ko ʻAapa, ʻaia ko Hepeloni, ko e potu naʻe ʻāunofoai ʻa ʻEpalahame mo ʻAisake.
Pea ko e ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻAisake, ko e taʻu ʻe teau, mo e taʻu ʻe valungofulu.
Pea tukuangeʻe ʻAisake ʻa hono laumālie, pea pekia ia, pea fakataha ia ki hono kakai, kuo motuʻa, naʻe aʻu hono ngaahi ʻaho; pea naʻe tanu ia ʻe hono ongo foha, ko ʻIsoa, mo Sēkope.
36: PEA ko e ngaahi toʻutangata eni ʻo ʻIsoa, ʻaia ko ʻItomi.

Naʻe maʻu ʻe ʻIsoa hono ngaahi ʻunohomei he fānau fefine ʻo Kēnani; ko ʻAta ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻEloni ko e tangata Heti, mo ʻAholipama ko e taʻahine ʻo ʻAna, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Sipione, ko e tangata Hevi.
Mo Pasimati ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli, ko e tuofefine ʻo Nepeoti.
Pea naʻe fānau ʻe ʻAta kia ʻIsoa, ʻa ʻIlifasi; pea fanauʻi ʻe Pasimati ʻa Leueli.
Pea fanauʻi ʻe ʻAholipama, ʻa Seusi, mo Salami, mo Kola; ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻIsoa, naʻe fanauʻi kiate ia ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani.

Pea naʻe ʻave ʻe ʻIsoa hono ngaahi ʻunoho, mo hono ngaahi foha, mo hono ngaahi ʻofefine, mo e kakai kotoa pēʻo hono fale, mo ʻene fanga pulu, mo ʻene fanga manu, mo e meʻa kotoa pēʻaia naʻa ne maʻu ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani; pea ʻalu mamaʻo ia ki he tukuʻuta, mei he ʻao ʻo hono tehina ko Sēkope.
He naʻe lahi ʻena koloa, ko ia naʻe ʻikai ai te na faʻa nofo fakataha; pea ko e fonua naʻa na nofo ʻāunofoai, naʻe ʻikai ʻataʻatāia kiate kinaua, koeʻuhi naʻe lahi ʻena fanga manu.
Pea pehē, naʻe nofo ʻa ʻIsoa ʻi he moʻunga ko Seia, pea ko ʻIsoa ko ʻItomi ia.
¶Pea ko e ngaahi toʻutangata eni ʻo ʻIsoa, ko e tamai ʻae kakai ʻItomi, ʻi he moʻunga ko Seia.
Ko e hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIsoa: ko ʻIlifasi ko e tama ʻa ʻAta ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa; ko Leueli ko e tama ʻa Pasimati, ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIlifasi, ko Temani, mo ʻOmaa, mo Sefo, mo Katami, mo Kinasi.
Pea ko Timina, ko e sinifu ia kia ʻIlifasi, ko e foha ʻo ʻIsoa, pea ne fāʻele kia ʻIlifasi, ʻa ʻAmaleki; ko e ngaahi tama ia ʻa ʻAta, ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Leueli ko Nehate, mo Sela, mo Sama, mo Misa: ko e ngaahi tama ia ʻa Pasimati, ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa.
¶Pea ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻa ʻAholipama, ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa, ko e taʻahine ʻo ʻAna, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Sipione; naʻa ne fānau kia ʻIsoa ʻa Seusi, mo Salami, mo Kola.
¶Pea ko e ngaahi ʻeiki eni ʻi he ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIsoa; ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIlifasi, ko e ʻuluaki foha ʻo ʻIsoa; ko e ʻeiki ko Temani, ko e ʻeiki ko ʻOmaa, ko e ʻeiki ko Sefo, ko e ʻeiki ko Kinasi,
Ko e ʻeiki ko Kola, mo e ʻeiki ko Katami, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻAmaleki; ko e ngaahi ʻeiki ianaʻe tupuia ʻIlifasi ʻi he fonua ko ʻItomi; ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻa ʻAta.

¶Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Leueli ko e foha ʻo ʻIsoa; ko e ʻeiki ko Nehate, mo e ʻeiki ko Sela, mo e ʻeiki ko Sama, mo e ʻeiki ko Misa: ko e ngaahi ʻeiki eninaʻe tupuia Leueli, ʻi he fonua ko ʻItomi; ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻa Pasimati ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa.

¶Pea ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻa ʻAholipama ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa: ko e ʻeiki ko Seusi, mo e ʻeiki ko Salami, mo e ʻeiki ko Kola: ko e ngaahi ʻeiki ianaʻe tupuia ʻAholipama, ko e taʻahine ʻo ʻAna, ko e ʻunohoʻo ʻIsoa.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻIsoa ʻaia ko ʻItomi, pea ko honau ngaahi ʻeiki ia.
¶Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Seia, ko e tangata Hoa, ʻaia naʻe maʻu ʻae fonua ko Lotani mo Sopale, mo Sipione, mo ʻAna,
Mo Tisoni, mo ʻEseli, mo Tisani ko e ngaahi ʻeiki ʻoe kakai Hoa, ko e fānau ʻa Seia, ʻi he fonua ko ʻItomi.
Pea ko e fānau ʻa Lotani ko Holi, mo Hemami; pea ko e tuofefine ʻo Lotani ko Timina.
Pea ko e fānau ʻa Sopale eni ko ʻAlivani, mo Maneate, mo ʻEpale, mo Sifo, mo ʻOnama.
Pea ko e fānau eni ʻa Sipione ko ʻEiaa mo ʻAna; ko e ʻAna ia ʻaia naʻa ne ʻiloʻi ʻae fanga miuli ʻi he toafa, ʻi heʻene tauhi ʻae fanga ʻasi ʻa ʻene tamai ko Sipione.
Pea ko e fānau ʻa ʻAna ʻa eni; ko Tisoni mo ʻAholipama, ko e taʻahine ʻa ʻAna.
Pea ko e fānau eni ʻa Tisoni; ko Hemitani, mo ʻEsipani, mo ʻItilani, mo Kilani.
Pea ko e fānau eni ʻa ʻEseli, ko Pilani, mo Sefani, mo ʻEkani.
Pea ko e fānau eni ʻa Tisani; ko ʻUsa mo ʻAlani.
Ko eni ʻae ngaahi ʻeikinaʻe tupuʻi he kau Hoa; ko e ʻeiki ko Lotani, mo e ʻeiki ko Sopale, mo e ʻeiki ko Sipione, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻAna,
Ko e ʻeiki ko Tisoni, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻEseli, mo e ʻeiki ko Tisani; ko e ngaahi ʻeiki eni naʻe tupu ia Holi, ʻi he ngaahi ʻeiki ʻi he fonua ko Seia.
¶Pea ko e ngaahi tuʻi eni naʻe pule ʻi he fonua ko ʻItomi, ʻi he teʻeki pule ha tuʻi ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
Ko Pela ko e foha ʻo Peoli, naʻe pule ia ki ʻItomi; pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono kolo ko Tinapa.
Pea pekia ʻa Pela, pea pule ʻi hono puleʻanga ʻa Sopapa ko e foha ʻo Sela ʻo Posila.
Pea pekia ʻa Sopapa, pea pule ʻi hono puleʻanga ʻa Husami, mei he fonua ko Temani.
Pea pekia ʻa Husami, pea ko Hetati ko e foha ʻo Pitati, ʻaia naʻa ne taaʻi ʻa Mitiane, ʻi he ngoue ʻo Moape, naʻe pule ia ʻi hono puleʻanga; pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono kolo ko ʻEviti.
Pea pekia ʻa Hetati, pea ko Samila mei Masileka, naʻa ne pule ʻi hono puleʻanga.
Pea pekia ʻa Samila, pea ko Saula mei Leopote ʻo ofi ki he vaitafe, naʻe pule ia ʻi hono puleʻanga.
Pea pekia ʻa Saula, pea ko Pealihenani, ko e foha ʻo ʻAkepoa, naʻe pule ʻi hono puleʻanga.

Pea pekia ʻa Pealihenani ko e foha ʻo ʻAkepoa; pea pule ʻa Hetali ʻi hono puleʻanga pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono kolo ko Pau pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono ʻunohoko Mehetepeli, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Matileti, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Mesaʻapi.

¶Pea ko e ngaahi hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi ʻeikinaʻe tupuia ʻIsoa, ʻo hangēko honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi honau ngaahi potu, ʻi honau ngaahi hingoa; ko e ʻeiki ko Timina, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻAlivani, mo e ʻeiki ko Sesete,
Ko e ʻeiki ko ʻAholipama, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻe ia, mo e ʻeiki ko Pinoni,
Mo e ʻeiki ko Kinasi, mo e ʻeiki ko Temani, mo e ʻeiki ko Mipisali,
Mo e ʻeiki ko Makiteli, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻIlami; ko e ngaahi ʻeiki eni ʻo ʻItomi, ʻo hangēko honau nofoʻanga, ʻi honau ngaahi fonua: pea ko ʻIsoa, ko e tamai ia ʻae kakai ʻItomi.
37: PEA naʻe nofo ʻa Sēkope ʻi he fonua naʻe ʻāunofoki ai ʻene tamai, ʻio, ʻi he fonua ko Kēnani.

Ko e hako eni ʻo Sēkope naʻe hongofulu ma fitu ʻae taʻu ʻo Siosefa, pea naʻe tauhi ʻe ia ʻae fanga manu, ʻo fakataha mo hono ngaahi taʻokete; pea naʻe nofo ʻae tama mo e ongo tama ʻa Pila, pea mo e fānau ʻa Silipa, ko e ongo sinifu ʻo ʻene tamai: pea naʻe ʻomi ʻe Siosefa ki heʻene tamai ʻenau ongoongo kovi.
Pea naʻe ʻofa lahi hake ʻa ʻIsileli kia Siosefa ʻi heʻene fānau kotoa pē, koeʻuhi ko hono foha ia ʻi heʻene motuʻa; pea ne ngaohi maʻana ʻae kofutuʻa pulepule.
Pea kuo mamata hono ngaahi taʻokete, ʻoku ʻofa lahi hake ʻenau tamai kiate ia, ʻi hono taʻokete kotoa pē, naʻa nau fehiʻa ai kiate ia, pea naʻe ʻikai te nau lea lelei kiate ia.
Pea misi ʻe Siosefa ʻae misi, pea ne tala ia ki hono ngaahi taʻokete; pea naʻe ʻāsili ai ʻenau fehiʻa kiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ou kole ke mou fanongo ki he misi ni, kuo u misi ʻaki;

He naʻa tau nonoʻo ʻae ngaahi u koane ʻi he ngoue, pea vakai, naʻe tuʻu hake ʻeku u koane, ʻo tuʻu totonu; pea vakai, ko hoʻomou ngaahi u koane naʻa nau tutuʻu hake ʻo takatakai ia, ʻo nau punou ki heʻeku u koane.”
Pea pehēʻe hono ngaahi taʻokete kiate ia, “He ko e moʻoni te ke pule kiate kimautolu? Pea te ke mālohi kiate kimautolu?”Pea ʻāsili ai ʻenau fehiʻa kiate ia ʻi heʻene misi, mo ʻene ngaahi lea.

¶Pea misi ia ʻae misi ʻe taha, pea ne tala ia ki hono ngaahi taʻokete, ʻo pehē, “Vakai, kuo u misi ʻae misi ʻe taha, pea vakai, ko e laʻāmo e māhina, mo e fetuʻu ʻe hongofulu ma taha, naʻa nau punou kiate au.”

Pea ne fakahāki heʻene tamai, mo hono ngaahi taʻokete: pea valoki ia ʻe heʻene tamai, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Ko e hāʻae misi ni kuo ke misi ʻaki? Ko e moʻoni ʻe pehēau mo hoʻo faʻē, mo ho ngaahi taʻokete, ke mau punou ʻakimautolukiate koe, ki he kelekele?”
Pea naʻe meheka ʻa hono ngaahi taʻokete kiate ia; ka naʻe tokanga ʻene tamai ki he lea.
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu hono ngaahi taʻokete ki Sikemi, ke fafanga ʻae fanga manu ʻa ʻenau tamai.
Pea pehēʻe ʻIsileli kia Siosefa, “ʻIkai ʻoku fafanga ʻe ho ngaahi taʻokete ʻae fanga manu ʻi Sikemi?”Haʻu, pea te u fekau koe kiate kinautolu. Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko au eni.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “Ke ke ʻalu, ʻo vakai pe ʻoku lelei ʻa ho ngaahi taʻokete, pea lelei mo e fanga manu; pea ke haʻu ʻo tala mai.”Pea ne fekau ia mei he teleʻa ʻo Hepeloni ʻo ne hoko ki Sikemi.
¶Pea naʻe ʻilo ia ʻe he tangata ʻe taha, pea vakai, naʻe ʻalu he pe ia ʻi he fonua; pea fehuʻi ʻae tangata kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hāʻoku ke kumi?”
Pea ne pehē, “ʻOku ou kumi hoku ngaahi taʻokete; ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, fakahākiate au ʻae potu ʻoku nau fafanga ai ʻae fanga manu.”
Pea pehēange ʻe he tangata, “Kuo nau ō, he naʻaku fanongo ki heʻenau pehē, Tau ōki Totani.”Pea naʻe muimuiʻa Siosefa ki hono ngaahi taʻokete, pea ne ʻilo ʻakinautoluʻi Totani.
Pea kuo nau mamata kiate ia, ʻi heʻene kei mamaʻo, ʻi he teʻeki ke ne ofi kiate kinautolu, naʻa nau alea fakataha, ke tāmateʻi ia.
Pea naʻa nau fealēleaʻaki, ʻo pehē, “Vakai, ʻoku haʻu ʻae faʻa misi ni.”
Pea ko ia ke tau tāmateʻi ia pea līia ki ha luo, pea te tau pehē, kuo kai ia ʻe ha manu fekai; pea te tau vakai, pe ʻe hoko ʻo fēfēʻene ngaahi misi.
Pea fanongo ki ai ʻa Lupeni, ʻo ne fakahaofi ia mei honau nima; ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOua naʻa tau tāmateʻi ia.”

Pea pehēʻe Lupenikiate kinautolu, “ʻOua naʻa lingi toto, kae līia ki he luo ni, ʻoku ʻi he toafa, pea ʻoua naʻa ala ha nima kiate ia;”naʻa ne pehēkoeʻuhi ke ne toʻo ia mei honau nima, ke toe ʻatu ia ki heʻene tamai.
¶Pea kuo hoko atu ʻa Siosefa ki hono ngaahi taʻokete, pea pehē, naʻa nau toʻo ʻae kofutuʻa ʻo Siosefa meiate ia, ʻae kofutuʻa pulepule naʻe ʻiate ia;
Pea nau ʻave ia ʻo līki he luo; pea naʻe maha pe ʻae luo, naʻe ʻikai ʻi ai ha vai.

Pea nau nofo ki lalo ke kai mā: pea ʻi he hanga hake honau mata ʻo sio, pea vakai, naʻe haʻu ʻae fononga ʻoe kakai ʻIsimeʻeli, naʻe haʻu mei Kiliate, mo e nau fanga kāmeli, naʻe fakaheka ki ai ʻae ngaahi ʻakau namu lelei, mo e pulu mo e pulu nanamu, ko e nau fetuku ia ki ʻIsipite.
