“Tuku hoʻomou lau, pea tuku ai pe au, koeʻuhi, ke u lea,
kae hoko kiate au ʻaia ʻe hoko.

Ko e hāʻoku ou ʻūtaki ai hoku kakano,
pea ʻai ʻeku moʻui ki hoku nima?

Neongo ʻene tāmateʻi au,
te u falala pe kiate ia:
ka te u fakamatala hoku ngaahi hala ʻi hono ʻao.

‌ʻE fakamoʻui au foki ʻe ia:
ka ʻe ʻikai ha mālualoiʻe haʻu ki hono ʻao.

Fanongo lelei ki heʻeku lea,
fanongo ʻaki homou telinga ʻa ʻeku fakamatala.

Vakai eni, kuo u teu ʻeku fakamatala;
ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻe fakatonuhiaʻi au.

Ko hai ia te ne talatalaakiʻi au?
He ko eni, kapau te u fakalongo pe, te u mate.

“Ko e meʻa ʻe ua pe, ke ʻoua naʻa fai kiate au:
ko ia ʻe ʻikai ai te u fufūau ʻiate koe.

Ke toʻo atu ke mamaʻo ho nima ʻiate au:
pea ʻoua naʻaku puputuʻu ʻi hoʻo fakailifia.

Pea ke toki folofola mai, pea te u talia;
pea te u lea atu, ka ke talia au.

‌ʻOku fiha ʻeku ngaahi hia mo ʻeku angahala?
Fakaʻilo mai kiate au ʻeku talangataʻa mo ʻeku angahala.

Ko e hāʻoku ke fufūai ho fofonga,
mo ke lau au ko ho fili?

He te ke pakiʻi ʻae louʻakau kuo feʻaveʻaki?
Pea te ke tuli ʻe koe ʻae mohuku mōmoa?

He ʻoku ke tohi ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakamamahi kiate au,
pea ʻoku ke fakahoko kiate au ʻae ngaahi hia ʻo ʻeku kei siʻi.

Pea ʻoku fakaʻaʻau ia ʻo hangēha meʻa popo,
pea tatau mo e kofu kuo kai ʻe he ane.
14:
“KO E tangata kuo fanauʻi ʻe he fefine,
ʻoku siʻi pe hono ngaahi ʻaho, pea fonu ʻi he mamahi.

‌ʻOku tupu hake ia ʻo hangēko e fisiʻi ʻakau, pea tuʻusi hifo:
ʻoku puna foki ia ʻo hangēko e ʻatā, ʻo ʻikai nofomaʻu.

Pea ʻoku ke fofonga ʻa ki ha taha pehē,
mo ke ʻomi au ke fakamaau mo koe?

Ko hai te ne faʻa ʻomi ʻae maʻa mei he taʻemaʻa?
ʻIkai ha taha.

“Afe atu meiate ia, ka ne mālōlō,
kaeʻoua ke ne fakakakato hono ʻaho ʻo hangēha ngāue unga.

He ʻoku ʻamanaki ki he ʻakau,
ʻo kapau ʻe tāhifo ia, ki heʻene toe tupu hake,
pea ʻe ʻikai ʻosi hono huli ʻo ia.

Neongo ʻae fakaʻaʻau ke motuʻa hono aka ʻi he kelekele,
pea mate hono sino ʻi he efu;

Ka ʻi he nanamu ʻoe vai ʻe toe tupu ia,
ʻo tupu ai ʻae ngaahi vaʻa ʻo hangēha ʻakau.

Ka ʻoku mate pēʻae tangata, ʻo fakaʻaʻau ke ʻosi:
ʻio, ʻoku fononga ʻae tangata, pea kofaʻāia?

‌ʻO hangēʻoku mole ʻae ngaahi vai mei he tahi,
pea matuʻu ʻo mōmoa ʻae ngaahi vaitafe:

‌ʻOku pehēʻoku tokoto hifo ʻae tangata, pea ʻikai toetuʻu:
ʻe ʻikai te nau ʻa pētuʻu mei heʻenau mohe,
kaeʻoua ke mole ʻae ngaahi langi.

“Taumaiāte ke fufūau ʻi he faʻitoka,
ʻo ke fakafufūau, kaeʻoua ke mole atu ho houhau,
mo ke kotofa hoku ʻaho, ʻo manatuʻi au.

Kapau ʻe mate ʻae tangata, ʻe toe moʻui ia?
Ko e ngaahi ʻaho kotoa pēkuo kotofa kiate au te u tatali ai,
kaeʻoua ke hoko hoku liliu.

Te ke ui, pea te u talia koe:
he te ke holi ki he ngāue ʻa ho nima.

Ka ko eni, kuo ke lau ʻeku ngaahi laka:
ʻikai ʻoku ke vakai ki heʻeku angahala?

Kuo fakamaʻu ʻeku kovi ʻi ha tangai,
pea ʻoku ke tuituiai ʻeku hia.

“ʻO hangēʻoku fakaʻaʻau ʻo ngata ʻae moʻunga kuo tō,
pea ʻoku hiki ʻae fuʻu maka mei hono potu.

‌ʻOku ke mālohi maʻuaipēkiate ia, pea ʻoku mole ia:
ʻoku ke liliu hono mata mo ke fekau ia ke ʻalu.

‌ʻOku hoko ʻo ongoongo hono ngaahi foha, ka ʻoku ʻikai te ne ʻilo;
pea ʻoku fakavaivai hifo ʻakinautolu, ka ʻoku ʻikai te ne mamata ai.

Ka ko hono kakano ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻe langa,
pea ʻe mamahi mo hono laumālie ʻi loto ʻiate ia.”
15: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Elifasi mei Timani, ʻo ne pehē,

“He ʻoku taau mo e tangata poto ke lau meʻa vaʻinga,
mo fakapito hono kete ʻaki ʻae matangi hahake?

‌ʻOku taau ʻene leaʻaki ʻae lea taʻeʻaonga?
Pe ko e ngaahi lau ʻe ʻikai te ne lavaʻi ʻaki ha lelei?

‌ʻIo, ʻoku ke liʻaki ʻae manavahē,
pea ke taʻofi ʻae lotu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua.

He ʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe ho ngutu ʻa hoʻo angahala,
ka ʻoku ke fili ki he ʻelelo ʻoe fakaoloolo.

‌ʻOku talatalaakiʻi koe ʻe ho ngutu pe ʻoʻou, kae ʻikai ko au:
ʻio, ko ho loungutu pe ʻoʻou ʻoku fakamoʻoni kiate koe.

“He ko e ʻuluaki tangata koe naʻe fanauʻi?
Pe naʻe fakatupu koe ʻi muʻa ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga?

He kuo ke fanongo ʻe koe ki he meʻa fufūʻae ʻOtua?
Pea ʻoku ke fakangata ʻae poto kiate koe?

Ko e hāʻoku ke ʻilo, ka ʻoku ʻikai te mau ʻilo?
Ko e hāʻoku ke ʻilo pau, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ʻiate kimautolu?

‌ʻOku ʻiate kimautoluʻae ʻuluhināmo e kau mātuʻa,
ʻoku motuʻa lahi ʻi hoʻo tamai.

He ʻoku siʻi ʻae ngaahi fakafiemālie ʻae ʻOtua kiate koe?
He ʻoku ai ha meʻa fakalilolilo ʻiate koe?

Ko e hāʻoku ʻāvea ai koe ʻe ho loto?
Pea ʻoku lalama ho mata ʻi he hā.

Koeʻuhi ʻoku ke fakafoki ho loto ke tuʻu ki he ʻOtua,
pea tuku ke tafe ʻae ngaahi lea ni mei ho ngutu?

Ko e hāʻae tangata, ke pehēʻoku maʻa ia?
Pe ha taha ʻoku fanauʻi ʻe he fefine, ke pehēʻoku tonuhia ia?

Vakai, ʻoku ʻikai falala siʻi ʻe ia ki heʻene kau māʻoniʻoni;
ʻio, naʻa mo e ngaahi langi ʻoku ʻikai maʻa ia ʻi hono ʻao.

Ka ʻe fēfēhono lahi hake ʻoe fakalielia mo e ʻuli ʻoe tangata,
ʻaia ʻoku ne inumia ʻae angahala ʻo hangēha vai?

“Te u fakahākiate koe, fanongo kiate au;
pea ko ia kuo u mamata ai te u fakamatala atu;

‌ʻAia naʻe tala ʻe he kakai poto mei heʻenau ngaahi tamai,
ʻo ʻikai fufūia:

‌ʻAkinautolupēnaʻe foaki ki ai ʻae fonua,
pea naʻe ʻikai feʻaluʻaki ha muli ʻiate kinautolu.

‌ʻOku langa mamahi ʻae tangata angahala ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē,
pea ʻoku fufūmei he fakaaoao ʻae lau ʻoe ngaahi taʻu.

Ko e ongo fakailifia ʻoku ʻi hono telinga:
ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻene monūʻia ʻe hoko kiate ia ʻae fakaʻauha.

‌ʻOku ʻikai ʻamanaki ʻe ia ke ne liu mai mei he fakapoʻuli,
pea ʻoku talia ia ʻe he heletā.

‌ʻOku ʻalu fano pe ia ʻo kumi ʻae mā, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko māia?’
ʻOku ne ʻilo ʻoku ofi ʻae ʻaho ʻoe fakapoʻuli.

‌ʻE fakamanavahēʻi ia ʻe he mamahi mo e feinga;
te na ikuna ia, ʻo hangēha tuʻi kuo teu ki he tuʻa.

He ʻoku ne mafao atu hono nima ki he ʻOtua,
ʻo ne fakamālohi ia ʻo tuʻu ki he Māfimafi.

‌ʻOku ne ʻohofi kiate ia, ʻio, ki hono kia,
ki he ngaahi potu matolu ʻo hono sifa fatafata:

Koeʻuhi ʻoku ne fai ke fuʻu pupulahono mata,
pea ne fangapesi ke matolu ʻae ngako ʻi hono ngaahi potu.

Ka ʻoku ne nofo ʻi he ngaahi kolo lala,
ʻi he ngaahi fale ʻoku ʻikai nofo ai ha taha,
ʻaia kuo tuʻutuʻuni ko e ngaahi tuʻunga veve.

‌ʻE ʻikai koloaʻia ia, ʻe ʻikai tuʻumaʻu ʻene ngaahi meʻa,
pea ʻe ʻikai te ne faʻa fai ke fakatolonga hono lelei ʻi he fonua.

Ke ʻoua naʻa falala ia ʻaia kuo kākaaʻi ki he vaʻinga:
ko hono totongi ko e vaʻinga pe.

‌ʻE fakamoʻoni eni ʻi he teʻeki hoko hono ʻaho,
pea ʻe ʻikai maʻuiʻui hono vaʻa.

‌ʻE lulu ʻe ia ke tōhono fuhi kālepi taʻemomoho ʻo hangēpe ko e vaine,
pea te ne fakamokulu hono fisi ʻo hangēpēko e ʻolive.

He koeʻuhi ʻe lala ʻae fakatahaʻanga ʻoe kau angahala,
pea ʻe fakaʻauha ʻe he afi ʻae ngaahi fale naʻe maʻu ʻaki ʻae koloa kovi.

‌ʻOku nau tuʻituʻia ʻi he pauʻu, pea nau fanauʻi ʻae vaʻinga,
pea ʻoku teuteu ʻe honau loto ʻae kākā.
16: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Siope, ʻo ne pehē,

Kuo lahi ʻae meʻa pehēkuo u fanongo ai:
ko e kau fakafiemālie fakamamahi ʻakimoutolukotoa pē.

‌ʻE ngata afe ʻae launoa?
Pe ko e hāʻoku ne tokoniʻi koe ke ke tali?

Te u faʻa lea foki ʻeau ʻo hangēpe ko kimoutolu:
ka ne fetongi ʻaki homou laumālie ʻa hoku laumālie,
te u faʻa fokotuʻu lea kiate kimoutolu,
pea te u kalokalo hoku ʻulu kiate kimoutolu.

Ka te u tokoniʻi ʻakimoutoluʻaki hoku ngutu,
pea ko e ueʻi ʻo hoku loungutu ʻe fakafiemālieʻi ʻakimoutolu.

“Neongo ʻeku lea, ʻoku ʻikai fakasiʻisiʻi ʻeku mamahi:
pea kapau te u taʻofi, ko e hāʻeku fiemālie ai?

Ka ko eni, kuo ne fakakikinaʻi au:
kuo ke fakaʻauha ʻa hoku kāinga kotoa pē.

Kuo ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki au ʻae feʻufeʻu, ko e fakamoʻoni ia:
pea ʻoku ha hake hoku tutue ʻo valoki ki hoku mata.

‌ʻOku ne haehae au ʻi hono houhau,
ʻaia ʻoku fehiʻa kiate au ʻoku ne fengaiʻitaki hono nifo kiate au,
ʻoku matalili ʻa hoku fili kiate au.

Kuo tukuangeau ʻe he ʻOtua ki he kakai angahala,
pea kuo ne līau ki he nima ʻoe kakai fai kovi.

Ne u fiemālie, ka kuo ne maumauʻi au:
kuo ne kuku foki hoku kia, ʻo laiki au,
ʻo fokotuʻu au ko hono fanaʻanga.

‌ʻOku ne maumauʻi au ʻaki ʻae tāki he tā,
ʻoku ne ʻohofia au ʻo hangēpe ha fuʻu tangata lahi.

Kuo u tuituiʻae tauangaʻa ki hoku kili,
ʻo fakaʻuliʻi hoku nifo ʻi he efu.

‌ʻOku kovi hoku mata ʻi he tangi,
pea ʻoku ʻi hoku laumataʻae malumaluʻoe mate;

Ka ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ha taʻetotonu kuo ʻi hoku nima:
pea ʻoku māʻoniʻoni foki ʻeku lotu.

“ʻE kelekele, ʻoua naʻa ke ʻuʻufi hoku toto,
pea ʻoua naʻa hao ki ha potu ʻa ʻeku tangi.

Ko eni foki, vakai, ʻoku ʻi he langi hoku fakamoʻoni,
pea ko ia ʻoku ne ʻiloʻi au ʻoku ʻi ʻolunga.

‌ʻOku manukiʻi au ʻe hoku ngaahi kāinga:
ka ʻoku lilingi ʻae loʻimata ʻa hoku mata ki he ʻOtua.

Taumaiāke faʻa alea ʻae tangata mo e ʻOtua,
ʻo hangēko e tangata mo hono kaungāʻapi!

‌ʻOka hokosia ʻae ngaahi taʻu siʻi,
te u toki ʻalu ʻi he hala ʻe ʻikai te u foki mei ai.
17:
“ʻOKU ʻeho ʻeku mānava,
kuo ʻosi hoku ngaahi ʻaho,
ʻoku tali ʻae ngaahi luo kiate au.

‌ʻIkai ʻoku ʻiate au ʻae kau manuki?
Pea ʻikai ʻoku nofomaʻu ʻi hoku ʻao ʻenau ʻahiʻahi kovi?

“Ko eni, ke tuku hifo, ke ai haʻaku fakamoʻoni meiate koe;
ko hai ia te ma tānima mo au?

He kuo ke fufūhonau loto mei he ʻilo:
ko ia ʻe ʻikai ai te ke hakeakiʻi ʻakinautolu.

Ko ia ʻoku ne lea lapu ki hono kāinga,
ʻe vaivai ʻae mata ʻo ʻene fānau ʻaʻana.

“Kuo ne tuku au ko e taukaeʻanga ʻoe kakai;
ka naʻaku tatau muʻa mo e meʻa faiva.

Kuo nenefu hoku mata ko e meʻa ʻi he mamahi,
pea ko e ata pe ʻa hoku kupuʻi sino kotoa pē.

‌ʻE ofo ʻae kakai angatonu ʻi he meʻa ni,
pea ko e taʻeangahala te ne ueʻi ia ki he mālualoi.

‌ʻE fakakukafifoki ʻae māʻoniʻoni ʻi hono hala,
pea ko ia ʻoku nima maʻae fakahoko ʻe ia ʻae mālohi ki he mālohi.

Ka ko kimoutolukotoa pē, mou foki ʻo ʻalu:
he ʻoku ʻikai teu faʻa ʻilo ha taha ʻoku poto ʻiate kimoutolu.

Kuo ʻosi hoku ngaahi ʻaho, kuo motuhi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni,
ʻio, ʻaia naʻaku loto ki ai.

‌ʻOku nau liliu ʻae pōko e ʻaho:
ʻoku fuonounou ʻae maama ko e meʻa ʻi he fakapoʻuli.

Kapau te u tatali, ko hoku fale ʻae faʻitoka pē:
kuo ngaohi hoku mohenga ʻi he fakapoʻuli.

Kuo u pehēki he popo, ‘Ko ʻeku tamai koe:’
pea ki he kelemutu, ‘Ko ʻeku faʻē,’mo ‘hoku tuofefine.’

Pea kofaʻāeni ʻa ʻeku ʻamanaki lelei?
ʻIo, ko ʻeku ʻamanaki lelei, ko hai te ne mamata ki ai?

‌ʻE ʻalu hifo ia ki he ngaahi tāpuni ʻoe luo,
ʻoka tau ka mālōlōfakataha ʻi he efu.
18: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Pilitati mei Suaa, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻE fēfēhono fuoloapea ke fakangata ʻae lea?
Tokanga, pea te mau toki lea.

Ko e hākuo lau ai ʻakimautoluko e fanga manu,
pea lau ko e ʻuli ʻi ho ʻao?

‌ʻOku ne haehae ia ʻe ia pe ʻi heʻene ʻita:
ʻe liʻaki ʻa māmani koeʻuhi ko koe?
Pea ʻe hiki ʻae fuʻu makatuʻu mei hono potu?

“Ko e moʻoni, ʻe tāmateʻi ʻae maama ʻoe angahala,
pea ʻe ʻikai ulo ʻae kalofiama ʻo ʻene afi.

‌ʻE fakapoʻuli ʻae maama ʻi hono fale,
pea ʻe tāmateʻi ʻa ʻene maama fakataha mo ia.

‌ʻE fakaʻapiʻapi ʻae lakaʻanga ʻo hono mālohi,
pea ʻe līki lalo ia ʻe heʻene fakakaukau ʻaʻana.

He ko hono kauvaʻe ʻoʻona kuo ne līia ki he kupenga,
pea ʻoku ne ʻeveʻeva ʻi he funga tauhele.

‌ʻE moʻua ia ʻe he hele ʻi hono muivaʻe,
pea ʻe ikuna ia ʻe he kaihaʻa.

Kuo ʻai ʻae tauhelekiate ia ʻi he kelekele,
mo e sokitanu kiate ia ʻi he hala.

‌ʻE fakamanavahēʻi ia ʻe he ngaahi meʻa fakailifia mei he potu kotoa pē,
pea ʻe fakaveʻevave ia.

‌ʻE kai ʻe he fiekaia ʻa hono mālohi,
pea ʻe tali ofi ʻae fakaʻauha ki hono vakavaka.

‌ʻE fakaʻauha ʻe ia ʻae mālohi ʻo hono sino:
ʻio, ko e ʻuluaki fānau ʻoe mate te ne fakaʻauha ʻene mālohi.

‌ʻE līkituʻa mei hono fale ʻa hono falalaʻanga,
pea ko ia ʻe ʻomi ia ki he tuʻi ʻoe fakailifia.

‌ʻE nofo ia ʻi hono fale, he ʻoku ʻikai ʻoʻona ia:
ʻe tūtuuʻi ki hono ʻapi ʻae sulifa.

‌ʻE mōmoa mei lalo hono ngaahi aka,
pea ʻe motuhi mei ʻolunga ʻa hono vaʻa.

Ko hono manatuʻi ʻe ʻauha mei he fonua,
pea ʻe ʻikai hano hingoa ʻi he hala.

‌ʻE kapusi ia mei he maama ki he poʻuli,
pea ʻe tulia ia mei he māmani.

‌ʻE ʻikai maʻu ʻe ia ha foha pe mokopuna ʻi hono kakai,
ʻe ʻikai toe ha niʻihi ʻi hono ngaahi fale.

Ko kinautoluʻe muimuiʻiate ia te nau ofo ki hono ʻaho,
ʻo hangēko e ilifia ʻanautolunaʻa nau feangai.

Ko e moʻoni ʻoku pehēpe ʻae ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻoe angahala,
pea ko eni ʻae potu ʻo ia ʻoku taʻeʻiloʻi ʻae ʻOtua.”
19: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Siope, ʻo ne pehē,

‌ʻE fēfēhono fuoloamo hoʻomou fakafiuʻi hoku laumālie,
mo lailaiki ʻaki au ʻae ngaahi lea.

Ko hono liunga hongofulu eni mo hoʻomou manukiʻi au:
pea ʻoku ʻikai te mou māʻi hoʻomou fai ʻo hangēko e kau muli kiate au.

Pea kapau moʻoni kuo u hē,
ʻoku ʻiate au pe ʻeku hē.

Pea kapau moʻoni te mou fai fielahi kiate au,
pea talatalaakiʻi au ʻaki hoku manukiaʻanga:

Mou ʻilo eni, kuo fulihiau ʻe he ʻOtua,
pea ne kāpui au ʻaki hono kupenga.

“Vakai, ʻoku ou tangi koeʻuhi ko e fakamālohi, ka ʻoku ʻikai ongoʻi au:
ʻoku ou tangi kalanga ka ʻoku ʻikai ha fakamaau.

Kuo ne feleʻi hoku hala ke ʻoua naʻaku ʻalu,
pea kuo ne ʻai ʻae fakapoʻuli ʻi hoku ngaahi hala.

Kuo ne fakamasivaʻi au ʻi hoku nāunau,
pea kuo ne toʻo ʻae tatāmei hoku ʻulu.

Kuo ne fakaʻauhaʻi au mei he potu kotoa pē, pea kuo u mole:
pea kuo ne taʻaki ʻeku ʻamanaki ʻo hangēha ʻakau.

Kuo ne tutu foki ʻa hono houhau kiate au,
pea ʻoku ne lauʻi au ko e taha ʻo hono ngaahi fili.

‌ʻOku fakataha ʻene ngaahi kautau,
ʻonau keli takatakai ʻiate au,
pea nofo fakatakamilo ʻi hoku fale.

“Kuo ne fakamamaʻo atu hoku kāinga ʻiate au,
pea ko ʻeku ngaahi kaumeʻa ʻoku mahuʻi ʻaupitomeiate au.

Kuo mahuʻi hoku ngaahi kāinga ʻiate au,
pea kuo fakangalongaloʻi au ʻe hoku ngaahi kāinga feʻofoʻofani.

Ko kinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi hoku fale, mo ʻeku kau kaunanga, ʻoku nau lau au ko e muli,
ko e taha kehe au ʻi honau ʻao.

Naʻaku ui ki heʻeku tamaioʻeiki, ka naʻe ʻikai te ne tali;
ne u fakakolekole ʻaki hoku ngutu ki ai.

Kuo fakalielia ʻa ʻeku mānava ki hoku ʻunoho,
neongo ʻa ʻeku fakakolekole koeʻuhi ko e fānau ʻa hoku sino ʻoʻoku.

‌ʻIo, naʻe manukiʻi au ʻe he fānau iiki,
ʻoku ou tuʻu hake pea nau lauʻikoviʻi au.

Kuo fehiʻa kiate au ʻa hoku ngaahi kāinga feʻofoʻofani kotoa pē,
pea ko kinautolune u ʻofa ki ai kuo liliu ʻo angatuʻu kiate au.

‌ʻOku piki hoku ngaahi hui ki hoku kili ʻo hangēko hoku kakano,
pea kuo u hao mo e kili ʻo hoku kau nifo.

“ʻOfa mai kiate au, ʻofa mai kiate au, ʻakimoutoluko hoku kāinga;
he kuo ala kiate au ʻae nima ʻoe ʻOtua.

Ko e hāʻoku mou fakatanga ai au ʻo hangēko e ʻOtua,
pea mou taʻefiu ʻi hoku kakano?

“Taumaiākuo tohi ʻa ʻeku ngaahi lea!
Taumaiākuo tohi ia ʻi ha tohi!

Koeʻuhi ke tohi tongi ia ʻaki ʻae peniukamea mo e pulu,
ʻi he maka ke taʻengata!

He ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻoku moʻui ʻa hoku Huhuʻi,
pea ʻe tuʻu ia ʻi māmani ʻi he ʻaho fakamui.

Pea ka ʻosi hoku kili pea maumau hoku sino,
ka te u mamata ʻi hoku kakano ki he ʻOtua:

Ka ʻe lelei hoʻomou pehē, ‘Ko e hāʻoku tau fakatanga ai ia?’
He ʻoku ʻiate au ʻae tefito ʻoe meʻa lelei.

Ke manavahēʻakimoutoluki he heletā:
he ʻoku ʻomi ʻe he ʻita ʻae ngaahi tautea ʻoe heletā,
koeʻuhi ke mou ʻilo ʻoku ai ʻae fakamaau.”
20: PEA naʻe toki pehēange ʻe Sofaa mei Neama, ʻo ne pehē,

“Ko e moʻoni ʻoku langaʻi au ʻe heʻeku ngaahi mahalo ke u tali,
ko ia ʻoku ou fakatoʻotoʻo ai.

Kuo u fanongo ki he tautea ʻo ʻeku manuki,
pea ko e laumālie ʻo ʻeku ʻilo ʻoku langaʻi au ke u tali.

‌ʻIkai te ke ʻilo eni mei muʻa,
talu hono tuku ʻoe tangata ʻi māmani,

Koeʻuhi ʻoku fuonounou ʻae nekeneka ʻoe angahala,
pea ko e fiefia ʻae mālualoiʻoku ʻi he kemo pe taha?

Neongo ʻae aʻu hake ki he langi ʻa hono ongolelei,
pea ʻasi hake hono ʻulu ki he ngaahi ʻao;

Ka ʻe ʻauha ia ʻo taʻengata ʻo hangēpe ko ʻene meʻa kovi ʻaʻana:
ko kinautolunaʻe mamata ki ai te nau pehē, ‘Kofaʻāia?’

‌ʻE puna atu ia ʻo hangēha misi, pea ʻe ʻikai ʻilo ia:
ʻio, ʻe tuli atu ia ʻo hangēko ha meʻa ʻoku hāmai ʻi he pō.

Ko e mata foki naʻe mamata ki ai ʻe ʻikai toe mamata ai;
pea ʻe ʻikai toe ʻilo ia ʻe hono potu.

‌ʻE kumi ʻe heʻene fānau ke fakafiemālieʻi ʻae masiva,
pea ʻe toe ʻatu ʻe hono nima ʻenau ngaahi meʻa.

‌ʻOku fonu hono ngaahi huiʻi he angahalaʻo ʻene kei siʻi,
pea ʻe takoto mo ia ʻi he efu.

“Neongo ʻoku melie ʻi hono ngutu ʻae fai kovi,
pea ne fufūia ʻi hono lalo ʻelelo:

Neongo ʻene mamae ki ai, ʻo ʻikai liʻaki;
kae maʻu pe ʻi hono loto ngutu:

‌ʻE liliu ʻene meʻakai ʻi hono kete,
ʻe hoko ia ko e ʻahu ʻoe fanga ngata fekai ʻi loto ʻiate ia.

Kuo ne folo hifo ʻae koloa, ka te ne toe lua ʻaki hake ia:
ʻe līia ʻe he ʻOtua mei hono kete.

‌ʻE mimisi ʻe ia ʻae kona ʻoe fanga ngata fekai:
ʻe teʻia ia ʻe he ʻelelo ʻoe ngata fekai.

‌ʻE ʻikai mamata ia ki he ngaahi vai,
ko e ngaahi vai lahi, mo e ngaahi vaitafe ʻoe meʻa huʻamelie mo e pota.

‌ʻE toe ʻatu ʻe ia ʻae fua ʻo ʻene ngāue, pea ʻe ʻikai folo hifo:
pea ʻe ʻikai fiefia ia ʻi he lahi fau ʻo ʻene koloa.

Koeʻuhi kuo ne taʻomia mo liʻaki ʻae masiva;
kuo ne toʻo fakamālohi ʻae fale naʻe ʻikai ke ne langa;

“Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai te ne ongoʻi ʻae fiemālie ʻi hono loto,
ʻe ʻikai te ne faʻa maʻu ʻaia kuo ne holi ki ai.

‌ʻE ʻikai toe ʻene meʻa kai;
ko ia ʻe ʻikai ʻamanaki ʻe ha taha ki haʻane meʻa.

‌ʻI he lahi ʻo ʻene maʻumeʻa ʻe masiva ai ia;
ʻe hoko kiate ia ʻae nima ʻoe angakovi kotoa pē.

‌ʻI heʻene teu ke fakapito hono kete, ʻe līkiate ia ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae mālohi ʻo hono houhau,
pea fakaʻauha ia kiate ia lolotonga ʻene kai.

‌ʻE puna ia mei he meʻa tauukamea,
ka ʻe fanaʻi ia ke ʻasi ʻe he kaufanaukamea.

‌ʻE fakahāʻe he langi ʻa ʻene fai kovi,
pea ʻe tuʻu hake ki ai ʻae fonua.

Ko e koloa ʻo hono fale ʻe mole,
pea tafe atu ʻi he ʻaho ʻo hono houhau.

Ko e ʻinasi eni ʻoe tangata angahala mei he ʻOtua,
mo e tufakanga kuo tuʻutuʻuni maʻana ʻe he ʻOtua.”
21: KA naʻe tali ʻe Siope, ʻo ne pehē,

“Fakafanongo lelei ki heʻeku lea,
pea ko hoʻomou fakafiemālie eni.

Mou kātaki, kau lea atu;
pea hili ʻeku lea, fai pe hoʻomou manuki.

‌ʻOiauē, he ʻoku ou liunga ki he tangata?
Pea ka ne ko ia, ko e hānai ʻe ʻikai mamahi ai hoku laumālie?

Tokanga mai, pea mou ofo,
pea ʻai homou nima ki homou ngutu.

‌ʻIo, ʻi heʻeku fakamanatu ʻoku ou manavahēʻaupito,
pea ʻoku puke ʻa hoku kakano ʻe he tetetete.

“Ko e hāʻoku moʻui ai ʻae angakovi,
ʻo hoko ʻo motuʻa, ʻio, pea lahi ʻi he mālohi?

Kuo fakatuʻumaʻu honau hako fakataha mo kinautolu,
pea mo ʻenau fānau ʻi honau ʻao.

‌ʻOku malu honau fale mei he manavahē,
pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻiate kinautoluʻae meʻa tāʻae ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku fakatauʻi ʻe heʻenau pulu tangata ʻo touʻia taʻehala;
ʻoku fānau ʻenau pulu fefine ʻo taʻetōhonoʻuhiki.

‌ʻOku nau tuku atu ʻenau fānau ʻo hangēko e fanga sipi,
pea ʻoku meʻe hopohopo ʻenau fānau.

‌ʻOku nau toʻo hake ʻae kihiʻi lali mo e haʻape,
pea nau fiefia ʻi he leʻo ʻoe meʻa ifi.

‌ʻOku nau fakaʻosi honau ngaahi ʻaho ʻi he fakafiemālie,
pea fakafokifāpe ʻoku nau ʻalu hifo ki he faʻitoka.

Ko ia ʻoku nau pehēai ki he ʻOtua, ‘ʻAlu ʻiate kimautolu,
he ʻoku ʻikai te mau holi ke ʻilo ho ngaahi hala.

Ko hai ʻae Māfimafi, ke pehēke mau tauhi ia?
Pea ko e hāʻae totongi te mau maʻu, ʻo kapau te mau lotu ki ai?’

Vakai, ʻoku ʻikai ʻi honau nima ʻenau monūʻia:
ʻoku mamaʻo ʻiate au ʻae fakakaukau ʻoe angahala.

“ʻOku liunga fiha ʻae tāmateʻi ʻoe maama ʻae angahala?
Mo e hoko ʻenau fakaʻauha kiate kinautolu?
ʻoku tufakiʻe he ʻOtua ʻae ngaahi mamahi ʻi hono houhau.

‌ʻOku nau tatau mo e tefitoʻi kaho ʻi he mata ʻoe matangi,
pea hangēko e kafukafuʻoku ʻave ʻe he afi.

‘ʻOku hili ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa ʻene angahala ki heʻene fānau:’
ʻoku ne totongi kiate ia, pea te ne ʻilo ia.

‌ʻE mamata ʻe hono mata ki hono fakaʻauha,
pea ʻe inu ia ʻi he houhau ʻoe Māfimafi.

He ko e hāʻene fiemālie ʻi hono fale ʻamui ʻiate ia,
ʻoka tuʻu ua mālie ʻae lau ʻo hono ngaahi māhina?

“ʻE akonakiʻi ʻe ha taha ʻae ʻOtua ke ʻilo?
He ʻoku ne fakamaau ʻe ia ʻakinautoluʻoku māʻolunga.

‌ʻOku mate ha tokotaha lolotonga ʻene mālohi lahi,
mo ʻene nofo tofu pe mo fiemālie.

‌ʻOku fonu hono sino ʻi he ngako,
pea lolololo hono ngaahi hui ʻi he uho.

Pea ʻoku mate ha tokotaha ʻi he mamahi lahi ʻo hono laumālie,
pea ʻikai ʻaupitohaʻane kai ʻe fiemālie ai.

Te na tokoto tatau pe ʻi he efu,
pea ʻe ʻuʻufi ʻakinaua ʻe he fanga kelemutu.

“Vakai, ʻoku ou ʻilo hoʻomou ngaahi mahalo,
mo e ngaahi filioʻi kovi ʻoku mou mahalo ʻaki kiate au.

He ʻoku mou pehē, ‘Kofaʻāʻae fale ʻoe ʻeiki?
Pea kofaʻāʻae ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻoe kakai angahala?’

‌ʻIkai kuo mou ʻeke kiate kinautoluʻoku feʻaluʻaki ʻi he hala?
Pea ʻikai ʻoku mou ʻilo ʻenau ngaahi tala,

‌ʻAia kuo tuku tolonga ʻae angahala ki he ʻaho ʻoe fakaʻauha?
ʻE taki atu ʻakinautoluki he ʻaho ʻoe houhau.

Ko hai te ne fakahāhono hala ki hono mata?
Pea ʻe totongi ʻe hai kiate ia ʻae meʻa kuo ne fai?

Ka ʻe ʻomi ia ki he faʻitoka,
ʻe nofomaʻu ia ʻi he fonualoto.

‌ʻE melie kiate ia ʻae ngaahi tutuʻanga kelekele ʻoe luo,
pea ʻe fusi kiate ia ʻae kakai kotoa pē,
ʻo hangēko e taʻefaʻalaua ʻae kakai naʻe muʻa ʻiate ia.

Pea ka kuo pehē, pea ko e hāʻoku mou fakafiemālie taʻeʻaonga kiate au,
kae vakai ʻoku ai ʻae loi ʻi hoʻomou ngaahi lea?”
22: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Elifasi mei Timani, ʻo ne pehē,

‘ʻE faʻa ʻaonga ʻae tangata ki he ʻOtua,’
ʻo hangēʻoku ʻaonga ʻaia ʻoku poto kiate ia pe?

He ʻoku ʻaonga ki he Māfimafi ʻa hoʻo māʻoniʻoni?
Pe ʻaonga ki ai ʻa hoʻo fakahaohaoa ho ngaahi ʻaluʻanga?

He te ne tautea koe ko ʻene manavahēkiate koe?
Te ne fai koāmo koe ʻae fakamaau?

‌ʻIkai ʻoku lahi ʻaupitohoʻo angahala?
Pea taʻengata mo hoʻo ngaahi hia?

He kuo ke maʻu taʻetotonu ʻae totongi mei ho kāinga,
pea kuo ke faʻao mei he telefua honau kofu.

Naʻe ʻikai te ke fakainua ʻae vaivai ʻaki ʻae vai,
pea kuo ke taʻofi ʻae māmei he fiekaia.

Ka naʻe ʻoe tangata mālohi ʻae fonua;
pea nofo ai ʻae tangata ongoongolelei.

Kuo ke fekau atu taʻehameʻa ʻae kau fefine kuo mate honau ʻunoho,
pea kuo fesiʻi ʻae nima ʻoe kau tamai mate.

Ko ia kuo kāpui ai koe ʻe he ngaahi tauhele,
pea ke puputuʻu ʻi he manavahēkuo fakafokifā;

Pea ko e fakapoʻuli ke ʻoua naʻa ke mamata,
pea ʻufiʻufi koe ʻe he ngaahi vai lahi.

“ʻIkai ʻoku ʻi he langi ʻi ʻolunga ʻae ʻOtua?
Pea ke vakai ki hono māʻolunga faufau ʻoe ngaahi fetuʻu lahi!

Ka ke pehēʻe koe, ‘ʻOku ʻilo fēfēʻe he ʻOtua?
Pea ʻe faʻa fakamaau ʻe ia ʻi he loto ʻao fakapoʻuli?

Ko e ʻufiʻufi kiate ia ʻae ngaahi ʻao matolu, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai te ne mamata ai;
pea ʻoku hāʻele pe ia ʻi he hāʻeleʻanga ʻi he langi.’

He kuo ke fakaʻilongaʻi ʻe koe ʻae hala motuʻa,
naʻe fou ai ʻae kakai angahala?

‌ʻAkinautolunaʻe tuʻusi hifo ʻi he teʻeki hoko honau kuonga,
ʻakinautolunaʻe lōmaki honau tuʻunga ʻaki ʻae vai:

‌ʻAkinautolunaʻe pehēki he ʻOtua, ‘ʻAlu ʻiate kimautolu:’
pea, ‘Ko e hāʻe faʻa fai ʻe he Māfimafi maʻanautolu?’

Ka naʻa ne fakapito ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei honau ngaahi fale:
ka ʻoku mamaʻo ʻiate au ʻae fakakaukau ʻoe angahala.

‌ʻOku mamata ki ai ʻae māʻoniʻoni, pea fiefia:
pea ʻoku kata manuki kiate kinautoluʻe he taʻeangahala.

‘Koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai tuʻusi ʻetau koloa,
ka ko honau toe ʻoku fakaʻauha ʻe he afi.’

“Fai ke ke ʻiloʻi ia, pea ke melino:
pea ko ia ʻe hoko ai ʻae lelei kiate koe.

‌ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke maʻu ʻae fono mei hono ngutu,
pea ke faʻo ki ho loto ʻa ʻene ngaahi folofola.

Kapau te ke tafoki ki he Māfimafi, ʻe langa hake koe,
pea te ke tukuangeke mamaʻo ʻae hia mei ho ngaahi fale.

Pea te ke toki fokotuʻu ʻae koloa ʻo hangēko e efu,
mo e koula ʻo Ofeli ʻo hangēko e ngaahi maka teka ʻoe tafeʻanga vai.

‌ʻIo, ʻe hoko ʻae Māfimafi ko ho fakaū,
pea te ke maʻu ʻo lahi ʻae siliva.

He te ke toki fiefia ʻi he Māfimafi,
pea hanga hake ho mata ki he ʻOtua.

Te ke fai haʻo lotu kiate ia, pea te ne ongoʻi koe,
pea te ke fai hoʻo ngaahi fuakava.

Te ke tuʻutuʻuni foki ha meʻa, pea ʻe fakamoʻoni ia kiate koe:
pea ʻe ulo ʻae maama ki ho ngaahi hala.

‌ʻOka ai ha tōkilalo, te ke toki pehē, ‘ʻOku ai ʻae hakeakiʻi;’
pea ʻe fakamoʻui ʻe ia ʻae angavaivai.

‌ʻE fakahaofi ʻe ia ʻae fonua motu ʻoe taʻeangahala:
pea ʻoku hao ia ʻi he māʻoniʻoni ʻo ho nima.”
23: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Siope, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻOku kona ʻaupitoʻa ʻeku mamahi,
ʻio, ʻi he ʻaho ni: pea mamafa lahi hoku tāʻi heʻeku faʻa toʻe.
Taumaiāke u ʻilo ʻae potu te u maʻu ai ia! Ke u aʻu atu ki hono nofoʻanga!

Te u fakamatala ʻeku meʻa ʻi hono ʻao,
ʻo fakafonu hoku ngutu ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea fakamamafa.

Te u ʻilo ai ʻae ngaahi lea te ne tali ʻaki au,
pea u faʻa ʻilo ʻaia te ne lea ʻaki mai kiate au.

He te ne fai mo au ʻaki hono mālohi lahi?
ʻIkai: ka te ne ʻai ʻae mālohi kiate au.

‌ʻE faʻa alea ai mo ia ʻae māʻoniʻoni;
pea ʻe fakamoʻui taʻengata ai au mei hoku fakamaau.

“Vakai, ʻoku ou ʻalu atu, ka ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ai ia;
pea ʻoku ou foki mai, kae ʻikai te u ʻiloʻi ia:

Ki he toʻohema, ʻoku ne ngāue ai, kae ʻikai teu sio ki ai:
pea ʻoku ne fufūia ʻi he toʻomataʻu, ke ʻoua naʻaku ʻilo ia:

Ka ʻoku ne ʻilo ʻae hala ʻoku ou ʻalu ai:
pea ka ʻosi ʻene ʻahiʻahiʻi au, te u hao mai ʻo hangēko e koula.

Kuo puke maʻu ʻe hoku vaʻe ki hono lakaʻanga,
pea kuo u ʻalu ʻi hono hala, ʻo ʻikai afe.

Pea naʻe ʻikai te u foki mai mei he fekau ʻa hono fofonga:
kuo u fufūʻi hoku loto ʻae ngaahi lea ʻa hono fofonga.

Ka ʻoku pehēai pe ia pea ko hai te ne liliu ia?
Pea ko ia ʻoku tokanga ki ai hono finangalo, ʻe fai pēʻe ia.

He te ne fakakakato hoku ʻinasi kuo tuʻutuʻuni:
pea ʻoku lahi ʻae meʻa pehēʻiate ia.

Ko ia ʻoku ou manavahēai ʻi hono ʻao:
pea kau ka fakakaukau, ʻoku ou ilifia kiate ia.

He ʻoku fakamolūhoku loto ʻe he ʻOtua,
pea ʻoku fakamamahiʻi au ʻe he Māfimafi:

Koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai tuʻusi au ʻi he teʻeki hoko ʻae fakapoʻuli,
ʻo ʻikai ʻufiʻufi ʻe ia ʻae poʻuli mei hoku mata.
24:
“KO E meʻa ʻi he ʻikai lilo ʻae ngaahi kuongamei he Māfimafi,
ko e hāʻoku ʻikai mamata ai ki hono ngaahi ʻaho ʻekinautoluʻoku nau ʻiloʻi ia?

‌ʻOku hiki ʻe he niʻihi ʻae ngaahi fakangatangata ʻoe fonua;
ʻoku nau ʻave fakamālohi ʻae ngaahi fanga manu, ʻonau fafanga ʻaki ʻakinautolu.

‌ʻOku nau fakahēʻi ʻae ʻasi ʻae tamai mate,
ʻoku nau maʻu ko e totongi ʻae pulu tangata ʻae fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho.

‌ʻOku nau fakaafeʻi ʻae masiva mei he hala:
ʻoku toitoi fakataha ʻae kakai masiva ʻoe fonua.

‌ʻOku nau taki taha tuʻusi ʻene koane ʻi he ngoue:
pea utu ʻe he angahala ʻae fua ʻoe vaine.

‌ʻOku nau fai ke mohe taʻekafu ʻae telefua,
pea ʻikai ha kafu ʻi he momoko.

‌ʻOku nau viviku ʻi he ngaahi ʻuha mei he moʻunga,
mo nau fāufuaʻi ʻae maka ko e taʻehamaluʻanga.

‌ʻOku hamusi ʻe he niʻihi ʻae tamai mate mei he huhu,
pea maʻu ʻae kofu ʻoe masiva ko e totongi.

‌ʻOku nau fai ke ʻalu telefua ia ʻo taʻehakofu,
ʻonau ʻave ʻae ūuite mei he fiekaia;

‌ʻOku nau fai lolo ʻi honau ngaahi loto ʻā,
ʻo molomoloki ʻae ngaahi tataʻoʻangauaine, mo nau fieinu.

‌ʻOku toʻe ʻae kakai mei he loto kolo,
pea tangi kalanga ʻae laumālie ʻoe mamahiʻia:
kae ʻikai ke tokangaʻi ʻe he ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku tuʻu fakataha ʻae fakapōmo e maama ʻo ne tāmateʻi ʻae masiva mo e vaivai,
pea tatau ia ʻi he poʻuli mo ha kaihaʻa.

‌ʻOku tatali ʻae mata ʻoe tono fefine ki he efiafi poʻuli,
ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻE ʻikai sio ha mata kiate au,’
pea ne fakapuli hono mata.

‌ʻOka poʻuli ʻoku nau keli ki he ngaahi fale,
ʻaia naʻa nau fakaʻilongaʻi moʻonautoluʻi he kei ʻaho,
ʻoku ʻikai ke nau ʻilo ʻae maama.

He ʻoku tatau kiate kinautoluʻae pongipongi mo e malumaluʻoe mate:
pea ka ʻiloa, ʻoku nau ʻi he lilika ʻoe malumaluʻoe mate.

Ko e laʻāmo e pupuhaʻoku faʻao ai ʻae ngaahi vai ʻuha hinehina:
ʻoku pehēʻae faʻitoka kiate kinautolukuo fai angahala.

‌ʻOku ne fai kovi ki he paʻa naʻe ʻikai fānau:
pea ʻoku ʻikai fai lelei ki he fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho.

‌ʻOku ne toho ʻaki ʻe hono mālohi ʻae kakai mālohi:
ʻoku ne tuʻuhake, pea ʻikai ʻilo ʻe ha taha pe te ne moʻui.

Neongo ʻene foaki kiate ia ʻae nofo fiemālie, ʻaia ʻoku ne falala ki ai;
ka ʻoku ne ʻafioʻi honau ngaahi hala.

Pea kapau ʻoku ʻikai pehē, ko hai te ne fakaʻilo ʻeku loi,
mo fakataʻeʻaonga ʻeku lea?”
25: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Pilitati mei Suaa, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻOku ʻiate ia ʻae pule mo e manavahēʻia,
ʻoku ne fakamelino ʻi hono ngaahi potu māʻolunga.

He ʻoku faʻa lauʻi ʻa ʻene ngaahi matatau?
Pea ko hai ia ʻoku ʻikai hopo ki ai ʻa ʻene maama?

Pea ka kuo pehē, ʻe faʻa fakatonuhia fēfēʻae tangata mo e ʻOtua?
Pea ʻe maʻa fēfēʻaia kuo fanauʻi ʻe he fefine?

Vakai pēki he māhina, pea ʻoku ʻikai huhuluia;
ʻio, ko e ngaahi fetuʻu ʻoku ʻikai maʻa ʻi hono ʻao.

Ka ʻe huanoaʻae tangata ʻaia ko e kelemutu?
Mo e foha ʻoe tangata, ʻaia ko e kelemutu?”
26: KA naʻe tali ʻe Siope, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻOku fēfēʻa hoʻo tokoni ki he taʻemālohi?
ʻOku fakamoʻui fēfēʻe koe ʻae nima vaivai?

‌ʻOku fēfēʻa hoʻo fakapotoʻi ʻae taʻepoto?
Pea fēfēʻa hoʻo fakahālahi ʻae meʻa ʻoku totonu?

Ko hoʻo lea mai kia hai?
Pea ko e laumālie ʻo hai kuo haʻu meiate koe?

“Ko e kakai mālohi kuo mate,
mo kinautoluʻoku nau nonofo, ʻoku nau feinga ki lalo ʻi he ngaahi vai.

‌ʻOku vavanga ʻae maama fufūʻi hono ʻao,
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha ʻufiʻufi ʻoe potu fakaʻauha.

‌ʻOku ne folahi atu ʻe ia ʻae potu fakatokelau ʻi he atāloa,
pea ne tautau ʻa māmani ki he ʻatānoa pe.

‌ʻOku ne haʻihaʻi ʻae ngaahi vai ʻi hono ngaahi ʻao matolu;
pea ʻoku ʻikai mahaehae ai ʻae ʻao.

‌ʻOku ne taʻofi atu ʻa hono muʻa ʻafioʻanga,
ʻo ne folahi ʻene ʻao ki ai.

‌ʻOku ne takatakai ʻae moana ʻo ʻai hono ngataʻanga,
kaeʻoua ke ʻosi ʻae ʻaho mo e pō.

‌ʻOku ngalulu ʻae ngaahi pou ʻoe langi,
pea ofo ʻi heʻene valoki.

‌ʻOku ne fakalaolao ʻae tahi ʻaki hono mālohi,
pea ʻi heʻene poto ʻoku ne tāhifo ʻae laukau.

Ko hono laumālie kuo ne teuteu ʻaki ʻae ngaahi langi;
pea kuo ngaohi ʻe hono nima ʻae ngata pikopiko.

Vakai, ko e meʻa niʻihi pe eni ʻi hono ngaahi hala:
ka ʻikai ko e meʻa siʻi ʻaupitoʻiate ia ʻoku tau fanongo ai?
Pea ko e mana ʻo hono mālohi ko hai te ne faʻa ʻiloʻi?”
27: KA naʻe fai pe ʻe Siope ʻene lea mamafa, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻI he moʻui ʻae ʻOtua, ʻaia ʻoku ne taʻefiefakamaauʻi au;
mo e Māfimafi, kuo ne fakamamahiʻi hoku laumālie;

Lolotonga ʻoku ʻiate au ʻeku mānava,
pea ʻi hoku avaʻi ihu ʻae mānava ʻae ʻOtua;

‌ʻE ʻikai lea ʻaki ʻae angahala ʻe hoku loungutu,
pe lea ʻaki ʻae kākāʻe hoku ʻelelo.

‌ʻE ʻikai ʻaupitote u fakatonuhiaʻi ʻakimoutolu:
te u mate pēka ʻe ʻikai te u tukuangeʻeku angatonu meiate au.

‌ʻOku ou kuku maʻu ʻeku māʻoniʻoni, ʻe ʻikai te u tukuangeia:
ʻe ʻikai valokiʻi au ʻe hoku loto ʻi heʻeku moʻui ni.

“Tuku ke tatau hoku fili mo e angahala,
mo ia ʻoku angatuʻu kiate au ke tatau mo e taʻemāʻoniʻoni.
He neongo ʻene maʻumeʻa, ko e hāʻae ʻamanaki ʻoe mālualoi, ʻoka toʻo atu ʻe he ʻOtua hono laumālie?
‌ʻE ongoʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa ʻene tangi ʻoka hoko ʻae mamahi kiate ia?

He te ne fakafiefiaʻi ia ʻi he Māfimafi?
ʻE ui maʻuaipēʻe ia ki he ʻOtua?

Te u akonekina ʻakimoutoluʻaki ʻae nima ʻoe ʻOtua:
ʻe ʻikai te u fufūʻaia ʻoku ʻi he Māfimafi.

“Vakai, kuo mamata ki ai ʻakimoutolukotoa pē;
pea ko e hāʻoku mou launoa pehēai fau?

Ko eni ʻae ʻinasi ʻoe tangata fai kovi mei he ʻOtua,
mo e tofiʻa ʻe maʻu ʻe he kau fakamālohi mei he Māfimafi.

Kapau ʻe fakatokolahiʻi ʻene fānau, ko e meʻa ia ki he heletā:
pea ʻe ʻikai mākona ʻi he māʻa hono hako.

Ko kinautoluʻoku toe ʻiate ia, ʻe tanu ʻi he mate:
pea ʻe ʻikai tangi ʻa hono ngaahi ʻunoho.

Neongo ʻene fokotuʻu siliva ʻo hangēko e efu,
pea teuteu ʻae ngaahi kofu ʻo hangēko e ʻumea;

‌ʻE teuteu pe ʻe ia, ka ʻe ʻai ia ʻe he angatonu,
pea ʻe vahevahe ʻae siliva ʻe he taʻeangahala.

‌ʻOku langa ʻe ia hono fale ʻo hangēko e ʻunufe,
pea hangēko e fale leʻo ʻoku langa hake ʻe he leʻo.

‌ʻE tokoto hifo ʻae tangata koloaʻia, ka ʻe ʻikai tānaki ia:
ʻoku ne fakaʻāhono mata, pea ne ʻikai leva.

‌ʻOku lōmekina ia ʻi he ilifia ʻo hangēha vai,
ʻoku kaihaʻasi ia ʻe he afāʻi he pō.

‌ʻOku ʻave ia ʻe he matangi hahake, pea ʻoku mole atu ia:
pea hangēko e afāʻoku fakapuna ia mei hono potu.

‌ʻE haʻaki ia kiate ia ʻo ʻikai taʻofi,
ʻoku holi ia ke hao atu mei hono mālohi.

Ka ʻe pasipasi ʻe ia hono nima kiate ia,
ʻo seseʻe ia mei hono potu.
28:
“KO E moʻoni ʻoku ai ʻae halanga ki he siliva,
mo e potu ki he koula ʻoku fakamaʻa ʻe he kakai.

‌ʻOku toʻo ʻae ʻaione mei he kelekele,
pea ʻoku haka ʻae palasa mei he maka.

‌ʻOku ne fakangata ʻae fakapoʻuli,
pea ne kumi ki hono ngataʻanga:
ko e ngaahi maka ʻoe poʻuli mo e ʻata ʻoe mate.

‌ʻOku tupu ʻae māmei he kelekele:
pea ʻoku fulihiʻi lalo ia ʻo hangēko e afi.

Ko hono ngaahi maka ko e potu ia ʻoe ngaahi safaia:
pea ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae efu koula.

Ko e hala eni ʻoku ʻikai ʻiloʻi ʻe he manupuna,
pea kuo ʻikai mamata ki ai ʻae mata ʻoe vulita.

Naʻe ʻikai moloki ia ʻe he fānganga ʻoe laione,
pe ʻalu ʻi ai ʻae laione fekai.

‌ʻOku ne ʻai hono nima ki he maka;
ʻoku taʻaki fuʻu hake ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi moʻunga.

‌ʻOku ne matofa ʻae ngaahi tafeʻanga vai ʻi he ngaahi maka;
pea ʻoku mamata ʻa hono mata ki he meʻa mahuʻinga kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku ne nonoʻo ʻae ngaahi vai ke ʻoua naʻa mafola ia;
pea ko ia naʻe fufūʻoku ne ʻomi ki he maama.

“Ka ʻe ʻilo ki fēʻae poto?
Pea ko māia ʻae potu ʻoe ʻilo?

Ko hono mahuʻinga ʻo ia ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo ʻe he tangata;
pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo ia ʻi he fonua ʻoe moʻui.

‌ʻOku pehēʻe he loloto, ‘ʻOku ʻikai ʻiate au ia:’
ʻoku pehēmo e tahi, ‘ʻOku ʻikai ʻiate au.’

‌ʻE ʻikai faʻa maʻu ia ʻaki ʻae koula,
pea ʻe ʻikai fakamamafa ʻae siliva mo hono totongi ʻoʻona.

‌ʻE ʻikai fakatauʻaki ia ʻae koula ʻo Ofeli,
pe ko e oniki mahuʻinga, pe ko e safaia.

‌ʻOku ʻikai tatau mo ia ʻae koula mo e kalisitala:
pea ʻe ʻikai fetongi ʻaki ia ʻae ngaahi teunga koula lelei.

‌ʻE ʻikai lau ki ai ʻae feo kulokula, mo e mataʻitofe:
he ko e mahuʻinga ʻoe poto ʻoku lahi hake ia ʻi he ngaahi maka mahuʻinga.

‌ʻOku ʻikai tatau mo ia ʻae topasi ʻo ʻItiopea,
pea ʻe ʻikai totongi ʻaki ia ʻae koula haohaoa.

Ko ia, ʻoku haʻu mei fēʻae poto?
pea ko maʻāia ʻae potu ʻoe ʻilo?

He kuo fufūia mei he mata ʻoe moʻui kotoa pē,
pea fakalilolilo mei he fanga manu ʻoe ʻatā.

‌ʻOku pehēʻe he fakaʻauha mo e mate,
‘Kuo ma fanongo ki hono ongoongo ʻo ia ʻaki homa telinga.’

“ʻOku ʻiloʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa hono hala,
pea ʻoku ne ʻiloʻi mo hono potu.

He ʻoku ne sio ki he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani,
pea ʻoku ne ʻafioʻi ʻaia kotoa pēʻoku ʻi lalo langi;

Ke ne ngaohi ʻae mamafa ʻoe matangi;
pea ʻoku ne tuʻutuʻuni ʻae ngaahi vai ʻi he fuofua.

‌ʻI heʻene fokotuʻu ʻae fono ki he ʻuha,
pea mo e hala ki he ʻuhilaʻoe mana:

Ko ia naʻa ne mamata ki ai, pea fakahāia;
naʻa ne fokotuʻumaʻu ia, ʻio, pea naʻa ne hakule ki ai.
29: KA naʻe fai ai pe ʻe Siope ʻene lea mamafa, ʻo ne pehē,

“Taumaiākuo u tatau eni mo e ngaahi māhina kuo hili ange,
ʻo hangēko e ngaahi ʻaho naʻe maluʻi ai au ʻe he ʻOtua;

‌ʻI he kei ulo ʻa ʻene maama ki hoku ʻulu,
pea u ʻalu mo ʻene maama ʻi he fakapoʻuli;

‌ʻO hangēko ʻeku nofo ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻeku monūʻia,
ʻi he fakataha ʻae kakai ʻoe ʻOtua ʻi hoku fale;

‌ʻI he kei ʻiate au ʻae Māfimafi,
pea ʻiate au mo ʻeku fānau;

‌ʻI he tafe ʻae pota ʻi hoku hala,
pea lilingi mai ʻe he maka ʻae lolo lahi ʻaupito;

‌ʻI heʻeku ʻalu atu ʻi he loto kolo ki he matapā,
pea teuʻi hoku nofoʻanga ʻi he hala lahi!

Naʻe sio kiate au ʻae kau talavou, ʻonau toitoi:
pea tutuʻu ki ʻolunga ʻae kau mātuʻa.

Naʻe taʻofi ʻe he ngaahi ʻeiki ʻenau alea,
ʻo ʻai honau nima ki honau ngutu.

Naʻe longo pe ʻae houʻeiki,
pea piki honau ʻelelo ki honau ʻoʻaoʻingutu.

‌ʻI he ongoʻi au ʻe he telinga, ne ne tāpuakiʻi au;
pea ʻi he mamata ʻae mata kiate au, naʻa ne fakamoʻoniʻi au:

He naʻaku fakahaofia ʻae masiva naʻe tangi,
ʻae tamai mate, mo ia naʻe ʻikai hano tokoni.

Ko e tāpuaki ʻo ia naʻe meimei mate ne hoko kiate au:
pea naʻaku fakafiefiaʻi ke hiva ʻae loto ʻoe fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho.

Ne u ai ʻae māʻoniʻoni, pea ne ʻufiʻufi ʻaki au:
naʻe tatau ʻeku fakamaau mo e pulupulumo e pale.

Ko e mata au ki he kui,
mo e vaʻe ki he ketu.

Ko e tamai au ki he masiva:
pea ko e meʻa naʻe ʻikai te u ʻiloʻi ne u kumi lahi ki ai.

Naʻaku fesiʻi ʻae kouʻahe ʻoe fai kovi,
ʻo toʻo ʻae meʻa faʻao mei hono nifo.

Pea u toki pehē,‘Te u mate ʻi hoku pununga,
pea te u fakalahi hoku ngaahi ʻaho ke hangēko e ʻoneʻone.

Naʻe mafola hoku aka ʻi he ngaahi veʻe vai,
pea toka ʻae hahau ki hoku vaʻa ʻi he pōkotoa.

Ko hoku ongoongolelei naʻe maʻuiʻui pe,
pea naʻe fakafoʻou ʻeku kaufanaʻi hoku nima.’

“Naʻe fakafanongo ʻae kakai kiate au, ʻo tatali,
pea fakalongo pēʻi heʻeku akonaki.

Hili ʻeku lea naʻe ʻikai te nau tali;
pea naʻe tōʻeku lea kiate kinautolu.

Pea naʻa nau tatali kiate au ʻo hangēki he ʻuha:
pea nau fakamanga lahi honau ngutu ʻo hangēki he ʻuha mui.

Ne u kata kiate kinautolu, pea ʻikai te nau faʻa tui;
pea ko e maama ʻo hoku mata naʻe ʻikai ke nau līki lalo.

Naʻaku fili honau hala, ʻo nofo ko e ʻeiki,
ne u nofo ʻo hangēha tuʻi ʻi he kautau,
pea hangēha taha ʻoku ne fakafiemālieʻi ʻae kakai mamahi.
30:
“KA ko eni, ʻoku manukiʻi au ʻekinautoluʻoku mui ʻiate au,
ka ko ʻenau ngaahi tamai ʻanautolune u fehiʻa ke lau fakataha mo e fanga kulīʻo ʻeku ngaahi fanga manu.

‌ʻIo, ʻe ʻaonga fēfēkiate au ʻae mālohi ʻa honau nima,
ka kuo ʻauha ʻenau motuʻa lelei?

Ko e meʻa ʻi he masiva mo e honge naʻa nau ʻi he fakapoʻuli ʻo hangēko e pō;
ʻo feholaki ki he toafa kuo masiva mo siʻaki.

Naʻa nau tuʻusi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau kona,
pea keli aka ke nau kai.

Naʻe kapusi ʻakinautolumei he kakai,
(pea naʻa nau kalanga ki ai ʻo hangēki ha kaihaʻa;)

Ke nau nofo ʻi he ngaahi lilifa ʻoe luo,
ʻi he ngaahi ʻana ʻoe fonua, mo e ngaahi maka.

Naʻa nau tangi mei he ngaahi ʻakau,
pea nau fakataha ʻi lalo ʻi he ngaahi ʻakau talatala.

Ko e fānau ʻae kau vale, ko e hako ʻoe kakai meʻa vale;
naʻe kapusi ʻakinautolumei he fonua.

“Ka ko eni, kuo u hoko au ko ʻenau hivehivaʻanga,
ʻio, ko ʻenau lea manukiʻanga au.

‌ʻOku nau fakaliliʻa kiate au, pea nau hola mamaʻo ʻiate au,
pea ʻikai te nau manavahēke ʻaʻanu ki hoku mata.

Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene vete ʻeku afo, ʻo tautea au,
ko ia kuo nau tukuangeai foki ʻae noʻo ʻi hoku ʻao.

‌ʻOku nau maumauʻi hoku hala,
ʻoku nau fiefia ʻi heʻeku mamahi,
ʻoku ʻikai hanau tokoni.

Naʻa nau feʻohofi mai ʻo hangēʻi ha potu fālahi:
pea ʻi he maumau naʻa nau filifilihi ʻakinautolukiate au.

Kuo tōkiate au ʻae ngaahi ilifia:
ʻoku nau tuli hoku laumālie ʻo hangēko e matangi:
pea ʻoku mole atu ʻeku lelei ʻo hangēko e ʻao.

“Pea ko eni, kuo lilingi hoku laumālie ʻiate au;
kuo puke au ʻe he ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe mamahi.

‌ʻOku mahuhuhuhuʻa hoku ngaahi hui ʻi he poʻuli:
pea ʻoku ʻikai ke mālōlōsiʻi hoku ngaahi uoua.

Kuo fetongi hoku kofu ʻe he mālohi lahi:
ʻoku ne nonoʻo takatakai au ʻo hangēko e kia ʻo hoku kofutuʻa.

Kuo ne līau ki he pelepela,
pea kuo u tatau mo e efu mo e efuefu.

‌ʻOku ou tangi kiate koe, ka ʻoku ʻikai te ke ongoʻi au:
ʻoku ou tuʻu hake, ka ʻoku ʻikai te ke tokangaʻi au.

Kuo ke liliu ʻo taʻeʻofa kiate au:
ʻoku ke tuʻu kiate au ʻaki ho nima mālohi.

‌ʻOku ke ʻohake au ki he matangi mo ke fakaheka au ki ai,
pea ʻoku ke veteki ʻeku meʻa.

He ʻoku ou ʻilo pau te ke ʻomi au ki he mate,
pea ki he fale kuo tuʻutuʻuni ki he kakai moʻui kotoa pē.

“Ka ʻe ʻikai te ne mafao atu hono nima ki he faʻitoka,
neongo ʻoku nau tangi ʻi heʻene fakaʻauha.

‌ʻIkai naʻaku tēngihia ia ʻaia naʻe mamahi?
ʻIkai naʻe mamahi hoku laumālie koeʻuhi ko e masiva?

‌ʻI heʻeku ʻamanaki ki he lelei, naʻe hoko mai ʻae kovi:
pea ʻi heʻeku tatali ki he maama, ne hoko mai ʻae fakapoʻuli.

Naʻe lili hoku fatu, ʻo ʻikai toka:
naʻe taʻofi au ʻe he ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe mamahi.

Naʻaku ʻalu mamahi pe ʻi he taʻeulo ʻae laʻā;
ne u tuʻu hake ʻo tangi ʻi he fakataha.

Ko e tokoua au ʻoe fanga talākoni,
mo e kaumeʻa ʻoe fanga lulu.

Kuo ʻuliʻuli hoku kili ʻiate au,
pea kuo velehia hoku ngaahi hui ʻi he ʻafu.

Kuo liliu ʻeku haʻape ko e tangi,
pea ko ʻeku meʻa ifi ko e leʻo ʻokinautoluʻoku tangi.
31:
“NAʻA KU fai ʻae fuakava mo hoku mata;
pea ka kuo pehē, ko e hāte u siofia ai ha taʻahine?

He ko e hāʻae ʻinasi mei he ʻOtua ʻi ʻolunga?
Pea mo e tufakanga mei he Māfimafi ʻi ʻolunga?

‌ʻIkai ʻoku ʻi he kau angahala ʻae malaʻia?
Mo e fakaʻauha foʻou ki he kau fai kovi?

‌ʻIkai ʻoku ne ʻiloʻi hoku ngaahi hala,
pea lau ʻeku ngaahi laka kotoa pē?

“He kapau naʻaku ʻalu ʻi he loi,
pea kapau teu veʻe vave ki he kākā;

Tuku ke fakamamafa au ʻi he meʻa fakatatau totonu,
koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa ʻeku angatonu.

Tuku ai ke u tūtuuʻi kae kai ʻe ha taha kehe;
ʻio, ke taʻaki fuʻu hake ʻa hoku taʻu.

“Kapau naʻe kākaaʻi ʻa hoku loto ʻe ha fefine,
pe teu toitoi ʻi he matapāʻo hoku kaungāʻapi;

Pea tuku ke momosi ʻa hoku ʻunohomo ha taha,
pea mapelu ki ai ha niʻihi kehe.

He ko e hia matea ia,
ʻio, ko e angahala ke tautea ʻe he kau fakamaau.

He ko e afi ia ʻoku ne kai ʻo aʻu ki he fakaʻauha,
pea ʻe ʻosiʻosingamālie ai ʻeku koloa.

“Kapau naʻaku lumaʻi ʻae meʻa ʻa ʻeku tamaioʻeiki pe ko ʻeku kaunanga,
ʻi he ʻena fai mo au.

Ko e hāai te u fai ʻoka tuʻu hake ʻae ʻOtua?
Pea ʻoka ʻaʻahi ʻe ia, ko e hāteu tali ʻaki ia?

He ʻikai naʻe ngaohi ia ʻe ia naʻa ne ngaohi au ʻi he manāva?
Pea ʻikai naʻe fakatupu ʻakimaua ʻosi pe ʻi he manāva ʻe he tokotaha?

“Kapau ne u taʻofi ʻae masiva mei heʻenau holi,
pe fai ke vaivai ʻae mata ʻoe fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho;

Pea kuo u kai vale haʻaku meʻa siʻi,
ʻo ʻikai te ma kai ia mo e tamai mate;

(He ʻoku talu ʻeku lahi hake mo ʻene ʻiate au, ʻo hangēko haʻane tamai,
pea talu ʻeku haʻu mei he manāva ʻo ʻeku faʻēmo ʻeku fakahinohino ia;)

Kapau kuo u mamata ki ha taha ʻoku mate koeʻuhi ko e telefua,
pe ha masiva taʻehakofu;

Kapau naʻe ʻikai tāpuaki au ʻe hono noʻotanga vala,
pea ʻikai māfana ia ʻi he fulufuluʻo ʻeku fanga sipi;

Kapau kuo u hiki hoku nima ki he tamai mate,
ʻi heʻeku ʻilo ʻoku ou mālohi ʻi he matapā:

‌ʻOfa ke homo hoku uma mei hoku hui fohe,
pea fesiʻi hoku nima ʻi he hokotanga hui.

He ko e fakaʻauha mei he ʻOtua ko e meʻa fakailifia kiate au,
pea ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene ngeia naʻe ʻikai teu faʻa kātakiʻi.

“He kapau naʻaku ʻamanaki ki he koula,
pe te u pehēki he koula lelei, ‘Ko hoku falalaʻanga koe;’

Kapau naʻaku fiefia ʻi he tupu ʻo lahi ʻeku koloa,
pea koeʻuhi kuo maʻu lahi ʻe hoku nima;

Kapau naʻaku siofia ʻae laʻāʻi heʻene ulo,
pe ko e māhina ʻoku hāʻele ʻi he ngingila;

Pea kuo fasiaʻi fufūpe hoku loto,
pe ʻuma hoku ngutu ki hoku nima:

Ko e angahala foki ia ke fakamaauʻi he ka ne pehē,
ko ʻeku liʻaki ia ʻae ʻOtua ʻoku ʻi ʻolunga.

He kapau naʻaku fiefia ʻi he ʻauha ʻo ia naʻe fehiʻa kiate au,
pe te u angahiki ki ai ʻoka moʻua ia ʻe he kovi:

Ka naʻe ʻikai te u tuku ke angahala ai ʻa hoku ngutu,
ʻi he fakaʻamu ke tōha malaʻia ki hono laumālie.

‌ʻIkai ʻoku faʻa pehēʻe heʻeku kau nofoʻanga,
Naʻe holi ʻe hai ki haʻane meʻakai pea ʻikai mākona ai?

Naʻe ʻikai mohe ʻae muli ʻi he hala:
ka ne u fakaava hoku matapāke talia ʻae fononga.

He naʻaku fufūkoāʻeku angahala ʻo hangēko ʻAtama,
ʻo fakalilolilo ʻeku hia ʻi hoku fatafata?

Pea teu manavahēki he fuʻu tokolahi?
Pe fakailifiaʻi au ʻe he manuki ʻae ngaahi fānau,
ke u longo ai, ʻo taʻehūatu ʻi he matapā?

Taumaiākuo ʻi ai ha tokotaha ʻe fie fanongo kiate au!
Vakai, ko hoku loto ke talia au ʻe he Māfimafi,
pea ke fai ha tohi ʻe hoku fili.

Ko e moʻoni te u hili ia ki hoku uma,
ʻo nonoʻo ia kiate au ʻo hangēha pale.

Te u ʻaʻau atu kiate ia ʻae lau ʻo ʻeku ngaahi laka;
te u ʻalu atu ʻo hangēha ʻeiki ke ofi kiate ia.

He kapau kuo tangi ʻe hoku fonua kiate au,
pe lāunga ʻa hono ngaahi keliʻanga;

Pea kapau kuo u kai taʻetotongi ʻa hono ngaahi fua,
pe te u fakamamahiʻi ʻae laumālie ʻokinautolunaʻe tauhi ki ai:

‌ʻOfa ke tupu ai ʻae talatalaʻāmoa ko e fetongi ʻoe uite,
mo e ʻakau taʻeʻaonga ko e fetongi ʻoe paʻale.”
Kuo ngata ʻae fakamatala ʻa Siope.
32: NAʻE tuku ai ʻe he kau tangata ʻe toko tolu ni ʻenau lea atu kia Siope, koeʻuhi naʻe māʻoniʻoni ia ʻi hono mata ʻoʻona.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻae ʻita ʻa Elihu ko e foha ʻo Palakela ko e tangata Pusa, ʻi he kāinga ʻo Lame: naʻe tupu ʻene ʻita kia Siope, koeʻuhi naʻa ne fakatonuhiaʻi ia ʻe ia kae ʻikai ko e ʻOtua.
Naʻe ʻita foki ia ki hono kāinga ʻe toko tolu, koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai te nau faʻa talia ʻa Siope, ka kuo nau talatalaakiʻi ia.
Ka naʻe tatali ʻa Elihu kaeʻoua ke ʻosi ʻae lea ʻa Siope, koeʻuhi naʻa nau motuʻa ʻiate ia.
Pea ʻi he vakai ʻa Elihu kuo ʻikai ha tali ʻi he ngutu ʻoe kau tangata ʻe toko tolu ni, naʻe tupu ʻene ʻita.
Ne u pehē, ‘ʻE lea ʻae ngaahi ʻaho, pea ʻe akonekina ke poto ʻe he ngaahi taʻu lahi.’

Ka ʻoku ai ʻae laumālie ʻi he tangata,
pea ʻoku foaki kiate ia ʻae ʻilo lahi ʻe he fakamānava ʻae Māfimafi.

‌ʻOku ʻikai poto ʻae houʻeiki kotoa pē,
pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo ʻe he mātuʻa ʻae fakamaau.

Ko ia ne u pehēai, ‘Fanongo mai kiate au;
te u fakahāfoki hoku loto.’

‌ʻIo, ne u tokangaʻi ʻakimoutolu,
pea vakai, kuo ʻikai ha taha ʻiate kimoutolukuo ne lavaʻi ʻa Siope,
pe tali ʻene ngaahi lea:
Telia naʻa mou pehē, ‘Kuo mau ʻiloʻi ʻae poto: ʻoku līhifo ia ʻe he ʻOtua, kae ʻikai ko e tangata.’

Pea ko eni, naʻe ʻikai te ne lea fakatotonu mai kiate au:
pea ʻe ʻikai teu tali ʻaki ia ʻa hoʻomou ngaahi lea.
“Naʻe ofo ʻakinautolu, ʻo ʻikai te nau toe lea: pea fakalongo pe.

Pea kuo u tatali, (he naʻe ʻikai te nau lea,
kae tutuʻu pe, ʻo ʻikai toe lea:)

Pea ne u pehē, ‘Te u tali foki ʻeau ʻi hoku lakanga,
te u fakahāfoki hoku loto.’

He ʻoku ou pito ʻi he ngaahi lea,
ʻoku fakangaueʻi au ʻe hoku laumālie.

Vakai, ʻoku tatau hoku loto mo euainetaʻehanoava;
ʻo hangēko e ngaahi hina ʻoeuainefoʻou, ʻoku toe siʻi pea mahaehae.

Te u lea kau fiemālie:
te u faʻai hoku loungutu ʻo tali.

‌ʻOfa ke ʻoua naʻaku filifilimānako ki ha taha,
pea ʻoua naʻaku ʻai ʻae hingoa fakalapu ki ha tangata.

He ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻilo ke ʻai ʻae hingoa lapu;
telia naʻa ʻave fakavave ai au ʻe hoku Tupuʻanga.
33:
“KO IA ʻoku ou kole kiate koe ʻe Siope,
fakafanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi fakamatala,
mo ke tokanga ki heʻeku lea kotoa pē.

Vakai, kuo u faʻai eni ʻa hoku ngutu,
kuo lea ʻa hoku ʻelelo ʻi hoku ngutu.

Te u lea au mei he totonu ʻo hoku loto:
pea ʻe mahino ʻae ʻilo ʻe lea ʻaki ʻe hoku loungutu.

Naʻe ngaohi au ʻe he Laumālie ʻoe ʻOtua,
pea ko e mānava ʻoe Māfimafi kuo ne foaki ʻae moʻui kiate au.

Kapau te ke faʻa tali au,
pea fokotuʻu hokohoko pe hoʻo ngaahi lea, tuʻu hake ʻi hoku ʻao.

Vakai, ʻoku ou tatau mo koe ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua:
kuo ngaohi foki au mei he ʻumea.

‌ʻE ʻikai fakamanavahēʻi koe ʻe haʻaku fakailifia,
pea ʻe ʻikai mamafa ʻa hoku nima kiate koe.

“Ko e moʻoni kuo ke lea ʻi hoku telinga,
pea kuo u ongoʻi ʻae leʻo ʻo hoʻo ngaahi lea, ʻo pehē,

‘ʻOku ou maʻa taʻehaangahala, ʻoku ou māʻoniʻoni;
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha hia ʻiate au.

Vakai,
ʻoku ne kumi ʻae meʻa ke u kovi ai,
ʻoku ne lauʻi au ko hono fili,

‌ʻOku ne ʻai hoku vaʻe ki he meʻa fakamaʻu vaʻe,
ʻoku ne vakaiʻi ʻa hoku ʻalunga kotoa pē.’

“Vakai eni, ʻoku ʻikai te ke tonuhia: te u talia koe,
he ʻoku lahi ʻae ʻOtua ki he tangata.

He ko e hāʻoku ke fai ai mo ia?
Koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻikai fakahāʻe ia ʻae ʻuhinga ʻo ʻene ngaahi ngāue.

Ka ʻoku lea ʻae ʻOtua ʻo tuʻo taha,
ʻio, ʻo tuʻo ua, ka ʻoku ʻikai tokangaʻi ia ʻe he tangata.

‌ʻOku ne toki fakaongo ʻae telinga ʻoe kakai,
ʻo ne pulusiʻa honau akonakiʻi,

Koeʻuhi ke ne taʻofi ʻae tangata mei heʻene ngāue ʻaʻana,
pea fufūʻae fielahi mei he tangata.

‌ʻOku ne taʻofi mai hono laumālie mei he luo,
mo ʻene moʻui ke ʻoua naʻa ʻauha ʻi he heletā.

Pea ʻoku ne tautea foki ia ʻaki ʻae mamahi ʻi hono mohenga,
mo hono ngaahi hui ʻaki ʻae mamahi lahi:

Ko ia ʻoku fehiʻa ai ʻene moʻui ki he mā,
mo hono laumālie ki he meʻakai ifo lelei.

‌ʻOku fakaʻaʻau ʻo ʻosi ʻa hono kakano, ʻo ʻikai ʻiloa;
pea ʻoku tuʻu mai hono ngaahi hui naʻe ʻikai hāmai.

‌ʻIo, ʻoku ʻunuʻunu atu hono laumālie ki he faʻitoka,
mo ʻene moʻui ki he kau fakaʻauha.

“Kapau ʻe ʻiate ia ha faifekau,
ko e fakamatala, ko e taha mei he toko taha afe,
ke fakahāki he tangata ʻene māʻoniʻoni:

‌ʻOku toki ʻaloʻofa ai ia kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē,
“Fakamoʻui ia mei he ʻalu hifo ki he luo:
kuo u ʻiloʻi ʻae huhuʻi.”

‌ʻE moʻui lelei hake hono sino ʻi ha tamasiʻi:
ʻe toe foki ia ki he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene kei siʻi:

‌ʻE lotu ia ki he ʻOtua, pea ʻe tokanga ia ki ai:
pea ʻe mamata ia ki hono fofonga ʻi he fiefia:
he te ne totongi ki he tangata ʻa ʻene māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻE fakahaofi ʻe ia ʻa hono laumālie ke ʻoua naʻa ʻalu hifo ki he luo,
pea ʻe mamata ʻene moʻui ki he maama.
“Vakai, ʻoku faʻa fai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēkoeʻuhi ko e tangata,

Ke ne toe ʻomi ai hono laumālie mei he luo,
pea ne fakamaama ia ʻaki ʻae maama ʻoe moʻui.

Tokanga, ʻe Siope, fakafanongo kiate au:
ke ke longo pe, kau lea.

Kapau ʻoku ai haʻo lea, tali mai:
lea, he ko hoku loto ke ke tonuhia.

Kapau ʻoku ʻikai, fakafanongo kiate au:
ke ke longo pē, kau akonekina koe ke ke poto.
34: PEA naʻe fai pe ʻe Elihu ʻa ʻene lea, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻAe kau tangata poto, mou fanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi lea;
pea tokanga kiate au ʻakimoutolukuo maʻu ʻae ʻilo.

He ʻoku ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻe he telinga ʻae ngaahi lea,
ʻo hangēʻoku kamata ʻe he ngutu ʻae kai.

Ke tau fili kiate kitautoluʻae fakamaau;
ke tau ʻilo ʻiate kitautoluʻaia ʻoku lelei.

He naʻe pehēʻe Siope, ‘ʻOku ou māʻoniʻoni:
pea kuo toʻo atu ʻe he ʻOtua hoku fakamaau.

He te u lohiakiʻi ʻa ʻeku totonu?
ʻOku taʻefaʻafakamoʻui ʻa hoku lavea ʻi he taʻetalangataʻa.’

Ko hai ha tangata ʻoku tatau mo Siope,
ʻoku ne inumia ʻae manuki ʻo hangēko e vai?

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne ʻalu fakataha mo e kau ngāue kovi,
pea ʻeveʻeva mo e kau tangata angahala.
He naʻe pehēʻe ia, ‘ʻOku ʻikai hano ʻaonga siʻi ki ha tangata ke ne fakafiefiaʻi ia ʻi he ʻOtua.’

“Ko ia, fanongo mai kiate au, ʻakimoutoluʻae kau tangata faʻa ʻilo:
ko e kovi, ke mamaʻo ia mei he ʻOtua,
pea mo e angahala mei he Māfimafi.

He ko e ngāue ʻae tangata te ne totongi kiate ia,
pea fakaʻilo ki he tangata kotoa pēʻo fakatatau ki hono ngaahi hala.

‌ʻIo, ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai fai kovi ʻae ʻOtua,
pea ʻe ʻikai fakahalaʻi ʻae fakamaau ʻe he Māfimafi.

Ko hai naʻa ne fakanofo ia ke pule ki māmani?
Pea ko hai kuo ne ngaohi ʻa māmani kotoa pē?

Kapau te ne fakatokangaʻi hono finangalo ki he tangata,
te ne tānaki kiate ia hono laumālie mo ʻene mānava;

‌ʻE mate fakataha ʻae kakano kotoa pē,
pea ʻe toe liliu ʻae tangata ko e efu.

“Kapau ʻoku ke maʻu ʻae faʻa ʻilo, fanongo eni:
fakafanongo ki he leʻo ʻo ʻeku ngaahi lea.

Te ne faʻa pule ʻaia ʻoku fehiʻa ki he totonu?
Pea te ke faʻa fakahalaiaʻi ʻaia ʻoku mātuʻaki angatonu?

He ʻoku ngali ke pehēki ha tuʻi, ʻOku ke kovi?
Pe ki he houʻeiki, ʻOku mou fai kovi?

Ka ʻe fēfēkiate ia ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai te ne filifilimānako ki he kakai houʻeiki,
pea ʻoku ʻikai lahi hake ʻene tokanga ki he koloaʻia ʻi he masiva?
He ko e ngāue ʻa hono nima ʻakinautolukotoa pē.

Te nau mate fakafokifāpe, pea ʻe mamahi ʻae kakai ʻi he tuʻuapōmālie,
pea nau mole atu:
pea ʻe fetuku atu ʻae kau mālohi taʻehanima.

“He ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi fale ʻoe tangata ʻa hono fofonga,
pea ʻoku ne ʻafioʻi ʻa hono ʻalunga kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku ʻikai ha poʻuli, pe ha malumaluʻoe mate,
ʻe faʻa fakafufūai ʻe he kau fai kovi ʻakinautolu.

Koeʻuhi ʻeʻi he meʻa ʻoku totonu;
koeʻuhi ke ne fie fakamaau ai mo e ʻOtua.

Te ne lailaiki ʻae kau tangata mālohi tokolahi taʻefaʻalaua,
pea fokotuʻu ʻae niʻihi moʻono totongi.

Ko ia ʻoku ne ʻilo ʻenau ngaahi ngāue,
pea ʻoku ne fulihiʻakinautoluʻi he pō, pea ʻoku nau ʻauha ai.

‌ʻOku ne taaʻi ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e kau tangata fai kovi,
ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai.

Koeʻuhi naʻa nau tafoki kimui meiate ia,
pea ʻikai fie tokanga ki hono ngaahi hala:

Ko ia ʻoku nau fakahoko ʻae tangi ʻae masiva ke aʻu atu kiate ia,
pea ʻoku ne ongoʻi ʻae tangi ʻae mahaki.

‌ʻOku foaki ʻe ia ʻae fiemālie, ko hai te ne faʻa fakamamahi?
Pea ka fufūʻe ia hono fofonga, ko hai ʻe faʻa mamata kiate ia?
ʻO kapau te ne fai ki ha puleʻanga, pe ki ha tangata pe tokotaha:

Koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa pule ʻae mālualoi,
telia naʻa fasiaʻi ʻae kakai.

“ʻOku taau moʻoni mo e ʻOtua ʻae lea pehēki ai,
kuo u kātaki, ʻe ʻikai te u fakamamahi.

Ko ia ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻilo ke ke ako ia kiate au:
kapau kuo u fai angahala, ʻe ʻikai te u toe fai ia.

‌ʻE fakatatau ia koāmo ho loto? Te ne totongi ia, ʻo kapau te ke ʻoua,
pe te ke loto ki ai; kae ʻikai ko au:
ko ia ke ke tala ʻaia ʻoku ke ʻilo.

Ke tala kiate au ʻe he kau tangata faʻa ʻilo,
pea ke fanongo kiate au ʻe ha tangata poto.

‘Kuo lea ʻa Siope ʻi he taʻeʻilo,
pea ʻoku taʻepoto ʻa ʻene ngaahi lea.

Ko hoku loto ke fakamaauʻi ʻa Siope ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga,
koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi tali ʻo hangēko e kau tangata angahala.

He ʻoku ne fakahoko ʻae talangataʻa ki he angahala,
ʻoku ne pasipasi hono nima ʻiate kitautolu,
ʻo fakalahi ʻene ngaahi lea ki he ʻOtua.”
35: PEA naʻe fai pe ʻe Elihu ʻa ʻene lea, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻOku ke mahalo ʻoku totonu eni, ʻa hoʻo lea ʻo pehē,
‘Ko ʻeku māʻoniʻoni ʻoku lahi ki he ʻOtua?’

He naʻa ke pehē, ‘Ko e hāhono ʻaonga kiate koe?
Pea ko e hāʻae totongi te u maʻuʻo kapau ʻe fakamaʻaau mei heʻeku angahala?’

Te u tala kiate koe,
mo kinautoluʻoku kaumeʻa mo koe.

Sio ki he ngaahi langi, ʻo mamata;
pea vakai ki he ngaahi ʻao ʻaia ʻoku māʻolunga hake ʻiate koe.

Kapau ʻoku ke fai angahala, ko e hāʻoku ke fai kiate ia?
Pea kapau kuo tupu ʻo lahi ʻa hoʻo talangataʻa, ko e hāʻoku ke fai kiate ia?

Kapau ʻoku ke māʻoniʻoni, ko e hāʻoku ke foaki kiate ia?
Pe ko e hāia ʻoku ne maʻu ʻi ho nima?

‌ʻE kovi nai hoʻo angahala ki he tangata ʻo hangēko koe;
pea ʻe ʻaonga nai hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ki he foha ʻoe tangata.

“Ko e meʻa ʻi he lahi ʻoe ngaahi meʻa fakamālohi ʻoku tangi ai ʻae kau fakamālohia,
ʻoku nau tangi kalanga ʻi he nima ʻoe mālohi.

Ka ʻoku ʻikai pehēʻe ha taha, ‘Kofaʻāia ʻae ʻOtua ko hoku tupuʻanga,
ʻaia ʻoku ne foaki ʻae ngaahi hiva ʻi he pō;

‌ʻAia ʻoku ako lahi hake kiate kitautoluʻi he ngaahi manu ʻoe fonua,
ʻo ne fakapoto lahi hake ʻakitautoluʻi he ngaahi manupunaʻoe ʻatā?’

‌ʻOku nau tangi ʻi ai, ka ʻoku ʻikai lea ha tokotaha,
ko e meʻa ʻi he laukau ʻae kau tangata kovi.

Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai fanongo ʻae ʻOtua ki he launoa,
pea ʻe ʻikai tokanga ki ai ʻae Māfimafi.

Naʻa ke lea, ʻo pehē, ‘ʻE ʻikai te ke mamata kiate ia,
ka ʻoku ʻi hono ʻao ʻae fakamaau, ko ia ke ke falala kiate ia.

Ka koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻikai pehēeni, ko ia kuo ne ʻaʻahi ai ʻi hono houhau;
ka ʻoku ʻikai te ne ʻilo ia ʻi he mamahi lahi:

Ko ia ʻoku mafaʻa taʻeʻaonga ai ʻae ngutu ʻo Siope;
ʻoku ne fakalahi ʻae ngaahi lea ʻi he taʻeʻilo.
36: KA naʻe fai ai pe ʻe Elihu ʻene lea, ʻo ne pehē,
“Ke ke kātaki siʻi pe au, pea te u fakahākiate koe ʻaia ʻoku toe ʻiate au ke lea ʻaki koeʻuhi ko e ʻOtua.

Te u ʻomi ʻa ʻeku ʻilo mei he mamaʻo,
pea te u tuku ʻae māʻoniʻoni ki hoku Tupuʻanga.

He ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai hala ʻa ʻeku ngaahi lea:
ko ia ia ʻoku haohaoa ʻi he ʻilo ʻoku ʻiate koe.

“Vakai, ʻoku māfimafi ʻae ʻOtua, pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne manukiʻi ha tokotaha:
ʻoku māfimafi ia ʻi he mālohi mo e poto.

‌ʻOku ʻikai te ne fakatolonga ʻae moʻui ʻae angakovi:
ka ʻoku ne foaki ʻae totonu ki he masiva.

Pea kapau kuo haʻi ʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae ngaahiukamea fakamaʻu,
pea fakamaʻu ʻaki ʻae ngaahi afo ʻoe mahaki;

‌ʻOku ne fakahāai kiate kinautoluʻenau ngaahi ngāue,
mo ʻenau ngaahi talangataʻa ʻaia kuo nau angatuʻu ai.

‌ʻOku ne fakaava honau telinga foki ki he akonaki,
pea fekau ke nau tafoki, pea fekau ke nau tafoki mei he angahia.

Kapau te nau talangofua pea tauhi ia,
te nau fakaʻosi honau ngaahi ʻaho ʻi he monūʻia,
mo honau ngaahi taʻu ʻi he fiemālie.

Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te nau talangofua, te nau ʻauha ʻi he heletā,
pea te nau mate taʻemaʻu ʻae ʻilo.

“Ka ko e kau loto mālualoiʻoku nau fokotuʻu ʻae houhau:
ʻoku ʻikai te nau tangi ʻi heʻene haʻisia ʻakinautolu.

‌ʻOku nau mate ʻi he kei talavou,
pea ʻoku ʻi he kau taʻemaʻa ʻa ʻenau moʻui.

‌ʻOku ne fakamoʻui ʻae mahaki ʻi hono mahaki,
pea ne fakaava honau telinga ʻi he taʻomia.

“Ka kuo ke fakakakato ʻae fakamaau ʻoe kau angakovi:
ko e fakamaau mo e angatonu ʻoku na puke koe.

“Koeʻuhi ʻoku ai ʻae houhau, ke ke vakai telia naʻa ne toʻo atu koe ʻi heʻene tā:
pea ka pehē, ʻe ʻikai faʻa fakahaofi koe ʻe he huhuʻi lahi.

Pea ʻe manako ia ki hoʻo ngaahi koloa?
ʻIkai ʻi he koula, pe ko e mafai kotoa pēʻoe mālohi.

‌ʻOua naʻa ke holi ki he pō,
ʻaia kuo motuhi ai ʻae kakai mei honau fonua.

Ke ke vakai, ke ʻoua naʻa ke tokanga ki he angahia:
he kuo ke tomuʻa fili ia ʻi he mahaki.

Vakai, ʻoku hakeakiʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻi hono mālohi:
ko hai ʻoku akonaki ʻo hangēko ia?

Ko hai kuo ne tuʻutuʻuni kiate ia ʻa hono hala?
Pe ko hai te ne faʻa pehē, ‘Kuo ke fai angahala?’

“Ke ke manatu ke fakaongolelei ʻa ʻene ngāue,
ʻaia ʻoku mamata ki ai ʻae kakai.

‌ʻE faʻa mamata ki ai ʻae tangata kotoa pē,
ʻe faʻa vakai ki ai ʻae tangata ʻi he kei mamaʻo.

Vakai, ʻoku lahi ʻae ʻOtua, pea ʻoku ʻikai te tau faʻa ʻiloʻi ia,
pea ko e lau ʻo hono ngaahi ʻaho ʻoku taʻefaʻahakule.

He ʻoku ne toʻo hake ʻae ngaahi mosiʻi vai:
ʻoku nau huaʻi hifo ʻae ʻuha ʻo fakatatau ki he mao ʻo ia:

‌ʻAia ʻoku tōhifo ʻe he ngaahi ʻao,
pea ʻuha lahi ki he tangata.

Pea ʻe faʻa ʻilo koāʻe ha taha hono folahi atu ʻoe ngaahi ʻao,
pe ki he longoaʻa ʻo hono nofoʻanga?

Vakai, ʻoku ne folahi atu ʻa ʻene maama ki ai,
pea ʻoku ne ʻufiʻufi ʻae kilisitahi.

He ʻoku ne fakamaau ʻae kakai ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni;
ʻoku ne foaki ʻae meʻakai lahi ʻaupito.

‌ʻOku ne ʻufiʻufi ʻae maama ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻao;
pea ne fekauʻi ia ʻi heʻene hoko ʻi he vahaʻa ke ʻoua naʻa ulo.

Ko hono longoaʻa ʻoku ne fakahāia,
ko e houhau lahi ki he angahala.
37: “ʻOKU tetetete hoku loto foki ʻi he meʻa ni, pea homo mei hono potu.

Ke ke fanongo lelei ki he longoaʻa ʻo hono leʻo,
mo e fatulisiʻoku ʻalu atu mei hono fofonga.

‌ʻOku ne fakahinohino ia ʻi he lalo langi kotoa pē,
mo ʻene ʻuhilaʻoku aʻu atu ki he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani.

‌ʻOku mana fakamanavahēmai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻaki hono leʻo;
ʻoku fai ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai te tau faʻa ʻiloʻi.

He ʻoku pehēʻe ia ki he ʻuha hinehina, ‘Ke ke ʻi he kelekele koe;’
pea pehēpe ki he taumosi, mo e ʻuha lahi foki ʻo hono mālohi.

‌ʻOku ne tāpuni ʻae nima ʻoe tangata kotoa pē;
koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ʻe he tangata kotoa pēʻa ʻene ngāue.

Pea ʻoku toki hūʻae fanga manu ki he ngaahi ʻana,
ʻo nofo ʻi honau ngaahi potu.

‌ʻOku haʻu ʻae ʻahiohio mei he feituʻu tonga:
mo e momoko mei he tokelau.

‌ʻOku tupu ʻae hahau ʻi he mānava ʻae ʻOtua;
pea ʻoku ʻapiʻapi ai ʻae māukupuʻoe ngaahi vai.

Pea ʻi he faʻa ʻuha ʻoku ne fakamanifinifi ʻae ʻao matolu:
ʻoku ne veteki ʻa ʻene ʻao ngingila:

Pea ʻoku ʻave fakatakamilo ia ʻe heʻene fakakaukau:
koeʻuhi ke nau fai ʻaia kotoa pēʻoku ne fekau kiate kinautoluʻi he funga ʻo māmani ʻi he fonua.

‌ʻOku ne pule ke haʻu ia, ko e meʻa tautea,
pe ko e meʻa ʻa hono fonua, pe ʻi he ʻaloʻofa.

“Ke ke fakafanongo ʻe Siope, ki he meʻa ni:
tuʻu mai ʻo fakakaukau ki he ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻae ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku ke ʻilo naʻe fakatonutonuia ʻanefēʻe he ʻOtua,
pea pule ke huhuluʻae maama ʻo ʻene ʻao?

‌ʻOku ke ʻilo ʻae potupotumālie ʻoe ngaahi ʻao,
ʻae ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻo ia ʻaia ʻoku haohaoa ʻi he ʻilo?

Pea ʻoku mafana fēfēho ngaahi kofu,
ʻoka ne ka fakatofutofuʻae fonua ʻaki ʻae matangi tonga?

He naʻa ke kau mo ia ʻi he folahi atu ʻae langi, ʻaia ʻoku mālohi,
pea ʻoku tatau mo e sioʻata haka?

‌ʻAko mai kiate kimautolupe ko e hāte mau tala kiate ia;
he ʻoku ʻikai te mau faʻa fakatonutonuʻemau lea, ko e meʻa ʻi he fakapoʻuli.

‌ʻE tala kiate ia ʻoku ou lea?
Kapau ʻe lea ha tangata, ko e moʻoni ʻe fōngia hifo ia.

Pea ko eni ʻoku ʻikai mamata ʻe he kakai ki he maama ngingila ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi ʻao:
ka ʻoku ʻalu ʻae matangi, ʻo ne fakamaʻa ia.

‌ʻOku haʻu ʻae ʻafua mei he tokelau:
ʻoku ʻi he ʻOtua ʻae ngeia fakamanavahē.

Ko e Māfimafi, ʻoku ʻikai te tau faʻa ʻiloʻi ia:
ʻoku lahi ia ʻi he mālohi,
mo e fakamaau, pea mohu angatonu: ʻe ʻikai te ne tautea.

Ko ia ʻoku manavahēai ʻae kakai kiate ia:
ʻoku ʻikai te ne tokanga ki ha tokotaha ʻoku loto poto.”
38: PEA naʻe toki folofola ʻa Sihova kia Siope mei he ʻahiohio, ʻo pehē,
“Ko hai eni ʻoku ne fakapoʻuliʻi ʻae fakakaukau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea ʻoe taʻeʻilo?

Ko eni, ke ke nonoʻo ho noʻotangavala ʻo ngali mo e tangata;
he teu ʻeke kiate koe, pea ke fakamatala mai kiate au.

“Naʻa ke ʻi fēkoe ʻi heʻeku ʻai ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo māmani?
Fakahāmai, kapau ʻoku ʻiate koe ʻae faʻa ʻilo.

Ko hai naʻa ne ai hono ngaahi fuofuaʻo ia, ʻo kapau ʻoku ke ʻilo?
Pe ko hai naʻa ne falōʻae afo ki ai?

‌ʻOku fakamaʻu ki he hāʻa hono ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo ia?
Pe ko hai naʻa ne ʻai ʻa hono maka tulikiʻo ia;

‌ʻAia naʻe hiva fiefia fakataha ai ʻae ngaahi fetuʻu ʻoe pongipongi,
pea kalanga fakafiefia ai ʻae ngaahi foha kotoa pēʻoe ʻOtua?

“Pe ko hai naʻa ne tāpuni ʻae tahi ʻaki ʻae ngaahi matapā,
ʻi heʻene hāmai, ʻo hangēko ʻene puna mei he manāva?

‌ʻI heʻeku ngaohi ʻae ʻao ko e kofu ʻo ia,
pea ko e fakapoʻuli matolu ko hono noʻo ʻoʻona.

‌ʻO keli hake ʻae potu naʻaku tuʻutuʻuni ki ai,
ʻo ʻai ki ai ʻae ngaahi pou mo e matapā.

Pea u pehē, ‘Te ke haʻu ki heni, pea ngata ai:
pea ʻe lolomi ʻi heni hoʻo ngaahi peau laukau?’

“Naʻa ke fekau ki he pongipongi talu hoʻo ngaahi ʻaho;
pea pule ki he hengihengi ʻoe ʻaho ke ne ʻilo hono potu:

Koeʻuhi ke ne puke ki he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻoe fonua,
koeʻuhi ke tupeʻi mei ai ʻae kakai angahala.

‌ʻOku liliu ia ʻo hangēko e ʻumea ki he fakaʻilonga;
pea ʻoku nau tuʻu ʻo hangēko e kofu.

Ka ʻoku taʻofi mei he kau angahala ʻenau maama,
pea ʻe fesiʻi ʻae nima māʻolunga.

“Naʻa ke hūkoe ki he ngaahi matavai ʻoe tahi?
Pe naʻa ke ʻeveʻeva ke kumi ʻae loloto?

Naʻe toʻo ʻae ngaahi matapāʻoe mate kiate koe?
Pe naʻa ke mamata ʻe koe ki he ngaahi matapāʻoe malumaluʻoe mate?

Naʻa ke ʻiloʻi ʻae māukupuʻoe fonua?
Fakahāʻo kapau ʻoku ke ʻilo ia kotoa pē.

“Ko e fēʻae hala ʻoku nofo ai ʻae maama?
Pea ko e poʻuli, ko māia ʻae potu ʻoʻona.

Koeʻuhi ke ke ʻave ia ki hono ngataʻanga ʻoʻona,
pea koeʻuhi ke ke ʻilo ʻae ngaahi hala ki he fale ʻo ia?

Kuo ke ʻilo ia, he naʻe fanauʻi koe ʻi he kuongako ia?
Pe koeʻuhi kuo lahi hono lau ʻo ho ngaahi ʻaho?

Naʻa ke hūkoe ki he ngaahi faʻoakianga ʻoe ʻuha hinehina?
Pe naʻa ke mamata koe ki he ngaahi faʻoakiʻanga ʻoe ʻuha maka,

‌ʻAia kuo u tuku ki he kuongaʻoe fakamamahi,
ki he ʻaho ʻoe fekeʻikeʻi mo e tau?

‌ʻOku vahevahe fēfeeʻi ʻae maama,
ʻaia ʻoku ne tufakike mamaʻo ʻae matangi hahake ʻi he fonua?

Ko hai kuo ne vaheʻi ʻae tafeʻanga vai ki he mahuohuaʻoe ngaahi vai,
pe ko e hala ki he ʻuhilaʻoe mana;

Koeʻuhi ke pule ke ʻuha ki he fonua, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ai ha tangata;
ki he toafa, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ai ha tangata;

Ke fakafiemālie ʻae kelekele lala mo liʻaki;
ke fakatupu ʻae moto ʻoe ʻakau vaivai?

Ko hai ʻae tamai ʻae ʻuha?
Pe ko hai kuo ne fakatupu ʻae ngaahi tulutāʻoe hahau?

Naʻe haʻu ʻae vai fefeka mei he manāva ʻo hai?
Pea ko hai naʻa ne fakatupu ʻae falositi hinehina ʻoe langi?

Kuo fufūʻae ngaahi vai ʻo hangēko e maka,
pea kuo fakafefeka ʻae funga ʻoe loloto.

“ʻOku ke faʻa puleʻi ʻe koe ʻae ngaahi mālohi melie ʻo Peliatisi,
pe vete ʻae ngaahi haʻi ʻo Olioni?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa ʻomi ʻe koe ʻa Masaloti ʻi hono kuonga?
Pe te ke faʻa fakahinohino ʻa ʻAakitulio mo hono ngaahi foha?

‌ʻOku ke ʻiloʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ʻoe langi?
ʻOku ke faʻa fokotuʻu ʻene pule ki he fonua?

“ʻOku ke faʻa hiki hake ʻe koe ho leʻo ki he ngaahi ʻao,
koeʻuhi ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki koe ʻae ngaahi vai lahi?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa fekau atu ʻae ngaahi ʻuhila, koeʻuhi ke nau ʻalu,
ʻonau pehēkiate koe, ‘Ko kimautolueni?’

Ko hai kuo ne ʻai ʻae poto ki he ngaahi potu ʻi loto?
Pe ko hai kuo ne foaki ʻae faʻa ʻilo ki he loto?

Ko hai ʻoku faʻa lau ʻae ngaahi ʻao ʻi he poto?
Pe ko hai te ne faʻa taʻofi ʻae ngaahi hina ʻoe langi?

‌ʻOka tupu ʻo fefeka ʻae efu,
pea piki fakataha ʻae tuʻutanga kelekele?

“He te ke tuli ʻae meʻakai maʻae laione?
Pe fakamākona ʻae fiekaia ʻoe fanga laione mui,

‌ʻOka nau ka tokoto ʻi honau ngaahi ʻana,
pea nofo pe ʻo lama ʻi he potu lilo?

Ko hai ʻoku ne tokonaki ʻae meʻakai ki he leveni,
ʻoka tangi hono fānganga ki he ʻOtua,
ʻi heʻenau hēko e masiva kai?
39:
“ʻOKU ke ʻilo ʻae feituʻulaʻāʻoku fanauʻi ai ʻae fanga kosi kaivao ʻoe maka?
Pe ʻoku ke faʻa fakaʻilonga ʻoka fanauʻi ʻae fanga hainiti?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa lau ki he kakato ʻo honau ngaahi māhina?
Pe ʻoku ke ʻilo ʻae feituʻulaʻāʻoku nau fāʻele ai?

‌ʻOku nau fakamapelu ʻakinautolu, ʻoku nau fāʻeleʻi honau ʻuhiki,
ʻoku nau līkituʻa ʻenau ngaahi mamahi.

“Ko hai kuo ne fekau atu tauʻatāina ʻae ʻasi kaivao?
Pe ko hai kuo ne vete ʻae ngaahi haʻi ʻoe ʻasi kaivao?

‌ʻAia kuo u tuʻutuʻuni ʻae toafa ko hono fale ʻoʻona,
mo e fonua lala ko hono ngaahi nofoʻanga.

‌ʻOku manuki ia ki he tokolahi ʻoe kolo,
pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne tokanga ki he kalanga ʻoe tauhi.

Ko hono kaiʻanga ko e ngaahi moʻunga ʻataʻatā,
pea ʻoku ne kumi ʻae meʻa mata kotoa pē.

“ʻE fie tauhi kiate koe ʻae liimi,
pe nofo ofi ki hoʻo ʻaiʻangakai?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa nonoʻo ʻae liimi ʻaki hono noʻotaki ʻi he keli?
Pe te ne muimuiʻiate koe ke fakatoka lelei ʻae ngaahi luo?

Te ke falala ki ai koeʻuhi ʻoku lahi ʻa hono mālohi?
Pe te ke tuku hoʻo ngāue kiate ia?

Te ke tui kiate ia, te ne fetuku ki ʻapi hoʻo ngaahi fua,
ʻo tānaki ia ki ho feleoko?

“Ko e kapakau ʻoe ʻositalesi ke kapakapa:
ka ʻoku puna hake ʻae sitoaka mo e falekoni.

Vakai, ʻoku ne fakato hono ngaahi fua ʻi he kelekele,
ʻo ne fakamafana ia ʻi he efu,

Pea ngalo ʻiate ia ʻe laiki nai ia ʻe he vaʻe,
pe maumauʻi ia ʻe he manu kaivao.

Kuo fakafefeka ʻene anga ki hono fānganga ʻo hangēʻoku ʻikai ʻaʻana ʻakinautolu:
ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻene ngāue taʻemanavahē;

Koeʻuhi kuo fakamasivaʻi ia ʻe he ʻOtua ʻi he poto,
pea naʻe ʻikai te ne tuku kiate ia ʻae faʻa ʻilo.

Ko e feituʻulaʻāko ia te ne tuʻu hake ki ʻolunga,
ʻoku ne manukiʻi ʻae hoosi mo ia ʻoku heka ai.

“Naʻa ke tuku ʻe koe ʻae mālohi ki he hoosi?
Naʻa ke fakakofuʻaki hono kia ʻae mana?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa fakamanavahēʻi ia ʻo hangēko e heʻe?
Ko e mānava lahi ʻo hono ihu ʻoku fakailifia.

‌ʻOku kenukenuia ʻi he vahaʻa moʻunga, pea fiefia ʻi he mālohi:
ʻoku ʻalu atu ia ke fakafetaulakiki he kau tangata ʻoku toʻo mahafutau.

‌ʻOku ne manuki ki he manavahē, pea ʻoku ʻikai ilifia ia;
pe foki kimui mei he heletā.

‌ʻOku ngatata ʻae tangakaho kiate ia,
ʻae tao ngingila pea mo e fakaū.

‌ʻOku ne folohifo ʻae kelekele ʻi he feinga mo e lili:
pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne tui ko e leʻo ia ʻoe meʻa lea.

‌ʻOku pehēʻe ia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi meʻa lea, ‘He, he;’
pea nanamu ki he tau ʻi he kei mamaʻo,
ko e mana ʻoe kau taki tau, mo ʻenau mavava.

“ʻOku puna ʻae falekoni ʻi hoʻo poto,
ʻo mafao atu hono kapakau ki he feituʻu tonga?

‌ʻOku puna hake ʻae ʻikale ko hoʻo fekau,
ʻo ne ngaohi hono pununga ʻi ʻolunga?

‌ʻOku nofo ia ʻo tatali ʻi he maka,
ʻi he maka hangatāmaki, mo e potu mālohi.

‌ʻOku kumi mei ai ʻene meʻakai,
pea ʻoku sio hono mata mei he mamaʻo.

‌ʻOku mimisi hake foki ʻe hono ʻuhikiʻae toto:
pea ko e potu ko ia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae mate, ʻoku ʻi ai ia.”
40: PEA naʻe folofola pe ʻa Sihova kia Siope, ʻo pehē,

“Ko ia ʻoku ne fakakikihi ki he Māfimafi te ne akonaki ia?
Ko ia ʻoku ne valokiʻi ʻae ʻOtua, tuku ke ne talia ia.”
¶Pea naʻe toki tali ʻe Siope kia Sihova, ʻo ne pehē,

“Vakai kuo u kovi; ko e hāte u tali ʻaki koe?
Te u ʻai hoku nima ki hoku ngutu.

Kuo u lea ʻo tuʻo taha ka ʻe ʻikai te u toe lea:
ʻio, kuo tuʻo ua ka ʻe ʻikai te u toe lea atu.”
¶Pea naʻe toki folofola ʻa Sihova kia Siope mei he ʻahiohio, ʻo pehē,

“Ko eni, ke ke nonoʻo ho noʻotangavala ʻo taau mo e tangata:
pea te u ʻeke kiate koe, pea ke fakahāmai kiate au.

Te ke fakataʻeʻaongaʻi ʻa ʻeku fakamaau foki?
Te ke fakahalaia au, koeʻuhi ke ke māʻoniʻoni koe?

Kuo ke maʻu ʻae nima ʻo hangēko e ʻOtua?
Pe ʻoku ke faʻa mana koe ʻaki ʻae leʻo ʻo hangēko ia?

“Ko eni, ke ke teuʻi koe ʻaki ʻae māfimafi mo e ngeia;
mo ke kofuʻaki koe ʻae nāunau mo e toulekeleka.

Tufakike mamaʻo ʻae tuputāmaki ʻo ho houhau:
pea vakai kiate kinautolutaki taha kotoa pēʻoku laukau, ʻo fakavaivai ia.

Vakai kiate ia kotoa pēʻoku fielahi, pea ʻohifo ia ki lalo;
pea molomoloki hifo ʻae kau angahala ʻi honau potu.

Fakafufūʻakinautolufakataha ʻi he efu;
pea nonoʻo honau mata ʻi he lilo.

Pea te u toki fakamoʻoni kiate koe,
ʻe faʻa fakamoʻui koe ʻe ho nima toʻomataʻu ʻoʻou.

“Ko eni, ke ke vakai ki he Piʻimote, ʻaia kuo u ngaohi mo koe;
ʻoku ne kai mohuku ʻo hangēko e fanga pulu:

Vakai, ʻoku ʻi hono fasiʻatuʻa ʻa hono mālohi,
mo ʻene mafai ʻoku ʻi he pito ʻo hono kete.

‌ʻOku ne ueʻi hono iku ʻo hangēko e sita:
ko e uoua ʻo hono tenga ʻoku fefihitaki fakataha.

Ko hono ngaahi hui ʻoku tatau mo e ngaahi konga palasa mālohi;
ʻoku tatau hono ngaahi hui mo e ngaahi vaʻa ʻaione.

Ko e lahi ia ʻoe ngaahi ngāue ʻae ʻOtua:
ko ia naʻa ne ngaohi ia ʻoku ne faʻa fai ke fakaofi ʻene heletākiate ia.

Ko e moʻoni, ʻoku tupu hake ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga ʻae meʻakai maʻana,
ʻaia ʻoku fakavāai ʻae ngaahi manu kotoa pēʻoe ngoue.

‌ʻOku tokoto ia ʻi he lolo ʻakau malumalu,
ʻi he lilolilo ʻoe kaho, mo e ngaahi ano.

Ko e ngaahi ʻakau malumaluʻoku ʻufiʻufi ia ʻaki honau ata;
ʻoku tuʻu takatakai ʻiate ia ʻae ngaahiuilouʻoe vaitafe.

Vakai, ʻoku ne inu ʻae vaitafe ʻo maha, pea ʻikai toʻotoʻo:
ʻoku tui ia te ne faʻa mimisi hake ʻa Sioatani ki hono ngutu.

‌ʻOku ne maʻu ia ʻaki hono mata:
ʻoku ne tuiʻi ʻae ngaahi tauheleʻaki hono iku.
41:
“ʻOKU ke faʻa fusi hake ʻae levaiatani ʻaki ʻae mātaʻu?
Pe ko hono ʻelelo ʻaki ʻae afo ʻoku ke tukutukuhifo?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa ʻai ʻae mātaʻu ki hono ihu?
Pe vili ke ʻasi hono kouʻahe ʻaki ʻae talaʻi ʻakau?

Te ne fai ʻene ngaahi hūtāumaʻu kiate koe?
Te ne lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea malu kiate koe?

Te ne fai ʻae fuakava mo koe?
Te ke maʻu ia ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ʻo taʻengata?

Te ke fakavāmo ia ʻo hangēko e manupuna?
Pe te ke noʻotaki ia maʻa hoʻo kau taʻahine?

‌ʻE fai kātoanga ʻaki ia ʻe ho kaumeʻa?
Te nau vahevahe ia ki he kakai fakatau?

‌ʻOku ke faʻa fakapito hono kili ʻi he taoukamea talatala?
Pe ko hono ʻulu ʻi he tao hoka ika?

Hilifaki ho nima kiate ia,
manatu ki he tau, pea ʻoua naʻa toe fai hāmeʻa.

Vakai, ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ke ʻamanaki kiate ia:
ʻikai ʻe tōki lalo ha tokotaha ʻi he mamata pe kiate ia?

‌ʻOku ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻoku loto lahi ʻe fie ueʻi ia ke tuʻu hake:
pea ka kuo pehē, ko hai koāʻe faʻa tuʻu ʻi hoku ʻao?

Ko hai kuo ne tomuʻa fai kiate au koeʻuhi ke u totongi ia?
Ko e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ʻi lalo langi ʻoku ʻaʻaku ia.

“ʻE ʻikai te u fakapuli hono ngaahi konga,
pe ko hono mālohi, pe ko hono matamatalelei.

Ko hai te ne faʻa ʻilo ʻae mata ʻo hono kofu?
Pe ko hai ʻe faʻa haʻu kiate ia mo e palaiteli lou ua?

Ko hai te ne faʻa toʻo ʻae matapāʻo hono mata?
ʻOku fakailifia hono ngaahi nifo ʻoku takatakai.

‌ʻOku viki ia ʻi hono ngaahi ʻuno,
ʻaia ʻoku tāpuni fakataha ʻo hangēko e meʻa pulusimaʻu.

‌ʻOku fengūtaki pehēʻae taha ki he taha,
ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai faʻa hūai ʻae matangi ʻi hona vahaʻa.

‌ʻOku nau fehokotaki,
ʻo fepikitaki fakataha, pea ʻe ʻikai faʻa vaheʻi.

‌ʻI heʻene mafatua ʻoku ulo ai ʻae maama,
pea ʻoku tatau hono mata mo e laumataʻoe pongipongi.

‌ʻOku ʻalu atu mei hono ngutu ʻae ngaahi maama ulo,
ʻoku puna mei ai kituʻa ʻae ngaahi kalofiama.

‌ʻOku ʻalu atu ʻi hono avaʻi ihu ʻae ʻohuafi,
ʻo hangēko e kulo vai kuo lili, pe ko e fuʻu kulo.

‌ʻOku tutu ʻe heʻene mānava ʻae malala,
pea ʻoku ulo mai ʻae afi mei hono ngutu.

‌ʻOku nofo ʻae mālohi ʻi hono kia,
pea ʻoku liliu ʻae mamahi ko e fiefia ʻi hono ʻao.

‌ʻOku mālohi hono loto ʻo hangēko e maka;
ʻio, ʻoku fefeka ʻo hangēko e konga ʻoe maka tokalalo ʻoe meʻa momosi.

‌ʻOka fokotuʻu hake ia ki ʻolunga, ʻoku manavahēʻae kau mālohi:
ko e meʻa ʻi he faʻa maumau ʻoku nau fakamaʻa ʻakinautolu.

Ko e heletāʻo ia ʻoku ne tākiate ia ʻoku ʻikai tau;
pe ko e tao, pe ko e tokotoko, mo e kofutau.

‌ʻOku tatau kiate ia ʻae ʻaione mo e mohuku,
ʻae palasa mo e ʻakau popo.

‌ʻE ʻikai hola ia ʻi he ngahau:
ʻoku ne liliu ʻae ngaahi makatāko e veve.

‌ʻOku ne ui ʻae ngaahi ngahau ko e mohuku mōmoa:
ʻoku kata ia ʻi he apoapo ʻoe tao.

‌ʻOku ʻi lalo ʻiate ia ʻae ngaahi maka māsila:
ʻoku ne folahi ki he pelepela ʻae ngaahi meʻa māsila.

‌ʻOku ne fakalili ʻae loloto ʻo hangēko e kulo:
ʻoku ne ngaohi ke tatau ʻae tahi mo e ipu ʻoe meʻa tākai.

‌ʻOku ne fakangingila ʻae hala kimui ʻiate ia;
ʻe mahalo ʻe ha taha ʻoku hinehina ʻae loloto.

‌ʻOku ʻikai hano tatau ʻi he fonua,
ʻaia kuo ngaohi ke taʻemanavahē.

‌ʻOku ne vakai ki he ngaahi meʻa māʻolunga kotoa pē:
ko e tuʻi ia ki he ngaahi fānau kotoa pēʻoe laukau.”
42: PEA naʻe toki tali ʻe Siope kia Sihova, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻOku ou ʻilo ʻoku ke faʻa fai ʻae meʻa kotoa pē,
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha mahalo ʻe faʻa puli meiate koe.

‘ʻOku ou kole kiate koe ke ke fanongo mai, pea te u lea:
te u ʻeke kiate koe, pea ke fakahāmai kiate au.’

Kuo u fanongo kiate koe ʻi he fanongo ʻoe telinga:
ka ko eni kuo mamata ʻe hoku mata kiate koe.

Ko ia ʻoku ou fehiʻa ai kiate au,
ʻo fakatomala ʻi he efu mo e efuefu.”

¶Pea naʻe pehē, hili ʻae folofola ʻa Sihova ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea ni kia Siope, “Naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Elifasi mei Timani, Kuo tupu hoku houhau kiate koe, mo ho kāinga ʻe toko ua: he ʻoku ʻikai te mou lea ʻaki kiate au ʻae meʻa ʻoku totonu, ʻo hangēko ʻeku tamaioʻeiki ko Siope.

Ko ia ke mou toʻo ni kiate kimoutoluʻae fanga pulu ʻe fitu, mo e sipitangata ʻe fitu, ʻo ʻalu ki heʻeku tamaioʻeiki ko Siope, pea ʻohake ʻae feilaulau tutu koeʻuhi ko kimoutolu; pea ʻe hūfia ʻakimoutoluʻe heʻeku tamaioʻeiki ko Siope: he te u maʻu ia: telia naʻaku taaʻi kiate kimoutoluʻo hangēko hoʻomou vale, ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻikai te mou lea ʻaki kiate au ʻaia ʻoku totonu, ʻo hangēko ʻeku tamaioʻeiki ko Siope.”
Ko ia naʻe ʻalu ai ʻa Elifasi mei Timani, mo Pilitati mei Suaa, mo Sofaa mei Neama, ʻonau fai ʻo hangēko e fekau ʻa Sihova kiate kinautolu: pea naʻe maʻu ʻe Sihova ʻa Siope foki.
Pea naʻe liliu ʻe Sihova ʻae pōpula ʻo Siope, ʻi heʻene hūfia hono kāinga: pea naʻe fakamaʻumeʻa ʻe Sihova kia Siope ʻo liunga ua hake ʻi he meʻa naʻa ne maʻu ʻi muʻa.

Pea naʻe toki haʻu kiate ia ʻa hono ngaahi kāinga kotoa pē, mo hono ngaahi tuofefine, mo kinautolukotoa pēnaʻa nau kaumeʻa mo ia ʻi muʻa, ʻonau kai māmo ia ʻi hono fale: pea naʻa nau tēngihia ia, ʻo fakafiemālie ia ʻi he ngaahi kovi kotoa pēnaʻe ʻomi ʻe Sihova kiate ia: pea naʻe foaki ʻe he tangata taki taha kotoa pēkiate ia ʻae paʻanga, mo e hau koula.

Pea naʻe tāpuaki lahi hake ʻe Sihova ʻae moʻui kimui ʻa Siope ʻi heʻene moʻui ki muʻa: he naʻa ne maʻu ʻae sipi ʻe taha mano ma fāafe, mo e kāmeli ʻe ono afe, mo e fanga pulu taulua ʻe taha afe, mo e ʻasi fefine ʻe taha afe.
Pea naʻa ne maʻu foki ʻae foha ʻe toko fitu mo e ʻofefine ʻe toko tolu.
Pea naʻa ne ui ʻae hingoa ʻoe ʻuluaki, ko Simaima, mo e hingoa ʻo hono toko ua, ko Kesaia, mo e hingoa ʻo hono toko tolu, ko Keleni-Hapuka.

Pea naʻe ʻikai ʻilo ʻi he fonua kotoa pēha kau fefine hoihoifua ʻo hangēko e ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Siope: pea naʻe foaki ʻae tofiʻa kiate kinautoluʻe heʻenau tamai ʻi he fakataha mo honau ngaahi tuongaʻane.
Pea hili ʻae meʻa ni naʻe moʻui ʻa Siope ʻi he taʻu ʻe teau ma fāngofulu, ʻo ne mamata ki hono ngaahi foha, mo e ngaahi foha ʻo hono ngaahi foha, ʻio, ko e toʻutangata ʻe fā.
Pea naʻe pekia ʻa Siope, kuo motuʻa mo fonu ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho.

1:
‌ʻOKU monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku ʻikai ʻeveʻeva ʻi he fakakaukau ʻae angakovi,
pe tuʻu ʻi he hala ʻoe kau angahala,
pe nofo ʻi he nofoʻa ʻoe manuki.

Ka ko ʻene fiefia ʻoku ʻi he fono ʻa Sihova;
pea ko ʻene fono ʻoku ne fakalaulaulotoai ʻi he ʻaho mo e pō.

‌ʻOku ʻikai pehēʻae angakovi:
ka ʻoku tatau ia mo e kafukafuʻaia ʻoku vilingia, ʻi he matangi.

Ko ia ʻe ʻikai tuʻu ʻae angakovi ʻi he fakamaau,
pe ko e angahala ʻi he fakataha ʻoe māʻoniʻoni.

He ʻoku ʻilo ʻe Sihova ʻae hala ʻoe māʻoniʻoni:
ka ko e hala ʻoe angakovi ʻe ʻauha ia.
2:
KO E HĀʻoku matalili ai ʻae hiteni?
Pea fakalaulaulotoʻae kakai ki he meʻa noa pē?

‌ʻOku tuʻu hake fakataha ʻae ngaahi tuʻi ʻo māmani,
pea fakakaukau fakataha
ʻae kau pule kia Sihova mo ia kuo ne pani, ʻo pehē,

“Ke tau motuhi ʻena ngaahi haʻi
pea liʻaki ʻena ngaahi afo ʻiate kitautolu.”

Ko ia ʻoku nofo ʻi he ngaahi langi ʻe kata ia:
ʻe manuki ʻa Sihova kiate kinautolu.

Pea te ne toki folofola kiate kinautoluʻi hono houhau,
pea fakamamahiʻi ʻakinautoluʻi hono tuputāmaki lahi.

Ka kuo u fakanofo ʻeku tuʻi ki Saione,
ko e moʻunga ʻo ʻeku māʻoniʻoni.

“Te u fakahāʻae tuʻutuʻuni:”
naʻe pehēʻe Sihova kiate au,
“Ko hoku ʻAlo koe kuo u fakatupu koe ʻi he ʻaho ni.

Ke ke lea kiate au, pea te u foaki ʻae ngaahi hiteni ko ho tofiʻa,
mo e ngaahi ngataʻanga kotoa pēʻo māmani moʻou.

Te ke maumauʻi ʻakinautoluʻaki ʻae vaʻaukamea;
pea te ke laiki ke lailai ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e ipu ʻumea.

Pea ko eni, ke poto ʻakimoutoluʻae ngaahi tuʻi:
pea maʻu ʻae akonaki ʻakimoutoluʻae kau fakamaau ʻo māmani.

Tauhi ʻa Sihova ʻi he manavahē,
pea fiefia ʻi he tetetete.

‌ʻUma ki he ʻAlo, telia naʻa houhau ia, pea te mou ʻauha mei he hala,
ʻoka tupu siʻi pe hono houhau.
ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku falala kiate ia.
3:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, kuo tupu ʻo tokolahi ʻakinautoluʻoku fakamamahiʻi au!
ʻOku tokolahi ʻakinautoluʻaia ʻoku tuʻu hake ʻo angatuʻu kiate au.

‌ʻOku tokolahi ʻakinautoluʻaia ʻoku pehēki hoku laumālie,
“ʻOku ʻikai ha tokoni kiate ia ʻi he ʻOtua.”Sila.

Ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ko e fakaūkiate au;
ko hoku nāunau, mo e hiki hake ʻa hoku ʻulu.

Naʻaku tangi kia Sihova ʻaki hoku leʻo,
pea naʻa ne ongoʻi au mei hono moʻunga māʻoniʻoni.Sila.

Ne u tokoto hifo ʻo mohe; pea u ʻāhake;
he ko Sihova naʻa ne tokoniʻi au.

‌ʻE ʻikai te u manavahēʻi he ngaahi toko mano ʻoe kakai,
ʻaia ʻoku angatuʻu ʻo kāpui au.

Tuʻu hake, ʻE Sihova;
fakamoʻui au, ʻE hoku ʻOtua:
he kuo ke taaʻi hoku ngaahi fili kotoa pēʻi honau hui kouʻahe
kuo ke fesiʻi ʻae kau nifo ʻoe angakovi.

‌ʻOku ʻia Sihova ʻae fakamoʻui:
ko hoʻo tāpuaki ʻoku ʻi hoʻo kakai.Sila.
4:
‌ʻAe ngaahi foha ʻoe tangata, ʻe ngata ʻafēhoʻomou liliu hoku nāunau ko e meʻa fakamā?
ʻe ngata ʻafēhoʻomou ʻofa ki he meʻa vaʻinga pe, ʻo kumi ki he loi?Sila.

Ka mou ʻilo kuo vaheʻi ʻe Sihova maʻana ʻaia ʻoku angalelei:
ʻe fanongo ʻe Sihova ʻo kau ka kole kiate ia.

Mou manavahē, pea ʻoua naʻa fai angahala:
fakakaukau mo homou loto ʻi homou mohenga, pea mou fakalongo pe.Sila.

Feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi feilaulau māʻoniʻoni,
pea mou falala kia Sihova.

‌ʻOku pehēʻe he tokolahi, “Ko hai te ne fakahāha lelei kiate kitautolu?”
ʻE Sihova, ke ke hiki hake kiate kimautoluʻae maama ʻo ho fofonga.

Kuo ke ʻai ki hoku loto ʻae fiefia lahi hake ʻi he fiefia
ʻi he kuonganaʻe tupu ʻo lahi ai ʻenau uite mo euaine.

Te u tokoto hifo ʻi he fiemālie, ʻo mohe: he ko koe pē,
ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke pule ke u nofo lelei.
5:
KE ke fofonga mai ki heʻeku ngaahi lea,
ʻE Sihova,
tokanga ki heʻeku fakalaulauloto.

Ke ke fanongo ki he leʻo ʻo ʻeku tangi, ʻE hoku tuʻi, mo hoku ʻOtua:
he te u lotu pe kiate koe.

Ko hoku leʻo te ke ongoʻi ʻE Sihova, ʻi he pongipongi;
ʻi he pongipongi te u ʻohake ʻeku lotu kiate koe, pea u hanga hake.

He ʻoku ʻikai ko e ʻOtua koe ʻoku fiemālie ʻi he angahala:
pea ʻe ʻikai nonofo mo koe ʻae kovi.

‌ʻE ʻikai tuʻu ʻi ho ʻao ʻae kau vale:
ʻoku ke fehiʻa ki he kakai fai kovi kotoa pē.

Te ke fakaʻauha ʻakinautoluʻoku lea loi:
ʻe fakaliliʻa ʻa Sihova ki he tangata pani toto mo kākā.

Ka ko au, te u hūki ho fale ʻi he lahi ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻofa:
pea ʻi he manavahēkiate koe te u hūʻi he faletapu ʻo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.

Tataki au, ʻE Sihova, ʻi hoʻo māʻoniʻoni koeʻuhi ko hoku ngaahi fili;
fakatotonu ho hala ʻi hoku mata.

Kae tuku ke fiefia ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻaia ʻoku falala kiate koe:
ke nau kalanga maʻuaipēʻi he fiefia, ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻo maluʻi ʻakinautolu:
tuku ke fiefia ʻiate koe ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻofa ki ho huafa.

He ko koe, ʻE Sihova, te ke tāpuaki ʻae māʻoniʻoni;
te ke kāpui ʻaki ia ʻae ʻofa ʻo hangēko e fakaū.
6:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, ʻoua naʻa ke valokiʻi au ʻi ho houhau,
pe tautea au ʻi ho houhau vela.

‌ʻAloʻofa mai kiate au, ʻE Sihova; he ʻoku ou vaivai:
ʻE Sihova, fakamoʻui au he kuo mamahi hoku ngaahi hui.

‌ʻOku mamahi lahi foki mo hoku laumālie:
ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloa?

Tafoki mai, ʻE Sihova, fakahaofi hoku laumālie:
ʻoiauē, fakamoʻui au koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa.

He ʻoku ʻikai ha fakamanatu kiate koe ʻi he mate:
ko hai te ne fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻi he faʻitoka?

Kuo tutue hoku mata ko e meʻa ʻi he mamahi;
ʻoku fakaʻaʻau ke motuʻa ia koeʻuhi ko hoku ngaahi fili.

‌ʻAlu ʻiate au, ʻakimoutolukotoa pēʻoku fai kovi;
he kuo ongoʻi ʻe Sihova ʻae leʻo ʻo ʻeku tangi.

Kuo fanongo ʻa Sihova ki heʻeku hūtāumaʻu;
pea ʻe maʻu ʻe Sihova ʻa ʻeku lotu.

Tuku ke māmo mamahi lahi ʻa hoku ngaahi fili kotoa pē:
tuku ke nau foki pea māfakafokifāpe.
7:
‌ʻE SIHOVA ko hoku ʻOtua, ʻoku ou falala pe kiate koe:
ke ke fakamoʻui au meiate kinautolukotoa pēʻoku fakatangaʻi au, mo ke fakahaofi au.

Telia naʻa ne haehae hoku laumālie ʻo hangēko e laione,
ʻo haehae ia ke fakaikiiki, ʻoka ʻikai ha fakahaofi.

‌ʻE Sihova ko hoku ʻOtua, kapau naʻaku fai eni;
kapau ʻoku ai ha angahala ʻi hoku nima;

Kapau ne u totongi kovi kiate ia naʻe nofo ʻi he melino mo au;
ʻio, naʻaku fakamoʻui ia ʻaia kuo hoko ko hoku fili taʻehanoʻuhinga:

Tuʻu hake, ʻE Sihova, ʻi ho houhau,
ke ke hiki hake koe, ko e meʻa ʻi he lili ʻo hoku ngaahi fili:
pea ke ʻāhake koeʻuhi ko au ki he fakamaau ʻaia naʻa ke fekau.

Pehēʻe kāpui koe ʻe he fakataha ʻoe kakai:
ko ia ko e meʻa ʻiate kinautoluke ke hāʻele hake ki ʻolunga.

‌ʻE fakamaau ʻe Sihova ʻae kakai:
ke ke fakamaau au, ʻE Sihova, ʻo fakatatau ki heʻeku māʻoniʻoni,
pea hangēko ʻeku angatonu ʻoku ʻiate au.

Tuku ke ngata ʻae kovi ʻoe angakovi,
