te u ʻāhengihengi hake pe au.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, te u fakamālōkiate koe ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai:
te u hiva kiate koe ʻi he ngaahi puleʻanga.

He ʻoku lahi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻo aʻu ki he ngaahi langi,
mo hoʻo moʻoni ki he ngaahi ʻao.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ke māʻolunga lahi hake koe ʻi he ngaahi langi:
tuku ke māʻolunga hake ho nāunau ʻi māmani kotoa pē.
58:
‌ʻAE fakataha, ʻoku moʻoni ʻa hoʻomou lea māʻoniʻoni ʻakimoutolu?
ʻAe ngaahi foha ʻoe tangata, ʻoku mou fakamaau totonu koā?

‌ʻIo, ʻoku mou fai kovi ʻi loto;
ʻoku mou fakamamafa ʻae kovi ʻo homou nima ʻi māmani.

Talu ʻae māvae ʻae angakovi mo e manāva mo ʻenau hē:
ʻoku nau ʻalu hēleva talu ʻenau fanauʻi, ʻi he lea loi.

Ko honau kona ʻoku hangēko e kona ʻoe ngata:
ʻoku nau tatau mo e ngata tuli ʻoku ne tāpuni hono telinga;

‌ʻAia ʻe ʻikai tokanga ki he leʻo ʻoe kau fakafiemālie,
neongo ʻae poto lahi ʻoe tangata faiva.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke sili honau kau nifo ʻi honau ngutu:
ʻE Sihova, pakiʻi ʻo toʻo kituʻa ʻae kau nifo lahi ʻoe fanga laione mui.

Tuku ke vela ʻo vai ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e vai ʻoku tafe maʻuaipē:
ʻoka teteke ʻe ia ʻene kau fana ke fana ʻaki ʻene ngaahi ngahau, tuku ke tuʻutuʻu ʻakinautolu.

Ke mole ʻo ʻosi ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e sineli:
tuku ke nau hangēko e tama taʻehoko ʻae fefine, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa nau mamata ki he laʻā.

‌ʻI he teʻeki vela ki hoʻomou kulo ʻae okooko ʻakau talatala,
ʻe ʻosi ʻene ʻave moʻui ʻakinautoluʻi hono houhau, ʻo hangēko e ʻahiohio.

‌ʻE fiefia ʻae māʻoniʻoni ʻi heʻene mamata ki he totongi:
ʻe fufuluʻe ia hono vaʻe ʻi he toto ʻoe angakovi.

Ko ia ʻe pehēai ʻe he tangata, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ai ʻae totongi ki he māʻoniʻoni:
ko e moʻoni ko e ʻOtua ia ʻoku fakamaau ʻi māmani.”
59:
‌ʻE HOKU ʻOtua, ke ke fakahaofi au mei hoku ngaahi fili:
maluʻi au meiate kinautoluʻoku tuʻu hake kiate au.
Ke ke fakahaofi au mei he kau fai kovi mo ke fakamoʻui au mei he kau tangata pani toto.

Vakai, ʻoku nau tatali ʻo lama ki hoku laumālie:
ʻE Sihova, kuo kātoa fakataha ʻae kau mālohi kiate au:
ka ʻoku ʻikai ʻi heʻeku talangataʻa, pe ko ʻeku angahala.

‌ʻOku nau feleleʻi ʻo teuʻi ʻakinautolu, ka ʻoku ʻikai haʻaku kovi:
ke ke ʻāke tokoni au, pea ke ʻafioʻi.

Pea ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ko e ʻOtua, ʻoe ngaahi tokolahi, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli,
ke ke ʻāhake ʻo ʻahiʻahi ki he hiteni kotoa pē:
ʻoua naʻa ke ʻaloʻofa ki he kau angakovi kākā.Sila.

‌ʻOku nau liu mai ʻi he efiafi: ʻoku nau longoaʻa ʻo hangēko e kulī,
pea ʻalu fakatakamilo ʻi he kolo.

Vakai, ʻoku nau hake ʻi honau ngutu:
ʻoku ʻi honau loungutu ʻae ngaahi heletā:
he ʻoku nau pehē, “ko hai ʻoku ne fanongo?”

Ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, te ke kata kiate kinautolu;
te ke manuki ki he hiteni kotoa pē.

Pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene mālohi ko ia te u tatali ai kiate koe:
he ko hoku hūfanga ʻae ʻOtua.

Ko e ʻOtua ʻoku ʻaloʻofa kiate au te ne tokoni au:
ʻe tuku kiate au ʻe he ʻOtua ke u mamata ki heʻeku holi ki hoku ngaahi fili.

Ko e meʻa ʻi he angahala ʻa honau ngutu, mo e ngaahi lea ʻa honau loungutu,
tuku ke moʻua ai ʻakinautoluʻi heʻenau laukau:
koeʻuhi ko e kape mo e loi ʻoku nau lea ʻaki.

Fakaʻauha ʻakinautoluʻi he houhau,
fakaʻauha ʻakinautoluke ʻoua naʻa kei ai ʻakinautolu:
pea tuku ke ʻilo ʻekinautoluʻoku pule, ʻae ʻOtua, ʻia Sēkope,
ʻo aʻu ki he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani.Sila.

Pea tuku kenau liu mai ʻi he efiafi;
tuku kenau longoaʻa ʻo hangēko e kulī, ʻo ʻalu fakatakamilo ʻi he kolo.

Tuku kenau ʻalu ʻo hēfano ai pēʻo kumi kai,
pea lāunga ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai tenau mākona.

Ka te u hiva au ki ho mālohi;
ʻio, te u hiva mālohi ʻi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻi he pongipongi:
he ko hoku ungaʻanga koe,
mo e hūfanga kiate au ʻi he ʻaho ʻo ʻeku mamahi.

‌ʻE hoku mālohi, te u hiva kiate koe:
he ko hoku kalofanga ʻae ʻOtua, ko e ʻOtua ʻoku ʻaloʻofa kiate au.
60:
Kuo ke fakahāʻae ngaahi meʻa faingataʻa ki hoʻo kakai;
kuo ke fakainu ʻaki ʻakimautoluʻaeuainefakaofo.

Kuo ke foaki ʻae fuka kiate kinautolunaʻe manavahēkiate koe,
ke fakahāia koeʻuhi ko e moʻoni.Sila.

Ko hai te ne ʻomi au ki he kolo mālohi?
Ko hai te ne aʻutakiau ki ʻItomi?

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻe ʻikai te ke fai ia, ʻa koe kuo ke liʻaki ʻakimautolu?
ʻA koe, ʻE ʻOtua, naʻe ʻikai te ke ʻalu mo ʻemau ngaahi kautau?

Ke ke tuku kiate kimautoluʻae tokoni mei he mamahi:
he ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae tokoni ʻae tangata.

Ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻOtua te tau fai mālohi ai:
he ko ia ia te ne malaki hifo hotau ngaahi fili.
61:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, ke ke fanongo ki heʻeku tangi;
tokanga ki heʻeku lotu.

Te u tangi kiate koe mei he ngataʻanga ʻo māmani, ʻoka taʻomia hoku loto:
ke ke tataki au ki he maka ʻoku māʻolunga hake ʻiate au.

He naʻa ke hoko ko hokuungakiʻi,
ko e fale māʻolunga pea mālohi ki he fili.

Te u nofomaʻu ʻi ho fale fehikitaki ʻo taʻengata:
te u falala ki he malu ʻo ho kapakau.Sila.

He kuo ke fanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi fuakava, ʻE ʻOtua:
kuo ke foaki kiate au ʻae tofiʻa ʻokinautoluʻoku manavahēki ho huafa.

Te ke fakatolonga ʻae moʻui ʻae tuʻi,
mo hono ngaahi taʻu ʻo hangēmei he toʻutangata ki he toʻutangata.

‌ʻE nofomaʻu ia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua taʻengata:
ke ke teuteu ʻae ʻaloʻofa mo e moʻoni ʻaia te na fakamoʻui ia.
Ko ia te u hiva fakamālōai ki ho huafa ʻo taʻengata,
koeʻuhi ke u fai ki heʻeku ngaahi fuakava ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.

Ko ia te u hiva fakamālōai ki ho huafa ʻo taʻengata,
koeʻuhi ke u fai ki heʻeku ngaahi fuakava ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
62:
KO E moʻoni ʻoku tatali hoku laumālie ki he ʻOtua:
ʻoku meiate ia hoku fakamoʻui.

Ko ia pēko hoku makatuʻu mo hoku fakamoʻui; ko hoku hūfanga ia;
ʻe ʻikai faʻa ueʻi lahi au.

‌ʻE fēfēhono fuoloamo hoʻomou kei filioʻi kovi ki he tangata?
ʻe tāmateʻi ʻakimoutolukotoa pē:
te mou hangēko e ʻākuo malele, mo e ʻāʻoku tuʻu tetetete.

‌ʻOku nau fakakaukau ke tulakihifo ia mei heʻene lelei:
ʻoku nau fiemālie pe ʻi he loi:
ʻoku nau tāpuaki ʻaki honau ngutu, ka ʻoku nau kape ʻi loto.Sila.

‌ʻE hoku laumālie, ke ke tatali pe ki he ʻOtua;
he ʻoku meiate ia ʻeku ʻamanaki lelei.

Ko ia pe ko hoku makatuʻu mo hoku fakamoʻui: ko hoku hūfanga ia;
ʻe ʻikai faʻa ueʻi au.

‌ʻOku ʻi he ʻOtua ʻa hoku fakamoʻui mo ʻeku fiefia:
ko e makatuʻu ʻo hoku mālohi, mo hoku hūfanga ʻoku ʻi he ʻOtua.

Falala maʻuaipēkiate ia; ʻakimoutoluʻae kakai,
lilingi homou loto ʻi hono ʻao:
ko e hūfanga ʻae ʻOtua kiate kitautolu.Sila.

Ko e moʻoni ko e meʻa vaʻinga pe ʻae kau tangata māʻulalo,
pea ko e meʻa loi ʻae kau tangata māʻolunga:
kapau ʻe ʻai ki he meʻa fakamamafa,
ʻoku nau maʻamaʻa lahi hake kotoa pēʻi he meʻa vaʻinga.

‌ʻOua naʻa falala ki he fakamālohi pea ʻoua naʻa viki ʻi he kaihaʻa:
kapau ʻoku tupu ʻae koloa,
ʻoua naʻa tuku homou loto ki ai.

Pea ʻoku ʻiate koe foki, ʻE ʻEiki, ʻae ʻaloʻofa:
he ʻoku ke ʻange ki he tangata taki taha kotoa pēʻo fakatatau ki heʻene ngāue.
63:
Ke mamata ki hoʻo māfimafi mo ho nāunau,
ʻo hangēko ʻeku mamata ai kiate koe ʻi he faletapu.

‌ʻOku lelei lahi hake ʻa hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻi he moʻui,
ko ia ʻe fakafetaʻi ai ʻa hoku loungutu kiate koe.

Ko ia ʻe pehēpe ʻeku fakafetaʻi kiate koe lolotonga ʻeku moʻui:
te u hiki hake hoku nima ʻi ho huafa.

‌ʻE mākona lelei hoku laumālie ʻo hangēko e meʻa ʻi he ngako mo e meʻa momona;
pea ʻe fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻa hoku ngutu ʻi he loungutu fiefia.

‌ʻI heʻeku manatu kiate koe ʻi hoku mohenga,
ʻo fakalaulaulotokiate koe ʻi he ngaahi lakanga leʻo ʻi he poʻuli.

Ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻo faʻa tokoni au,
ko ia te u fiefia ai ʻi he malu ʻo ho kapakau.

‌ʻOku pikitai maʻu pēhoku laumālie kiate koe:
ʻoku poupou au ʻe ho nima toʻomataʻu.

Ka ko kinautoluʻoku kumi hoku laumālie ke fakaʻauha ia,
tenau ʻalu hifo ki he ngaahi potu ʻi lalo ʻi he fonua.

Tenau tōʻi he heletā:
tenau hoko ko e ʻinasi ʻoe fanga fokisi.
64:
FANONGO ki hoku leʻo, ʻE ʻOtua, ʻi heʻeku lotu:
fakahaofi ʻeku moʻui mei he manavahēki he fili.

Fakafufūau mei he filioʻi ʻae kau angahala;
mei he angatuʻu fakamaveuveu ʻoe kau fai kovi:

‌ʻOku nau fakamata honau ʻelelo ʻo hangēko e heletā,
ʻonau teke ʻenau kaufanake fanaʻi ʻenau ngaahi ngahau, ʻio, ko e ngaahi lea kona.

Koeʻuhi ke nau fana ʻi he lilo ki he haohaoa:
ʻoku nau fana fakafokifāpe kiate ia, ʻo taʻemanavahē.

‌ʻOku nau kumi ke ʻilo ʻae ngaahi kovi ʻoku nau faʻa ʻeke ke lahi:
ʻoku taumamaʻo ʻae mahalo mo e loto ʻokinautolukotoa pē.

Ka ʻe fana ʻe he ʻOtua kiate kinautoluʻaki ʻae ngahau;
te nau lavea fakafokifāpe.

Ko ia tenau ngaohi honau ʻelelo ke tōkiate kinautolu:
ʻe hola ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku mamata kiate kinautolu.
65:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, ʻoku tatali ʻae fakamālōkiate koe ʻi Saione:
pea ʻe fai kiate koe ʻae fuakava.

‌ʻA koe ʻoku ke ongoʻi ʻae lotu,
ʻe aʻu atu kiate koe ʻae kakai kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku mālohi kiate au ʻae ngaahi hia:
pea ko ʻemau ngaahi talangataʻa te ke fakamaʻa ia ke ʻosi.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ia ʻaia ʻoku ke fili,
mo ke fakaofi ia kiate koe,
koeʻuhi ke ne nofo ʻi ho lotoʻā:
temau fiemālie ʻi he lelei ʻo ho fale,
ʻio, ʻo ho faletapu māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻE ʻOtua ko homau fakamoʻui,
te ke talia ʻakimautoluʻi he ngaahi meʻa fakamanavahēʻi he māʻoniʻoni;
ʻa koe ko e ʻamanaki leleiʻanga ʻoe ngaahi ngataʻanga kotoa pēʻo māmani,
pea mo kinautoluʻoku mamaʻo atu ʻi he tahi:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fokotuʻumaʻu ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻi hono mālohi;
kuo nonoʻo ʻaki ʻae māfimafi:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne lolomi ʻae longoaʻa ʻoe ngaahi tahi,
ko e longoaʻa ʻoe ngaahi peau,
mo e maveuveu ʻoe kakai.

Pea ʻoku manavahēʻi ho ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻakinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi he ngaahi potu mamaʻo:
ʻoku ke fakafiefiaʻi ʻae ngaahi ʻaluʻanga ʻoe pongipongi mo e efiafi.

‌ʻOku ke ʻaʻahi ki he fonua,
ʻo fakaviviku ia:
ʻoku ke fakakoloa lahi ʻaki ia ʻae vaitafe ʻoe ʻOtua,
ʻaia ʻoku pito ʻi he vai:
ʻoku ke teuʻi ʻenau meʻakai, hili hoʻo tokonaki pehēki ai.

‌ʻOku ke fakaviviku lahi hono tafungofunga ʻo ia:
ʻoku ke pule ke tōʻae ʻuha ki hono ngaahi keli:
ʻoku ke fakamolūʻaki ia ʻae ʻuha tuʻu mo tō:
ʻoku ke tāpuaki hono tupu ʻo ia.

‌ʻOku ke tatāʻaki ʻae taʻu ʻa hoʻo angalelei;
pea ʻoku ngangana mei ho ngaahi hala ʻae momona.

‌ʻOku ngangana ia ki he ngaahi potu mohuku ʻoe toafa:
pea fiefia ʻae ngaahi tafungofunga ʻi he potu kotoa pē.
66: MOU kalanga fiefia ki he ʻOtua, ʻae fonua kotoa pē:

Hiva ʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei ʻo hono huafa:
fakaongoongolelei ʻae fakamālōkiate ia.

Mou pehēki he ʻOtua, “ʻOku ke fakamanavahēkoe ʻi hoʻo ngaahi ngāue!
Ko e meʻa ʻi hono lahi ʻo hoʻo māfimafi ʻe fakamoʻulaloa ai ʻekinautoluʻe ho ngaahi fili kiate koe.

Haʻu ʻo mamata ki he ngaahi ngāue ʻae ʻOtua:
ʻoku fakamanavahēia ʻi heʻene ngāue ki he ngaahi fānau ʻae tangata.

Naʻa ne liliu ʻae tahi ko e fonua mōmoa:
naʻa nau ʻalu ʻi he fuʻu vaitafe ʻi honau vaʻe:
naʻa tau fiefia ʻiate ia ʻi ai.

‌ʻAkimoutoluʻae kakai, mou fakafetaʻi ki hotau ʻOtua,
pea fai ke ongo ʻae leʻo ʻoe fakamālōkiate ia:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne poupou hotau laumālie ʻi he moʻui,
pea ʻikai tuku hotau vaʻe ke ngaue.

He kuo ke ʻiloʻi ʻakimautolu, ʻE ʻOtua:
kuo ke ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻakimautolu, ʻo hangēko e ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻoe siliva.

Naʻa ke ʻomi ʻakimautoluki he kupenga;
naʻa ke ʻai ʻae mahaki ki homau kongaloto.

Te u hūki ho fale mo e ngaahi feilaulau tutu:
te u ʻatu kiate koe ʻo hangēko ʻeku ngaahi fuakava,

‌ʻAia kuo ongo atu mei hoku loungutu,
pea lea ʻaki ʻe hoku ngutu, ʻi heʻeku ʻi he mamahi.

Haʻu ʻo fanongo, ʻakimoutolukotoa pēʻoku manavahēki he ʻOtua,
pea te u fakahāʻaia kuo ne fai ki hoku laumālie.

Naʻaku tangi kiate ia ʻaki hoku ngutu,
pea naʻe fakamālōʻa hoku ʻelelo kiate ia.

Kapau te u tokanga ki he kovi ʻi hoku loto,
ʻe ʻikai fanongo ʻae ʻEiki kiate au:

Ka ko e moʻoni kuo ongoʻi au ʻe he ʻOtua;
naʻe tokanga ia ki he leʻo ʻo ʻeku lotu.

Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te ne liʻaki ʻeku lotu,
pe ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa ʻiate au.
67:
Koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ai ho hala ʻi māmani,
mo hoʻo fakamoʻui ʻi he ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē.

Tuku ke fakamālōʻae kakai kiate koe, ʻE ʻOtua;
ke fakamālōkiate koe ʻae kakai kotoa pē.

Tuku ke fiefia ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga, pea hiva ʻi he nekeneka:
he te ke fakamaau māʻoniʻoni ʻae kakai,
pea tataki ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga ʻi māmani.Sila.

Tuku ke fakamālōʻae kakai kiate koe, ʻE ʻOtua;
ke fakamālōkiate koe ʻae kakai kotoa pē.

Pea ʻe toki tuku mai ʻe he fonua hono tupu;
pea ko e ʻOtua, ʻio, ko hotau ʻOtua, te ne tāpuaki ʻakitautolu.

‌ʻE tāpuaki ʻakitautoluʻe he ʻOtua;
pea ʻe manavahēkiate ia ʻae ngataʻanga kotoa pēʻo māmani.
68:
KE tuʻu hake ʻae ʻOtua, tuku ke veteki hono ngaahi fili:
tuku ke puna foki mei hono ʻao ʻakinautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate ia.

Hangēko e vilingia ʻo mole ʻae kohu,
ke pehēpe hono vilingia ʻakinautolu:
hangēko e pulu ʻoku vela ʻo vai ʻi he afi,
ke ʻauha pehēpe ʻae kau angahala ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua.

Hiva ki he ʻOtua, hiva fakamālōki hono huafa:
fakaongoongolelei ia ʻoku hāʻele ʻi he ngaahi toafa
ʻi hono huafa ko SIHOVA,
pea fiefia ʻi hono ʻao.

Ko e tamai ʻae ʻOtua ki he tamai mate,
mo e fakamaau ia ʻi hono ʻafioʻanga māʻoniʻoni,
ki he kau fefine kuo mate honau ʻunoho.

‌ʻOku ʻai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae kau paea ʻi he ngaahi fale:
ʻoku ne ʻomi kituʻa ʻakinautolukuo haʻi ʻaki ʻaeukamea fihifihi:
ka ʻoku nofo ʻae kau angatuʻu ʻi he fonua mōmoa.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻi hoʻo muʻomuʻa atu ki ho kakai,
ʻi hoʻo hāʻele ʻi he toafa;Sila.

Naʻe ngalulu ʻa māmani, pea ngangana mo e ngaahi langi foki ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua:
ʻio, naʻe ngaueue ʻa Sainai ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, naʻa ke tuku hifo ʻae ʻuha lahi,
ʻaia naʻa ke fakamālohi ʻaki ho tofiʻa, ʻi heʻene vaivai.

Naʻe nofo ki ai ʻa ho kakai:
ʻE ʻOtua, kuo ke tokonaki ʻi hoʻo angalelei ki he masiva.
Naʻe foaki mai ʻe he ʻEiki ʻae folofola pea naʻe tokolahi ʻakinautolunaʻe fakahāia.

“Naʻe hola vave ʻae ngaahi tuʻi ʻoe kautau:”
pea naʻe tufa ʻae vete ʻe he fefine naʻe nofo ʻo leʻo.

Neongo hoʻomou nofo ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi kulo,
ka temou hangēko e kapakau ʻoe lupe ʻoku ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻae siliva, mo hono fulufuluko e koula melomelo.

‌ʻI he veteki ʻi ai ʻe he Māfimafi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi,
naʻe hinehina ia ʻo hangēko e ʻuha hinehina ʻi Salimoni.

Ko e moʻunga ʻoe ʻOtua ʻoku hangēko e moʻunga ko Pesani;
ko e moʻunga māʻolunga ʻo hangēko e moʻunga ko Pesani,

Ko e ngaahi saliote ʻae ʻOtua ʻoku ua mano,
ʻio, ko e ngaahi toko afe ʻoe ʻāngelo:
ʻoku ʻiate kinautoluʻae ʻEiki,
ʻio, ʻo hangēko ʻene ʻi Sainai,
ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni.

Kuo ke hāʻele hake ki ʻolunga,
kuo u angatuʻu foki,
koeʻuhi ke nofo kiate kinautoluʻa Sihova ko e ʻOtua.

Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki,
ʻaia ʻoku ne hili kiate kitautoluʻae kavenga ʻoe meʻa lelei ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē,
ʻio, ko e ʻOtua ʻo hotau fakamoʻui.Sila.

Ko ia, ko hotau ʻOtua ko e ʻOtua ia ʻoe fakamoʻui;
pea ʻoku ʻia Sihova ko e ʻEiki ʻae moʻui mei he mate.

Ka ʻe taaʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae ʻulu ʻo hono ngaahi fili,
mo e tumuʻaki fulufuluʻo ia ʻoku ʻalu pēʻi heʻene ngaahi talangataʻa.

Naʻe pehēʻe he ʻEiki, “Te u toe ʻomi mei Pesani,
te u toe ʻomi hoku kakai mei he loloto ʻo e ngaahi tahi.

Koeʻuhi ke kulokula ho vaʻe ʻi he toto ʻo ho ngaahi fili,
pea mo e ʻelelo ʻo hoʻo fanga kulīʻi ai.”

Kuo nau mamata ki ho ngaahi hāʻeleʻanga, ʻE ʻOtua;
ʻio, ko e ngaahi hāʻeleʻanga ʻo hoku ʻOtua, mo hoku Tuʻi, ʻi he faletapu.

‌ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻae kau hiva, pea hoko mo e kau pulotutāmālie ʻoe ngaahi meʻa faiva;
pea ʻoku ʻiate kinautoluʻae kau taʻahine ʻoku tāʻae lali iiki.

“Mou fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻi he ngaahi fakataha,
ʻio, ki he ʻEiki, ʻakimoutolumei he matavai ʻo ʻIsileli.”

‌ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa Penisimani siʻi mo honau pule,
ʻae houʻeiki ʻo Siuta mo ʻenau fakataha,
mo e houʻeiki ʻo Sepuloni, pea mo e houʻeiki ʻo Nafitali.

Ko ho ʻOtua kuo ne tuʻutuʻuni ho mālohi:
ke ke fakamālohi, ʻE ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻa ke fai kiate kimautolu.

Ko e meʻa ʻi ho faletapu ʻi Selūsalema,
ʻe ʻomi ai ʻe he ngaahi tuʻi ʻae ngaahi meʻaʻofa kiate koe.

Ke ke tautea ʻae fanga manu ʻoe vao kaho,
ʻae fuʻu tokolahi ʻoe fanga pulu tangata, mo e ngaahi ʻuhikiʻi pulu ʻoe kakai,
ke ʻoua kenau fakavaivai ʻakinautoluʻaki ʻae ngaahi konga siliva:
ke ke veteki ʻae kakai ʻoku manako ki he tau.

‌ʻE haʻu ʻae ngaahi houʻeiki mei ʻIsipite;
ʻe mafao vave atu ʻae nima ʻo ʻItiopea ki he ʻOtua.

Kiate ia ʻoku heka ki he langi ʻoe ngaahi langi, ʻaia naʻe ʻi muʻa pe;
vakai, ʻoku ne fakaongo atu hono leʻo, pea ko e leʻo māfimafi ia.

Mou tuku ki he ʻOtua ʻae mālohi:
ʻoku ʻi ʻolunga ʻi ʻIsileli ʻa hono nāunau,
mo ʻene māfimafi ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi langi.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku fakamanavahēko e ʻituʻa ʻi ho ngaahi faletapu:
ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli ko ia ʻoku ne foaki ʻae mālohi mo e faʻa fai ki hono kakai.
Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua.
69:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, ke ke fakamoʻui au;
he kuo hūki loto ʻae ngaahi vai ki hoku laumālie.

‌ʻOku ou ngalo hifo ʻi he pela loloto, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ha potu ke tuʻu ai:
kuo u hoko ki he vai loloto, pea ʻoku lōmakiʻi au ʻe he vai lahi.

Kuo u vaivai ʻi heʻeku tangi:
kuo mōmoa hoku kia:
ʻoku fakaʻaʻau ʻo ʻosi hoku mata ʻi heʻeku tatali ki hoku ʻOtua.

Ko kinautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate au taʻehanoʻuhinga ʻoku nau tokolahi hake ʻi he tuʻoni louʻulu ʻo hoku ʻulu:
ko kinautoluʻoku loto ke fakaʻauha au,
ʻaia ko hoku ngaahi fili taʻetotonu, ʻoku nau mālohi;
pea ne u toki ʻange ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te u ʻave.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku vale;
pea ʻoku ʻikai lilo ʻiate koe ʻeku ngaahi angahala.

‌ʻE ʻEiki Sihova ʻoe ngaahi kautau, ʻoua naʻa tuku ke māʻakinautoluʻoku tatali kiate koe koeʻuhi ko au:
ʻE ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻoua naʻa puputuʻu ʻakinautoluʻoku kumi kiate koe koeʻuhi ko au.

He ko e meʻa ʻiate koe kuo u kātaki ai ʻae lauʻikovi;
kuo ʻufiʻufi ʻaki hoku mata ʻae mā.

Kuo u hoko ko e muli ki hoku ngaahi kāinga,
mo e ʻāuhe ki he fānau ʻa ʻeku faʻē.

He kuo u ʻosiʻosiloto ʻi he fai feinga ki ho fale;
pea ko e ngaahi manuki ʻanautolunaʻe manukiʻi koe kuo tōkiate au.

‌ʻI heʻeku tangi, ʻo tautea hoku laumālie ʻaki ʻae ʻaukai,
naʻe manukiʻi ai au.

Naʻaku kofuʻaki ʻae tauangaʻa;
pea ne u hoko ko honau lumaʻanga.

‌ʻOku lauʻikoviʻi au ʻekinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi he matapā;
pea ʻoku hiva ʻaki au ʻe he kau konāʻi he kava.

Ka ko au, ʻE Sihova, ʻe aʻu atu kiate koe ʻeku lotu ʻi he ʻaho tuʻumālie:
ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke fanongo kiate au ʻi hono lahi fau ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻi hono moʻoni ʻo hoʻo fakamoʻui.

Fakamoʻui au mei he pela, pea ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u ngalo hifo:
tuku ke fakamoʻui au meiate kinautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate au, pea mei he ngaahi vai loloto.

‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ke lōmakiʻi au ʻe he vai lahi,
pea ʻoua naʻa folo hifo au ʻe he loloto,
pea ʻoua naʻa tāpuni ʻe he luo hono ngutu kiate au.

Fanongo kiate au, ʻE Sihova, he ʻoku lelei hoʻo manavaʻofa:
ke ke tafoki mai kiate au ʻo fakatatau ki hono lahi ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ongongofua.

Ke ke ʻunuʻunu mai ke ofi ki hoku laumālie, pea huhuʻi ia:
fakamoʻui au koeʻuhi ko hoku ngaahi fili.

Kuo ke ʻiloʻi hoku lauʻikovi, mo ʻeku mā, mo hoku manukia:
ʻoku ʻi ho ʻao ʻa hoku ngaahi fili kotoa pē.

Naʻa nau foaki foki kiate au ʻae ʻahu ko ʻeku meʻakai;
pea ʻi heʻeku fieinu naʻa nau tuku mai ʻae vaimahi ke u inu.

Ke hoko honau keinangaʻanga ko e hele ʻi honau ʻao:
mo ia naʻe totonu kenau lelei ai, ke hoko ia ko e tauhele.

Ke fakapoʻuli honau mata, ke ʻoua naʻa nau mamata;
pea ke tetetete maʻuaipēhonau kongaloto.

Te ke lilingi ho houhau kiate kinautolu,
pea puke ʻakinautoluʻe ho houhau vela.

Tuku ke lala honau nofoʻanga;
ke ʻoua naʻa nofo ha tokotaha ʻi honau fale fehikitaki.

He ʻoku nau fakatangaʻi ia ʻaia kuo ke taaʻi;
pea ʻoku nau talanoa fakamamahi kiate kinautolukuo ke tautea.

Fakalahi ʻaki ʻae nunuʻa ʻoe hia ki heʻenau hia:
pea ke ʻoua naʻa nau hoko ki hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.

Tuku ke tāmateʻi mei he tohi ʻoe moʻui,
pea ʻoua naʻa tohi fakataha ʻakinautolumo e kau māʻoniʻoni.

Ka ko au ʻoku ou masiva mo mamahi:
ʻE ʻOtua, tuku ke hiki ki ʻolunga au ʻe hoʻo fakamoʻui.

Teu fakamālōki he huafa ʻoe ʻOtua ʻaki ʻae hiva,
pea te u hiki hake ia ʻaki ʻae fakafetaʻi.

Pea ʻe fiemālie lahi hake ai ʻa Sihova ʻi he meʻa ni,
ʻi he pulu tangata pe ko e pulu ʻoku ai hono nifo mo e ngeʻesi vaʻe.

‌ʻE mamata ki he meʻa ni ʻae angavaivai, pea fiefia ai:
pea ʻe moʻui homou loto ʻaia ʻoku kumi ki he ʻOtua.

He ʻoku ongoʻi ʻe Sihova ʻae masiva,
pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne manukiʻi ʻene kau pōpula.

Tuku ke fakamālōkiate ia ʻae langi mo māmani,
ʻae ngaahi tahi, mo e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ngaue ʻi ai.

Koeʻuhi ʻe fakamoʻui ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa Saione,
pea langa ʻae ngaahi kolo ʻo Siuta:
koeʻuhi ke nau nofo ʻi ai, ʻo maʻu ia ko honau tofiʻa.

‌ʻE maʻu foki ia ʻe he hako ʻo ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki:
pea ʻe nofo ki ai ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻofa ki hono huafa.
70:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, ke ke fakamoʻui au;
ʻE Sihova, ke ke fai vave ke tokoni au.

Tuku ke māmo puputuʻu ʻakinautoluʻoku kumi hoku laumālie:
tuku ke fakafoki kimui, mo fakamaveuveu, ʻakinautoluʻoku holi ke u kovi.

Tuku ke foki kimui ʻakinautolu, ko e totongi ʻo ʻenau kovi,
ʻakinautoluʻoku pehē, Ha ha.

Tuku ke fiefia mo nekeneka ʻiate koe ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku kumi kiate koe:
tuku ke lea pehēmaʻuaipēʻakinautoluʻoku ʻofa ki hoʻo fakamoʻui,
“Ke ongoongolelei ʻae ʻOtua.”

Ka ko au ʻoku ou masiva mo paea:
ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke haʻu vave kiate au:
ko koe ko hoku tokoni mo hoku fakamoʻui;
ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa ke tatali.
71: ‌ʻE SIHOVA, ʻoku ou falala kiate koe ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u māʻo taʻengata.

Fakamoʻui au ʻi hoʻo māʻoniʻoni, pea tuku ke u hao:
fakatokangaʻi ho fofonga kiate au, ʻo fakamoʻui au.

‌ʻE hoku ʻOtua, ke ke fakamoʻui au mei he nima ʻoe kau angahala,
mei he nima ʻoe kau tangata taʻemāʻoniʻoni mo angamālohi.

He ko koe, ʻE ʻEiki Sihova, ko ʻeku ʻamanaki lelei:
ko koe ko hoku falalaʻanga talu ʻeku kei siʻi.

Kuo ke poupou au talu ʻekumāvaemei he manāva: ko koe ia naʻe toʻo au mei he fatu ʻo ʻeku faʻē:
te u fakafetaʻi maʻuaipēkiate koe.

‌ʻOku ou hangēko e meʻa fakaofo ki he tokolahi:
ka ko koe ko hoku hūfanga mālohi.
Tuku ke pito hoku ngutu ʻaki hoʻo fakamālōmo hoʻo fakaʻapaʻapa ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.

Pea ʻoua naʻa siʻaki au ʻi he ʻaho ʻo ʻeku motuʻa;
ʻoua naʻa liʻaki au ʻoka mole ʻiate au ʻeku mālohi.

He ʻoku lea kovi kiate au ʻa hoku ngaahi fili;
pea ko kinautoluʻoku lamasi hoku laumālie ʻoku nau fakakaukau fakataha,

‌ʻO nau pehē, “Kuo liʻaki ia ʻe he ʻOtua:
fakatanga ʻo puke ia; he ʻoku ʻikai ha tokotaha ke fakamoʻui ia.”

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoua naʻa ke mamaʻo ʻiate au:
ʻE hoku ʻOtua, ke ke fai vave ke tokoni au.

Tuku ke puputuʻu mo ʻauha ʻakinautoluʻoku nofo ko e fili ki hoku laumālie;
ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻae māmo e manuki ʻakinautoluʻoku kumi ke u kovi.

Ka te u ʻamanaki lelei maʻuaipē,
pea ʻe tupulekina pe ʻeku fakamālōkiate koe.

‌ʻE fakahāatu ʻe hoku ngutu ʻa hoʻo māʻoniʻoni mo hoʻo fakamoʻui ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē;
he ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻilo ki hono lau ʻo ia.

Te u ʻalu ʻi he mālohi ʻae ʻEiki ko Sihova:
te u fakahāhoʻo māʻoniʻoni, ʻio, ʻoʻou pe.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, kuo ke akonakiʻi au talu ʻeku kei siʻi:
pea talu mei muʻa mo ʻeku fakahāatu ʻa hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo.

Ko hoʻo māʻoniʻoni foki, ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku māʻolunga ʻaupito,
ʻa koe naʻa ke fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi:
ʻE ʻOtua, ko hai ʻoku hangēko koe!

‌ʻA koe, kuo ke fakahākiate au ʻae ngaahi mamahi ʻoku lahi mo kovi,
te ke toe fakaake au,
ʻo toe ʻohake au mei he loto kelekele.

Te ke fakatupulekina hoku nāunauʻia,
ʻo fakafiemālieʻi au ʻi he potu kotoa pē.

‌ʻE hoku ʻOtua, te u fakamālōfoki kiate koe, ʻio, ki hoʻo moʻoni ʻaki ʻae saliteli:
te u hiva kiate koe ʻaki ʻae haʻape, ʻa koe koe tokotaha māʻoniʻoni ʻa ʻIsileli.

‌ʻE fiefia lahi hoku loungutu ʻo kau ka hiva kiate koe;
mo hoku laumālie ʻaia kuo ke huhuʻi.

‌ʻE talanoa ʻa hoku ʻelelo foki ki hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē:
he kuo puputuʻu, kuo hoko ʻo mā, ʻakinautoluʻoku kumi ke u kovi.
72:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, tuku ki he tuʻi ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau,
mo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ki he foha ʻoe tuʻi.

Te ne fakamaau hoʻo kakai ʻi he māʻoniʻoni,
mo hoʻo kau masiva ʻaki ʻae fakamaau.

‌ʻE ʻomi ʻe he ngaahi moʻunga ʻae melino ki he kakai,
mo e māʻoniʻoni mei he ngaahi tafungofunga.

‌ʻE fakamaau ʻe ia ʻae kakai mamahi,
te ne fakamoʻui ʻae fānau ʻae masiva,
pea te ne fesifesi ʻae fakamālohi.

Te nau manavahēkiate koe ʻi he lolotonga ʻae kei tuʻu ʻae laʻā,
mo e māhina, ʻi he toʻutangata kotoa pē.

‌ʻE ʻalu hifo ia ʻo hangēko e ʻuha ki he mohuku kuo tutuʻu:
ʻo hangēko e ʻuha tuʻu mo tōʻoku fakaviviku ʻae fonua.

‌ʻE tupu pēʻae kau māʻoniʻoni ʻi hono ngaahi ʻaho;
mo e melino lahi ʻaupitoʻi he kei tolonga ʻae māhina.

‌ʻE pule ʻe ia foki mei he tahi ki he tahi,
pea mei he vaitafe ʻo aʻu ki he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani.

‌ʻE punou ʻi hono ʻao ʻakinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi he toafa;
pea ʻe ʻemo ʻae efu ʻe hono ngaahi fili.

‌ʻE ʻomi ʻae ngaahi meʻaʻofa ʻe he ngaahi tuʻi ʻo Tasisi pea mo e ngaahi motu:
ʻe ʻatu ʻae ngaahi meʻa foaki ʻe he ngaahi tuʻi ʻo Sipa mo Sepa.

‌ʻIo, ʻe punou ʻi hono ʻao ʻae ngaahi tuʻi kotoa pē:
ʻE tauhi ia ʻe he puleʻanga kotoa pē.

He te ne fakamoʻui ʻae masiva ʻi heʻene tangi;
ʻae mamahi foki, mo ia ʻoku ʻikai hano tokoni.

Te ne fakamoʻui ʻae vaivai mo e masiva,
ʻo fakamoʻui ʻae laumālie ʻoe kau masiva.

‌ʻE huhuʻi ʻe ia honau laumālie mei he kākāmo e fakamālohi:
pea ʻe mahuʻinga honau toto ʻi hono ʻao.

Pea ʻe ʻi ai ʻae falukunga ʻoe uite ʻi he fonua ʻi he tumutumuʻoe ngaahi moʻunga,
ʻe ngaueue hono fua ʻo ia ʻo hangēko Lepanoni:
pea ko kinautoluʻi he kolo ʻe tupu pe ʻo hangēko e mohuku ʻoe fonua.

‌ʻE tuʻumaʻu hono huafa ʻo taʻengata,
ʻe tolonga maʻuaipēhono huafa ʻo hangēko e laʻā:
pea ʻe monūʻia ʻae kakai ʻiate ia:
ʻe ui ia ko e monūʻia ʻe he puleʻanga kotoa pē.

Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova ko e ʻOtua, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli,
ʻaia tokotaha pe ʻoku fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo.
Kuo ngata ʻae ngaahi lotu ʻa Tevita ko e foha ʻo Sese.
73:
KO E moʻoni ʻoku angalelei ʻae ʻOtua ki ʻIsileli,
ʻio, kiate kinautoluʻoku loto maʻa.

Ka ko au naʻe meimei mole hoku vaʻe:
naʻaku meimei hekea ʻi heʻeku ngaahi laka.

He naʻaku meheka ʻi he kau vale,
ʻi heʻeku mamata ki he fiemālie ʻae angakovi.

He ʻoku ʻikai hanau mamahi ʻi heʻenau mate:
ka ʻoku maʻu pe honau mālohi.

‌ʻOku ʻikai moʻua ʻi he mamahi ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e kakai kehe;
pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e kakai niʻihi.

Ko ia ʻoku takatakai ai ʻakinautoluʻe he laukau ʻo hangēko eukamea fihifihi;
ʻoku ʻufiʻufi ʻakinautoluʻe he angamālohi ʻo hangēko e kofu.

‌ʻOku hohopo honau mata ʻi heʻenau sino:
ʻoku nau maʻu meʻa ʻo lahi hake ʻi he holi ʻoe loto.

Kuo kovi ʻakinautolu, pea lea kovi ʻi he fakamālohi:
ʻoku nau lea fakafiefielahi.

‌ʻOku nau hangatonu atu honau ngutu ʻo angatuʻu ki he ngaahi langi,
pea ʻoku ʻeveʻeva honau ʻelelo ʻi māmani.
Ko ia ʻoku liu mai ai ki heni hono kakai: pea ʻoku tatau ʻae vai kiate kinautoluke pito ʻae ipu.

Pea ʻoku nau pehē, “ʻOku ʻilo fēfēʻe he ʻOtua?
Pea ʻoku ai ha ʻilo ʻi he Fungani Māʻolunga?”

Vakai, ko eni ʻae kau angakovi ʻoku fiemālie ʻi he māmani;
ʻoku tupu pēʻenau koloa.

Ko e moʻoni ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻeku fakamaʻa hoku loto,
mo ʻeku fanofano hoku nima ʻi he māʻoniʻoni.

He kuo ʻahiʻahiʻi au ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē,
pea kuo tautea au ʻi he pongipongi kotoa pē,

Kapau te u tala, te u lea pehē;
vakai, ko ʻeku fai hala ki he toʻutangata ʻo hoʻo fānau.

Pea ʻi heʻeku ʻahiʻahi ke ʻilo ʻae meʻa ni,
naʻe faingataʻa ia kiate au;

Ka ʻi heʻeku hūki he faletapu ʻoe ʻOtua;
naʻaku toki ʻilo ai honau ikuʻanga.

Ko e moʻoni naʻa ke tuku ʻakinautoluʻi he ngaahi potu hekeheke:
kuo ke laku hifo ʻakinautoluki he ngaahi fakaʻauha.

Kuo ʻomi vave ʻakinautoluki he malaʻia,
ʻo hangēko e kemo pe taha ʻoe mata!
Kuo fakaʻauha ʻaupitoʻakinautoluʻi he ngaahi ilifia.

Hangēko e misi ʻoka ʻāhake ha taha;
ke pehēpe, ʻE ʻEiki, ʻoka ke ka ʻāhake, te ke manukiʻi honau tatau.

Naʻe mamahi pehēpe hoku laumālie,
pea naʻe mahuhuhuhuai hoku loto.

Naʻe pehēʻeku vale, pea naʻe ʻikai te u ʻilo:
naʻaku hangēko e manu ʻi ho ʻao.

Ka ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou ʻiate koe maʻuaipē:
pea kuo ke puke au ʻi hoku nima toʻomataʻu.

Te ke tataki au ʻi hoʻo poto,
pea hili ia te ke maʻu au ki ho nāunau.

He ko hai mo koe ʻoku ou maʻu ʻi he loto langi?
Pea ʻoku ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻi māmani ʻoku ou holi ki ai, ka ko koe pē.

‌ʻOku vaivai hoku kakano mo hoku loto:
ka ko e makatuʻu ʻo hoku loto ʻae ʻOtua,
mo hoku ʻinasi ʻo taʻengata.

Vakai, ʻe ʻauha ʻakinautoluʻoku mamaʻo ʻiate koe:
kuo ke fakaʻauha ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku ʻalu meiate koe ʻo fai kovi.

Ka ʻoku lelei kiate au ʻeku ʻunuʻunu ke ofi ki he ʻOtua:
kuo u falala ki he ʻEiki ko Sihova, koeʻuhi ke u fakahāai hoʻo ngāue kotoa pē.
74:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, ko e hākuo ke liʻaki ai ʻakimautoluʻo taʻengata?
Ko e hāʻoku kohu ai ho houhau ki he fanga sipi ʻo hoʻo ngoue?

Hiki hake ho vaʻe ki hono ngaahi maumau kuo tuʻumaʻu pe;
ʻio, ki he meʻa kotoa pēkuo fai ʻi he angakovi ʻe he fili ʻi he faletapu.

‌ʻOku ʻioho ʻa ho ngaahi fili ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakataha;
ʻoku nau fokotuʻu ʻenau ngaahi fuka ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga.

Naʻe ongoongo ʻae tangata ʻo fakatatau mo ʻene faʻa fai
ke hiki ki ʻolunga ʻae ngaahi toki ki he ngaahi ʻakau lahi.
Ka ko eni, kuo nau maumauʻi ʻaki ʻae ngaahi toki mo e hamala ʻae ngaahi meʻa tongitongi kotoa pē.

Kuo nau līʻae afi ki ho faletapu,
kuo nau ʻuliʻi ʻae ʻafioʻanga ʻo ho huafa ʻo holoki hifo ia ki he kelekele.

Naʻa nau pehēʻi honau loto, “Ketau fakaʻauha fakataha ʻakinautolu:”
kuo nau tutu ʻo ʻosi ʻae ngaahi falelotu ʻoe ʻOtua ʻi he fonua.

‌ʻOku ʻikai temau kei mamata ki heʻemau ngaahi fakaʻilonga:
ʻoku ʻikai ha palōfita ʻe toe:
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻiate kitautoluʻoku ne ʻilo pe ʻe fēfēhono fuoloa.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloaʻoe lauʻikovi ʻae fili?
ʻE kape ki ho huafa ʻe he fili ʻo taʻengata?

Ko e hāʻoku ke toʻo atu ai ho nima, ʻio, ho nima toʻomataʻu?
Toʻo mai ia mei ho fatafata.

He ko e ʻOtua ko hoku Tuʻi talu mei muʻa,
ʻoku ne fai ʻae fakamoʻui ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo māmani.

Naʻa ke vaeua ʻae tahi ʻi ho mālohi:
naʻa ke foaʻi ʻae ʻulu ʻoe ngaahi talākoni ʻi he ngaahi vai,

‌ʻOku ke foaʻi ʻo laiki ʻae ngaahi ʻulu ʻoe levaiatani,
ʻo ke ʻange ia ko e meʻakai ki he kakai ʻoku nofo ʻi he toafa.

Naʻa ke vaeua ʻae matavai mo e vaitafe lahi:
naʻa ke fakamōmoa ʻae ngaahi vaitafe lahi.

‌ʻOku ʻoʻou ʻae ʻaho, pea ʻoku ʻoʻou foki mo e pō:
kuo ke teuteu ʻae maama mo e laʻā.

Kuo ke ʻai ʻae ngaahi ngataʻanga kotoa pēʻoe fonua;
kuo ke ngaohi ʻae faʻahitaʻu mafana mo e faʻahitaʻu momoko.

‌ʻE Sihova, manatu ki he meʻa ni, kuo lauʻikovi ʻe he fili,
pea kuo kape ki ho huafa ʻae kakai vale.

‌ʻOua naʻa tukuangeʻae laumālie ʻo ho ʻofaʻanga ki he fuʻu tokolahi ʻoe kau angakovi:
ʻoua naʻa ngalo ʻiate koe ʻae fakataha ʻo ho kakai masiva ʻo taʻengata.

Ke ke tokanga ki he fuakava:
he ʻoku pito ʻae ngaahi potu fakapoʻuli ʻo māmani ʻi he ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻoe angamālohi.

‌ʻOua naʻa ke tuku ke liu mai kuo māʻae kakai kuo taʻomia:
tuku ke fakamālōki ho huafa ʻae kau masiva mo e vaivai.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke tuʻu hake, ʻo langomakiʻi hoʻo ngāue ʻaʻau:
manatu ki he lauʻikoviʻi koe ʻe he tangata vale ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.

‌ʻOua naʻa ngalo ʻae leʻo ʻo ho ngaahi fili:
ko e maveuveu ʻokinautoluʻoku tuʻu hake kiate koe ʻoku tupulekina ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
75:
‌ʻOKU mau ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kiate koe,
ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku mau ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kiate koe:
he ʻoku fakahāʻe hoʻo ngaahi ngāue lahi ʻoku ofi ho huafa.
“ʻO kau ka maʻu ʻae fakataha te u fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.

Kuo movetevete ʻae fonua mo hono kakai:
ʻoku ou poupou hake hono ngaahi pou.Sila.

Naʻaku pehēki he kau vale, ʻoua naʻa mou fai fakavalevale:
pea ki he kau angakovi, ʻoua te mou hiki hake ʻae nifo.

‌ʻOua naʻa hiki ki ʻolunga homou nifo:
ʻoua te mou lea ʻi he kia kekeva.”

He ʻoku ʻikai haʻu mei he potu hahake, pe mei he potu lulunga,
pe mei he potu tonga ʻae hakeakiʻi.

He ko e fakamaau ʻae ʻOtua:
ʻoku ʻohifo ʻe ia ʻae tokotaha, kae fokotuʻu hake ʻae tokotaha.

He ʻoku ʻi he nima ʻo Sihova ʻae ipu,
pea ʻoku kulokula ʻaeuaine:
kuo pito ia ʻi he meʻa kuo huʻi ki ai;
pea ʻoku lilingi ʻe ia mei ai:
ka ko hono efe ʻo ia, ʻe tatau ia ʻe he angakovi kotoa pēʻo māmani, ʻo inu ia.

Ka ko au te u fakahāʻo taʻengata;
te u hiva ʻaki ʻae fakamālōki he ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope.

Te u tutuʻu ke motu ʻae ngaahi nifo ʻoe kau angahala;
ka ʻe hakeakiʻi ʻae ngaahi nifo ʻoe kau māʻoniʻoni.
76:
‌ʻOKU ʻilo ʻae ʻOtua ʻi Siuta:
ʻOku lahi hono huafa ʻi ʻIsileli.

‌ʻOku ʻi Selemi foki hono fale fehikitaki,
mo hono ʻafioʻanga ʻi Saione.

Naʻe fesifesi ʻe ia ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi ngahau ʻoe kaufana,
ʻae fakaū, mo e heletā, mo e tau.Sila.

‌ʻOku ke nāunauʻia mo lelei lahi hake ʻa koe
ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga ʻoe fakamālohi.

Kuo ikuna ʻae kau loto mālohi,
kuo nau mohe ʻi heʻenau mohe:
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻi he kau tangata mālohi ʻoku ʻilo honau nima.

‌ʻE ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope,
ʻi hoʻo tautea kuo ke līfakatouʻosi pēʻae saliote mo e hoosi ki he mohe ʻoe mate.

Ko koe, ʻio, ko koe, ko e manavahēʻia:
pea ko hai ʻe faʻa tuʻu ʻi ho ʻao ʻoka ke ka houhau?

Naʻa ke fakaongoʻi ʻae fakamaau mei he langi;
naʻe manavahēai ʻa māmani, ʻo tuʻu taʻengaue,

‌ʻI he tuʻu hake ʻae ʻOtua ki he fakamaau,
ke fakamoʻui ʻae kau angavaivai kotoa pēʻo māmani.Sila.

Ko e moʻoni ʻe fakaongolelei koe ʻe he ʻita ʻae tangata:
pea ko hono toe ʻoe ʻita te ke lolomi.

Mou fuakava, ʻo fai ia kia Sihova ko homou ʻOtua:
tuku ke ʻomi ʻae ngaahi meʻaʻofa kiate ia ʻoku totonu ke manavahēki ai, ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku nofo ʻo takatakai ia.

‌ʻE motuhi ʻe ia ʻae loto lahi ʻoe houʻeiki:
ʻoku fakailifia ia ki he ngaahi tuʻi ʻo māmani.
77:
NAʻA KU tangi ki he ʻOtua ʻaki hoku leʻo;
ʻio, ki he ʻOtua ʻaki hoku leʻo pea ne tokanga kiate au.

‌ʻI he ʻaho ʻo ʻeku mamahi naʻaku kumi ki he ʻEiki:
naʻe aʻu pe ʻeku mamahi ʻi he poʻuli, pea ʻikai tuku:
naʻe liʻaki ʻe hoku laumālie ʻae fakafiemālie.

Naʻaku manatu ki he ʻOtua, pea u mamahi ai:
naʻaku fakalaulauloto, pea naʻe lōmekina hoku laumālie.Sila.

‌ʻOku ke pule ke ʻāhoku mata:
ʻoku lahi ʻeku mamahi,
ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ai te u faʻa lea.

Naʻaku fakamanatu ki he ngaahi ʻaho ʻi muʻa,
ki he ngaahi taʻu ʻi he ngaahi kuongaʻi muʻa.

‌ʻOku ou fakamanatu, ki heʻeku hiva ʻi he poʻuli:
ʻoku ou fakakaukau mo hoku loto:
pea naʻe ʻeke lahi ʻa hoku laumālie.

“ʻE liʻaki maʻuaipēʻe Sihova?
Pea ʻe ʻikai te ne toe finangalo ʻofa mai?

Kuo mole ʻaupitoʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa?
Pe kuo taʻehoko ʻene talaʻofa ki he toʻutangata mo e toʻutangata?

Kuo ngalo ʻi he ʻOtua ke fai ʻofa?
Kuo ne tāpuni ʻi he houhau ʻa ʻene ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua? ”Sila.

Pea ne u pehē, ”Ko ʻeku vaivai eni ka te u manatu
ki he ngaahi taʻu ʻoe nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe Fungani Māʻolunga.”

Te u manatu ki he ngaahi ngāue ʻa Sihova:
ko e moʻoni te u manatu ki hoʻo ngaahi mana ʻi muʻa.

Te u fakalaulaulotofoki ki hoʻo ngāue kotoa pē,
ʻo talanoa ki hoʻo ngaahi faianga.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ko ho hala ʻoku ʻi he faletapu:
ko hai ha ʻOtua ʻoku lahi ʻo hangēko hotau ʻOtua!

Ko koe ko e ʻOtua ʻoku fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo:
kuo ke fakahāho mālohi ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe kakai.

Naʻa ke huhuʻi ʻaki ho nima ʻa ho kakai,
ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sēkope mo Siosefa.Sila.

Naʻe mamata kiate koe ʻae ngaahi vai, ʻE ʻOtua,
naʻe mamata kiate koe ʻae ngaahi vai; pea naʻa nau manavahē:
naʻe ngaueue foki ʻae ngaahi loloto.

Naʻe lilingi ʻae vai ʻe he ngaahi ʻao:
naʻe fakaʻuʻulu mei he langi ʻae longoaʻa:
pea naʻe puna foki hoʻo ngaahi ngahau ki he mamaʻo.

Naʻe ʻi he langi ʻae leʻo ʻo hoʻo mana:
naʻe fakamaama ʻaki ʻa māmani ʻae ngaahi ʻuhila:
naʻe tetetete mo ngalulu ʻae fonua.

Ko ho hala ʻoku ʻi he tahi,
mo ho hāʻeleʻanga ʻoku ʻi he vai lahi,
pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻilonga ʻa ho ngaahi ʻaluʻanga.

Naʻa ke tataki atu ho kakai ʻo hangēko e fanga sipi
ʻi he nima ʻo Mōsese mo ʻElone.
78:
FAKAFANONGO ʻa hoku kakai ki heʻeku akonaki:
fakatokangaʻi homou telinga ki he ngaahi lea ʻa hoku ngutu.

Te u mafaʻa hoku ngutu ʻi he fakatātā:
te u fakahāʻae ngaahi lea fufūmei muʻa:

‌ʻAia kuo tau fanongo ki ai pea ʻiloʻi,
pea naʻe tala ia kiate kitautoluʻe heʻetau ngaahi tamai.

‌ʻE ʻikai te tau fufūia mei heʻenau fānau,
ka ʻe fakahāki he toʻutangata ʻe hoko ʻae ongoongolelei ʻo Sihova,
mo hono mālohi, mo e ngaahi ngāue mana naʻa ne fai.

He naʻa ne fokotuʻumaʻu ʻae fono ʻia Sēkope,
ʻo ne tuʻutuʻuni ʻae akonaki ʻi ʻIsileli,
ʻaia naʻa ne fekauʻi ʻetau ngaahi tamai,
koeʻuhi ke nau fakaʻilo ia ki heʻenau fānau:

Koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ia ʻe he toʻutangata ʻe hoko, ʻio, ʻae fānau ʻe fanauʻi;
ʻaia tenau tupu hake ʻo fakahāia ki heʻenau fānau:

Koeʻuhi kenau ʻamanaki lelei maʻuaipēki he ʻOtua,
pea ʻoua naʻa fakangalongaloʻi ʻae ngaahi ngāue ʻae ʻOtua,
ka e tauhi ʻene ngaahi fekau:

Kaeʻoua naʻa tatau mo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
ko e toʻutangata paongataʻa mo angatuʻu;
ko e toʻutangata naʻe ʻikai tenau teuteu honau loto ke lelei,
pea naʻe ʻikai tuʻumaʻu honau laumālie ʻi he ʻOtua.

Ko e fānau ʻa ʻIfalemi naʻe toʻo mahafutau,
mo e ngaahi kaufana,
naʻa nau hola ʻi he ʻaho ʻoe tau.

Naʻe ʻikai tenau fai ki he fuakava ʻae ʻOtua,
pea naʻe ʻikai siʻi tenau loto ke ʻaʻeva ʻi heʻene akonaki;

Pea naʻa nau fakangalongaloʻi ʻene ngaahi ngāue,
mo ʻene ngaahi mana naʻa ne fakahākiate kinautolu.

Naʻa ne fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi he ʻao ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
ʻi he fonua ko ʻIsipite, ʻi he ngoue ʻo Soani.

Naʻe vaeua ʻe ia ʻae tahi, pea ne pule kenau ʻalu atu ai;
pea ne ngaohi ʻae tahi ke tuʻu fakatafungofunga pē.

Naʻa ne tataki foki ʻakinautoluʻi he ʻaho ʻaki ʻae ʻao,
pea ʻi he pōʻaki ʻae maama ʻoe afi.

Naʻe fahiʻi ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi makatuʻu ʻi he toafa,
pea ʻange ʻae inu kiate kinautoluʻo hangēʻoku mei he loloto lahi.

Naʻa ne ʻomi foki kiate kinautoluʻae ngaahi vaitafe mei he makatuʻu,
ʻo ne pule ke tafe hifo ʻae ngaahi vai ʻo hangēko e ngaahi vaitafe lahi.

Pea naʻa nau toe fai angahala kiate ia,
ʻi heʻenau fakahouhau ki he Fungani Māʻolunga ʻi he toafa.

Pea naʻa nau ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻae ʻOtua ʻi honau loto,
ʻi heʻenau lea ke maʻu ʻae kakano ʻi heʻenau holi kovi.

‌ʻIo, naʻa nau lauʻikoviʻi ʻae ʻOtua;
naʻa nau pehē, “ʻE faʻa teuteu ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae keinangaʻanga ʻi he toafa?

Vakai, naʻe taaʻi ʻe ia ʻae makatuʻu, pea puna mei ai ʻae ngaahi vai,
pea pito ʻo fetāfeaki ʻae ngaahi vaitafe;
te ne faʻa tuku mai foki ʻae mā?
ʻE faʻa tokonaki ʻe ia ʻae kakano maʻa hono kakai?”

Koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai tenau tui ki he ʻOtua,
pea naʻe ʻikai ha falala ki heʻene fakamoʻui:

Neongo ʻene fekauʻi ʻae ngaahi ʻao ʻi ʻolunga,
mo ʻene toʻo ʻae ngaahi matapāʻoe langi,

‌ʻO ne tuku ke tōhifo ʻae mana kiate kinautolukenau kai,
pea ne foaki kiate kinautoluʻae uite ʻoe langi.

Naʻe kai ʻe he tangata ʻae meʻakai ʻae kau ʻāngelo:
naʻa ne tuku atu ʻae meʻakai kenau mākona ai.

Naʻe pule ʻe ia ke maʻili ʻae matangi hahake ʻi he langi:
pea ne ʻomi mo e matangi tonga ʻi heʻene māfimafi.

Naʻe fakatōhifo ʻe ia ʻae kakano kiate kinautoluʻo tatau mo e efu,
mo e fanga manu kapakau ʻo hangēko e ʻoneʻone ʻoe tahi:

Pea naʻa ne tuku ke tōia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo honau fale fehikitaki,
ʻo takatakai ʻi honau ngaahi nofoʻanga.

Ko ia naʻa nau kai, pea nau mākona:
he naʻa ne ʻange kiate kinautoluʻenau holi.

Naʻe ʻikai te nau mavahe mei heʻenau holi kovi.
Ka ʻi he kei ʻi honau ngutu ʻae maʻanga,

Naʻe hoko ʻae houhau ʻoe ʻOtua kiate kinautolu,
ʻo ne tāmateʻi ʻae fungani kakai sino ʻiate kinautolu,
pea ne tāhifo ʻae kau tangata kuo fili ʻi ʻIsileli.

Naʻe hoko ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, ka naʻa nau kei fai angahala pē,
ʻo ʻikai tui ki heʻene ngaahi ngāue mana.

Ko ia naʻa ne fakaʻosi ai honau ngaahi ʻaho ʻi he meʻa vaʻinga pē,
mo honau ngaahi taʻu ʻi he mamahi.

Pea ʻi heʻene tāmateʻi ʻakinautolu, naʻa nau toki kumi kiate ia:
ʻonau tafoki ʻo fehuʻi fakavave ki he ʻOtua.

Pea naʻa nau manatu ko honau maka ʻae ʻOtua,
pea ko honau huhuʻi ʻae ʻOtua māʻolunga.

Ka naʻa nau lapu kiate ia ʻi honau ngutu,
ʻonau loi kiate ia ʻaki honau ʻelelo.

He naʻe ʻikai totonu honau loto kiate ia,
pea naʻe ʻikai tenau tuʻumaʻu ʻi heʻene fuakava.

Ka naʻe fonu ia ʻi he ʻaloʻofa, ʻo ne fakamolemole ʻenau hia, pea naʻe ʻikai fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu:
ʻIo, naʻe liunga lahi ʻene fakaafe hono houhau,
pea naʻe ʻikai te ne ueʻi hake hono houhau kotoa pē.

He naʻa ne manatu ko e kakano pēʻakinautolu;
ko e matangi ʻoku mole atu, pea ʻikai toe haʻu.

Naʻe liunga fiha ʻenau fakahouhau kiate ia ʻi he toafa,
pea fakamamahiʻi ia ʻi he potu lala!

‌ʻIo, naʻa nau foki kimui pea ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻae ʻOtua,
ʻonau hūhūmamaʻi ʻae tokotaha māʻoniʻoni ʻo ʻIsileli.

Naʻe ʻikai tenau manatu ki hono nima,
pe ko e ʻaho naʻa ne fakamoʻui ai ʻakinautolumei he fili.

Mo ʻene fai ʻene ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻi ʻIsipite,
mo ʻene ngaahi meʻa mana ʻi he ngoue ʻo Soani:

Naʻa ne liliu honau ngaahi vaitafe ko e toto;
mo honau ngaahi vai lahi, naʻe ʻikai tenau faʻa inu ai.

Naʻe fekau atu ʻe ia kiate kinautoluʻae ngaahi lango kehekehe, ʻaia naʻe keina ʻakinautolu;
mo e fanga poto, ʻaia naʻe fakakoviʻi ʻakinautolu.

Naʻe tuku foki ʻe ia ʻae fua ʻo ʻenau ngoue ki he ʻunufe,
mo ʻenau ngāue ki he fanga heʻe.

Naʻa ne tāmateʻi ʻenau ngaahi vaine ʻaki ʻae ʻuhamaka,
mo ʻenau ʻakau ko e sukamino ʻaki ʻae momoko lahi.

Naʻe tuku foki ʻe ia ʻenau fanga manu ki he ʻuhamaka,
mo ʻenau fanga sipi ki he ngaahi faisisili vela.

Naʻe līʻe ia ʻae kakaha ʻo ʻene ʻita kiate kinautolu,
ʻae houhau lahi, mo e tuputāmaki, mo e mamahi,
ʻi heʻene fekau atu kiate kinautoluʻae kau ʻāngelo ʻoe kovi.

‌ʻO ne tāʻi ʻae ʻuluaki fānau kotoa pēʻi ʻIsipite;
ko e fungani mālohi ʻi he ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻo Hami.

Ka naʻa ne pule ke ʻalu atu ʻa hono kakai ʻoʻona ʻo hangēko e fanga sipi,
ʻo ne fakahinohino ʻakinautoluʻi he toafa ʻo hangēko e fuʻu fanga sipi.

Pea naʻe tataki fiemālie atu ʻe ia ʻakinautolu, ko ia naʻe ʻikai ai tenau manavahē:
ka naʻe lōmekina ʻe he tahi ʻa honau ngaahi fili.

Pea naʻe ʻomi ʻe ia ʻakinautoluʻo ofi ki hono faletapu,
ʻio, ki he moʻunga ni ʻaia kuo fakatau ʻe hono nima toʻomataʻu.

Naʻe kapusi foki ʻe ia ʻae hiteni mei honau ʻao,
ʻo ne vaheʻi kiate kinautoluʻae tofiʻa ʻaki ʻae afo,
pea ne pule ke nofo ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo ʻIsileli ʻi honau ngaahi fale fehikitaki.

Ka naʻa nau kei ʻahiʻahiʻi mo fakahouhauʻi ʻae ʻOtua fungani māʻolunga,
ʻo ʻikai tauhi ʻene ngaahi fekau:

Ka naʻa nau foki kimui, ʻo fai taʻeangatonu ʻo hangēko ʻenau ngaahi tamai:
naʻe ʻalu kehe ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e kaufanataka kehe.
Naʻa nau fakahouhau ia ʻaki honau ngaahi potu māʻolunga ʻonau fakafuaʻa ia ʻaki ʻenau ngaahi tamapua kuo tā.

Pea ʻi he ongoʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae meʻa ni, naʻe houhau ai ia,
ʻo fehiʻa lahi ki ʻIsileli:

Ko ia naʻa ne liʻaki ai ʻae fale fehikitaki ʻo Sailo,
ʻae nofoʻanga ko ia naʻe fokotuʻu ʻe ia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe kakai;

‌ʻO ne tukuangehono mālohi ke pōpula,
mo hono nāunau ki he nima ʻoe fili.

Naʻe fakatukutukuʻi foki ʻe ia hono kakai ki he heletā;
pea naʻe houhau ia ki hono tofiʻa.

Naʻe kai ke ʻosi ʻe he afi honau kau talavou;
pea naʻe ʻikai ʻunohoʻenau kau taʻahine.

Naʻe tōʻenau kau taulaʻeiki ʻi he heletā;
pea naʻe ʻikai fai ha tangi ʻe honau ʻunoho.

Pea naʻe toki ʻāai ʻae ʻEiki ʻo hangēko ha taha naʻe mohe,
pea hangēko e tangata mālohi ʻoku kalanga ko e meʻa ʻi heuaine.

Pea naʻe taaʻi ʻe ia hono ngaahi fili ʻi honau potu kimui:
naʻa ne tuku ʻakinautoluke manukia maʻuaipē.

Pea naʻa ne liʻaki ʻae fale fehikitaki ʻo Siosefa,
pea naʻe ʻikai te ne fili ʻae faʻahinga ʻo ʻIfalemi:

Ka naʻa ne fili ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Siuta,
ko e moʻunga ko Saione ʻaia naʻa ne ʻofa ki ai.

Pea naʻa ne langa hono faletapu ʻo hangēko e ngaahi fale māʻolunga,
ʻo hangēko e fonua ʻaia kuo fokotuʻumaʻu ke taʻengata.

Naʻe fili foki ʻe ia ʻa Tevita ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki,
ʻo ne toʻo ia mei he ngaahi lotoʻāsipi:

Naʻa ne ʻomi ia mei heʻene muimuiʻi he fanga sipi fefine naʻe talitali pō,
ke ne fafanga ʻa Sēkope ko hono kakai,
mo ʻIsileli ko hono tofiʻa.

Pea naʻa ne fafanga ʻakinautoluʻo fakatatau ki he angatonu ʻo hono loto;
ʻo ne tataki ʻakinautoluʻi he poto ʻo hono nima.
79:
Kuo nau ʻange ʻae sino mate ʻo hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ko e meʻakai ki he manupunaʻoe langi,
mo e kakano ʻo hoʻo kakai māʻoniʻoni ki he fanga manu ʻoe fonua.

Kuo nau lilingi honau toto ʻo hangēko e vai ʻo takatakai ʻi Selūsalema;
pea naʻe ʻikai ha niʻihi ke tanu ʻakinautolu.

Kuo mau hoko ko e manukiʻanga ʻo homau ngaahi kaungāʻapi,
ko e meʻa manuki mo e taukaeʻanga ʻokinautoluʻoku nofo takatakai ʻiate kimautolu.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloa?
Te ke houhau ʻo taʻengata?
pea vela ho fuaʻa ʻo hangēko e afi?

Ke ke lilingi ho houhau ki he hiteni ʻoku teʻeki ai ʻilo koe,
pea mo e ngaahi puleʻanga ʻoku teʻeki ai ui ki ho huafa.

He kuo nau kai ʻo ʻosi ʻa Sēkope,
ʻo maumauʻi ke lala hono nofoʻanga.

‌ʻoua naʻa ke fakamanatu kiate kimautoluʻemau ngaahi muʻaki hia:
tuku ke tokoni vave ʻakimautoluʻe hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ongongofua:
he kuo ʻohifo ki lalo ʻaupitoʻakimautolu.

‌ʻE ʻOtua ko homau fakamoʻui, ke ke tokoni ʻakimautolu, koeʻuhi ko e ongoongolelei ʻo ho huafa:
pea fakahaofi ʻakimautolu, ʻo fakamaʻa ke ʻosi ʻemau ngaahi angahala, koeʻuhi ko ho huafa.

Koeʻumaʻāʻae lea pehēmai ʻe he hiteni, “Ko e fēhonau ʻOtua?”
Tuku ke ʻilo ia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe hiteni ʻi homau ʻao ʻi he totongi ʻoe toto ʻo hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ʻaia kuo huaʻi.

Tuku ke aʻu ki ho ʻao ʻae ngaahi mafulu ʻae kau nofo pōpula;
ke ke fakamoʻui ʻakinautolukuo tuʻutuʻuni ke mate ʻo fakatatau mo hono lahi ʻo hoʻo māfimafi.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, ke ke ʻange ke liunga fitu ki he fatafata ʻo homau kaungāʻapi ʻenau lauʻikovi,
ʻaia naʻa nau lauʻikoviʻi ʻaki koe.

Pea ko kimautoluko ho kakai mo e fanga sipi ʻo hoʻo ngoue,
temau ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻo taʻengata:
temau fakahāatu ho ongoongolelei ki he toʻutangata kotoa pē.
80:
‌ʻI he ʻao ʻo ʻIfalemi mo Penisimani mo Manase ke ke ueʻi hake ho mālohi,
pea hāʻele mai ʻo fakamoʻui ʻakimautolu.

‌ʻE Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi kautau,
ʻe fēfēhono fuoloamo hoʻo kei houhau ki he lotu ʻa ho kakai?
‌ʻOku ke fafanga ʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae māʻoe loʻimata; pea ʻoku ʻange kiate kinautoluʻae loʻimata lahi kenau inu.

‌ʻOku ke ngaohi ʻakimautoluko e fekeʻikeʻiʻanga ʻo homau kaungāʻapi:
pea ʻoku katakata homau ngaahi fili ʻiate kinautolu.

‌ʻE ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi kautau,
ke ke toe fakatafoki ʻakimautolu,
pea tuku ke ulo mai ho fofonga;
pea te mau moʻui ai.

Naʻa ke līkituʻa ʻae hiteni;
ka naʻa ke ʻomi ʻae vaine mei ʻIsipite, ʻo tōia.

Naʻa ke fakaʻataʻatāʻae potuʻi hono ʻao,
pea naʻa ke fakaaka māʻulaloia, pea naʻa ne fakapito ʻae fonua.

Naʻe ʻufiʻufi ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻi hono malumalu,
pea ko hono ngaahi vaʻa naʻe hangēko e ngaahi sita ʻae ʻOtua.

Naʻa ne tuku atu hono ngaahi vaʻa ki he tahi,
mo hono ngaahi ʻuluʻulu ki he vaitafe.

Ko e hākuo ke hae hifo ai hono ngaahi ʻā,
ke toli ia ʻekinautolukotoa pēʻoku ʻalu atu ʻi he hala?

‌ʻOku maumauʻi ia ʻe he puaka tau mei he vao,
ʻoku kai ke ʻosi ia ʻe he fanga manu kaivao.

‌ʻE ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi kautau, ʻoku mau kole kiate koe ke ke foki mai:
ʻafio hifo mei he langi, ʻo vakai, mo ʻaʻahi ki he vaine ni;

Mo e ngoue vaine ʻaia kuo tōʻe ho nima toʻomataʻu,
mo e vaʻa ʻaia naʻa ke ngaohi ke mālohi maʻau.

Kuo tutu ia ʻaki ʻae afi, kuo tāhifo ia:
kuo nau ʻauha ʻi he tautea ʻe ho fofonga.

Tuku ke hili ho nima ki he tangata ʻo ho nima toʻomataʻu,
ki he foha ʻoe tangata ʻaia naʻa ke fakamālohi maʻau.

Pea ʻe ʻikai ai te mau foki kimui meiate koe:
ke ke fakaakeake ʻakimautolu, pea temau ui ki ho huafa.

‌ʻE Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi kautau, ke ke toe fakatafoki ʻakimautolu,
pea tuku ke ulo mai ho fofonga; pea temau moʻui ai.
81:
HIVA kalanga ki he ʻOtua ko hotau mālohi,
kalanga fakafiefia ki he ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope.

Toʻo mai ʻae saame, pea ʻomi ʻae kihiʻi lali,
mo e haʻape mālie mo e saliteli.

Ifi mālohi ʻae meʻa lea ʻi he māhina foʻou,
ʻi he ʻaho kuo tuʻutuʻuni, ʻi hotau ʻaho kātoanga mamalu.

He ko e fekau eni ki ʻIsileli,
mo e fono ʻae ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope.

Naʻa ne tuʻutuʻuni eni ʻia Siosefa ko e fakamoʻoni,
ʻi heʻene ʻalu atu ʻi he fonua ko ʻIsipite:
ʻaia naʻaku fanongo ai ki he lea naʻe ʻikai te u ʻiloa.

“Naʻaku hiki ʻae kavenga mei hono uma:
naʻe hao hono nima mei he ngaahi kato.

Naʻa ke ui ʻi he mamahi, pea ne u fakamoʻui koe:
naʻaku talia koe ʻi he potu lilo ʻoe mana: ne u ʻahiʻahiʻi koe ʻi he vai ʻo Melipa.Sila.

‌ʻOua naʻa fokotuʻu ha ʻotua foʻou kiate koe:
pea ʻe ʻikai te ke hūki ha ʻotua foʻou.

Ko au Sihova ko ho ʻOtua,
naʻaku ʻomi koe mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite:
fakamanga ho ngutu ke lahi, pea te u fakafonu ia.

“Ka naʻe ʻikai fie tokanga ʻa hoku kakai ki hoku leʻo;
pea naʻe ʻikai manako ʻa ʻIsileli kiate au.

Ko ia ne u fakatukutukuʻi ai ʻakinautoluki he holi kovi ʻa honau loto:
pea naʻa nau ʻaʻeva ʻi heʻenau ngaahi filioʻi.

‌ʻAmusiaange ʻeau kuo tokanga ʻa hoku kakai kiate au,
pea ʻeveʻeva ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi hoku ngaahi hala!

Pehē, kuo u fakavaivaiʻi leva honau ngaahi fili,
ʻo mafao atu hoku nima ki honau kau fakamamahi.

Pea ko e kau fehiʻa kia Sihova kuo nau fakavaivai ʻakinautolukiate ia:
ka ʻe tolonga ʻo taʻengata honau ngaahi ʻaho.

Kuo ne fafanga foki ʻakinautoluʻaki ʻae uite mātuʻaki lelei:
pea u fakamākona ʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae hone mei he maka.”
82:
‌ʻOKU ʻafio ʻae ʻOtua ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kau mālohi;
ʻoku ne fakamaau ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi ʻotua.

“ʻE fēfēhono fuoloamo hoʻomou fakamaau taʻetotonu,
pea filifilimānako ki he kakai angahala?”Sila.

“Fakamaau ʻae paea mo e tamai mate:
fai angatonu ki he mamahi mo e masiva.

Fakahaofi ʻae masiva mo e paea:
fakamoʻui ʻakinautolumei he nima ʻoe kau angahala.”

‌ʻOku ʻikai te nau ʻilo,
pea ʻoku ʻikai te nau fie ʻilo;
ʻoku nau ʻalu pēʻi he poʻuli:
kuo ueʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga kotoa pēʻo māmani.

Naʻaku pehē, “Ko e ngaahi ʻotua ʻakimoutolu;
pea ko e fānau ʻae Fungani Māʻolunga ʻakimoutolukotoa pē.

Ka temou mate ʻo hangēko e kau tangata,
pea tōʻo hangēko e tokotaha ʻoe houʻeiki.”

Tuʻu hake, ʻE ʻOtua, fakamaau ʻa māmani:
he te ke maʻu ʻae puleʻanga kotoa pē.
83:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, ʻoua naʻa ke fakalongo pē:
ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoua naʻa ke taʻeʻafioʻi, pea ʻoua naʻa ke nofo pē.

Vakai, ʻoku fakatupu maveuveu ʻe ho ngaahi fili:
pea ko kinautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate koe kuo nau hiki hake honau ʻulu.

Naʻa nau alea fakalilolilo ki hoʻo kakai,
pea nau fakakaukau fakataha ki he kakai ʻoku ke maluʻi.

Naʻa nau pehē, “Haʻu, ketau fakaʻauha ʻakinautoluke ʻoua naʻa toe ui ʻakinautoluko e puleʻanga;
ke ʻoua naʻa kei manatu ki he hingoa ʻo ʻIsileli.”

He kuo nau fakakaukau ʻi he loto taha:
ʻoku nau fuakava ʻo angatuʻu kiate koe:

Ko e ngaahi fale fehikitaki ʻo ʻItomi, mo e kau ʻIsimeʻeli;
ʻa Moape, mo e hako ʻo Hekaʻā;

‌ʻA Kepale, mo ʻAmoni, mo ʻAmaleki,
ko e kau Filisitia mo e kakai ʻo Taia;

‌ʻOku fakataha mo kinautolufoki ʻa ʻAsilia:
kuo nau tokoni ki he fānau ʻa Lote.Sila.

Fai kiate kinautoluʻo hangēko hoʻo fai ki he kau Mitiani;
ʻo hangēko Sisela, mo Sapini, ʻi he vaitafe ʻo Kisoni:

‌ʻAia naʻe ʻauha ʻi Enitoa:
naʻa nau hoko ʻo hangēko e kinohaʻa ki he kelekele.

Ngaohi honau ngaahi ʻeiki ke hangēko Olipi, pea tatau mo Siipi:
ʻio, ʻa ʻenau houʻeiki kotoa pēʻo hangēko Sipaa, mo Salimuna.
‌ʻAia naʻa nau pehē, “Ketau maʻu ʻae ngaahi fale ʻoe ʻOtua moʻotautolu.”

‌ʻE hoku ʻOtua, ke ke ngaohi ʻakinautoluke hangēko e teka;
ke hangēko e veve ʻoku vilingia ʻi he matangi.

‌ʻO hangēko e vela ʻoe vao ʻakau ʻi he afi,
pea hangēkuo tutu ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻe he ulo afi.

Ke fakatanga pehēʻakinautoluʻaki hoʻo fuʻu taufa,
pea fakamanavahēʻi ʻakinautoluʻaki hoʻo afā.

‌ʻE Sihova, fakafonu honau mata ʻi he mā;
koeʻuhi kenau kumi ki ho huafa.

Tuku kenau puputuʻu mo mamahi ʻo taʻengata;
ʻio, tuku ke māmo ʻauha ʻakinautolu.

Koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ʻe he kakai ko koe, ko ho huafa ʻoʻou ko Sihova,
ko e Fungani Māʻolunga ʻi māmani kotoa pē.
84:
‌ʻE SIHOVA ʻoe ngaahi kautau,
ʻoku lelei lahi ho ngaahi fale fehikitaki!

‌ʻOku holi hoku laumālie, ʻio, ʻoku ou vaivai ʻi he fie ʻalu ki he ngaahi lotoʻāʻo Sihova;
ʻoku tangi kalanga hoku loto mo hoku kakano ki he ʻOtua moʻui.

‌ʻIo, kuo ʻilo ʻe he hikiʻi manupunaʻae fale,
mo e kulukuluha pununga maʻana, ʻaia te ne tuku ki ai ʻene fānau,
ʻio, ko ho ngaahi feilaulauʻanga, ʻE Sihova ʻoe ngaahi kautau, ko hoku Tuʻi, mo hoku ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi ho fale:
tenau kei fakafetaʻi pe kiate koe.Sila.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku ʻiate koe hono mālohi;
ʻoku ʻi hono loto ʻae ngaahi hala.

Pea ʻi heʻenau ʻalu ʻi he toafa ʻo Peka ʻoku ngaohi ia ko e matavai;
ʻoku fakafonu foki ʻe he ʻuha ʻae ngaahi lepa.

‌ʻOku nau ʻalu ʻi he mālohi ki he mālohi,
ʻo fakahātaki taha kotoa pēia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua ʻi Saione.

‌ʻE Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi kautau,
ke ke fanongo ki heʻeku lotu:
fakafanongo, ʻE ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope.Sila.

Vakai, ʻE ʻOtua ko homau fakaū,
mo ke ʻafio ki he fofonga ʻo hoʻo pani.

He ʻoku lelei lahi hake ʻae ʻaho pe taha ʻi ho ngaahi loto ʻā,
ʻi he ʻaho ʻe taha afe.
ʻOku ou fili muʻa ke u nofo ko e leʻo matapāʻi he fale ʻo hoku ʻOtua,
ʻi heʻeku nofo ʻi he ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻoe kovi.

He ko Sihova ko e ʻOtua ko e laʻāia mo e fakaū:
ʻe foaki ʻe Sihova ʻae ʻaloʻofa mo e nāunau:
ʻe ʻikai te ne taʻofi ha meʻa lelei ʻe taha meiate kinautoluʻoku ʻaʻeva totonu.

‌ʻE Sihova ʻoe ngaahi kautau,
ʻoku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku falala kiate koe.
85:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, kuo ke finangalo lelei ki ho fonua:
kuo ke toe ʻomi ʻa Sēkope mei he pōpula.

Kuo ke fakamolemole ʻae hia ʻa hoʻo kakai,
kuo ke ʻufiʻufi ʻenau angahala kotoa pē.Sila.

Kuo ke toʻo ʻo ʻave ho houhau kotoa pē:
kuo ke fakatafoki koe mei he kakaha ʻo ho houhau.

Fakatafoki ʻakimautolu, ʻE ʻOtua ʻo ʻemau moʻui,
pea ke fakangata ho houhau kiate kimautolu.

Te ke houhau kiate kimautoluke taʻengata?
Te ke toloi atu ho houhau ki he toʻutangata kotoa pē?

‌ʻIkai te ke toe fakaakeake ʻakimautolu:
koeʻuhi ke fiefia hoʻo kakai ʻiate koe?

Fakahākiate kimautoluhoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻE Sihova,
mo ke tuku kiate kimautoluʻa hoʻo fakamoʻui.

Te u fanongo ki he folofola ʻae ʻOtua ko Sihova:
he te ne folofolaʻaki ʻae melino ki hono kakai, pea ki heʻene kau māʻoniʻoni:
kaeʻoua naʻa nau toe tafoki ki he kovi.

Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ofi ʻene fakamoʻui kiate kinautoluʻoku manavahēkiate ia,
koeʻuhi ke nofo ʻae monūʻia ʻi hotau fonua.

Kuo fakafetaulakiʻae ʻaloʻofa mo e moʻoni;
ko e māʻoniʻoni mo e melino kuo na toutou fekita.

‌ʻE tupu hake ʻae moʻoni mei he kelekele;
pea ʻe sio hifo ʻae māʻoniʻoni mei he langi.

‌ʻIo, ʻe foaki ʻe Sihova ʻaia ʻoku lelei;
pea ʻe tuku mai hono fua ʻe hotau fonua.

‌ʻE muʻomuʻa ʻiate ia ʻae māʻoniʻoni,
ʻo ne fokotuʻu hotau vaʻe ʻi hono hala.
86:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, ke ke fofonga mai, ʻo fanongo kiate au:
he ʻoku ou masiva mo mamahi.

Fakamoʻui hoku laumālie; he ʻoku ou māʻoniʻoni:
ʻa koe ko hoku ʻOtua, fakamoʻui hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ʻaia ʻoku falala kiate koe.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, ke ke ʻaloʻofa kiate au:
he ʻoku ou tangi kiate koe ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, fakafiefiaʻi ʻae laumālie ʻo hoʻo tamaioʻeiki:
he ʻoku ou hiki hake hoku laumālie kiate koe.

He ko koe, ʻE ʻEiki ʻoku ke angalelei, pea faʻa fakamolemole;
pea mohu ʻaloʻofa kiate kinautolukotoa pēʻoku ui kiate koe.

Fanongo, ʻE Sihova, ki heʻeku lotu
pea tokanga ki he leʻo ʻo ʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu.

‌ʻI he ʻaho ʻo ʻeku mamahi te u ui kiate koe;
he te ke talia au.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, ʻoku ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua ʻoku tatau mo koe;
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha ngāue ʻe hangēko hoʻo ngaahi ngāue.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, ʻe haʻu ʻo hūʻi ho ʻao ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pēnaʻa ke ngaohi;
pea tenau fakaongoongoleleiʻi ho huafa.

He ʻoku ke lahi, pea ʻoku ke fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa mana:
ko koe pēko e ʻOtua.

‌ʻE ʻEiki ko hoku ʻOtua, te u fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻaki hoku loto kotoa:
pea te u fakaongoongolelei ho huafa ʻo taʻengata.

He ʻoku lahi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa kiate au:
pea kuo ke fakamoʻui hoku laumālie mei he loto heli.

Ka ko koe, ʻE ʻEiki, ko e ʻOtua ʻoku fonu ʻi he manavaʻofa, mo e angalelei,
ʻoku ke kātaki fuoloa, pea mohu ʻaloʻofa mo e moʻoni.
87: KO hono tuʻunga ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻOku ʻofa lahi hake ʻa Sihova ki he ngaahi matapāʻo Saione,
ʻi he ngaahi nofoʻanga kotoa pēʻo Sēkope.
‌ʻA e kolo ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻoku talanoa ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ongoongolelei ʻiate koe.Sila.

Pea ʻe lau pehēki Saione,
“Ko e tangata ni mo e tangata na naʻe fanauʻi ʻi ai”:
pea ʻe fakatuʻumaʻu ia ʻe he Fungani Māʻolunga.

‌ʻE lau ʻe Sihova, ʻi heʻene tohi ʻae kakai,
“ko e tangata ni naʻe fanauʻi ʻi ai.”Sila.

‌ʻE ʻi ai fakatouʻosi ʻae kau hiva mo e kau pulotuʻoe ngaahi meʻa faiva:
“ko ʻeku ngaahi matavai kotoa pēʻoku ʻiate koe.”
88:
‌ʻE SIHOVA ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻeku moʻui,
naʻaku tangi ʻi he ʻaho mo e pōʻi ho ʻao:
Tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku lotu ki ho ʻao ke ke fofonga mai ki heʻeku tangi;

He ʻoku fonu hoku laumālie ʻi he mamahi:
pea ʻoku fakaʻaʻau ʻeku moʻui ki he faʻitoka.

‌ʻOku lau fakataha au mo kinautoluʻoku ʻalu hifo ki he luo:
ʻoku ou hangēha tangata ʻoku ʻikai hano mālohi:

‌ʻO tauʻatāina mo e kakai mate,
ʻo hangēko e kakai kuo tāmateʻi ʻoku tokoto ʻi he faʻitoka,
ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻikai te ke kei manatuʻi:
pea kuo motuhi ʻakinautoluʻe ho nima.

Kuo ke tuku au ʻi he luo taumamaʻo,
ʻi he fakapoʻuli,
ʻi he ngaahi loloto.

‌ʻOku tataʻo mamafa ho houhau ʻiate au,
pea kuo ke fakamamahiʻi au ʻaki hoʻo ngaahi peau kotoa pē.Sila.

‌ʻOku vaivai hoku mata ko e meʻa ʻi he mamahi:
ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou ui kiate koe ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē,
kuo u mafao atu hoku nima kiate koe.

Te ke fakahāʻae ngaahi meʻa mana ki he mate?
ʻE tuʻu hake ʻae mate ʻo fakafetaʻi kiate koe?Sila.

‌ʻE fakahāatu ʻa hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻi he faʻitoka?
Pe ko hoʻo moʻoni ʻi he fakaʻauha?

‌ʻE ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻi he poʻuli?
Mo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ʻi he fonua ʻoe fakangalo?

Ka naʻaku tangi kiate koe, ʻE Sihova;
pea ʻi he pongipongi ʻe aʻu atu kiate koe ʻeku lotu.

‌ʻE Sihova, ko e hāʻoku ke liʻaki ai ʻa hoku laumālie?
Ko e hāʻoku ke fufūai ho fofonga ʻiate au?

‌ʻOku ou mamahi, pea meimei mate talu ʻeku kei talavou:
ʻi heʻeku kātaki hoʻo ngaahi meʻa fakailifia ʻoku ou feinga ai ʻaupito.

Kuo lōfia au ʻe ho houhau lahi;
kuo motuhi au ʻe hoʻo ngaahi fakailifia.

Naʻa nau kāpui au ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pēʻo hangēko e vai;
naʻa nau fakataha ʻo takatakai au.

Ko e kaumeʻaʻofa mo e kāinga kuo ke fakamamaʻo atu ʻiate au,
mo hoku kaumeʻa ki he poʻuli.
89:
TE U hiva ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ʻa Sihova ʻo taʻengata:
te u fakaʻilo ʻaki hoku ngutu ʻa hoʻo moʻoni ki he toʻutangata kotoa pē.

He naʻaku pehē, “ʻE fokotuʻumaʻu pēʻa e ʻaloʻofa ʻo taʻengata:
ko hoʻo moʻoni te ke fakatuʻumaʻu ʻi he ngaahi langi.”

Kuo u fai ʻae fuakava mo ʻeku fili,
kuo u fuakava ki heʻeku tamaioʻeiki ko Tevita.

“Te u fakatuʻumaʻu ho hako ʻo taʻengata,
te u fokotuʻu ho puleʻanga ki he toʻutangata kotoa pē.”Sila.

Pea ʻe fakamālōʻe he ngaahi langi ki hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo, ʻE Sihova:
mo hoʻo moʻoni foki ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kau māʻoniʻoni.

He ko hai ʻi he langi ʻe fakatatau ia kia Sihova?
Ko hai ʻi he ngaahi foha ʻoe mālohi ʻe faʻa fakatatau kia Sihova?

‌ʻOku totonu ke manavahēlahi ki he ʻOtua ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kau māʻoniʻoni,
pea ke fakaʻapaʻapa ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku tuʻu takatakai kiate ia.

‌ʻE Sihova ko e ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi kautau, ko hai ʻoku tatau mo koe ko Sihova māfimafi?
Pea ko hoʻo moʻoni ʻoku kāpui koe.

‌ʻOku ke puleʻi ʻae ngaue mālohi ʻoe tahi:
ʻoka hou hono ngaahi peau, ʻoku ke fakatofukīia.

Kuo ke fesiʻi ʻa Lehapi ke lailai, ʻo hangēha taha kuo tāmateʻi;
kuo fakahēʻi ho ngaahi fili ʻaki ho nima mālohi.

‌ʻOku ʻoʻou ʻae ngaahi langi,
pea ʻoku ʻoʻou foki mo e fonua: ko māmani mo hono fonu
ʻo ia kuo ke fakatuʻumaʻu ia.

Kuo ke ngaohi ʻae potu tokelau mo e potu tonga:
ko Tepoa mo Heamoni ʻe fiefia ʻi ho huafa.

‌ʻOku ʻiate koe ʻae nima māfimafi ʻoku mālohi ho nima,
pea māʻolunga ho nima toʻomataʻu.

Ko e angatonu mo e fakamaau ko e tuʻunga ia ʻo ho ʻafioʻanga:
ʻe muʻomuʻa ʻi ho ʻao ʻae ʻaloʻofa mo e moʻoni.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae kakai ʻoku nau ʻiloʻi ʻae ongoongo fakafiefia:
tenau ʻaʻeva, ʻE Sihova, ʻi he maama ʻo ho fofonga.

Te nau fiefia ʻi ho huafa ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē:
pea ʻi hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ʻe hakeakiʻi ai ʻakinautolu.

He ko koe ko e vikivikiʻanga ʻo honau mālohi:
pea ʻi hoʻo ʻofa ʻe hiki ai ki ʻolunga honau nifo.

He ko homau hūfanga ʻa Sihova;
pea ko e tokotaha māʻoniʻoni ʻo ʻIsileli ko homau tuʻi.

Kuo u ʻiloʻi ʻa Tevita ko ʻeku tamaioʻeiki;
pea kuo u tākai ʻaki ia ʻa ʻeku lolo māʻoniʻoni:

‌ʻE tuʻumaʻu hoku nima mo ia:
ko hoku nima foki ʻe fakamālohiʻi ia.

‌ʻE ʻikai fai fakamālohi kiate ia ʻe he fili;
pe fakamamahiʻi ia ʻe he foha ʻoe angakovi.

Pea te u taaʻi hifo hono ngaahi fili ʻi hono ʻao,
pea tautea ʻakinautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate ia.

Ka ʻe ʻiate ia ʻa ʻeku moʻoni mo ʻeku ʻaloʻofa:
pea ʻi hoku huafa ʻe hiki ki ʻolunga ai ʻa hono nifo.

Te u ʻai foki hono nima ki he tahi,
mo hono nima toʻomataʻu ki he ngaahi vaitafe.

‌ʻE tangi ia kiate au, ‘Ko koe ko ʻeku Tamai,
ko hoku ʻOtua, mo e maka ʻo hoku fakamoʻui.’

Pea te u ngaohi foki ia ko hoku ʻuluaki foha,
ʻe māʻolunga lahi ia ʻi he ngaahi tuʻi ʻo māmani.

Te u tuku ʻeku ʻaloʻofa maʻana ʻo taʻengata,
pea ʻe tuʻumaʻu ʻeku fuakava mo ia.

Te u ngaohi foki hono hako kenau tolonga ʻo taʻengata,
mo hono nofoʻa ʻo hangēko e ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe langi.

“Kapau ʻe liʻaki ʻeku akonaki ʻe heʻene fānau,
ʻo ʻikai ʻaʻeva ʻi heʻeku ngaahi fakamaau;

Kapau tenau maumauʻi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni,
pea ʻikai tauhi ʻeku ngaahi fekau;

Pea te u toki ʻaʻahi ʻenau ngaahi talangataʻa ʻaki ʻae meʻa kini,
mo ʻenau hia ʻaki ʻae ngaahi tā.

Ka ʻe ʻikai te u hiki ʻaupitoʻeku manavaʻofa ʻiate ia,
pe tuku taʻehoko ʻa ʻeku moʻoni.

‌ʻE ʻikai te u liʻaki ʻeku fuakava,
pe fakakehe ʻae meʻa kuo ʻalu atu ʻi hoku loungutu.
“Kuo u fuakava tuʻo taha ʻi heʻeku māʻoniʻoni ʻe ʻikai te u loi kia Tevita.

‌ʻE tolonga ʻene fānau ʻo taʻengata,
mo hono nofoʻa ʻo hangēko e laʻāʻi hoku ʻao.

‌ʻE fakatuʻumaʻu ia ke taʻengata ʻo hangēko e māhina,
pea hangēko e fakamoʻoni ʻi he langi.”Sila.

Ka kuo liʻaki mo fākaliliʻa,
mo ke houhau kiate ia naʻa ke pani.

Kuo ke fakataʻeʻaongaʻi ʻae fuakava ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki:
kuo ke fakakoviʻi hono tatāʻi hoʻo līia ki he kelekele.

Kuo ke maumauʻi hifo hono ngaahi ʻākotoa pē;
kuo ke fakaʻauha hono ngaahi potu mālohi.

Ko kinautolukotoa pēʻoku ʻalu ʻi he hala ʻoku nau kaihaʻa ʻiate ia:
ko e manukiʻanga ia ʻo hono ngaahi kaungāʻapi.

Kuo ke hiki hake ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo hono ngaahi fili;
kuo ke fakafiefiaʻi ʻa hono ngaahi fili kotoa pē.

Kuo ke liliu foki ʻae mata ʻo ʻene heletā,
pea ʻe ʻikai te ke ngaohi ia ke tuʻu ʻi he tau.

Kuo ke fakaʻosi hono nāunau,
pea līhono nofoʻa ki he kelekele.

Kuo ke fakafuonounou ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene talavou:
kuo ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae mā.Sila.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloa?
Te ke fakafufūkoe ʻo taʻengata?
ʻE vela ho houhau ʻo hangēko e afi?

Manatu ki hono fuonounou ʻo ʻeku moʻui:
ko e hākuo ke ngaohi ʻae kakai kotoa pēke taʻeʻaonga?

Ko hai ʻae tangata ko ia ʻoku moʻui,
pea ʻe ʻikai te ne mamata ki he mate? ʻE fakamoʻui ʻe ia ʻa hono laumālie mei he nima ʻoe faʻitoka?Sila.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, ko e fēhoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ʻi muʻa,
ʻaia naʻa ke fuakava ʻaki kia Tevita ʻi hoʻo moʻoni?

Manatu, ʻE ʻEiki, ki he manukiʻi ʻo hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki;
mo ʻeku fua ʻi hoku fatafata ʻae manuki ʻae kakai mālohi kotoa pē;

‌ʻAia kuo manuki ʻaki ʻe ho ngaahi fili,
ʻE Sihova; ʻaia kuo nau manuki ʻaki ʻae ngaahi ʻaluʻanga ʻo ia kuo ke pani.

Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova ʻo taʻengata.
ʻEmeni, mo ʻEmeni.
90: ‌ʻE SIHOVA, ko koe ko homau hūfanga ʻi he toʻutangata kotoa pē.

‌ʻI he teʻeki ai fakatupu ʻae ngaahi moʻunga,
pea teʻeki ai te ke ngaohi ʻae fonua mo māmani,
ʻio, talu mei muʻa ʻo aʻu ʻo taʻengata, ko koe pe ko e ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku ke liliu ʻae tangata ke ʻauha; pea ke pehē,
“Tafoki, ʻakimoutoluʻae fānau ʻae tangata.”

He ʻoku tatau ʻi ho ʻao ʻae taʻu ʻe afe mo e ʻaneafi ʻi hono hili ange ia,
pea mo e leʻo ʻi he pō.

‌ʻOku ke ʻave ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e ʻave ʻe he vaitafe; ʻoku nau hangēko e mohe:
ʻi he pongipongi ʻoku nau tatau mo e mohuku ʻoku tupu hake.

‌ʻI he pongipongi ʻoku lau maʻuiʻui ia, pea tupu hake:
ʻi he efiafi ʻoku tuʻusi hifo ia, pea mae.

He ʻoku mau ʻauha ʻi ho houhau,
pea ʻoku mau mamahi ʻi ho tuputāmaki.

Kuo ke tuku ʻemau ngaahi hia ʻi ho ʻao,
pea mo ʻemau ngaahi angahala fufūʻi he maama ʻo ho fofonga.

He ʻoku ʻosi atu homau ngaahi ʻaho kotoa pēʻi ho houhau:
ʻoku mau fakaʻosi homau ngaahi taʻu ʻo hangēko e talanoa ʻoku lau.

Ko hai ʻoku ne ʻiloʻi ʻae mālohi ʻo ho houhau?
ʻO hangēko ho manavahēʻia, ʻoku pehēho houhau.

Ke pehēhoʻo akonakiʻi ʻakimautoluke mau lau homau ngaahi ʻaho,
koeʻuhi ke mau fakatokangaʻi homau loto ki he poto.

Tafoki, ʻE Sihova,
ʻe fēfēhono fuoloa?
Pea ke lolou koeʻuhi ko hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki.

Ke ke fakamākona vave ʻakimautoluʻaki hoʻo ʻaloʻofa;
koeʻuhi ke mau fiefia mo nekeneka ʻi homau ʻaho fulipē.

Ke ke fakafiefiaʻi ʻakimautoluʻo fakatatau ki he ngaahi ʻaho ne ke fakamamahiʻi ai ʻakimautolu,
pea mo e ngaahi taʻu kuo mau mamata ai ki he kovi.

Pea ke tuku ke hāki hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa hoʻo ngāue,
pea mo ho nāunau ki heʻenau fānau.
91: KO ia ʻoku nofo ʻi he potu lilo ʻi he fungani māʻolunga, ʻe nofomaʻu ia he malumaluʻoe Māfimafi.

Te u pehē, “Ko Sihova, ko hoku hūfanga ia mo ʻeku kolo:
ko hoku ʻOtua te u falala kiate ia.”

Ko e moʻoni te ne fakamoʻui koe mei he hele ʻae tangata tauhele,
pea mei he mahaki fakaʻauha.

Te ne ʻōʻōfaki koe ʻaki hono fulufulu,
pea te ke falala ki hono lalo kapakau:
ko ʻene moʻoni ko ho fakaūmo ho pāia.

‌ʻE ʻikai te ke manavahēkoeʻuhi ko e meʻa fakailifia ʻi he pō;
pe koeʻuhi ko e ngahau ʻoku puna atu ʻi he ʻaho;

Pe koeʻuhi ko e mahaki lahi ʻoku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he poʻuli;
pe koeʻuhi ko e fakaʻauha ʻoku fakaʻosiʻosi ʻi he hoʻatā.

‌ʻE tōʻae toko afe ʻi ho tafaʻaki,
pea ko e toko mano ʻi ho nima toʻomataʻu ka ʻe ʻikai hoko ia ʻo ofi kiate koe.
Ka te ke vakai ʻo mamata ʻaki ho mata ki he totongi ʻoe angahala.

Koeʻuhi kuo ke fili ʻa Sihova ʻaia ko hoku hūfanga,
ʻio, ko e fungani māʻolunga ko ho nofoʻanga:

‌ʻE ʻikai tōha kovi kiate koe,
pea ʻe ʻikai hoko ha mamahi fakaʻauha ke ofi ki ho nofoʻanga.

He te ne fekau ʻene kau ʻāngelo kenau vakai koe,
ke tauhi koe ʻi ho ngaahi hala kotoa pē.

Tenau hapai hake koe ʻi he nima,
telia naʻa tūkia ho vaʻe ki ha maka.

Te ke molomoloki ʻae laione mo e ngata:
ko e laione mui mo e talākoni te ke malaki hifo ia.

“Koeʻuhi kuo ne tuku ʻene ʻofa kiate au, ko ia te u fakamoʻui ia:
te u fokotuʻu ia ke māʻolunga, koeʻuhi kuo ne ʻiloʻi hoku huafa.

Te u fakafiemālieʻi ʻaki ia ʻae moʻui fuoloa,
pea fakahākiate ia ʻeku fakamoʻui.”
92:
‌ʻOKU lelei ke ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova,
pea ke hiva fakamālōki ho huafa, ʻE fungani māʻolunga:

Ke fakahāatu hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻi he pongipongi,
mo hoʻo moʻoni ʻi he pōkotoa pē,

‌ʻAki ʻae meʻa faiva ʻoku hongofulu hono filo, pea mo e saliteli;
ʻaki ʻae leʻo mamafa ʻi he haʻape.

He kuo ke fakafiefiaʻi au, ʻE Sihova, ʻi hoʻo ngāue:
te u vikiviki ʻi he ngaahi ngāue ʻa ho nima.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku mātuʻaki lahi hoʻo ngaahi ngāue!
pea ʻoku loloto ʻaupitohoʻo ngaahi fakakaukau.

‌ʻOku ʻikai ʻiloʻi ʻe he tangata anga fakamanu;
pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo eni ʻe he vale.
Ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke fungani māʻolunga ʻo taʻengata.

Pea vakai, ko ho ngaahi fili, ʻE Sihova, ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻauha ho ngaahi fili;
ʻe fakahēʻi ʻae kau fai kovi kotoa pē.

Ka te ke hiki hake hoku nifo ʻo hangēko e nifo ʻoe liimi:
ʻe tākai ʻaki au ʻae lolo foʻou.

Pea ʻe mamata foki ʻa hoku mata ki hoku ngaahi fili,
pea ʻe fanongo ʻa hoku telinga, ki he angahala ʻoku tuʻu hake ʻo angatuʻu kiate au.

‌ʻE lau maʻuiʻui ʻae angatonu ʻo hangēko e ʻakau ko e ponga:
ʻe tupu ia ʻo hangēko e sita ʻi Lepanoni.
Ko kinautolukuo tōʻi he fale ʻo Sihova tenau lau maʻuiʻui ʻi he ngaahi lotoʻāʻo hotau ʻOtua.

‌ʻE kei tupu ʻae fua ʻiate kinautoluʻi heʻenau motuʻa;
tenau sino lelei mo lau maʻuiʻui.

Ke fakahāʻoku angatonu ʻa Sihova:
ko hoku maka ia,
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha taʻemāʻoniʻoni ʻiate ia.
93:
‌ʻOKU pule ʻa Sihova, ʻoku kofuʻaki ia ʻae nāunau lahi;
ʻoku kofuʻaki ʻa Sihova ʻae māfimafi,
ʻaia kuo ne nonoʻo ʻaki ia kuo fokotuʻumaʻu foki ʻa māmani,
pea ʻe ʻikai faʻa ueʻi ia.

KUO fokotuʻumaʻu ho ʻafioʻanga talu mei muʻa:
ʻoku talu mei muʻa ʻae ʻafiona.

Ko Sihova ʻoku ʻi ʻolunga ʻoku mālohi lahi hake ia ʻi he ʻuʻulu ʻoe ngaahi vai lahi,
ʻio, ʻi he ngaahi peau mālohi ʻoe tahi.

‌ʻOku moʻoni ʻaupitohoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni:
ʻE Sihova, ʻoku taau mo ho fale ʻae māʻoniʻoni ʻo lauikuonga.
94:
‌ʻE SIHOVA ko e ʻOtua, ʻoku ʻaʻau ʻae totongi;
ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku ʻaʻau ʻae totongi: ke ke ulo mai.

Ke ke hiki hake koe, ʻa koe ko e fakamaau ʻo māmani;
ʻange ʻae totongi ki he laukau.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloaʻoe fielahi ʻae angahala,
ʻe fēfēhono fuoloaʻoe polepole ʻae angahala?

‌ʻE fēfēhono fuoloaʻo ʻenau fakahāmo lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa faingataʻa?
Pea vikiviki ai ʻae kakai kotoa pēʻoku fai kovi?

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku nau fesiʻi ʻo lailaiki ho kakai,
mo fakamamahiʻi ho tofiʻa.

‌ʻOku nau tāmateʻi ʻae muli mo e fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho,
pea fakapoongi ʻae tamai mate.
Ka ʻoku nau pehē, “ʻE ʻikai ʻafioʻi ʻe Sihova, ʻe ʻikai tokanga ki ai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope.”

Mou ʻilo ʻekimoutoluʻoku anga fakamanu ʻi he kakai:
pea ko kimoutoluʻae kau vale, te mou poto ʻafē?

Ko ia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae telinga, ʻikai te ne fanongo?
Ko ia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae mata, ʻikai te ne ʻafioʻi?

Ko ia ʻoku ne tautea ʻae hiteni, ʻikai te ne tautea?
Ko ia ʻoku ne akonakiʻi ʻae tangata ke poto, ʻikai te ne ʻiloʻi?

‌ʻOku ʻiloʻi ʻe Sihova ʻae ngaahi mahalo ʻae tangata,
ʻoku nau vaʻinga pē.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku ke tautea,
mo ke ako kiate ia ʻaki hoʻo fono;

Koeʻuhi te ke foaki kiate ia ʻae mālōlōmei he ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe mamahi,
kaeʻoua ke keli ʻae luo ki he kau angahala.

Koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai liʻaki ʻe Sihova hono kakai,
pea ʻe ʻikai te ne fakatukutukuʻi hono tofiʻa.

Ka ʻe foki ʻae fakamaau ki he māʻoniʻoni:
pea ʻe angimui ki ai ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku angatonu ʻi loto.

Ko hai ʻe tuʻu hake maʻaku ʻo taʻofi ʻae kau fai kovi?
Pe ko hai ʻe tuʻu hake maʻaku ʻo taʻofi ʻakinautoluʻoku ngāue ʻi he angahala?

Ka ne ʻikai tokoni au ʻe Sihova, pehē,
kuo vave ʻae nofo ʻa hoku laumālie ʻi he fakalongo pē.

‌ʻI heʻeku pehē, “ʻOku hekea hoku vaʻe;”
ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻE Sihova, naʻe poupou hake au.

‌ʻI hono lahi ʻo ʻeku ngaahi mahalo ʻiate au,
ʻoku fakafiefiaʻi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi meʻa fakafiemālie.

‌ʻE feohi koāmo koe ʻae nofoʻa ʻoe angahala,
ʻaia ʻoku fakatupu ʻae pauʻu ʻaki ʻae fono?

‌ʻOku nau fakataha ʻo angatuʻu ki he laumālie ʻoe angatonu,
mo fakahalaia ʻae toto tonuhia.
Ka ko hokuungakiʻi ʻa Sihova pea ko hoku ʻOtua ko e maka ia ʻo hoku hūfanga.
95:
HAʻU, ketau hiva kia Sihova:
ketau kalanga ʻi he fiefia ki he maka ʻo ʻetau moʻui.

Ketau haʻu ki hono ʻao mo e fakafetaʻi,
mo kalanga ʻi he fiefia kiate ia ʻaki ʻae ngaahi saame.

He ko Sihova ko e ʻOtua lahi,
pea ko e Tuʻi lahi hake ia ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku ʻi hono nima ʻae ngaahi potu māʻulaloʻo māmani:
ko e mālohi ʻoe ngaahi moʻunga ʻoku ʻoʻona foki.

‌ʻOku ʻoʻona ʻae tahi, he naʻa ne ngaohi ia:
pea naʻe ngaohi ʻe hono nima ʻae fonua mōmoa.

Haʻu, ketau lotu mo punou:
ketau tūʻulutui ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ko hotau tupuʻanga.

He ko hotau ʻOtua ia;
pea ko e kakai ʻakitautoluʻo ʻene ngoue,
mo e fanga sipi ʻa hono nima.
Ko e ʻaho ni, ʻo kapau te mou fanongo ki hono leʻo,

“ʻOua naʻa mou fakafefeka homou loto,
ʻo hangēko ia ʻi he fakahouhau lahi,
pea ʻi he ʻaho ʻoe ʻahiʻahi ʻi he toafa:

‌ʻAia naʻe ʻahiʻahiʻi au ʻe hoʻomou ngaahi tamai,
pea nau ʻahiʻahi kiate au,
ʻonau mamata ki heʻeku ngāue.

Naʻaku fehiʻa ki he toʻutangata ko ia ʻi he taʻu ʻe fāngofulu,
pea naʻaku pehē, ‘Ko e kakai eni ʻoku hēʻi honau loto,
pea ʻoku ʻikai te nau ʻilo hoku ngaahi hala:

Pea ne u fuakava kiate kinautoluʻi hoku houhau,
‘ʻE ʻikai tenau hūki hoku mālōlōʻanga.’|”
96:
HIVA kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae hiva foʻou:
hiva kia Sihova ʻa māmani kotoa pē.

Hiva kia Sihova, fakafetaʻi ki hono huafa;
fakahāatu ʻene fakamoʻui mei he ʻaho ki he ʻaho.

Fakahāhono nāunau ʻi he ʻao ʻoe hiteni,
mo ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he kakai kotoa pē.

He ʻoku lahi ʻa Sihova, pea totonu ke fakamālōlahi kiate ia:
ʻoku lelei ke manavahēlahi hake kiate ia ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.

He ko e ʻotua kotoa pēʻoe ngaahi puleʻanga ko e ngaahi tamapua ia:
ka ko Sihova naʻe ngaohi ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi langi.

‌ʻOku ʻi hono ʻao ʻae fakaʻapaʻapa mo e māfimafi:
ʻoku ʻi hono faletapu ʻae mālohi mo e nāunau.

Tuku kia Sihova, ʻakimoutoluʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe kakai,
tuku kia Sihova ʻae nāunau mo e māfimafi.

Tuku kia Sihova ʻae ongoongolelei ʻoku taau mo hono huafa:
ʻomi ʻae feilaulau, pea haʻu ki hono ngaahi lotoʻā.

Lotu kia Sihova ʻi he teunga matamatalelei ʻoe māʻoniʻoni:
mou manavahēʻi hono ʻao, ʻa māmani kotoa pē.

Mou pehēʻi he ʻao ʻoe hiteni ʻoku pule ʻa Sihova:
“ʻE fokotuʻumaʻu foki ʻa māmani,
pea ʻe ʻikai ngaueue ia:
te ne fakamaau ʻae kakai ʻi he māʻoniʻoni.”

Tuku ke fiefia ʻae ngaahi langi,
pea nekeneka mo māmani; tuku ke ʻuʻulu ʻae tahi,
mo hono fonu ʻo ia.

Ke fiefia ʻae ngoue,
mo e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ʻi ai:
pea ʻe toki fiefia ʻae ngaahi ʻakau kotoa pēʻoe vao,

‌ʻI he ʻao ʻo Sihova: he ʻoku ne hāʻele mai, he ʻoku hāʻele mai ia ke fakamaau ʻa māmani:
te ne fakamaau ʻa māmani ʻi he māʻoniʻoni, mo e kakai ʻi heʻene moʻoni.
97:
‌ʻOku takatakai ia ʻe he ngaahi ʻao mo e fakapoʻuli:
ko e angatonu mo e fakamaau ko e tuʻunga ia ʻo hono ʻafioʻanga.

‌ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻae afi ʻiate ia,
pea vela ke ʻosi hono ngaahi fili ʻoku takatakai.

Naʻe fakamaama ʻaki ʻa māmani ʻa hono ngaahi ʻuhila:
naʻe mamata ʻae fonua, pea tetetete.
Naʻe vela ʻo vai ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻo hangēko e pulu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻEiki ʻo māmani kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku fakahāʻe he ngaahi langi ʻene māʻoniʻoni,
pea mamata ʻae kakai kotoa pēki hono nāunau.

Ke puputuʻu ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku nau tauhi ʻae ngaahi fakatātākuo tā,
mo nau polepole ʻi he ngaahi tamapua:
lotu kiate ia, ʻakimoutolukotoa pēʻae ngaahi ʻotua.

Naʻe fanongo ʻa Saione,
pea fiefia ai pea naʻe fiefia ʻae ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Siuta,
koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau, ʻE Sihova.

He ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke māʻolunga hake ki māmani kotoa pē:
ʻoku ke māʻolunga lahi ʻaupitoʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.

Kuo tūtuuʻi ʻae maama maʻae māʻoniʻoni,
mo e fiefia maʻae angatonu ʻi loto.

Mou fiefia ʻia Sihova ʻae kau angatonu;
pea fakafetaʻi ʻi he manatu ki heʻene māʻoniʻoni.
98:
Kuo fakahāʻe Sihova ʻa ʻene fakamoʻui:
kuo ne fakahāatu ʻene māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻao ʻoe hiteni.

Kuo ne manatu ki heʻene ʻaloʻofa mo ʻene moʻoni ki he fale ʻo ʻIsileli:
kuo mamata ʻe he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani ki he fakamoʻui ʻa hotau ʻOtua.

Kalanga ʻi he fiefia kia Sihova, ʻa māmani kotoa pē:
kalanga ʻi he leʻo lahi, mo fiefia, pea hiva fakamālō.

Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae haʻape;
ʻaki ʻae haʻape, pea mo e leʻo ʻoe saame.

Mou kalanga fakafiefia ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻalea mo e leʻo ʻoe meʻalea,
ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ko e Tuʻi.

Tuku ke ʻuʻulu ʻae tahi, mo hono fonu ʻo ia;
ʻa māmani, mo kinautoluʻoku nofo ai.

Ke pasipasi ʻe he ngaahi vai ʻa honau nima:
tuku ke fiefia fakataha ʻae ngaahi moʻunga,

‌ʻI he ʻao ʻo Sihova;
he ʻoku hāʻele mai ia ke fakamaau ʻa māmani:
te ne fakamaau ʻa māmani ʻi he māʻoniʻoni,
pea mo e kakai ʻi he angatonu.
99:
‌ʻOku lahi ʻa Sihova ʻi Saione;
pea ʻoku māʻolunga lahi ia ʻi he kakai kotoa pē.

Tuku kenau fakamālōki ho huafa lahi mo fakailifia;
he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ia.

Mou fakahikihiki ʻa Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, pea lotu ʻi hono tuʻunga vaʻe;
he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ia.

Naʻa ne folofola kiate kinautoluʻi he pou ʻoe ʻao:
naʻa nau tauhi ʻene ngaahi fakamoʻoni,
mo e tuʻutuʻuni naʻa ne fokotuʻu kiate kinautolu.

‌ʻE Sihova ko homau ʻOtua, naʻa ke talia ʻakinautolu:
ko koe ko e ʻOtua naʻa ke fakamolemolea ʻakinautolu,
neongo hoʻo totongi koeʻuhi ko ʻenau ngaahi fakakaukau.

Fakahikihiki ʻa Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, pea lotu ʻi hono moʻunga tapu;
he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ʻa Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua.
100: MOU mavava ʻi he fiefia kia Sihova, ʻae ngaahi fonua kotoa pē.

Tauhi ʻa Sihova ʻi he fiefia:
haʻu mo e hiva ki hono ʻao.

Mou ʻilo ko Sihova ko ia pe ko e ʻOtua:
ko ia pe naʻa ne ngaohi ʻakitautolu,
ka naʻe ʻikai te tau ngaohi ʻakitautolu;
ko hono kakai ʻakitautolu,
mo e fanga sipi ʻo ʻene ngoue.

Hūʻi hono ngaahi matapāmo e fakafetaʻi,
pea ki hono ngaahi lotoʻāmo e fakamālō:
mou fakafetaʻi kiate ia, pea fakamālōki hono huafa.
101:
TE U hiva ʻaki ʻae ʻaloʻofa mo e fakamaau:
‌ʻE Sihova, te u hiva kiate koe.

Te u fai fakapotopoto ʻi he hala haohaoa.
Te ke hāʻele mai ʻafēkiate au?
Te u ʻeveʻeva ʻi hoku fale ʻi he loto haohaoa.

‌ʻE ʻalu ʻiate au ʻaia ʻoku loto kovi:
ʻE ʻikai te u ʻiloʻi ha taha ʻoku kovi.

Ko ia ʻoku fakakovi fakafufūhono kaungāʻapi, te u tuʻusi ia:
ko ia ʻoku fiematamuʻa mo loto laukau ʻe ʻikai te u kātakiʻi.

‌ʻE sio maʻu hoku mata ki he kakai angatonu ʻi he fonua,
koeʻuhi ke mau nonofo mo au:
ko ia ʻoku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he hala haohaoa,
ko ia ia ʻe tauhi au.

Ko ia ʻoku ne fai kākāʻe ʻikai nofo ia ʻi hoku fale:
ko ia ʻoku faʻa loi ʻe ʻikai te ne nofo ʻi hoku ʻao.

‌ʻE vave ʻeku fakaʻauha ʻae kau angahala kotoa pēʻoe fonua;
koeʻuhi ke u tuʻusi ʻae kakai fai kovi kotoa pēmei he kolo ʻa Sihova.
102:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, fanongo ki heʻeku lotu,
pea tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku tangi kiate koe.

He kuo fakaʻosi hoku ngaahi ʻaho ʻo hangēko e kohu,
pea kuo vela hoku ngaahi hui ʻo hangēko e veʻe tofunanga.

Kuo taaʻi hoku loto, pea kuo mae ʻo hangēko e mohuku;
ko ia kuo ngalo ai ʻiate au ke kai ʻeku mā.

Koeʻuhi ko e leʻo ʻo ʻeku toʻe,
ko ia ʻoku piki ai hoku ngaahi hui ki hoku kili.

‌ʻOku ou tatau mo e pelikani ʻoe toafa:
ʻoku ou hangēko e lulu ʻoe potu lala.
‌ʻOku ou leʻo, pea u tatau mo e kihiʻi manupunaʻoku tokotaha pēʻi he tuʻahivi ʻoe fale.

‌ʻOku manuki kiate au ʻa hoku ngaahi fili ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē;
pea ko kinautoluʻoku mata lili kiate au kuo nau fuakava ke angatuʻu kiate au.

He kuo u kai ʻae efuefu ʻo hangēko e mā,
mo huʻi ʻaki hoku inu ʻae loʻimata,

Koeʻuhi ko ho tuputāmaki mo ho houhau:
he kuo ke hiki hake au, pea līau ki lalo.

‌ʻOku tatau hoku ngaahi ʻaho mo e ʻata ʻoku mole atu;
pea kuo u mae ʻo hangēko e mohuku.

Ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, te ke tolonga ʻo taʻengata;
mo hoʻo fakaʻilonga ki he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.

Te ke tuʻu hake,
mo ke ʻaloʻofa ki Saione:
he ko e ʻaho ke tokoni ia,
ʻio, ko e ʻaho kuo tuʻutuʻuni kuo hoko mai.

He ʻoku fiemālie ʻa hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ʻi hono ngaahi maka,
pea ʻoku nau ʻofa ki hono efu ʻoʻona.

Ko ia ʻe manavahēai ʻae hiteni ki he huafa ʻo Sihova,
pea ko e ngaahi tuʻi kotoa pēʻo māmani ki ho nāunau.

‌ʻOka toe langa hake ʻe Sihova ʻa Saione,
ʻe fakahāia ʻi hono nāunau.

Te ne tokanga ki he lotu ʻae masiva,
pea ʻe ʻikai manukiʻi ʻenau hū.

‌ʻE tohi eni maʻae toʻutangata ʻe haʻu:
pea ko e kakai ʻe fakatupu te nau fakamālōkia Sihova.

He kuo ʻafio hifo ia mei he māʻolunga ʻo hono faletapu;
naʻe ʻafio ʻa Sihova mei he langi ki māmani;

Ke ne fanongo ki he toʻe ʻoe pōpula;
ke vete ʻakinautolukuo tuʻutuʻuni ke mate;

Ke fakahāʻae huafa ʻo Sihova ʻi Saione,
mo ʻene fakamālōʻi Selūsalema;

‌ʻOka fakataha ʻae kakai,
pea mo e ngaahi puleʻanga, ke tauhi ʻa Sihova.

Naʻa ne fakavaivaiʻi hoku mālohi ʻi he hala;
naʻa ne fakanounou hoku ngaahi ʻaho.

Naʻaku pehē, ʻE hoku ʻOtua, ʻoua naʻa ʻave au ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo hoku ngaahi ʻaho:
ko ho ngaahi taʻu ʻoku tolonga ki he toʻutangata kotoa pē.

Naʻa ke ʻai ʻi he kamataʻanga ʻae tuʻunga ʻo māmani;
pea koe ngaahi langi koe ngaue ia ʻa ho nima.

‌ʻE ʻauha ia, ka ʻe pehēai pe ʻa koe,
ʻio, ʻe fakaʻaʻau kotoa pēia ke motuʻa ʻo hangēko e kofu;
pea hangēko e pulupulute ke fatufatuia,
pea ʻe fakakehe ia:

Ka ʻe pehēai pe ʻa koe,
pea ʻe ʻikai hano ngataʻanga ʻo ho ngaahi taʻu.

‌ʻE tolonga ʻae fānau ʻa hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki,
pea ʻe fokotuʻumaʻu honau hako ʻi ho ʻao.
103:
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova ʻa hoku laumālie:
pea mo ia kotoa pēʻoku ʻiate au,
fakafetaʻi ki hono huafa māʻoniʻoni.

Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie,
pea ʻoua naʻa ngalo ʻa ʻene ngaahi meʻaʻofa kotoa pē:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fakamolemole hoʻo ngaahi hia kotoa pē;
mo ne fakamoʻui ho ngaahi mahaki kotoa pē;

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne huhuʻi hoʻo moʻui mei he fakaʻauha;
ʻo ne tatāʻaki koe ʻae manavaʻofa mo e ʻaloʻofa ongongofua;

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fakamākona ʻaki ho ngutu ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei;
ko ia kuo toe tupulakiai ho talavou ʻo hangēko e ʻikale.
‌ʻOku fai ʻe Sihova ʻae māʻoniʻoni mo e fakamaau kiate kinautolukotoa pēkuo fakamālohia.

Naʻa ne fakahāhono ngaahi hala kia Mōsese,
mo ʻene ngaahi ngāue ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.

‌ʻOku manavaʻofa mo angalelei ʻa Sihova, ʻoku faʻa kātaki,
pea mohu ʻaloʻofa.

‌ʻE ʻikai te ne valoki maʻuaipē:
pea ʻe ʻikai tuputāmaki ʻo taʻengata.

Naʻe ʻikai fai ʻe ia kiate kitautoluʻo fakatatau mo ʻetau ngaahi angahala;
pe totongi kiate kitautoluʻo fakatatau mo ʻetau ngaahi hia.

Kae hangēko hono māʻolunga ʻoe langi ki māmani,
ʻoku pehēhono lahi ʻo ʻene ʻaloʻofa kiate kinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkiate ia.

‌ʻOku hangēko hono vāmamaʻo ʻoe potu hahake mei he potu lulunga,
ʻoku pehēhono mamaʻo ʻo ʻene ʻave ʻetau ngaahi angahala ʻiate kitautolu.

Pea hangēʻoku manavaʻofa ʻae tamai ki heʻene fānau,
ʻoku pehēʻae manavaʻofa ʻa Sihova kiate kinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkiate ia.

He ʻoku ne ʻiloʻi hotau anga;
ʻoku ne manatu ko e efu pe ʻakitautolu.

Pea ko e tangata, ʻoku tatau hono ngaahi ʻaho mo e mohuku:
pea hangēko e fisiʻi ʻakau ʻoe ngoue hono lau maʻuiʻui.

He ʻoku ʻalu atu ki ai ʻae matangi, pea kuo ʻikai ia;
pea ʻe ʻikai siʻi toe ʻilo ia ʻi hono potu.

Ka ko e ʻaloʻofa ʻa Sihova ʻoku talu mei muʻa ʻo aʻu ʻo taʻengata kiate kinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkiate ia,
pea ko ʻene māʻoniʻoni ki he fānau ʻae fānau;

Kiate kinautoluʻoku nau tauhi ʻene fuakava,
