pea mo kinautoluʻoku nau manatu ki heʻene ngaahi fekau ke fai ki ai.

Kuo teuteu ʻe Sihova hono ʻafioʻanga ʻi he ngaahi langi;
pea ʻoku pule hono puleʻanga ki he meʻa kotoa pē.

Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova ʻakimoutoluko ʻene kau ʻāngelo,
ʻoku lahi homou mālohi,
pea ʻoku mou fai ʻene ngaahi fekau,
ʻo fakafanongo ki he leʻo ʻo ʻene folofola.

Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa ʻene ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē
ʻi he potu kotoa pēʻo hono puleʻanga:
fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie.
104:
‌ʻOku ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki koe ʻae maama ʻo hangēko e kofu:
ʻoku ke fofola atu ʻae ngaahi langi ʻo hangēko e puipui:

‌ʻOku ne ʻai ʻae ngaahiutupotoʻo hono ngaahi fale ʻi he ngaahi vai:
pea ko ʻene saliote ʻae ngaahi ʻao:
pea ʻoku hāʻele ia ʻi he ngaahi kapakau ʻoe matangi:

‌ʻOku ne ngaohi ʻene kau ʻāngelo ke hangēko e matangi;
mo ʻene kau faifekau ko e afi ʻoku ulo:

Naʻa ne ʻai ʻae ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo māmani,
ke ʻoua naʻa ueʻi ia ʻo lauikuonga.

‌ʻOku ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae loloto ʻo hangēko e kofu:
naʻe tuʻu ʻae ngaahi vai ʻo māʻolunga hake ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga.

‌ʻI hoʻo valoki naʻa nau puna;
ʻi he leʻo ʻo hoʻo fatulisinaʻa nau hola ai.

‌ʻOku nau ʻalu hake ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga,
pea nau ʻalu hifo ʻi he ngaahi vahaʻa moʻunga,
ki he potu kuo ke teuteu ki ai.

Kuo ke ʻai hono ngataʻanga ke ʻoua naʻa ʻalu atu ia ʻi ai;
koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa toe haʻu ia ke lōfia ʻa māmani.

‌ʻOku ne fekau atu ʻae ngaahi matavai ʻi he ngaahi luo,
ʻaia ʻoku tafe ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi foʻi moʻunga.

‌ʻOku inu mei ai ʻae fanga manu kotoa pēʻoe vao:
pea ʻoku inu ʻo fiu ai ʻae fanga ʻasi hehengi.

‌ʻOku maʻu ʻi ai ʻe he manupunaʻoe ʻatāhonau nofoʻanga,
ʻoku nau hiva ʻi he ngaahi vaʻa.

‌ʻOku ne fakaviviku ʻae ngaahi foʻi moʻunga mei hono fale ʻafioʻanga:
ʻoku mākona ʻae kelekele ʻi he fua ʻo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue.

Mo euaineʻaia ʻoku fakafiefiaʻi ʻae loto ʻoe tangata,
mo e lolo ke fakangingila hono mata,
mo e māke fakamālohi ʻae loto ʻoe tangata.

‌ʻOku fonu ʻi he huhuʻa ʻae ngaahi ʻakau ʻo Sihova;
ko e ngaahi sita ʻo Lepanoni, ʻaia kuo ne tō;

‌ʻOku ngaohi ʻi ai ʻe he fanga manupunahonau pununga:
pea ko e sitoaka,
ko hono fale ko e ngaahi ʻakau ko e paini.

Ko e ngaahi foʻi moʻunga māʻolunga ko e hūfanga ia ʻoe fanga kosi hehengi;
pea mo e ngaahi maka ki he fanga koni.

Naʻa ne tuʻutuʻuni ʻae māhina ki he ngaahi faʻahitaʻu:
ʻoku ʻiloʻi ʻe he laʻāhono tōʻanga.

‌ʻOku ke ngaohi ʻae poʻuli, pea ko e pōia:
pea ʻoku totolo atu ʻi ai ʻae fanga manu kotoa pēʻoe vao.

‌ʻOku ngungulu ʻae fanga laione mui ke maʻu ʻenau meʻa,
pea nau kumi ʻenau meʻakai mei he ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku hopo hake ʻae laʻā, pea ʻoku nau fakataha ai,
ʻonau tokoto ʻi honau ngaahi ʻana.

‌ʻOku ʻalu atu ʻae tangata ki heʻene ngāue,
mo ʻene ngoue ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.

‌ʻE Sihova, hono ʻikai lahi ʻa hoʻo ngaahi ngāue!
Kuo ke ngaohi kotoa pēia ʻi he poto:
ʻoku fonu ʻa māmani ʻi hoʻo koloa.
Pea ʻoku pehēʻae tahi lahi ni mo laulahi, ʻa ia ʻoku ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa totolo taʻefaʻalaua, ʻae fanga ika iiki mo e lalahi.

‌ʻOku ʻalu ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi vaka:
ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae levaiatani ko ia, ʻaia kuo ke ngaohi ke ne fakavāai.

‌ʻOku tatali ʻakinautoluni kotoa pēkiate koe:
koeʻuhi ke ke foaki kiate kinautoluʻenau meʻakai ʻi he feituʻulaʻātotonu.

Ko ia ʻoku ke foaki kiate kinautoluʻoku nau tānaki:
ʻoku ke mafola ho nima, pea ʻoku pito ʻakinautoluʻi he lelei.

‌ʻOku ke fufūho fofonga, pea nau mamahi ai:
ʻoku ke toʻo atu ʻenau mānava, pea nau mate, pea foki ki honau efu.

‌ʻOku ke fekau atu ho Laumālie, pea ʻoku fakatupu ai ʻakinautolu:
pea ʻoku ke fakafoʻou ʻae funga ʻo māmani.

‌ʻE tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻae nāunau ʻo Sihova:
ʻe fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻi heʻene ngaahi ngāue.

‌ʻOku ʻafio ia ki māmani, pea tetetete ia:
ʻoku ala ia ki he ngaahi foʻi moʻunga,
pea ʻoku nau kohu ai.

Te u hiva kia Sihova ʻi heʻeku kei moʻui:
te u hiva fakamālōki hoku ʻOtua ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻeku moʻui.

‌ʻE melie ʻa ʻeku fakakaukau kiate ia:
te u fiefia ʻia Sihova.

Tuku ke ʻosiʻosingamālie ʻae kakai angahala mei māmani,
pea ʻoua naʻa kei toe ʻae kau angakovi.
Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻa hoku laumālie.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
105:
MOU ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova; ui ki hono huafa:
fakahāʻene ngaahi ngāue ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai.

Hiva kiate ia, hiva ʻaki ʻae ngaahi saame kiate ia:
mou talanoa ʻaki ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo kotoa pē.

Mou vikiviki ʻi hono huafa māʻoniʻoni:
tuku ke fiefia ʻae loto ʻokinautoluʻoku nau kumi kia Sihova.

Kumi kia Sihova, mo hono mālohi:
kumi maʻuaipēki hono fofonga.

Manatu ki heʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻaia kuo ne fai;
ʻa ʻene ngaahi mana, mo e ngaahi fakamaau ʻa hono fofonga;

‌ʻAkimoutoluʻae hako ʻo ʻEpalahame ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki,
ʻakimoutoluʻae fānau ʻa Sēkope ʻaia kuo ne fili.

Ko ia, ko Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua,
ʻoku ʻi māmani kotoa pēʻa ʻene ngaahi fakamaau.

Kuo manatu ʻe ia ki heʻene fuakava ʻo lauikuonga,
ko e folofola ʻaia naʻa ne fekau ki he toʻutangata ʻe taha afe.

‌ʻA e fuakava ʻaia naʻa ne fai mo ʻEpalahame,
pea mo ʻene fuakava kia ʻAisake;

Pea ne fokotuʻumaʻu ia kia Sēkope ko e fono,
pea kia ʻIsileli ko e fuakava taʻengata:

‌ʻO ne pehē, “Te u foaki kiate koe ʻae fonua ko Kēnani,
ko e fuofuaʻo homou tofiʻa:”

‌ʻI he lolotonga naʻe tokosiʻi pe honau kau tangata;
ʻio, ko e tokosiʻi ʻaupito, mo e kau muli ʻi ai.

Lolotonga ʻa ʻenau ʻalu mei he faʻahinga ʻe taha ki ha faʻahinga kehe,
pea mei he puleʻanga ʻe taha ki he kakai kehe;

Naʻe ʻikai tuku ʻe ia ke fai kovi ʻe ha tangata ʻe taha kiate kinautolu:
ʻio, naʻa ne valoki ʻae ngaahi tuʻi koeʻuhi ko kinautolu;

“ʻO ne pehē, ʻoua naʻa ala kiate ia kuo u pani,
pea ʻoua naʻa fai kovi ki heʻeku kau palōfita.”

Pea naʻa ne ui foki ke hoko ʻae honge ki he fonua:
naʻa ne fesiʻi ʻae tokotoko kotoa pēʻoe mā,

Naʻa ne fekau ʻae tangata ke muʻomuʻa ʻiate kinautolu,
ʻio, ko Siosefa ʻaia naʻe fakatau ke tamaioʻeiki:

Pea naʻa nau fakamamahiʻi hono vaʻe ʻaki ʻae ngaahi haʻi:
naʻe tuia ia ʻe heukamea:

‌ʻO aʻu ki he ʻaho naʻe hoko ai ʻene lea:
naʻe ʻahiʻahiʻi ia ʻe he folofola ʻa Sihova.

Naʻe fekau ʻe he tuʻi ke vete ia;
ʻio, ʻe he pule ʻoe kakai, pea naʻa ne tukuangeia ke tauʻatāina pe.

Naʻa ne fakanofo ia ko e ʻeiki ʻo hono fale,
mo e pule ʻo ʻene koloa kotoa pē:

Ke haʻisia hono ngaahi ʻeiki ko ʻene faʻiteliha;
mo akonakiʻi ʻa ʻene kau mātuʻa ʻi he poto.
Naʻe haʻu foki ʻa ʻIsileli ki ʻIsipite pea naʻe ʻāunofoʻa Sēkope ʻi he fonua ʻo Hami.

Pea naʻa ne fakatupu ʻo tokolahi ʻaupitoʻa hono kakai;
pea ne ngaohi ʻakinautolukenau mālohi hake ʻi honau ngaahi fili.

Naʻa ne liliu honau loto kenau fehiʻa ki hono kakai,
kenau fai kākāki heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.

Naʻa ne fekau atu ʻa Mōsese ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki;
mo ʻElone ʻaia naʻa ne fili.

Naʻa ne fakahāhono ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻiate kinautolu,
mo e ngaahi meʻa mana ʻi he fonua ʻo Hami.

Naʻe fekau ʻe ia ki he fakapoʻuli, pea ngaohi ia ko e poʻuli;
pea naʻe ʻikai angatuʻu ʻakinautoluki heʻene folofola.

Naʻa ne liliu honau ngaahi vai ko e toto,
mo tāmateʻi ʻenau ika.

Naʻe tupu ʻi honau fonua ʻae fanga poto ʻo lahi ʻaupito,
ʻi he ngaahi loki ʻo honau ngaahi tuʻi.

Naʻe folofola ia, pea naʻe haʻu ʻae ngaahi lango kehekehe,
mo e fanga kutu ʻi honau fonua.

Naʻa ne ʻomi ʻae ʻuha maka kiate kinautoluko e fetongi ʻoe ʻuha,
mo e afi ʻoku ulo ʻi honau fonua.

Naʻa ne taaʻi foki ʻenau ngaahi vaine, mo ʻenau ngaahi ʻakau ko e fiki;
pea fesiʻi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau ʻo honau fonua.

Naʻa ne folofola, pea naʻe haʻu ai ʻae fanga heʻe,
mo e ngaahi ʻunufeʻoku taʻefaʻalaua.

Pea naʻa nau kai ke ʻosi ʻae ngaahi ʻakau kotoa pēʻi honau fonua,
pea nau fakaʻauha ʻae fua ʻo ʻenau ngoue.

Naʻa ne taaʻi foki ʻae ʻuluaki fānau kotoa pēʻi honau fonua,
ko e fungani ʻo ʻenau mālohi kotoa pē.

Naʻa ne ʻomi foki ʻakinautolumo e siliva mo e koula:
pea naʻe ʻikai ai ha tokotaha naʻe vaivai ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga.
Naʻe fiefia ʻa ʻIsipite ʻi heʻenau ʻalu hēnaʻe tōkiate kinautoluʻae manavahēkoeʻuhi ko kinautolu.
Naʻa ne fofola ʻae ʻao ko e fakamalu pea mo e afi ke fakamaama ʻi he pō.

Naʻe kole ʻe he kakai, pea naʻa ne ʻomi ʻae fanga manupuna,
mo ne fakamākona ʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae māʻoe langi.

He naʻa ne manatu ki heʻene talaʻofa māʻoniʻoni,
mo ʻEpalahame ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki.

Pea ne ʻomi hono kakai ʻi he fiefia,
mo kinautolukuo ne fili ʻi he nekeneka:
Pea ne foaki kiate kinautoluʻae ngaahi fonua ʻoe hiteni, pea naʻa nau maʻu ʻae ngāue ʻae kakai

Koeʻuhi kenau tokanga ki heʻene ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni,
mo tauhi ʻene ngaahi fekau.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
106:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova; he ʻoku angalelei ia:
koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Ko hai ʻe faʻa fakamatala ki he ngaahi ngāue lahi ʻa Sihova?
Ko hai ʻe faʻa fakahāʻae fakamālōkotoa pēkiate ia?

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautoluʻoku tokanga ki he fakamaau,
mo ia ʻoku fai māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke manatuʻi au ʻaki ʻae ʻofa ʻaia ʻoku ke ʻofa ʻaki ki hoʻo kakai: ke ke ʻaʻahi mai kiate au ʻaki hoʻo fakamoʻui;

Koeʻuhi ke u mamata ki he lelei ʻo ia kuo ke fili,
koeʻuhi ke u fiefia ʻi he fiefia ʻo ho puleʻanga,
pea u vikiviki ai fakataha mo ho tofiʻa.

Ko kimautolumo ʻemau ngaahi tamai kuo mau fai angahala,
kuo mau fai ʻae ngaahi hia,
kuo mau fai kovi.

Ka naʻa ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolukoeʻuhi ko hono huafa,
koeʻuhi ke ne fakaʻilo ʻa hono mālohi lahi.

Naʻe valoki foki ʻe ia ʻae Tahi Kulokula, pea mōmoa ia:
ko ia naʻa ne tataki ʻakinautoluʻi he loloto, ʻo hangēko e toafa.

Pea naʻa ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolumei he nima ʻo ia naʻe fehiʻa kiate kinautolu,
mo ne huhuʻi ʻakinautolumei he nima ʻoe fili.

Pea naʻe lōmakiʻi honau ngaahi fili ʻaki ʻae ngaahi vai:
pea naʻe ʻikai hao ha tokotaha ʻiate kinautolu.

Pea naʻa nau toki tui ki heʻene folofola;
naʻa nau hiva ʻaki ʻae fakamālōkiate ia.

Naʻe ngalo leva ʻiate kinautoluʻene ngaahi ngāue;
pea naʻe ʻikai tenau tatali ki heʻene akonaki:

Ka naʻa nau holi kovi ʻaupitoʻi he toafa,
pea ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻae ʻOtua ʻi he potu lala.

Pea naʻa ne foaki kiate kinautoluʻaia naʻa nau kole;
ka naʻa ne fekau ʻae tutue ki honau laumālie.

Naʻa nau meheka foki kia Mōsese ʻi he loto ʻapitanga,
mo ʻElone ko e tokotaha māʻoniʻoni ʻa Sihova.

Naʻe mafahi ʻae kelekele pea folo hifo ai ʻa Tatani,
mo ʻufiʻufi ai ʻae kakai ʻo ʻEpilami.

Pea naʻe tutu ai ʻae afi ʻi honau kakai;
pea vela ke ʻosi ʻe he ulo afi ʻae kau angahala.

Naʻa nau ngaohi ʻae fakatātāʻoe ʻuhikiʻi pulu ʻi Holepi,
pea lotu ki he fakatātākoula.

Naʻe pehēʻenau liliu honau nāunau,
ki he fakatātāʻoe pulu ʻaia ʻoku kai mohuku.

Naʻa nau fakangalongaloʻi ʻae ʻOtua ko honau fakamoʻui,
ʻaia naʻe fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi ʻi ʻIsipite;

Ko e ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ʻi he fonua ʻo Hami,
mo e ngaahi meʻa fakailifia ʻi he Tahi Kulokula.

Ko ia naʻa ne pehēte ne fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu,
ka ne ʻikai tuʻu ʻi hono ʻao ʻi he vahaʻa ʻa Mōsese ʻaia kuo ne fili,
ke fakatafoki hono houhau,
telia naʻa fakaʻauha ʻe ia ʻakinautolu.

‌ʻIo, naʻa nau fehiʻa ki he fonua lelei,
naʻe ʻikai tenau tui ki heʻene folofola:

Ka naʻa nau lāunga ʻi honau ngaahi fale fehikitaki,
ʻo taʻetokanga ki he leʻo ʻo Sihova.

Ko ia naʻa ne hiki hake ai hono nima kiate kinautolu,
ke tulakiʻakinautoluʻi he toafa:

Ke tulakifoki honau hako ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi puleʻanga,
mo fakahēʻi ʻakinautoluʻi he ngaahi fonua.

Naʻa nau ului foki kia Peali-Peoli,
mo nau kai ʻae ngaahi feilaulau ʻoe mate.

Ko ia naʻa nau fakahouhauʻi ia ʻaki ʻenau ngaahi filioʻi:
pea naʻe ʻoho mai ʻae mahaki fakaʻauha kiate kinautolu.

Pea naʻe toki tuʻu hake ʻa Finiasi, ʻo fai ʻae fakamaau:
pea naʻe lolomi ai ʻae mahaki fakaʻauha.
Pea naʻe lau ia kiate ia ko e māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pēʻo lauikuonga.

Naʻa nau fakahouhau kiate ia foki ʻi he ngaahi vai ʻoe fekeʻikeʻi,
pea hoko ʻae kovi kia Mōsese koeʻuhi ko kinautolu:

Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau fakatupu hono loto,
ko ia naʻa ne lea ʻaki ʻae lea taʻengali ʻe hono loungutu.

Naʻe ʻikai tenau fakaʻauha ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga,
ʻaia naʻe fekau ʻe Sihova kiate kinautolu:

Ka naʻa nau nofo fakataha mo e hiteni,
pea nau ʻilo ʻenau ngaahi ngāue.

Pea naʻa nau tauhi honau ngaahi tamapua:
ʻaia naʻe hoko ko e tauhelekiate kinautolu.
‌ʻIo, naʻa nau feilaulau ʻaki honau ngaahi foha mo honau ngaahi ʻofefine ki he kau tēvolo,

Mo lilingi ʻae toto māʻoniʻoni,
ko e toto ʻo honau ngaahi foha mo honau ngaahi ʻofefine,
ʻakinautolunaʻa nau feilaulau ʻaki ki he ngaahi tamapua ʻo ʻi he toto.

Pea naʻe fakaʻuliʻi pehēʻakinautoluʻi heʻenau ngaahi ngāue,
pea nau fai feʻauaki ʻi heʻenau ngaahi filioʻi.

Ko ia naʻe tupu ai ʻae houhau ʻo Sihova ki hono kakai,
pea ne fākaliliʻa ai ki hono tofiʻa ʻoʻona.

Pea naʻa ne tukuangeʻakinautoluki he nima ʻoe hiteni;
pea naʻe pule kiate kinautoluʻakinautolunaʻe fehiʻa kiate kinautolu.

Pea naʻe fakamālohiʻi ʻakinautoluʻe honau ngaahi fili,
pea fakamoʻulaloa ʻakinautoluki honau lalo nima.

Ka naʻa ne tokanga ki heʻenau mamahi,
ʻi heʻene ongoʻi ʻenau tangi:

Pea ne manatuʻi ʻa ʻene fuakava mo kinautolu,
pea ne fakatomala ʻo fakatatau mo hono lahi ʻo ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

naʻa ne pule foki ke manavaʻofa kiate kinautolu
ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ʻave pōpula ʻakinautolu.

Fakamoʻui ʻakimautolu, ʻE Sihova ko homau ʻOtua,
pea tānaki ʻakimautolumei he lotolotonga ʻoe hiteni,
ke mau fakafetaʻi ki ho huafa māʻoniʻoni,
pea hanuhanuʻi he fakamālōkiate koe.
107:
“MOU ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, he ʻoku angalelei ia:
koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.”
Ke lea pehēʻe he kakai kuo huhuʻi ʻe Sihova, ʻakinautolukuo ne huhuʻi mei he nima ʻoe fili;

Pea tānaki ʻakinautolumei he ngaahi fonua,
mei he potu hahake, pea mei he potu lulunga,
mei he potu tokelau, pea mei he feituʻu tonga.
Naʻa nau ʻalu fano pēʻi he toafa ʻi he hala liʻaki; naʻe ʻikai tenau ʻilo ha kolo ke nofo ai.

Pea ʻi he fiekaia mo e fieinua,
naʻe pongia ai honau laumālie ʻiate kinautolu.

Pea naʻa nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki,
pea ne ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolumei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.

Pea naʻa ne tataki atu ʻakinautoluʻi he hala totonu,
koeʻuhi kenau hoko ki he kolo naʻe kakai.

Taumaiāke fakamālōʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa,
pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!

He ʻoku ne fakamākona ʻae laumālie ʻoku holi,
mo ne fakapito ʻaki ʻae lelei ʻae laumālie ʻoku fiekaia.

Ko kinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi he fakapoʻuli pea mo e ʻata ʻae mate,
kuo haʻi ʻaki ʻae mamahi mo eukamea;

Koeʻuhi naʻa nau angatuʻu ki he ngaahi folofola ʻae ʻOtua,
mo nau fehiʻa ki he akonaki ʻae fungani Māʻolunga:

Ko ia naʻa ne fakavaivaiʻi honau loto ʻi he ngāue;
naʻa nau tōki lalo, pea naʻe ʻikai ha taha ke tokoni.

Pea naʻa nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki,
pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolumei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.

Naʻa ne ʻomi ʻakinautolumei he fakapoʻuli mo e ʻata ʻoe mate,
ʻo ne motuhi honau ngaahi haʻi.

Taumaiāke fakamālōʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa,
pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!

He kuo ne maumauʻi ʻae ngaahi matapāpalasa,
pea ne tutuʻu ʻae ngaahiukamea fakamaʻu.

‌ʻOku mamahi ʻae kau vale koeʻuhi ko ʻenau talangataʻa,
pea mo ʻenau ngaahi hia.

‌ʻOku fehiʻa honau laumālie ki he meʻakai kotoa pē;
pea ʻoku nau fakaʻaʻau ki he ngaahi matapāʻoe mate.

Pea ʻoku nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki,
pea ʻoku ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolumei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.

Naʻa ne fekau ʻene folofola, pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu,
mo ne fakahaofi ʻakinautolumei heʻenau ngaahi meʻa fakaʻauha.

Taumaiāke fakamālōʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa,
pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!

Pea tuku kenau feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi feilaulau ʻoe fakafetaʻi,
mo fakahāʻene ngaahi ngāue ʻi he fiefia.

Ko kinautoluʻoku ʻalu hifo ki he tahi ʻi he ngaahi vaka,
mo fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he ngaahi vai lahi;

‌ʻOku nau mamata ki he ngaahi ngāue ʻa Sihova,
mo ʻene ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi he moana.

He ʻoku fekau ʻe ia, pea ʻoku fakatupu ʻae matangi mālohi,
ʻaia ʻoku tupu hake ai hono ngaahi peau.

‌ʻOku nau ʻalu hake ki he langi, ʻoku nau toe ʻalu hifo ki he ngaahi loloto:
kuo vela ʻo vai honau laumālie koeʻuhi ko e mamahi.

‌ʻOku nau tasipa, pea luelueʻo hangēko e tangata konā,
pea kuo mole honau poto kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku nau toki tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻenau tuʻutāmaki,
pea ʻoku ne ʻomi ʻakinautolumei heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.

‌ʻOku ne ngaohi ʻae afāke tofukī,
ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ngaue ai hono peau.

Pea ʻoku nau toki fiefia koeʻuhi ʻoku nau fiemālie ai;
pea ʻoku ne ʻomi ʻakinautoluki he taulanga kuo nau holi ki ai.

Taumaiāke fakamālōʻae kakai kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻaloʻofa,
pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ki he fānau ʻae tangata!
Tuku kenau fakahikihiki ʻa ʻene ʻafio ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kakai, mo fakamālō

‌ʻOku liliu ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi vaitafe ko e toafa,
mo e ngaahi matavai ko e kelekele mōmoa;

Mo e fonua mahu ko e hongea,
koeʻuhi ko e angakovi ʻae kakai ʻoku nofo ai.

‌ʻOku ne liliu ʻae toafa ko e ano vai,
mo e fonua mōmoa ko e ngaahi matavai.

Pea ʻoku ne pule ke nofo ai ʻae fiekaia,
koeʻuhi kenau teuteu ʻae kolo ke nofo ai;

Mo tūtuuʻi ʻae ngaahi ngoue,
pea tōʻae ngaahi ngoue vaine,
ʻaia ʻoku faʻa ʻomi ʻae ngaahi fua kuo tupu.

‌ʻOku ne fakamonūʻia foki ʻakinautolu, ko ia kuo nau tupu ʻo tokolahi ʻaupito;
pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne tuku ke fakaʻaʻau ke siʻi ʻenau fanga manu.

Pea ʻoku toe fakaʻaʻau ke tokosiʻi mo vaivai ʻakinautolu
ʻi he fakamālohi, mo e mahaki, mo e mamahi.

‌ʻOku ne lilingi ʻae manuki ki he ngaahi ʻeiki,
pea ʻoku ne pule kenau ʻalu fano ʻi he toafa, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ha hala ʻi ai.

Ka ʻoku ne hiki hake ʻae masiva mei he mamahi,
pea ʻoku ne ngaohi maʻana ʻae ngaahi kāinga ʻo hangēko e fanga sipi.

‌ʻE mamata ki ai ʻae angatonu, pea fiefia;
pea ʻe tāpuni ʻe he angahala kotoa pēhono ngutu.

Ko hai ʻoku poto, pea tokanga ki he ngaahi meʻa ni,
tenau ʻiloʻi ʻae ʻaloʻofa ongongofua ʻa Sihova.
108:
‌ʻE ʻOTUA, kuo maʻu hoku loto;
te u hiva mo ʻatu ʻae fakamālōʻaki hoku nāunau.

Ke ʻāhake ʻae saliteli mo e haʻape:
te u ʻa hengihengi hake pe au.

‌ʻE Sihova, te u fakamālōkiate koe ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai:
pea te u hiva fakamālōkiate koe ʻi he ngaahi puleʻanga.

He ʻoku lahi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ʻo māʻolunga hake ʻi he ngaahi langi:
mo hoʻo moʻoni ʻoku aʻu atu ki he ngaahi ʻao.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ke māʻolunga lahi hake koe ʻi he ngaahi langi:
pea ke māʻolunga hake ho nāunau ʻi māmani kotoa pē;

Koeʻuhi ke hao ʻaia ʻoku ke ʻofa ai ke ke fakamoʻui
ʻaki ho nima toʻomataʻu, ʻo talia au.

Kuo folofola ʻae ʻOtua ʻi heʻene māʻoniʻoni; te u fiefia,
“Te u vaeua ʻa Sikemi, ʻo fuofuaʻae luo ʻo Sukote.

Ko hai te ne ʻomi au ki he kolo mālohi?
Ko hai te ne aʻutakiau ki ʻItomi?

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻe ʻikai, te ke fai ia, ʻa koe kuo ke liʻaki ʻakimautolu?
Pea ʻikai te ke ʻalu atu, ʻE ʻOtua, mo ʻemau ngaahi kautau?

Ke ke tuku kiate kimautoluʻae tokoni ʻi he mamahi:
he ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae tokoni ʻae tangata.

Ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻOtua te tau fai mālohi ai:
he ko ia ia te ne malaki hifo hotau ngaahi fili.
109: ‌ʻE ʻOTUA ʻo ʻeku fakamālō, ʻoua naʻa ke fakalongo pē;

He kuo mafaʻa ʻae ngutu ʻoe angahala mo e ngutu ʻoe kākākiate au:
kuo nau lea kovi kiate au ʻaki ʻae ʻelelo loi.

Naʻa nau kāpui foki au ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea ʻoe taufehiʻa;
mo nau tauʻi au taʻehanoʻuhinga.

Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku ʻofa kuo hoko ʻakinautoluko hoku ngaahi fili:
ka te u hangahanga lotu pe au.

Pea kuo nau totongi ʻaki kiate au ʻae kovi ki he lelei,
mo e fehiʻa ki heʻeku ʻofa.

Ke ke fakanofo ʻae tangata angakovi ke pule kiate ia:
pea tuku ke tuʻu ʻa Sētane ʻi hono nima toʻomataʻu.

‌ʻOka fakamaau ia,
tuku ke halaia ia pea tuku ke hoko ʻene lotu ko e angahala.

Tuku ke siʻi pēhono ngaahi ʻaho;
pea ke maʻu ʻe ha taha kehe ʻene ngāue.

Tuku ke tamai mate ʻene fānau,
pea hoko ʻa hono ʻunohoko e fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho.

Tuku ke ne maʻuaipēʻene fānau, mo kole:
pea tuku kenau kumi foki ʻenau māmei honau ngaahi potu ʻoku lala.

Tuku ke maʻu ʻe he fakamālohi ʻae meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ʻaʻana;
pea maumauʻi ʻe he kau muli ʻene ngāue.

‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ha taha ke manavaʻofa kiate ia:
pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ha taha ke ʻofa ki heʻene fānau ʻoku tamai mate.

Tuku ke tuʻusi hono hako;
pea ʻi he toʻutangata ʻe haʻu tuku ke tāmateʻi honau hingoa.

Ke manatuʻi ʻe Sihova ʻae hia ʻa ʻene ngaahi tamai;
pea ʻoua naʻa tāmateʻi ʻae angahala ʻa ʻene faʻē.
Tuku maʻuaipēia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, koeʻuhi ke ne tuʻusi honau fakamanatuʻi mei māmani.

Koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai manatuʻi ʻe ia ke fakahāʻae ʻofa,
ka naʻa ne fakatanga ʻae tangata masiva mo paea,
koeʻuhi ke ne tāmateʻi ʻaia ʻoku mafesi hono loto.

Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene ʻofa ki he kapekape, ko ia ke hoko ia kiate ia:
ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene taʻefiefia ʻi he tāpuaki, ko ia ke mamaʻo ia ʻiate ia.

Ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene fakakofuʻaki ia ʻae kape ʻo hangēko e kofu,
ko ia ke hoko ia ki hono kete ʻo hangēko e vai,
pea hangēko e lolo ki hono ngaahi hui.

Ke tatau ia kiate ia mo e kofu ʻaia ʻoku ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia,
pea mo e noʻo ʻaia ʻoku nonoʻo ʻaki maʻuaipēia.
Tuku eni ko e totongi ki hoku ngaahi fili meia Sihova, pea kiate kinautoluʻoku nau lea ʻaki ʻae kovi ki hoku laumālie.

Ka ke fai ʻe koe maʻaku, ʻE Sihova ko e ʻEiki,
koeʻuhi ko ho huafa: koeʻuhi ʻoku lelei hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ke ke fakamoʻui au.

He ʻoku ou masiva mo paea,
pea kuo lavea hoku loto ʻiate au.

Kuo u mole atu ʻo hangēko e ʻata ʻoka fakaʻaʻau ke ʻosi ia:
kuo feʻaveʻaki au ʻo hangēko e fanga heʻe.

‌ʻOku vaivai hoku tui ʻi he ʻaukai:
pea kuo mole ʻae sino ʻo hoku kakano.

Ne u hoko foki ko e manukiʻanga kiate kinautolu:
ʻi heʻenau sio mai kiate au,
naʻa nau kalokalo honau ʻulu.

Tokoniʻi au, ʻE Sihova ko hoku ʻOtua:
ke ke fakamoʻui au ʻo hangēko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa:

Koeʻuhi ke nau ʻilo ko ho nima eni;
pea ko koe, ʻE Sihova, kuo ke fai ia.

Tuku ke kofu ʻa hoku ngaahi fili ʻaki ʻae mā,
pea tuku kenau ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻakinautoluʻa ʻenau puputuʻu, ʻo hangēko e pulupulu.

Te u fakamālōlahi kia Sihova ʻaki hoku ngutu;
ʻio, te u fakamālōkiate ia ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe tokolahi.

Koeʻuhi ʻe tuʻu ia ʻi he nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe masiva,
ke fakamoʻui ia meiate kinautoluʻoku nau fakahalaia hono laumālie.
110:
NAʻE pehēʻE Sihova ki hoku ʻEiki, “Nofo koe ki hoku nima toʻomataʻu,
kaeʻoua ke u ngaohi ho ngaahi fili ko ho tuʻungavaʻe.”

‌ʻE fekau ʻe Sihova ʻae tokotoko ʻo ho mālohi mei Saione:
“Ke ke pule ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo ho ngaahi fili.”

‌ʻE loto matala ʻa hoʻo kakai ʻi he ʻaho ʻo ho mālohi, ʻi he ngaahi teunga matamatalelei ʻoe māʻoniʻoni mei he manāva ʻoe pongipongi:
ʻoku ʻiate koe ʻae hahau ʻo hoʻo talavou.

Kuo fuakava ʻa Sihova, pea ʻe ʻikai liliu ia,
“Ko e taulaʻeiki koe ʻo lauikuongaʻi he lakanga ʻo Melikiseteke.”

Ko e ʻEiki ʻaia ʻoku ʻi ho nima toʻomataʻu,
te ne taaʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi ʻi he ʻaho ʻo hono houhau.
‌ʻE inu ia ʻi he vaitafe ʻi he hala: ko ia te ne hiki hake ai ʻae ʻulu.
111:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
Te u fakamālōkia Sihova ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē,
ʻi he fakataha ʻoe angatonu, pea ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe kakai.
‌ʻOku lahi ʻae ngāue ʻa Sihova, ʻoku kumi ki ai ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku fiefia ai.

‌ʻOku ongoongolelei mo nāunauʻia ʻa ʻene ngāue:
pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene māʻoniʻoni.

Kuo ne fai ʻene ngaahi ngāue fakaofo ke manatu ia ʻe he kakai:
ʻoku manavaʻofa ʻa Sihova, pea fonu ʻi he ʻaloʻofa.

Kuo foaki ʻe ia ʻae meʻakai kiate kinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkiate ia:
te ne manatuʻi maʻuaipēʻa ʻene fuakava.

Kuo ne fakahāki hono kakai ʻae mālohi ʻo ʻene ngaahi ngāue,
koeʻuhi ke ne foaki kiate kinautoluʻae tofiʻa ʻoe hiteni.

Ko e ngaahi ngāue ʻa hono nima ko e moʻoni mo e fakamaau:
ʻoku moʻoni ʻa ʻene ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku tuʻumaʻu ia ʻo lauikuongapea taʻengata,
pea kuo fai ia ʻi he moʻoni mo e angatonu.

Naʻa ne fekau atu ʻae huhuʻi ki hono kakai:
kuo ne fokotuʻu ʻene fuakava ʻo lauikuonga:
ʻoku māʻoniʻoni mo ngeia ʻa hono huafa.

Ko e manavahēkia Sihova ko e kamataʻanga ia ʻoe poto:
ʻoku poto ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku fai ki heʻene fekau:
ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻae fakamālōkiate ia.
112:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻoku ne manavahēkia Sihova,
mo ne fiefia lahi ʻi heʻene ngaahi fekau.

‌ʻE mālohi hono hako ʻi māmani:
ko e toʻutangata ʻoe angatonu tenau monūʻia.

‌ʻE ʻi hono fale ʻae koloa mo e nāunau:
pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene angatonu.

‌ʻOku tupu ʻae maama ki he angatonu ʻi he poʻuli:
ʻoku angaʻofa ia, pea fonu ʻi he manavaʻofa, pea māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻOku fakahāʻe he tangata angalelei ʻae ʻofa, pea ʻoku faʻa ʻatu:
te ne pule ki heʻene meʻa ʻi he poto.

Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai ueʻi ia ʻo lauikuonga:
ʻe taʻengata ʻae fakamanatu ki he kakai māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻE ʻikai te ne manavahēki he ongoongo kovi:
kuo maʻu hono loto ʻi he falala kia Sihova.

Kuo fokotuʻumaʻu ʻa hono loto:
ʻe ʻikai te ne manavahē, ka ʻe mamata ia ki hono ngaahi fili.

‌ʻE mamata ki ai ʻae angahala, pea tenau mamahi:
ʻe fengaiʻitaki hono nifo, pea ʻe mole atu ia:
ʻe ʻauha ʻae holi ʻae angahala.
113:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
Fakamālō, ʻakimoutoluko e kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa Sihova,
fakamālōki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
Fakafetaʻi ki he huafa ʻo Sihova mei he ʻaho ni ʻo taʻengata.
Ke fakamālōki he huafa ʻo Sihova, mei he hopo hake ʻoe laʻāʻo aʻu ki heʻene tōhifo.
‌ʻOku māʻolunga hake ʻa Sihova ʻi he ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē, mo hono nāunau ʻoku māʻolunga hake ʻi he ngaahi langi.
Ko hai ʻoku na tatau mo Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua, ʻaia ʻoku ʻafio ʻi ʻolunga,
‌ʻOku ne fakamoʻulaloaʻi ia ke ʻafio ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻi he langi, pea mo māmani!

‌ʻOku ne fokotuʻu hake ʻae masiva mei he efu,
mo ne hiki hake ʻae paea mei he tuʻunga ʻotoʻota;

Koeʻuhi ke ne fakataha mo e ngaahi ʻeiki,
pea ke kautahamo e houʻeiki ʻo hono kakai.

‌ʻOku ne ngaohi ʻae fefine paʻa ke tauhi ʻae fale,
pea ke hoko ʻi he fiefia ko e faʻēʻae fānau.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
114:
‌ʻI HE ʻalu atu ʻa ʻIsileli mei ʻIsipite,
ko e fale ʻo Sēkope mei he kakai ʻoe lea kehe;

Ko hono faletapu ʻa Siuta,
mo hono puleʻanga ʻa ʻIsileli.

Naʻe mamata ki ai ʻae tahi, pea hola ai:
naʻe tekeʻi atu ʻo fakaholomui ʻa Sioatani.

Naʻe hopohopo ʻae ngaahi moʻunga ʻo hangēko e fanga sipitangata,
mo e ngaahi foʻi moʻunga ʻo hangēko e fanga lami.

Ko e hānaʻe hoko kiate koe, ʻa koe ko e tahi, koeʻuhi naʻa ke hola ai?
ʻA koe Sioatani, koeʻuhi ke tekeʻi atu ʻo fakaholomui koe?

‌ʻA e ngaahi moʻunga, koeʻuhi naʻa mou hopohopo ai ʻo hangēko e fanga sipitangata;
mo kimoutoluʻae ngaahi foʻi moʻunga, ʻo hangēko e fanga lami?

‌ʻA koe ko māmani, ke ke tetetete ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻEiki,
ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope;

‌ʻAia naʻa ne liliu ʻae maka ko e anovai,
mo e maka afi ko e matavai.
115:
‌ʻOUA naʻa tuku kiate kimautolu,
ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa tuku kiate kimautolu,
ka ki ho huafa ʻae ongoongolelei, koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, pea mo hoʻo moʻoni.

Ko e hāʻe pehēai ʻe he hiteni,
“Ko e fēhonau ʻOtua?”

Ka ko hotau ʻOtua ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi langi:
kuo ne fai ʻaia kuo ne finangalo ki ai.

Ko honau ngaahi tamapua ko e siliva mo e koula,
ko e ngāue ʻae nima ʻoe tangata.

‌ʻOku ai honau ngutu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea:
ʻoku nau maʻu ʻae mata, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau mamata:

‌ʻOku nau telinga, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau ongoʻi:
ʻoku ai honau ihu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau nanamu:

‌ʻOku nau maʻu ʻae nima, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau ala ki ha meʻa:
ʻoku ai honau vaʻe, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau ʻaʻeva:
pea ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea ʻaki honau kia.

Ko kinautoluʻoku ngaohi ʻakinautoluʻoku nau tatau mo kinautolu:
pea ʻoku pehēpe ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku falala ki ai.
‌ʻE ʻIsileli, ke ke falala kia Sihova ko honau tokoni ia mo honau fakaū.

‌ʻE fale ʻo ʻElone, ke ke falala kia Sihova:
ko honau tokoni ia mo honau fakaū.

‌ʻAkimoutoluʻoku manavahēkia Sihova, mou falala kia Sihova:
ko honau tokoni ia mo honau fakaū.
Te ne tāpuaki ʻakinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkia Sihova, ʻae iiki mo e lalahi.

‌ʻE fakatokolahi ʻakimoutoluʻe Sihova, pea te mou tupu pe,
ʻakimoutolumo hoʻomou fānau.
‌ʻOku mou monūʻia ʻia Sihova, ʻaia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.

‌ʻOku ʻo Sihova ʻae langi, ʻio, ko e ngaahi langi:
pea kuo ne foaki ʻa māmani ki he fānau ʻae tangata.

‌ʻOku ʻikai fakamālōkia Sihova ʻae mate,
pe ha taha ʻoku ʻalu hifo ki he fakalongo pē.

Ka te tau fakafetaʻi kia Sihova mei he ʻaho ni ʻo taʻengata.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
116:
‌ʻOKU ou ʻofa kia Sihova, koeʻuhi kuo ne ongoʻi hoku leʻo
mo ʻeku lotu tāumaʻu.

Koeʻuhi kuo ne fakatokangaʻi hono fofonga kiate au,
ko ia te u ui ai ki heʻene ʻafio ʻi hoku ngaahi ʻaho.

Naʻe kāpui au ʻe he ngaahi mamahi ʻoe mate,
pea naʻe puke au ʻe he ngaahi mamahi ʻo heli:
naʻaku ʻilo ai ʻae tuʻutāmaki mo e mamahi.

Pea naʻaku toki ui ki he huafa ʻo Sihova;
“ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke fakamoʻui hoku laumālie.”

‌ʻOku manavaʻofa ʻa Sihova, mo māʻoniʻoni;
ʻio, ʻoku ʻaloʻofa ʻa hotau ʻOtua.

‌ʻOku fakamoʻui ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae taʻekākā:
naʻaku vaivai pea naʻa ne tokoniʻi au.

‌ʻE hoku laumālie, ke ke foki ki ho mālōlōʻanga;
he kuo lahi ʻae foaki ʻa Sihova kiate koe.

He kuo ke fakamoʻui hoku laumālie mei he mate,
mo hoku mata mei he loʻimata,
mo hoku vaʻe ke ʻoua naʻa hinga.
Te u ʻeveʻeva, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻi he fonua ʻoe moʻui.

Naʻaku tui, ko ia kuo u lea ai:
“Naʻaku mahaki lahi:”

Naʻaku pehēʻi heʻeku toʻotoʻo,
“ʻOku loi ʻae kakai kotoa pē.”
Ko e hāte u ʻatu kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi meʻaʻofa kotoa pēkiate au?

Te u toʻo ʻae ipu ʻoe fakamoʻui,
pea te u ui ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
Te u fai ni ʻeku ngaahi fuakava kia Sihova ʻi he ʻao ʻo hono kakai kotoa pē.
‌ʻOku mahuʻinga ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻae pekia ʻo ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni.

Te u ʻatu kiate koe ʻae feilaulau ʻoe fakafetaʻi,
pea ui ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.
Te u fai ni ʻeku ngaahi fuakava kia Sihova ʻi he ʻao ʻo hono kakai kotoa pē,

‌ʻI he ngaahi lotoʻāʻoe fale ʻo Sihova,
ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoʻou, ʻE Selūsalema.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
117:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova, ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē:
fakamālōki heʻene ʻafio,
ʻakimoutoluʻae kakai kotoa pē.

He ʻoku lahi ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa kiate kitautolu:
pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻae moʻoni ʻa Sihova.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
118:
MOU ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia:
koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Ke lea ni ʻe ʻIsileli,
“ʻOku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.”

Ke lea ni ʻae fale ʻo ʻElone,
“ʻOku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.”
Tuku ke lea ni ʻakinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkia Sihova, ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Naʻaku ui kia Sihova ʻi he mamahi:
pea naʻe talia au ʻe Sihova, mo ne tuku au ki he potu ʻataʻatā.
‌ʻOku kau maʻaku ʻa Sihova; ʻe ʻikai te u manavahēko e hāʻe faʻa fai ʻe he tangata kiate au.

‌ʻOku fai maʻaku ʻa Sihova mo kinautoluʻoku nau tokoni au:
ko ia te u mamata ai kiate kinautoluʻoku nau fehiʻa kiate au.
‌ʻOku lelei lahi ʻae falala kia Sihova ʻi he falala ki he tangata.
‌ʻOku lelei lahi ʻae falala kia Sihova ʻi he falala ki he ngaahi ʻeiki.

Naʻe kāpui au ʻe he ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē:
ka ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova te u fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu.

Naʻa nau takatakai au; ʻio, naʻa nau kāpui au:
ka ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova te u fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu.

Kuo ke tekeʻi mālohi au koeʻuhi ke u hinga ai:
ka naʻe tokoni au ʻe Sihova

Ko hoku mālohi ʻa Sihova mo ʻeku hiva,
pea kuo hoko ia ko hoku fakamoʻui.

Ko e lea ʻoe fiefia mo e fakamoʻui ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi fale fehikitaki ʻoe angatonu:
ʻoku fai mālohi ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo Sihova.

Kuo hiki hake ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo Sihova:
ʻoku fai mālohi ʻae nima toʻomataʻu ʻo Sihova.

‌ʻE ʻikai te u mate, kae moʻui,
ʻo fakahāʻae ngaahi ngāue ʻa Sihova.

Kuo tautea fakamamahiʻi au ʻe Sihova:
ka ʻoku teʻeki ai te ne tukuangeau ki he mate.

Toʻo kiate au ʻae ngaahi matapāʻoe māʻoniʻoni:
te u hūai, pea u fakamālōkia Sihova:
Ko e matapāeni ʻo Sihova, ʻaia ʻe hūai ʻae angatonu.

Te u fakamālōkiate koe: he kuo ke ongoʻi au,
pea kuo ke hoko ko hoku fakamoʻui.
Ko e maka naʻe liʻaki ʻe he kau tufunga kuo hoko ia ko e fungani maka ʻoe tuliki.

Ko e ngāue eni ʻa Sihova;
pea ko e meʻa fakaofo ʻi hotau ʻao.

Ko e ʻaho eni kuo ngaohi ʻe Sihova;
te tau fiefia pea nekeneka ai.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke fakamoʻui ni:
ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke tuku mai ni ʻae monūʻia.

Ke monūʻia ia ʻoku haʻu ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova:
kuo mau tāpuekina ʻakimoutolumei he fale ʻo Sihova.

Ko e ʻOtua ko Sihova ia, ʻaia kuo ne fakahāʻae maama kiate kitautolu:
mou nonoʻo ʻae feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ngaahi afo ki he ngaahi nifo, ʻoe feilaulauʻanga.

Ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua, pea teu fakamālōkiate koe:
ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua, te u fakahikihikiʻi koe.

Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia:
koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
119:
‌ʻOKU monūʻia ʻae haohaoa ʻi he hala,
ʻaia ʻoku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he fono ʻa Sihova.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻakinautoluʻoku tauhi ʻene ngaahi fakamoʻoni,
pea kumi kiate ia ʻaki honau loto kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku ʻikai foki tenau fai ha kovi:
ʻoku nau ʻaʻeva ʻi hono ngaahi hala.
Kuo ke fekau mai ke mau tauhi maʻu hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

‌ʻOku ʻamusiaange ʻeau kuo fakahinohino ki hoku ngaahi hala,
ke fai ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Pea ʻe ʻikai te u mā,
ʻo kau ka tokanga ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.

Te u fakamālōkiate koe ʻi he angatonu ʻoe loto,
ʻo kau ka ʻilo hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.

Te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni:
ʻoua naʻa ke siʻaki ʻaupitoau.
PETA

‌ʻE fakamaʻa ʻe he tangata talavou hono hala ʻi he hā?
ʻI heʻene tokanga ki ai ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

Kuo u kumi kiate koe ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē:
ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u hēmei hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

Kuo u fufūhoʻo folofola ʻi hoku loto,
koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻaku angahala kiate koe.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku monūʻia ʻa hoʻo ʻafio:
ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Kuo u fakahāʻaki hoku loungutu,
ʻae ngaahi fakamaau kotoa pēʻa ho fofonga.

Naʻaku fiefia ʻi hono ʻalunga ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni,
ʻo tatau mo e ngaahi koloa kotoa pē.

Te u fakalaulaulotoki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki,
pea te u tokanga ki ho ngaahi hala.

Te u fakafiefiaʻi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni:
ʻe ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo folofola.
KIMELA

Foaki ke lahi ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki,
koeʻuhi ke u moʻui, pea te u tauhi ki hoʻo folofola.

Ke ke fakaʻāhoku mata,
koeʻuhi ke u mamata ki he ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi hoʻo fono.

Ko e muli au ʻi māmani:
ʻoua naʻa fufūhoʻo ngaahi fekau ʻiate au.
‌ʻOku mafesi hoku laumālie koeʻuhi ko ʻene holi ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.

Kuo ke valokiʻi ʻae laukau, ʻakinautoluʻoku malaʻia,
ʻaia kuo hēmei hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

‌ʻAve ʻiate au ʻae taukaeamo e manukia;
he kuo u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Naʻe nofo foki ʻae ngaahi ʻeiki ʻo lauʻikoviʻi au:
ka naʻe fakalaulotoʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni foki ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia,
mo hoku ngaahi akonakiʻi.
TALETA

‌ʻOku pikitai ʻa hoku laumālie ki he efu:
ke ke fakamoʻui au ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

Kuo u fakahāhoku ngaahi hala, pea naʻa ke ongoʻi au:
ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Ngaohi au ke u ʻilo ʻae hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi akonaki:
pea te u lea ki hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo.

Kuo vai ʻa hoku laumālie koeʻuhi ko e ongosia:
fakamālohiʻi au ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

Ke ke hiki ʻiate au ʻae hala ʻoe loi,
pea ke tuku mai hoʻo fono kiate au ʻi he ʻofa.

Kuo u fili ʻae hala ʻoe moʻoni:
pea kuo u fokotuʻu hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau ʻi hoku ʻao.

Kuo u pikitai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni;
ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa ke fakamaaʻi au.

Te u lele ʻi he hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fekau,
ʻoka ke ka fakaʻataʻatāhoku loto.
HE

‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke ako kiate au ʻae hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni;
pea te u fai ki ai ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga.

Foaki mai kiate au ʻae faʻa ʻilo, pea te u fai ki hoʻo fono;
ʻio, te u tokanga ki ai ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē.

Ngaohi au ke u ʻalu ʻi he hala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fekau;
he ʻoku ou fiefia ai.

Fakatokangaʻi hoku loto ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni,
kae ʻikai ki he manumanu.

Taʻofi hoku mata mei he vakai ki he meʻa vaʻinga;
pea ke fakaakeake au ʻi ho hala.

Fakamoʻoni hoʻo folofola ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki,
ʻaia ʻoku fakaʻapaʻapa kiate koe.

Taʻofi atu hoku manukia ʻaia ʻoku ou manavahēai:
he ʻoku lelei hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.

Vakai, ʻoku ou holi ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki:
fakamoʻui au ʻi ho māʻoniʻoni.
VAU

‌ʻE Sihova, tuku ke hoko foki hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa kiate au,
ʻio, ko hoʻo fakamoʻui, ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.
Pehēte u maʻu ha meʻa ke tali ʻaki kiate ia ʻoku manukiʻi au: he ʻoku ou falala ki hoʻo folofola.

Pea ʻoua naʻa toʻo ʻaupitoʻae folofola ʻoe moʻoni mei hoku ngutu;
he kuo u ʻamanaki lelei ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
Pea te u fai maʻuaipēki hoʻo fono ʻo lauikuongapea taʻengata.

Pea te u ʻeveʻeva ʻi he tauʻatāina:
he ʻoku ou kumi ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

Te u lea foki ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi tuʻi,
pea ʻe ʻikai te u māai.

Pea te u fakafiefiaʻi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fekau,
ʻaia kuo u ʻofa ki ai.

Te u hiki hake foki hoku nima ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau,
ʻaia kuo u ʻofa ki ai pea te u fakalaulaulotoki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
SAINI

Manatuʻi ʻae folofola ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki,
ʻaia kuo ke fakaʻamanakiʻi au ki ai.

Ko hoku fiemālieʻanga eni ʻi heʻeku mamahi:
he ko hoʻo folofola kuo ne fakamoʻui au.

Kuo manuki lahi kiate au ʻae laukau:
ka naʻe ʻikai te u afe mei hoʻo fono.

‌ʻE Sihova, naʻaku manatu ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau ʻi muʻa;
pea u fakafiemālieʻi au.
Kuo pukea au ʻe he ilifia koeʻuhi ko e angahala kuo nau siʻaki hoʻo fono.
Ko hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ko ʻeku hiva ia ʻi he fale ʻo ʻeku ʻāunofo.

‌ʻE Sihova, kuo u manatu ki ho huafa ʻi he pō,
pea u fai ki hoʻo fono.

Naʻaku maʻu eni,
ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
KETA

‌ʻE Sihova, ko hoku ʻinasi ʻa koe:
naʻaku pehēte u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi folofola.

Naʻaku kole ki hoʻo ʻofa ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē:
ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate au ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

Naʻaku fifili ki hoku ngaahi ʻaluʻanga,
pea u fakaafe hoku vaʻe ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Ne u fakatoʻotoʻo, pea ʻikai tuai,
ʻeku fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

Kuo kaihaʻasia au ʻe he ngaahi kaihaʻakau ʻoe kau angahala:
ka naʻe ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au ʻa hoʻo fono.

Te u tuʻu hake ʻi he tuʻuapōmālie ke fakafetaʻi kiate koe,
koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻOku ou kaumeʻa mo kinautolukotoa pēʻoku manavahēkiate koe,
mo kinautoluʻoku fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku fonu ʻa māmani ʻi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa:
ke ke ako kiate au ʻa hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.
TETA

‌ʻE Sihova, kuo ke fie fai lelei ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki,
ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

Ke ke ako kiate au ʻae fakamaau lelei mo e faʻa ʻilo:
he ʻoku ou tui ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

‌ʻI he teʻeki ai te u mahaki naʻaku hē:
ka ko eni kuo u fai ki hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻOku ke angalelei, pea ʻoku ke fai lelei;
ke ke ako kiate au ʻa hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Kuo fakatupu ʻe he fielahi ʻae loi kiate au:
ka te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku tatau honau loto mo e ngako,
ka ʻoku ou fiefia ʻi hoʻo fono.
‌ʻOku lelei lahi kiate au ʻae fono ʻaho fofonga ʻi he ngaahi afe ʻoe kuongakoula mo e siliva.

Ko ho nima naʻa ne ngaohi au mo fakatonutonu: foaki mai ʻae poto,
koeʻuhi ke u ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

Ko kinautoluʻoku manavahēkiate koe tenau fiefia ʻoka nau ka mamata kiate au;
koeʻuhi naʻaku ʻamanaki ki hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻoku totonu hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau,
pea ʻi he angatonu kuo ke fakamamahiʻi au.

‌ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, tuku ke fakafiemālieʻi au ʻe hoʻo ʻaloʻofa,
ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki.

Tuku ke hoko kiate au hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua,
koeʻuhi ke u moʻui ai:
he ko hoʻo fono ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia.

Tuku ke māʻae fielahi; he naʻa Tuku ke tafoki mai kiate au ʻakinautoluʻoku manavahēkiate koe,
pea mo kinautolukuo nau ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Tuku ke tafoki mai kiate au ʻakinautoluʻoku manavahēkiate koe,
pea mo kinautolukuo nau ʻiloʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

‌ʻOku pongia hoku laumālie ʻi he fiemaʻu hoʻo fakamoʻui:
ka ʻoku ou ʻamanaki ki hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻOku vaivai hoku mata koeʻuhi ko hoʻo folofola,
ʻoku ou pehē, “Te ke fakafiemālieʻi au ʻafē?”

He kuo u hoko ʻo tatau mo e hina ʻi he ʻohuafi;
ka ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

‌ʻOku fiha ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo hoʻo tamaioʻeiki?
Te ke fakamaau ʻafēʻakinautoluʻoku fakatangaʻi au?
Kuo keli ʻe he fielahi ʻae ngaahi luo kiate au ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai tatau mo hoʻo fono.

‌ʻOku tuʻumaʻu hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē:
ʻoku taʻetotonu ʻenau fakatangaʻi au; ke ke tokoniʻi au,
Naʻa nau meimei fakaʻauha au ʻi māmani ka naʻe ʻikai te u siʻaki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku tuʻumaʻu hoʻo folofola ʻi he langi ʻo lauikuonga.

‌ʻOku aʻu atu hoʻo moʻoni ki he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē:
kuo ke fokotuʻu ʻa māmani, pea ʻoku tuʻumaʻu ia.

‌ʻOku nau tolonga he ʻaho ni ʻo hangēko hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni:
he ko hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki ʻae meʻa kotoa pē.

Ka ne ʻikai ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ʻa hoʻo fono,
pehē, ne u mate ʻi hoku mahaki.

‌ʻE ʻikai siʻi ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi akonaki ʻo lauikuonga:
he ko ia kuo ke fakamoʻui ai au.

‌ʻOku ʻaʻau au,
ke ke fakamoʻui au he kuo u kumi ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

Kuo tatali ʻae angahala kiate au ke tāmateʻi au:
ka te u fifili ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Kuo u mamata ki hono ngataʻanga ʻoe haohaoa kotoa pē:
ka ʻoku laulahiʻaupitoʻa hoʻo fekau.
MEMA

‌ʻOku ou ʻofa lahi ki hoʻo fono:
ʻoku ou fakalaulaulotoki ai ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.

Kuo ke ngaohi au ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fekau ke u poto hake ʻi hoku ngaahi fili:
he ʻoku ʻiate au maʻuaipēia.

‌ʻOku ou poto lahi hake ʻi heʻeku kau akonaki kotoa pē:
he ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni ko hoku fakakaukauʻanga ia.

‌ʻOku ou ʻilo lahi hake ʻi he kau mātuʻa,
koeʻuhi ʻoku ou tauhi hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

Naʻaku taʻofi hoku vaʻe mei he hala kovi kotoa pē,
koeʻuhi ke u fai ki hoʻo folofola.

Naʻe ʻikai te u afe mei hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau:
he kuo ke akonakiʻi au.

‌ʻOku huʻamelie lahi hoʻo ngaahi folofola ki hoku ifo!
ʻIo, ʻoku melie lahi ʻi he hone ki hoku ngutu!

‌ʻOku ou maʻu ʻae poto ʻi hoʻo ngaahi akonaki:
ko ia ʻoku ou fehiʻa ai ki he hala kotoa pēʻoe loi.
NUNA

Ko hoʻo folofola ko e tūhulu ia ki hoku vaʻe,
mo e maama ki hoku hala.

Kuo u fuakava, pea te u fai ki ai,
ke u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻOku lahi ʻaupitohoku mahaki:
fakamoʻui au, ʻE Sihova, ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke maʻu ʻae ngaahi feilaulau loto lelei ʻa hoku ngutu,
pea ke ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.

‌ʻOku ʻi hoku nima maʻuaipēʻa ʻeku moʻui:
ka ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo fono.

Kuo ʻai ʻe he angahala ʻae tauhelekiate au:
ka naʻe ʻikai te u hēmei hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

Kuo u maʻu ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni ko hoku tofiʻa ʻo lauikuonga:
he ko e fiefiaʻanga ia ʻo hoku loto.

Kuo u fakatokangaʻi hoku loto ke fai maʻuaipēki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni,
ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga.
SAMEHA

‌ʻOku ou fehiʻa ki he ngaahi mahalo kovi:
ka ʻoku ou ʻofa ki hoʻo fono.

Ko koe ko hoku toitoiʻanga, mo hoku fakaū;
ʻoku ou ʻamanaki lelei ʻi hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻAlu ʻiate au, ʻakimoutoluʻoku fai kovi:
he te u fai ki he ngaahi fekau ʻa hoku ʻOtua.

Poupou hake au ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola, koeʻuhi ke u moʻui ai.
Pea ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u māʻi heʻeku ʻamanaki.

Ke ke poupou hake au, pea te u hao ai:
pea te u tokanga maʻuaipēki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Kuo ke malaki hifo ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku hēmei hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni:
he ko ʻenau kākāko e loi ia.

‌ʻOku ke siʻaki ʻae kau angahala kotoa pēʻo māmani ʻo hangēko e ʻotoʻota:
ko ia ʻoku ou ʻofa ai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Kuo u fai ʻae fakamaau mo e angatonu:
ʻoua naʻa tukuangeau ki he kau fakamālohi kiate au.

Ke ke hoko ko eungakiʻi ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ke u lelei ai;
ʻoua naʻa tuku ke taʻomia au ʻe he fielahi.

‌ʻOku vaivai hoku mata koeʻuhi ko hoʻo fakamoʻui,
pea mo e folofola ʻo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.

Fai ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ʻo hangēko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa,
pea ke ako kiate au ʻa hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki au; foaki mai ʻae poto,
koeʻuhi ke u ʻilo ai hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

‌ʻE Sihova, kuo hoko ʻae kuongake ke ngāue ai:
he kuo nau fakataʻeʻaongaʻi hoʻo fono.

Ko ia ʻoku ou ʻofa lahi hake ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau ʻi he koula;
ʻio, ʻi he koula lelei.

‌ʻOku fakamanavahēhoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni:
ko ia ʻoku fai ki ai ʻa hoku laumālie.

Ko e hūloto ʻa hoʻo ngaahi folofola ʻoku foaki ai ʻae maama;
ʻoku ʻomi ʻe ia ʻae poto ki he taʻekākā.

Ne u mafaʻa hoku ngutu,
pea u holi he ʻoku ou feinga ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

Ke ke ʻafio mai kiate au, mo ke ʻaloʻofa kiate au,
ʻo hangēko hoʻo faʻa fai kiate kinautoluʻoku ʻofa ki ho huafa.

Tuʻutuʻuni ʻeku ngaahi laka ʻi hoʻo folofola:
pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ke pule kiate au ha hia ʻe taha.

Fakamoʻui au mei he fakamālohi ʻae tangata:
pea te u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

Tuku ke ulo mai ho fofonga ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki;
pea ke ako kiate au hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

‌ʻOku tafe hifo ʻae ngaahi vaitafe ʻi hoku mata,
koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻikai tenau tokanga ki hoʻo fono.
SATI

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke angatonu,
pea ʻoku totonu hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.

‌ʻOku māʻoniʻoni pea ʻoku tuʻumaʻu ʻaupitohoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni,
ʻaia kuo ke fekau mai.

Kuo u ʻosiʻosiloto ʻi heʻeku fai feinga,
koeʻuhi kuo ngalo ʻi hoku ngaahi fili hoʻo ngaahi folofola.

‌ʻOku haohaoa ʻaupitohoʻo folofola:
ko ia ʻoku ʻofa ki ai ʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki.

‌ʻOku ou siʻi au mo manukia:
ka ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

Ko hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ko e māʻoniʻoni taʻengata,
pea ko hoʻo fono ko e moʻoni ia.

Kuo pukea au ʻe he mamahi mo e feinga:
ka ko hoʻo ngaahi fekau ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia.

‌ʻOku taʻengata ʻae māʻoniʻoni ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni:
ke ke foaki mai ʻae poto, pea te u moʻui ai.
KOFI

Ne u tangi kiate koe; fakamoʻui au,
koeʻuhi ke u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Naʻaku muʻomuʻa ʻi he maʻa ʻae ʻaho, pea u tangi:
ne u ʻamanaki ʻi hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻa hoku mata ki he ngaahi leʻo ʻoe pō,
koeʻuhi ke u fakakaukau ki hoʻo folofola.

Ke ke fanongo ki hoku leʻo ʻo hangēko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa:
ʻE Sihova, fakamoʻui au ʻo hangēko hoʻo fakamaau.

‌ʻOku ʻunuʻunu mai ʻakinautoluʻoku nau angimui ki he kovi:
ʻoku nau mamaʻo mei hoʻo fono.

‌ʻOku ke ofi mai, ʻE Sihova;
pea ʻoku moʻoni hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.

Koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni,
kuo fuoloaʻeku ʻilo kuo ke fakamaau ia ʻo lauikuonga.
LESA

Ke ke tokanga ki hoku mahaki, pea ke fakamoʻui au:
he ʻoku ʻikai ngalo ʻiate au hoʻo fono.

Ke ke fakamatala ʻeku meʻa, mo fakahaofi au:
fakamoʻui au ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻOku mamaʻo ʻae fakamoʻui mei he angahala:
he ʻoku ʻikai tenau kumi ki hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

‌ʻOku lahi hoʻo ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua, ʻE Sihova:
fakamoʻui au ʻo hangēko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.

‌ʻOku tokolahi hoku kau fakatanga mo hoku ngaahi fili;
ka ʻoku ʻikai te u afe mei hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni.

Naʻaku mamata ki he kau talangataʻa, pea u mamahi ai;
koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai tenau fai ki hoʻo folofola.

Ke ke ʻafio ki hono anga ʻo ʻeku ʻofa ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki:
fakamoʻui au, ʻE Sihova, ʻo hangēko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa.

‌ʻOku moʻoni hoʻo folofola mei hono kamataʻanga:
pea ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni kotoa pē.
SINI.

Kuo fakatanga au taʻehanoʻuhinga ʻe he ngaahi ʻeiki:
ka ʻoku fakaʻapaʻapa ʻa hoku loto ki hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻOku ou fiefia ʻi hoʻo folofola,
ʻo hangēko e taha ʻoku ne ʻilo ʻae koloa lahi.

‌ʻOku ou fehiʻa mo fākaliliʻa ki he loi:
ka ʻoku ou ʻofa ki hoʻo fono.

‌ʻOku ou fakamālōkiate koe ʻo liunga fitu ʻi he ʻaho,
koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻOku maʻu ʻae fiemālie lahi ʻekinautoluʻoku ʻofa ki hoʻo fono:
pea ʻe ʻikai tūkia ʻakinautoluʻi ha meʻa.

‌ʻE Sihova, kuo u ʻamanaki ki hoʻo fakamoʻui,
pea kuo u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi fekau.

Kuo tauhi ʻe hoku laumālie ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni;
pea ʻoku ou ʻofa lahi ʻaupitoki ai.

Kuo u fai ki hoʻo ngaahi akonaki mo hoʻo ngaahi fakamoʻoni:
he ʻoku ʻi ho ʻao hoku ngaahi ʻaluʻanga kotoa pē.
TAU

‌ʻE Sihova, tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku tangi ʻo ofi kiate koe:
ke ke foaki mai ʻae poto ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

Tuku ke aʻu atu ʻeku lotu tāumaʻu ki ho ʻao:
fakamoʻui au ʻo hangēko hoʻo folofola.

‌ʻE huaʻaki ʻe hoku loungutu ʻae fakamālō,
ʻoka ke ka ako hoʻo ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni kiate au.

‌ʻE lea ʻaki ʻe hoku ʻelelo hoʻo folofola:
he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni hoʻo ngaahi fekau kotoa pē.

Ke tokoni au ʻe ho nima;
he kuo u fili hoʻo ngaahi akonaki.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ou holi ki hoʻo fakamoʻui;
pea ko hoʻo fono ko hoku fiefiaʻanga ia.

Tuku ke moʻui ʻa hoku laumālie, pea ʻe fakamālōia kiate koe;
pea ke tokoni au ʻe hoʻo ngaahi fakamaau.
120:
Naʻaku tangi kia Sihova ʻi heʻeku mamahi,
pea naʻa ne ongoʻi au.

‌ʻE Sihova, fakahaofi hoku laumālie mei he loungutu loi,
pea mei he ʻelelo kākā.

Ko e hāʻe ʻatu kiate koe?
He ko e hāʻe fai kiate koe, ʻa koe ko e ʻelelo kākā?

‌ʻAe ngaahi ngahau māsila ʻae tangata mālohi,
mo e ngaahi malalaʻi afi ʻoe sunipa.

‌ʻOku ou malaʻia, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku ʻāunofoʻi Meseki,
koeʻuhi ko ʻeku nofo ʻi he ngaahi fale fehikitaki ʻo Keta!

Kuo nofo ʻo fuoloaʻa hoku laumālie
fakataha mo ia ʻoku ne fehiʻa ki he melino.

‌ʻOku ou loto ki he melino:
ka ʻi heʻeku lea ʻoku nau fie tau.
121:
TE U hanga hake hoku mata ki he ngaahi moʻunga,
ʻaia ʻoku haʻu mei ai hoku tokoni.

‌ʻOku haʻu hoku tokoni meia Sihova,
ʻaia ne ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.

‌ʻE ʻikai tuku ʻe ia ke hiki ho vaʻe:
ko ia ʻoku ne tauhi koe ʻe ʻikai tulemohe ia.

Vakai, ko ia ʻoku ne tauhi ʻa ʻIsileli
ʻe ʻikai te ne tulemohe pe mohe.

Ko Sihova ko ho tauhi:
ko Sihova ko ho fakamalu ia ʻi ho nima toʻomataʻu.

‌ʻE ʻikai taaʻi koe ʻe he laʻāʻi he ʻaho,
pe ʻe he māhina ʻi he pō.

‌ʻE fakahaofi koe ʻe Sihova mei he kovi kotoa pē:
te ne fakamoʻui ho laumālie.

‌ʻE tauhi ʻe Sihova hoʻo ʻalu kituʻa mo hoʻo liu
mai mei he ʻaho ni, pea taʻengata.
122:
Naʻaku fiefia ʻi heʻenau pehēmai kiate au,
“Ke tau ōki he fale ʻo Sihova.”

‌ʻE tuʻu homau vaʻe ki lotoʻāʻi ho ngaahi matapā,
ʻE Selūsalema.
Kuo langa ʻa Selūsalema ʻo hangēko e kolo ʻoku māʻopoʻopo:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ʻalu hake ki ai ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga,
ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo Sihova, ki he fakamoʻoni ʻa ʻIsileli,
ke ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he huafa ʻo Sihova.

He ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi nofoʻa ʻoe fakamaau,
ko e ngaahi nofoʻa ʻoe fale ʻo Tevita.

Mou hūfia ke melino ʻa Selūsalema:
“ʻE monūʻia ʻakinautoluʻoku nau ʻofa kiate koe.

Ke ʻai ʻae melino ʻi ho ngaahi lotoʻāmaka,
mo e monūʻia ʻi ho ngaahi fale fakaʻeiʻeiki.”

Pea koeʻuhi ko hoku ngaahi kāinga mo hoku ngaahi kaumeʻa,
te u lea ni, “Ke ʻiate koe ʻae melino.”

Koeʻuhi ko e fale ʻo Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua,
te u kumi ke ke lelei ai.
123:
‌ʻOKU ou hanga hake hoku mata ki hoʻo ʻafio,
ʻa koe ʻoku ke ʻafio ʻi he ngaahi langi.

Vakai, ʻoku hangēko e sio ʻae mata ʻoe kau tamaioʻeiki ki he nima ʻo ʻenau ngaahi ʻeiki,
pea hangēko e mata ʻo ha kaunanga ki he nima ʻo ʻene ʻeiki fefine;
ʻoku tatali pehēʻa homau mata kia Sihova ko homau ʻOtua,
kaeʻoua ke ne ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu.

‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu, ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu:
he kuo mau fonu ʻaupitoʻi he manukia.

‌ʻOku fonu ʻaupitohomau laumālie ʻi he manuki ʻanautoluʻoku anga fakafiemālie,
pea mo e fehiʻa ʻae fielahi.
124:
KAPAU naʻe ʻikai kau ʻa Sihova mo kitautolu,
ʻoku totonu ke lea ni ʻa ʻIsileli;

“Kapau naʻe ʻikai kau ʻa Sihova mo kitautolu,
ʻi he tuʻu hake ʻae kakai kiate kitautolu:

Pehē, kuo nau folo hifo leva ʻakitautolu,
ʻi he tupu ʻenau ʻita kiate kitautolu;

Pehē, kuo lōfia ʻakitautoluʻe he ngaahi vai,
kuo tafe ʻae vaitafe ʻi he funga ʻo hotau laumālie:
Pea ʻalu ʻae ngaahi vai ʻoe laukau ʻi he funga ʻo hotau laumālie.”

Fakafetaʻi kia Sihova,
ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te ne tukuangeʻakitautoluko e meʻakai ki honau nifo.

Kuo hao hotau laumālie ʻo hangēko e manupunamei he hele ʻae tangata tauhele:
kuo maumauʻi ʻae tauhele, pea kuo tau hao ai.
Ko hotau tokoni ʻoku ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova, ʻaia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.
125:
KO kinautoluʻoku falala kia Sihova tenau tatau mo e moʻunga ko Saione,
ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai siʻi faʻa hiki, kae tuʻumaʻu pe ʻo taʻengata.

Hangēko e takatakai ʻe he ngaahi moʻunga ʻa Selūsalema,
ʻoku takatakai pehēʻe Sihova ʻa hono kakai mei he ʻaho ni ʻo lauikuonga.

Koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai tuku maʻu ʻae tokotoko ʻoe angahala ʻi he tofiʻa ʻoe angatonu;
telia naʻa mafao atu ʻe he angatonu honau nima ki he angahala.

‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke fai lelei kiate kinautoluʻoku angalelei,
pea kiate kinautoluʻoku angatonu ʻi honau loto.

Ka ko kinautoluʻoku nau afe ki honau ngaahi hala pikopiko,
ʻe tataki atu ʻakinautoluʻe Sihova fakataha mo e kakai fai kovi:
ka ʻe hoko ʻae melino ki ʻIsileli.
126:
‌ʻI HE toe liliu ʻe Sihova ʻae pōpula ʻo Saione,
naʻa tau tatau mo kinautoluʻoku misi.

Pea naʻe toki fakapito ʻaki hotau ngutu ʻae kata,
mo hotau ʻelelo ʻi he hiva:
pea naʻe toki pehēʻe he hiteni, “Kuo fai ʻe Sihova ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi maʻanautolu.”

Kuo fai ʻe Sihova ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi maʻatautolu;
pea ʻoku tau fiefia ai.
‌ʻE Sihova, ke ke toe liliu ʻemau pōpula, ʻo hangēko e ngaahi vaitafe ʻi he feituʻu tonga.
Ko kinautoluʻoku tūtuuʻi ʻi he loʻimata te nau tuʻusi ʻi he fiefia.

Ko ia ʻoku ne ʻalu atu ʻo tangi, pea ʻave ʻae tenga mahuʻinga,
te ne toe haʻu ʻi he fiefia, mo ʻomi ʻene ngaahi ūuite fakataha mo ia.
127:
KAPAU ʻe ʻikai langa ʻe Sihova ʻae fale,
ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae ngāue ʻanautoluʻoku nau langa ia:
kapau ʻe ʻikai tauhi ʻe Sihova ʻae kolo,
ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻae ʻāʻae tangata leʻo.

‌ʻOku taʻeʻaonga hoʻomou tuʻu hake hengihengi pē,
mo nofo pēʻo fuoloaʻi he pō,
ke kai ʻae māʻoe mamahi:
he ʻoku ne foaki ʻae mohe ki heʻene pele.

Vakai, ko e fānau ko e tofiʻa meia Sihova:
pea ko e fua ʻoe manāva ko ʻene totongi.

Hangēko e ngaahi ngahau ʻi he nima ʻoe tangata mālohi;
ʻoku pehēʻae fānau ʻae talavou.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tangata ʻaia ʻoku fonu ʻene hōfangahau ʻiate kinautolu:
ʻe ʻikai tenau mā, ka tenau lea ki he ngaahi fili ʻi he matapā.
128:
‌ʻOKU monūʻia ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku manavahēkia Sihova;
ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻeva ʻi hono ngaahi hala.

He te ke kai ʻae ngāue ʻa ho nima:
te ke monūʻia, pea ʻe hoko ʻae lelei kiate koe.

‌ʻE tatau ho ʻunohomo e vaine ʻoku faʻa fua ʻi ho veʻe fale:
ʻe tatau hoʻo fānau mo e ngaahi vaʻa ʻolive ʻoku kāpui hoʻo keinangaʻanga.
Vakai, ʻe pehēʻae monūʻia ʻoe tangata ʻaia ʻoku ne manavahēkia Sihova.

‌ʻE tāpuaki koe ʻe Sihova mei Saione:
pea te ke mamata ki hono lelei ʻo Selūsalema ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho kotoa pēʻo hoʻo moʻui.
‌ʻIo, te ke mamata ki he fānau ʻa hoʻo fānau pea mo e melino ʻi ʻIsileli.
129:
‌ʻOKU totonu ke lea ni ʻa ʻIsileli,
Kuo liunga lahi ʻenau fakamamahiʻi au talu ʻeku kei talavou:

“Kuo liunga lahi ʻenau fakamamahiʻi au talu ʻeku talavou:
ka naʻe ʻikai tenau mālohi kiate au.

Naʻe keli ʻae kau tangata keli ʻi hoku tuʻa:
naʻa nau ngaohi ke lōloa ʻenau ngaahi keli.

‌ʻOku angatonu ʻa Sihova:
kuo tuʻusi ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi afo ʻae kakai angahala.”
Tuku ke puputuʻu pea foki kimui ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku fehiʻa ki Saione.

Tuku kenau tatau mo e mohuku ʻi he tatāʻoe fale,
ʻaia ʻoku mae ʻi he teʻeki ai ke lahi ia:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ʻikai fakapito ʻaki ʻe he tangata tuʻusi ʻa hono nima;
pe ko e fatafata ʻo ia ʻoku ne nonoʻo ʻae ngaahi ʻūmohuku.

Pea ʻoku ʻikai lea ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻalu ʻi ai,
ʻo pehē, “Ke ʻiate kimoutoluʻae monūʻia meia Sihova:
ʻoku mau tāpuaki ʻakimoutoluʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova.”
130: ‌ʻE SIHOVA, naʻaku tangi kiate koe mei he ngaahi moana.

‌ʻE ʻEiki, ke ke ongoʻi hoku leʻo:
fakatokangaʻi ho fofonga ki he leʻo ʻo ʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu.

Kapau te ke fakaʻilonga, ʻE Sihova, ʻae ngaahi hia,
ʻE ʻEiki, ko hai ʻe faʻa tuʻu?

Ka ʻoku ʻiate koe ʻae fakamolemole,
koeʻuhi ke manavahēai kiate koe.

‌ʻOku ou tatali kia Sihova,
ʻoku tatali ʻa hoku laumālie,
pea ʻoku ou ʻamanaki lelei ki heʻene folofola.

‌ʻOku tatali ʻa hoku laumālie kia Sihova ʻo lahi hake ʻiate kinautoluʻoku nau leʻo ki he pongipongi:
ʻoku ou pehē, ʻo lahi hake ʻiate kinautoluʻoku nau leʻo ki he pongipongi.

Ke ʻamanaki ʻa ʻIsileli kia Sihova:
he ʻoku ʻia Sihova ʻae ʻaloʻofa,
pea ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae huhuʻi lahi.
Pea te ne huhuʻi ʻa ʻIsileli mei heʻene ngaahi hia kotoa pē.
131:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, ʻoku ʻikai fielahi hoku loto, pe fieʻeiki hoku mata:
pea ʻoku ʻikai te u kau ʻi he ngaahi meʻa lalahi,
pe ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku māʻolunga hake ʻiate au.

Ko e moʻoni kuo u fakafiemālieʻi mo fakanaʻanaʻaʻi au,
ʻo hangēko e tamasiʻi kuo fakamāvae mei heʻene faʻē:
ʻoku tatau hoku laumālie mo e tamasiʻi kuo fakamāvae.

Tuku ke ʻamanaki lelei ʻa ʻIsileli kia Sihova,
mei he ʻaho ni pea taʻengata.
132: ‌ʻE SIHOVA, ke ke manatu kia Tevita, mo ʻene mamahi kotoa pē:
‌ʻA ʻene fuakava kia Sihova, mo ʻene lea fakapapau ki he ʻOtua mālohi ʻa Sēkope;

“Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai te u ʻalu ki hoku fale nofoʻanga,
pe ʻalu hake ki hoku mohenga;

‌ʻE ʻikai te u tuku ʻae mohe ki hoku mata,
pe ko e tulemohe ki hoku laumata,
Kaeʻoua ke u ʻilo ha potu moʻo Sihova, ko e ʻafioʻanga ki he ʻOtua mālohi ʻo Sēkope.”

Vakai, naʻa tau fanongo ki ai ʻi ʻEfalata:
pea naʻa tau ʻilo ia ʻi he ngaahi ngoue ʻoe vao.

“Te tau hūki hono ngaahi fale fehikitaki:
te tau lotu ʻi hono tuʻunga vaʻe.”

Tuʻu hake, ʻE Sihova, ki ho mālōlōʻanga;
ʻa koe, mo e puha ʻoe fuakava ʻo ho mālohi.

Ke kofuʻaki ʻe hoʻo kau taulaʻeiki ʻae angatonu;
pea ke kalanga ʻi he fiefia ʻa hoʻo kakai māʻoniʻoni.

Koeʻuhi ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki ko Tevita,
ʻoua naʻa ke fakatafoki ʻae mata ʻo hoʻo pani.

Kapau ʻe fai ʻe hoʻo fānau ki heʻeku fuakava
mo ʻeku fakamoʻoni ʻaia te u ako kiate kinautolu,
ʻe nofo foki ʻenau fānau ʻi ho nofoʻa fakaʻeiʻeiki ʻo lauikuonga.”

He kuo fili ʻe Sihova ʻa Saione;
kuo ne finangalo ki ai ko hono ʻafioʻanga.

“Ko hoku mālōlōʻanga eni ʻo taʻengata:
te u nofo ʻi heni; he naʻaku finangalo ki ai.

Ko e moʻoni te u tāpuaki lahi hono meʻakai:
te u fakamākona ʻa hono kau masiva ʻaki ʻae mā.

Te u fakakofu foki ʻene kau taulaʻeiki ʻaki ʻae fakamoʻui:
pea ko ʻene kau māʻoniʻoni tenau kalanga ʻo leʻo lahi ʻi he fiefia.

Te u ngaohi ke moto ai ʻae nifo ʻo Tevita:
kuo u tuʻutuʻuni ʻae maama ʻa ʻeku pani.

Te u fakakofuʻaki hono ngaahi fili ʻae mā:
ka ʻe maʻuiʻui ʻa hono tatāʻiate ia.”
133:
VAKAI ki hono lelei pea mo hono fakafiemālie,
ʻoe nofo fakataha ʻae kāinga ʻi he feʻofoʻofani!

‌ʻOku tatau ia mo e lolo mahuʻinga ki he ʻulu,
ʻaia naʻe tafe hifo ki he halakava,
ʻio, ko e halakava ʻo ʻElone:
pea ʻalu hifo ki he kapa ʻo hono ngaahi kofu;

‌ʻOku hangēko e hahau ʻo Heamoni,
pea hangēko e hahau naʻe tōki he ngaahi moʻunga ʻo Saione,
he naʻe fekau ʻi ai ʻe Sihova ʻae monūʻia,
ʻio, ko e moʻui taʻengata.
134:
Ko eni, mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova,
ʻakimoutolukotoa pēko e kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa Sihova,
ʻoku mou tuʻu ʻi he pōʻi he fale ʻo Sihova.

Hiki hake homou nima ʻi he faletapu,
mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova.

Ke tāpuaki koe mei Saione ʻe Sihova;
ʻaia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi mo māmani.
135: ‌ʻAkimoutoluʻoku tuʻu ʻi he fale ʻo Sihova, ʻi he ngaahi lotoʻāʻoe fale ʻo hotau ʻOtua,

Fakamālōkia Sihova; he ʻoku angalelei ʻa Sihova:
hiva fakamālōki hono huafa; he ʻoku mālie ia.

He kuo fili ʻe Sihova ʻa Sēkope maʻana,
mo ʻIsileli ko hono tofiʻa ʻoʻona.

He ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻoku lahi ʻa Sihova,
pea ʻoku māʻolunga hake hotau ʻEiki ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.

Ko e meʻa kotoa pēnaʻe finangalo ki ai ʻa Sihova, ko ia naʻa ne fai ʻi he langi,
mo māmani, ʻi he ngaahi tahi, mo e ngaahi potu loloto kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku pule ʻe ia ke ʻalu hake ʻae kakapu mei he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani,
ʻoku ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi ʻuhilamo e ʻuha ʻoku ʻomi,
ʻe ia ʻae matangi mei hono ngaahi feleoko.

Ko ia ia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ʻuluaki fānau ʻo ʻIsipite,
ʻae tangata mo e manu.

Mo ne fekau atu ʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga,
mo e ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoʻou,
ʻE ʻIsipite, kia Felo, pea mo ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki kotoa pē.

Ko ia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga lahi,
mo tāmateʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi mālohi;

Ko Sihoni ko e tuʻi ʻoe kau ʻAmoli,
mo Oki ko e tuʻi ʻo Pesani,
mo e ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pēʻo Kēnani:

Pea naʻe foaki honau fonua ko e tofiʻa,
ko e tofiʻa ki ʻIsileli ko hono kakai.

Koeʻuhi ʻe fakamaau ʻe Sihova hono kakai,
pea ʻe lolou ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.

Ko e ngaahi tamapua ʻoe hiteni ko e siliva mo e koula,
ko e ngāue ʻae nima ʻoe tangata.

‌ʻOku ai honau ngutu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea;
ʻoku nau maʻu ʻae mata, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau mamata;

Ko kinautoluʻoku ngaohi ʻakinautoluʻoku nau tatau mo kinautolu:
pea ʻoku pehēpe ʻakinautoluʻoku falala ki ai.

‌ʻE fale ʻo ʻIsileli, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:
ʻE fale ʻo ʻElone, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:

‌ʻE fale ʻo Livai, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:
ʻakimoutoluʻoku manavahēkia Sihova, mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova.

Mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova mei Saione,
ʻaia ʻoku ʻafio ʻi Selūsalema.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
136:
MOU ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia:
koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi ʻotua:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki ʻoe ngaahi ʻeiki:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia tokotaha pe ʻoku fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo lahi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe ngaohi ʻi he poto ʻae ngaahi langi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe folahi ʻa māmani ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi vai:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe ngaohi ʻae ngaahi maama lahi he ʻoku tolonga,
ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa

Ko e laʻāke pule ʻi he ʻaho:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:

Ko e māhina mo e ngaahi fetuʻu ke pule ʻi he pō:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe taaʻi ʻa ʻIsipite ʻi heʻenau ʻuluaki fānau:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa

Mo ne ʻomi ʻa ʻIsileli meiate kinautolu:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:

‌ʻAki ʻae nima mālohi, mo e nima kuo mafao atu:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia naʻe vaheʻi ke vaeua ʻae Tahi Kulokula:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:

Pea ne pule ke ʻalu ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi hono vahaʻa:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa

Ka naʻe tulakiʻa Felo mo ʻene kautau ʻi he Tahi Kulokula:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe tataki hono kakai ʻi he toafa:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi lahi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Pea tāmateʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi naʻe ongoongo:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa

Ko Sihoni ko e tuʻi ʻoe kau ʻAmoli:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:

Mo Oki ko e tuʻi ʻo Pesani:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa

Pea ne foaki honau fonua ko e tofiʻa:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:

Ko e tofiʻa kia ʻIsileli ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

‌ʻAia naʻe manatu kiate kitautoluʻi heʻetau masiva:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:

Pea ne huhuʻi ʻakitautolumei hotau ngaahi fili:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

‌ʻOku ne foaki ʻae meʻakai ki he kakano kotoa pē:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻoe langi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
137:
NAʻA mau nofo ki lalo ʻi he veʻe vaitafe ʻo Papilone,
ʻio, naʻa mau tangi ʻi heʻemau manatu ki Saione.

Naʻa mau tautau ʻemau ngaahi haʻape,
ʻi he ngaahiuilouʻi he lotolotonga ʻo ia.
‌ʻE fēfēʻemau hiva ʻaki ʻae hiva ʻa Sihova ʻi he fonua ʻoe muli?

Kapau te u fakangalongaloʻi koe, ʻE Selūsalema,
tuku ke ngalo ʻi hoku nima toʻomataʻu hono faiva.

Kapau ʻe ʻikai te u manatu kiate koe, tuku ke pikitai ʻa hoku ʻelelo ki hoku ʻaoʻingutu;
ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai te u hiki māʻolunga hake ʻa Selūsalema ʻi hoku fungani fiefiaʻanga.

Manatu, ʻE Sihova, ki he fānau ʻa ʻItomi,
ʻi he ʻaho ʻo Selūsalema;
naʻa nau pehē, “Fakaʻauha ia!
Fakaʻauha ia, ʻo aʻu ki hono tuʻunga!”

‌ʻE monūʻia ia,
ʻaia te ne toʻo ʻo laiki hoʻo fānau iiki ki he maka.
138:
TE U fakamālōkiate koe ʻaki hoku loto kotoa pē:
ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi ʻotua te u hiva fakamālōkiate koe.

Te u lotu ʻo hanga atu ki ho faletapu māʻoniʻoni,
mo fakamālōki ho huafa koeʻuhi ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa mo hoʻo moʻoni:
he kuo ke hiki ke māʻolunga hake hoʻo folofola ʻi ho huafa kotoa pē.

‌ʻI he ʻaho ne u tangi ai naʻa ke talia au,
mo fakamālohi ʻaki au ʻae mālohi ʻi hoku laumālie.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fakamālōkiate koe ʻae ngaahi tuʻi kotoa pēʻo māmani,
ʻoka nau ka fanongo ki he ngaahi folofola ʻo ho fofonga.

‌ʻIo, tenau hiva ʻi he ngaahi hala ʻo Sihova:
he ʻoku lahi ʻae nāunau ʻo Sihova.

Ko e moʻoni ʻoku māʻolunga ʻa Sihova, ka ʻoku ʻofa ia ki he angavaivai:
ka ʻoku ʻilo ʻe ia ʻae laukau ki he mamaʻo.

Neongo ʻeku ʻeveʻeva ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe mamahi, te ke fakaakeake au:
te ke mafao atu ho nima ke taʻofi ki he ʻita ʻa hoku ngaahi fili,
pea ko ho nima toʻomataʻu te ne fakamoʻui au.

‌ʻE fakahaohaoa ʻe Sihova ʻaia ʻoku kau kiate au:
ko hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻE Sihova ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata:
ʻoua naʻa ke liʻaki ʻae ngaahi ngāue ʻa ho nima ʻoʻou.
139:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, naʻa ke ʻahiʻahiʻi au,
pea kuo ke ʻiloʻi au.

‌ʻOku ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku nofo hifo mo ʻeku tuʻu hake,
ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku ngaahi mahalo ʻoku kei mamaʻo.

‌ʻOku ke ʻāʻi hoku hala mo hoku tokotoʻanga,
pea ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi hoku hala kotoa pē.

He ʻoku ʻikai ha lea ʻi hoku ʻelelo,
ka ko koe, ʻE Sihova, ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi kotoa pē.

Naʻa ke kāpui au ʻi hoku tuʻa mo hoku ʻao,
ʻo ke hilifaki ho nima kiate au.

Te u ʻalu ki fēmei ho Laumālie?
Pe te u hola ki fēmei ho ʻao?

Kapau te u ʻalu hake ki he loto langi, ʻoku ke ʻi ai:
kapau te u ngaohi hoku mohenga ʻi heli,
vakai, ʻoku ke ʻi ai.

Kapau te u toʻo mai ʻae ngaahi kapakau ʻoe pongipongi,
pea nofo ʻi he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻoe tahi;

‌ʻE tataki foki au ʻe ho nima ʻi ai,
pea ko ho nima toʻomataʻu te ne puke au.

Kapau te u pehē, Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻufiʻufi au ʻe he poʻuli;
ʻe hoko ʻae pōfoki ko e maama ʻo takatakai ʻiate au.

‌ʻIo, ʻoku ʻikai fakafufūmeiate koe ʻe he poʻuli,
ka ʻoku malama ʻae pōʻo hangēko e ʻaho:
ko e poʻuli mo e maama ʻoku na tatau pe kiate koe.

He kuo ke maʻu hoku kongaloto:
naʻa ke ʻufiʻufi au ʻi he manāva ʻo ʻeku faʻē.

Naʻe ʻikai fufūʻa hoku sino meiate koe,
ʻi he ngaohi au ʻi he lilo,
mo teuteu lelei au ʻi he ngaahi potu māʻulaloʻoe fonua.

Naʻe ʻafio ho fofonga ki hoku sino ʻoku teʻeki ai fakaʻosi;
pea naʻe tohi ʻi hoʻo tohi hoku ngaahi kupuʻi sino kotoa pē,
ʻaia naʻe fakatupu fakaholo,
ʻi he teʻeki ai ha kupu ʻe taha.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, hono ʻikai mahuʻinga ʻa hoʻo ngaahi fakakaukau kiate au!
ʻOku fēfēnai hono lahi ʻo ia!

Kapau te u lau ia, ʻoku lahi hake hono lau ʻi he ʻoneʻone:
ʻo kau ka ʻāhake ʻoku ou kei ʻiate koe.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ko e moʻoni te ke tāmateʻi ʻae angahala:
ko ia mou ʻalu ʻiate au, ʻakimoutoluʻae kau tangata pani toto.

He ʻoku nau lea kovi ʻi he angatuʻu kiate koe,
pea ko ho ngaahi fili ʻoku nau takuanoaho huafa.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻikai ʻoku ou fehiʻa kiate kinautoluʻoku nau fehiʻa kiate koe?
Pea ʻikai ʻoku ou mamahi ʻiate kinautoluʻoku nau tuʻu hake ʻo angatuʻu kiate koe?

‌ʻOku ou fehiʻa kiate kinautoluʻaki ʻae fehiʻa ʻaupito:
ʻoku ou lau ʻakinautoluko hoku ngaahi fili.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻafioʻi au, pea ke ʻiloʻi hoku loto:
ʻahiʻahiʻi au, mo ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku ngaahi mahalo:

Pea ke vakai pe ʻoku ai ha hala kovi ʻiate au,
pea ke tataki au ʻi he hala taʻengata.
140:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, fakamoʻui au mei he tangata angakovi:
fakamoʻui au mei he tangata fakamālohi;

‌ʻAia ʻoku mahalo kovi ʻi honau loto;
ʻoku nau fakataha maʻuaipēke tau.

Kuo nau fakamāsila honau ʻelelo ʻo hangēko e ngata;
ʻoku ʻai ʻae kona ʻoe ngata ʻi honau lalo loungutu.Sila.

Naʻaku pehēkia Sihova, “Ko koe ko hoku ʻOtua:”
ʻE Sihova, ke ke ongoʻi ʻae leʻo ʻo ʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu.

‌ʻE Sihova ko e ʻEiki, ko e mālohi ʻo ʻeku fakamoʻui,
kuo ke maluʻi hoku ʻulu ʻi he ʻaho ʻoe tau.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoua naʻa ke fai ki he ngaahi holi ʻae angahala:
ʻoua naʻa ke tokoni ʻene fakakaukau kovi, telia naʻa nau hiki hake ʻakinautolu.Sila.

Ka ko e ʻulu ʻokinautoluʻoku nau kāpui au,
tuku ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae kovi ʻo honau loungutu.

Ke tōkiate kinautoluʻae malalaʻi afi ʻoku vela: tuku ke līʻakinautoluki he afi;
ki he ngaahi luo tau mamaʻo, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa nau toetuʻu hake.

‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ha tangata lea kovi ke tuʻumaʻu ʻi māmani:
ʻe tuli ʻe he kovi ʻae tangata fakamālohi ke tulakiia.

‌ʻOku ou ʻilo ʻe fakamaau ʻe Sihova ʻae meʻa ʻae mamahi,
mo e ʻinasi totonu ʻoe masiva.

Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ʻe he māʻoniʻoni ki ho huafa:
ʻe nofo ʻae angatonu ʻi ho ʻao.
141:
Ke aʻu atu ʻeku lotu ki ho ʻao ʻo hangēko e meʻa namu kakala;
mo e hiki hake ʻo hoku nima ʻo hangēko e feilaulau ʻoe efiafi.

‌ʻE Sihova, fakanofo ʻae leʻo ki hoku ngutu;
tauhi ʻae matapāʻo hoku loungutu.

‌ʻOua naʻa ueʻi hoku loto ki ha meʻa kovi ʻe taha,
ke fai ʻae ngaahi ngāue kovi mo e kau tangata ʻoku fai kovi:
pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ke u kai ʻi heʻenau ngaahi meʻa lelei.

Ke taaʻi au ʻe he angatonu; pea ko e ʻofa ia:
pea tuku ke ne valokiʻi au; ko e lolo lelei ia, ʻaia ʻe ʻikai foa ai hoku ʻulu:
he ko ʻeku lotu foki ʻe fai ia ʻi heʻenau ngaahi mamahi.

‌ʻOka hinga ʻenau kau fakamaau ʻi he ngaahi potu tokatāmaki,
tenau fanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi lea; he ʻoku melie ia.

Kuo movetevete hotau ngaahi hui ʻi he ngutu ʻoe faʻitoka,
ʻo hangēko e taaʻi ʻo mafahi ʻe he taha ʻae ʻakau ʻi he funga ʻoe fonua.

Taʻofi au mei he ngaahi tauhelekuo nau ʻai kiate au,
mo e ngaahi meʻa fakauʻu, ʻae kakai fai kovi.

Tuku ke tōʻae angahala ki he ngaahi kupenga ʻanautolu,
ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻeku hao mei ai.
142:
Naʻaku tangi kia Sihova ʻaki hoku leʻo;
ne u kole tāumaʻu kia Sihova ʻaki hoku leʻo.

Naʻaku lilingi ʻeku fakakaukau ʻi hono ʻao;
ne u fakahāʻi hono ʻao ʻeku mamahi.

‌ʻI he taʻomia ʻa hoku laumālie,
ne ke ʻilo ai hoku ʻaluʻanga.
ʻI he hala ne u ʻeveʻeva ai kuo nau ʻai fufūʻae tauhelekiate au.

Ne u sio, mo vakai ʻi hoku nima toʻomataʻu,
ka naʻe ʻikai ha tangata te ne ʻiloʻi au:
naʻe ʻikai haʻaku hūfanga;
naʻe ʻikai tokanga ha tangata ki hoku laumālie.

Naʻaku tangi kiate koe,
ʻE Sihova; ne u pehē,
Ko koe ko hoku hūfanga,
mo hoku ʻinasi ʻi he fonua ʻoe moʻui.

‌ʻOmi hoku laumālie mei he fale fakapōpula,
koeʻuhi ke u fakamālōai ki ho huafa:
ʻe kāpui au ʻe he angatonu;
he te ke fai lelei lahi kiate au.
143:
‌ʻE SIHOVA, fanongo ki heʻeku lotu,
fakafanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi lotu tāumaʻu:
pea ʻi hoʻo moʻoni mo hoʻo māʻoniʻoni, ke ke talia au.

Pea ʻoua naʻa ke fakamaauʻi hoʻo tamaioʻeiki:
koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai tonuhia ʻi ho ʻao ha tangata moʻui ʻe tokotaha.

Ko ia kuo taʻomia ai ʻa hoku laumālie;
kuo lala hoku loto ʻiate au.

‌ʻOku ou mafao atu hoku nima kiate koe:
ʻoku holi ʻa hoku laumālie kiate koe,
ʻo hangēko e fonua fieinua.Sila.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻafio vave kiate au:
kuo vaivai ʻa hoku laumālie:
ʻoua naʻa fufūho fofonga ʻiate au,
telia naʻaku tatau mo kinautoluʻoku nau ʻalu hifo ki he luo.

Fakamoʻui au, ʻE Sihova, mei hoku ngaahi fili:
ʻoku ou hola kiate koe ke fakafufūau,

‌ʻE Sihova, fakamoʻui au koeʻuhi ko ho huafa:
koeʻuhi ko hoʻo māʻoniʻoni ke ke ʻomi hoku laumālie mei he mamahi.

Pea ʻi hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ke ke motuhi hoku ngaahi fili,
mo fakaʻauha ʻakinautoluʻoku nau fakamamahi ki hoku laumālie: he ko hoʻo tamaioʻeiki au.
144:
KE monūʻia pēʻa Sihova ko hoku makatuʻu,
ʻaia ʻoku ne ako ki hoku nima ketau,
mo hoku louhiʻi nima ketau:

‌ʻE Sihova, ko e hāʻae tangata, ʻoku ke tokanga ai kiate ia!
Pe ko e foha ʻoe tangata, koeʻuhi ʻoku ke finangalo kiate ia!

‌ʻOku tatau ʻae tangata mo e meʻa vaʻinga:
ko hono ngaahi ʻaho ʻoku hangēko e ʻata ʻoku mole atu.

Ofeʻi hifo, ʻE Sihova, ho ngaahi langi, pea ke hāʻele hifo:
ala ki he ngaahi moʻunga, pea tenau kohu ai.

Līatu ʻae ʻuhila, pea fakamovete ʻakinautolu:
fanaʻi atu hoʻo ngaahi ngahau, mo fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu.

‌ʻAkinautoluʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe honau ngutu ʻae vaʻinga,
pea ko honau nima toʻomataʻu ko e nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe loi.

‌ʻE ʻOtua, te u hiva ʻaki ʻae hiva foʻou kiate koe:
te u hiva fakamālōkiate koe ʻaki ʻae saliteli mo e meʻa faiva ʻoku filo ʻe hongofulu.

Ko ia ia ʻoku ne foaki ʻae fakamoʻui ki he ngaahi tuʻi:
ʻoku ne fakamoʻui ʻa Tevita ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki mei he heletāʻoe kovi.

Fakamoʻui au,
mo fakahaofi au mei he nima ʻoe fānau ʻae muli;
ʻakinautoluʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe honau ngutu ʻae vaʻinga,
pea ko honau nima toʻomataʻu ko e nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe loi:

Koeʻuhi ke tatau homau ngaahi foha mo e ngaahi ʻakau naʻe tupu ʻi heʻenau talavou;
ke tatau homau ngaahi ʻofefine mo e ngaahi maka ʻoe tuliki, kuo tāʻo fakatatau mo e fale fakaʻeiʻeiki:

Koeʻuhi ke pito ai homau ngaahi feleoko,
ʻoku ʻomi mei ai ʻae meʻakai kehekehe kotoa pē:
ke fānau ʻemau ngaahi fanga sipi ʻi he lauʻi afe mo e lauʻi mano ʻi homau ngaahi hala:

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae kakai ko ia, ʻaia ʻoku pehē:
ʻio, ʻoku monūʻia ʻae kakai ko ia, ʻoku ʻOtua ʻaki ʻa Sihova.
145:
TE U fakahikihiki koe, ko hoku ʻOtua, ko e tuʻi;
pea te u fakafetaʻi ki ho huafa ʻo lauikuongapea taʻengata.

Te u fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē;
pea te u fakamālōki ho huafa ʻo lauikuongapea taʻengata.

‌ʻOku lahi ʻa Sihova, pea ʻoku ngali ke faʻa fakamālōkiate ia;
pea ko hono lahi ʻoku taʻefaʻaʻiloʻi.

‌ʻE fakamālōʻae toʻutangata ʻe taha ki hoʻo ngaahi ngāue ʻo aʻu ki he taha,
pea tenau fakahāhoʻo ngaahi ngāue lahi.

Te u lea ki hono ongoongolelei lahi ʻo hoʻo ʻafio,
pea mo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakaofo.

Pea ʻe leaʻaekakai ki hono mālohi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi ngāue fakailifia:
pea te u fakahāhoʻo māfimafi.

Tenau faʻa fakahāʻae fakamanatu ʻo hoʻo ʻulungāanga lelei lahi,
pea tenau hiva ʻaki hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.

‌ʻOku angalelei ʻa Sihova, pea fonu ʻi he manavaʻofa;
ʻoku tōʻohi hono houhau, pea ʻoku lahi ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.

‌ʻOku angalelei ʻa Sihova ki he kakai kotoa pē:
pea ʻoku kāpui ʻene ngāue kotoa pēʻe heʻene ngaahi ʻaloʻofa ongongofua.

‌ʻE Sihova, ʻe fakamālōkiate koe ʻa hoʻo ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē;
pea ʻe fakafetaʻi kiate koe ʻa hoʻo kakai māʻoniʻoni.

Tenau lea ki he nāunau ʻo ho puleʻanga,
pea talanoa ki hoʻo māfimafi;

Ke fakaʻilo ki he ngaahi foha ʻoe tangata ʻene ngaahi ngāue lahi,
pea mo e ongoongolelei lahi ʻo hono puleʻanga.

Ko ho puleʻanga ko e puleʻanga taʻengata,
pea ko hoʻo pule ʻoku tolonga ia ʻi he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku poupou hake ʻe Sihova ʻakinautolukotoa pēkuo hinga,
pea ʻoku ne fokotuʻu ʻakinautolukotoa pēkuo mapelu ki lalo.

‌ʻOku hanga ʻae ngaahi mata kotoa pēkiate koe;
pea ʻoku ke foaki ʻenau meʻakai ʻi he feituʻulaʻātotonu.

‌ʻOku ke mafola ho nima,
mo fakamākona ʻae holi ʻae meʻa moʻui kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku angatonu ʻa Sihova ʻi hono hala kotoa pē,
pea māʻoniʻoni ʻi heʻene ngaahi ngāue kotoa pē.

‌ʻOku ofi ʻa Sihova kiate kinautolukotoa pēkuo ui ki heʻene ʻafio,
kiate kinautolukotoa pēʻoku nau ui kiate ia ʻi he moʻoni.

Te ne fai ki he holi ʻanautoluʻoku manavahēkiate ia:
ʻe fanongo foki ia ki heʻenau tangi, pea te ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.

‌ʻOku fakamoʻui ʻe Sihova ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻoku nau ʻofa kiate ia:
ka ko e angakovi kotoa pēte ne fakaʻauha.

‌ʻE lea ʻaki ʻe hoku ngutu ʻae fakamālōkia Sihova:
pea tuku ke fakafetaʻi ʻae kakano kotoa pēki hono huafa māʻoniʻoni ʻo lauikuongapea taʻengata.
146:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
Fakamālōkia Sihova, ʻE hoku laumālie.

Teu fakamālōkia Sihova ʻi heʻeku kei moʻui:
teu hiva fakamālōki hoku ʻOtua ʻi he lolotonga ʻo ʻeku moʻui.

‌ʻOua naʻa mou falala ki he ngaahi ʻeiki,
pe ki he foha ʻoe tangata, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ha fakamoʻui ʻiate ia.

‌ʻOku mole atu ʻene mānava, pea ʻoku foki ia ki he kelekele;
ʻoku mole ai ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻene ngaahi mahalo.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ia ʻaia ʻoku ne maʻu ʻae ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope ko hono tokoni,
pea ko ʻene ʻamanaki lelei ʻoku ʻia Sihova ko hono ʻOtua:

‌ʻAia naʻa ne ngaohi ʻae langi, mo māmani,
ʻae tahi mo e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ʻi ai:
pea ʻoku ne tauhi ʻae moʻoni ʻo lauikuonga:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne fai ʻae fakamaau koeʻuhi ko e kakai fakamālohia:
ʻoku ne foaki ʻae meʻakai ki he fiekaia. ʻOku vete ʻe Sihova ʻae kau pōpula:

‌ʻOku fakaʻāʻe Sihova ʻae kui:
ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻe Sihova ʻakinautolukuo mapelu ki lalo:
ʻoku ʻofa ʻa Sihova ki he angatonu:

‌ʻE pule ʻa Sihova ʻo taʻengata,
ʻio, ko ho ʻOtua, ʻE Saione,
ʻi he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
147:
‌ʻOku langa hake ʻe Sihova ʻa Selūsalema:
ʻoku ne tānaki fakataha ʻae kau ʻIsileli naʻe fakahēʻi

‌ʻOku ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautoluʻoku loto mafesi,
ʻo ne nonoʻo honau ngaahi lavea.

‌ʻOku ne tala hono lau ʻoe ngaahi fetuʻu;
ʻoku ne ui ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻi honau ngaahi hingoa.

Ko hotau ʻEiki ʻoku lahi ia,
pea lahi hono mālohi:
ko ʻene ʻilo ʻoku taʻengata.

‌ʻOku hiki hake ʻe Sihova ʻae angamalū:
ʻoku līʻe ia ʻae angahala ki he kelekele.

Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae fakafetaʻi;
hiva fakamālōʻi he haʻape ki hotau ʻOtua:

‌ʻAia ʻoku ne ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻae langi ʻae ngaahi ʻao,
ʻoku ne teuteu ʻae ʻuha ki he kelekele,
mo ne fakatupu ʻae mohuku ʻi he ngaahi moʻunga.

‌ʻOku ne foaki ki he manu ʻene meʻakai,
pea ki he fanga leveni iiki ʻaia ʻoku tangi.

‌ʻOku ʻikai fiefia ia ʻi he mālohi ʻoe hoosi:
ʻoku ʻikai fiefia ia ʻi he kau vaʻe ʻoe tangata.

‌ʻOku fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻiate kinautoluʻoku nau manavahēkiate ia,
ʻiate kinautoluʻoku nau ʻamanaki ki heʻene ʻaloʻofa.

Fakamālōkia Sihova, ʻE Selūsalema;
fakamālōki ho ʻOtua, ʻE Saione.

He kuo ne fakamālohi ʻae ngaahi songo ʻo ho ngaahi matapā;
kuo ne tāpuakiʻi hoʻo fānau ʻi loto ʻiate koe.

‌ʻOku fakatupu ʻe ia ʻae melino ʻi ho ngaahi potu,
pea ʻoku ne fakamahu ʻaki koe ʻae uite ʻoku fungani lelei.

‌ʻOku ne tuku atu ʻene fekau ki māmani:
ʻoku vave ʻaupitoʻae lele atu ʻo ʻene folofola,

‌ʻOku ne foaki ʻae ʻuha hinehina ʻo hangēko e fulufuluʻi sipi:
ʻoku ne tūtuuʻi ʻae hahau kuo fefeka ʻo hangēko e efuefu.

‌ʻOku ne laku atu ʻae ʻuha maka ʻo hangēko e ngaahi momoʻi meʻa siʻi:
ko hai ʻe faʻa kātaki hono momoko?

‌ʻOku ne fekau atu ʻene folofola, pea ʻoku vai ai ia:
ʻoku ne pule ke angi ʻene matangi, pea ʻoku tafe atu ʻae ngaahi vai.

‌ʻOku ne fakahāʻene folofola kia Sēkope,
ʻa ʻene ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni mo ʻene ngaahi fakamaau ki ʻIsileli.

Naʻe ʻikai te ne fai pehēki ha puleʻanga ʻe taha:
pea ko ʻene ngaahi fakamaau, naʻe ʻikai tenau ʻilo ki ai.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
148:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova. Mou fakamālōkia Sihova mei he ngaahi langi:
fakamālōki heʻene ʻafio ʻi he ngaahi potu māʻolunga.

Mou fakamālōkiate ia, ʻa ʻene kau ʻāngelo kotoa pē:
mou fakamālōkiate ia, ʻa ʻene ngaahi kautau kotoa pē.

Mo fakamālōkiate ia, ʻae laʻāmo e māhina:
mou fakamālōkiate ia, ʻae ngaahi fetuʻu kotoa pēʻoe maama.

Mou fakamālōkiate ia, ʻae ngaahi langi ʻoe ngaahi langi,
mo e ngaahi vai ʻoku māʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi langi.

Kenau fakamālōki he huafa ʻo Sihova:
he naʻe fekau ʻe ia, pea naʻe fakatupu ʻakinautolu.

Pea kuo ne fokotuʻumaʻu ʻakinautoluʻo lauikuongapea taʻengata.
Kuo ne tuʻutuʻuni pea ʻe ʻikai mole ia.

Fakamālōkia Sihova mei māmani,
ʻae fanga talākoni, mo e ngaahi loloto kotoa pē:

‌ʻAe afi, mo e ʻuha maka; ʻae ʻuha hinehina, mo e ngaahi kakapu;
ʻae matangi mālohi ʻoku fakamoʻoni ki heʻene folofola:

‌ʻAe ngaahi moʻunga, mo e ngaahi foʻi moʻunga kotoa pē;
ʻae ngaahi ʻakau fua, mo e ngaahi sita kotoa pē:

‌ʻAe ngaahi tuʻi ʻo māmani, mo e kakai kotoa pē;
ʻae ngaahi ʻeiki, mo e kau fakamaau kotoa pēʻo māmani:

‌ʻAe kau tangata talavou, mo e kau taʻahine;
ʻae kau mātuʻa, mo e fānau:

‌ʻOku hiki hake foki ʻe ia ʻae nifo ʻo hono kakai,
ko ia ʻoku fakamālōai ʻa ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni kotoa pē;
ʻio, ʻa hono kakai ko ʻIsileli,
ko e kakai ʻoku ofi kiate ia.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
149:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
Hiva kia Sihova ʻaki ʻae hiva foʻou,
mo e fakamālōkiate ia ʻi he fakataha ʻoe kakai māʻoniʻoni.

Ke fiefia ʻa ʻIsileli ʻiate ia naʻa ne ngaohi ia:
ke fiefia ʻae fānau ʻa Saione ʻi honau Tuʻi.

Kenau fakamālōki hono huafa ʻi he meʻe:
kenau hiva fakamālōkiate ia ʻaki ʻae lali iiki mo e haʻape.

He ʻoku fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻi hono kakai
te ne teuteu ʻae angamalūʻaki ʻae fakamoʻui.

Ke fiefia ʻae kakai māʻoniʻoni ʻi he nāunau:
kenau hiva kalanga,
ʻi honau ngaahi mohenga.
Ke ʻi honau ngutu ʻae fakamālōlahi ki he ʻOtua, pea ʻi honau nima ʻae heletāʻoku fakatoumata;

Ke ʻatu ʻae totongi ki he hiteni,
mo e ngaahi tautea ki he kakai:

Ke haʻisia honau ngaahi tuʻi ʻaki ʻaeukamea fihifihi,
mo honau houʻeiki ʻaki ʻae ngaahi haʻiukamea;

Ke fai kiate kinautoluʻae fakamaau kuo tohi:
kuo pehēʻae hakeakiʻi ʻo ʻene kakai māʻoniʻoni kotoa pē.
Mou fakamālōkia Sihova.
150:
MOU fakamālōkia Sihova.
Fakamālōkia Sihova ʻi hono faletapu:
fakamālōki heʻene ʻafio ʻi he ʻatāʻo hono mālohi.

Fakamālōkiate ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene ngaahi ngāue lahi:
fakamālōkiate ia ʻo fakatatau mo hono lahi ʻo ʻene māfimafi.

Fakamālōkiate ia ʻaki ʻae leʻo ʻoe meʻa lea:
fakamālōkiate ia ʻaki ʻae saliteli mo e haʻape.

Fakamālōkiate ia ʻaki ʻae lali iiki mo e meʻe:
fakamālōkiate ia ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa faiva mo e ngaahi meʻa ifi.

Fakamālōkiate ia ʻaki ʻae simipale tatangi:
fakamālōki heʻene ʻafio ʻaki ʻae ngaahi simipale ʻoku leʻo lahi.

Ke fakamālōkia Sihova ʻae meʻa kotoa pēʻoku mānava.
Haleluia.

1: KO E ngaahi lea fakatātāʻa Solomone ko e foha ʻo Tevita, ko e tuʻi ʻo ʻIsileli;

Ke ʻilo ai ʻae poto mo e akonaki;
pea ongoʻi ʻae ngaahi lea ʻoe faʻa ʻilo;

Ke maʻu ʻae akonaki ʻoe poto,
mo e angatonu, mo e fakamaau, pea mo e fai totonu;
