Ko ia ʻoku ai ʻae telinga ke ongo, ke ongoʻi ia.
¶“Ka te u fakatatau ʻae toʻutangata ni ki he hā? ʻOku tatau ia mo e tamaiki ʻoku nofo ʻi he potu fakatau, ʻoku nau ui ki honau niʻihi,
‌ʻO pehē, ‘Naʻa mau ifi fangufangu kiate kimoutolu, pea ʻikai te mou meʻe; naʻa mauhivafakatangi kiate kimoutolu, kae ʻikai te mou tangi.’
He naʻe ʻikai haʻu ʻa Sione ʻo kai mo inu, pea nau pehē, ‘ʻOku ʻiate ia ha tēvolo.’

Ka kuo haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻo kai mo inu, pea nau pehē, ‘Vakai, ko e tangata faʻa kai, mo faʻa inuuaine, ko e kāinga ʻoe kau tānaki tukuhau mo e angahala.’Ka ʻoku fakatonuhia ʻae poto ʻe heʻene fānau.”
¶Pea toki kamata valoki ʻe ia ki he ngaahi kolo naʻe fai lahi ai ʻene ngaahi ngāue mana, koeʻuhi ko ʻenau taʻefakatomala:

“ʻE malaʻia ʻa koe, Kolesini! ʻE malaʻia ʻa koe, Peteseta! He ka ne fai ʻi Taia mo Saitone ʻae ngaahi ngāue lahi, ʻaia kuo fai ʻiate kimoutolu, pehē, kuo loa ʻenau fakatomala ʻi he tauangaʻa mo e efuefu.
Ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻe kātakingofua ʻa Taia mo Saitone ʻi he ʻaho fakamaau ʻiate kimoutolu.
Pea ko Koe Kapaneume, ʻa Koe kuo hiki ki he langi, ʻe fakahifo Koe ki heli: he ka ne fai ʻi Sotoma ʻae ngaahi ngāue lahi, ʻaia kuo fai ʻiate koe, pehē, kuo tuʻumaʻu ia ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho ni.
Ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE kātakingofua ʻae fonua ko Sotoma ʻi he ʻaho fakamaau ʻiate koe.”

¶Pea lea ʻa Sisu ʻi he ʻaho ko ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ou fakafetaʻi kiate koe, ʻe Tamai, ko e ʻEiki ʻoe langi mo māmani, ʻi hoʻo fufūʻae ngaahi meʻa ni mei he kau poto mo e fieʻiloʻilo, ka kuo ke fakahāia ki he kau valevale.
Ke pehē, ʻe Tamai: he ʻoku lelei ia ʻi ho ʻao ke pehē.

“Kuo tuku ʻae meʻa kotoa pēkiate au ʻe heʻeku Tamai: pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo ʻae ʻAlo ʻe ha taha, ka ko e Tamai pe; pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo ʻae Tamai ʻe ha taha, ka ko e ʻAlo pe, mo ia ʻe fakahāia ki ai ʻe he ʻAlo.
¶“Haʻu kiate au ʻakimoutolukotoa pēʻoku feinga mo māfasia, pea te u foaki ʻae fiemālie kiate kimoutolu.
Toʻo ʻeku haʻamonga kiate kimoutolu, pea mou ako ʻiate au; he ʻoku ou angavaivai mo angamalū: pea te mou ʻilo ai ʻae fiemālie ki homou laumālie.
He ʻoku faingofua pe ʻeku haʻamonga, pea ʻoku maʻamaʻa ʻeku kavenga.”
12: NAʻE ʻalu ʻa Sisu ʻi he kuongako ia ʻi he ngoue uite ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate; pea naʻe fiekaia ʻene kau ākonga, ʻonau kamata toli ʻae fua ʻoe uite, ʻo kai.
Ka ʻi he mamata ki ai ʻae kau Fālesi, naʻa nau pehēkiate ia, “Vakai, ʻoku fai ʻe hoʻo kau ākonga ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ngofua ke fai ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate.”
Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, Naʻe ʻikai te mou lau ʻaia naʻe fai ʻe Tevita, ʻi heʻene fiekaia, mo kinautolunaʻe ʻiate ia;
‌ʻA ʻene hūki he fale ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻo ne kai ʻae māʻoe ʻao, ʻaia naʻe ʻikai ngofua ke ne kai, pe ko kinautolunaʻe ʻiate ia, ka ko e kau taulaʻeiki pe?
Naʻe ʻikai te mou lau ʻi he fono, ʻoku fai taʻehalaia ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki ʻi he falelotu lahi ʻaia ʻoku kovi ke fai ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho Sāpate?
Ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻoku ʻi he potu ni ha taha ʻoku lahi ʻi he falelotu lahi.
Pea ka ne mou ʻilo hono ʻuhinga ʻoelea ni, ‘ʻE ʻikai te u lelei lahi ʻi he feilaulau, ka ʻi he lotoʻofa,’pehē, ne ʻikai te mou tukuekina ʻae taʻehalaia.
He ko e Foha ʻoe tangata ko e ʻEiki ia ʻoe ʻaho Sāpate foki.”
¶Pea kuo ʻalu ia mei ai, pea hūia ki honau falelotu.
Pea vakai, naʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangata kuo mate hono nima. Pea nau fehuʻi kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ngofua ke fakamoʻui ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho Sāpate?”Koeʻuhi ke nau fakakoviʻi ia.
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko e tangata fēʻiate kimoutolu, ʻoku taha pe ʻene sipi, pea ka tōia ki ha luo ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate, ʻe ʻikai te ne puke ia, ʻo toʻo hake?
Pea ʻikai ʻoku lelei lahi ʻae tangata ʻi he sipi? Ko ia, ʻoku ngofua ke fai lelei ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate.”
Pea toki pehēʻe ia ki he tangata, “Mafao atu ho nima.”Pea ne mafao atuia; pea fakamoʻui ia, ʻo hangēkohono nimaʻe taha.
¶Pea toki ʻalu kituʻa ʻae kau Fālesi, ʻonau fakakaukau, pe fēfēʻenau tāmateʻi ia.
Ka ʻi he ʻilo ia ʻe Sisu, naʻa ne ʻalu mei ai: pea muimuiʻiate ia ʻae kakai tokolahi, pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolukotoa pē;
Pea ne fekau kiate kinautoluke ʻoua naʻa nau fakaʻilo ia:
Koeʻuhi ke fakamoʻoni ʻaia naʻe lea ʻaki ʻe he palōfita ko ʻIsaia, ʻo pehē,

“Vakai ki heʻeku tamaioʻeiki, ʻaia kuo u fili;
ʻoku ou ʻofa ai, pea ʻoku mālieʻia ai hoku laumālie:
Te u tuku hoku laumālie kiate ia,
pea te ne fakahāʻae ngaahi fekau ki he Senitaile.

‌ʻE ʻikai fakakikihi ia, pe kalanga;
pea ʻe ʻikai fanongo ʻe ha taha ki hono leʻo ʻi he hala.

‌ʻE ʻikai te ne fesiʻi ha kaho kuo volu,
pe tāmateʻi ʻae maama ʻoku kohu pē,
kaeʻoua ke mālohi ia ʻi he fofola ʻo ʻene ngaahi fekau.
Pea ʻe falala ʻae Senitaile ki hono huafa.”
¶Pea naʻe toki ʻomi ai kiate ia ʻae tokotaha naʻe kui mo noa, kuo ʻulusinoai ʻae tēvolo: pea naʻa ne fakamoʻui ia, ko ia naʻe lea mo ʻāai ʻaia naʻe kui mo noa.
Pea ofo ʻae kakai kotoa pē, ʻonau pehē,“ʻIkai ko e Foha eni ʻo Tevita?”
Ka ʻi he fanongo ki ai ʻae kau Fālesi, naʻa nau pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai kapusi ʻae tēvolo ʻe he siana ni, kae ʻia Pelisipupe ko e ʻeiki ʻoe kau tēvolo.”
Pea ʻilo ʻe Sisu ʻenau mahalo, pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko e puleʻanga kotoa pēʻoku feʻiteʻitani, ʻe ʻauha ia; pea ko e kolo mo e fale kotoa pēkuo feʻiteʻitani, ʻe ʻikai tuʻu ia:
Pea kapau ʻoku kapusi ʻe Sētane ʻa Sētane, kuo fehiʻa ia kiate ia.; pea ʻe tuʻu fēfēʻa hono puleʻanga?
Pea kapau ʻoku ou kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ʻia Pelisipupe, ʻoku kapusiʻakinautoluʻe hoʻomou fānau ʻia hai? Ko ia ko homou kau fakamaau ʻakinautolu.
Pea kapau ʻoku ou kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ʻi he Laumālie ʻoe ʻOtua, pea tākuo hoko mai ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua kiate kimoutolu.
“ʻE faʻa hūfēfēha taha ki he fale ʻoe tokotaha mālohi, ʻo kaihaʻasi ʻene ngaahi meʻa ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai te ne tomuʻa haʻi ʻae tokotaha mālohi? Pea te ne toki kaihaʻasi ʻene koloa.
Ko ia ʻoku ʻikai kau mo au, ʻoku angatuʻu ia kiate au; pea ko ia ʻoku ʻikai te ma tānaki mo au, ʻoku ne fakahēke mamaʻo.
¶“Ko ia ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e angahala kotoa pēmo e lohiakiʻi, ʻe fakamolemole ia ki he kakai: ka ko e lohiakiʻi ʻoe LaumālieMāʻoniʻoni, ʻe ʻikai fakamolemolea ia ki he kakai.
Pea ko ia ʻoku ne lea kovi ki he Foha ʻoe tangata, ʻe fakamolemolea ia: ka ko ia ʻoku lea kovi ki he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni, ʻe ʻikai fakamolemolea, ʻi he māmani, peʻi he maamaʻe haʻu.
“Ke pehē, ʻoku lelei ʻae ʻakau, pea lelei mo hono fua; pe pehē, ʻoku kovi ʻae ʻakau, pea kovi mo hono fua: he ʻoku ʻilo ʻae ʻakau ʻi hono fua.
‌ʻAe hako ʻoe ngata fekai! ʻE fēfeeʻi hoʻomou faʻa lea lelei, ka ʻoku mou kovi pe? He ʻoku lea ʻae ngutu mei he meʻa lahi ʻoku ʻi he loto.
‌ʻOku ʻomi ʻe he tangata angalelei ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei mei he koloa leleiʻoe loto: pea ʻoku ʻomi ʻe he tangata angakovi ʻae ngaahi meʻa kovi mei he koloa koviʻoe loto.
“Ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e lea kovi kotoa pēʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe he kakai, ʻe fakamaau ai ʻakinautoluʻi he ʻaho fakamaau.
Koeʻuhi ʻe fakatonuhiaʻi koe ʻe hoʻo ngaahi lea, pea ʻe fakahalaiaʻi koe ʻe hoʻo ngaahi lea.”
¶Pea toki leaange ʻae niʻihi ʻoe kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻoku mau fie mamata ki ha fakaʻilonga meiate koe.”
Ka naʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko e toʻutangata kovi mo feʻauaki ʻoku holi ki ha fakaʻilonga; ka ʻoku ʻikai ha fakaʻilonga ʻe tuku ki ai, ka ko e fakaʻilonga ʻoe palōfita ko Siona;
He naʻe ʻaho tolu mo e pōʻe tolu ʻa Siona ʻi he kete ʻoe ika lahi: pea pehē, ʻe ʻaho tolu mo e pōʻe tolu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻi lalo fonua.
‌ʻE tuʻu hake ʻae kakai ʻo Ninive ʻi he fakamaau mo e toʻutangata ni, ʻo fakahalaia ia: koeʻuhi naʻa nau fakatomala ʻi he malanga ʻa Siona; pea vakai, ʻoku ʻi heni ʻaia ʻoku lahi ʻia Siona.

‌ʻE tuʻu hake ʻae tuʻi fefine ʻoe feituʻu tonga ʻi he fakamaau mo e toʻutangata ni, ʻo fakahalaia ia: he naʻe haʻu ia mei he potu mamaʻo ʻo māmani ke fanongo ki he poto ʻa Solomone; pea vakai, ʻoku ʻi heni ʻaia ʻoku lahi ʻia Solomone.
“ʻOka ʻalu ʻae laumālie ʻuli mei he tangata, ʻoku ʻalu fano ia ʻi he potu mōmoa ʻo kumi mālōloʻanga, kae ʻikai ʻilo ia.
Pea toki pehēʻe ia, Te u toe ʻalu ki hoku fale ne u haʻu mei ai; pea ka haʻu ia, ʻoku ne ʻilo ia kuo liʻaki, pea kuo tafi pea teuteu.

Pea toki ʻalu ia, ʻo ʻomi mo e laumālie ʻe toko fitu kehe ʻoku kovi lahi ʻiate ia, pea nau hūʻo nofo ki ai: pea kovi lahi ʻa eangaki mui ʻae tangata ko ia ʻi heʻeneangaʻi muʻa. Pea ʻe pehēpe foki ki he toʻutangata angakovi ni.”
¶Pea ʻi heʻene kei lea ki he kakai, vakai, ko ʻene faʻēmo hono ngaahi kāinga naʻa nau tutuʻu ʻituʻa, ʻonau fie lea kiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe ha taha kiate ia, “Vakai, ʻoku tuʻu ʻituʻa hoʻo faʻēmo ho kāinga, ko ʻenau fie lea kiate koe.”
Pea ne lea, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, naʻa ne fakahāmai, “Ko hai ʻeku faʻē? Pea ko hai mo hoku kāinga?”
Pea mafao atu ʻe ia hono nima ki heʻene kau ākonga, ʻo ne pehē, “Vakai, ko ʻeku faʻēmo hoku kāinga!
He ko ia ia te ne fai ʻae finangalo ʻo ʻeku Tamai ʻoku ʻi he langi, ko hoku tokoua ia, mohokutuofefine, moʻekufaʻē.”
13: NAʻE ʻalu ʻa Sisu ʻi he ʻaho ko ia mei he fale, ʻo nofo ʻi he matātahi.
Pea kātoa kiate ia ʻae kakai tokolahi, ka ka ʻalu ia ki ha vaka, ʻo nofo ai; ka naʻe tutuʻu ʻae kakai kotoa pēki ʻuta.
Pea lahi ʻae ngaahi meʻa naʻa ne lea ʻaki kiate kinautoluʻi he lea fakatātā, ʻo pehē, “Vakai, naʻe ʻalu atu ʻae tangata tūtuuʻi ke tūtuuʻi;
“Pea ʻi heʻene tūtuuʻi, naʻe mokulu ʻaetenganiʻihi ʻi he veʻe hala, pea haʻu ʻae fanga manupunaʻo kai ʻo ʻosi ia.
Pea mokulu ʻae niʻihi ʻi he potu makamaka, naʻe siʻi ai ʻae kelekele; pea tupu leva ia, koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai matolu ʻae kelekele;
Pea ʻi he ʻalu hake ʻae laʻā, naʻe vela ia; pea koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai hano aka, ne mate ia.
Pea mokulu ʻae niʻihi ʻi he ʻakau talatala, pea tupu ʻae ʻakau talatala, ʻo fakakāsia ia.
Ka naʻe mokulu ʻae niʻihi ki he kelekele lelei, pea tupu ai ʻae fua, ko e taki teau ʻae niʻihi, pea onongofulu ʻae niʻihi, mo e tolungofulu ʻae niʻihi.”
“Ko ia ʻoku ne telinga ongo, ke ongoʻi ia.”
Pea haʻu ʻae kau ākonga, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “Ko e hāʻoku ke lea ai kiate kinautoluʻi he ngaahi fakatātā?”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Koeʻuhi kuo tuku kiate kimoutoluke ʻilo ʻae ngaahi meʻa lilo ʻoe puleʻanga ʻoe langi, ka ʻoku ʻikai tuku kiate kinautolu.
He ko ia ʻoku ne maʻu, ʻe toe foaki kiate ia, pea te ne maʻu ʻo lahi; ka ko ia ʻoku ʻikai maʻu, ʻe toʻo meiate ia ʻaia ʻoku ne maʻu.
Ko ia ʻoku ou lea ai kiate kinautoluʻi he ngaahi fakatātā: koeʻuhi ʻoku nau ʻā, kae ʻikai mamata; pea ʻoku nau fanongo, kae ʻikai ongoʻi, pea ʻoku ʻikai te nau ʻilo.

Pea kuo fakamoʻoni ʻiate kinautoluʻae lea ʻa ʻIsaia, ʻoku pehē,
‘Te mou fakaongoongo pea fanongo,
kae ʻikai ongoʻi;
pea te mou siofia ʻo mamata,
kae ʻikai ʻiloʻi:

He kuo fakaongonoa ʻae loto ʻoe kakai ni,
pea kuo tuli honau telinga,
pea kuo nau fakamohe honau mata:
telia naʻa ʻiloange kuo mamata honau mata,
pea ongoʻi honau telinga, pea ʻilo ʻe honau loto,
pea liliu ai,
pea te u fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.’
“Ka ʻoku monūʻia homou mata, he ʻoku nau mamata: mo homou telinga, he ʻoku nau ongoʻi.

He ʻoku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku tokolahi ʻae palōfita mo e tangata māʻoniʻoni, naʻe holi ke mamata ʻaia ʻoku mou mamataai, ka naʻe ʻikai te nau mamata, pea ke fanongo ʻaia ʻoku mou fanongoai, ka naʻe ʻikai te nau fanongo.
¶“Ko ia ke fanongo ʻakimoutoluki he fakatātāʻoe tangata tūtuuʻi.

‌ʻOka fanongo ʻe ha taha ki he folofola ʻoe puleʻanga, ka ʻoku ʻikai tokanga ki ai, ʻoku haʻu ʻae tokotaha angakovi, ʻo faʻao ʻaia naʻe tūtuuʻi ki hono loto. Ko eni ia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae tenga ʻi he veʻe hala.
Ka ko ia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae tenga ʻi hepotu maka, ko ia ʻoku ne fanongo ki he folofola, pea maʻu fiefia leva ia;
Ka ʻoku ʻikai aka ia ʻiate ia, pea ʻoku tolonga siʻi pe ia: he ʻoka hoko ʻae mamahi pe ʻae fakatanga koeʻuhi ko e folofola, ʻoku hinga leva ia.

Pea ko ia foki naʻa ne maʻu ʻae tenga ʻi he ʻakau talatala, ko ia ia ʻoku ne fanongo ki he folofola; ka ko e tokanga ki māmani, mo e fakaheke ʻe he koloa, ʻoku ne fakakāsiaʻi ʻae folofola, pea taʻefua ai ia.

Ka ko ia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae tenga ʻi he kelekele lelei, ko ia ia ʻoku ne fanongo ki he folofola, pea tokangaʻi; pea tupu ai hono fua, ʻo taki teau ʻi he niʻihi, pea onongofulu ʻi he niʻihi, mo tolungofulu ʻi he niʻihi.”
¶Pea fakahāatu ʻe ia kiate kinautoluʻae fakatātāʻe taha, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e tangata naʻa ne tūtuuʻi ʻae tenga lelei ki heʻene ngoue:
Pea lolotonga ʻae mohe ʻae kakai, naʻe haʻu hono fili ʻo ne tūtuuʻi ʻae tenga kovi ʻi he uite, kae ʻalu ia.
Pea kuo tupu hake hono muka, pea kamata fua, pea toki hāai foki ʻae ʻakau kovi.
Pea haʻu ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki ʻae ʻeiki, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, ‘ʻEiki, ʻikai naʻa ke tūtuuʻi ʻae tenga lelei ki hoʻo ngoue? Pea kuo tupu mei fēʻae ʻakau kovi?’
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ‘Ko e fili kuo ne fai eni.’Pea pehēʻe he kau tamaioʻeiki kiate ia, ‘ʻE lelei kiate koe ʻemau ʻalu ʻo taʻaki iamei ai?’
Ka naʻe pehēange ʻe ia, ‘ʻE ʻikai; telia ʻi hoʻomou taʻaki ʻae ʻakau kovi, ʻe mataʻaki ai mo e uite foki.
Tuku ke na tupu fakataha ʻo aʻu ki heututaʻu: pea ʻi he fai ʻoeututaʻu te u tala ki he kau tuʻusi, Mou tomuʻa tānaki ʻae ʻakau kovi, ʻo noʻo ʻūke tutu ia: kae tānaki ʻae uite ki hoku feleoko.’|”
¶Pea fakahāatu ʻe ia kiate kinautoluʻae fakatātāʻe taha, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e foʻi tengaʻi musita, ʻaia naʻe tōʻe ha tangata ʻi heʻene ngoue.
‌ʻAia ʻoku siʻi hifo ʻi he tengaʻiʻakaukotoa pē: ka ʻoka tupu ia, ʻoku lahi taha pe ʻi he faʻahinga ʻakau iiki, pea hoko ia ko efuʻuʻakau, ke tuʻu ʻae fanga manu ʻoe ʻatāʻi hono ngaahi vaʻa.”

¶Pea lea ʻaki ʻe ia kiate kinautoluʻae fakatātāʻe taha; “ʻOku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e meʻa fakatupu, naʻe toʻo ʻe ha fefine, ʻo ʻai ki he fua mahoaʻa ʻe tolu, ke ʻoua ke fakatupu kotoa pēia.”
Naʻe lea ʻaki ʻe Sisu ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēki he kakai ʻi he fakatātā; pea naʻe ʻikai lea ia kiate kinautoluka ʻi he fakatātāpe:
Pea toki fekau ʻe Sisu ke ʻalu ʻae kakai, pea hūia ki he fale: pea haʻu kiate ia ʻene kau ākonga, ʻonau pehē, “Fakamatala kiate kimautoluʻae fakatātāʻoe tenga kovi ʻi he ngoue.”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko ia naʻa ne tūtuuʻi ʻae tenga lelei, ko e Foha ia ʻoe tangata;
Ko e ngoue, ko māmani ia; ko e tenga lelei, ko e fānau ia ʻoe puleʻanga; ka ko e tenga kovi, ko e fānau ia ʻae tokotaha angakovi;
Ko e fili naʻa ne tūtuuʻi ia, ko e tēvolo ia; ko eututaʻu, ko e ikuʻanga ʻo māmani; pea ko e kau tuʻusi, ko e kau ʻāngelo.
Ko ia ʻo hangēʻoku tānaki ʻae ʻakau kovi ʻo tutu ʻi he afi; ʻe pehēfoki ʻi he ikuʻanga ʻoe māmani.
‌ʻE fekau atu ʻe he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻene kau ʻāngelo, pea te nau tānaki mei hono puleʻanga ʻae meʻa kotoa pēʻoku fakakovi, mo kinautoluʻoku fai angahala;
Pea ʻe laku ʻakinautoluki he pupuʻa afi: pea ʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangi mo e fengaiʻitaki ʻoe nifo.
Pea ʻe toki ulo atu ʻae māʻoniʻoni ʻo hangēko e laʻāʻi he puleʻanga ʻo ʻenau Tamai. Ko ia ʻoku ne telinga ongo, ke ongoʻi ia.

¶“Ko e taha, ʻoku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e koloa kuo fufūʻi ha ngoue; ʻaia ka ʻilo ʻe ha tangata, ʻoku ne fufūia, pea ʻalu fiefia ai, ʻo ne fakatau ʻene meʻa kotoa pē, ke fakatauʻaki ʻae ngoue ko ia.
¶“Ko e taha, ʻoku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e tangata fakatau, ʻoku kumi mataʻitofe lelei:
‌ʻAia, ʻi heʻene ʻilo ʻae mataʻitofe mahuʻinga lahi, ʻoku ʻalu ia, ʻo ne fakatau ʻene meʻa kotoa pē, ke fakatauʻaki ia.
¶“Ko e taha, ʻoku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e kupenga, naʻe ʻaʻau ʻi tahi, pea tau aiʻae ngaahi ikakehekehe:
Pea kuo fonu ia, pea nau taki ki ʻuta, pea nofo ʻo tānaki ʻae lelei ki he ngaahi kato, kae liʻaki ʻae kovi.
‌ʻE pehēfoki ʻi he ikuʻanga ʻo māmani ʻe haʻu ʻae kau ʻāngelo, ʻo vaheʻi ʻae angahala mei he angatonu,
‌ʻO laku ʻakinautoluki he pupuʻa afi; pea ʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangi mo e fengaiʻitaki ʻoe nifo.”
Pea pehēai ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku mou ʻilo ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē?”Pea nau talaange kiate ia, “ʻIo, ʻEiki.”

Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko ia ko e akonaki kotoa pēkuo akonekina ki he puleʻanga ʻoe langi, ʻoku tatau ia mo e tangata ko e ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ʻaia ʻoku ʻomi mei heʻene koloa ʻae ngaahi meʻa foʻou mo e meʻa motuʻa.”
¶Pea ʻi he fakaʻosi ʻe Sisu ʻae ngaahi fakatātāni, pea ʻalu ia mei ai.
Pea kuo haʻu ia ki hono fonua, naʻa ne akonaki ʻakinautoluʻi honau falelotu: ko ia ne nau ofo lahi ai, ʻonau pehē, “ʻOku mei fēʻae poto mo e ngaahi ngāue lahi ʻae tangata ni?
‌ʻIkai ko e foha eni ʻoe tufunga? ʻIkai ʻoku ui ʻene faʻēko Mele? Mo hono ngaahi kāinga, ko Semisi, mo Sose, mo Saimone, mo Siutasi?
Mo hono ngaahi tuofefine kotoa pē, ʻikai ʻoku nau ʻiate kitautolu? Pea kuo maʻu mei fēʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni?”
Pea nau tūkia ʻiate ia. Ka naʻe pehēʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ʻikai masiva fakaʻapaʻapa ha palōfita, ka ʻi hono fonua pe, mo hono fale ʻoʻona.”
Pea naʻe ʻikai fai ai ʻe ia ha mana lahi ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau taʻetui.
14: ‌ʻI HE kuongako ia naʻe fanongo ʻa Helota ko e tuʻi ki he ongoongo ʻo Sisu.
Pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, “Ko Sione eni ko e Papitaiso: he kuo tuʻu hake ia mei he mate; pea ko ia ʻoku hāai ʻiate ia ʻae ngaahi ngāue lahi.”
¶He naʻe puke mo haʻi ʻe Helota ʻa Sione, ʻo tuku ia ki he fale fakapōpula, koeʻuhi ko Helotiasi, ko e ʻunohoʻo hono tokoua ko Filipe.
He naʻe pehēʻe Sione kiate ia, “ʻOku ʻikai ngofua haʻo maʻu ia.”
Pea ʻi heʻene tokanga ke tāmateʻi ia, naʻe manavahēia ki he kakai, he naʻa nau lau ia ko e palōfita.
Ka ʻi he ʻaho naʻe fakamanatuʻi ai ʻae fāʻeleʻi ʻo Helota, naʻe meʻe ʻihonauʻao ʻae taʻahine ʻa Helotiasi, pea mālieʻia ai ʻa Helota.
“Ko ia naʻa ne fuakava ai ke ne foaki kiate ia ʻaia kotoa pēte ne kole ki ai.”
Pea kuo tomuʻa akonekina ia ʻe heʻene faʻē, pea ne pehē, “Tuku mai ni kiate au ʻae ʻulu ʻo Sione ko e Papitaiso ʻi ha ipu.”
Pea mamahi ai ʻae tuʻi: ka koeʻuhi ko ʻene fuakava, mo kinautolunaʻa nau nonofo mo ia ʻi he kai, naʻa ne fekau ke ʻange iakiate ia.
Pea ne fekau ai ke tutuʻu ʻae ʻulu ʻo Sione ʻi he fale fakapōpula.
Pea naʻe ʻomi hono ʻulu ʻi he ipu, ʻo ʻoatu ki he taʻahine: pea ne ʻomi ia ki heʻene faʻē.
Pea naʻe haʻu ʻene kau ākonga, ʻo ʻave ʻae sino, mo tanu, pea ʻalu ʻo fakahākia Sisu.
Pea kuo fanongo ki ai ʻa Sisu, pea heka vaka ia, ʻo ʻalu mei he potu ko ia ki ha potu lala: pea fanongo ki ai ʻae kakai, pea nau hala ʻuta, ʻo muimuiʻiate ia mei he ngaahi kolo.
Pea ʻalu atu ʻa Sisu, ʻo ne mamata ki he kakai tokolahi, pea ʻofa mamahi ia kiate kinautolu, ʻo ne fakamoʻui ʻenau ngaahi mahaki.
¶Pea kuo efiafi ai, pea haʻu ʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko e potu lala eni, pea kuo tei ʻosi ʻae ʻaho; fekau ke ʻalu ʻae kakai ki he ngaahi potu kakai, ke fakatau meʻakai maʻanautolu.”
Ka naʻe tala ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ʻikai ʻaonga ʻenau ʻalu: mou ʻoatu haʻanau kai.”
Pea nau pehēkiate ia, “Ko e foʻi māpe ʻe nima, mo e ika ʻe ua, ʻoku tau maʻu ʻi heni.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻOmi ia kiate au.”

Pea fekau ʻe ia ki he kakai ke nofo ki lalo ki he mohuku, pea ne toʻo ʻae foʻi māʻe nima, mo e ika ʻe ua, ʻo hanga hake ki he langi, ʻo tāpuaki, mo tofitofi ʻae ngaahi foʻi mā, pea ʻoatu ki heʻene kau ākonga, peatufakiʻe he kau ākonga ki he kakai.
Pea naʻa nau kai kotoa pē, ʻo mākona: pea tānaki ʻae toenga kai, pea pito ai ʻae kato ʻe hongofulu ma ua.
Pea ko kinautolunaʻe kai, ko e tangata ʻe toko nima afe nai; kaeʻumaʻāʻae kau fefine mo e tamaiki.
¶Pea toki fekau ʻe Sisu ki heʻene kau ākonga ke nau heka vaka, ʻo muʻomuʻa ʻiate ia ki he kauvai ʻe taha, ke ne fekau ke ʻalu ʻae kakai.
Pea kuo ne fekau ʻae kakai ke ʻalu, pea ʻalu hake tokotaha pe ia ki he moʻunga ke lotu: pea hokosia ʻae efiafi, ʻoku ne kei ʻi ai tokotaha pe.
Ka kuo ʻi he vaha ʻae vaka, ʻo tōmo hopo ʻi he peau: he naʻe tokai ʻae matangi.
Pea ʻi hono fāʻoe leʻo ʻi he pōnaʻe ʻalu atu ʻa Sisu kiate kinautolu, ʻo hāʻele ʻi hefukahitahi.
Pea ʻi he mamata ʻae kau ākonga ki heʻene hāʻele ʻi hefukahitahi, naʻa nau manavahē, ʻonau pehē, “Ko e laumālie!”Pea nau tangi kalanga ʻi he manavahē.
Ka naʻe lea leva ʻa Sisu kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “Fiemālie pe; he ko au pe; ʻoua te mou manavahē.”
Pea lea ʻa Pita, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “ʻEiki, kapau ko koe, fekau mai ke u ʻalu atu kiate koe ʻi he vai.”
Pea ne pehē, “Haʻu.”Pea ʻi he ʻalu hifo ʻa Pita mei he vaka, naʻe ʻeveʻeva ia ʻi he tahi, ke ʻalu atu kia Sisu.
Ka ʻi heʻene mamata ʻoku mālohi ʻae matangi, naʻe manavahēia; pea kamata ngalo hifo, pea tangi ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, fakamoʻui au.”
Pea mafao leva ʻae nima ʻo Sisu, ʻo ne puke ia, ʻo ne pehēki ai, “ʻA koe ʻoku siʻi hoʻo tui, ko e hāʻoku ke fakataʻetaʻetui ai?’
Pea ʻi heʻena hoko ki he vaka, pea malūʻae matangi.
Pea haʻu ai ʻakinautolunaʻe ʻi he vaka, ʻo hūkiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko e moʻoni ko e ʻAlo koe ʻoe ʻOtua.”
¶Pea ʻi heʻenau hoko atu, naʻa nau tuʻu ki ʻuta ki he fonua ko Kenesaleti.
Pea kuo ʻilo ia ʻe he kakai ʻoe potu ko ia, naʻa nau fanongonongo ki he potu kotoa pēʻoe fonua ko ia, ʻo omi kiate ia ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe mahaki;
‌ʻO nau kole kiate ia ke nau ala pe ki he kapa ʻo hono kofu: pea naʻe fakamoʻui haohaoa ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ala ki ai.
15: PEA toki haʻu ʻae kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi ʻo Selūsalema, kia Sisu, ʻonau pehē,
“Ko e hāʻoku liʻaki ai ʻe hoʻo kau ākonga ʻae talatupuʻa ʻae kau mātuʻa? He ʻoku ʻikai te nau fanofano honau nima ʻoka nau ka kai mā.”
Ka naʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou liʻaki ai foki ʻae fekau ʻae ʻOtua ʻi hoʻomou talatupuʻa?
He kuo fekau ʻe he ʻOtua, ʻo pehē, ‘Fakaʻapaʻapa ki hoʻo tamai mohoʻofaʻē:’pea, ‘Ko ia ʻe kapeʻiʻenetamai pe koʻenefaʻē, tuku ke mate tāmateʻi ia.’
Ka ʻoku pehēʻekimoutolu, ‘Ko ia ʻe pehēki heʻene tamai pe ko ʻene faʻē, “Kuo fakatapui ʻaia kotoa pēʻoku ou faʻa ʻaonga ai kiate koe,”
pea ʻoku ʻikai toe fakaʻapaʻapa ia ki heʻene tamai pe ko ʻene faʻē,ʻe ʻataʻatāia.’Ko ia ʻoku mou fakataʻeʻaongaʻi ʻae fekau ʻae ʻOtua ʻaki hoʻomou talatupuʻa.
‌ʻAe kau mālualoi! Neʻineʻi lea ʻa ʻIsaia kiate kimoutolu, ʻo pehē,

Ka ʻoku taʻeʻaonga ʻenau hūkiate au,
ʻo akonaki ʻaki ʻae ngaahi fekau ʻae tangata pe.’|”
¶Pea ui ia ki he kakai, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Fanongo, pea tokanga:
‌ʻOku ʻikai fakaʻuli ki he tangata ʻaia ʻoku ʻalu ki he ngutu; ka ko ia ʻoku haʻu mei he ngutu, ʻoku ne fakaʻuliʻi ʻae tangata.”
Pea toki haʻu ai ʻene kau ākonga, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ke ʻilo naʻe tūkia ʻae kau Fālesi, ʻi heʻenau fanongo ki he lea ko ia?”
Ka naʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēange, “Ko e ʻakau kotoa pēnaʻe ʻikai tōʻe heʻeku Tamai ʻoku ʻi he langi, ʻe taʻaki fuʻu hake ia.
Tuku ai pe ʻakinautolu: ko e kau takimuʻa kui ʻoe kui ʻakinautolu. Pea kapau ʻoku tataki ʻae kui ʻe he kui, ʻe tōfakatouʻosi pe ki he luo.”
Pea lea ʻa Pita, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “Fakamatala kiate kimautoluʻae fakatātāni.”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu, “ʻOku mou kei taʻeʻilo foki?
‌ʻOku teʻeki ai te mou ʻilo, ko e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ʻalu ʻi he ngutu, ʻoku ʻalu ia ki he kete, pea toki ʻalu hifo kituʻa?
Ka ko e ngaahi meʻa ko ia ʻoku ʻalu atu ʻi he ngutu, ʻoku haʻu mei he loto: pea ko ia ia ʻoku fakaʻuliʻi ʻae tangata.
He ʻoku haʻu mei he loto ʻae mahalo kovi, mo e fakapō, mo e tono fefine, mo e feʻauaki, mo e kaihaʻa, mo e fakamoʻoni loi, mo e lea kovi:
Ko eni ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻoku fakaʻuliʻi ʻae tangata: ka ko e kai taʻefanofano nima, ʻoku ʻikai fakaʻuliʻi ia ʻae tangata.”
¶Pea toki ʻalu mei ai ʻa Sisu, ki he ngaahi potu ʻo Taia mo Saitone.
Pea vakai, naʻe haʻu ʻae fefine Kēnani mei he potu ko ia, ʻo tangi kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻAloʻofa mai kiate au, ʻe ʻEiki, ko e foha ʻo Tevita; ko ʻeku taʻahine ʻoku mamahi lahi ʻi he tēvolo.”
Ka naʻe ʻikai siʻi te ne lea kiate ia. Pea haʻu ʻene kau ākonga, ʻo kole kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Fekau ia ke ʻalu; he ʻoku ne tangi toupilimai kiate kitautolu.”
Ka naʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēange, “ʻOku ʻikai fekau au ka ki he fanga sipi he ʻoe fale ʻo ʻIsileli.”
Pea toki haʻu ia, ʻo hūkiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, tokoniʻi au.”
Ka naʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēange, “ʻOku ʻikai lelei ke toʻo ʻae māʻae fānau, pea līki he fanga kulī.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e moʻoni, ʻEiki: ka ʻoku kai ʻe he fanga kulīʻae momoʻimeʻakaiʻoku ngangana mei he keinangaʻanga ʻa honau ʻeiki.”
Pea toki lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “ʻE fefine, ʻoku lahi hoʻo tui: ke hoko kiate koe ʻo hangēko ho loto.”Pea moʻui ʻene taʻahine ʻi he feituʻulaʻāko ia.
Pea ʻalu mei ai ʻa Sisu, pea haʻu ia, ʻo ofi ki he tahi ʻo Kaleli; pea ʻalu hake ia ki he moʻunga, ʻo nofo ai.
Pea haʻu ʻae kakai tokolahi kiate ia, pea nau ʻomi ʻae pipiki, mo e kui, mo e noa, mo e lavea, mo e tokolahi kehe, ʻo tuku ʻakinautoluki he vaʻe ʻo Sisu; pea fakamoʻui ʻe ia ʻakinautolu:
Ko ia naʻe ofo lahi ai ʻae kakai, ʻi heʻenau mamata kuo fakalea ʻae noa, pea fakahaohaoa ʻae lavea, pea fakaʻeveʻeva ʻae pipiki, pea fakaʻāʻae kui: pea nau fakamālōki he ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli.

¶Pea ui ʻa Sisu ke ʻalu ange ʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOku ou ʻofa mamahi ki he kakai, koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻaho tolu ʻenau ʻiate au, pea ʻoku ʻikai haʻanau meʻa ke kai: pea ʻe ʻikai te u faʻa fekau ke nau ʻalu ʻaukai pe, telia naʻa nau pongia ʻi he hala.”
Pea lea ʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, “Te tau maʻu mei fēʻi he toafa ni ʻae mālahi, ke fakamākona ʻaki ʻae fuʻu kakai pehēni?”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku fiha hoʻomou foʻi mā?”Pea nau pehē, “ʻOku fitu, mo e fanga kihiʻi ika.”
Pea fekau ʻe ia ki he kakai ke nofo ki he kelekele.
Pea toʻo ʻe ia ʻae foʻi māʻe fitu mo e ngaahi ika, pea fai ʻae fakafetaʻi, pea tofitofi ia, ʻo ʻoatu ki heʻene kau ākonga, peatufakiʻe he kau ākonga ki he kakai.
Pea naʻa nau kai kotoa pē, pea mākona ai: pea nau tānaki ʻae toenga kai pea fonu ai ʻae kato ʻe fitu.
Pea ko kinautolunaʻe kai, ko e tangata ʻe toko fāafe, kaeʻumaʻāʻae kau fefine mo e tamaiki.
Pea fekau ʻe ia ʻae kakai ke nau ʻalu, pea heka vaka ia ʻo folau ki he potu ʻo Makitala.
16: PEA haʻu kiate ia ʻae kau Fālesi mo e Sātusi, ʻo ʻahiʻahiʻi ia ʻi heʻenau holi ke ne fakahākiate kinautoluha fakaʻilonga mei he langi.
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “ʻOka efiafi, ʻoku mou pehē, ‘ʻE ʻafua he ʻoku kulokula ʻae langi.’

Pea pongipongi ai, ‘ʻE ʻalotāmaki ʻae ʻaho ni, he ʻoku kulokula mo fetautauʻi ʻae langi.’ʻAe kau mālualoi! ʻOku mou faʻa ʻilo ki he mata ʻoe langi; ka ʻe ʻikai te mou faʻaʻiloʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻoe kuongani?
Ko e toʻutangata angakovi mo feʻauaki ʻoku kumi ʻae fakaʻilonga; pea ʻe ʻikai ha fakaʻilonga ʻe ʻoatu ki ai, ka ko e fakaʻilonga pe ʻoe palōfita ko Siona.”Pea tukuangeʻe ia ʻakinautolu, kae ʻalu.
Pea kuo hoko ʻene kau ākonga ki he kauvai ʻe taha, kuo ngalo ʻiate kinautoluke ʻomi ʻae mā.
¶Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “Mou vakai telia ʻae meʻa fakatupu ʻae kau Fālesi pea mo e Satusi.”
Pea naʻa nau fealēleaʻaki ʻo pehē, “Ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻikai te tau ʻomi ha mā.”
Pea kuo ʻilo ʻe Sisu, pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻAkimoutoluʻoku siʻi hoʻomou tui, ko e hāʻoku mou fealēleaʻaki ai, ʻi hoʻomou taʻeʻomi ha mā?
‌ʻOku ʻikai te mou ʻilo, pe manatu ki he foʻi māʻe nima ki he toko nima afe, mo e kato ʻe fiha naʻa mou ʻave?
Pe ki he foʻi māʻe fitu ki he toko fāafe, mo e kato ʻe fiha naʻa mou ʻave?
Ko e hāʻoku ʻikai ai te mou ʻilo naʻe ʻikaiko e leaki he māʻa ʻeku pehēkiate kimoutolu, Mou vakai telia ʻae meʻa fakatupu ʻae kau Fālesi pea mo e Sātusi?”
Pea ne nau toki ʻilo naʻe ʻikai ko ʻene tala ke nau vakai telia ʻae meʻa fakatupu ʻoe mā, ka ko e akonaki ʻae kau Fālesi mo e kau Sātusi.
¶Pea ʻi he hoko ʻa Sisu ki he potu ʻo Sesalia ʻi Filipai, naʻe fehuʻi ia ki heʻene kau ākonga, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku pehēʻe he kakai pe ko hai au ko e Foha ʻoe tangata?”
Pea nau pehē, “ʻOku leaʻae niʻihi, ko Sione ko e Papitaiso; ko e niʻihi, ko ʻIlaisiā; mo e niʻihi, ko Selemaia, pe ha taha ʻoe kau palōfita.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ka ʻoku pehēʻekimoutoluko hai au?”
Pea lea ʻa Saimone Pita, ʻo pehēange, “Ko koe ko e Kalaisi, ko e ʻAlo ʻoe ʻOtua moʻui.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “Saimone Pāsiona, ʻoku ke monūʻia: he naʻe ʻikai fakahāia kiate koe ʻe he kakano mo e toto, ka ko ʻeku Tamai ʻoku ʻi he langi.
Pea ʻoku ou tala atu foki kiate koe, Ko Pita koe, pea te u langa hoku siasi ki he maka ni; pea ʻe ʻikai lavaʻi ia ʻe he ngaahi matapāʻo hētesi.
Pea te u ʻoatu kiate koe ʻae kīʻoe puleʻanga ʻoe langi: pea ko ia kotoa pēte ke nonoʻo ʻi māmani, ʻe nonoʻo ia ʻi he langi; pea ko ia te ke veteki ʻi māmani, ʻe veteki ia ʻi he langi.”
Pea naʻa ne toki fekau ki heʻene kau ākonga, ke ʻoua naʻa nau fakahāki ha tokotaha ko Sisu ia ko e Kalaisi.

¶Pea talu mei he ʻaho ko ia naʻe kamata fakahāai ʻe Sisu ki heʻene kau ākonga, “ʻE ʻalu ia ki Selūsalema, pea ne kātaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi ʻi he kau mātuʻa, mo e kau taulaʻeiki lahi, mo e kau tangata tohi, pea ʻe tāmateʻi ia, pea toe fokotuʻu ʻi hono ʻaho tolu.”
Ka ka ʻave ia ʻe Pita, ʻo kamata valokiʻi ia, ʻo pehē, “Ke mamaʻo ia ʻiate koe, ʻEiki: ʻe ʻikai hoko eni kiate koe.”
Ka naʻe tafoki ia, ʻo ne pehēkia Pita, “ʻAlu ki hoku tuʻa, Sētane: ko e fakahala koe kiate au: he ʻoku ʻikai te ke leleiʻia ʻi he meʻa ʻae ʻOtua, ka ʻi he meʻa ʻae tangata.”
¶Pea toki pehēai ʻe Sisu ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Kapau ʻe muimuiha taha ʻiate au, tuku ke ne liʻaki ʻe ia ia, pea toʻo hake ʻene ʻakau māfasia ʻo muimuiʻiate au.
He ko ia ʻe kalofaki ʻene moʻui, ʻe mole ia: pea ko ia ʻe mole ʻene moʻui koeʻuhi ko au, te ne maʻu ia.
He ko e hāhono ʻaonga ki he tangata, ʻo kapau te ne maʻu ʻa māmani kotoa pē, kae mole ai hono laumālie ʻoʻona; pe ko e hāʻe foaki ʻe ha tangata ke fetongi ʻaki hono laumālie?
He ko e Foha ʻoe tangata ʻe haʻu ia ʻi he nāunau ʻo ʻene Tamai mo ʻene kau ʻāngelo; pea te ne toki totongi ai ki he tangata kotoa pēʻo fakatatau ki heʻene ngāue.
Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku tutuʻu ʻae niʻihi ʻi heni, ʻe ʻikai te nau kamata ʻae mate, kaeʻoua ke nau vakai ki he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻoku haʻu ʻi hono puleʻanga.”
17: PEA hili ʻae ʻaho ʻe ono, pea vaheʻi ʻe Sisu ʻa Pita, mo Semisi, mo Sione ko hono tokoua, ʻo ne ʻave ʻakinautolupe ki ha potu moʻunga māʻolunga,
Pea naʻe liliu ia ʻi honau ʻao: pea ulo hono fofonga ʻo hangēko e laʻā, pea hinehina hono kofu ʻo hangēko e maama.
Pea vakai, kuo hāmai ʻa Mōsese mo ʻIlaisiākiate kinautolu, ʻo na feleaʻaki mo ia.

Pea lea ai ʻa Pita, ʻo pehēange kia Sisu, “ʻEiki, ʻoku lelei ʻetau ʻi heni: pea kapau te ke lotoki ai, tuku ke mau ngaohi ʻi heni ha fale ʻe tolu; ke ʻoʻou ʻae taha, pea taha ʻo Mōsese, pea taha ʻo ʻIlaisiā.”

Pea lolotonga ʻene lea, ʻiloange, kuo fakamaluʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae ʻao ngingila: pea vakai, ko e leʻo mei he ʻao, naʻe pehē, “Ko hoku ʻAlo ʻofaʻanga eni ʻaia ʻoku ou fiemālie lahi ai; mou fakaongo kiate ia.”
Pea ʻi he fanongo ki ai ʻae kau ākonga, naʻa nau tōfoʻohifo ki honau mata, ʻo manavahēlahi.
Pea haʻu ʻa Sisu, ʻo ala kiate kinautolu, mo ne pehē, “Tuʻu hake, pea ʻoua ʻe manavahē.”
Pea ʻi he hanga hake honau mata, naʻe ʻikai te nau mamata ki ha taha, ka ko Sisu pe.
Pea ʻi heʻenau ʻalu hifo mei he moʻunga, naʻe fekau ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “ʻOua naʻa tala ki ha taha ʻaia kuo hāmai, kaeʻoua ke toetuʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata mei he mate.”
Pea fehuʻi kiate ia ʻene kau ākonga, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hāʻoku pehēai ʻe he kau tangata tohi, “ʻE tomuʻa haʻu ʻa ʻIlaisiā?”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko e moʻoni ʻe tomuʻa haʻu ʻa ʻIlaisiā, ʻo fakatonutonuʻae meʻa kotoa pē.
Ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Kuo hili ʻae haʻu ʻa ʻIlaisiā, pea naʻe ʻikai te nau ʻilo ia, ka kuo nau fai kiate ia ʻenau faʻiteliha. ʻE mamahi pehēfoki ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻiate kinautolu.”
Pea toki ʻilo ai ʻe he kau ākonga, ko ʻene lea ia kiate kinautolukia Sione ko e Papitaiso.
¶Pea kuo nau hoko atu ki he kakai, mo ʻene haʻu kiate ia ha tangata, ʻo tuʻulutui kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē,
“ʻEiki, ʻaloʻofa ki hoku foha; he ʻoku vale ia, pea mamahi lahi: pea ʻoku faʻa tōki he afi, pea faʻatōki he vai.
Pea naʻaku ʻomi ia ki hoʻo kau ākonga, ka naʻe ʻikai te nau faʻa fakamoʻui ia.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange, “ʻAe toʻutangata taʻetui mo angakovi, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloaʻo ʻeku ʻiate kimoutolu? ʻE fēfēhono fuoloaʻo ʻeku kātakiʻi ʻakimoutolu? ʻOmi ia ki heni kiate au.”
Pea naʻe valoki ʻe Sisu ʻae tēvolo; pea ʻalu kituʻa ia ʻiate ia: pea naʻe moʻui ʻae tamasiʻi talu mei he feituʻulaʻāko ia.
Pea toki haʻu fakafufūpe ʻae kau ākonga kia Sisu, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hānaʻe ʻikai ai te mau faʻa kapusi ia?”

“Pea talaange ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “Ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻomou taʻetui: he ʻoku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Kapau ʻe ʻai hoʻomou tui ʻo hangēko e foʻi tengaʻi musita, te mou pehēki he moʻunga ni, ‘Hiki ʻi heni ki he potu na;’pea ʻe hiki ia: pea ʻe ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻe taʻefaʻafai ʻekimoutolu.
Ka ʻoku ʻikai ʻalu kituʻa ʻae faʻahinga ko ia, ka ʻi he lotu mo e ʻaukai.”
¶Pea ʻi heʻenau kei ʻi Kaleli, naʻe pehēʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻE lavakiʻi ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ki he nima ʻae kau tangata:
Pea te nau tāmateʻi ia, pea ʻi hono ʻaho tolu ʻe toe fokotuʻu ia.”Pea naʻe mamahi lahi ai ʻakinautolu.
¶Pea ʻi heʻenau hoko ki Kapaneume, naʻe haʻu kia Pita ʻae kau tānaki tukuhau, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai tukuhau ʻa homou ʻEiki?”

Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻIo.”Pea kuo haʻu ia ki he fale, pea taʻofi ia ʻe Sisu, ʻo pehē, “Saimone, ko e hāho loto? ʻOku maʻu ʻe he ngaahi tuʻi ʻo māmani ʻae totongi pe ʻae tukuhau ʻia hai? ʻI heʻenau fānau, pe mei he kakai kehe?”
Pea talaange ʻe Pita kiate ia, “ʻI he kakai kehe.”Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Pea tāʻoku ʻataʻatāʻae fānau.

Ka ko eni telia naʻa tau fakaʻita kiate kinautolu, ʻalu koe ki tahi, ʻo taumātaʻu, ʻo toʻo ʻae ika ʻoku fuofuakai; pea ʻi hoʻo faʻai hono ngutu, te ke ʻilo ʻi ai ʻae paʻanga: ke ke toʻo ia, ʻo ʻoatu kiate kinautolukoeʻuhi ko kitaua.”
18: PEA ʻi he ʻaho ko ia naʻe haʻu ai ʻae kau ākonga kia Sisu, ʻonau pehē, “Ko hai ʻoku lahi ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe langi?”
Pea ui ʻe Sisu ha tamasiʻi siʻi ke ʻalu ange kiate ia, ʻo ne tuku ia ki honau haʻohaʻonga,
‌ʻO ne pehē, “ʻOku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Kapau ʻe ʻikai liliu ʻakimoutolu, ke tatau mo e tamaiki iiki, ʻe ʻikai te mou hūki he puleʻanga ʻoe langi.
Ko ia ia te ne fakavaivaiʻi ia ʻo hangēko e tamasiʻi siʻi ni, ko ia pe ʻoku lahi ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe langi.
Pea ko ia te ne maʻu ha tamasiʻi siʻi pehēʻi hoku hingoa, ʻoku ne maʻu au.
“Ka ko ia te ne fakahalaʻi ha tokotaha ʻiate kinautoluni ʻoku siʻi ʻoku tui kiate au, ʻe lelei hake kiate ia ʻo ka ne taupungaʻi ʻaki ia ʻae maka momosi ʻi hono kia, pea lōmakiʻi ia ʻi he loto moana.
¶ʻE malaʻia ʻa māmani koeʻuhi ko e ngaahi fakahala! He kuo pau ʻe hoko ʻae ngaahi fakahala; kae malaʻia ʻae tangata ko ia ʻe hoko ai ʻae fakahala!

“Ko ia, kapau ʻoku fakahalaʻi koe ʻe ho nima pe ko ho vaʻe, tutuʻu ia, ʻo liʻaki ia ʻiate koe: ʻoku lelei kiate koe haʻo hūki he moʻui ʻoku ke ketu penimamutu, ʻi hoʻo maʻu ʻae nima ʻe ua mo e vaʻe ʻe ua, kae līkoe ki he afi taʻengata.
Pea kapau ʻoku fakahalaʻi koe ʻe ho mata, kapeʻi ia, ʻo liʻaki ʻiate koe: ʻoku lelei kiate koe haʻo hūki he moʻui ʻoku ke mata taha, ʻi hoʻo maʻu ʻae mata ʻe ua, kae līkoe ki he afi ʻo heli.

¶“Vakai ke ʻoua naʻa mou manukiʻi ha tokotaha ʻiate kinautoluni ʻoku siʻi; he ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku mamata maʻuaipēʻi he langi hānau ʻāngelo ki he fofonga ʻo ʻeku Tamai ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he langi.
Pea kuo hoko mai ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ke fakamoʻui ʻaia naʻe hē.
“Ko e hāhomou loto? Kapau ʻoku maʻu ʻe ha tangata ʻae sipi ʻe teau, pea ʻalu hēpe hanau taha, ʻikai ʻoku ne tuku ʻae hivangofulu ma hiva, pea ʻalu ki he ngaahi moʻunga, ʻo kumi ʻaia kuo hē?
Pea kapau te ne ʻilo ia, ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻoku lahi ʻene fiefiaʻihe sipi ko ia, ʻi he hivangofulu ma hiva naʻe ʻikai ʻalu hē.
Pea pehē, ʻoku ʻikai ko e finangalo ʻo hoʻomou Tamai ʻoku ʻi he langi, ke malaʻia ha tokotaha ʻiate kinautoluni ʻoku siʻi.
¶“Ko ia, kapau ʻe fai angahala kiate koe ʻe ho kāinga, ʻalu ʻo fakahāʻene kovi kiate ia, ʻa koe pēmo ia: kapau ʻe tokanga ia kiate koe, kuo ke fakalelei mo ho kāinga.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te ne tokangakiate koe, pea ketokiʻave ha tokotaha pe ha toko ua kehe, koeʻuhi ʻe fakapapau ʻae lea kotoa pēmei he ngutu ʻoe fakamoʻoni ʻe toko ua pe toko tolu.
Pea kapau ʻe taʻetokanga ia kiate kinautolu, fakahāiaki he siasi: pea kapau ʻe taʻetokanga ia ki he siasi, tuku ke tatau ia kiate koe mo e tangata hiteni mo e tānaki tukuhau
“Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e meʻa ko ia te mou nonoʻo ʻi māmani, ʻe nonoʻo ia ʻi he langi: pea ko e meʻa ko ia te mou veteki ʻi māmani, ʻe veteki ia ʻi he langi.
“Pea ʻoku ou tala atu foki kiate kimoutolu, Kapau ʻe loto taha hamou toko ua ʻi māmani ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha te na kole, ʻe fai ia kiate kinaua ʻe heʻeku Tamai ʻoku ʻi he langi.
He ko e potu ko ia ʻoku fakataha ai ʻae toko ua pe ʻae toko tolu ʻi hoku huafa, te u ʻi ai au mo kinautolu.”
¶Pea naʻe toki haʻu ai ʻa Pita kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻe liunga fiha ʻae angahala ʻa hoku tokoua kiate au mo ʻeku fakamolemole ia? Ke liunga fitu?”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “ʻOku ʻikai te u pehēkiate koe, Ke liunga fitupēkae liunga fitungofulu lau ʻe fitu.
¶Ko ia ʻoku fakatatau ai ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi ki ha tuʻi, naʻe loto ke fakamaauʻi ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.
Pea kamata fai ʻe ia ʻae fakamaau, pea ʻomi kiate ia ʻae tokotaha naʻe totonu ke ne totongiki he tuʻiʻae taleniti ʻe mano.
Ka ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻikai haʻa ne meʻa ke totongi ʻaki, naʻe fekau ʻe heʻene ʻeiki ke fakatau ia, mo hono ʻunoho, mo ʻene fānau, mo ia kotoa pēnaʻe ʻaʻana, ʻo totongi ʻaki.
Pea fakatōmapeʻe ʻae tamaioʻeiki, ʻo hūkiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, ke ke faʻa kātaki kiate au, pea te u totongi kotoa pēkiate koe.’
Pea toki manavaʻofa ʻae ʻeiki ki he tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻo ne tukuangeia, ʻo ne fakamolemole kiate ia ʻae totongi.

Ka naʻe ʻalu ʻae tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻo ne ʻilo ʻae tokotaha ʻo ʻene kaungātamaioʻeiki, naʻe totonu ke totongi ʻaki kiate ia ʻae tenali ʻe teau: pea ne puke ʻe ia ia, ʻo kuku hono kia, ʻo pehē, ‘Totongi mai kiate au ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻaku.’
Pea fakatōmapeʻe ʻa ʻene kaungātamaioʻeiki ki hono vaʻe, ʻo ne kole kiate ia, ʻo pehē, ‘Ke ke faʻa kātaki kiate au, pea te u totongi kotoa pēkiate koe.’
Ka naʻe ʻikai te ne fai; ka naʻe ʻalu ia, ʻo tuku ia ki he fale fakapōpula, kaeʻoua ke ne totongi ʻaia naʻe totonu.
Ka ʻi he mamata ʻa ʻene kaungātamaioʻeiki ki he meʻa kuo fai, naʻa nau mamahi lahi, pea ʻalu ʻo fakahāki honau ʻeiki ʻaia kotoa pēkuo fai.
Pea ui ia ʻe heʻene ʻeiki, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, ‘ʻAe tamaioʻeiki angakovi ko koe, ne u fakamolemolea koe ʻi he totongi kotoa pēko ia, ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻo kole kiate au:’
Pea ʻikai naʻe taau mo koe hoʻo manavaʻofa foki ki ho kaungātamaioʻeiki, ʻo hangēko ʻeku manavaʻofa kiate koe?
Pea ʻita ai ʻene ʻeiki, ʻo ne tuku atu ia ki he kau fakamamahi, kaeʻoua ke ne totongi ʻaia kotoa pēnaʻe totonu.
“ʻE fai pehēfoki ʻe heʻeku Tamai ʻi he langi kiate kimoutolu, ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou taki taha fakamolemolea mei hono loto ʻae ngaahi angahala ʻo hono kāinga.”
19: PEA ʻi he fakaʻosi ʻe Sisu ʻene ngaahi lea ni, naʻe ʻalu ia mei Kaleli, pea haʻu ia ki he ngaahi potu ʻo Siutea, ʻo ofi ki Sioatani.
Pea muimuiʻiate ia ʻae kakai tokolahi ʻaupito: pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautoluʻi ai.
¶Naʻe haʻu foki ʻae kau Fālesi kiate ia, ʻo ʻahiʻahiʻi ia, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ngofua ki he tangata ke tukuangehono ʻunohoʻi he meʻa kotoa pē?”
Pea lea ia, “ʻO pehēange kiate kinautolu, Naʻe ʻikai te mou lau, ko ia naʻa ne fakatupuʻae kakaiʻi he kamataʻanga, ‘naʻa ne fakatupu ʻakinaua ko e tangata mo e fefine,’
‌ʻO ne pehē, ‘Ko e meʻa eni ʻe tuku ai ʻe he tangata ʻene tamai mo ʻene faʻē, kae pikitai ki hono ʻunoho: pea ʻe hoko ʻakinaua ko e kakano pe taha?’
Ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ai te na kei ua, ka ko e kakano pe taha. Pea ko eni, ko ia kuo fakataha ʻe he ʻOtua, ʻoua naʻa fakamāvae ʻe ha tangata.”
Pea nau pehēkiate ia, “Ka kuo pehē, ko e hānaʻe fekau ai ʻe Mōsese ke ʻoatu ʻae tohi fakamāvae, pea ke tukuangeia?”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko e meʻa ʻi he fefeka ʻo homou loto, ko ia naʻe kātaki ai ʻe Mōsese ʻa hoʻomou tukuangehomou ʻunoho: ka naʻe ʻikai pehēmei he kamataʻanga.

Pea ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko ia ʻe tukuangehono ʻunoho, ka ʻiheʻenetono tangata pe, pea fakamaʻu ia mo ha tokotaha kehe, ko e tono fefine ia: pea ko ia ʻe fakamaʻu mo ia kuo tukuange, ko e tono fefine ia.”
¶Pea pehēʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, “Kapau ʻoku pehēpe ʻae tangata mo hono ʻunoho, tāʻoku ʻikai lelei ke fakamaʻu.”
Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ʻikai faʻa maʻu ʻae tala ni ʻe he tangata kotoa pē, ka ko kinautolukuo foaki ia ki ai.

He ʻoku ai ʻae niʻihi ʻoku ʻiunoke, ʻi heʻenau fanauʻi mei he manāva ʻoʻenaufaʻē: pea ʻoku ai ʻae ʻiunokeniʻihi, kuo ngaohi ke ʻiunokeʻe he tangata: pea ʻoku ai ʻae ʻiunokeniʻihi, kuo nau ngaohi ʻakinautoluke ʻiunoke, koeʻuhi ko e puleʻanga ʻoe langi. Ko ia ʻoku ne faʻa maʻu ia, ke maʻu pe ʻe ia.”
¶Pea naʻe ʻomi ai kiate ia ʻae tamaiki iiki, koeʻuhi ke ne hilifaki hono nima kiate kinautolu, ʻo lotu: ka naʻe lolomi ʻakinautoluʻe he kau ākonga.
Pea naʻe pehēʻe Sisu, “ʻOua ʻe taʻofi, kae tuku ke haʻu kiate au ʻae tamaiki iiki: he ʻoku ʻoe kakai pehēʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi.”
Pea hilifaki ʻe ia hono nima kiate kinautolu, ka ka ʻalu mei ai.
Pea vakai, naʻe haʻu ʻae tokotaha kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻE ʻEiki lelei, ko e hāha meʻa lelei te u fai ke u maʻu ai ʻae moʻui taʻengata?”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate ia, “Ko e hāʻoku ke ui ai au ko e lelei? Ko e tokotaha pe ʻoku lelei ʻaia ko e ʻOtua: ka ko ho loto ke ke hūki he moʻui pea ke fai ki he ngaahi fekau.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “ʻA fē?”Pea pehēʻe Sisu, “|‘ʻOua naʻa ke fakapō,’‘ʻOua naʻa ke tono fefine,’‘ʻOua naʻa ke kaihaʻa,’‘ʻOua naʻa ke fakamoʻoni loi,’
‘Fakaʻapaʻapa ki hoʻo tamai mohoʻofaʻē:’pea, ‘Ke ʻofa ki ho kaungāʻapi ʻo hangēpe ko koe.’|”
Pea pehēange ʻe he talavou kiate ia, “Kuo u fai kotoa pēeni talu ʻeku kei siʻi: ko e hāʻoku ou kei hala ai?”
Pea talaange ʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Kapau ko ho loto ke ke haohaoa, ʻalu ʻo fakatau ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻau, mo foaki ki he masiva, pea te ke maʻu ai ʻae koloa ʻi he langi: pea ke haʻu, ʻo muimuiʻiate au.”
Ka ʻi he fanongo ʻae talavou ki he lea ko ia, naʻa ne ʻalu mamahi: he naʻe lahi ʻene koloa.
¶Pea pehēai ʻe Sisu ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE faingataʻa ʻaupitoʻae hūʻae tangata koloaʻia ki he puleʻanga ʻoe langi.
Pea ʻoku ou tala foki kiate kimoutolu, ʻoku faingofua ke hūʻae kāmeli ʻi he avaʻi hui, ʻi he hūʻae tangata koloaʻia ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
Pea ʻi he fanongo ki ai ʻene kau ākonga, naʻa nau ofo lahi ʻaupito, ʻonau pehē, “Pea ko hai ʻe moʻui?”
Pea vakai ʻe Sisu, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ʻikai faʻa fai eni ʻe he tangata; ka ʻoku faʻa fai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae meʻa kotoa pē.”
¶Pea toki lea ai ʻa Pita, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “Vakai, kuo mau siʻaki ʻae meʻa kotoa pē, ʻo muimuiʻiate koe: ko e hāte mau maʻu ai?”

Pea talaange ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko kimoutolukuo muimuiʻiate au, ʻoka nofo ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ki he nofoʻa ʻo hono nāunau, ʻi he fakafoʻou, ʻe nofo ʻakimoutolufoki ki he nofoʻa ʻe hongofulu ma ua, ʻo fakamaau ai ki he faʻahinga ʻe hongofulu ma ua ʻo ʻIsileli.

Pea ko ia fulipēkuo ne liʻaki ʻae fale, pe ʻae kāinga, pe ko e tuofefine, pe ko e tamai, pe ko e faʻē, pe ko e ʻunoho, pe ʻae fānau, pe ʻae fonua, koeʻuhi ko hoku hingoa, te ne maʻu ʻo taki teau, pea te ne maʻu mo e moʻui taʻengata.
Ka ko e tokolahi ʻoku muʻomuʻa te nau muimui; pea ko e muimuiʻe muʻomuʻa.
20: “HE ʻoku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e tangata ko e ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ʻaia naʻe ʻalu atu hengihengi pe, ke unga ʻae kau ngāue ki heʻene ngoue vaine.
Pea kuo nau alea mo e kau ngāue ko e ʻaho mo e tenali ʻe taha, naʻa ne fekau ʻakinautoluki heʻene ngoue vaine.
Pea ʻalu atu ia ʻi hono tolu ʻoe feituʻulaʻā, ʻo mamata ki he niʻihi ʻoku tutuʻu noa ai pe ʻi he potu fakatau.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ‘ʻAlu ʻakimoutolufoki ki he ngoue vaine, pea ko ia ʻoku totonu, te u ʻoatu kiate kimoutolu.’Pea nau ʻalu.
Pea toe ʻalu atu ia ʻi hono ono mo hono hiva ʻoe feituʻulaʻā, ʻo netoefai pehē.
Pea ʻi hono hongofulu ma taha ʻoe feituʻulaʻānaʻe ʻalu atu ia, ʻo ne ʻilo ʻae niʻihi ʻoku tutuʻu noa ai pe, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, ‘Ko e hāʻoku mou tutuʻu noa ai pe ʻi heni ʻi he ʻaho kotoa?’
Pea nau pehēkiate ia, ‘Koeʻuhi kuo ʻikai unga ʻakimautoluʻe ha taha.’Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ‘ʻAlu ʻakimoutolufoki ki he ngoue vaine; pea ko ia ʻoku totonu, te mou maʻu.’
“Pea kuo efiafi, pea pehēʻe he ʻeiki ʻoe ngoue vaine ki heʻene tauhi koloa, ‘Ui ʻae kau ngāue, ʻo ʻoatu kiate kinautoluʻenau totongi, ʻo fua fai ki he mui mai ʻo aʻu ki he muʻomuʻa mai.’
Pea haʻu ʻakinautolunaʻe ungaʻi hono hongofulu ma taha ʻoe feituʻulaʻā, pea maʻu taki taha ʻe he tangata ʻae tenali.
Pea ʻi he omi ʻae kau muʻomuʻa mai, naʻa nau ʻamanaki ke maʻu ʻo lahi hake; ka naʻe maʻu ʻekinautolutaki taha foki ʻae tenali.
Pea ʻi heʻenau maʻu ia, naʻa nau lāunga ki he ʻeiki ʻoe fale,
‌ʻO nau pehē, ‘Ko e feituʻulaʻāpe taha kuo ngāue ai ʻae kau muimuimai ni, pea kuo ke fakatatau ʻakinautolukiate kimautolukuo katekina ʻae ngāue ʻoe ʻaho, mo hono pupuha.’
Ka naʻe lea ia ki honau tokotaha, ʻo pehēange, ‘Kāinga, ʻoku ʻikai te u fai hala kiate koe: ʻikai naʻa ta alea ki he tenali?’
Toʻo ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻau, pea ke ʻalu: te u ʻoatu ki he mui mai ni, ʻo hangēpe ko koe.
‌ʻIkai ʻoku ngofua kiate au ke fai ʻeku faʻiteliha ki he meʻa ʻaʻaku? ʻOku kovi ho mata, koeʻuhi ʻoku ou angalelei?’
Ko ia ko e muimuiʻe muʻomuʻa, pea ʻe muʻomuʻa ʻae muimui: he ʻoku ui ʻae tokolahi, ka ʻoku fili ʻae tokosiʻi.”
Pea ʻi he ʻalu hake ʻa Sisu ki Selūsalema, naʻa ne fakaafe ʻae kau ākonga ʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ua ʻi he hala, ʻo ne tala kiate kinautolu,
“Vakai, ʻoku tau ʻalu hake ki Selūsalema; pea ʻe lavakiʻi ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ki he kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi; pea te nau fakamaau ia ke mate;
pea ʻe tukuangeia ki he Senitaile ke manukiʻi, mo haha, mo tutukiki he ʻakau: pea ʻe tuʻu hake ia ʻi hono ʻaho tolu.”
Pea haʻu ai kiate ia ʻae faʻēʻae fānau ʻa Sepeti mo ʻene ongo tama, ʻo hū, mo ne holi ki he meʻa ʻe taha meiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “Ko e hāho loto?”Pea pehēmai ʻe ia kiate ia, “Tuku ke nofo ʻeku ongo tama ni, ko e tokotaha ki ho nima toʻomataʻu, mo e tokotaha ki ho toʻohema, ʻi ho puleʻanga.”

Ka naʻe leaange ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te mou ʻilo ʻaia ʻoku mou kole. ʻOku mou faʻa fai ke inu ʻi he ipu te u inu ai, pea ke papitaiso ʻi he papitaiso ko ia te u papitaiso ai?”Pea na talaange kiate ia, “ʻOku ma mafai pe.”

Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinaua, “ʻE inu moʻoni ʻekimoua ʻi heʻeku ipu, pea papitaiso ʻi he papitaiso ko ia te u papitaiso ai: ka ko e nofo ki hoku nima toʻomataʻu, mo hoku toʻohema, ʻoku ʻikai ʻaʻaku ia ke foaki, ka kiate kinautolupēkuo teuteu ia ki ai ʻe heʻeku Tamai.”
Pea ʻi he fanongo ki ai ʻae toko hongofulu, naʻe tupu ai ʻenau ʻita ki he ongo kāinga.
Ka naʻe ui ʻakinautoluʻe Sisu, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOku mou ʻilo ko e houʻeiki ʻoe Senitaile ʻoku nau faʻa puleʻi ʻa kinautolu, pea ko kinautoluʻoku lahi ʻoku nau faʻa pule mālohi kiate kinautolu.
Ka ʻe ʻikai pehēʻiate kimoutolu: ka ko ia ʻoku loto ke lahi ʻiate kimoutolu, ke hoko ia ko homou tauhi.
pea ko ia ʻoku loto ke ʻeiki ʻiate kimoutolu, ʻe hoko ia ko hoʻomou tamaioʻeiki:
‌ʻIo, ʻo hangēko e Foha ʻoe tangata, naʻe ʻikai haʻu ia ke tauhia ia, ka ke tauhi, pea ke foaki ʻene moʻui ko e huhuʻi ʻoe tokolahi.”
Pea ʻi heʻenau ʻalu ʻi Seliko, naʻe muimuiʻiate ia ʻae kakai tokolahi.
Pea vakai, naʻe nonofo ʻae ongo tangata kui ʻi he veʻe hala, pea kuo na fanongo ʻoku ʻalu ange ʻa Sisu, naʻa na kalanga, ʻo pehē, “ʻE ʻEiki, Foha ʻo Tevita, ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimaua.”
Pea lolomi ʻakinaua ʻe he kakai, ke na fakalongo pē: ka naʻe ʻāsili ai ʻena tangi, ʻo pehē, “ʻE ʻEiki, Foha ʻo Tevita, ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimaua.”
Pea tuʻu mai ʻa Sisu, ʻo ui kiate kinaua, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hāho mo loto ke u fai kiate kimoua?”
Pea na talaange kiate ia, “ʻEiki, ke ʻāhoma mata.”
Pea ʻaloʻofa ʻa Sisu, ʻo ne tuhuʻi hona mata; pea ʻāai leva hona mata, ʻo na muimuiʻiate ia.
21: PEA ʻi heʻenau ofi ki Selūsalema, ʻo hoko ki Petefesi, ki he moʻunga ko ʻOlive, naʻe toki fekau ʻe Sisu ʻae ākonga ʻe toko ua,
‌ʻO ne pehēkiate kinaua, “Mo ōki he potu kakai ʻoku hangatonu mai, pea te mo ʻilo leva ʻae ʻasi ʻoku noʻotaki, mo hono ʻuhiki: vevete ʻo tataki mai kiate au.
Pea kapau ʻe lea ha taha kiate kimoua, te mo pehē, ‘ʻOku na ʻaonga ki he ʻEiki;’pea te ne tuku mai leva ia.”
Naʻe fai eni kotoa pē, koeʻuhi ke fakamoʻoni ʻaia naʻe lea ʻaki ʻe he palōfita, ʻo pehē,

“Mou tala ki he taʻahine ʻo Saione,
‘Vakai, ʻoku haʻu ho Tuʻi kiate koe,
ʻoku angamalū, ʻo heka ki he ʻasi,
mo e ʻuhikiko e fānau ʻae ʻasi.’|”
Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻae ongo ākonga ʻo na fai ʻo hangēko e fekau ʻa Sisu kiate kinaua,
‌ʻo ʻomi ʻae ʻasi, mo e ʻuhiki, pea nau ʻai ki ai honau kofu, ʻonau fakaheka,iaki ai.
Pea folahi atu ʻe he kakai tokolahi honau kofu ʻi he hala; pea naʻe tutuʻu hifo ʻe he niʻihi ʻae ʻuluʻuluʻi ʻakau, ʻo falikiliki ʻaki ʻae hala.
Pea ko e kakai tokolahi naʻe muʻomuʻa mo muimuiatu, naʻa nau kalanga, ʻo pehē, “Hosana ki he Foha ʻo Tevita: ‘ʻOku monūʻia ia ʻoku haʻu ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova;’Hosana ʻi ʻolunga.”
Pea ʻi heʻene hoko ki Selūsalema, naʻe ngatūʻae kolo kotoa, ʻo pehē, “Ko hai eni?”
Pea pehēʻe he kakai, “Ko Sisu eni, ko e palōfita ʻo Nāsaleti ʻi Kaleli.”

¶Pea hūʻa Sisu ki he falelotu lahi ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻo kapusi kituʻa ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe fefakatauʻaki ʻi he falelotu lahi, ʻo ne fulihiʻae ngaahi palepale ʻoe kau fetongi paʻanga, mo e nofoʻa ʻonautolunaʻe fakatau lupe,
‌ʻo ne pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Kuo tohi, ‘ʻE ui hoku fale ko e falelotu;’ka kuo mou ngaohi ia ko e ʻana ʻoe kau kaihaʻa.”
Pea naʻe haʻu kiate ia, ʻi he falelotu lahi, ʻae kui mo e pipiki; pea ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.

Pea kuo mamata ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi ki he ngaahi meʻa mana naʻa ne fai, mo e kalanga ʻae tamaiki ʻi he falelotu lahi, ʻo pehē, “Hosana ki he foha ʻo Tevita;”naʻa nau ʻita lahi,
‌ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ke ongoʻi ʻenau lea?”Pea talaange ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻIo; pea ʻoku teʻeki siʻi ke mou lau, ‘Kuo ke maʻu ʻae fakamālōmei he ngutu ʻoe kau valevale mo e kei huhū?’|”
¶Pea tuku ʻe ia ʻakinautolu, kae ʻalu ia mei he kolo ki Pētani; pea mohe ai.
Pea pongipongi ai, ʻi heʻene liu mai ki he kolo, kuo fiekaia ia.

Pea mamata ia ki he ʻakau ko e fiki ʻi he hala, pea ʻalu ia ki ai, ka naʻe ʻikai te ne ʻilo ai ha meʻa ka ko e lau pe, pea pehēʻe ia ki ai, “Ngata ʻi heni, ke ʻoua naʻa tupu ha fua ʻiate koe ʻo lauikuonga.”Pea mate leva ʻae ʻakau ko e fiki.
Pea kuo mamata ki ai ʻae kau ākonga, pea nau ofo, ʻo pehē, “Kuo mate vave ʻae ʻakau ko e fiki!”

Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Kapau ʻoku mou maʻu ʻae tui, pea ʻoua naʻa fakataʻetaʻetui, ʻe ʻikai te mou fai pe ʻa iakuo faiki he ʻakau ko e fiki, ka ʻoka mou ka tala ki he moʻunga ni foki, ‘Ke hiki koe, mo līkoe ki he tahi;’ʻe fai ia.
Pea ko e meʻa kotoa pēʻaia te mou kole ʻi he lotu, ʻi he tui, te mou maʻu.”

¶Pea kuo hūia ki he falelotu lahi, pea haʻu kiate ia ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e mātuʻa ʻoe kakai, ʻi heʻene kei malanga, ʻonau pehē, “Ko e pule fēʻoku ke fai ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni? Pea ko hai naʻa ne tuku ʻae pule ni kiate koe?”

Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Te u fehuʻi kiate kimoutolufoki ki he meʻa ʻe taha, pea kapau te mou tala ia kiate au, te u tala foki kiate kimoutoluʻae pule ko ia ʻoku ou fai ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni.

Ko e papitaiso ʻa Sione, naʻe mei fē? Mei he langi, pe mei he tangata?”Pea nau fealēleaʻaki, ʻo pehē, “Kapau te tau pehē, ‘Mei he langi;’pea ʻe pehēʻe ia kiate kitautolu, ‘Pea ko e hānaʻe ʻikai ai te mou tui kiate ia?’
Pea kapau te tau pehē, ‘Mei he tangata;’ʻoku tau manavahēki he kakai; he ʻoku lau kotoa pēko e palōfita ʻa Sione.”
Pea nau talaange kia Sisu, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te mau ʻilo.”Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Pea ʻe ʻikai te u tala kiate kimoutoluʻae pule ko ia ʻoku ou fai ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni.
¶“Ka ko e hāhomou loto? Naʻe ai ʻae tangata ʻe taha naʻe toko ua hono foha; pea haʻu ia ki hono ʻuluaki, ʻo ne pehē, ‘Foha, ʻalu ʻo ngāue ʻi heʻeku ngoue vaine he ʻaho ni.’
Pea talaange ʻe ia ʻo pehē, ‘ʻE ʻikai:’kae hili ia ne ne fakatomala pea ʻalu.
Pea haʻu ia ki hono toko ua, ʻo ne lea pehēpe foki. Pea lea ia, ʻo pehē, ‘ʻEiki, te uʻalu:’ka naʻe ʻikai ʻalu ia.

Ko hai ia ʻiate kinaua naʻe fai ʻae loto ʻo ʻena tamai?”Pea nau talaange kiate ia, “Ko e ʻuluaki.”Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku tomuʻa hoko ʻae kau tānaki tukuhau mo e kau faʻa feʻauaki ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua ʻiate kimoutolu.

He naʻe haʻu ʻa Sione kiate kimoutoluʻi he hala ʻoe māʻoniʻoni, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou tui kiate ia: ka naʻe tui kiate ia ʻae kau tānaki tukuhau mo e kau faʻa feʻauaki: pea hili hoʻomou mamata ki ai, naʻe ʻikai te mou fakatomala ai, ke mou tui kiate ia.”

¶“Fanongo ki he fakatātāʻe taha: Naʻe ai ʻae ʻeiki ʻe taha, naʻa ne tōʻae ngoue vaine, ʻo takatakai ʻaki ia ʻae ʻā, ʻo keli ʻi ai ʻae tataʻoʻangauaine, ʻo ne langa ʻae fale leʻo, ʻo ne tuku ia ki he kau tangata tauhi ngoue, kae ʻalu ia ki he fonua mamaʻo:
Pea kuo ofi hono toʻukai vaine, pea fekau ʻe ia ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki ki he kau tauhi ngoue, koeʻuhi ke nau maʻu hono ngaahi fua.
Pea puke ʻe he kau tangata ngoue ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, ʻo haha ʻae tokotaha, mo tāmateʻi ʻae tokotaha, pea tolongaki ʻaki ʻae maka ʻae tokotaha.
Pea toe fekau ʻe ia ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki lahi hake ʻi he ʻuluaki: pea nau fai pehēpe kiate kinautolu.
Pea fekau fakamui ʻe ia ʻa hono foha kiate kinautolu, ʻo ne pehē, ‘Te nau fakaʻapaʻapa ki hoku foha.’
Ka kuo mamata ʻae kau tauhi ngoue ki he foha, pea nau fealēleaʻaki,ʻo pehē, ‘Ko eni ʻae foha hoko; haʻu, ke tau tāmateʻi ia, pea tau maʻu hono tofiʻa.’
Pea naʻa nau puke ia, ʻo līia kituaʻāngoue vaine, ʻo tāmateʻi ia.
“Pea ko ia, ʻoka haʻu ʻae ʻeiki ʻoe ngoue vaine, ko e hāte ne fai ki he kau tauhi ngoue ko ia?”
Pea nau talaange kiate ia, “Te ne fakaʻauha fakamamahi ʻae kau tangata angakovi ko ia, pea tuku ʻene ngoue ki he kau tauhi kehe, te nau ʻoatu kiate ia ʻae fua ʻi hono ngaahi faʻahitaʻu.”

Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku teʻeki siʻi te mou lau ʻi he tohi,
‘Ko e maka ko ia naʻe liʻaki ʻe he kau tufunga,
ko ia ia kuo hoko ko e fungani ʻoe tuliki;
ko e ngāue eni ʻa Sihova,
pea ko e meʻa fakaofo ʻi hotau ʻao?’
“Ko ia ʻoku ou tala atu ai kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻave ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua ʻiate kimoutolu, pea ʻe ʻoatu ia ki ha kakai ʻe tupu ai hono ngaahi fua.
Pea ko ia ʻe tōki he maka ni, ʻe mafesi ai ia: ka ko ia fulipēʻe tōia ki ai, te ne momosi ia ke efuefu.”
Pea kuo fanongo ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e Fālesi ki heʻene ngaahi fakatātā, naʻa nau ʻilo ko ʻene lea kiate kinautolu.
Ka ʻi heʻenau holi ke puke ia, naʻa nau manavahēki he kakai, he naʻa nau pehē, “Ko e palōfita ia.”
22: PEA lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo toe pehēange kiate kinautoluʻi he fakatātā;
“ʻOku tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e tuʻi ʻe tokotaha, ʻaia naʻe fai ʻae kātoanga ʻi he taʻane ʻa hono foha,
‌ʻO ne fekau atu ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki ke ui ʻakinautolunaʻe tala ki ai ʻae taʻane: ka naʻe ʻikai te nau fie haʻu.

Pea toe fekau atu ʻe ia ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki kehe, ʻo ne pehē, ‘Fakahākiate kinautolunaʻe talaki ai, “Vakai, kuo ʻosi ʻeku teu ʻae kai: kuo tāmateʻi ʻeku fanga pulu mo e fanga manu sino, pea kuo ʻosi hono teu ʻoe meʻa kotoa pē: haʻu ki he taʻane.”|’
Ka naʻa nau fakavaʻivaʻingaʻaki ia, ʻotaki tahaʻalu, ko e taha ki heʻene ngoue, ko e taha ki heʻene meʻa fakatau:
Pea puke ʻo ngaohikoviʻi mo tāmateʻi, ʻe he niʻihi, ʻa ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.
Ka kuo fanongo ki ai ʻae tuʻi, pea houhau: ʻo ne fekau atu ʻene ngaahi kongakau, ke fakaʻauha ʻae kau fakapōko ia, pea tutu ʻenau kolo,
Pea toki pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, ‘Kuo ʻosi hono teu ʻae kātoanga taʻane, ka ko kinautolukuo tala ki ai, ʻoku ʻikai ʻaonga.
Ko ia mou ʻalu ki he ngaahi hala motuʻa, pea ko kinautolute mou ʻilo, fakahāki ai ʻae taʻane.’
Pea naʻe ʻalu atu ai ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki ko ia ki he ngaahi halamotuʻa, ʻo fakakātoa kotoa pēnaʻa nau ʻilo, ʻae kovi mo e lelei: pea tokolahi ai ʻae kakai ʻi he taʻane.
¶“Pea ʻi he haʻu ʻae tuʻi ke mamata ki he kakai, naʻa ne ʻiloʻi ʻae tangata kuo ʻikai ʻi ai ha kofu taʻane.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, ‘Kāinga, naʻe fēfeeʻi hoʻo hūmai ki heni ʻoku ʻikai hao kofu taʻane?’Pea fakalongo pēia.
Pea toki pehēʻe he tuʻi ki he kau tamaioʻeiki, ‘Haʻi hono vaʻe mo e nima pea ʻave, ʻo līia ki he poʻuli ʻi tuaʻā: pea ʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangi mo e fengaiʻitaki ʻoe nifo.’
“He ʻoku ui ʻae tokolahi, ka ʻoku fili ʻae tokosiʻi.”
¶Pea toki ʻalu ʻae kau Fālesi, ʻonau fakakaukau pe fēfeeʻi ʻenau femioekina ia ʻi he alea.

Pea nau fekau kiate ia ʻenau kau ākonga mo e kau Helotiane, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻoku mau ʻilo ʻoku ke moʻoni koe, pea ʻoku ke ako moʻoni ʻaki ʻae hala ʻoe ʻOtua, pea ʻoku ʻikai te ke tokanga ki ha tangata: he ʻoku ʻikai te ke filifilimānako ki he tangata.
Ko ia ke ke tala mai kiate kimautolu, Ko e hāho loto? ʻOku ngofua ke ʻoatu ʻae tukuhau kia Sisa, pe ʻikai?”
Ka naʻe ʻilo ʻe Sisu ʻenau angakovi, pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻAe kau mālualoi, ko e hāʻoku mou ʻahiʻahiʻi ai au?
Fakahāmai ʻae paʻanga tukuhau.”Pea naʻa nau ʻomi kiate ia ʻae tenali.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko e mata eni mo e tohi ʻa hai?”
Pea nau talaange kiate ia, “ʻA Sisa.”Pea toki pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko ia ʻoange kia Sisa ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻa Sisa; pea ʻoange ki he ʻOtua ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻae ʻOtua.”
Pea kuo nau fanongo ki ai, naʻa nau ofo, ʻo tuku ia, ka nau ʻalu.
¶Pea haʻu kiate ia ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻae kau Sātusi, ʻakinautoluʻoku pehē, ʻoku ʻikai ha toetuʻu, ʻonau fehuʻi kiate ia,
‌ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, naʻe pehēʻe Mōsese, Kapau ʻe mate ha tangata, kae ʻikai haʻane fānau, ʻe fakamaʻu hono tokoua mo hono ʻunoho, ʻo fakatupu ʻae hako ki hono tokoua.
Pea ko eni, naʻe ʻiate kimautoluʻae kāinga ʻe toko fitu; ko e ʻuluaki naʻe fakamaʻu mo e ʻunoho, pea mate ia, kuo ʻikai haʻane fānau, pea tuku hono ʻunohoki hono tokoua.
Pea pehēpe foki hono toko ua, mo hono toko tolu, ʻo hoko ki hono toko fitu.
Pea mate fakamui ʻae fefine.
Pea ko ia ʻi he toetuʻu ʻe hoko ia ko e ʻunohoʻo hai ʻi he toko fitu? He naʻe maʻu ia ʻekinautolukotoa pē.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku mou hē, ʻi he taʻeʻilo ki he ngaahi tohi, mo e mālohi ʻae ʻOtua.
Koeʻuhi ʻi he toetuʻu ʻe ʻikai te nau mali, pe foaki ke mali, ka ʻe tatau mo e kau ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua ʻi he langi.
Ka koeʻuhi ko e toetuʻu ʻoe mate, ʻoku teʻeki te mou lau ʻaia naʻe lea ʻaki kiate kimoutoluʻe he ʻOtua, ʻo pehē,
‘Ko au ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻEpalahame, pea ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻAisake, pea ko e ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope?’ʻOku ʻikai ko e ʻOtua ʻoe mate ʻae ʻOtua, ka ko e moʻui.”
Pea kuo fanongo ʻae kakai, naʻa nau ofo ʻi heʻene akonaki.
¶Pea ʻi he fanongo ʻae kau Fālesi kuo ne fakalongo ʻae kau Sātusi, naʻe fakataha leva ʻakinautolu.
Pea fehuʻi ʻahiʻahi kiate ia ʻe honau tokotaha, ko e akonaki ʻi he fono, ʻo pehē,
“ʻEiki, ko e fekau fēʻi he fono ʻoku lahi?”
Pea tala ʻe Sisu kiate ia, “|‘Ke ke ʻofa kia Sihova ko ho ʻOtua ʻaki ho laumālie kotoa, mo hoʻo moʻui kotoa, mo ho loto kotoa.’
Ko e ʻuluaki pea ko e lahi ia ʻoe fekau.
Pea ko hono ua ʻoku tatau mo ia, Ke ke ʻofa ki ho kaungāʻapi ʻo hangēpe ko koe.’
Ko e fekau ni ʻe ua ʻoku tautau ai ʻae fono kotoa mo e kau palōfita.”
¶Pea ʻi he kei fakataha ʻae kau Fālesi, naʻe fehuʻi ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu,
‌ʻO pehē, “Ko e hāhomou loto ki he Kalaisi? Ko e foha ia ʻo hai?”Pea nau talaange kiate ia, “ʻO Tevita.”
Pea pehēange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku fēfēai hono ui ia ʻe Tevita ʻi he Laumālie, ‘ʻEiki,’ʻi heʻene pehē,

‘Naʻe pehēʻe Sihova ki hoku ʻEiki,
Nofo koe ki hoku nima toʻomataʻu,
kaeʻoua ke u ngaohi ho ngaahi fili ko ho tuʻungavaʻe”|’?
Pea kapau ʻoku ui ia ʻe Tevita, ‘ʻEiki,’pea ko hono foha fēfeeʻi ia?”
Pea naʻe ʻikai ha lea ʻe faʻa lea ʻaki ʻe ha tangata kiate ia; talu mei he ʻaho ko ia naʻe ʻikai faʻa fehuʻi ʻe ha taha kiate ia.
23: PEA toki lea ai ʻa Sisu ki he kakai, mo ʻene kau ākonga.
‌ʻo pehēange, “ʻOku nofo ʻae kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi ʻi he nofoʻa ʻo Mōsese:
“Ko ia ko e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku nau fekau ke mou tokanga ki ai, mou tokanga ki ai ʻo fai: kaeʻoua naʻa mou faʻifaʻitaki ki heʻenau ngāue: he ʻoku nau enginaki, kae ʻikai fai.
He ʻoku nau haʻihaʻi ʻae ngaahi kavenga mamafa, mo fakamamahi ke fua, ʻo hilifaki ia ki he uma ʻoe kakai; ka ʻoku ʻikai ala ʻekinautoluhanau tuhu ki ai.
Ka ʻoku nau fai ʻenau ngāue kotoa pēke mamata ki ai ʻae kakai: he ʻoku nau fakalaulahihonau failaketeli, mo fakalahi ʻae tapa ʻo honau kofu,
‌ʻO nau manako ki he nofoʻa māʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi kātoanga, mo e nofoʻanga lahi ʻi he ngaahi falelotu,
Mo e fetapa ʻi he ngaahi faianga fakatau, pea ke ui ʻakinautoluʻe he kakai, ‘Lāpai, Lāpai.’
Kae ʻoua naʻa ui ʻakimoutolu‘Lāpai:’he ʻoku taha pe homou ʻEiki, ko Kalaisi; pea ko e kāinga pe ʻakimoutolukotoa pē.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ui ha tokotaha ʻi māmani ko hoʻomou tamai; he ʻoku taha pe hoʻomou Tamai, ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he langi.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ui ʻakimoutoluko e takimuʻa; he ʻoku taha pe homou Takimuʻa, ko Kalaisi.
Ka ko ia ʻoku lahi ʻiate kimoutolu, ʻe hoko ia ko homou tauhi.
Pea ko ia te ne hiki hake ia, ʻe fakavaivaiʻi ia; ka ko ia ʻe fakavaivaiʻi ia, ʻe hiki hake ia.

¶“Ka ʻe malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! He ʻoku mou tāpuni ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi ki he kakai: he ʻoku ʻikai te mou hūki ai, pe tuku ke hūki aiʻakinautoluʻoku fai ke hūki ai.

‌ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! He ʻoku mou faʻao ʻae fale ʻoe kau fefine kuo mate honau ʻunoho, ʻo fakakākāʻaki ʻae lotu fuoloa: ko ia te mou malaʻia lahi ai.

“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi; he ʻoku mou foli ʻae tahi mo e fonua, ke fakatafoki ha tokotaha, pea ka tafoki ia, ʻoku mou ngaohi ia ko e tama ʻo heli ʻo kovi lahi hake ʻiate kimoutolu.
“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau takimuʻa kui, ʻaia ʻoku lea pehē, ‘Ko e meʻa noa pēʻae fuakava ʻaki ʻae falelotu lahi: ka ko ia ʻe fuakava ʻaki ʻae koula ʻoe falelotu lahi, ʻe maʻu ia.’
Ko e kau vale mo e kui: he ʻoku lahi ʻae fē, ʻae koula, pe ʻae falelotu lahi ʻaia ʻoku ne fakatapui ʻae koula?
Pea, ‘Ko ia ʻe fuakava ʻaki ʻae ʻesifeilaulau, ko e meʻa noa pē: ka ko ia ʻoku fuakava ki he meʻa foaki ʻoku tuku ai, ʻe maʻu pe ia.’
Ko e kau vale mo e kui: he ʻoku lahi ʻae fē, ʻae meʻa foaki, pe ko e ʻesifeilaulau ʻoku ne fakatapui ʻae meʻa foaki?
Pea ko ia ʻoku ne fuakava ʻaki ʻae ʻesifeilaulau, ʻoku fuakava ki ai ia, pea mo e meʻa kotoa pēʻoku ʻi ai.
Pea ko ia ʻoku fuakava ʻaki ʻae falelotu lahi, ʻoku ne fuakava ki ai, pea mo ia ʻoku nofo ʻi ai.
Pea ko ia te ne fuakava ʻaki ʻae langi, ʻoku fuakava ki he ʻafioʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, pea mo ia ʻoku nofo ʻi ai.

“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! Koeʻuhi ʻoku mou tukuhau ʻi he mini, mo e ʻaneto, mo e kumino, ka ʻoku mou taʻetokanga ki he ngaahi meʻa mamafa ʻoe fono, ko e fai totonu, mo e loto ʻofa, mo e tui: naʻe totonu hoʻomou fai eni, kaeʻoua naʻa liʻaki ʻena.
Ko e kau takimuʻa kui, ʻoku mou heuʻi ʻae lango, kae folo ʻae kāmeli.
“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! He ʻoku mou fakamaʻa ʻae tuʻa ipu inu mo e ipu kai, ka ʻoku fonu ʻi loto ʻi he fakamālohi mo e holi kovi.
‌ʻAe Fālesi kui, tomuʻa fakamaʻa ʻae loto ipu inu mo e ipu kai, koeʻuhi ke maʻa ai foki ʻae tuʻaipu.

“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! He ʻoku mou tatau mo e fonualoto kuo vali hinehina, ʻaia ʻoku matamatalelei moʻoni ʻituʻa, ka ʻoku fonu ʻi loto ʻi he ngaahi hui ʻoe kakai mate, mo e meʻa fakalielia kotoa pē.
‌ʻOku pehēpe ʻakimoutolufoki, ʻoku mou ha māʻoniʻoni ʻituʻa ki he kakai, ka ʻoku mou fonu ʻi loto ʻi he mālualoimo e angahia.
“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ko e kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! He ʻoku mou ngaohi ʻae tanuʻanga ʻoe kau palōfita, ʻo fakasanisani ʻae fonualoto ʻoe kakai māʻoniʻoni,
‌ʻo mou pehē, ‘Ka ne mau moʻui ʻi he ʻaho ʻo ʻemau ngaahi tamai, pehē, ʻe ʻikai te mau kau mo kinautoluʻi he toto ʻoe kau palōfita.’
“Ko ia ko e kau fakamoʻoni ʻakimoutolukiate kimoutolu, ko e fānau ʻakimoutoluʻanautolunaʻe tāmateʻi ʻae kau palōfita.
Ko ia mou fakafonu ʻae ipu fuofuaʻa hoʻomou ngaahi tamai.
‌ʻAe fanga ngata, ʻae fānau ʻae ngata fekai! Te mou hao fēfeeʻi mei he malaʻia ʻo heli?

¶Ko ia, vakai, ʻoku ou fekau atu kiate kimoutoluʻae kau palōfita, mo e kau tangata poto, mo e kau tangata tohi: pea ko honau niʻihi te mou tāmateʻi ʻo tutukiki he ʻakau: pea ko honau niʻihi te mou haha ʻi homou ngaahi falelotu, ʻo fakatangaʻi mei he kolo ki he kolo:

Koeʻuhi ʻe ʻeke ʻiate kimoutoluʻae toto māʻoniʻoni kotoa pēkuo lilingi ʻi māmani mei he toto ʻo ʻEpeli māʻoniʻoni, ʻo hoko ki he toto ʻo Sakalaia ko e foha ʻo Palakia, ʻaia naʻa mou tāmateʻi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻoe potu toputapumo e ʻesifeilaulau.
Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE hoko ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēki he toʻutangata ni.

“ʻE Selūsalema, Selūsalema, ʻa Koe ʻoku ke tāmateʻi ʻae kau palōfita, mo ke tolongaki ʻaki ʻae maka ʻakinautoluʻoku fekau atu kiate koe, kuo liunga fiha ʻeku fie tānaki fakataha hoʻo fānau, ʻo hangēko e tānaki fakataha ʻe he motuʻa moa ʻene fānau ʻi hono lalo kapakau, ka naʻe ʻikai te mou lotoki ai!
Vakai, kuo siʻaki homou fale kiate kimoutoluke lala ʻaupito.
He ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Ngata mei heni, ʻe ʻikai te mou mamata kiate au, kaeʻoua ke mou pehē, ‘ʻOku monūʻia ia ʻoku haʻu ʻi he huafa ʻoe ʻEiki.’|”
24: PEA hūatu ʻa Sisu mei he falelotu lahi, pea haʻu ʻene kau ākonga ke fakahākiate ia hono ngaahi potu ʻoe falelotu lahi.

Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻIkai ʻoku mou mamata ki he ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē? ʻOku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai ʻi heni ha maka kuo fokotuʻu ki ha maka, ʻe taʻelaku ki lalo.”

¶Pea ʻi heʻene nofo ʻi he moʻunga ʻoe ʻOlive, naʻe haʻu fakafufūʻae kau ākonga kiate ia, ʻonau pehē, “Fakahākiate kimautolu, ʻe hoko ʻafe ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni? Pea ko e hāʻae fakaʻilonga ʻo hoʻo haʻu, pea mo e ngataʻanga ʻo māmani?”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Vakai telia naʻa kākaaʻi ʻakimoutoluʻe ha tangata.
Koeʻuhi ʻe haʻu ʻae tokolahi ʻi hoku hingoa, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko au ko e Kalaisi;’pea ʻe kākaaʻi ʻae tokolahi:
Pea te mou fanongo ki he ngaahi tau mo e ongoongo ʻoe tau: kaeʻoua naʻa mou manavahē: koeʻuhi ʻe hokoenikotoa pē, kae teʻeki hoko ʻae ngataʻanga.
Koeʻuhi ʻe tuʻu hake ʻae kakai ki he kakai, mo e puleʻanga ki he puleʻanga: pea ʻe ai ʻae ngaahi honge, mo e mahaki lahi, mo e mofuike, ʻi he potu kehekehe.
Ka ko e ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēko e kamataʻanga pe ʻoe ngaahi mamahi.
“Pea te nau toki tukuangeʻakimoutoluke tautea, mo tāmateʻi ʻakimoutolu: pea ko e fehiʻanekina ʻakimoutoluʻe he puleʻanga kotoa pēkoeʻuhi ko hoku hingoa.
Pea ʻe toki hinga ai ʻae tokolahi, ʻo felavakiʻiʻaki ʻakinautolu, mo fetāufehiʻaʻaki.
Pea tokolahi ʻae kau palōfita loi ʻe tupu ai, ʻonau kākaaʻi ʻae tokolahi.
Pea ko e meʻa ʻi he lahi ʻaupitoʻoe angahala, ʻe momoko ai ʻae ʻofa ʻae tokolahi.
Ka ko ia ʻe faʻa kātaki ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga, ko ia ia ʻe moʻui.
Pea ko e ongoongolelei ni ʻoe puleʻanga ʻe malangaʻaki ʻi māmani kotoa pē, ko e meʻa fakamoʻoni ki he puleʻanga kotoa pē, pea ʻe toki hoko mai ʻae ikuʻanga.
“Ko ia ʻoka mou ka mamata ʻoku tuʻu ʻi he potu tapu, ʻae meʻa ‘fakalielia ʻoe fakaʻauha,’naʻe lea ki ai ʻae palōfita ko Taniela,”(pea ko ia ʻoku ne lau ia, ke tokanga iaki ai:)
“Pea ke toki feholaki ki he ngaahi moʻunga ʻakinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi Siutea:
Pea ko ia ʻoku ʻi he tuʻa fale, ke ʻoua naʻa ʻalu hifo ia, ke toʻo ha meʻa ʻe taha mei hono fale:
Pea ko ia ʻoku ʻi he ngoue, ke ʻoua naʻa liu mai ia, ke toʻo hono ngaahi kofu.
Ka ʻe malaʻia ʻakinautoluʻoku feitama, mo kinautoluʻoku toutama, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia!
Ka mou kole ke ʻoua naʻa hoko hoʻomou feholaki ʻi he faʻahitaʻu momoko, pe ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate:
Ka koeʻuhi ʻe toki hoko ʻae mamahi lahi, naʻe ʻikai hano tatau talu mei he kamataʻanga ʻo māmani, ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho ni, pea ʻe ʻikai ʻo lauikuonga.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai fakasiʻisiʻi ki he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, ʻe ʻikai moʻui ha tokotaha: ka koeʻuhi ko e kakai kuo fili ʻe fakasiʻisiʻi ai ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ko ia.
“Pea kapau ʻe toki pehēai ʻe ha taha kiate kimoutolu, ‘Vakai, ʻoku ʻi heni ʻa Kalaisi,’pe ‘ʻi hena;’ʻoua naʻa tuiki ai.
Koeʻuhi ʻe ai ʻae ngaahi Kalaisi loi, mo e kau palōfita loi, ʻonau fakahāʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga lahi, mo e meʻa fakaofo: ke nau kākāʻaki ʻae kakai kuo fili, ʻoka ne faingofua.
Vakai, kuo u tomuʻa tala ia kiate kimoutolu.
“Ko ia kapau te nau pehēkiate kimoutolu, ‘Vakai, ʻoku ʻi he toafa ia;’ʻoua naʻa ʻalu atu: ‘Vakai, ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi potu lilo:’ʻoua naʻa tuiki ai.
He ʻoku hangēko e ʻasi mai ʻoe ʻuhilamei he potu hahake, pea ulo ʻo aʻu ki he potu lulunga; ʻe pehēfoki ʻae haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata.
“He ko e potu ko ia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae ʻangaʻanga, ʻe kātoa ki ai ʻae fanga ʻikale foki.
¶“Pea hili ʻae mamahi ʻoe ngaahi ʻaho ko ia ʻe fakapoʻuli leva ʻae laʻā, pea ʻe ʻikai ulo mai ʻae māhina, pea ʻe ngangana ʻae ngaahi fetuʻu mei he langi, pea ʻe ngalulu ʻae ngaahi mālohi ʻoe langi:

Pea ʻe toki hāmai ʻae fakaʻilonga ʻoe Foha ʻoe tangata ʻi he langi: pea ʻe toki tangi ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga kotoa pēʻo māmani, pea te nau mamata ki he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻoku haʻu ʻi he ngaahi ʻao ʻoe langi, ʻi he mālohi mo e nāunau lahi.

Pea ʻe fekau ʻe ia ʻene kau ʻāngelo mo e meʻa lea leʻo lahi, pea te nau tānaki fakataha ʻene kakai kuo fili mei hono feituʻu langi ʻe fā, mei he ngataʻanga ʻe taha ʻoe langi ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga ʻe taha.
“Pea mou tokanga ki he fakatātāʻoe ʻakau ko e fiki: ʻOka kei litolito hono vaʻa, pea tupu hono lau, ʻoku mou ʻilo ʻoku ofi ʻae faʻahitaʻu mafana:
Pea pehēfoki, ʻoka mou ka mamata ki he ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē, mou ʻilo ʻoku ofi ia, ʻio, ʻoku ʻi he matapā.
‌ʻOku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai ʻosi ʻae toʻutangata ni, kaeʻoua ke fakamoʻoni ʻa eni kotoa pē.
‌ʻE mole ʻae langi mo māmani, kae ʻikai mole ʻeku lea.
¶“Ka ko e ʻaho mo e feituʻulaʻāko ia, ʻoku ʻikai ʻilo ki ai ha taha, peʻilo ʻehe kau ʻāngelo ʻoe langi, ka ko ʻeku Tamai pe.
Kae hangēko e ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Noa, ʻe pehēpe foki ʻae haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata.
He koeʻuhi ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho naʻe muʻomuʻa ʻi he lōmaki naʻa nau kai mo inu, mo mali, mo foaki ke fakamaʻu, ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho naʻe hūai ʻa Noa ki he vaka,
Pea naʻe ʻikai te nau ʻamanaki, mo ʻene hoko mai ʻae vai lahi, ʻo ʻave ʻakinautolukotoa pē; ʻe pehēpe ʻae haʻu foki ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata.
‌ʻE ʻi he ngoue ʻae toko ua; ʻe ʻave ʻae tokotaha, ka ʻe tuku ʻae tokotaha.
‌ʻE ai ʻae fefine ʻe toko ua ʻoku ngāue ʻi he meʻa momosi; ʻe ʻave ʻae tokotaha, ka ʻe tuku ʻae tokotaha.
¶“Ko ia leʻo: he ʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻilo ʻae feituʻulaʻāko ia ʻe haʻu ai homou ʻEiki.
Kae ʻilo eni, ka ne ʻilo ʻe he ʻeiki ʻoe fale ʻae lakanga leʻo ko ia ʻe haʻu ai ʻae kaihaʻa,pehē, kuo ne leʻo, kae ʻikai tuku ke haea hono fale.
Ko ia ke tali teu pe ʻakimoutolufoki: koeʻuhi ʻe haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻi he feituʻulaʻāʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻamanaki ki ai.
“Pea ko hai ʻae tamaioʻeiki angatonu mo poto, kuo fakanofo ʻe heʻene ʻeiki ke pule ki hono kaungāʻapi, mo tufakikiate kinautoluʻae meʻakai ʻi hono taimi totonu?
‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻoka haʻu ʻa ʻene ʻeiki, ʻo ʻilo ia ʻoku ne fai pehē.
Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, te ne fakanofo ia ke ne puleʻi ʻene meʻa kotoa pē.
Pea kapau ʻe pehēʻe he tamaioʻeiki angakovi ʻi hono loto, ‘ʻOku fakatuai ne haʻu ʻa ʻeku ʻeiki;’
pea ne kamata teʻia ʻene kaungātamaioʻeiki, pea kai ia mo inu fakataha mo e kau konā;
‌ʻE haʻu ʻae ʻeiki ʻae tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻi ha ʻaho ʻoku ʻikai te ne ʻamanekina, pea ʻi ha feituʻulaʻāʻoku ʻikai te ne ʻilo,
Pea ʻe tuʻuua ia, ʻo tuʻutuʻuni ke ʻinasi fakataha ia mo e kau mālualoi: pea ʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangi mo e fengaiʻitaki ʻoe nifo.
25: “PEA ʻe toki tatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe langi mo e kau tāupoʻou ʻe toko hongofulu, naʻa nau toʻo ʻenau ngaahi tūhulu, ʻo ʻalu atu ke fakafetaulakiki he tangata taʻane.
Naʻe poto honau toko nima, kae vale ʻae toko nima.
Ko kinautolunaʻe vale naʻe ʻave ʻenau tūhulu, ka naʻe ʻikai ʻave mo haʻanau lolo:
Ka naʻe ʻave ʻe he poto ʻae lolo ʻi heʻenau ngaahi ipu, pea mo ʻenau tūhulu
Pea ʻi he tuai mai ʻae tangata taʻane, naʻa nau tulemohe kotoa pēʻo mohe.
“Pea tuʻuapōmālie mo ʻene pa mai ʻae kalanga, ‘Vakai, ʻoku haʻu ʻae tangata taʻane; mou ʻalu atu ʻo fakafetaulakikiate ia.’
Pea toki tuʻu hake ʻae kau tāupoʻou kotoa pēko ia, ʻo teuteu ʻenau tūhulu.
Pea lea ʻae vale ki he poto, ‘Foaki mai maʻamautoluʻi hoʻomou lolo; he ʻoku tei mate ʻemau tūhulu’
Ka naʻe lea ʻae poto, ʻo pehēange, ‘Ka koeʻuhi naʻa siʻi ia kiate kimautolumo kimoutolu: ka mou ʻalu kiate kinautoluʻoku fakatau, ʻo fakatau maʻamoutolu.’
Pea lolotonga ʻenau ʻalu ke fakatau, mo ʻene haʻu ʻae tangata taʻane, pea ko kinautolunaʻe teuteu naʻe hūmo ia ki he taʻane: pea tāpuni ʻae matapā.
“Hili ia, mo ʻene haʻu foki ʻae kau tāupoʻou naʻe ʻalu, ʻonau pehē, ‘ʻEiki, ʻEiki, toʻo kiate kimautolu.’
Ka naʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēange, ‘ʻOku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻiloa ʻakimoutolu.’
“Ko ia mou leʻo, he ʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻilo ʻae ʻaho pe ʻae feituʻulaʻāʻe haʻu ai ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata.
¶“Pea ʻoku hangēfoki ko e tangata ʻoku te u fononga ki ha fonua mamaʻo, pea ui ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki ʻaʻana, ʻo ne tuku kiate kinautoluʻene ngaahi meʻa.
Naʻe tuku ki he tokotaha ʻae taleniti ʻe nima, pea ua ki he tokotaha, pea taha ki he tokotaha; ki he tangata taki taha ʻo fakatatau ki heʻene faʻa fai, pea ʻalu leva hono fononga.
Pea ko ia naʻe maʻu ʻae taleniti ʻe nima, naʻe ʻalu ia, ʻo fakatauʻaki ia, ʻo ne fakalahi ʻaki ia ʻae taleniti kehe ʻe nima.
Pea ko ia foki naʻe ua, naʻa ne maʻu ʻaki ia ʻae ua kehe.
Ka ko ia naʻe maʻu ʻae taha, naʻe ʻalu ia, ʻo keli ʻi he kelekele, ʻo tanu ʻae koloa ʻa ʻene ʻeiki.
“Pea fuoloa, peatokihaʻu ʻae ʻeiki ʻoe kau tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻo ne fakamaauʻi ʻakinautolu.

Pea haʻu ia ʻaia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae taleniti ʻe nima, ʻo ne ʻomi mo e taleniti kehe ʻe nima, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, naʻa ke tuku mai kiate au ʻae taleniti ʻe nima: vakai, kuo u maʻu mo ia ʻae taleniti kehe ʻe nima.’

Pea pehēange ʻe heʻene ʻeiki kiate ia, ‘Mālō, ko e tamaioʻeiki lelei mo angatonu: kuo ke fai totonu ʻi he meʻa siʻi, te u fakanofo koe ke ke pule ki he meʻa lahi: hūkoe ki he fiefiaʻanga ʻo hoʻo ʻeiki.’
Pea haʻu foki ia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae taleniti ʻe ua, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, naʻa ke tuku mai kiate au ʻae taleniti ʻe ua: vakai, kuo u maʻu mo ia ʻae taleniti kehe ʻe ua.’

Pea pehēange ʻe heʻene ʻeiki kiate ia, ‘Mālō, ko e tamaioʻeiki lelei mo angatonu: kuo ke fai totonu ʻi he meʻa siʻi, te u fakanofo koe ke ke pule ki he meʻa lahi: hūkoe ki he fiefiaʻanga ʻo hoʻo ʻeiki.’

Pea toki haʻu ia naʻa ne maʻu ʻae taleniti ʻe taha, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, ne u ʻilo koe ko e tangata faingataʻa, ʻoku ke tuʻusi ʻi he potu naʻe ʻikai te ke tūtuuʻi ai, ʻo tānaki ʻi he potu naʻe ʻikai te ke tufakiai:
Pea ne u manavahē, pea u ʻalu ʻo fufūhoʻo taleniti ʻi he kelekele: vakai, ʻoku ke maʻu ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻau.’
“Pea lea ʻene ʻeiki, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, ‘ʻAe tamaioʻeiki angakovi mo fakapikopiko, naʻa ke ʻilo ʻoku ou tuʻusi ʻi he potu naʻe ʻikai te u tūtuuʻi ai, mo tānaki ʻi he potu naʻe ʻikai te u tufakiai:
Naʻe totonu ai haʻo ʻatu ʻeku koloa ki he kau fakatau, koeʻuhi ʻi heʻeku haʻu te u maʻu ʻaia ʻoku ʻaʻaku mo hono fakalahi.
Ko ia toʻo ʻae taleniti meiate ia, ʻo ʻoatu kiate ia ʻoku hongofulu ʻene taleniti.
He ko ia fulipēʻoku maʻu, ʻetoeʻoatu kiate ia, pea te ne maʻu ʻo lahi ʻaupito: ka ko ia ʻoku ʻikai maʻu, ʻe toʻo meiate ia ʻaia ʻoku ne maʻu.
Pea mou līʻae tamaioʻeiki taʻeʻaonga ki he poʻuli ʻi tuaʻā: pea ʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangi mo e fengaiʻitaki ʻoe nifo.’
¶“ʻOka haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻi hono nāunau, mo e kau ʻāngelo māʻoniʻoni kotoa pēmo ia, ʻe toki nofo ia ʻi he nofoʻa ʻo hono nāunau:
pea ʻe fakakātoa ʻi hono ʻao ʻae ngaahi kakai kotoa pē: pea ʻe vahe ua ʻe ia ʻakinautolu, ʻo hangēko e vaheʻi ʻe he tauhi sipi ʻa ʻene sipi mei he kosi:
Pea ʻe tuku ʻe ia ʻae fanga sipi ki hono nima toʻomataʻu, ka ko e fanga kosi ki he toʻohema.
Pea ʻe toki pehēʻe he Tuʻi kiate kinautoluʻi hono nima toʻomataʻu, ‘Haʻu, ʻakimoutolukuo monūʻia ʻi heʻeku Tamai, ʻo maʻu ʻae puleʻanga kuo teu moʻomoutolutalu mei he kamataʻanga ʻo māmani:
He naʻaku fiekaia, pea naʻa mou foaki ʻae meʻakai kiate au: naʻaku fieinua, pea naʻa mou foaki ʻae inu kiate au: ko e muli au, pea naʻa mou fakaʻafeʻi au:
Telefua, pea naʻa mou fakakofuʻi au: naʻaku mahaki, pea naʻa mou ʻaʻahi mai kiate au: naʻaku ʻi he fale fakapōpula, pea naʻa mou haʻu kiate au.’
“Pea ʻe toki lea ʻae māʻoniʻoni, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, ‘ʻEiki, naʻa mau mamata kiate koe ʻanefēʻoku ke fiekaia, pea mau fafangaʻikoe? Pea fieinua, pea mau foaki ʻae inukiate koe?
Naʻa mau mamata kiate koe ʻanefēko e muli, pea mau fakaafeʻikoe? Pe telefua, pea mau fakakofuʻikoe?
Pea naʻa mau mamata kiate koe ʻanefēʻoku ke mahaki, pe ʻi he fale fakapōpula, pea mau ʻalu atu kiate koe?’
Pea ʻe lea ʻae Tuʻi, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, ‘Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻomou fai ia ki ha taha ʻoku kihiʻi siʻi hifo ʻi hoku kāinga ni, ko hoʻomou faiiakiate au.’
“Pea ʻe toki tala ʻe ia foki kiate kinautoluʻihononima toʻohema, ‘ʻAlu ʻiate au, ʻakimoutolukuo malaʻia, ki he afi taʻemate, naʻe teu ki he tēvolo mo ʻene kau ʻāngelo:
He naʻaku fiekaia, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou foaki ha meʻakai kiate au: naʻaku fieinua, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou foaki ha inu kiate au:
Ko e muli au, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou fakaafeʻi au: telefua, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou fakakofuʻi au: mahaki, pea ʻi he fale fakapōpula, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou ʻaʻahi kiate au.’

“Pea ʻe toki lea ai ʻakinautolukiate ia foki, ʻo pehēange, ‘ʻEiki, naʻa mau mamata kiate koe ʻanefēʻoku ke fiekaia, pe ko e fieinua, pe ko e muli, pe telefua, pe mahaki, pe ʻi he fale fakapōpula, kae ʻikai te mau tauhi koe?’

Pea ʻe toki lea ia kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻomou taʻefaiiaki ha tokotaha ʻoku kihiʻi siʻi hifoʻiate kinautoluni, ko hoʻomou taʻefaiiakiate au.’
Pea ʻe ʻalu atu ʻakinautoluni ki he malaʻia taʻengata: ka ko e māʻoniʻoni ki he moʻui taʻengata.”
26: PEA kuo fakaʻosi ʻe Sisu ʻae ngaahi akonaki ni kotoa pē, pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau ākonga,
“ʻOku mou ʻilo ka hili ʻae ʻaho ʻe ua ʻe hoko ʻa ekātoanga ʻoeLakaatu, pea ʻe lavakiʻi ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ke tutukiki he ʻakau.”
Pea toki fakataha ai ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi, mo e kau tangata tohi, mo e kau mātuʻa ʻoe kakai, ki he fale ʻoe taulaʻeiki lahi naʻe ui ko Kaiafasi,
‌ʻonau fakakaukau pe fēfēʻenau puke ia, kae tāmateʻiia?
Ka naʻa nau pehē, “Kae ʻikai ʻi he kātoanga, telia naʻa ai ha maveuveu ʻi he kakai.”
¶Pea naʻe ʻi Pētani ʻa Sisu, ʻi he fale ʻo Saimone ko e kilia,
Mo ʻene haʻu kiate ia ha fefine, naʻe ʻomi ʻae puha ʻalapasita ʻoe lolo mahuʻinga lahi ʻaupito, ʻo ne lilingi ia ki hono fofonga, ʻi heʻene nofo ʻo taumafa.
Ka ʻi he mamata ki ai ʻene kau ākonga, naʻa nau lea ʻita, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hākuo maumauʻi ai eni?
He naʻe mei fakatau ʻae lolo ni ʻaki ʻae koloa lahi, pea foaki ia ki he masiva.”
Pea kuo ʻiloʻi ʻe Sisu, pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou fakamamahi ai ki he fefine? He kuo fai ʻe ia ʻae ngāue lelei kiate au.
He ʻoku ʻiate kimoutolumaʻuaipēʻae masiva; ka ʻoku ʻikai te mou maʻu maʻuaipēau.
Koeʻuhi ʻi heʻene lilingi ʻae lolo ni ki hoku sino, kuo ne fai ia ko e teu ki hoku putu.
Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e potu kotoa pēʻo māmani ʻe malangaʻaki ai ʻae ongoongolelei ni, ʻe fakahāai foki ʻaia kuo fai ʻe he fefine ni, ko hono fakamanatuʻi.”
¶Pea toki ʻalu ki he kau taulaʻeiki lahi ha taha ʻoe toko hongofulu ma toko ua, naʻe ui ko SiutasiʻIsikaliote,
‌ʻo ne pehē, “Ko e hāte mou ʻomi kiate au, kau lavakiʻi ia kiate kimoutolu?”Pea nau alea mo ia ki he konga siliva ʻe tolungofulu.
Pea talu mei ai mo ʻene lamasi ia ke tuʻumālie ʻa hono lavakiʻi.
¶Pea naʻe haʻu kia Sisu ʻae kau ākonga ʻi he ʻuluakiʻahoʻoe mātaʻemeʻafakatupu, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ke loto ke mau teuteu ʻi fēke ke kai ai ʻi he Lakaatu.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Mou ōki he tangata ko ia ʻi he kolo, ʻo tala kiate ia, ‘ʻOku pehēmai ʻae ʻEiki, “Kuo ofi hoku ʻaho, pea te mau kai ʻae Lakaatu ʻi ho fale mo ʻeku kau ākonga.”|’|”
Pea naʻe fai ʻe he kau ākonga ʻo hangēko e fekau ʻa Sisu kiate kinautolu; pea nau teu ʻa ekātoanga ʻoeLakaatu.
Pea kuo hoko ʻae efiafi, pea nofo ia mo e toko hongofulu ma toko ua.
Pea ʻi heʻenau kai, naʻe pehēʻe ia, “Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻe lavakiʻi au ʻe homou tokotaha.”
Pea naʻa nau mamahi lahi, ʻonau taki taha kamata fehuʻi kiate ia,ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ko au ia?”
Pea lea ia ʻo pehē, “Ko ia ʻokuma ʻai mo au homa nima ki he ipu kai, ko ia ia te ne lavakiʻi au.
‌ʻOku ʻalu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻo hangēko ia kuo tohi kiate ia: kae malaʻia ʻae tangata ko ia ʻaia ʻoku lavakiʻi ai ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata! Naʻe lelei ki he tangata ko ia ʻoka ne ʻikai fanauʻi ia.”
Pea toki lea ʻa Siutasi, ʻaia ne lavakiʻi ia, ʻo pehēange, “ʻEiki, ko au ia?”Pea talaange ʻe ia kiate ia, “Ko ia pe.”
