Pea kuo nau haʻu, pea nau pehēkiate ia, “ʻEiki ʻoku mau ʻilo ʻoku ke moʻoni koe, pea ʻoku ʻikai te ke tokanga ki ha tangata; he ʻoku ʻikai te ke filifilimānako ki he tangata, ka ʻoku ke akonaki ʻaki ʻae hala ʻoe ʻOtua ʻi he moʻoni: ʻOku ngofua ke ʻatu ʻae tukuhau kia Sisa, pe ʻikai?
‌ʻE lelei ʻemau ʻatu, pe ʻikai?”Ka naʻe ʻilo ʻe ia ʻenau mālualoi, mo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou ʻahiʻahiʻi ai au?”ʻOmi ha tenali ke u mamata ai.
Pea nau ʻomiia. Pea ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko e fofonga mo e tohi eni ʻa hai?”Pea nau pehēkiate ia, “ʻA Sisa.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “ʻAnge kia Sisa ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻa Sisa, peaʻangeki he ʻOtua ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻae ʻOtua. Pea naʻa nau ofo ʻiate ia.”
¶Pea toki haʻu ʻae kau Satusi kiate ia, ʻakinautoluʻoku pehēʻoku ʻikai ha toetuʻu; pea nau fehuʻi kiate ia, ʻo pehē,

“ʻEiki, naʻe tohi ʻe Mōsese kiate kimautolu,ʻo pehē, ‘Kapau ʻe pekia ʻae tokoua ʻo ha tangata, pea ʻoku aihonoʻunoho, kae ʻikai haʻane fānau, ʻe maʻu ʻe hono tokoua ʻa hono ʻunoho, ʻo fakatupu ʻae hako ki hono tokoua.’
Naʻe ai ʻae kāinga ʻe toko fitu: pea maʻu ʻe he ʻuluaki ʻae ʻunoho, pea pekia ia ʻoku ʻikai hano hako.
Pea maʻu ia ʻe hono toko ua, pea pekia ia, kae ʻikai hano hako; pea mo hono toko tolu foki,
Pea maʻu ia ʻe he toko fitu, kae ʻikai ha hako: pea mate fakamui foki ʻae fefine.
Ko ia, ʻi he toetuʻu, ʻoka nau ka tuʻu hake, ʻe hoko ia ko e ʻunohoʻo hai ʻiate kinautolu? He naʻe maʻu ia ʻe he toko fitu kohonauʻunoho.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “ʻIkai ko ia ʻoku mou hēai, koeʻuhi ko hoʻomou taʻeʻilo ki he tohi, mo e mālohi ʻae ʻOtua?
Koeʻuhi, ʻoka nau ka tuʻu hake mei he pekia, ʻoku ʻikai te nau mali, pe foaki ke mali; ka ʻoku nau tatau mo e kau ʻāngelo ʻi he langi.

Pea koeʻuhi ko e toetuʻu ʻae pekia, naʻe ʻikai te mou lau ʻi he tohi ʻa Mōsese, ki he folofola ʻae ʻOtua kiate ia ʻi he ʻulu ʻakau, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko au ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻEpalahame, pea ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻAisake, pea ko e ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope?’
‌ʻOku ʻikai ko e ʻOtua ia ʻoe mate, ka ko e ʻOtua ʻoe moʻui: ko ia ʻoku mou hēlahi ai.”
¶Pea ko e tangata tohi ʻe tokotaha, naʻa ne fanongo ki heʻenau fetauʻaki, pea ne ʻilo kuo tali lelei ʻe ia ʻakinautolu, pea haʻu ia ʻo fehuʻi kiate ia, “Ko e fekau fēʻoku lahi ʻi hefonokotoa pē?”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Ko e lahieniʻi he ngaahi fekau kotoa pē, ‘Fanongo, ʻe ʻIsileli; Ko Sihova ko hotau ʻOtua ko Sihova ʻoku taha pe:
pea ke ʻofa kia Sihova ko ho ʻOtua ʻaki ho loto kotoa, pea mo ho laumālie kotoa, mo ho ʻatamai kotoa, mo ho mālohi kotoa.’Ko e lahi eni ʻi he fekau.
Pea ko hono ua ʻoku tataumo ia, ‘Ke ke ʻofa ki ho kaungāʻapi ʻo hangēpe ko koe.’ʻOku ʻikai ha fekau ʻe lahi hake ki he ongofekauni.”
Pea pehēʻe he tangata tohi kiate ia, “Ko e moʻoni, ʻEiki, kuo ke lea totonu: he ʻoku ai ʻae ʻOtua pe taha; pea ʻoku ʻikai mo ha taha:

Pea ko e ʻofa kiate ia ʻaki ʻae loto kotoa, mo e ʻatamai kotoa, mo e laumālie kotoa, pea mo e mālohi kotoa, pea ko e ʻofa ki hono kaungāʻapi ʻo hangēpe ko ia, ʻoku lahi hake ia ʻi he ngaahi feilaulau tutu kotoa mo e ngaahi hifo kotoa pē.”
Pea kuo ʻilo ʻe Sisu ʻoku ne lea fakapotopoto mai, pea ne pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ʻikai te ke mamaʻo mo e puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”Pea hili ia, naʻe ʻikai ha tangata ʻe faʻa fehuʻi kiate ia.
¶Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo ne pehēʻi heʻene kei akonaki ʻi he falelotu lahi, “Ko e hāʻoku pehēai ʻae kau tangata tohi, ‘Ko Kalaisi ko e foha ʻo Tevita?

He naʻe lea foki ʻe Tevita, ʻi he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni,
‘Naʻe pehēʻe Sihova ki hoku ʻEiki,
Nofo koe ki hoku nima toʻomataʻu,
kaeʻoua ke u ngaohi hoʻo ngaahi fili ko ho tuʻungavaʻe.”|’
Ko ia, ʻoku ui ia ʻe Tevita, ‘ʻEiki;’pea ko hono foha fēfēia?”Pea fanongo fiefia kiate ia ʻae kakai lāuvale.
¶Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ʻi heʻene akonaki, “Vakai telia ʻae kau tangata tohi, ʻoku nau manako ke ʻalu ʻi he kofu tōtōlofa, mo e fetapa ʻi he ngaahi faianga fakatau,
mo e nofoʻanga lelei ʻi he ngaahi falelotu, mo e potu māʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi kātoanga;
‌ʻAkinautoluʻoku nau faʻao ʻae ngaahi fale ʻoe kau fefine kuo mate honau ʻunoho, mo fakakākāʻaki ʻae ngaahi lotu fuoloa: ʻe maʻu ʻekinautoluni ʻae malaʻia lahi.”
¶Pea nofo ʻa Sisu ʻo hangatonu ki hefaletukuʻanga koloa, ʻo ne vakai ki he līʻe he kakaiʻenaupaʻanga ki he tukuʻanga koloa: pea ko e tokolahi naʻe koloaʻia ne nau līki aiʻae meʻa lahi.
Pea haʻu ʻae fefine masiva kuo mate hono ʻunoho, ʻone līki aiʻae kihiʻi paʻanga ʻe ua, ʻaia ʻoku tatau mo e kotani ʻe taha.

Pea ne ui ʻene kau ākonga, mo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e fefine paea ni, kuo ne līki aiʻae meʻa lahi hake ʻiate kinautolufulipē, kuo nau līki he tukuʻanga koloa:
He naʻa nau līkotoa pēki aimei heʻenau koloa lahi; ka ko ia, ʻi heʻene masiva, kuo ne līki aiʻa ia kotoa pēne ne maʻu, ʻio, ʻa ʻene moʻui kotoa pē.”
13: PEA ʻi heʻene ʻalu mei he falelotu lahi, naʻe pehēʻene ākonga ʻe toko kiate ia, “ʻEiki, vakai ki hono anga ʻoe ngaahi maka mo e ngaahi fale!”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ke mamata ki he ngaahi fale lahi ni? ʻE ʻikai ha maka kuo fokotuʻu ki ha maka ʻe tuku, ka ʻe laku kotoa pēki lalo.”
Pea ʻi heʻene nofo ʻi he moʻunga ʻoe ʻOlive, ʻo hangatonu ki he falelotu lahi, naʻe fehuʻi fakafufūkiate ia ʻa Pita mo Semisi mo Sione mo ʻAnitelū,ʻo pehē!
“Fakahākiate kimautolu, ʻe hoko afe ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni? Pea ko e hāʻae fakaʻilonga ʻoka fakamoʻoni ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē?”
Pea fua lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Vakai telia naʻa kākaaʻi ʻakimoutoluʻe ha taha.
Koeʻuhi ʻe haʻu ʻae tokolahi ʻi hoku huafa, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko au ia;’pea te nau kākaaʻi ʻae tokolahi.
Pea ka mou ka fanongo ki he ngaahi tau mo e ongoongo ʻoe tau, ʻoua te mou manavahē: koeʻuhi kuo pau ke hoko ia; kae teʻekihokoʻae ikuʻanga.

Koeʻuhi ʻe tuʻu hake ʻae kakai ki he kakai, mo e puleʻanga ki he puleʻanga; pea ʻe ai ʻae mofuike ʻi he ngaahi potu kehekehe, pea ʻe ai ʻae ngaahi honge mo e ngaahi fakamamahi: ko e kamataʻanga eni ʻoe ngaahi mamahi.

“Ka mou vakai kiate kimoutolu: he te nau tukuangeʻakimoutoluki he kau fakamaau; pea ʻe haha ʻakimoutoluʻi he ngaahi falelotu; pea ʻe ʻomi ʻakimoutoluki he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi pule mo e ngaahi tuʻi koeʻuhi ko au, ko e fakamoʻoni kiate kinautolu.
Ka ʻe tomuʻa malangaʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei ki he ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē.

Pea ka nau ka taki mo tukuangeʻakimoutolu, ʻoua naʻa mou tomuʻa fifili, pe fakakaukau ki he meʻa te mou lea ʻaki: ka ko ia ʻe foaki kiate kimoutoluʻi he feituʻulaʻāko ia, ko ia pe te mou lea ʻaki: he ʻoku ʻikai ko kimoutoluʻoku lea, ka ko e Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni.
Pea ʻe lavakiʻi ʻe he tokotaha ʻahonotokoua ke mate, mo e tamai ʻae foha; pea ʻe tuʻu hake ʻae fānau ki he mātuʻa, mo pule ke tāmateʻi ʻakinautolu.
Pea ʻe fehiʻanekina ʻakimoutoluʻi he kakai fulipēkoeʻuhi ko hoku huafa: ka ko ia ʻe kātaki ʻo aʻu ki he ikuʻanga, ko ia ia ʻe moʻui.

¶“Ka ʻoka mou ka mamata ki he ‘fakalielia ʻoe fakaʻauha,’naʻe lea ki ai ʻa Taniela ko e palōfita, ʻoku tuʻu ʻi he potu ʻoku ʻikai leleike tuʻu ai,”(ko ia ʻoku lau ke tokanga,) “Pea ʻilonga ai ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻi Siutea, ke nau feholaki ki he ngaahi moʻunga:
Pea ko ia ʻoku ʻi he tuʻa fale, ke ʻoua naʻa ʻalu hifo ki loto fale, pe hūki ai, ke toʻo ha meʻa mei hono fale:
Pea ko ia ʻoku ʻi he ngoue, ke ʻoua naʻa foki ia ki mui ke toʻo mai hono kofu.
Ka ʻe malaʻia ʻakinautoluʻoku feitama, pea mo kinautoluʻoku toutama, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia!
Pea mou lotu ke ʻoua naʻa hoko hoʻomou hola ʻi he faʻahitaʻu momoko.
He koeʻuhi ʻe ai ha mamahi ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, ʻaia naʻe ʻikai hano tatau talu hono kamataʻanga ʻo māmani, ʻaia naʻe fakatupu ʻe he ʻOtua, ʻo aʻu ki heni, pea ʻe ʻikai toe pehē.
Pea ka ne taʻeʻoua ʻae fakasiʻisiʻi ʻe he ʻEiki ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, pehē, ʻe ʻikai ha taha ʻe moʻui: ka koeʻuhi ko e kakai fili, ʻaia kuo fili ʻe ia, kuo ne fakasiʻisiʻi ai ʻae ngaahi ʻaho.
“Pea ka toki pehēai ʻe ha taha kiate kimoutolu, ‘Vakai, ko eni ʻa Kalaisi;’pe, ‘Vakai,ʻokuʻi henaia;’ʻoua ʻe tuiki ia:
He koeʻuhi ʻe tupu ʻae ngaahi Kalaisi loi mo e kau palōfita loi, ʻonau fakahāʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga mo e ngaahi meʻa fakaofo, ke kākāʻaki ʻae kakai kuo fili ʻo ka ne faingofua.
Kae tokanga ʻakimoutolu: vakai, ku ou tomuʻa fakahāʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēkiate kimoutolu.
¶“Ka ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, hili ʻae mamahi ko ia, ʻe fakapoʻuli ʻae laʻā, pea ʻe ʻikai tuku mai ʻe he māhina ʻa hono maama,
Pea ʻe ngangana ʻae ngaahi fetuʻu ʻoe langi, pea ʻe lulu ʻae ngaahi mālohi ʻoe langi.
Pea te nau toki mamata ki he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻoku haʻu ʻi he ngaahi ʻao, mo e mālohi lahi mo e nāunau.
Pea ʻe toki fekau ʻe ia ʻa ʻene kau ʻāngelo, pea tānaki fakataha ʻa ʻene kakai fili mei he feituʻu langi ʻe fā, mei he ngataʻanga ʻoe fonua ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga ʻae langi.
“Ko eni, mou ʻilo ʻae fakaʻilonga ʻi he ʻakau ko e fiki; ʻOka kei litolito hono vaʻa, pea tupu hono lau, ʻoku mou ʻilo ʻoku ofi ʻae faʻahitaʻu mafana:
Ke pehēfoki ʻakimoutolu, ʻoka mou ka mamata ki hono hoko ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ni, mou ʻilo ʻoku ofi ia, ʻio, ʻi he matapā.
Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻe ʻikai mole ʻae toʻutangata ni, kaeʻoua ke fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē.
‌ʻE mole ʻae langi mo e fonua: ka ko ʻeku ngaahi lea ʻe ʻikai mole.
¶“Ka ko e ʻaho ko ia mo hono feituʻulaʻā, ʻoku ʻikai ha taha ʻoku ne ʻilo ki ai, ʻe ʻikai, pe ko e kau ʻāngelo ʻoku ʻi he langi, pe ko e Foha, ka ko e Tamai.
Mou vakai, leʻo pea lotu: he ʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻilo pe hoko ʻafēʻae ʻaho ko ia.
‌ʻOka fononga ha tangata, ʻoku ne tuku hono ʻapi ke tauhi ʻe heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, pea ne vahe ʻae ngāue kiate kinautolutaki taha, pea fekau ki he tauhi matapāke leʻo.
Ko ia mou leʻo: he ʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻilo pe haʻu fakakūʻae ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ʻi he efiafi, pe ʻi he tuʻuapō, pe ʻi he ʻuʻua ʻae moa, pe ʻi he pongipongi;
Telia naʻa haʻu fakafokifāpe ia, ʻo ne ʻilo ʻakimoutoluʻoku mou mohe.
Pea ko ia ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻoku ou tala ki he kakai kotoa pē, Leʻo.”
14: PEA hili ʻae ʻaho ʻe ua, pea hoko ʻa ekātoangaʻoe Lakaatu, mo e mātaʻemeʻafakatupu: pea naʻe kumi ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi pe fēfeeʻi ʻenau moʻua ia ʻi he kākā, ke tāmateʻi.
Ka naʻa nau pehē, “Kae ʻikai ʻi he kātoanga, telia naʻa ai ha maveuveu ʻae kakai.”

¶Pea naʻe ʻi Pētani ia, ʻi he fale ʻo Saimone ko e kilia, pea ʻi heʻene nofo ʻo kai, naʻe haʻu ʻae fefine mo e puha ʻalapasita ʻoe lolo ko e naʻati moʻoni ʻoku mahuʻinga lahi; pea ne foaʻi ʻae puha, mo lilingi ki hono fofonga.
Pea naʻe ai ʻae niʻihi naʻa nau loto ʻita, ʻonau pehē, “Ko e hākuo maumauʻi ai ʻae lolo?
He naʻe faingofua ke fakatauʻaki ia ʻae tenali ʻe tolungeau tupu, pea foaki ki he masiva.”Pea nau lāunga kiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe Sisu, “Tuku ai pe ia; ko e hāʻoku mou fakamamahiʻi ai ia? Kuo fai ʻe ia ʻae ngāue lelei kiate au.
He ʻoku ʻiate kimoutolumaʻuaipēʻae masiva, pea ka mou ka loto ki ai ʻoku mou faʻa fai lelei kiate kinautolu; kae ʻikai teu ʻiate kimoutolumaʻuaipēau.
Kuo ne fai ʻaia ʻoku ne faʻa fai: kuo tomuʻa haʻu ia ke tākai hoku sino ki hono tanu.
Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Ko e potu ʻo māmani kotoa pēʻe malangaʻaki ai ʻae ongoongolelei ni, ʻe fakahāʻi ai foki mo ia kuo ne fai ko hono fakamanatuʻi.”
¶Pea ko e tokotaha ʻoe toko hongofulu ma toko ua, ko SiutasiʻIsikaliote, naʻa ne ʻalu ki he kau taulaʻeiki lahi, ke lavakiʻi ia kiate kinautolu.
Pea ʻi heʻenau fanongo ki ai, naʻa nau fiefia, ʻo fakaʻilo paʻanga kiate ia. Pea lamasi ʻe ia ke tuʻumālie ʻene lavakiʻi ia.

¶Pea ʻi he ʻuluaki ʻaho ʻoe mātaʻemeʻafakatupu, ʻi heʻenau tāmateʻi ʻa efeilaulau ʻoeLakaatu, pea pehēʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, “Ko e potu fēʻoku ke loto ke mau ʻalu ʻo teuteu ai, koeʻuhi ke ke kai ʻi he kātoangaʻoeLakaatu?”
Pea fekau atu ʻe ia ʻae toko ua ʻi heʻene kau ākonga, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinaua, “Mo ōki he kolo, pea ʻe fakafetaulakimai kiate kimoua ʻae tangata ʻoku ne fua ʻae ipu vai: muimuiʻiate ia.
Pea ko e fale ko ia ʻe hūki ai ia, mo pehēai ki he ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ‘ʻOku pehēʻe he ʻEiki, “Kofaʻāʻae potu fale, ʻaia teu kai ai mo ʻeku kau ākonga ʻi hekātoanga ʻoeLakaatu.”|’
Pea ʻe fakahāʻe ia kiate kimoua ʻae potu lahi ki ʻolunga, kuo ngaohi mo teuteu: mo teuteu ʻi ai maʻatautolu.”
Pea naʻe ʻalu atu ʻene ongo ākonga, ʻo na hūki he kolo, pea na ʻilo ʻo hangēko ʻene lea kiate kinaua: pea na teuteu ai ʻa efeilaulau ʻoeLakaatu.
Pea ʻi he efiafi naʻa ne haʻu mo e toko hongofulu ma toko ua.
Pea ʻi heʻenau nofo ʻo kai, naʻe pehēʻe Sisu, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, Ko homou tokotaha ʻoku tau keinanga te ne lavakiʻi au.”
Pea naʻa nau mamahi leva, mo nau taki taha pehēkiate ia, “Ko au ia?”Peapehēʻe ha taha, “Ko au ia?”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko e tokotaha ʻi he toko hongofulu ma toko ua, ʻoku māala mo au ki he ipu.

Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ʻalu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata, ʻo hangēko ia kuo tohi kiate ia: ka ʻe malaʻia ʻae tangata ko ia ʻaia ʻoku ne lavakiʻi ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata! Naʻe lelei ki he tangata ko ia ʻo ka ne ʻikai fanauʻi ia.”
¶Pea ʻi heʻenau kai, naʻe toʻo ʻe Sisu ʻae mā, ʻo ne tāpuaki, mo tofitofi, pea ne ʻatu kiate kinautolu, ʻo ne pehē, “Toʻo, ʻo kai: ko eni hoku sino.”
Pea toʻo ʻe ia ʻae ipu inu, pea hili ʻene fakafetaʻi, naʻa ne ʻatu kiate kinautolu: pea naʻa nau inu mei ai kotoa pē.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko hoku toto eni ʻoe fuakava foʻou, ʻaia ʻoku lilingi koeʻuhi ko e tokolahi.
Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai te u toe inu ʻi he fua ʻoe vaine, kaeʻoua ke hokosia ʻae ʻaho ko ia te u inu foʻou ai ia ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
¶Pea kuo hili ʻenau fasi hiva, naʻa nau ʻalu atu ki he moʻunga ʻoe ʻOlive.
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “ʻE tūkia ʻakimoutolukotoa pēʻi he poōni ʻiate au: he kuo tohi, ‘Te u taaʻi ʻae tauhi, pea ʻe movetevete ai ʻae fanga sipi.’
“Kae hili ʻeku toetuʻu, te u muʻomuʻa ʻiate kimoutoluki Kāleli.”
Ka naʻe pehēʻe Pita kiate ia, “Kapau ʻe tūkia kotoa pē, ka e ʻikai te u pehēau.”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate koe, Ko e ʻaho ni, ʻio, ʻi he pōko eni, ʻe teʻeki ai ʻuʻua ʻae moa ʻo tuʻo ua, ka e liunga tolu hoʻo fakafisi ʻiate au.”
Ka naʻe ʻāsili ai ʻene lea fakamātoato, “Kapau te u mate ai mo koe, ʻe ʻikai ʻaupitote u fakafisiʻi koe.”Pea naʻe lea pehēfoki ʻakinautolukotoa pē.
Pea naʻa nau hoko ki he potu naʻe hingoa ko Ketisemani: pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Mou nonofo ʻi heni, kaeʻoua ke u lotu.”
Pea ne ʻave ʻe ia ʻa Pita mo Semisi mo Sione, pea kamata ilifia lahi, mo māfasia lahi ʻaupito;
Pea ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “ʻOku mamahi lahi ʻaupitoʻo hangēka mate hoku laumālie: mou tatali ʻi heni, pea leʻo.”
Pea ʻalu siʻi atu ia, ʻo tōfakafoʻohifo ki he kelekele, pea ne kole, ʻo kapau ʻe faʻa fai, pea laka ʻae feituʻu pōko ia ʻiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻApā, Tamai, ʻoku faʻa fai ʻe koe ʻae meʻa kotoa pē; ke ke ʻave ʻae ipu ni ʻiate au: kaeʻoua naʻaku faʻiteliha au, ka ko koe pe.”
Pea haʻu ia, ʻo ne ʻilo kuo nau mohe, pea pehēʻe ia kia Pita, “Saimone, ʻoku ke mohe ʻa koe? ʻE ʻikai te ke faʻa leʻo ʻe koe ʻi he feituʻu pōʻe taha?
Mou leʻo pea lotu, telia naʻa lavaʻi ʻakimoutoluʻe he ʻahiʻahi. Ko e moʻoni ʻoku fie fai ʻe he laumālie, ka ʻoku vaivai ʻae kakano.”
Pea toe ʻalu atu ia, ʻo lotu, ʻo ne fai pe ʻae lea ko ia.
Pea ʻi heʻene haʻu, naʻa ne ʻilo ʻenau toe mohe, (he naʻe māfasia honau mata,) pea ʻikai te nau ʻilo pe ko e hāte nau lea ʻaki kiate ia.

Pea haʻu ia ko hono liunga tolu, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Maʻu pe hoʻomou mohe, pea mālōlō: kuo lahi ia, kuo hokosia ʻae feituʻu pō: vakai, kuo lavakiʻi ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ki he nima ʻoe kau angahala.
Tuʻu hake, ke tau ʻalu; vakai, ʻoku ʻi heni ia ʻoku ne lavakiʻi au.”

¶Pea lolotonga ʻene lea, mo ʻene haʻu ʻa Siutasi, ko e tokotaha ʻoe toko hongofulu ma toko ua, pea mo e fuʻu kakai mo ia, mo e ngaahi heletāmo e ngaahi ʻakau, mei he kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi pea mo e mātuʻa.
Pea ko ia naʻe lavakiʻi ia kuo ne tuku ʻae fakaʻilonga kiate kinautolu, ʻo ne pehē, “Ka ʻilonga ʻaia teu ʻuma ki ai, ko ia ia: puke ia, ʻo tataki atu.”
Pea ʻi heʻene hoko mai, pea ne ʻalu leva kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻeiki;”pea ʻuma kiate ia.
¶Pea naʻa nau ala honau nima kiate ia, ʻo puke ia.
Pea ko e tokotaha ʻiate kinautolunaʻe tutuʻuʻi ai, naʻa neunuhiʻae heletā, ʻo ne taaʻi ʻae tamaioʻeiki ʻae taulaʻeiki lahi, ʻo motuhi hono telinga.
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “He kuo mou omi ke puke au, mo e ngaahi heletāmo e ngaahi ʻakau, ʻo hangēha kaihaʻa?
Naʻaku ʻi he falelotu lahi mo kimoutoluʻi he ʻaho kotoa pēʻo akonaki, pea naʻe ʻikai te mou puke au: kakuo pauke fakamoʻoni ʻae ngaahi tohi.”
Pea naʻe liʻaki ia ʻekinautolukotoa pē, ka nau feholaki.
Pea naʻe muimuiʻiate ia ʻae talavou ʻe tokotaha, kuo vala ʻaki ʻae tupenupea naʻe puke ia ʻe he kau talavou:
Pea siʻaki ʻe ia ʻae tupenu, kae hola telefua ʻiate kinautolu.
¶Pea naʻa nau tataki atu ʻa Sisu ki he taulaʻeiki lahi: pea naʻe fakataha mo ia ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi kotoa pēmo e mātuʻa mo e kau tangata tohi.
Pea muimuimamaʻo atu kiate ia ʻa Pita, ki he fale ʻoe taulaʻeiki lahi: pea nofo ia mo e kau tamaioʻeiki, ʻo ne mumūʻi he afi.
Pea kumi ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau fakamaau kotoa pē, ʻae fakamoʻoni kia Sisu, ke nau tāmateʻi ai ia; ka naʻe ʻikai maʻu.
He naʻe fakamoʻoni loi kiate ia ʻae tokolahi, ka naʻe ʻikai fai tatau ʻa ʻenau fakamoʻoni.
Pea tuʻu hake ʻae niʻihi, ʻonau fakamoʻoni loi kiate ia, ʻo pehē,
“Naʻa mau fanongo ki heʻene pehē, ‘Te u veteki ʻae falelotu lahi ni kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae nima, pea ʻi he ʻaho ʻe tolu langa ha taha kehe, kae ʻikai ʻaki ʻae nima.’|”
Ka naʻe ʻikai fai tatau foki ʻenau fakamoʻoni.
Pea tuʻu hake ʻae taulaʻeiki lahi ʻi he haʻohaʻonga, ʻo ne fehuʻi kia Sisu, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te ke leaki ai? Ko e hāeni ʻoku fakamoʻoni ʻekinautoluni kiate koe?”
Ka naʻe longo pēia, ʻo ʻikai siʻi lea. Pea toe fehuʻi ʻae taulaʻeiki lahi kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “Ko koe ko e Kalaisi, ko e ʻAlo ʻoe Monūʻia?”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu, “Ko au ia: pea te mou mamata ki he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻoku nofo ia ʻi he nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe māfimafi, pea mo ʻene haʻu mo e ngaahi ʻao ʻoe langi.”
Pea toki haehae ʻe he taulaʻeiki lahi hono kofu, ʻo pehē, “He koeʻumaʻāmo ha kau fakamoʻoni kehe?
Kuo mou fanongo ki he lea fie ʻOtua: ko e hāhomou loto?”Pea nau loto taha kotoa pēʻe totonu ke mate.
Pea kamata ʻaʻanu ʻae niʻihi kiate ia, pea ke ʻufiʻufi hono mata, ʻo taaʻi ia, pea nau pehēkiate ia, “Kikite!”Pea sipiʻi ia ʻe he kau tamaioʻeiki ʻaki honau ʻaofinima.
¶Pea ʻi he kei nofo ʻa Pita ʻi he fale ʻi lalo, ne haʻu ʻae fefine kaunanga ʻe taha ʻae taulaʻeiki lahi:
Pea ʻi heʻene mamata kia Pita ʻoku ne mumū, naʻa ne sio kiate ia, mo ne pehē, “Ta ko koe foki naʻa ke ʻia Sisu ʻo Nāsaleti.”
Ka naʻe fakafisi ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te u ʻiloia, pea ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻilo ʻaia ʻoku ke lea ʻaki.”Pea ʻalu ia ki he fale ʻituʻa; pea ʻuʻua ʻae moa.
Pea toe mamata kiate ia ʻae fefine kaunanga, pea kamata pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolunaʻe tutuʻu ʻi ai, ko e taha eni ʻokinautolu.
Pea toe fakafisi ia. Pea fuoloasiʻi, pea toe pehēʻekinautolunaʻe tutuʻu ʻi ai kia Pita, “Ko e moʻoni ko etahakoe ʻakinautolu; he ko e Kāleli koe, pea ʻoku tataumo iahoʻo lea.”
Ka naʻe kamata kape ia mo fuakava, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te u ʻilo ʻae tangata ni ʻoku mou lea ki ai.”

Pea naʻe ʻuʻua ʻae moa ko hono liunga ua. Pea manatu ʻa Pita ki he lea ʻaia naʻe lea ʻaki ʻe Sisu kiate ia, “ʻE teʻeki ai liunga ua ʻae ʻuʻua ʻae moa, kae liunga tolu hoʻo fakafisi ʻiate au.”Pea ʻi heʻene manatuki ai, naʻa ne tangi.
15: PEA pongipongi hake ai, naʻe fakakaukau leva ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi, fakataha mo e mātuʻa mo e kau tangata tohi mo e kau fakamaau kotoa pē, pea naʻe haʻi ʻa Sisu, ʻo ʻave, mo tukuangekia Pailato.
Pea pehēʻe Pailato kiate ia, “Ko e tuʻi koe ʻoe kakai Siu?”Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate ia,“Ko ia pe.”
Pea talatalaakiʻi ia ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi ʻi he ngaahi meʻa lahi.
Pea toe fehuʻi ʻe Pailato kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai te ke lea ki ha meʻa? Vakai ki hono lahi ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ʻoku nau fakamoʻoni kiate koe.”
Ka naʻe ʻikai siʻi lea ʻa Sisu ki ha meʻa; pea ofo ai ʻa Pailato.
Pea ko e kātoangako ianaʻa ne tukuangeai kiate kinautoluha pōpula ʻe tokotaha, ʻaia te nau loto ki ai.
Pea naʻe ai ʻa etokotahako Palāpasa hono hingoa, kuo haʻi fakataha mo kinautolunaʻa nau kau mo ia ʻi he angatuʻu, mo nau fai ʻae fakapōʻi he angatuʻu.
Pea ʻioho leʻo lahi ʻae kakai, ʻonau kamata talake ne faiʻo hangēko ia naʻa ne faʻa fai kiate kinautolu.
Ka naʻe lea ʻa Pailato, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko homou loto ke tukuangekiate kimoutoluʻae Tuʻi ʻoe kakai Siu?”
He naʻa ne ʻilo ko e meʻa ʻi he meheka kuo tukuangeai ia ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi.
Ka naʻe ueʻi ʻae kakai ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi, ke ne tuku mai ʻa Palāpasa pe kiate kinautolu.
Pea toe lea ʻa Pailato, ʻo ne pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ka ko e hāhomou loto ke u fai kiate ia ʻaia ʻoku mou ui ko e Tuʻi ʻoe kakai Siu?”
Pea naʻa nau toe kalanga, “Tutukiia ki he ʻakau.”
Pea toki pehēʻe Pailato kiate kinautolu, “Koeʻumaʻā, ko e hāʻae kovi kuo ne fai? Pea naʻa nau ʻāsili kalanga ai ʻaupito, “Tutukiia ki he ʻakau.”
¶Pea ko e meʻa ʻi he fie fakafiemālie ʻe Pailato ki he kakai, naʻa ne tukuangeʻa Palāpasa kiate kinautolu, pea hili ʻene kauʻimaea ʻa Sisu, naʻa ne tukuangeiake tutukiki he ʻakau.
Pea naʻe tataki ia ʻe he kau tau ki he potu fale naʻe ui ko e fale fakaʻeiki, ʻonau fakataha ʻae kautau kotoa.
Pea naʻa nau fakakofuʻaki ia ʻae kulokula, ʻo lalanga ʻae tatāʻaki ʻae ʻakau talatala, ʻo ʻai kiate ia.
Mo nau kamata fetapa kiate ia, “Siʻotoʻofa, Tuʻi ʻoe kakai Siu!”
Pea naʻa nau taaʻi ʻakiiaʻae vaʻa kaho ʻi hono mata, ʻo ʻaʻanu kiate ia, pea tūʻulutui mo hūkiate ia.
Pea kuo nau manukiʻi ia, pea nau toʻo ʻiate ia ʻae kulokula, kae ʻai kiate ia hono kofu ʻoʻona, ʻo tataki atu ia ke tutukiki he ʻakau.
Pea naʻa nau pule ke fua hono ʻakau ʻe he tokotaha ko Saimone ko e Sailini, ko e tamai ʻa ʻAlekisānita mo Lufusi, ʻi heʻene ʻalu ange ai, ko ʻene haʻu mei he tukuʻuta.
Pea naʻa nau ʻomi ia ki he potu ko Kolokota, ʻaia ko hono ʻuhinga, “Ko e potu ʻoe ʻulupoko.”
Pea naʻa nau ʻatu ʻae inu kiate ia ko euaine, kuo huʻi ʻaki ʻae mula: ka naʻe ʻikai te ne maʻu ia.
Pea kuo nau tutukiia ki he ʻakau, pea nau vahevahe hono ngaahi kofu, mo talotalo ki ai,ke ʻilongaʻa ia ʻe maʻu ʻe he tangata taki taha.
Pea ko hono tolu ia ʻoe feituʻulaʻā, naʻa nau tutukiai ia ki he ʻakau.
Pea naʻe tohi ʻi ʻolunga ʻae tohi ʻo hono talakoviʻi, KO E TUʻI ʻOE KAKAI SIU.
Pea naʻa nau tutukiki he ʻakau fakataha mo ia ʻae ongo kaihaʻa ʻe toko ua: ko e taha ʻi he nima toʻomataʻu, mo e taha ʻi hono toʻohema.
Pea naʻe fakamoʻoni ai ʻae tohi, ʻaia ʻoku pehē, “Pea naʻe lau ia fakataha mo e kau angahala.”
Pea manukiʻi ia ʻekinautolunaʻe feʻaluʻaki, ʻi he kalokalo honau ʻulu, mo e pehē, “ʻA koe, ʻoku ke maumauʻi ʻae falelotu lahi, motoelanga ia ʻi he ʻaho ʻe tolu,
Fakamoʻui koe, pea ke ʻalu hifo mei he ʻakau.”
Pea manuki pehēfoki ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi, “ʻO nau fepehēʻaki ʻiate kinautolumo e kau tangata tohi, naʻa ne fakamoʻui ʻae kakai; ka ʻoku ʻikai te ne faʻa fakamoʻui ia.
Tuku ke ʻalu hifo eni ʻa Kalaisi ko e Tuʻi ʻo ʻIsileli mei he ʻakau, koeʻuhi ke mau mamata mo tui.”Pea ko kinaua naʻe tutukiki he ʻakau mo ia ne na manukiʻi ia.
Pea ʻi he hokosia hono ono ʻoe feituʻulaʻā, naʻe fakapoʻuli ʻae fonua kotoa ʻo aʻu ki hono hiva ʻoe feituʻulaʻā.
Pea ʻi hono hiva ʻoe feituʻulaʻānaʻe tangi leʻo lahi ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehē, “ʻIlai, ʻIlai, lama sapakatani?”ʻAia ko hono ʻuhinga, “Ko hoku ʻOtua, ko hoku ʻOtua, ko e hākuo ke liʻaki ai au?”
Pea ko honau niʻihi naʻe tutuʻuʻi ai, ʻi heʻenau fanongo, naʻa nau pehē, “Vakai, ʻoku ne ui kia ʻIlaisiā.”
Pea lele ʻae tokotaha, ʻo ne unu ʻae oma ki he vai mahi, ʻo ʻai ia ki he vaʻa kaho, mo ʻohake ke ne inu, mo ne pehē, “Tuku ai pe; ke tau vakai, pe haʻu ʻa ʻIlaisiāke tuku hifo ia.”
Pea tangi leʻo lahi ʻa Sisu, pea ne tuku hake hono laumālie.
Pea naʻe mahae ua ʻae puipuiʻoe falelotu lahi, mei hono potu ʻi ʻolunga ʻo aʻu ki lalo.
¶Pea ʻi he mamata ʻae ʻeikitau, naʻe tuʻu ʻo hangatonu atu kiate ia, kuo pehēʻa ʻene tangi, mo e tuku hake ʻa hono laumālie, ne ne pehē, “Tāko e moʻoni ko e ʻAlo ʻoe ʻOtua ʻae tangata ni.”
Naʻe ai mo e kau fefine naʻa nau sio mai mei he mamaʻo: pea naʻe ʻiate kinautoluʻa Mele Makitaline, mo Mele ko e faʻēʻa Semisi siʻi pea mo Sose, mo Salome;
(ʻAkinautolufoki naʻa nau muimuikiate ia, mo tauhi ia ʻi heʻene ʻi Kāleli;) pea mo e kau fefine tokolahi, naʻa nau ʻalu hake mo ia ki Selūsalema.
¶Pea kuo efiafi ai, pea koeʻuhi ko e teuteu, ʻaia ko e ʻaho ʻoku muʻa ʻi heʻahoSāpate,
Naʻe ʻalu loto mālohi ʻa Siosefa ʻo ʻAlematea, ko e fakamaau ongolelei, pea naʻe tatali foki ia ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻo ne kole meia Pailato ʻae sino ʻo Sisu.
Pea ofo ʻa Pailato ʻi heʻene pekia vave: pea ne ui ʻae ʻeikitau, ʻo fehuʻi ki ai pe kuo fuoloaange ʻene pekia.
Pea kuo ne ʻiloiamei he ʻeikitau, pea ne ʻatu ʻae sino kia Siosefa.

Pea fakatau ʻe ia ʻae tupenumahuʻinga lelei, mo vete hifo ia, ʻo fakakoloaʻakiiaʻae tupenumahuʻinga, pea fakatokoto ia ʻi he fonualoto kuo tāʻi he maka, pea ne teketekaʻi ʻae maka ki he matapāʻoe fonualoto.
Pea ko Mele Makitaline mo Meleko e faʻēʻa Sose, ne na mamata ki he potu kuo fakatokoto aiia.
16: PEA ʻi he hili ʻae Sāpate, kuo fakatau ʻe Mele Makitaline, mo Mele ko e faʻēʻa Semisi, mo Salome, ʻae ngaahi ʻakau namu lelei, koeʻuhi ke nau omi ʻo fakatolongaʻaki ia.
Pea ʻi he hengihengi ʻoe ʻuluakiʻahoʻoe uike, naʻa nau omi ki he fonualoto, feʻunga mo e ʻalu hake ʻae laʻā.
Pea naʻa nau fepehēʻaki, “Ko hai te ne teketekaʻi maʻatautoluʻae maka mei he matapāʻoe fonualoto?”
Pea ʻi heʻenau sio, naʻa nau ʻilo kuo tekaʻi atu ʻae maka: he naʻe lahi ʻaupitoia.
Pea ʻi he hūki he fonualoto, naʻa nau mamata ki ha talavou ʻoku nofo ʻi he potu toʻomataʻu, kuo kofuʻaki ʻae kofu tōtōlofa mo hinehina; pea naʻa nau ilifia.

Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOua te mou ilifia: ʻOku mou kumi ʻa Sisu ʻo Nāsaleti, ʻaia naʻe tutukiki he ʻakau: kuo tuʻu hake ia; ʻoku ʻikai ʻi heni ia; vakai ki he potu naʻa nau fakatokoto ai ia.
Ka mou ō, ʻo fakahāki heʻene kau ākonga mo Pita, ʻoku muʻomuʻa ia ʻiate kimoutoluki Kāleli: te mou mamata kiate ia ʻi ai, ʻo hangēko ʻene tala kiate kimoutolu.”
Pea naʻa nau hūleva kituʻa, ʻo feholaki mei he fonualoto; he naʻa nau tetetete mo ilifia: pea ʻikai te nau lea siʻi ki ha taha; he naʻa nau manavahē.
¶Pea kuo toetuʻu ʻaSisuʻi he hengihengi ʻoe ʻuluakiʻahoʻoe uike, naʻa ne tomuʻa fakahāia kia Mele Makitaline, ʻaia ne ne kapusi mei ai ʻae tēvolo ʻe toko fitu.
Pea ʻalu ia ʻo fakahākiate kinautolunaʻa nau ʻiate ia, lolotonga ʻenau mamahi mo tangi.
Pea ko kinautolu, ʻi heʻenau fanongo kuo moʻui ia, pea kuo mamata iaki ai, naʻe ʻikai te nau tui.
¶Pea hili eni ne hāia ʻi he anga ʻe taha ki honau tokoua, ʻi heʻena ōʻo fononga ki he potu tukuʻuta.
Pea naʻa na ō, ʻo fakahāiakiate kinautolu; ka naʻe ʻikai te nau tui kiate kinaua.

¶Pea hili ia, naʻa ne hāki he toko hongofulu ma tokotaha ʻi heʻenau nofo ʻo kai, ʻo ne valokiʻi ʻenau taʻetui mo loto fefeka, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau taʻetui kiate kinautolunaʻa nau mamata kiate ia ʻi he hili ʻene toetuʻu.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Mou ʻalu ki māmani kotoa pē, ʻo malangaʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei ki he kakai fulipē.
Ko ia ia ʻe tui mo papitaiso, ʻe moʻui; ka ko ia ia ʻe ʻikai tui, ʻe malaʻia.
Pea ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga eni ʻe hoko kiate kinautoluʻoku tui: Te nau kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ʻi hoku huafa; te nau lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi lea foʻou;
Te nau toʻo hake ʻae ngaahi ngata; pea kapau te nau inu ha meʻa fakamate, ʻe ʻikai kovi ia kiate kinautolu; te nau hilifaki nima ki he mahaki, pea te nau moʻui.”
¶Ko ia hili ʻae lea ʻae ʻEiki kiate kinautolu, naʻe maʻu hake ia ki he langi ʻo nofo ʻi he nima toʻomataʻu ʻoe ʻOtua.
Pea naʻa nau ʻalu atu, ʻo malanga ʻi he potu kotoa pē, pea naʻe ngāue ʻae ʻEiki mokinautolu, ʻo ne fakamoʻoni ʻae folofola ʻaki ʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga naʻe hoko. ʻEmeni.

1: KO E meʻa ʻi he fai ʻe he tokolahi ke tohi fakaholo hono fakamatala ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ko ia ʻoku tui moʻoni ki ai ʻiate kitautolu,
‌ʻO hangēko ia kuo tuku mai kiate kitautolu, ʻekinautolunaʻe mamata pauki ai, pea hoko ko e kau faifekau ʻoe folofola, talu hono kamataʻanga;
‌ʻE Tiofilusi lelei, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻeku kumi fakatotolo ki he meʻa kotoa pētalu hano kamataʻanga, ʻoku ou loto ai ke u tohi fakaholo atu ia kiate koe,
Koeʻuhi ke ke ʻilo hono moʻoni ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ko ia, ʻaia kuo akonekina ai koe.

¶NAʻE ai ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Helota, ko e tuʻi ʻo Siutea, ʻae taulaʻeiki ʻe taha, ʻi he lakanga ʻo ʻApia, ko Sakalaia hono hingoa: pea ko hono ʻunohonaʻe mei he ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo ʻElone, pea ko ʻIlisapeti hono hingoa.
Pea naʻa na angatonu fakatouʻosi pe he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻo na ʻalu taʻehala ʻi he ngaahi fekau mo e tuʻutuʻuni kotoa pēʻae ʻEiki.
Pea naʻe ʻikai haʻana tama, koeʻuhi naʻe paʻa ʻa ʻIlisapeti, pea kuo na motuʻa fakatouʻosi pe.
Pea pehē, ʻi heʻene fai ki he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻi he lakanga ʻo hono vahe,
Ko hono lakanga, ʻo hangēko hono anga ʻoe ngāue fakataulaʻeiki, ke tutu ʻae meʻa namu lelei ʻi heʻene hūki he potu tapu ʻae ʻEiki.
Pea naʻe lotu ʻae fuʻu kakai kotoa pēʻituʻa, ʻi he lolotongaʻae tutuʻoe ʻakau namu lelei.
Pea naʻe hāmai kiate ia ha ʻāngelo ʻae ʻEiki, ʻoku tuʻu ia ʻi he potu fakatoʻomataʻu ʻoe ʻesifeilaulau ʻoe ʻakau namu lelei.
Pea tāfuʻua ʻa Sakalaia ʻi heʻene mamataki ai, pea tōkiate ia ʻae manavahē.
Ka naʻe pehēʻe he ʻāngelo kiate ia, “Sakalaia, ʻoua te ke manavahē, he kuo tau hoʻo lotu; pea ʻe fāʻeleʻi ʻe ho ʻunohoko ʻIlisapeti, ʻae tama kiate koe, pea te ke ui hono hingoa ko Sione.
Pea te ke maʻu ai ʻae fiefia mo e nekeneka; pea ʻe fiefia ʻae tokolahi ʻi heʻene fanauʻi.
Koeʻuhi ʻe lahi ia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻEiki, pea ʻe ʻikai te ne inu ʻaeuainepe ha inu fakakona; pea ʻe fonu ia ʻi he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni, ʻio, mei he manāva ʻo ʻene faʻē.
Pea ʻe fakatafoki ʻe ia ʻae tokolahi ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ki he ʻEiki ko honau ʻOtua.
Pea ʻe muʻomuʻa ia ʻiate ia ʻi he anga mo e mālohi ʻo ʻIlaisiā, ‘Ke fakatafoki ʻae loto ʻoe mātuʻa ki he fānau,’mo e talangataʻa ki he poto ʻoe angatonu; ke teuʻi ʻae kakai ke lelei maʻae ʻEiki.”
Pea pehēʻe Sakalaia ki he ʻāngelo, “Te u ʻilo ʻi he hāʻae meʻa ni? He ko e tangata motuʻa au, pea kuo lahi ʻae taʻu ʻo hoku ʻunoho.”
Pea lea ʻae ʻāngelo, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “Ko au Kepaleli, ʻoku ou tuʻu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua; pea kuo fekau au ke u lea kiate koe, mo fakahākiate koe ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakafiefia ni.
Pea vakai, te ke noa koe, ʻe ʻikai te ke faʻa lea, ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho ʻe hoko ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻo taʻetui ki heʻeku ngaahi lea, ʻaia ʻe fakamoʻoni ʻi hono kuonga.”
Pea naʻe tatali ʻae kakai kia Sakalaia, pea naʻa nau ofo ʻi heʻene tuai mai mei he potu tapu.
Pea kuo haʻu ia kituʻa, pea ʻikai te ne faʻa lea kiate kinautolu: pea nau ʻilo ai kuo hāmai ha meʻa kiate ia ʻi he potu tapu: he naʻe kamokamo ia kiate kinautolu, pea taʻelea.
Pea pehē, ʻi hetokihili ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene ngāue, naʻe ʻalu ia ki hono fale.
Pea hili ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, naʻe tuituʻia ʻa hono ʻunohoko ʻIlisapeti, pea naʻe nofo ia ʻi he lilo, ʻi he māhina ʻe nima, ʻo ne pehē,
“Kuo fai pehēʻe he ʻEiki kiateau, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho naʻa ne vakaiʻiau, ke toʻoʻiate auhoku manukiʻanga ʻi he kakai.”
Pea ʻi hono ono ʻoe māhina, naʻe fekau ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae ʻāngelo ko Kepaleli ki he kolo ʻe taha ʻi Kāleli, ko Nāsaleti hono hingoa,
ki ha tāupoʻou ʻi he fale ʻo Tevita, kuo fakanofo ki he tangata naʻe hingoa ko Siosefa; pea ko e hingoa ʻoe tāupoʻou ko Mele.
Pea haʻu ʻae ʻāngelo kiate ia, ʻo ne pehē, “Siʻotoʻofa, ʻoku ke ʻofeina lahi, ʻoku ʻiate koe ʻae ʻEiki: ʻoku ke monūʻia ʻi he fefinefulipē.”
Pea kuo mamata iaki ai, pea tāfuʻua ia ʻi heʻene lea, mo ne fifili ʻi hono loto, pe ko e hāhono ʻuhinga ʻoe fetapa ko ia.
Pea pehēʻe he ʻāngelo kiate ia, “Mele, ʻoua ʻe manavahē: he ʻoku ke ʻofeina mei he ʻOtua.
Pea vakai, te ke tuituʻia ʻihomanāva, pea fāʻeleʻi ʻae tama, pea ke ui hono huafa ko Sisu.
Pea ʻe lahi ia, pea ʻe ui ia ko e ʻAlo ʻoe Fungani Māʻolunga; ʻe ange kiate ia ʻe he ʻEiki ko e ʻOtua ʻae nofoʻa ʻo ʻene tamai ko Tevita:
Pea ʻe pule ia ki he fale ʻo Sēkope ʻo taʻengata; pea ʻe ʻikai hano ngataʻanga ʻo ʻene pule.”
Pea pehēʻe Mele ki he ʻāngelo, “ʻE fēfēai ʻae meʻa ni, heʻeku ʻikai te u ʻiloa ha tangata?”

Pea lea ʻae ʻāngelo, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “ʻE hoko mai ʻae Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni kiate koe, pea ʻe fakamalūkoe ʻe he mālohi ʻoe Fungani Māʻolunga; pea ko ia foki ʻe ui ai ʻae hako māʻoniʻoni te ke fāʻeleʻi ko e ʻAlo ʻoe ʻOtua.
Pea vakai, ko ho kāinga ko ʻIlisapeti, kuo tuituʻia ia ʻi he tama ʻi heʻene motuʻa: pea ko hono ono mahina eni ʻo ia naʻe ui koe paʻa.
He ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe faingataʻa ki he ʻOtua.”
Pea pehēʻe Mele, “Vakai, ko e kaunangaauʻae ʻEiki; ke hoko mai kiate au ʻo hangēko hoʻo lea. Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻae ʻāngelo ʻiate ia.”
Pea tuʻu hake ʻa Mele, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, ʻo ʻalu fakavave ki he fonua moʻunga, ki ha kolo ʻo Siuta;
Pea naʻe hūia ki he fale ʻo Sakalaia, ʻo fetapa kia ʻIlisapeti.
Pea naʻe pehē, kuo fanongo ʻa ʻIlisapeti ki he fetapa ʻa Mele, pea hopohopo ʻae tama ʻi hono manāva; pea fakafonu ʻa ʻIlisapeti ʻi he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni:
Pea naʻe lea ʻaki ʻe ia ʻae leʻo lahi, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOku ke monūʻia koe ʻi he fefinekotoa pēpea ʻoku monūʻia mo e fua ʻo ho manāva.
Pea ʻoku fēfēnai eni kiate au, koeʻuhi kuo haʻu ʻae faʻēʻa hoku ʻEiki kiate au?
Pea vakai, kuo ongo leva ʻae leʻo ʻa hoʻo fetapa ki hoku telinga, pea hopohopo fiefia ʻae tama ʻi hoku manāva.
Pea ʻoku monūʻia ʻaia kuo tui: koeʻuhi ʻe fakamoʻoni ʻae ngaahi meʻa ko ia ʻaia naʻe fakahākiate ia mei he ʻEiki.”

¶Pea pehēʻe Mele,
“ʻOku fakahikihiki ʻae ʻEiki ʻe hoku laumālie,
Pea ʻoku fiefia hoku laumālie ʻi he ʻOtua ko hoku fakamoʻui.

He kuo ne vakai ʻe ia ʻae vaivai ʻa ʻene kaunanga:
Vakai, ngata mei he ʻaho ni ʻe ui au ko e monūʻia ʻe he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.

He ko ia ʻoku māfimafi kuo ne fai kiate au ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi;
pea ʻoku māʻoniʻoni hono huafa.
Pea ʻoku ʻiate kinautoluʻoku manavahēkiate ia ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa Mei he toʻutangata ki he toʻutangata.

Kuo fakahāmai ʻe ia ʻae mālohi ʻo hono nima;
Pea kuo veteki ʻe ia ʻae laukau ʻi he ngaoʻi ʻa honau loto.

Kuo fakahifo ʻe ia ʻae mālohi mei he ngaahi nofoʻanga,
Pea kuo ne hakeakiʻi ʻakinautolunaʻe māʻulalo.

Kuo fakamākona ʻe ia ʻae fiekaia, ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei;
Ka ne tekeʻi atu ʻae maʻumeʻa ke masiva.
Kuo tokoni ʻe ia ʻa ʻene tamaioʻeiki ko ʻIsileli, ʻI heʻene manatu ki he ʻaloʻofa;

Kia ʻEpalahame, mo hono hako ʻo lauikuonga,
ʻO hangēko ʻene lea ki heʻetau ngaahi tamai.”
Pea naʻa na nonofo mo Mele ʻi he māhina nai ʻe tolu, peatokiʻalu ia ki hono fale.
Pea kuo hokosia ʻae ʻaho ke fāʻele ai ʻa ʻIlisapeti; pea fāʻeleʻi ʻe ia ʻae tama.
Pea fanongo ʻa hono kaungāʻapi mo hono kāinga, kuo fakahāʻe he ʻEiki ʻae ʻaloʻofa lahi kiate ia; pea nau fiefia mo ia.
Pea pehē, ʻi hono ʻaho valu naʻa nau omi ke kamu ʻae tamasiʻi; pea naʻa nau ui ia ko Sakalaia, ʻo hangēko e hingoa ʻo ʻene tamai.
Pea leaange ʻene faʻē, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻE ʻikai, kae ui ia ko Sione.”
Pea naʻa nau pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku ʻikai hao kāinga ʻoku ui ʻi he hingoa ko ia.”
Pea nau kamokamo ki heʻene tamai, pe ko e hāhono loto ke ui ia.
Pea ne meʻa ke ʻomi ʻae tohiʻanga, pea tohi ʻe ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko Sione hono hingoa.”Pea naʻa nau ofo ai kotoa pē.
Pea matoʻo leva hono ngutu, pea mo hono ʻelelo, pea lea ia ʻo fakamālōki he ʻOtua.
Pea naʻe tōʻae manavahēki he kakai kotoa pēnaʻa nau nonofo ʻi he potu ko ia: pea naʻe ongoongoa ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēʻi he fonua moʻunga kotoa pēʻo Siutea.
Pea ko kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe fanongo ki ai, naʻa nau fifili ʻi honau loto, mo pehē, “ʻE fēfēnai ʻae anga ʻae tama ni!”Pea naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae nima ʻoe ʻEiki.
Pea naʻe fakafonu ʻa ʻene tamai ko Sakalaia ʻi he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni, pea kikite ia, ʻo pehē,

“Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli;
He kuo ne ʻaʻahi mo huhuʻi ʻa hono kakai,
Pea kuo ne fokotuʻu ʻe ia ʻae mālohi ʻoe fakamoʻui kiate kitautolu, ʻI he fale ʻo ʻene tamaioʻeiki ko Tevita;
‌ʻO hangēko ʻene folofola ʻi he ngutu ʻo ʻene kau palōfita māʻoniʻoni, Naʻe ai talu ʻae tupuʻanga ʻo māmani:
Koeʻuhi ke fakamoʻui ʻakitautolumei hotau ngaahi fili, Mo e nima ʻokinautolukotoa pēʻoku fehiʻa kiate kitautolu;

Ke fakamoʻoni ʻae ʻaloʻofa ki heʻetau mātuʻa,
Mo manatu ki heʻene fuakava māʻoniʻoni;
‌ʻAe fuakava ʻaia naʻa ne fuakava ʻaki ki heʻetau tamai ko ʻEpalahame,

Ke tuku ʻe ia kiate kitautolu, Ke tau hao mei he nima ʻo hotau ngaahi fili,
Pea tau tauhi ia taʻemanavahē,
‌ʻI he māʻoniʻoni mo e angatonu ʻi hono ʻao, ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pēʻo ʻetau moʻui.

Pea ko koe, ʻe tama, ʻe ui koe ko e palōfita ʻoe Fungani Māʻolunga:
He te ke muʻomuʻa ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻEiki ke teuteu hono hala;
Ke fakaʻilo ʻae fakamoʻui ki hono kakai ʻi he fakamolemole ʻo ʻenau hia,

Ko e meʻa ʻi he ʻaloʻofa ongongofua ʻa hotau ʻOtua;
ʻAia kuo hoko mei ai ʻae hengihengi ʻoe ʻaho mei ʻolunga kiate kitautolu,

Ke fakamaama kiate kinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi he fakapoʻuli mo e ʻata ʻoe mate,
Ke fakahinohino hotau vaʻe ki he hala ʻoe fiemālie.”
Pea naʻe tupu ʻae tama, pea fakaʻaʻau ʻo mālohi ʻi he laumālie, pea naʻa ne ʻi he toafa ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho naʻa ne fakahāai ia ki ʻIsileli.
2: PEA pehē, naʻe fai ʻae fono ʻe Sisa ʻAokositusi, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, ke tohi ʻae kakai kotoa pēʻoe puleʻanga.
(Pea naʻe fuofuafai ʻae tohi ni ʻi he pule ʻa Kilinio ʻi Silia.)
Pea naʻe taki taha ʻalu ʻae kakai kotoa pēki hono potu, ke tohi ai ia.
Pea ʻalu hake foki ʻa Siosefa mei Kāleli, mei he kolo ko Nāsaleti, ki Siutea, ki he Kolo ʻo Tevita, ʻoku ui ko Petelihema; (he naʻa ne ʻoe fale mo e faʻahinga ʻo Tevita;)
Ke tohi ia mo hono ʻunohoko Mele, naʻe fakanofo, kuo feitama ia.
Pea naʻe lolotonga ʻena ʻi ai, pea pehē, kuo kakato hono ngaahi ʻaho ke fāʻele ai ia.
Pea fāʻeleʻi ʻe ia ʻae tama ko hono ʻolopoʻou, pea ne takatakai ʻaki ia ʻae kofu, ʻo fakatokoto ia ʻi he ʻaiʻanga kai ʻoe manu; koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai te nau hao ʻi he fale talifononga.
Pea naʻe ʻi he fonua ko ia ʻae kau tauhi sipi ʻoku nofo ʻi he ngoue, ʻo leʻohi ʻenau fanga sipi ʻi he poʻuli.
Pea ʻiloange, naʻe tuʻu mai kiate kinautoluʻae ʻāngelo ʻae ʻEiki, pea malama ʻae nāunau ʻoe ʻEiki ʻo takatakai ʻakinautolu: pea naʻa nau manavahēʻaupito.
Pea pehēʻe he ʻāngelo kiate kinautolu, “ʻOua ʻe manavahē: vakai, he ʻoku ou ʻomi kiate kimoutoluʻae ongoongolelei ʻoe fiefia lahi, ʻaia ʻe hoko ki he kakai fulipē.
He kuo ʻaloʻi kiate kimoutoluʻi he ʻaho ni, ʻi he Kolo ʻo Tevita, ʻae Fakamoʻui, ʻaia ko Kalaisi ko e ʻEiki.
Pea ko e fakaʻilonga eni kiate kimoutolu; te mou ʻilo ʻae tamasiʻi kuo takatakai ʻaki ia ʻae kofu, pea tokoto ia ʻi he ʻaiʻanga kai ʻoe manu.”
Pea fakafokifāpe kuo ʻi he ʻāngelo ʻae tokolahi ʻoe kau ʻāngelo mei he langi, ʻonau fakamālōki he ʻOtua, ʻo pehē,

“Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻi ʻolunga,
Pea ʻi māmani ʻae melino, ko e ʻofa ki he kakai.”

Pea pehē, ʻi he liliu ange ʻae kau ʻāngelo ki he langi meiate kinautolu, naʻe fepehēʻaki ʻe he kau tauhi sipi, “Ke tau ōeni ki Petelihema, ʻo mamata ki he meʻa ni kuo fai, ʻaia kuo fakahāmai ʻe he ʻEiki kiate kitautolu.”
Pea naʻa nau omi fakavave, ʻo ʻilo ʻa Mele, mo Siosefa, mo e tama ʻoku tokoto ʻi he ʻaiʻanga kai ʻoe manu.
Pea kuo nau mamata, pea nau ongoongoa ʻae lea naʻe fakahākiate kinautoluʻi he tama ni.
Pea ofo ai ʻakinautolukotoa pēnaʻe fanongo ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ko ia naʻe fakahāʻe he kau tauhi sipi kiate kinautolu.
Ka naʻe faʻoa ʻe Mele ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēki hono loto, ʻo fifili ki ai.
Pea naʻe liu mai ʻae kau tauhi sipi, ʻo fakamālōmo fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua, koeʻuhi ko e ngaahi meʻa kotoa pēkuo nau fanongo mo mamata ai, ʻo hangēko ia ne fakahākiate kinautolu.
Pea ʻi heʻene kakato ʻae ʻaho ʻe valu naʻe kamu ʻae tama, pea ui hono huafa ko Sisu, ʻaia naʻe fakahingoa ʻe he ʻāngelo kae teʻeki tuituʻia ia ʻi he manāva.
Pea kuo hili ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻena fakamaʻa, ʻo fakatatau ki he fono ʻa Mōsese, naʻa nau ʻomi ia ki Selūsalema ke ʻatuiaki he ʻEiki;
(ʻO hangēko ia kuo tohi ʻi he fono ʻae ʻEiki, “Ko e tama kotoa pe, ʻae ʻolopoʻou, ʻe ui ia ko e tapu ki he ʻEiki;”)
Pea ke ʻatu ʻae feilaulau, ʻo fakatatau mo ia ʻoku fakahāmai ʻi he fono ʻae ʻEiki, “Ko e ongo kulukulu, pe ko e lupe mui ʻe ua.”

Pea vakai, naʻe ʻi Selūsalema ʻae tangata, ko Simione hono hingoa; pea naʻe angatonu ʻae tangata ko ia mo faʻa lotu, mo tatali ki he fiemālieʻanga ʻo ʻIsileli: pea naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni.
Pea naʻe fakahāmai kiate ia ʻe he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni, ʻe ʻikai mate ia, kaeʻoua ke ne mamata ki he Kalaisi ʻae ʻEiki.
Pea haʻu ia ʻi he Laumālie ki he falelotu tatau ki hono anga ʻoe fono,
Naʻa ne toki toʻo hake ia ʻi hono nima, pea fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua, ʻo ne pehē,

“ʻE ʻEiki, ko eni, ʻoku ke tukuangeʻa hoʻo tamaioʻeiki
ke fononga ʻi he fiemālie, ʻO hangēko hoʻo folofola:
He kuo mamata ʻa hoku mata ki hoʻo fakamoʻui,
‌ʻAia kuo ke teuteu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai kotoa pē;

Ko e maama ke fakamaamaʻaki ʻae Senitaile,
Mo e nāunau ʻo hoʻo kakai ko ʻIsileli.”
¶Pea ofo ʻa Siosefa mo ʻene faʻēʻi he ngaahi meʻa ko ia naʻe fakahāʻiate ia.

Pea tāpuakiʻi ʻe Simione ʻakinaua, ʻo ne pehēki heʻene faʻēko Mele, “Vakai, kuo fokotuʻu ʻae tamasiʻi ni ko e tūkiaʻanga mo e toetuʻuʻanga ʻoe tokolahi ʻi ʻIsileli pea ko e fakaʻilonga ke lea koviki ai;
koeʻuhi ke hāai ʻae ngaahi mahalo ʻoe loto ʻoe tokolahi: (ʻio, ʻe tui pea ʻasi ʻae heletāʻi ho laumālie foki.”)
Pea naʻe ʻi ai ʻae fefine palōfita ko ʻAna, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Fanueli, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻAsa: naʻe lahi hono motuʻa, pea naʻa na nonofo mohonoʻunohoʻi he taʻu ʻe fitu talu ʻene tāupoʻou;

ka ka nofo ai pe ia ko e fefine ia kuo mate hono ʻunoho, pea kuo valungofulu ma fāʻae taʻuʻo ʻene motuʻa, pea ne ʻikai mahuʻi ia mei he falelotu lahi, ka naʻa ne ngāue ʻi he ʻaukai mo e faʻa lotu he pōmo e ʻaho.
Pea ʻi heʻene haʻu ʻo feʻunga mo ia, naʻa ne ʻatu foki ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki, ʻo ne fakahāia kiate kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe tatali ki he huhuʻi ʻi Selūsalema.
Pea hili ʻena fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē, ʻo fakatatau ki he fono ʻae ʻEiki, naʻa nau foki mai ki Kāleli, ki hona kolo ko Nāsaleti.
Pea tupu ʻae tamasiʻi, pea mālohi ʻi he laumālie, pea fonu ia ʻi he poto: pea naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae ʻofa ʻae ʻOtua.
Pea naʻe ʻalu ʻene mātuʻa ʻi he taʻu kotoa pēki Selūsalema, ki he kātoangaʻoe Lakaatu.
Pea kuo hongofulu ma ua hono taʻu, pea nau ōhake ki Selūsalema, ʻo hangēko hono anga ʻoe kātoanga.
Pea kuo nau fakaʻosi ʻae ngaahi ʻaho, ka ʻi heʻenau liliu mai, naʻe nofo pe ʻae tama ko Sisu ʻi Selūsalema: pea naʻe ʻikai ʻilo ʻe Siosefa mo ʻene faʻē.
Ka naʻe mahalo ʻakinaua ʻoku ʻi he fononga ia, pea fononga ʻi he ʻaho ʻe taha; peatokikumi ia ʻi hona kāinga mo e kau fononga.
Pea ʻi he ʻikai te na ʻilo ia, naʻa na foki atu ki Selūsalema, ko hono kumi.
Pea pehē, kuo hili ʻae ʻaho ʻe tolu, pea natokiʻilo ia ʻi he falelotu lahi, ʻoku nofo ʻi he haʻohaʻonga ʻoe kau akonaki, ʻo fakafanongo kiate kinautolu, mo fakafehuʻi kiate kinautolu.
Pea ko kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe fanongo kiate ia, naʻa nau ofo ʻi heʻene poto mo ʻene tali ʻae fehuʻi.
Pea ʻi heʻena mamata kiate ia, ne na ofo ai ʻaupito: pea pehēʻe heʻene faʻēkiate ia, “Tama, ko e hākuo ke fai pehēai kiate kimaua? Vakai, ko hoʻo tamai mo au kuo ma kumi koe ʻi he mamahi.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinaua, “Ko e hāʻoku mo kumi ai au? ʻIkai te mo ʻilo ʻoku ʻaʻaku ke fai ʻae ngāue ʻa ʻeku Tamai?”
Ka naʻe ʻikai te na ʻilohono ʻuhingaʻoe lea ne ne lea ʻaki kiate kinaua.
Pea ʻalu hifo ia mo kinaua, ʻo hoko ki Nāsaleti, pea anganofo ia kiate kinaua: ka naʻe faʻo ʻe heʻene faʻēʻae ngaahi lea ni kotoa pēki hono loto.
Pea tupulakiʻae poto ʻia Sisu mo e lahi, pea naʻe ʻofeina ia ʻe he ʻOtua mo e tangata.
3: PEA ʻi hono hongofulu ma nima ʻoe taʻu ʻoe pule ʻa Taipiliusi Sisa, ko e ʻeiki pule ʻa Ponito Pailato ʻi Siutea, pea tuʻi ai ʻa Helota ʻi Kāleli, pea tuʻi ʻa hono tokoua ko Filipe ʻi ʻAitulia mo e feituʻu ʻo Tilakonite, pea tuʻi ʻa Lisaniasi ʻi ʻApiline,
Pea ko ʻAnasi mo Kaiafasi ko e ongo taulaʻeiki lahi ʻakinaua, naʻe hoko ʻae folofola ʻae ʻOtua kia Sione ko e foha ʻo Sakalaia ʻi he toafa.
Pea haʻu ia ki he potu fonua kotoa pēʻo ofi ki Sioatani, ʻo ne malangaʻaki ʻae papitaiso ʻoe fakatomala ki he fakamolemole ʻoe angahala:

‌ʻO hangēko ia kuo tohi ʻi he tohi ʻae ngaahi lea ʻae palōfita ko ʻIsaia, ʻo pehē,
“Ko e leʻo ʻoe tokotaha ʻoku kalanga ʻi he toafa,
‘Mou teuteu ʻae hala ʻo Sihova,
pea fakatonutonuhono ʻaluʻanga.
Pea ʻe mamata ʻae kakai kotoa pēki he fakamoʻui ʻae ʻOtua.’|”
Pea toki pehēʻe ia ki he kakai kuo ʻalu ange ke nau papitaiso ʻiate ia, “ʻAe fānau ʻae ngata fekai, Ko hai ne ne valoki ʻakimoutoluke mou puna mei he houhau ʻe haʻu?

Ko ia mou fakahāʻae ngaahi fua ʻoku ngali mo e fakatomala, pea ʻoua naʻa lau leva ʻi homou loto, ‘ʻOku mau tamai ʻaki ʻa ʻEpalahame:’he ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku faʻa fai ʻe he ʻOtua ke fakatupu ʻi he ngaahi maka ni ʻae fānau kia ʻEpalahame.
Pea ko eni foki, kuo tuku ʻae toki ki he tefito ʻoe ngaahi ʻakau: pea ko ia, ka ʻilonga ʻae ʻakau ʻoku ʻikai tupu ai ʻae fua lelei ʻe tāhifoia, ʻo laku ki he afi.”
Pea fehuʻi ʻae kakai kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hānai te mau fai?”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko ia ʻoku maʻu ʻae kofutuʻa ʻe ua, ke ne foaki kiate ia ʻoku ʻikai maʻu; pea ko ia ʻoku maʻu ʻae meʻa kai, ke fai pehēfoki.”
Pea haʻu foki ʻae kau tānaki tukuhau ke papitaiso, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “ʻEiki, ko e hāte mau fai?”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOua naʻa mou maʻu ʻo lahi ʻi he meʻa kuo tuʻutuʻuni maʻamoutolu.”

Pea fehuʻi foki ʻe he kau tau kiate ia, ʻo pehē; “Pea ko e hāte mau fai?”Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOua naʻa fai fakamālohi ki ha taha, pea ʻoua naʻa lohiakiʻi; pea mou fiemālie ʻi hoʻomou totongi.”
Pea naʻe lolotonga ʻae ʻamanaki ʻae kakai, mo nau fifili kotoa pēʻi honau loto kia Sione, pe ko e Kalaisi ia pe ʻikai;

Pea lea ʻa Sione, ʻo ne pehēange kiate kinautolukotoa pē, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou papitaiso ʻaki ʻakimoutoluʻae vai; ka ʻoku haʻu ʻae tokotaha ʻoku mālohi ʻiate au, pea ʻoku ʻikai taau mo au ke u vete ʻae nonoʻo ʻo hono topuvaʻe: pea ʻe papitaiso ʻaki ʻe ia ʻakimoutoluʻae Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni mo e afi:
‌ʻOku ʻi hono nima ʻa hono fohe, pea te ne fakamaʻa ʻaupitohono hahaʻanga, pea ʻe ia ʻae kafukafuʻaki ʻae afi taʻemate.”
¶Pea lahi ʻae meʻa kehekehe naʻa ne malangaʻaki ʻi heʻene enginaki ki he kakai.
Ka naʻe valoki ʻe ia ʻa Helota ko e tuʻi, koeʻuhi ko Helotiasi ko e ʻunohoʻo hono tokoua ko Filipe, pea mo e kovi kotoa pēne fai ʻe Helota.
Pea ne fakalahi ʻaki ʻae meʻa ni kotoa pē, ʻa ʻene fakahūʻa Sione ki he fale fakapōpula.
¶Pea kuo papitaiso ʻae kakai kotoa pē, pea pehē, ne papitaiso foki mo Sisu, pea ʻi heʻene lotu, ne matoʻo ʻae langi,
Pea maliu hifo ʻae Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni kiate ia ʻo hangēko e sino ʻoe lupe, pea hoko mai mo e leʻo mei he langi, ʻo pehē, “Ko hoku ʻAlo ʻofaʻanga koe; ʻoku ou fiemālie lahi ʻiate koe.”
¶Pea kuo tolungofulu nai ʻae taʻu ʻo Sisu, ʻaia (naʻe ui) ko e foha ʻo Siosefa, ʻaia ko e foha ʻo Helai,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Matati, ko e foha ia ʻo Livai, ko e foha ia ʻo Melikai, ko e foha ia ʻo Sana, ko e foha ia ʻo Siosefa,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Matatiasi, ko e foha ia ʻo Emosi, ko e foha ia ʻo Neumi, ko e foha ia ʻo Esilai, ko e foha ia ʻo Naki,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Mati, ko e foha ia ʻo Matatiasi, ko e foha ia ʻo Semiai, ko e foha ia ʻo Siosefa, ko e foha ia ʻo Siuta,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Soana, ko e foha ia ʻo Lisa, ko e foha ia ʻo Solopepeli, ko e foha ia ʻo Saletieli, ko e foha ia ʻo Nilai,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Milikai, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻAtai, ko e foha ia ʻo Kosami, ko e foha ia ʻo Elimotami, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻEa,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Sose, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻEliesa, ko e foha ia ʻo Solimi, ko e foha ia ʻo Matati, ko e foha ia ʻo Livai,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Simione, ko e foha ia ʻo Siuta, ko e foha ia ʻo Siosefa, ko e foha ia Sonani, ko e foha ia ʻo Iliakimi,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Melia, ko e foha ia ʻo Menani, ko e foha ia ʻo Matata, ko e foha ia ʻo Netani, ko e foha ia ʻo Tevita,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Sese, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻOpeti, ko e foha ia ʻo Poasi, ko e foha ia ʻo Salimoni, ko e foha ia ʻo Neasoni,
Ko e foha ia ʻo ʻAminitape, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻElami, ko e foha ia ʻo Esiloni, ko e foha ia ʻo Felesi, ko e foha ia ʻo Siuta,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Sēkope, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻAisake, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻEpalahame, ko e foha ia ʻo Tela, ko e foha ia ʻo Nekoa,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Seluki, ko e foha ia ʻo Lekoa, ko e foha ia ʻo Feleki, ko e foha ia ʻo Hepa, ko e foha ia ʻo Sala,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Kēnani, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻAfakisati, ko e foha ia ʻo Semi, ko e foha ia ʻo Noa, ko e foha ia ʻo Lemeki,
Ko e foha ia ʻo Metusela, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻInoke, ko e foha ia ʻo Seleti, ko e foha ia ʻo Melilieli, ko e foha ia ʻo Kēnani,
Ko e foha ia ʻo ʻInosi, ko e foha ia ʻo Seti, ko e foha ia ʻo ʻAtama, ko e foha ia ʻoe ʻOtua.
4: NAʻE liu mai ʻa Sisu mei Sioatani, kuo fonu ʻi he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni, pea naʻe tatakiiaʻe he Laumālie ki he toafa.
Pea ʻahiʻahiʻi ia ʻe he tēvolo ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fāngofulu. Pea ko e ngaahi ʻaho ko ia naʻe ʻikai te ne kai ai ha meʻa: pea hili ia, naʻa ne fiekaia.
Pea pehēʻe he tēvolo kiate ia, “Kapau ko e ʻAlo koe ʻoe ʻOtua, fekau ki he maka ni ke liliu ko e mā.”
Pea leaange ʻa Sisu kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Kuo tohi, ‘ʻE ʻikai moʻui ʻae tangata ʻi he māpe, ka ʻi he folofola kotoa pēʻae ʻOtua.’|”
Pea naʻe ʻave ia ʻe he tēvolo ki he moʻunga māʻolunga, ʻo fakahāfakafokifāpe kiate ia ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pēʻo māmani.
Pea naʻe pehēʻe he tēvolo kiate ia, “Te u ʻatu moʻou ʻae mālohi ni kotoa pē, mo hono nāunau: he kuo tuku mai ia kiate au; pea ʻoku ou foaki ia ko ʻeku faʻiteliha.
Ko ia kapau te ke hūkiate au, ʻe ʻoʻou ia kotoa pē.”
Pea leaange ʻa Sisu, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Sētane, ke ke ʻalu ki hoku tuʻa; he kuo tohi, ‘Ke ke hūkia Sihova ko ho ʻOtua, pea ko ia pe te ke tauhi.’|”
Pea ne ʻomi ia ki Selūsalema, ʻo ne tuku ia ki he tuʻa falelotu lahi, pea pehēkiate ia, “Kapau ko e ʻAlo koe ʻoe ʻOtua, fakatōkoe ʻi heni ki lalo:

He kuo tohi,
‘ʻE fekau ʻe ia ʻene kau ʻāngelo kiate koe, ke nau tauhiʻi koe;

Pea,
‘Te nau hapahapai koe,
telia naʻa touʻia ho vaʻe ʻi ha maka.’|”
Pea leaange ʻa Sisu, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Ka kuo pehē, ‘ʻOua te ke ʻahiʻahi kia Sihova ko ho ʻOtua.’|”
Pea kuo fakaʻosi ʻe he tēvolo ʻae ʻahiʻahi kotoa pē, naʻe ʻalu ia ʻiate ia ʻo fuoloasiʻi.
¶Pea foki atu ʻa Sisu ki Kāleli, ʻi he mālohi ʻoe Laumālie: pea naʻe mafola hono ongoongo ki he potu fonua ko ia kotoa pē.
Pea ako ia ʻi honau ngaahi falelotu, pea fakamālōai ʻae kakai fulipē.
Pea haʻu ia ki Nāsaleti, ʻaia naʻe tupu ai ia: pea hūia ki he falelotu ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate, ʻo hangēko ʻene faʻa fai, pea tuʻu hake ke lautohi.
Pea naʻe ʻatu kiate ia ʻae tohi ʻae palōfita ko ʻIsaia. Pea ʻi heʻene folahi ʻae tohi, naʻa ne ʻilo ʻae potu kuo tohi ai,ʻo pehē,

“ʻOku ʻiate au ʻae Laumālie ʻo Sihova,
Koeʻuhi kuo ne fakanofo au ke u malangaʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei ki he masiva;
Kuo ne fekau au ke fakamoʻui ʻae loto mafesi,
Ke malangaʻaki ʻae huhuʻi ki he kau pōpula,
Mo e fakaʻāʻoe kui,
Ke veteange ʻakinautolukuo lavea,
Ke malangaʻaki ʻae taʻu lelei ʻo Sihova.”
Pea ne takai ʻe ia ʻae tohi, ʻo ʻange ki he tauhi, pea nofo hifo. Pea sio fakamamaʻu kiate ia ʻae mata ʻokinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ʻi he falelotu.
Pea ne fua lea ia kiate kinautolu, “Kuo fakamoʻoni ʻi he ʻaho ni ʻae tohi ko eni ʻi homou telinga.”
Pea naʻa nau fakamālōkotoa pēkiate ia, ʻonau ofo ʻi he ngaahi lea mālie naʻe ʻalu atu ʻi hono fofonga. Pea naʻa nau pehē, “ʻIkai ko e foha eni ʻo Siosefa?”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ka ko e moʻoni te mou lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātāni kiate au, ‘Faitoʻo, fakamoʻui koe:’pea ko ia kotoa pēkuo mau fanongo kuo fai ʻi Kapaneume, fai foki ʻi heni ʻi ho fonua.”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku ʻikai ha palōfita ʻe ʻofeina ʻi hono fonua.

Ka ʻoku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, naʻe tokolahi ʻae fefine kuo mate honau ʻunohoʻi ʻIsileli, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻIlaisiā, ʻi he lolotonga ʻae tāpuni ʻoe langi, ʻi he taʻu ʻe tolu mo e māhina ʻe ono, pea naʻe honge lahi ʻae fonua kotoa;
Ka naʻe ʻikai fekau ʻa ʻIlaisiāki ha taha ʻiate kinautolu, ka ki he fefine kuo mate hono ʻunohoʻi Salepita ʻi Saitoni.
Pea naʻe tokolahi ʻae kilia ʻi ʻIsileli, ʻi he kuongaʻo ʻIlaisiāko e palōfita; ka naʻe ʻikai ke fakamaʻa ha taha ʻiate kinautolu, ka ko Neamani ko e Silia.”
Pea ko kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ʻi he falelotu, naʻa nau mātuʻaki lili ʻi heʻenau fanongo ki he ngaahi meʻa ni,
‌ʻO nau tutuʻu, pea kapusi ia kituaʻākolo, ʻo tataki ia ki he matanga ʻoe moʻunga ʻaia naʻe tuʻu ai ʻenau kolo, koeʻuhi ke nau līia ʻi he lilifa ki lalo.
Ka naʻe ʻalu ia mei honau lotolotonga, pea mole atu ia,
‌ʻO ne ʻalu hifo ki Kapaneume, ko e kolo ʻo Kāleli, ʻo ne ako kiate kinautoluʻi he ngaahi ʻaho Sāpate.
Pea naʻa nau ofo ʻi heʻene akonaki he naʻe lea ia ʻi he mālohi.
¶Pea naʻe ʻi he falelotu ʻae tangata, naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae laumālie ʻoe tēvolo ʻuli, pea naʻe kalanga ia, ʻo leʻo lahi,
‌ʻO pehē, “ʻE Sisu ʻo Nāsaleti, tuku ai pe; ko e hāʻakimautolukiate koe? Kuo ke haʻu ke fakaʻauha ʻakimautolu? ʻOku ou ʻilo koe; ko e tokotaha māʻoniʻoni ʻoe ʻOtua.”

Pea lolomi ia ʻe Sisu, ʻo pehē, “Ke ke fakalongo pe, pea ke haʻu kituʻa ʻiate ia.”Pea kuo līʻae tangataʻe he tēvolo ki he haʻohaʻonga pea haʻu ia kituʻa ʻiate ia, pea naʻe ʻikai te ne fakamamahi kiate ia.
Pea naʻa nau ofo lahi ai kotoa pē, ʻonau fepehēʻaki, “Ko e hāʻae akonaki ni! He ʻoku ne fekau ʻi he pule mo e mālohi ki he kau laumālie ʻuli, pea ʻoku nau haʻu kituʻa.”
Pea naʻe mafola hono ongoongo ki he potu kotoa pēʻoe fonua ko ia.
¶Pea naʻe tuʻu hake ia, mei he falelotu, ʻo hūki he fale ʻo Saimone. Pea ko e faʻēʻae ʻunohoʻo Saimone kuo pukea ʻi he mofi lahi; pea naʻa nau kole kiate ia koeʻuhi ko ia.
Pea naʻa ne tuʻu hake kiate ia, ʻo taʻofi ʻae mofi, pea mahuʻi ia: ka ka tuʻu leva ia, ʻo tauhi ʻakinautolu.
¶Pea kuo tōʻae laʻā, pea ko kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ai haʻanau mahaki ʻi he mahaki kehekehe, naʻe ʻomi ʻakinautolukiate ia; pea ne hilifaki hono nima kiate kinautolutaki taha, ʻo fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.
Pea haʻu kituʻa ʻae kau tēvolo mei he tokolahi, ʻonau kalanga, ʻo pehē, “Ko koe ʻae Kalaisi ko e ʻAlo ʻoe ʻOtua.”Pea ne lolomi ʻakinautoluke ʻoua ʻe fakahāʻoku nau ʻilo ia ko e Kalaisi.
Pea kuo ʻaho, pea ʻalu ia, ʻo nofo ʻi ha potu lala: pea kumi ia ʻe he kakai, ʻonau omi kiate ia, pea naʻa nau taʻofia ia, ke ʻoua naʻa ne ʻalu ʻiate kinautolu.
Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku totonu ke u malangaʻaki ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua ki he ngaahi kolo kehe foki he ko ia kuo fekau ai au.”
Pea malanga ʻe ia ʻi he ngaahi falelotu ʻo Kāleli.
5: PEA pehē, ʻi heʻene tuʻu ʻi he matātahi ʻo Kenesaleti, naʻe lolofi mai kiate ia ʻae kakai ke fanongo ki he folofola ʻae ʻOtua.
Pea mamata ia ki he vaka ʻe ua ʻoku toka ʻi he veʻe ano: ka kuo ʻalu mei ai ʻae kau toutai ika, ʻonau fōhonau ngaahi kupenga.
Pea heka ia ki he vaka ʻe taha, ʻaia naʻe ʻo Saimone, pea ne kole kiate ia ke tukutukusiʻi mei ʻuta. Pea naʻe nofo hifo ia, ʻo akonaki ki he kakai mei he vaka.
¶Pea kuo hili ʻene lea, pea pehēʻe ia kia Saimone, “Maʻu atu ki he loloto, pea ʻaʻau homou ngaahi kupenga koeʻuhi kae fusi hake.”
Pea lea ʻa Saimone, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “ʻEiki, kuo mau ngāue ʻanepōʻo ʻaho, ka naʻe ʻikai maʻu ha meʻa: ka ʻi hoʻo fekau te u ʻaʻau ʻae kupenga.”
Pea kuo nau fai ia, pea nau maʻu ʻae ngaahi ika ʻo lahi ʻaupito: pea kamata mahae honau kupenga.
Pea nau taʻalo ki heʻenau kaungatoutai ikaʻi he vaka ʻe taha, ke nau haʻu ʻo tokoni ʻakinautolu. Pea naʻa nau omi, ʻo fakapito ʻae vaka fakatouʻosi, pea na kamata ngalo hifo.
Pea kuo mamata ʻa Saimone Pita, pea fakatōmapeʻe ia ki he tui ʻo Sisu, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻE ʻEiki, ʻalu ʻiate au; he ko e tangata angahala au.”
He naʻe ofo ia, mo kinautolukotoa pēnaʻe ʻiate ia, ʻi he ngaahi ika kuo maʻu:
Pea pehēfoki ʻa Semisi, mo Sione ko e ongo foha ʻo Sepeti, ko e kaunga toutai mo Saimone. Pea pehēʻe Sisu kia Saimone, “ʻOua ʻe manavahē; ngata heni te ketoutaitangata.”
Pea kuo ʻomi honau ongo vaka ki ʻuta, naʻa nau liʻaki kotoa pē, ʻo muimuikiate ia.

¶Pea naʻe lolotonga ʻene ʻi he kolo ʻe taha, pea vakai, ko e tangata kuo fonu ʻi he kilia: pea ne mamata kia Sisu, mo tōfakafoʻohifo, ʻo kole kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, kapau ko ho loto ʻoku ke faʻa fakamaʻa au.”
Pea mafao ʻe ia hono nima, ʻo ala ki ai mo ne pehē, “Ko hoku loto: ke ke maʻa koe.”Pea mahuʻi leva ʻiate ia ʻae kilia.
Pea ne fekau ia, “Ke ʻoua naʻa tala ki ha taha: kae ʻalu, ʻo fakahākoe ki he taulaʻeiki, mo ke ʻange koeʻuhi ko hoʻo fakamaʻa, ʻo fakatataumo ianaʻe fekau ʻe Mōsese, ko e fakamoʻoni kiate kinautolu.”
Ka naʻe ʻāsili ai ʻae mafola ʻa hono ongoongo: pea naʻe fakataha ʻae kakai tokolahi ʻaupitoke fanongo, pea koeʻuhi ke ne fakamoʻui ʻakinautoluʻi honau ngaahi mahamahaki.
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu iamei aiki he toafa, ʻo lotu ai.

Pea pehē, ko e ʻaho ʻe taha, ʻi heʻene akonaki, naʻe nofo ai ʻae kau Fālesi mo e kau akonaki ʻi he fono, kuo nau omi mei he potu kakai kotoa pēʻo Kāleli, mo Siutea, mo Selūsalema: pea naʻe ʻi ai ʻae mālohi ʻoe ʻEiki ke fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.
¶Pea vakai, naʻe ʻomi ʻe he kau tangata ʻae tangata ʻihonomohenga kuo pukea ʻi he mahaki tete: pea naʻa nau feinga pe fēfeeʻi hono lava mai ki loto, ke tuku ʻi hono ʻao.
Pea kuo ʻikai te nau ʻilo pe fēfeeʻi hono lava mai ki loto, koeʻuhi ko e kakai, naʻa nau ʻohake ia kituʻa fale, ʻo tukutukuhifo ia ʻi he ʻato ʻi he mohenga ki he haʻohaʻonga, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sisu.
Pea kuo mamata ʻe ia ki heʻenau tui, pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Tangata, kuo fakamolemole kiate koe hoʻo ngaahi angahala.”
Pea fakakaukau leva ʻae kau tangata tohi mo e kau Fālesi, ʻonau pehē, “Ko hai eni ʻoku ne lea fie ʻOtua? Ko hai te ne faʻa fakamolemole ʻae angahala, ka ko e ʻOtua pe?”
Ka kuo ʻilo ʻe Sisu ʻenau mahalo, pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou femahaloʻaki ai ʻi homou loto?
He ʻoku faingofua ʻa fē, ke lea, ‘Kuo fakamolemole kiate koe hoʻo ngaahi angahala;’pe ko e lea, ‘Tuʻu hake ʻo ʻalu?’

Ka koeʻuhi ke mou ʻilo ʻoku ʻi he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻae mālohi ʻi māmani ke fakamolemole ʻae angahala,”(pea pehēʻe ia ki he mahaki tete,) “ʻOku ou pehēatu kiate koe, Tuʻu hake, ʻo toʻo ho mohenga, pea ke ke ʻalu ki ho fale.”
Pea naʻe tuʻu hake leva ia ʻi honau ʻao, pea ne toʻo mai ʻaia naʻe tokoto ai, ʻo ʻalu ki hono fale, mo fakamālōki he ʻOtua.
Pea nau ofo ai kotoa pē, mo nau fakamālōki he ʻOtua, pea fonu ʻi he manavahē, ʻonau pehē, “Kuo tau mamata ʻi he ʻaho ni ki he ngaahi meʻa foʻou!”
¶Pea hili ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, pea ʻalu atu ia, ʻo ne mamata ki he tangata tānaki tukuhau, ko Livai hono hingoa, ʻoku nofo ia ʻi he tukuhauʻanga; pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Muimuiʻiate au.”
Pea tukuangeʻe ia ʻae meʻa kotoa pē, ʻo tuʻu hake, pea muimuiʻiate ia.
Pea naʻe fai ʻe Livai ʻae kātoanga lahi kiate ia ʻi hono fale: pea naʻe nofo mo kinautoluʻae kau tānaki tukuhau tokolahi, mo e kakai niʻihi.
Ka naʻe lāunga honau kau tangata tohi mo e kau Fālesi ki heʻene kau ākonga, ʻonau pehē, “Ko e hāʻoku mou kai mo inu fakataha ai mo e kau tānaki tukuhau mo e angahala?”
Pea leaange ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēkiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ʻikai ʻaonga ʻae faitoʻo ʻe kiate kinautoluʻoku mālōlō; ka ki he mahaki.
Naʻe ʻikai te u haʻu ke ui ʻae māʻoniʻoni, ka ko e angahala ke fakatomala.”
¶Pea nau pehēkiate ia, “Ko e hāʻoku faʻa ʻaukai mo lotu ai ʻae kau ākonga ʻa Sione, mo kinautolufoki ʻoe kau Fālesi; ka ʻoku kai mo inu ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻoʻou.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Te mou faʻa pule ke ʻaukai ʻae kāinga ʻoe tangata taʻane, ʻi he kei ʻiate kinautoluʻae tangata taʻane?
Ka ʻe hoko ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻe ʻave ai ʻae tangata taʻane ʻiate kinautolu, pea ko e ngaahi ʻaho ko ia te nau toki ʻaukai ai.”

¶Pea lea ʻaki foki ʻe ia ʻae fakatātākiate kinautolu; “ʻOku ʻikai ha taha te ne monomono ʻaki ʻae kofu motuʻa ha konga ʻoe kofu foʻou; ka pehē, ʻe haeiaʻe he meʻa foʻou, kaeʻumaʻāʻoku ʻikai fai tatau ʻae konga foʻou mo e motuʻakofu.
Pea ʻoku ʻikai ha taha te ne utu ʻaeuainefoʻou ki he ngaahi hina ʻoku motuʻa; telia naʻa hae ʻe heuainefoʻou ʻae ngaahi hina, pea tafe, pea maumau ʻae ngaahi hina.
Kae ʻutu ʻaeuainefoʻou ki he ngaahi hina foʻou; pea tolonga ai fakatouʻosi.
‌ʻOku ʻikai foki ha tangata kuo inu ʻi heuainemotuʻa pea fili leva ia ki heuainefoʻou; he ʻoku ne pehē, ‘ʻOku lelei lahi ʻa euainemotuʻa.’|”
6: PEA ko eni, naʻe ai ha Sāpate, naʻe ʻalu ia ʻi he ngaahi ngoue uite; pea toli ʻe heʻene kau ākonga ʻae fua ʻoe uite, ʻo momosi ʻi honau nima mo nau kai.
Pea naʻe pehēʻe he niʻihi ʻoe Fālesi kiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou fai ai ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ngofua ke fai ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate?”
Pea leaange ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēkiate kinautolu, “Naʻe ʻikai te mou lau ʻaia naʻe fai ʻe Tevita, ʻi heʻene fiekaia, mo kinautolunaʻe ʻiate ia;
‌ʻA ʻene hūki he fale ʻoe ʻOtua, pea ne toʻo ʻo kai ʻae māʻoe ʻao, pea ʻange foki kiate kinautolunaʻe ʻiate ia; ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ngofua ke kaiaika ko e kau taulaʻeiki pe?”
Mo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko e Foha ʻoe tangata ko e ʻEiki foki ia ʻoe Sāpate.”
¶Pea ʻi he hoko ki he Sāpate foki ʻe taha, naʻe hūia ki he falelotu ʻo ako ai: pea naʻe ʻi ai ʻae tangata kuo mate hono nima toʻomataʻu.
Pea lamasi ia ʻe he kau tangata tohi mo e kau Fālesi, pe te ne fakamoʻui ia ʻi heʻahoSāpate; koeʻuhi ke nau ʻilo ha meʻa ke talakoviʻi ai ia.
Ka naʻe ʻilo ʻe ia ʻenau mahalo, pea ne pehēki he tangata naʻe nima mate, “Tuʻu hake, ʻo tuʻu mai ki loto. Pea naʻe tuʻu hake ia, ʻo tuʻuʻi ai.”
Pea toki pehēatu ʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “Te u fehuʻi kiate kimoutoluki he meʻa ʻe taha; Ko e hāʻoku ngofua ke fai ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate, ko e lelei pe ko e kovi! Ko e fakamoʻui pe ko e tāmateʻi?”
Pea naʻe vakai folia ʻe ia ʻakinautolukotoa pē, pea pehēʻe ia ki he tangata, “Mafao atu ho nima.”Pea ne fai ia: pea moʻui hono nima ʻo hangēkohono nimaʻe taha.
Ka naʻe mātuʻaki lili ʻakinautolu: ʻonau fakakaukau pe ko e hāte nau fai kia Sisu.
¶Pea pehē, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia naʻe ʻalu hake ia ki ha moʻunga ke lotu, pea lotu ai pe ia ki he ʻOtua ʻi he pōʻo ʻaho.
Pea kuo ʻaho hake, pea ne ui kiate ia ʻa ʻene kau ākonga; pea naʻa ne fili ʻiate kinautoluʻae toko hongofulu ma toko ua, ʻaia foki naʻa ne fakahingoa ko e kau ʻaposetolo;
Ko Saimone, (naʻa ne fakahingoa ko Pita,) mo ʻAnitelūko hono tokoua, mo Semisi, mo Sione, mo Filipe, mo Pātolomiu,
Mo Mātiu, mo Tōmasi, mo Semisi ko e foha ʻo ʻAlefiusi, mo Saimone ʻoku ui ko Selote,
Mo Siutasiko e tokouaʻo Semisi, mo SiutasiʻIsikaliote, ʻaia foki ko e lavaki.

¶Pea naʻe ʻalu hifo ia mo kinautolu, ʻo tuʻu ʻi he potu tafangafanga, fakataha mo ʻene kau ākonga, pea naʻe haʻu ʻae kakai tokolahi ʻaupitomei Siutea kotoa pēmo Selūsalema, mo e matātahi ʻo Taia mo Saitoni, ke nau fanongo kiate ia, mo moʻui mei honau ngaahi mahaki;
Pea mo kinautolunaʻe mamahi ʻi he kau laumālie ʻuli: pea naʻe fakamoʻui ʻakinautolu.
Pea holi ʻae kakai kotoa pēke nau ala kiate ia: he naʻe ʻalu ʻiate ia ʻae mālohi, ʻo fakamoʻui kotoa pē.

“ʻOku monūʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoku fiekaia ni:
Koeʻuhi ʻe fakamākona ʻakimoutolu.
ʻOku monūʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoku tangi ni:
He te mou kata.

“ʻOku monūʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoka fehiʻa ʻae kakai kiate kimoutolu, Mo fakamavaheʻi ʻakimoutolumeiate kinautolu, ʻO taukaekiate kimoutolu, Pea līkituʻa homou hingoa ʻo hangēko e kovi, Koeʻuhi ko e Foha ʻoe tangata.
Mou fiefia ʻi he ʻaho ko ia, Pea hopohopo ʻi he fiefia: Vakai, he ʻoku lahi hoʻomou totongi ʻi he langi: He naʻe fai pehēʻenau ngaahi tamai ki he kau palōfita.

“Kae malaʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoku koloaʻia!
He kuo mou maʻu hoʻomou fiemālie.

“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoku mākona!
He te mou fiekaia.
ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoku kata ni!
He te mou tangi mo tangilāulau.

“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutoluʻoka lauʻi lelei ʻakimoutoluʻe he kakai kotoa pē!
He naʻe fai pehēʻa ʻenau ngaahi tamai ki he kau palōfita kākā.
¶“Ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutoluʻoku fanongo, ʻofa ki homou ngaahi fili, fai lelei kiate kinautoluʻoku fehiʻa kiate kimoutolu.
Tāpuakiʻi ʻakinautoluʻoku kapeʻi ʻakimoutolu, pea hūfia ʻakinautoluʻoku fakakoviʻi ʻakimoutolu.
Pea ko ia ʻoku ne sipiʻi koe ʻi ho kouʻahe ʻe taha, fulihikiate ia ho kouʻaheʻe taha; pea mo ia ʻoku ne ʻave ho pulupulu, ʻoua naʻa taʻofiʻene ʻavemo ho kofutuʻa.
Foaki kiate ia fulipēʻoku kole kiate koe; pea ko ia ʻoku ne ʻave hoʻo koloa ʻoua naʻatoekoleia.
Pea ko ia te mou loto ke fai ʻe he kakai kiate kimoutolu, ko ia pe foki te mou fai kiate kinautolu.
“He kapau ʻoku mou ʻofa kiate kinautolupeʻoku ʻofa mai kiate kimoutolu, ko e hāʻae fakafetaʻi ʻoku mou maʻu? He ʻoku ʻofa mai ʻae kau angahala kiate kinautoluʻoku ʻofa ange kiate kinautolu.
Pea kapau ʻoku mou fai lelei kiate kinautolupeʻoku fai lelei kiate kimoutolu, ko e hāʻae fakafetaʻi ʻoku mou maʻu? He ʻoku fai pehēʻe he kau angahala.
Pea kapau ʻoku mou ʻatu meʻakiate kinautolupeʻoku mou ʻamanaki ke maʻu mei ai, ko e hāʻae fakafetaʻi te mou maʻu? He ʻoku ʻatu meʻa ʻae kau angahala ki he kau angahala, ketoemaʻu hono tatau.

Ka mou ʻofa ki homou ngaahi fili, pea fai lelei, mo ʻatu meʻa, ʻi he taʻeʻamanaki ke toe maʻu; pea ʻe lahi ai hoʻomou totongi pea ʻe ui ʻakimoutoluko e fānau ʻae Fungani Māʻolunga: he ʻoku angalelei ia ki he taʻefakafetaʻi pea mo e kovi.

Ko ia mou manavaʻofa,
ʻo hangēfoki ko e manavaʻofa ʻa hoʻomou Tamai.

“ʻOua ʻe fakamaau,
pea ʻe ʻikai fakamaauʻi ʻakimoutolu:
ʻoua naʻa fakahalaia,
pea ʻe ʻikai fakahalaia ʻakimoutolu:
mou fakamolemole,
pea ʻe fakamolemolea ʻakimoutolu:

Foaki, pea ʻe foaki ia kiate kimoutolu; ko e fua lahi, kuo faʻo lolo hifo, ʻo lulu fakataha, pea fonu mahuohua, ʻe ʻatu ki homou fatafata. He ko e fuofuako ia te mou fua ʻaki, ʻe toe fua ʻaki ia kiate kimoutolu.”
Pea naʻa ne lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātākiate kinautolu, “ʻE faʻa taki ʻe he kui ʻae kui? ʻIkai te na tōfakatouʻosi ki he luo?”
‌ʻOku ʻikai lahi hake ʻae ākonga ʻi heʻene akonaki: ka ko ia kotoa pēʻoku haohaoa ʻe hangēia ko ʻene akonaki.
“Pea ko e hāʻoku ke tokanga ai ki he malamalaʻi ʻakau ʻi he mata ʻo ho kāinga, ka ʻoku ʻikai te ke ʻilo ʻae fuʻu ʻakau ʻoku ʻi ho mata?

Pea ʻe fēfēhaʻo faʻa pehēki ho kāinga, ‘Kāinga, tuku mai ke u toʻo ʻae malamalaʻi ʻakau ʻoku ʻi ho mata,’ka ʻoku ʻikai te ke ʻilo ʻae fuʻu ʻakau ʻoku ʻi ho mata? Ko e mālualoikoe, tomuʻa līʻae fuʻu ʻakau mei ho mata, pea te ke toki ʻilo totonu ke toʻo mai ʻae malamalaʻi ʻakau mei he mata ʻo ho kāinga.
“He ʻoku ʻikai ha ʻakau lelei ʻe tupu ai ʻae fua kovi; pe ha ʻakau kovi ʻe tupu ai ʻae fua lelei.
He ʻoku ʻilo ʻae ʻakau kotoa pēʻi hono fua ʻoʻona. He ʻoku ʻikai toli ʻe he kakai ʻae fiki ʻi he ʻakau talatala, pe ko e fua ʻoe vaine ʻi he talatalaʻāmoa.

‌ʻOku ʻomi ʻe he tangata angalelei ʻaia ʻoku lelei mei he koloa lelei ʻi hono loto; pea ʻoku ʻomi ʻe he tangata angakovi ʻaia ʻoku kovi mei he koloa kovi ʻi hono loto: he ʻoku lea ʻa hono ngutu mei he meʻa lahi ʻoe loto.
¶“Pea ko e hāʻoku mou ui ai au, ‘ʻEiki, ʻEiki,’kae ʻikai fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ou tala?
Pea ko ia fulipēʻoku haʻu kiate au, ʻo fanongo ki heʻeku ngaahi lea, mo fai ki ai, te u fakahākiate kimoutoluhono tatau:

‌ʻOku tatau ia mo e tangata naʻe langa ʻae fale, pea keli māʻulalo, ʻo ne ai hono tuʻunga ki hefunga maka; pea ʻi he tupu ʻae vaitafe, pea ʻoho mālohi ʻae vai ki he fale ko ia, naʻe ʻikai ngaue ia; he naʻe fokotuʻu ia ki he maka.

Ka ko ia ʻoku fanongo, kae ʻikai faiki ai, ʻoku tatau ia mo e tangata naʻe langa ʻae fale ʻi he kelekele taʻehatuʻunga; pea naʻe ʻoho mālohi ʻae vai ki ai, pea holo leva ia; pea ko e maumau ʻoe fale ko ia ko e meʻa lahi.”
7: PEA kuo fakaʻosi ʻe ia ʻa ʻene tala kotoa pēʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai, pea ʻalu ia ki Kapaneume.
Pea naʻe mahaki, ʻo mei mate ʻae tamaioʻeiki ʻae ʻeikitau ʻe taha, ʻaia naʻe ʻofa lahi ai ia.
Pea kuo fanongo ia kia Sisu, pea ne fekau ʻae kau mātuʻa ʻi he kakai Siu, ke fakakolekole kiate ia ke ne haʻu ʻo fakamoʻui ʻa ʻene tamaioʻeiki.
Pea kuo nau omi kia Sisu, pea nau kole fakamātoato kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻaonga ia te ke fai ki ai ʻae meʻa ni:
He ʻoku ʻofa ia ki hotau kakai, pea ko ia ia ne langa ʻae falelotu moʻomautolu.”

Pea ʻalu ʻa Sisu mo kinautolu. Pea kuo hoko ia ʻo vāofi mo e fale, pea fekau ʻe he ʻeikitau ʻahonokāinga, ke leaʻo pehēkiate ia, “ʻEiki, ʻoua naʻa ke ongosia ange koe: he ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻaonga ke ke hūki hoku fale:
Pea naʻe ʻikai te u mahalo ʻoku taau mo au ke u ʻalu atu kiate koe: ka ke fai haʻo lea, pea ʻe moʻui ai ʻeku tamaioʻeiki.

He ko au ko e tangata puleʻia foki, ka ʻoku ai ʻae kautau ʻoku ou puleʻi pea ʻoku ou pehēki ha taha, ‘ʻAlu,’pea ʻalu ia; pea ki ha taha, ‘Haʻu,’pea haʻu ia; pea ki heʻeku tamaioʻeiki, ‘Fai eni,’pea ʻoku ne faiia.

Pea ofo ʻa Sisu kiate ia, ʻi heʻene fanongo ki he ngaahi meʻa ni, pea tafoki ia, ʻo ne pehēki he kakai naʻe muimuiʻiate ia, ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, “Naʻa mo ʻIsileli, ʻoku ʻikai te u ʻilo ai ha tui ʻe pehēnihono lahi.”
Pea liu atu ki he fale ʻakinautolunaʻe fekau, ʻonau ʻilo ʻae tamaioʻeiki naʻe mahaki kuo moʻui ia.
¶Pea ʻi he ʻaho naʻa na feholoi, naʻe ʻalu ia ki he kolo naʻe ui ko Neini: pea naʻe ʻalu mo ia ʻa ʻene kau ākonga tokolahi, mo e fuʻu kakai.

Pea kuo ofi ia ki he matapāʻoe kolo, pea vakai, naʻe fata mai kituaʻāʻae tangata mate, ko e tama pe taha ia ʻa ʻene faʻē, pea ko e fefine ia kuo mate hono ʻunoho: pea naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae kakai tokolahi ʻoe kolo.
Pea kuo mamata ki ai ʻae ʻEiki, pea manavaʻofa ia kiate ia, ʻo ne pehēki ai, “ʻOua ʻe tangi.”
Pea haʻu ia ʻo ala ki he fata: pea tuʻu pe ʻae kau fata. Pea pehēʻe ia, “Talavou, ʻoku ou pehēkiate koe, Tuʻu hake.”
Pea nofo hake ia ʻaia naʻe mate, ʻo kamata lea. Pea ne ʻatu ia ki heʻene faʻē.
Pea pukea kotoa pēʻi he manavahē: pea nau fakamālōki he ʻOtua, ʻo pehē, “Kuo tuʻu hake ʻae palōfita lahi ʻiate kitautolu;”pea, “Kuo ʻaʻahi ʻae ʻOtua ki hono kakai.”
Pea naʻe mafola ʻa hono ongoongo ni ʻi Siutea kotoa pē, pea mo e potu fonua kotoa pēko ia.
¶Pea naʻe fakahāʻe he kau ākonga ʻa Sione kiate ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē.
Pea naʻe ui ʻe Sione kiate ia ʻae toko ua ʻo ʻene kau ākonga, ʻo ne fekauʻakinauakia Sisu, ʻo ne pehē, “Ko koe ia naʻe pehēʻe haʻu? Pe te mau ʻamanaki ki ha taha?”
Pea kuo haʻu ʻae ongo tangata kiate ia, ʻo na pehē, “Kuo fekau ʻakimaua kiate koe ʻe Sione ko e Papitaiso, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko koe ia naʻe pehēʻe haʻu? Pe te tau ʻamanaki ki ha taha?’|”
Pea ʻi he feituʻulaʻāko ia naʻa ne fakamoʻui ai ʻae tokolahi mei he ngaahi mahaki, mo e ngaahi meʻa fakamamahi, pea mo e kau laumālie kovi; pea naʻa ne fakaʻāʻae tokolahi naʻe kui.

Peatokilea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinaua, “Mo ō, ʻo fakahākia Sione ʻae ngaahi meʻa kuo mo mamata mo fanongo ki ai: kuo ʻa ʻae kui, kuo ʻeveʻeva ʻae pipiki, kuo maʻa ʻae kilia, kuo ongo ʻae tuli, kuo fokotuʻu ʻae mate, pea ʻoku malangaʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei ki he masiva.
Pea ʻoku monūʻia ia ʻaia ʻe ʻikai tūkia ʻiate au.”
¶Pea kuo ʻalu ʻae ongo tangata fekau ʻa Sione, pea toki lea ia ki he kakai ʻia Sione, “Naʻa mou ʻalu atu ki he toafa ke mamata ki he hā? Ki ha kaho ʻoku luluʻi ʻe he matangi?
Ka naʻa mou ʻalu atu ke mamata ki he hā? Ki ha tangata kuo kofuʻaki ʻae kofu molū? Vakai, he ko kinautoluʻoku kofu fakakaukau, mo kai lelei, ʻoku ʻi he fale ʻoe ngaahi tuʻi.
Ka naʻa mou ʻalu atu ke mamata ki he hā? Ha palōfita? ʻIo, ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu. ʻOku lahi hake ia ʻi he palōfita.

Ko ia ia kuo tohi ki ai,ʻo pehē,
‘Vakai, ʻoku ou fekau atu hoku fakamelomelo ke muʻomuʻa ʻi ho ʻao,
Ke teuteu ʻe ia ho hala kiate koe.’

He ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻiate kinautoluʻoku fanauʻi ʻe he fefine ʻoku ʻikai ha palōfita lahi hake ʻia Sione ko e Papitaiso: ka ko ia ʻoku siʻi taha pe ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, ʻoku lahi ia ʻiate ia.”
Pea ko e kakai kotoa pēnaʻe fanongokiate ia, mo e kau tānaki tukuhau, naʻa nau fakahāʻae angatonu ʻae ʻOtua, ʻi heʻenau papitaiso ʻi he papitaiso ʻa Sione.
Ka ko e kau Fālesi, mo e kau akonaki ʻi he fono, naʻa nau fakataʻeʻaonga ʻae finangalo ʻoe ʻOtua kiate kinautolu, he naʻe ʻikai te nau papitaiso ʻiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe he ʻEiki, “Te u fakatatau ki he hāʻae kakai ʻoe toʻutangata ni? Pea ʻoku nau tatau mo e hā?

‌ʻOku nau tatau mo e tamaiki ʻoku nofo ʻi he potu fakatau, ʻoku nau feuiʻaki, ʻo pehē, ‘Kuo mau ifi fangufangu kiate kimoutolu, Ka naʻe ʻikai te mou meʻe; Kuo mau hiva fakamamahi kiate kimoutolu, Ka naʻe ʻikai te mou tangi.’
He naʻe ʻikai haʻu ʻa Sione ko e Papitaiso ʻo kai māmo inuuaine; pea ʻoku mou pehē, ‘ʻOku ʻiate ia ha tēvolo.’
Kuo haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻo kai mo inu; ka mou pehē, ‘Vakai, ko e tangata faʻa kai, mo faʻa inuuaine, ko e kāinga ʻoe kau tānaki tukuhau mo e angahala!’
Ka ʻoku fakatonuhia ʻae poto ʻe heʻene fānau kotoa pē.”
¶Pea naʻe kole kiate ia ʻae tokotaha ʻi he Fālesi ke na kai fakataha mo ia. Pea ne hūki he fale ʻoe Fālesi, ʻo nofo ai ke kai.
Pea vakai, ko e fefine naʻe angahala ʻi he kolo, kuo ʻilo ʻe ia ʻoku nofo mo kaiʻa Sisuʻi he fale ʻae Fālesi, pea ne ʻomi ʻae puha ʻalapasita ʻoe lolo.
Pea tuʻu ia ʻi hono vaʻe meihono tuʻa, ʻo tangi, pea kamata fufuluʻe ia hono vaʻe ʻaki hono loʻimata, ʻo ne holoholo ʻakiiahono louʻulu, pea ʻuma ki hono vaʻe, ʻo tākai ʻakiiaʻae lolo.

Ka kuo mamataki aiʻae Fālesi ʻaia naʻe kole kiate ia, pea lea ia ʻi hono loto, ʻo pehē, “Ka ne ko hāpalōfita ʻae tangata ni,pehē, kuo ne ʻilo ʻae fefine ni, mo ʻene anga, ʻaia ʻoku ala kiate ia: he ko e angahala ia.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “Saimone, ʻoku ʻiate au ʻae meʻa te u lea ai kiate koe.”Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻEiki, folofola mai.”
“Naʻe ai ʻae tangata ʻe tokotaha pea naʻe totonu ke totongi kiate ia ʻe he toko ua: ko e tenali ʻe nimangeau ʻae tokotaha, kae nimangofulu ʻae tokotaha.
Pea kuo ʻikai haʻana meʻa ke totongi ʻaki, pea ne fakamolemolelevaʻakinaua ʻosi pe. Ko ia ke ke tala mai, pe ko hai ʻiate kinaua ʻe ʻofa lahi kiate ia?”
Pea lea ʻa Saimone, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ou mahalo ko ia pe naʻe lahi ʻene fakamolemole ki ai.”Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “ʻOku totonu hoʻo mahalo.”

Pea tafoki ia ki he fefine, mo ne pehēkia Saimone, “ʻOku ke mamata ki he fefine ni? Naʻaku hūki ho fale, ka naʻe ʻikai te ke ʻomi ha vai ki hoku vaʻe; ka kuo fufuluʻaki ʻe ia ʻa hoku vaʻe ʻae loʻimata, mo holoholo ʻakiiahono louʻulu.
Naʻe ʻikai te ke ʻuma kiate au: ka ko e fefine ni talu ʻeku hūmai mo e ʻikai tuku ʻene ʻuma ki hoku vaʻe.
Naʻe ʻikai te ke pani ʻaki hoku ʻulu ʻae lolo: ka kuo tākai ʻe he fefine ni ʻa hoku vaʻe ʻaki ʻae lolo.
Ko ia ʻoku ou tala atu ai kiate koe, Ko ʻene angahala, ʻaia ʻoku lahi, kuo fakamolemole ia; ko ia ʻoku lahi ai ʻene ʻofa: ka ko ia ʻoku siʻi hono fakamolemole, ʻoku siʻi ʻene ʻofa.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “Kuo fakamolemole hoʻo ngaahi angahala.”
Pea ko kinautolunaʻa nau nofo ʻo kai mo ia, naʻa nau kamata pehēʻi honau loto, Ko hai eni ʻoku ne fakamolemole foki ʻae angahala?
Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia ki he fefine, “Kuo fakamoʻui koe ʻe hoʻo tui; ʻalu ʻi he fiemālie.”
8: PEA pehē, kuo hili ia, naʻa ne ʻalu ʻi he kolo mo e potu kakai kotoa pē, ʻo malanga mo fakahāʻae ongoongolelei ʻoe ʻOtua: pea naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae toko hongofulu ma toko ua,
Pea mo e kau fefine naʻe fakamoʻui mei he kau laumālie kovi, mo e ngaahi mahaki, ko Mele ʻoku ui ko Makitaline, ʻaia naʻe ʻalu ai ʻae tēvolo ʻe toko fitu,
Mo Sioana ko e ʻunohoʻo Kusa ko e tauhi koloa ʻo Helota, mo Susana, mo e tokolahi kehe, naʻa nau tauhi ʻaki ia ʻenau koloa.
¶Pea kuo fakataha mai ʻae fuʻu kakai, kuo haʻu mei he kolo kotoa pēkiate ia, pea pehēʻe ia ʻi he fakatātā:
“Naʻe ʻalu atu ʻae tangata tūtuuʻi ke tūtuuʻi ʻene tenga; pea ʻi heʻene tūtuuʻi, naʻe mokulu ʻae niʻihi ki he veʻe hala: pea malaki hifo ia, pea naʻe kai ʻo ʻosi ia ʻe he fanga manupunaʻoe ʻatā.
Pea mokulu ʻae niʻihi ki he maka; pea kuo toki tupu hake ia, pea maeleva, koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai viviku ia.
Pea mokulu ʻae niʻihi ki he ʻakau talatala; pea tupu hake mo ia ʻae ʻakau talatala, ʻo kāsia ai ia.
Pea mokulu ʻae niʻihi ki he kelekele lelei, ʻo tupu hake, pea tupu ai ʻae fua ʻe teau.”Pea kuo ne lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, pea kalanga ia, “Ko ia ʻoku ne telinga. Ongo, ke ongoʻi ia.”
Pea naʻe fehuʻi ʻa ʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko e hānaihono ʻuhingaʻoe fakatātāni?”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Kuo tuku ke ʻilo ʻekimoutoluʻae ngaahi meʻa lilo ʻoe puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua: ka ki he kakai kehe ʻi he ngaahi fakatātā; koeʻuhi kenau ʻāka ʻe ʻikai mamata, pea fanongo ka ʻe ʻikai ʻilo.
“Pea ko e fakatātāeni: Ko e tenga ko e folofola ia ʻae ʻOtua.
Ko kinautolueniʻi he veʻe hala, ʻoku nau fanongo; pea toki haʻu ʻae tēvolo, ʻo ne toʻo atu ʻae folofola ʻi honau loto, telia naʻa nau tui pea moʻui ai.
Ko kinautolueniʻi he maka, ʻaia ʻoku fanongo, pea maʻu ʻae folofola ʻi he fiefia; ka ʻoku ʻikai hanau aka, pea ʻoku nau tui fuoloasiʻi pe, pea ʻi he ʻaho ʻoe ʻahiʻahi ʻoku nau hinga ai.
Pea ko ia naʻe mokulu ki he ʻakau talatala, ko kinautolueni ʻoku fanongo pea ʻalu atu, ka ko e tokangamamahimo e koloa mo e fiefia ʻi māmani, ʻoku kāsia ai ia, pea ʻe ʻikai ai ha fua ke haohaoa.
Ka ko ia ʻoku ʻi he kelekele moʻui, ko kinautolueni ʻoku nau fanongo ki he folofola, ʻo maʻuiaki he loto totonu mo lelei, pea fakatupu ʻae fua ʻi he fakakukafi.
¶“ʻOku ʻikai ha tangata te ne tutu ʻae maama, ke fakapulonga ʻaki ʻae ipu, pe tukuiaki he lalo mohenga; kae fokotuʻuiaki ha tuʻunga, koeʻuhi ke mamata ki he maama ʻakinautoluʻokuʻi ai.
He ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻoku lilo, ʻe taʻefakahā; pea ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻoku fufū, ʻe taʻeʻiloa pe taʻemafola kituʻa.
Ko ia mou tokanga ki hoʻomou fanongo: he ko ia ʻoku maʻu, ʻe foaki kiate ia pea ko ia ʻoku ʻikai te ne maʻu, ʻe toʻo meiate ia ʻaia ʻoku ne mahalo kuo ne maʻu.”
¶Pea haʻu ai kiate ia ʻa ʻene faʻēmo hono kāinga, ka naʻe ʻikai te nau ofi kiate ia, ko e meʻa ʻi he kakai.
Pea naʻe fakahākiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko hoʻo faʻēmo ho kāinga ʻoku tutuʻu ʻituʻa, ko ʻenau holi ke mamata kiate koe.”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko ʻeku faʻēmo hoku kāinga ʻakinautoluni ʻoku fanongo ki he folofola ʻae ʻOtua, mo fai ki ai.”
¶Pea pehē, ʻi he ʻaho ʻe taha, naʻe heka vaka ia mo ʻene kau ākonga: pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ke tau ōki he kauvai ʻe taha. Pea naʻa nau tuku atu.”
Ka ʻi heʻenau folau naʻe mohe ia: pea naʻe tōhifo ki he tahi ʻae taufa lahi: pea ngotofuʻuʻae vaka, pea nau tuʻutāmaki ai.
Pea naʻa nau haʻu, ʻo fafangu ia, mo nau pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻeiki, kuo tau mate.”Pea tuʻu hake ia, ʻo lolomi ʻae matangi mo e hou ʻae tahi; pea tuku ia, ʻo tofukī.

Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Kofaʻāhoʻomou tui?”Ka naʻe manavahēmo ofo ʻakinautolu, ʻonau fepehēʻaki, “Ko hai nai ʻae tangata ni! He ʻoku fekau ʻe ia ki he matangi mo e tahi, pea ʻoku talangofua ia kiate ia.”
¶Pea naʻa nau tau ki he fonua ʻoe kakai Katala, ʻaia ʻoku hangatonu ki Kāleli.

Pea ʻi heʻene ʻalu ki ʻuta, naʻe fakafetaulakimai kiate ia ʻae tangata ʻe tokotaha mei he kolo, naʻe fuoloaʻaeulusinoʻiate ia ʻae kau tēvolo, naʻe ʻikai ke vala, pe nofo fale, ka ʻi he ngaahi faʻitoka.

Pea mamata ia kia Sisu, pea kalanga, mo fakatōmapeʻe ʻi hono ʻao, ʻotangileʻo lahi, ʻo pehē, “ʻE Sisu, ʻAlo ʻoe fungani ʻOtua māʻolunga, ko e hāau kiate koe? ʻOku ou kole kiate koe, ʻoua ʻe fakamamahiʻi au.”

(He kuo fekau ʻe ia ki he laumālie ʻuli ke haʻu kituʻa mei he tangata. He kuo liunga lahi hono puke ia: pea naʻe maʻu ia ʻi hono haʻisia ʻaki ʻae ngaahiukamea fihifihi mo e ngaahiukamea fakamaʻu; kae motuhi ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi haʻi, pea tuli ia ʻe he tēvolo ki he toafa.)
Pea fehuʻi ʻa Sisu kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Ko hai ho hingoa?”Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko Lisione:”koeʻuhi kuo hūkiate ia ʻae kau tēvolo tokolahi.
Pea naʻa nau kole kiate ia, ke ʻoua te ne fekau ʻakinautoluke nau ʻalu atu ki he loloto.
Pea naʻe ai ʻae fanga puaka lahi naʻe fafanga ʻi he moʻunga: pea naʻa nau kole kiate ia ke ne tuku ke nau hūki ai. Pea ne tukuangeia.
Pea ʻalu atulevaʻae kau tēvolo ʻi he tangata, ʻonau hūki he fanga puaka; pea feleleʻi ʻo ʻoho ʻae fanga puaka ʻi he potu tahifohifo ki tahi, ʻo melemo ai.
Pea kuo mamata ʻae kau tauhimanu ki he meʻa kuo fai, pea nau feholaki, ʻo ʻalu ʻo fakahāʻi he kolo mo e tukuʻuta.

Pea naʻa nau ʻalu atu ke vakai pe ko e hākuo fai, ʻo haʻu kia Sisu, pea ʻilo ʻae tangata, ʻaia kuo ʻalu ai ʻae kau tēvolo, ʻoku nofo ia ʻi he vaʻe ʻo Sisu, kuo kofu, pea poto hono loto: pea naʻa nau manavahēai.
Pea ko kinautolufoki naʻe mamataki ai, naʻa nau tala kiate kinautoluʻae ngāue kuo moʻui ai ia, ʻaia naʻeulusinoai ʻae kau tēvolo.
¶Pea toki kole ʻae kakai kotoa pēʻoe fonua ʻoe kau Katala ke ʻalu ia ʻiate kinautolu; he kuo nau pukea ʻi he ilifia lahi: pea heka ia ki vaka, ʻotoeliu mai.
Pea ko e tangata naʻe ʻalu ai ʻae kau tēvolo, naʻa ne kole kiate ia ke na nonofo mo ia: ka naʻe fekau ʻe Sisu ke ʻalu ia, ʻo ne pehē,
“Toe ʻalu koe ki ho fale, ʻo fakahāʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi kuo fai ʻe he ʻOtua kiate koe.”Pea naʻe ʻalu ia, ʻo ne ongoongoa ʻi he kolo kotoa pēʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi kuo fai ʻe Sisu kiate ia.
¶Pea pehē, kuo foki ange ʻa Sisu, naʻetoemaʻu fiefia ia ʻe he kakai: he naʻa nau tatali kotoa pēkiate ia.
Pea vakai, naʻe haʻu ʻae tangata ko Sailosi hono hingoa, ko e pule ia ʻi he falelotu; pea ne fakatōmapeʻe ki he vaʻe ʻo Sisu, ʻo kole kiate ia ke haʻu ki hono fale:
