He kuo taha pe hono ʻofefine, pea kuo hongofulu ma ua nai hono taʻu pea kuo tei mate ia. Ka ʻi heʻene ʻalu naʻe fakaʻefi ia ʻe he kakai.
¶Pea ko e fefine ʻe tokotaha naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau ʻoe toto, ʻi he taʻu ʻe hongofulu ma ua, pea kuo fakaʻosi ʻe ia ʻa ʻene meʻa kotoa pēki he kau faitoʻo, ka naʻe ʻikai ke moʻui ia ʻi ha taha,
Naʻe haʻu ia kihonotuʻa, ʻo ala ki he kapa ʻo hono kofu: pea matuʻu leva ʻae ʻau ʻo hono toto.

Pea pehēʻe Sisu, “Ko hai kuo ala kiate au?”Pea kuo nau ʻikai kotoa pē, pea pehēʻe Pita mo kinautolunaʻa nau ʻiate ia, “ʻEiki, ʻoku fakaʻefi mo kāpui koe ʻe he kakai, pea ʻoku ke pehē, ‘Ko hai kuo ala kiate au?’|”
Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu, “Kuo ala ha taha kiate au: he ʻoku ou ʻilo kuo ʻalu ʻae mālohi ʻiate au.”

Pea kuo ʻilo ʻe he fefine ʻoku ʻikai lilo ia, pea haʻu tetetete ia, ʻo fakatōmapeʻe ʻi hono ʻao, ʻo ne fakahākiate ia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai kotoa pēhono ʻuhinga ʻo ʻene ala kiate ia, pea mo ʻene moʻui ai leva.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “ʻOfefine, ke ke fiemālie: kuo fakamoʻui koe ʻe hoʻo tui; ʻalu ʻo fiemālie.”
¶Pea naʻe lolotonga ʻene lea, mo ʻene haʻu ʻae tokotaha mei hefale ʻoepule ʻoe falelotu, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “Kuo pekia ho ʻofefine; ʻoua naʻa fakafiuʻi ʻae ʻEiki.”
Ka kuo fanongo ki ai ʻa Sisu, pea lea ia, ʻo pehēkiate ia, “ʻOua te ke manavahē: ka ke tui pe, pea ʻe fakamoʻui ia.”
Pea kuo haʻu ia ki he fale, naʻe ʻikai te ne tuku ke hūki aiha taha, ka ko Pita, mo Semisi, mo Sione, pea mo e tamai mo e faʻēʻae taʻahine.
Pea naʻa nau tangi mo tangilāulau kotoa pēkoeʻuhi ko ia: ka naʻa ne pehē, “ʻOua ʻe tangi; he ʻoku ʻikai mate ia, ka ʻoku mohepe.”
Ka naʻa nau kakata manuki kiate ia, ko ʻenau ʻilo kuo mate ia.
Pea ne tuku ʻakinautolukotoa pēkituʻa, pea puke hono nima, ʻo ne ui, ʻo pehē, “Taʻahine, tuʻu hake.”
Pea naʻe toe haʻu ʻa hono laumālie, pea tuʻu hake leva ia: pea ne fekau ke ʻatu haʻane meʻakai.
Pea ofo ai ʻa ʻene mātuʻa: ka naʻe fekau ʻe ia kiate kinaua ke ʻoua naʻa na fakahāki ha taha ʻaia kuo fai.
9: PEA naʻe toki ui ia ke fakataha ʻene kau ākonga ʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ua, pea ne tuku kiate kinautoluʻae mālohi mo e pule ki he kau tēvolo kotoa pē, pea ke fakamoʻui ʻae ngaahi mahaki.
Pea ne fekau atu ʻakinautoluke malangaʻaki ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, mo fakamoʻui ʻae mahaki.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOua naʻa ʻave ha meʻa ʻi hoʻomou fononga, ʻae ngaahi tokotoko, pea ha kato, pe ha mā, pe ha paʻanga; pe te mou taki ua ʻae kofutuʻa.
Pea ko e fale ko ia te mou hūki ai, mou nofo ai, pea toki ʻalu ai.
Pea ko e potu ko ia ʻe ʻikai te nau maʻu ʻakimoutoluʻi ai, ʻoka mou ka ʻalu ʻi he kolo ko ia, mou tūtuuʻi ʻae efu ʻi homou vaʻe ko e fakamoʻoni kiate kinautolu.”
Pea naʻa nau ʻalu, ʻo fononga ʻi he ngaahi potu kakai, pea malangaʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei, mo nau fakamoʻui ʻi he potu kotoa pē.
¶Pea naʻe fanongo ʻa Helota ko e tuʻi ki he meʻa kotoa pēkuo fai ʻe ia: pea naʻa ne puputuʻu ai, koeʻuhi naʻe pehēʻe he niʻihi, “Kuo toetuʻu ʻa Sione mei he mate.”
Peapehēʻe he niʻihi, “Kuo hāmai ʻa ʻIlaisiā; mo e niʻihi, Kuo toetuʻu ha taha ʻi he kau palōfita motuʻa.”
Pea pehēʻe Helota, “Kuo u tutuʻu ʻae ʻulu ʻo Sione; ka ko hai eni, ʻoku ou fanongo ki ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni?”Pea ne ne holi ke mamata kiate ia.
¶Pea kuo liu mai ʻae kau ʻaposetolo, pea nau fakahākotoa pēkiate ia ʻaia kuo nau fai. Pea naʻa ne ʻave ʻakinautolu, ʻo afe fakafufūki he potu lala ʻoe kolo ʻoku ui ko Petesaita.
Pea kuo ʻiloiaʻe he kakai, naʻa nau muimuikiate ia: pea ne maʻu ʻakinautolu, ʻo ne lea kiate kinautolu, ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, pea naʻe fakamoʻui ʻakinautoluʻaia naʻe ʻaonga ke fakamoʻui.

Pea kuo tei ʻosi ʻae ʻaho, pea haʻu ʻae toko hongofulu ma toko ua, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “Fekau ke ʻalu ʻae kakai, koeʻuhi ke nau ōki he ngaahi potu kakai mo e ngaahi nofoʻanga kakai ofi mai, ʻo mohe ai, pea maʻu ai ʻae meʻa kai; he ʻoku tau ʻi heni ko e potu lala.”

Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Mou ʻatu ha meʻakai kiate kinautolu.”Pea naʻa nau pehēange, “ʻOku ʻikai haʻatau meʻa ka ko e foʻi māʻe nima mo e ika ʻe ua, ʻo kapau ʻe ʻikai te mau ō, ʻo fakatau meʻakai māʻae kakai ni kotoa pē.”
He naʻe toko nima afe nai ʻae tangata. Pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Pule ke nau nofo hifo ʻo tautau toko nimangofulu.”
Pea naʻa nau fai ia, mo pule ke nau nofo hifo kotoa pē.
Pea toʻo ʻe ia ʻae foʻi māʻe nima mo e ika ʻe ua, pea hanga hake ia ki he langi, ʻo ne tāpuaki ia, mo tofitofi, ʻo ʻatu ki he kau ākonga ke tufakiki he kakai.
Pea naʻa nau kai ʻo mākona ai kotoa pē: pea naʻe tānaki ʻae toenga kai naʻe toe kiate kinautolu, pea pito ai ʻae kato ʻe hongofulu ma ua.
¶Pea naʻe pehē, ʻi heʻene lotu tokotaha pe, kuo ʻalu ange ʻene kau ākonga: pea fehuʻi ia kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku pehēʻe he kakai, ko hai au?”
Pea naʻa nau lea, ʻo pehēange, “Ko Sione ko e Papitaiso;”kaepehēʻe he niʻihi, “Ko ʻIlaisiā;”peapehēʻe he niʻihi, “Kuo toetuʻu ha taha ʻi he kau palōfita motuʻa.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu. “Ka ʻoku pehēʻekimoutoluko hai au?”Pea lea ʻa Pita, ʻo pehēange, “Koe Kalaisi koe ʻoe ʻOtua.”
Pea ne naʻinaʻi mālohi mo fekau ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ke ʻoua naʻa fakahāʻae meʻa ko ia ki ha taha;

‌ʻO ne pehē, “ʻE kātaki ʻe he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi, pea ʻe siʻaki ia ʻe he kau mātuʻa pea mo e kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi, pea ʻe tāmateʻi ia, pea toe fokotuʻu ʻi hono ʻaho tolu.”
¶Pea ne pehēkiate kinautolukotoa pē, “Kapau ʻe muimuiha taha kiate au, tuku ke siʻaki ia ʻe ia, pea toʻo hake ʻene ʻakau māfasia ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē, pea muimuiʻiate au.
He ko ia ʻe kalofaki ʻene moʻui, ʻe mole ia; ka ko ia ʻe mole ʻene moʻui koeʻuhi ko au, ko iapeʻe maʻu ia.
He ko e hāhono ʻaonga ki he tangata, ʻo kapau ʻe maʻu ʻe ia ʻa māmani kotoa pē, kae mole ia, pe liaki ia?
He ko ia ʻe māʻiate au mo ʻeku ngaahi lea, ʻe māai ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata, ʻoka haʻu ia ʻi hono nāunau ʻoʻona, mo ʻene Tamai, pea mo e kau ʻāngelo māʻoniʻoni.
Ka ʻoku ou tala moʻoni atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku tutuʻu ʻae niʻihi ʻi heni, ʻe ʻikai te nau kamata ʻae mate, kaeʻoua ke nau mamata ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
¶Hili ʻae ngaahi lea ni, ko e ʻaho nai ʻe valu, naʻe ʻave ʻe ia ʻa Pita mo Sione mo Semisi, pea nau ōhake ki he moʻunga ke lotu.
Pea ʻi heʻene lotu, naʻe fakafoʻou ʻae anga ʻo hono fofonga, pea naʻe hinehina ʻo ngingila hono ngaahi kofu.
Pea vakai, naʻe alea mo ia ʻae tangata ʻe toko ua, ʻaia ko Mōsese mo ʻIlaisiā:
‌ʻO na hāmai ʻi he nāunau, ʻonau alea ki heʻene pekia, ʻaia te ne fai ʻi Selūsalema.
Ka ko Pita mo kinaua naʻe ʻiate ia naʻa nau māfasia ʻi hefiemohe: pea ʻi heʻenau ʻā, naʻa nau mamata ki hono nāunau, pea mo e ongo tangata naʻa nau tutuʻu mo ia.

Pea pehē, ʻi he ʻena ʻalu ʻiate ia, naʻe pehēʻe Pita kia Sisu, “ʻEiki, ʻoku lelei ʻetau ʻi heni: pea tuku ke mau ngaohi ha fale ʻe tolu; ke ʻoʻou ʻae taha, pea taha ʻo Mōsese, pea taha ʻo ʻIlaisiā:”ka naʻe ʻikai ʻilo ʻe ia ʻene lea.
Pea lolotonga ʻene lea pehē, naʻe fakamalūʻaki ʻakinautoluʻae ʻao: pea naʻa nau manavahēʻi heʻenau hūki he ʻao.
Pea naʻe ongo mai ʻae leʻo mei he ʻao, ʻo pehē, “Ko hoku ʻAlo ʻofaʻanga eni: fanongo kiate ia.”
Pea hili ʻae lea, naʻe ʻilo ʻa Sisu ʻoku tokotaha pe. Pea naʻa nau fufūeni, ʻo ʻikai fakahāki ha tokotaha, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, ha meʻa ʻe taha kuo nau mamata ki ai.
¶Pea pehē, ʻi he pongipongi hake, naʻa nau ʻalu hifo mei he moʻunga, pea fakafetaulakikiate ia ʻae fuʻu kakai,
Pea vakai, naʻe kalanga mai ʻae tangata ʻi he kakai, ʻo pehē, “ʻE ʻEiki, ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke vakai ki hoku foha: he ko ʻeku tamasiʻi tokotaha pe ia.
Pea vakai, ʻoku puke ia ʻe he laumālie, pea fokifāʻoku tangi kalanga ia; pea ʻoku ne haeʻi ke koāai ia, pea ʻoku ne haʻaki ia, pea ʻalu ai ʻi he taʻefieʻalu.”
Pea ne u kole ki hoʻo kau ākonga ke kapusi ia; ka naʻe ʻikai te nau faʻa fai.
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange, “ʻAe toʻutangata taʻetui mo angakovi, ʻe fēfēhono fuoloaʻo ʻetau nonofo, mo ʻeku kātaki ʻakimoutolu? ʻOmi ho foha ki heni.”
Pea ʻi heʻene haʻu, naʻe haʻaki ia ʻe he tēvolo, mo haeʻi. Pea naʻe tautea ʻe Sisu ʻae laumālie ʻuli, mo fakamoʻui ʻae tamasiʻi, ʻo toe ʻatu ia ki heʻene tamai.
¶Pea naʻa nau ofo kotoa pēʻi he māfimafi lahi ʻoe ʻOtua. Ka ʻi heʻenau ofo kotoa pēʻi he meʻa fulipēnaʻe fai ʻe Sisu, pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau ākonga,
“Tuku ke ongo ki ho ʻoʻou telinga ʻae ngaahi lea ko eni: ʻe tukuangeʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ki he nima ʻoe kakai.”
Ka naʻe ʻikai te nau ʻilo ʻae lea ni, pea naʻe fufūia meiate kinautolu, pea ʻikai ai te nau ʻilo ia: pea naʻa nau manavahēke fehuʻi kiate ia ʻi he lea ko ia.
¶Pea naʻe tupu ʻiate kinautoluʻae fakakikihi, pe ko hai ʻe lahi ʻiate kinautolu.
Pea ʻiloʻi ʻe Sisu ʻae mahalo ʻa honau loto, pea toʻo mai ʻe ia ʻae tamasiʻi, ʻo tuku ia ke ofi kiate ia,

‌ʻO ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko ia ia ʻe maʻu ʻae tamasiʻi ni ʻi hoku huafa, ʻoku ne maʻu au; pea ko ia ia ʻoku ne maʻu au, ʻoku ne maʻu ʻaia naʻa ne fekau au: he ko ia ʻoku siʻi ʻiate kimoutolukotoa pē, ko ia ia ʻe lahi.”
¶Pea lea ʻa Sione, ʻo pehēange, “ʻEiki, naʻa mau mamata ki ha taha ʻoku kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ʻi ho huafa; pea naʻa mau taʻofi ia, he ʻoku ʻikai ke muimuiia mo kimautolu.”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “ʻOua naʻa taʻofi: he ko ia ʻoku ʻikai angatuʻu kiate kitautoluʻoku kau ia mo kitautolu.”
Pea pehē, ʻi he ofi ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ke maʻu hake ai ia ki ʻolunga, naʻa ne fakahangatonu hono fofonga ke ʻalu ki Selūsalema,
‌ʻO ne fekau ʻe ia ʻae kau fakamelomelo ke muʻomuʻa ʻi hono ʻao: pea naʻa nau ō, ʻo hūki he potu kakai ʻo Samēlia, ke teuteuaikiate ia.
Ka naʻe ʻikai te nau maʻu ia, koeʻuhi naʻe hanga hono mata ʻo hangēka ʻalu ia ki Selūsalema.
Pea kuo mamata ki ai ʻene ākonga ko Semisi mo Sione, pea na pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻe lelei kiate koe ke ma fekau hifo ʻae afi mei he langi, ʻo fakaʻauha ʻakinautolu, ʻo hangēko ia naʻe fai ʻe ʻIlaisiā?”
Ka naʻe tangaki ia ki mui, ʻo valoki ʻakinaua, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai siʻi te mo ʻilo ʻae anga ʻo homo loto.
He naʻe ʻikai haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ke fakaʻauha ʻae moʻui ʻae kakai, ka ke fakamoʻui.”Pea naʻa nau ōki he potu kakai ʻe taha.
¶Pea ʻi heʻenau ōʻi he hala, naʻe pehēʻe he tokotaha kiate ia, “ʻEiki, te u muimuikiate koe ʻi he potu kotoa pēte ke ʻalu ki ai.”
Ka naʻe pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “ʻOku maʻu ʻe he fanga fokisi ʻae tafu, pea ʻoku ʻi he fanga manu ʻoe ʻatāʻae moheʻanga; ka ʻoku ʻikai ʻi he Foha ʻoe tangata ha potu ke tokoto ai hono ʻulu.”
Pea pehēʻe ia ki ha taha kehe, “Muimuimai kiate au.”Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia, “ʻEiki, tuku au ke u tomuʻa ʻalu ʻo tanu ʻeku tamai.”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Tuku ke tanu ʻe he mate honau mate; ka ke ʻalu koe ʻo malangaʻaki ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
Pea naʻe pehēfoki ʻe he tokotaha, “ʻEiki, te u muimuikiate koe; kae tuku au ke u tomuʻa ʻalu ʻo feʻiloaki mo kinautoluʻi hoku fale.”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “ʻOku ʻikai ha taha kuo ʻai hono nima ki he huo toho, kae sio ki mui, ʻe ʻaonga ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
10: PEA hili ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, naʻe fakanofo ʻe he ʻEiki ʻae toko fitungofulu kehe, ʻo ne fekau ke nau ō, ʻo tautau toko ua, ke muʻomuʻa ʻiate ia ki he kolo mo e potu kotoa pēʻe ʻalu ia ki ai.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku lahi ʻae taʻu, kae tokosiʻi ʻae kau ngāue: ko ia mou kole ai ki he ʻEiki ʻoe taʻu, ke ne fekau atu ʻae kau ngāue ki heʻene taʻu.
Mou ō: pea vakai, ʻoku ou tuku atu ʻakimoutoluʻo hangēko e fanga lami ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe fangaulofi.
‌ʻOua naʻa toʻo ha kato paʻanga, pe ha kato kai pe ha topuvaʻe; pea ʻoua ʻe fetapa ki ha taha ʻi he hala.
Pea ko e fale ko ia te mou hūki ai, mou tomuʻa lea, ‘Ke ʻi he fale ni ʻae fiemālie.’
Pea kapau ʻe ʻi ai ʻae foha ʻoe fiemālie, ʻe hoko ki ai hoʻomou fakafiemālie; pea kapau ʻe ʻikai, ʻe toe hoko ia kiate kimoutolu.
Pea mou nofo ʻi he fale ko ia, ʻo kai mo inu ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa tenau ʻomi; he ʻoku taau mo e tangata ngāue ke ne maʻu haʻane tauhi. Pea ʻoua naʻa fehufakiki he ngaahi fale.
Pea ko e kolo ko ia te mou hūki ai, pea nau maʻu ʻakimoutolu, mou kai ʻae ngaahi meʻa te nau ʻomi kiate kimoutolu.
Pea fakamoʻui ʻae mahaki ʻi ai, pea mou pehēkiate kinautolu, ‘Kuo ofi ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua kiate kimoutolu.’
Ka ko e kolo te mou hūki ai, pea ʻikai te nau maʻu ʻakimoutolu, mou ōki hono ngaahi hala, ʻo leapehē,
‘Naʻa mo e efu ʻo hoʻomou kolo, ʻaia ʻoku pikitai kiate kimautolu, ʻoku mau tūtuuʻiiakiate kimoutolu: ka mou ʻilo pau ʻae meʻa ni, kuo hoko ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua kiate kimoutolu.’
Ka ʻoku ou pehēkiate kimoutolu, ʻE kātakingofua ʻa Sotoma ʻi he ʻaho ko ia, ʻi he kolo ko ia.

“ʻE malaʻia ʻa koe, Kolesini! ʻE malaʻia ʻa koe, Petesaita! He ka ne fai ʻi Taia mo Saitoni ʻae ngaahi ngāue lahi kuo fai ʻiate kimoutolu, pehē, kuo loa ʻenau fakatomala, ʻonau nofo mo e tauangaʻa ʻi he efuefu.
Ka ʻe kātakingofua ʻa Taia mo Saitoni ʻae fakamaau, ʻiate kimoutolu.
Pea ko koe, Kapaneume, ʻa koe kuo hiki ki he langi, ʻe fakahifo koe ki heli.
Ko ia ʻoku fanongo kiate kimoutolu, ʻoku fanongo ia kiate au; pea ko ia ʻoku ne liʻaki ʻakimoutolu, ʻoku ne liʻaki au; pea ko ia ʻoku ne liʻaki au, ʻoku ne liʻaki ia kuo ne fekau au.”
¶Pea naʻe liliu mai ʻae toko fitungofulu ʻi he fiefia, mo nau pehē, “ʻEiki, kuo vaivai ʻae kau tēvolo kiate kimautoluʻi ho huafa.”
Pea ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Naʻaku mamata ki he hinga ʻa Sētane ʻo hangēko e ʻuhilamei he langi.
Vakai, ʻoku ou foaki ʻae mālohi kiate kimoutoluke malaki hifo ʻae ngaahi ngata, mo e sikopio, pea mo e mālohi kotoa pēʻoe fili: pea ʻe ʻikai ʻaupitoha meʻa ʻe lavea ai ʻakimoutolu.
Kae ʻoua naʻa fiefia ʻi he meʻa ni, koeʻuhi kuo vaivai ʻae kau laumālie kiate kimoutolu; ka mou fiefia muʻa koeʻuhi kuo tohi homou hingoa ʻi he langi.”

¶Naʻe fiefia ʻa Sisu ʻi hono laumālie ʻi he feituʻulaʻāko ia, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻE Tamai, ko e ʻEiki ʻoe langi mo māmani, ʻoku ou fakafetaʻi kiate koe, ʻi hoʻo fufūʻae ngaahi meʻa ni mei he kau poto mo e fieʻiloʻilo, ka kuo ke fakahāia ki he kau valevale: ke pehē, ʻE Tamai; he ʻoku lelei ia ʻi ho ʻao ke pehē.

Kuo tuku ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pēkiate au ʻe heʻeku Tamai: pea ʻoku ʻikai ke ʻilo ʻe ha taha pe ko hai ʻae ʻAlo, ka ko e Tamaipe; pe ko hai ʻae Tamai, ka ko e ʻAlope, pea mo ia ʻe fakahāia ki ai ʻe he ʻAlo.
Pea naʻe tafoki ia ki heʻene kau ākonga, ʻo lea fufū,ʻo pehē, “ʻOku monūʻia ʻae mata ʻoku mamata ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku mou mamata ki ai:”

He ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, naʻe tokolahi ʻae kau palōfita mo e ngaahi tuʻi naʻe holi ke mamata ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku mou mamata ki ai, ka naʻe ʻikai te nau mamata; pea fanongo ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻoku mou fanongo ki ai, ka naʻe ʻikai te nau fanongoai.
¶Pea vakai, naʻe tuʻu hake ʻae akonaki ʻi he fono, ʻo ʻahiʻahi kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ko e hāte u fai ke maʻu ai ʻae moʻui taʻengata?”
Pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Ko e hākuo tohi ʻi he fono? ʻOku fēfēhaʻo lau?”
Pea lea ia, ʻo ne pehēange, “|‘Ke ke ʻofa kia Sihova ko ho ʻOtua ʻaki ho loto kotoa, mo ho laumālie kotoa, mo ho ʻatamai kotoa; pea ki ho kaungāʻapi, ʻo hangēpe ko koe.’|”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “Kuo ke lea totonu: fai eni, pea te ke moʻui.”
Ka ʻi heʻene fie fakatonuhia ia, naʻa ne pehēkia Sisu, “Ko hai hoku kaungāʻapi?”

Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange, “Ko e tangata ʻe tokotaha naʻe ʻalu hifo mei Selūsalema ki Seliko, pea moʻua ia ki he kau kaihaʻa, pea naʻa nau vete ʻiate ia ʻa hono ngaahi kofu, mo taaʻi ia, pea nau ʻalu mei ai kuo ne mei mate.
Mo ʻene ʻalu ange ha taulaʻeiki ʻi he hala ko ia; pea mamata ia ki ai, pea ne ʻalu ki he kau hala ʻe taha.
Pea mo ha Livaite foki, kuo hoko ia ki he potu, pea haʻu ʻo mamata, pea ʻalu ia ki he kau hala ʻe taha.
Ka naʻe fononga ha tangata Samēlia, pea hoko ia ki he potu naʻe ʻi ai ia: pea kuo mamata ia ki ai, pea ne manavaʻofa lahi,
‌ʻO ne ʻalu ange, ʻo nonoʻo hono lavea, pea lilingi ki ai ʻae lolo mo euaine, pea ne fakaheka ia ki heʻene manu, ʻo ne ʻomi ia ki he fale talifononga, ʻo ne tauhi ia.

Pea pongipongi ai, ʻi heʻene ʻalu, naʻe toʻo ʻe ia ʻae tenali ʻe ua, ʻo ʻatu ki he matāpule, ʻo ne pehēki ai, ‘Ke ke tauhi ia; pea ko ia kotoa pēte ke toe angemaʻana, te u totongi kiate koe, ʻo kau ka toe haʻu.’
‌ʻOku ke mahalo, Ko hai ʻi he toko tolu ni naʻe kaungāʻapi kiate ia naʻe moʻua ki he kau kaihaʻa?”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko ia ia ne ne fai ʻofa kiate ia.”Pea pehēange ʻe Sisu kiate ia, “ʻAlu koe, pea ke fai pehēpe.”
¶Pea pehē, kuo nau fononga, pea ne hoko ki he potu kakai ʻe taha, pea ko e fefine ko Māʻata hono hingoa, ne ne maʻu ia ki hono fale.
Pea naʻe ai ʻa hono tokoua naʻe ui ko Mele, naʻe nofo foki ia ʻi he vaʻe ʻo Sisu, ʻo fanongo ki heʻene lea.
Ka kuo femouʻekina ʻa Māʻata ʻi he tauhi lahi, pea ne haʻu kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻoku ʻikai te ke tokanga kuo liʻaki au ʻe hoku tokoua ke u ngāue tokotaha pe? Ko ia ke ke fekau ia ke tokoni au.”
Pea tala ʻe Sisu, ʻo ne pehēange kiate ia, “Māʻata, Māʻata, ʻoku ke femouʻekina mo fetokangaʻaki ʻi he ngaahi meʻa lahi:
ka ko e meʻa pe taha ʻoku ʻaonga: pea kuo fili ʻe Mele ʻae meʻa lelei, ʻaia ʻe ʻikai toʻo meiate ia.”
11: PEA naʻe pehē, naʻe lotu ia ʻi he potu ʻe taha, pea hili ia, naʻe pehēʻe he tokotaha ʻo ʻene kau ākonga kiate ia, “ʻEiki, akonakiʻi ʻakimautoluke lotu, ʻo hangēko e ako ʻa Sione ki heʻene kau ākonga.”

Pea ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “ʻOka mou ka lotu, mou pehē,
Ko ʻemau Tamai ʻoku ʻi he langi,
Ke tāpuhāho huafa.
Ke hoko mai hoʻo pule.
Ke fai ʻa māmani ki ho finangalo, ʻo hangēʻi he langi.
Ke foaki mai kiate kimautoluhaʻamau meʻakai ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko hai ʻiate kimoutoluʻe ai hano kāinga, ʻe ʻalu atu kiate ia ʻi he tuʻuapō, ʻo pehēki ai, ‘Kāinga, ko ʻeku nōʻae foʻi māʻe tolu;
He ko e kāinga ʻoʻoku kuo haʻu kiate au ʻi he fononga, pea ʻoku ʻikai haʻaku meʻa ke tuku ki hono ʻao?’
Pea ʻe lea mai ʻaia ʻoku ʻi loto fale, ʻo pehē, ‘ʻOua te ke fakafiuʻi au; kuo tāpuni ʻae matapā, pea kuo mau ʻi he mohenga mo ʻeku fānau; ʻe ʻikai te u faʻa tuʻu hake ʻo foaki kiate koe.’

‌ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai tuʻu hake ia ʻo foaki ai, koeʻuhi ko hono kāinga ia, ka ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene kole tāumaʻu, ʻe tuʻu hake ai ia, ʻo foaki kiate ia ʻo fakatatau mo ʻene masiva.
“Pea ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Kole, pea ʻe foaki kiate kimoutolu; kumi, pea te mou ʻilo; tukituki, pea ʻe toʻo kiate kimoutolu.
He ko ia ʻoku kole, ʻoku ne maʻu; pea ko ia ʻoku kumi, ʻoku ne ʻilo; pea ʻe toʻo kiate ia ʻoku tukituki.
Ko e tamai fēʻiate kimoutolu, kapau ʻe kole māʻa hono foha, te ne ʻange ki ai ha maka? Pe ko e ika, ʻe tuku ʻae ika kae ʻatu ki ai ha ngata?
Pe ʻi heʻene kole ʻae foʻi manu, te ne ʻatu ki ai ha sikopio?

Ko ia kapau ʻoku mou ʻilo, ka ko e angakovi, ke foaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei ki hoʻomou fānau; ʻe fēfēhono lahi hake ʻoefiefoaki ʻe he Tamai ʻi he langi ʻae Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni kiate kinautoluʻoku kole kiate ia?”
¶Pea naʻe kapusi ʻae tēvolo, ʻaia naʻe noa. Pea ʻi heʻene ʻalu kituʻa ʻae tēvolo, naʻe lea ʻae noa; pea ofoaiʻae kakai.
Ka naʻe pehēʻe honau niʻihi, “ʻOku ne kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ia Pelisipupe ko e ʻeiki ʻoe kau tēvolo.”
Pea ʻahiʻahi ʻe he niʻihi, ʻonau kumi ʻiate ia ha fakaʻilonga mei he langi.
Ka naʻe ʻilo ʻe ia ʻenau mahalo, pea ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko e puleʻanga kotoa pēʻoku feʻiteʻitani,ʻe ʻauha ia; pea ko e fale ʻoku feʻiteʻitani, ʻe holo ia.
Pea kapau ʻe feʻiteʻitani ʻa Sētane kiate ia, ʻe tuʻu fēfēhono puleʻanga? He ʻoku mou pehēʻoku ou kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ia Pelisipupe.
Pea kapau ʻoku ou kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ʻia Pelisipupe, ʻoku kapusi ʻakinautoluʻia hai ʻe homou ngaahi foha? Ko ia ko hoʻomou kau fakamaauʻakinautolu.
Pea kapau ʻoku ou kapusi ʻae kau tēvolo ʻaki ʻae louhiʻi nima ʻoe ʻOtua, tākuo hoko moʻoni ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua kiate kimoutolu.
“ʻOka leʻohi hono fale ʻe ha tangata mālohi mo e mahafutau, ʻoku malu pe ʻene ngaahi meʻa:
Ka ʻi he hoko kiate ia ha taha ʻoku mālohi lahi, ʻo ikuʻi ia, ʻoku ne faʻao ʻa ʻene mahafu kotoa pēnaʻe falala ia ki ai, pea tufakiʻene meʻa.
“Ko ia ʻoku ʻikai kau mo au, ʻoku angatuʻu ia kiate au: pea ko ia ʻoku ʻikai te ma tānaki mo au, ʻoku fakahēʻe ia.
“ʻOka ʻalu ʻae laumālie ʻuli ʻi ha tangata, ʻoku ʻalu fano ia ʻi he ngaahi potu mōmoa, ʻo kumi mālōlōʻanga, kae ʻikai ʻiloia; pea pehēʻe ia, ‘Te u toe ʻalu ki hoku fale naʻaku haʻu mei ai.’
Pea ʻi heʻene haʻu, ʻoku ne ʻiloiakuo tafi mo teuteu.
Pea toki ʻalu ai ia, ʻo ʻomi mo e laumālie ʻe toko fitu kehe ʻoku angahala lahi ʻiate ia; pea nau hūʻo nofo ki ai: pea kovi lahi ʻa eangaki mui ʻae tangata ko ia ʻi heʻeneangaʻi muʻa.
¶Pea pehē, naʻe lolotonga ʻene lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, mo e kalanga mai ʻae fefine mei he kakai, ʻo ne pehēkiate ia, “ʻOku monūʻia ʻae manāva naʻa ne fua ʻaki koe, pea mo e huhu naʻa ke huhūai.”
Ka naʻe pehēʻe ia, “ʻIo, ka ʻoku monūʻia lahi hake ʻakinautoluʻoku nau fanongo ki he folofola ʻae ʻOtua, pea fai ki ai.”

¶Pea kuo lolofi mai ʻae kakai tokolahi, pea fua lea ia,ʻo pehē, “Ko e toʻutangata angakovi eni; ʻoku nau kumi ʻae fakaʻilonga; ka ʻe ʻikai ha fakaʻilonga ʻe tuku ki ai, ka ko e fakaʻilonga ʻoe palōfita ko Siona.
‌ʻO hangēko e fakaʻilonga ʻa Siona ki he kakai Ninive, ʻe pehēfoki ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ki he toʻutangata ni.

‌ʻE tuʻu hake ʻae tuʻi-fefine ʻoe feituʻu tonga ʻi he fakamaau mo e kakai ʻoe toʻutangata ni, ʻo fakahalaʻia ia; he naʻe haʻu ia mei he potu mamaʻo ʻo māmani ke fanongo ki he poto ʻa Solomone; pea vakai, ʻoku ʻi heni ʻaia ʻoku lahi ʻia Solomone.
‌ʻE tuʻu hake ʻae kakai ʻo Ninive ʻi he fakamaau mo e toʻutangata ni, ʻo fakahalaʻia ia: he naʻa nau fakatomala ʻi he malanga ʻa Siona; pea vakai, ʻoku ʻi heni ʻaia ʻoku lahi ʻia Siona.
“ʻOku ʻikai ha taha te ne tutu ha maama, pea tukuiaki ha potu lilo, pe ʻi he lalo puha fua, ka ki he tuʻunga, koeʻuhi ke mamata ki he maama ʻakinautoluʻoku hūki ai.
Ko e maama ʻoe sino ʻae mata: ko ia kapau ʻe haohaoa ho mata, ʻe pito foki ho sino kotoa ʻi he maama; ko ia kapau ʻoku koviho mata, ʻe fonu foki ho sino ʻi he poʻuli.
Ko ia vakai naʻa hoko ʻae maama ʻoku ʻiate koe koe poʻuli.
Ko ia kapau ʻe māmangia ho sino kotoa, pea taʻefakapoʻuli hano potu, ʻe māmangia kotoa pē, ʻo hangēko e fakamaama ʻaki koe ʻae fuʻu ulo ʻoe maama.”
¶Pea lolotonga ʻene lea, mo ʻene kole ʻae Fālesi ʻe tokotaha kiate ia ke na kai mo ia: pea ʻalu ia ki ai, ʻo nofo hifo ke kai.
Pea ofo ʻae Fālesi ʻi heʻene mamata naʻe ʻikai te ne tomuʻa fanofano, pea toki kai.
Pea pehēʻe he ʻEiki kiate ia, “Ko eni ʻakimoutolu, ʻae kau Fālesi, ʻoku mou fakamaʻa ʻae tuʻa ipu inu mo e ipu kai, ka ʻoku fonu homou loto ʻi he fakamālohi mo e angakovi.
‌ʻAe kau vale, ʻikai ko ia pe naʻa ne ngaohi ʻaia ʻoku ʻituʻa, naʻe ngaohi foki ʻaia ʻoku ʻi loto?
Ka mou foaki muʻa ʻae ngaahi meʻaʻofa mei he meʻa ʻoku mou maʻu; pea vakai, ʻoku maʻa ʻae meʻa kotoa pēkiate kimoutolu.

“Kae malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ʻae kau Fālesi! He ʻoku mou tukuhau ʻi he mini mo e pekano mo e ngaahi ʻakau iiki kotoa pē, ka ʻoku mou taʻetokanga ki he fakamaau mo e ʻofa ki he ʻOtua: naʻe totonu ke fai eni, kaeʻoua naʻa liʻaki ʻena.
“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ʻae kau Fālesi! He ʻoku mou manako ki he ngaahi nofoʻanga māʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi falelotu, mo e fetapa ʻi he ngaahi potu fakatau.
‌ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ʻae kau tangata tohi mo e Fālesi, ko e mālualoi! He ʻoku mou tatau mo e ngaahi faʻitoka ʻoku ʻikai hāmai, pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻiloiaʻe he kakai ʻoku ʻeveʻeva ai.”
¶Pea toki lea mai ʻae tokotaha ʻoe kau akonaki ʻi he fono, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “ʻEiki, ʻi hoʻo pehēmai, ʻoku ke valoki ai ʻakimautolufoki.”

Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolufoki, ʻae kau akonaki ʻi he fono! He ʻoku mou hili ki he kakai ʻae ngaahi kavenga ʻoku fakamamahi hono fua, ka ʻoku ʻikai ala ʻekimoutoluhaʻamou tuhu ʻe taha ki he ngaahi kavenga.
‌ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu! He ʻoku mou langa ʻae ngaahi fonualoto ʻoe kau palōfita, ʻakinautolunaʻe tāmateʻi ʻe hoʻomou ngaahi tamai.
Ko e moʻoni ʻoku mou fakamoʻoni ʻoku mou leleiʻia ʻi he faianga ʻo hoʻomou ngaahi tamai: he naʻa nau tāmateʻi ʻakinautolu, pea ʻoku mou langa honau ngaahi fonualoto.
Ko ia naʻe pehēai foki ʻae poto ʻae ʻOtua, ‘Te u fekau atu kiate kinautoluʻae kau palōfita mo e kau ʻaposetolo, pea ko honau niʻihi te nau tāmateʻi mo fakatanga:’
Koeʻuhi ke ʻeke ki he toʻutangata ni ʻae toto ʻoe kau palōfita kotoa pē, ʻaia naʻe lilingi talu mei he tupuʻanga ʻo māmani;

Mei he toto ʻo ʻEpeli, ʻo aʻu ki he toto ʻo Sakalaia, ʻaia naʻe tāmateʻi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻoe ʻesifeilaulau mo e potu toputapu: ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻeke ia mei he toʻutangata ni.
“ʻE malaʻia ʻakimoutolu, ʻae kau akonaki ʻi he fono! He kuo mou ʻave ʻae ki ʻoe ʻilo, pea ʻoku ʻikai te mou hūki ai ʻakimoutolu, pea ko kinautolunaʻe teu ke hūki ai naʻa mou taʻofi.”
Pea ʻi heʻene lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kiate kinautolu, naʻe kamata fai fakamatalili mo langaʻi ia ʻe he kau tangata tohi mo e kau Fālesi, ke ne lea ki he ngaahi meʻa lahi:
‌ʻO nau lamasi, mo kumi ke femioʻekina ia mei hono ngutu, koeʻuhi ke nau talatalaakiʻi ia.
12: PEA feʻunga mo ia, kuo fakakātoa ʻae fuʻu kakai taʻefaʻalaua, ʻonau femalakiʻaki ʻakinautolu, pea kamata lea ai ia, ʻo fuofuafai ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Mou vakai telia ʻae meʻa fakatupu ʻae kau Fālesi, ʻaia ko e mālualoi.
He ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻoku ʻufiʻufi, ʻe taʻefakahā; pe fufū, ʻe taʻeʻiloa ia.
Pea ko ia kotoa pēkuo mou lea ʻaki ʻi he poʻuli, ʻe fanongo ia ʻi he maama; pea ko ia kuo mou fanafana ʻaki ʻi he ngaahi loki, ʻe kalangaekina ia mei he tuʻa fale.”
“Pea ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutoluko hoku kāinga, “ʻOua te mou manavahēkiate kinautoluʻoku tāmateʻi ʻae sino, pea hili ia ʻoku ʻikai mo ha meʻa te nau faʻa fai.
Ka te u fakahākiate kimoutoluʻaia te mou manavahēki ai: manavahēkiate ia, ʻa ia, ʻoka hili ʻene tāmateʻi, ʻoku ne faʻa fai ke līki heli; ʻio, ʻoku ou pehēkiate kimoutolu, manavahēkiate ia.
“ʻIkai ʻoku fakatau ʻae kihiʻi manupunaʻe nima ʻaki ʻae paʻanga siʻi ʻe ua? Pea ʻoku ʻikai ngalo hanau taha ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua.
Ka ko e ngaahi tuʻoni louʻulu ʻo homou ʻulu kuo lau kotoa pē. Ko ia ʻoua ʻe manavahē:heʻoku mou mahuʻinga hake ʻi he fanga kihiʻi manu lahi.
“ʻOku ou tala foki kiate kimoutolu, Ko ia ia te ne fakahāau ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai, ʻe fakahāfoki ia ʻe he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kau ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua.
Ka ko ia ʻoku ne siʻaki au ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai, ʻe siʻaki ia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kau ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua.
“Pea ko ia ʻe lea kovi ki he Foha ʻoe tangata, ʻe fakamolemole ia kiate ia; ka ko ia ʻoku ne lohiakiʻi ʻae Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni, ʻe ʻikai fakamolemolea ia.
“Pea ka nau ka ʻomi ʻakimoutoluki he ngaahi falelotu, mo e kau fakamaau, mo e kau pule, ʻoua naʻa mou feinga pe fēfēpe ko e hāte mou tali ʻaki, pe ko ia te mou fakahā:
Koeʻuhi ʻe ako ʻe he Laumālie Māʻoniʻoni kiate kimoutoluʻi he feituʻulaʻāko ia, ʻaia ʻoku totonu kemoulea ʻaki.”
¶Pea naʻe pehēʻe he tokotaha ʻoe kakai kiate ia, “ʻEiki, ke ke leaange ki hoku tokoua ke ma vaeua mo au ʻae tofiʻa.”
Pea pehēʻe ia ki ai, “Tangata, Ko hai ne ne fakanofo au ko e fakamaau pe ko e tufakikiate kimoutolu?”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Tokanga pea vakai, telia ʻae manumanu: he ko e moʻui ʻae tangata ʻoku ʻikai ʻi hono lahi ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ne maʻu.”
Pea naʻa ne lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātākiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “Naʻe fua ʻo lahi ʻaupitoʻae fonua ʻoe tangata koloaʻia ʻe tokotaha:
Pea fifili ia ʻi hono loto, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko e hāte u fai, he ʻoku ʻikai ha potu ke fetuku ki ai ʻeku ngaahi fua?’
Pea ne pehē, ‘Te u fai eni: te u vete hifo ʻa hoku ngaahi feleoko, ʻo langa ke lalahi; pea teu fetuku ki ai ʻa ʻeku ngaahi fua kotoa pēmo ʻeku koloa.
Pea te u pehēki hoku laumālie, “Laumālie, kuo fokotuʻumaʻu ʻae ngaahi meʻa lelei lahi ki he taʻu lahi; ke ke fiemālie pe, ʻo kai, mo inu, mo fiefia.”|’
Ka naʻe pehēʻe he ʻOtua kiate ia, ‘Ko e vale koe, ʻe toʻo ʻiate koe ʻi he poōni ʻa ho laumālie: peaʻe hokoko e ngaahi meʻa ʻa hai ʻaia kuo ke tokonaki?’
“Pea ʻoku pehēia ʻaia ʻoku ne fokotuʻu koloa maʻana, ka ʻoku ʻikai maʻumeʻa ki he ʻOtua.”
¶Pea pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Ko ia ʻoku ou pehēai kiate kimoutolu, ʻoua naʻa mou tokanga ki hoʻomou moʻui, ki ha meʻa te mou kai; pe ki he sino, pe ko e hāte mou ʻai ki ai.
‌ʻOku lahi hake ʻae moʻui ʻi he meʻakai, mo e sino ʻi he kofu.

Tokanga ki he fanga leveni, he ʻoku ʻikai te nau tūtuuʻi pe tuʻusi; pea ʻoku ʻikai hanau fale koloa, pe feleoko ka ʻoku fafanga ʻe he ʻOtua ʻakinautolupea ʻikai ʻoku mou lelei hake ʻaupitoʻi he fanga manu?
Pea ko hai ia ʻiate kimoutoluʻi heʻene tokanga ʻe faʻa fakalōloa siʻi ki heʻene moʻui?
Pea kapau ʻoku ʻikai te mou mafai ʻaia ʻoku siʻi taha pe, ko e hāʻoku mou tokanga ai ki he meʻa kehe?

Tokanga ki he tupu hake ʻoe fisiʻi ʻakau: ʻoku ʻikai ke nau ngāue, pea ʻoku ʻikai ke filo; ka ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, naʻe ʻikai tatau ʻae teunga ʻo Solomone ʻi hono nāunau fulipēmo ha taha ʻiate kinautoluni.
Ko ia kapau ʻe fakakofu pehēʻe he ʻOtua ʻae mohuku, ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he ngoue he ʻaho ni, kae līki he ngotoʻumu ʻapongipongi; ʻikai ʻe lahi hake kiate kimoutolu, ʻakimoutoluʻoku siʻi hoʻomou tui?
“Pea ʻoua naʻa mou kumi ki ha meʻa te mou kai, mo e meʻa te mou inu, pea ʻoua naʻa mou loto fakataʻetaʻetui.
He ko e meʻa kotoa pēeni ʻoku kumi ki ai ʻe he ngaahi kakai ʻo māmani: pea ʻoku ʻilo ʻe hoʻomou Tamai ʻoku mou masiva ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ni.
Kae kumi muʻa ʻakimoutoluki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua: pea ʻe fakalahi ʻaki kiate kimoutoluʻae ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē.
¶“ʻAe fanga sipi siʻi, ʻOua ʻe manavahēhe ko e finangalo lelei ʻo hoʻomou Tamai ke foaki ʻae puleʻanga kiate kimoutolu.

Fakatau atu ʻaia ʻoku mou maʻu, pea faʻa foaki; tokonaki maʻamoutoluʻae ngaahi kato ʻe ʻikai fakaʻaʻau ke motuʻa, ko e koloa ʻi he langi ʻe ʻikai ʻosi, pea ʻe ʻikai ofi ki ai ha kaihaʻa, pe fakapopoiaʻe he ane.
He ko e potu ʻoku ʻi ai hoʻomou koloa, ʻe ʻi ai foki mo homou loto.
“Tuku ke nonoʻo pe homou noʻotanga vala, pea ulohoʻomoungaahi maama.
Pea ke tatau ʻakimoutolumo e kau tangata ʻoku tatali ki he liliu mai ʻa honau ʻeiki mei he taʻane; koeʻuhi ka haʻu ia ʻo tukituki, ke nau toʻo leva kiate ia.

‌ʻOku monūʻia ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻoka haʻu ʻae ʻeiki pea ne ʻilo ʻoku nau leʻo: ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, te ne nonoʻo ia, ʻo pule ke nau nofo hifo ki he kai, pea haʻu ia ʻo tauhi ʻakinautolu.
Pea kapau ʻe haʻu ia ʻi hono ua ʻoe leʻo, pe haʻu ʻi hono tolu ʻoe leʻo, pea ne ʻilo ʻoku pehēpe, ʻe monūʻia ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki ko ia.
Pea ʻilo eni, ka ne ʻilo ʻe he ʻeiki ʻoe fale ʻa e feituʻupōko ia ʻe haʻu ai ʻae kaihaʻa,pehē, ne leʻo ia, ka ʻe ʻikai tuku ke hae hono fale.
Ko ia mou teuteu pe foki: he ko e feituʻulaʻāʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻamanaki ki ai, ʻe haʻu ai ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata.”
¶Pea toki pehēʻe Pita kiate ia, “ʻEiki, ʻoku ke lea ʻaki mai ʻae fakatātāni kiate kimautolu, pe kihe kakaikotoa pē?”
Pea pehēʻe he ʻEiki, “He ko hai ʻae tauhi angatonu mo poto, ʻe fakanofo ʻe heʻene ʻeiki ke pule ki hono kau nofoʻanga, ke ʻatu ʻae tufakanga ʻi hono feituʻu totonu?
‌ʻE monūʻia ʻae tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻoka haʻu ʻene ʻeiki ʻo ne ʻilo ʻoku fai pehēpe ia.
Ko ʻeku tala moʻoni kiate kimoutolu, Te ne fakanofo ia ke pule ki heʻene meʻa kotoa pē.
Pea ka pehēʻe he tamaioʻeiki ko ia ʻi hono loto, ‘ʻOku fakatuotuai ʻe heʻeku ʻeiki ʻa ʻene haʻu;’pea hanga ia ʻo taaʻi ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki mo e kau kaunanga, pea kai mo inu ke konā:
‌ʻE haʻu ʻae ʻeiki ʻoe tamaioʻeiki ko ia ʻi ha ʻaho ʻe ʻikai ʻamanaki ia ki ai, pea ʻi ha feituʻulaʻāʻe ʻikai tokanga ai ia, ʻo tuʻusi ia, pea tuʻutuʻuni ke ne ʻinasi fakataha mo e taʻetui.
Pea ko e tamaioʻeiki ko ia naʻe ʻilo ʻae loto ʻo ʻene ʻeiki, ka naʻe ʻikai ke teuteu, pe fai ʻo fakatatau mo hono loto, ʻe taaʻi ʻaki ia ʻae ngaahi tālahi.

Ka ko ia naʻe ʻikai ʻiloa, pea fai ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ngali mo e tautea, ʻe taaʻi ʻaki ia ʻae ngaahi tāsiʻi. He ko ia ia kuo tuku ki ai ʻae meʻa lahi, ʻe ʻamanaki lahi ʻiate ia; pea ko ia kuo tuku ki ai ʻe he kakai ʻae meʻa lahi, ʻe lahi ai ʻenau ʻamanaki ʻiate ia.
¶“Kuo u haʻu ke tuku ʻae afi ki māmani; pea ko e hāhoku loto, ʻo kapau kuo tutu ni ia?
‌ʻOku ai ʻae papitaiso ke u papitaiso ai; pea ʻoku ou feinga kaeʻoua ke fai ia!
‌ʻOku mou mahalo kuo u haʻu ke tuku ʻae melino ki māmani? ʻOku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻIkai; ka ko e mavahevahe:
Ngata heni ʻe feʻiteʻitani ʻae toko nima ʻi he fale pe taha, ko e toko tolu ki he toko ua, mo e toko ua ki he toko tolu.

‌ʻE feʻiteʻitani ʻae tamai ki he foha, mo e foha ki he tamai; ko e faʻēki he taʻahine, mo e taʻahine ki he faʻē; ko e faʻēʻi he fono ki heʻene taʻahine ʻi he fono, mo e taʻahine ʻi he fono ki heʻene faʻēʻi he fono.”
¶Pea naʻa ne pehēfoki ki he kakai, “ʻOka mou ka mamata ki he ʻalu hake ʻae ʻao mei he tokanga laʻā, ʻoku mou pehēleva, ʻOku haʻu ʻae ʻuha; pea ʻoku pehē.
Pea ʻoka angi mai ʻae matangi mei he feituʻu tonga, ʻoku mou pehē, ʻE pupuhapea ʻoku pehē.
‌ʻAe kau mālualoi, ʻoku mou ʻilo ʻae mata ʻoe fonua pea mo e langi; ka ko e hāʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻilo ai ʻae kuongani?
‌ʻIo, pea ko e hāʻoku ʻikai te mou ʻilo ʻekimoutoluʻaia ʻoku totonu?

¶“ʻOka ke ka ʻalu mo ho fili ki he fakamaau, ke ke fai feinga ʻi he hala, koeʻuhi ke ke hao meiate ia, telia naʻa ne ʻave koe ki he fakamaau, pea tukuangeKoe ʻe he fakamaau ki he matāpule pea ʻe līkoe ʻe he matāpule ki he fale fakapōpula.
‌ʻOku ou tala kiate koe, ʻE ʻikai te ke ʻalu mei ai, kaeʻoua ke ke ʻatu ʻae totongi kotoa pē.”
13: NAʻE ʻi ai ʻae niʻihi ʻi he kuongako ia, naʻa nau fakahākiate ia ʻae kau Kāleli, ʻakinautolunaʻe hui ʻaki ʻe Pailato honau toto ʻa ʻenau ngaahi feilaulau.
Pea folofola ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku mou mahalo naʻe angahala lahi ʻae kau Kāleli ko ia ʻi he kakai Kāleli kotoa pē, koeʻuhi naʻe hoko ʻae meʻa pehēkiate kinautolu?
‌ʻOku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku ʻikai: pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou fakatomala, te mou malaʻia kotoa pēfoki.

Pe ko e toko hongofulu ma toko valu ko ia, naʻe taʻomia ʻi he holo ʻae fale leʻo ʻo Seiloame, pea mate ai ʻakinautolu, ʻoku mou mahalo ko e kau angahala lahi taha pe ʻakinautoluʻi he kakai fulipēnaʻe nofo ʻi Selūsalema?
‌ʻOku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku ʻikai: pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou fakatomala, te mou malaʻia kotoa pēfoki.”
¶Pea naʻa ne lea ʻaki foki ʻae fakatātāni; “Naʻe tōʻi he ngoue vaine ʻae tangata ʻe tokotaha ʻae ʻakau ko e fiki; pea haʻu ia ʻo kumi fua mei ai, ka naʻe ʻikai ʻiloia.
Pea toki pehēʻe ia ki he tauhi ngoue vaine, ‘Vakai, ko e taʻu ʻe tolu kuo u haʻu ʻo kumi fua ʻi he ʻakau ko e fiki ni, kae ʻikai ʻiloia: tāhifo ia; ko e hāʻoku ne fakataʻeʻaonga ai ʻae kelekele?’
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, ‘ʻEiki, tuku ai pe ia ʻi he taʻu ni foki, kaeʻoua ke u keli tākai, mo taufetukuki ai.
Heiʻilo ʻe toki fua ia, pea kapau ʻe ʻikai, pea ke toki tāhifo ia.’|”
¶Pea naʻe ako ia ʻi he falelotu ʻe taha ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate.
Pea vakai, naʻe ʻi ai ha fefine naʻe ʻiate ia ʻae laumālie fakamahaki ʻi he taʻu ʻe hongofulu ma valu, pea naʻe mapelu ia ki lalo, pea naʻe ʻikai ʻaupitoke faʻa tuʻu hake ia.
Pea ʻi he mamata ki ai ʻa Sisu, naʻa ne uiia, mo ne pehēkiate ia, “Fefine, kuo veteki koe mei hoʻo mahaki.”
Pea ne hilifaki hono nima kiate ia; pea naʻe toki tuʻu totonu leva ia, mo fakamālōki he ʻOtua.

Pea lea ʻita ange ʻae pule ʻoe falelotu, koeʻuhi naʻe fakamoʻui ʻe Sisu ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate, ʻo ne pehēki he kakai, “ʻOku ono ʻae ʻaho ʻoku totonu ke ngāue ai ʻae kakai: ko ia mou haʻu ai ke mou moʻui, kaeʻoua ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate.”
Pea folofola ange ʻae ʻEiki, ʻo pehēange kiate ia, “Ko e mālualoikoe! ʻIkai ʻoku mou taki taha vete ʻene pulu, pe ko ʻene ʻasi, mei hono tuʻunga, ʻo tatakiiake fakainu, ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate?
Pea ʻe ʻikai lelei ke vete ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate, mei he haʻi ni, ʻae fefine ni, ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻEpalahame ʻaia kuo haʻisia ʻe Sētane, ʻi he taʻu ʻe hongofulu ma valu ni?”
Pea ʻi heʻene lea ʻaki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, naʻe ma hono ngaahi fili kotoa pē; kae fiefia ʻae kakai kotoa pē, koeʻuhi ko e ngaahi meʻa ongoongolelei kotoa pēkuo ne fai.
¶Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻOku tatau mo e hāʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua? Pea te u fakatatau ia ki he hā?
‌ʻOku tatau ia mo e foʻi tengaʻi musita, naʻe toʻo ʻe ha tangata, ʻo līki heʻene ngoue, pea tupu ia, ʻo hoko ko e ʻakau lahi; pea nofo ai ʻae fanga manu ʻoe ʻatāʻi hono ngaahi vaʻa.”
Pea toe pehēʻe ia, “Te u fakatatau ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua ki he hā?
‌ʻOku tatau ia mo e meʻa fakatupu, naʻe toʻo ʻe ha fefine, ʻo fufūʻi he fua mahoaʻa ʻe tolu, ke ʻoua ke fakatupu ʻaki kotoa pēia.”
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu ia ʻi he ngaahi kolo mo e potu kakai, ʻo ako, mo fononga atu ki Selūsalema.
Pea toki pehēʻe he tokotaha kiate ia, “ʻEiki, ko e tokosiʻipete nau moʻui?”Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu,
“Fai feinga ke hūʻi he matapāfāsiʻi: he ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻE kumi ʻe he tokolahi ke hūki ai, kae ʻikai te nau mafai.

Pea ka tuʻu hake ʻae ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ʻo tāpuni ʻae matapā, pea te mou tutuʻu leva ʻi he matapāʻituʻa, ʻo tukituki, mo pehēai, ‘ʻEiki, ʻEiki, toʻo kiate kimautolu;’pea ʻe lea ia, ʻo pehēmai kiate kimoutolu, ‘ʻOku ʻikai te u ʻilo pe ko hoʻomou haʻu mei fē:’
Pea te mou lea leva,ʻo pehē, ‘Naʻa mau kai mo inu ʻi ho ʻao, pea naʻa ke akonaki ʻi homau ngaahi hala.’
Ka ʻe pehēʻe ia, ‘ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku ʻikai te u ʻilo pe ko hoʻomou haʻu mei fē; ʻalu ʻiate au ʻakimoutolukotoa pēʻoku fai angahala.’
‌ʻE ai ʻae tangi mo e fengaiʻitaki ʻoe nifo, ʻoka mou ka mamata kia ʻEpalahame, mo ʻAisake, mo Sēkope, mo e kau palōfita kotoa pē, ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, ka kuo kapusi ʻakimoutolukituaʻā.
Pea te nau haʻu mei he potu hahake mo hihifo, mei he tokelau mo e tonga, mo nau nofo hifo ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.
Pea vakai, ʻoku ai ʻae ki mui te nau muʻomuʻa; pea ʻoku ai ʻae ki muʻa te nau muimui.”
¶Pea naʻe haʻu ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻae niʻihi ʻoe kau Fālesi, ʻonau pehēkiate ia, “ʻAlu koe, pea ke mole ʻi heni: he ʻoku loto ʻa Helota ke tāmateʻi koe.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Mou ō, ʻo tala ki he fokisi ko ia, ‘Vakai, ko e ʻaho ni mo e ʻapongipongi ʻoku ou kapusi ai ʻae kau tēvolo, mo fai ʻae fakamoʻui, pea ʻi honoʻahotolu te u haohaoa.’
Ka ko e moʻoni teu ʻeveʻeva ʻi he ʻaho ni, mo e ʻapongipongi, mo eʻahoʻoku hokomo ia: koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai tāmateʻi ha palōfita ka ʻi Selūsalema pe.

“ʻE Selūsalema, Selūsalema, ʻa Koe ʻoku ke tāmateʻi ʻae kau palōfita, mo ke lisingi ʻaki ʻae maka ʻakinautolukuo fekau kiate koe, kuo tuʻo fiha ʻeku fie tānaki fakataha hoʻo fānau, ʻo hangēko e tānakiʻe he motuʻa moa hono ʻuhikiʻi hono lalo kapakau, ka naʻe ʻikai te mou lotoki ai.

Vakai, kuo siʻaki homou fale kiate kimoutoluke lala: pea ko ʻeku tala moʻoni kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai te mou mamata kiate au, kaeʻoua ke mou pehē, ‘ʻOku monūʻia ia ʻoku haʻu ʻi he huafa ʻoe ʻEiki.’|”
14: PEA pehē, ʻi heʻene hūki he fale ʻoe ʻeiki ʻe tokotaha ʻoe kau Fālesi ke kai māʻi he ʻaho Sāpate, naʻa nau lamasi ia.
Pea vakai, naʻe ʻi hono ʻao ha tangata naʻe fulavai.
Pea lea ʻa Sisu ki he kau akonaki ʻi he fono mo e kau Fālesi, ʻo ne pehē, “ʻOku ngofua ke fakamoʻui ʻi he ʻaho Sāpate?”
Pea nau fakalongo pe. Pea ne ʻomi ʻo fakamoʻui ia, pea tukuangeke ʻalu;
Pea leaange ia, ʻo pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko hai ʻiate kimoutolukapau ʻe tōʻene ʻasi pe ko ʻene pulu ki ha luo, ʻe ʻikai toʻo leva iamei aiʻi he ʻaho Sāpate?”
Pea naʻe ʻikai te nau faʻa tali ia ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ni.
¶Pea ʻi heʻene vakai kiate kinautolunaʻe talaki ai, ʻoku nau fili ki he ngaahi potu lelei, pea ne lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātā, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu.
“ʻOka tala kiate koe ʻe ha tahake ke ʻaluki he taʻane, ʻoua naʻa ke nofo hifo ʻi ha potu māʻolunga ʻaupito; telia kuo tala ʻe ia ki ha taha ʻoku lahi ʻiate koe;
Pea haʻu ia, ʻaia ne ne tala kiate koe mo ia, ʻo ne pehēkiate koe, ‘Fakaʻataʻatāki he tangata ni;’pea ke toki māai, ʻo ʻalu ki he potu māʻulalo.

Ka ʻoka tala kiate koe, pea ke ʻalu ʻo nofo ʻi he potu māʻulalo: koeʻuhi ʻoka haʻu ia naʻe tala kiate koe, te ne pehēkiate koe, ‘Kāinga, ʻalu koe ki ʻolunga:’pea te ke maʻu ʻae fakamālōʻi he ʻao ʻokinautoluʻoku mou nofo ʻo kai.
He ko ia ia ʻoku hiki hake ia, ʻe fakavaivai ia; pea ko ia ʻoku fakavaivai ia, ʻe hakeakiʻi ia.”

¶Pea pehēai foki ʻe ia kiate ia ne ne tala kiate ia, “ʻOka ke ka teuteu ʻae kai hoʻatāpe ʻae ʻohomohe, ʻoua naʻa ke uiki aiho kaumeʻa, pe ho ngaahi temomo, pe ho kāinga, pe ko e kaungāʻapi koloaʻia, telia naʻa nau toe tala kiate koe, pea totongi ai kiate koe.
Ka ʻoka ke ka teu ʻae kātoanga, ui ʻae kau masiva, mo e lavea, mo e pipiki, mo e kui:
‌ʻE monūʻia ai ʻa koe; he ʻoku ʻikai te nau faʻa totongi kiate koe: ka ʻe totongi kiate koe ʻi he toetuʻu ʻoe angatonu.”
¶Pea ko e tokotaha naʻe nofo ʻo kai mo ia, ʻi heʻene fanongo ki he ngaahi meʻa ni, naʻa ne pehēkiate ia, “ʻE monūʻia ia ʻaia te ne kai māʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
Pea toki pehēʻe ia kiate ia, “Naʻe te u ʻe he tangata ʻe tokotaha ʻae ʻohomohe lahi, ʻo ne talaiaki he tokolahi:
Pea hoko ʻae feituʻupōke kai, pea ne fekau ʻene tamaioʻeiki ke fakahākiate kinautolunaʻe tala ki ai, ‘Haʻu he kuo teuteu ʻae meʻa kotoa pē.’
Pea naʻa nau loto taha kotoa pēʻo kamata fakafisi. Naʻe pehēʻe he ʻuluaki kiate ia, ‘Kuo u fakatau ʻae potu fonua, pea ʻoku ngali ke u ʻalu ʻo vakai ia:’ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke tukuangeau.
Pea pehēʻe he tokotaha, ‘Kuo u fakatau ʻae taulua pulu ʻe nima, pea ʻoku ou ʻalu ko hono ʻahiʻahi: ʻoku ou kole kiate koe, ke ke tukuangeau.’
Pea pehēʻe he tokotaha, ‘Kuo u mali mo e fefine, pea ko ia ʻe ʻikai te u faʻa ʻalu ai:’

Pea liu mai ʻae tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻo fakahāki heʻene ʻeiki ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni. Pea tuputāmaki ʻae ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ʻo ne pehēki heʻene tamaioʻeiki, ‘ʻAlu fakavave ki he ngaahi hala motuʻa mo e ngaahi hala siʻi ʻoe kolo, ʻo ʻomi ki heni ʻae masiva, mo e mutu, mo e pipiki, mo e kui.’
Pea pehēʻe he tamaioʻeiki, ‘ʻEiki, kuo fai ʻo hangēko hoʻo fekau, ka ʻoku kei ʻataʻatāpe.’
Pea pehēʻe he ʻeiki ki heʻene tamaioʻeiki, ‘ʻAlu ki he ngaahi hala motuʻa mo e ngaahi mangaʻi hala, ʻo fakaafeʻi ʻakinautoluke haʻu, kae fonu ai hoku fale.
He ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻi he kakai ko ia naʻe tala ki ai te ne kamata ʻeku ʻohomohe.’|”
¶Pea naʻe ʻalu mo ia ʻae fuʻu kakai, pea tafoki ia, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu,

“Kapau ʻe haʻu ha taha kiate au, kae ʻikai fehiʻa ki heʻene tamai, mo e faʻē, mo e ʻunoho, mo e fānau, mo e ngaahi tokoua, mo e ngaahi tuofefine, ʻio, ki heʻene moʻui foki, ʻe ʻikai siʻi hoko ia ko ʻeku ākonga.
Pea ko ia ʻe ʻikai te ne fua ʻene ʻakau māfasia, ʻo muimuikiate au, ʻe ʻikai siʻi hoko ia ko ʻeku ākonga.
He Ko hai ʻiate kimoutoluʻoku te u langa ha fale, kae ʻikai tomuʻa nofo hifo ia ʻo lau hono totongi, pe ʻoku ʻiate ia ke faʻa fakaʻosi ʻaki?
Telia naʻa hili hono ʻai ʻae tuʻunga, ka ʻoku ʻikai te ne faʻa fakaʻosiia, ʻe kamata manuki kiate ia ʻakinautolukotoa pēʻe mamataai,
‌ʻo pehē, ‘Ko e tangata eni naʻe kamata fokotuʻu, ka naʻe ʻikai faʻa fakaʻosi.’
Pe ko e tuʻi fēʻoku te u tau ki ha tuʻi ʻe taha, ʻoku ʻikai ke tomuʻa nofo hifo, ʻo fakakaukau pe te ne faʻa tauʻi ʻaki ʻae toko mano, ʻaia ʻoku haʻu kiate ia mo e toko ua mano?
Pea ka ʻikai, ʻoku ne kouna ha talafekau, ʻi he kei mamaʻo ʻae tokotaha, ʻo kole ke na fakalelei.
Pea ʻoku pehēfoki, ko ia ia ʻiate kimoutoluʻoku ʻikai te ne siʻaki ʻaia kotoa pēʻoku ne maʻu, ʻe ʻikai hoko ia ko ʻeku ākonga.
¶“ʻOku lelei ʻae māsima: pea kapau kuo mole ʻi he māsima hono kona, ʻetoefakakona ia mei fē?
‌ʻOku ʻikai ʻaonga ia ki he kelekele, pe ki he tuʻunga ʻotoʻota; ka ʻoku līia kituʻa. Ko ia ʻoku ne telinga ongo, ke ongoʻi ia.”
15: PEA naʻe feʻunui atu ai kiate ia ʻae kau tānaki tukuhau mo e kau angahala kotoa pē, ke fanongo kiate ia.
Pea naʻe lāunga ʻae kau Fālesi mo e kau tangata tohi, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku maʻu ʻe he tangata ni ʻae kau angahala, ʻo kai mo kinautolu.”
¶Pea ne lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātāni kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē,
“Ko hai ha tangata ʻiate kimoutoluʻoku teau ʻene sipi, pea ka mole honau taha, ʻe ʻikai tuku ʻae hivangofulu ma hiva ʻi he toafa, kae ʻalu ʻo kumi ʻaia kuo mole, kaeʻoua ke ne ʻilo ia?
Pea ka ʻiloʻi ʻe ia, ʻoku ne hili ia ki hono uma, pea fiefia.
Pea ka haʻu ia ki ʻapi, ʻoku ne ui ke fakataha ʻae kāinga mo e kaungāʻapi, ʻone pehēkiate kinautolu, ‘Tau fiefia mo au, he kuo u ʻilo ʻa ʻeku sipi ʻaia naʻe mole.’

‌ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE pehēfoki ʻae fiefia ʻi he langi ʻo lahi ʻi he fakatomala ʻae angahala ʻe tokotaha, ʻi he angatonu ʻe toko hivangofulu ma toko hiva, ʻoku ʻikai ʻaonga ke nau fakatomala.
¶“Pea ko hai ha fefine ʻoku hongofulu ʻene paʻanga siliva, pea ka mole ha paʻanga ʻe taha, ʻe ʻikai te ne tutu ʻae maama, mo tafi ʻae fale, ʻo kumi lahi, kaeʻoua ke ʻilo ia?
Pea ka ʻiloia, ʻoku ne ui ke fakataha ʻae kāinga mo e kaungāʻapi, ʻo ne pehē, ‘Tau fiefia mo au, he kuo u ʻilo ʻae paʻanga naʻe mole ʻiate au.’
‌ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻOku pehēʻae fiefia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kau ʻāngelo ʻae ʻOtua ʻi he fakatomala ʻae angahala ʻe tokotaha.”
¶Pea pehēʻe ia, “Naʻe ai ʻae tangata naʻe toko ua hono foha.
Pea pehēʻe he kimui ki heʻene tamai, ‘Tamai, tuku mai haku tufakanga ʻi he koloa ʻoku ʻaʻaku.’Pea ne vaeua kiate kinaua ʻa ʻene meʻa.
Pea hili ʻae ngaahi ʻaho siʻi, naʻe tānaki ʻe he foha ki mui ʻa ʻene meʻa kotoa pē, ʻo fononga ki he fonua mamaʻo, ʻo maumauʻi ai ʻene koloa ʻi heʻene moʻui angakovi.
Pea kuo fakaʻosi ʻe ia kotoa pē, naʻe tōʻae honge lahi ki he fonua ko ia; pea hoko ia ʻo fiekaia.
Pea ʻalu ia ʻo nofo ki he tangata ʻe tokotaha ʻoe fonua ko ia; pea ne fekau ia ki hono potu fonua ke tauhi ʻae fanga puaka.
Pea naʻe feinga ia ke fakamākona ʻaki ia ʻae ngeʻesi naʻe kai ʻe he fanga puaka: he naʻe ʻikai ha taha ʻe foaki kiate ia.
“Pea kuo poto ia, pea ne pehē, ‘ʻOku toko fiha ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki totongi ʻa ʻeku tamai kuo lahi mo toe ʻenau mā, ka ʻoku ou mate ʻi he fiekaia!
Te u tuʻu hake ʻo ʻalu ki heʻeku tamai, pea te u pehēkiate ia, “Tamai, kuo u fai angahala ki he langi, pea ʻi ho ʻao;
Pea ʻoku ʻikai te u kei ʻaonga ke ui ko ho foha; ka ke tuku au ke u tatau mo ha taha ʻi hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki totongi.”|’
“Pea naʻe tuʻu hake ia, ʻo ʻalu ki heʻene tamai. Ka ʻi heʻene kei mamaʻo ʻaupito, naʻe mamata ʻa ʻene tamai kiate ia, pea manavaʻofa, mo lele, pea fāʻufua ia, ʻo ʻuma kiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe he foha kiate ia, ‘Tamai, kuo u angahala ki he langi, pea ʻi ho ʻao, pea ʻoku ʻikai te u kei ʻaonga ke ui ko ho foha.’
“Ka naʻe pehēʻe he tamai ki heʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, ‘ʻOmi ʻae pulupulufungani lelei, ʻo ʻai kiate ia; pea ʻai mo e mama ki hono nima, mo e topuvaʻe ki hono vaʻe:
Pea ʻomi ki heni ʻae ʻuhikipulu sino, ʻo tāmateʻiia; pea ke tau kai, mo fiefia:
He ko hoku foha eni naʻe mate, pea kuo toe moʻui; naʻe mole ia, pea kuo ʻiloʻi.’Pea naʻa nau kamata fiefia.
“Pea naʻe ʻi he ngoue ʻa hono ʻuluaki foha; pea ʻi heʻene haʻu ʻo ofi ki he fale, naʻe fanongo ia ki he meʻa faiva mo e meʻe.
Pea naʻa ne ui ki ha taha ʻoe kau tamaioʻeiki, ʻone fehuʻi ki hono ʻuhinga ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ni.
Pea ne tala kiate ia, ‘Kuo haʻu ho tehina; pea kuo tāmateʻi ʻe hoʻo tamai ʻae ʻuhikipulu sino,’koeʻuhi kuo ne maʻu ia ʻoku moʻui lelei pe.
Ka naʻe ʻita ia, pea ʻikai ʻalu ki ai: ko ia naʻe haʻu ai kituʻa ʻa ʻene tamai, ʻo fakakolekole kiate ia.

Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange ki heʻene tamai, ‘Vakai, ko e ngaahi taʻu lahi ni mo ʻeku tauhiʻi koe, pea naʻe ʻikai teu talangataʻa ki hoʻo fekau ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha: ka naʻe ʻikai siʻi te ke foaki kiate au ha ʻuhikiʻi kosi, koeʻuhi ke u fakafiefia ai mo hoku kāinga.
Ka kuo haʻu leva ho foha ko eni, ʻaia naʻe maumauʻi hoʻo koloa mo e kau faʻa feʻauaki, pea ke tāmateʻi maʻana ʻae ʻuhikipulu sino.’
“Pea ne pehēkiate ia, ‘Foha, ʻoku ta nofomaʻu mo au, pea ko ia kotoa pēʻoku ʻaʻaku ʻoku ʻaʻau ia.
Naʻe taau ʻemau fakafiefia mo nekeneka: he ko ho tehina eni naʻe mate, ka kuo toe moʻui ia; pea naʻe mole, ka kuo ʻilo ia.’|”
16: PEA naʻa ne pehēfoki ki heʻene kau ākonga, “Naʻe ai ha tangata koloaʻia, naʻe ai ʻene tauhi, pea naʻe fakaʻilo kiate ia kuo ne maumauʻi ʻene koloa.
Pea ne ui ia, ʻo pehēki ai, ‘Ko e hāeni ʻoku ou fanongo ai ʻiate koe? Fakamatala mai hoʻo tauhi; he ʻoku ʻikai te ke kei tauhi.’
Pea pehēʻe he tauhi ʻi hono loto, ‘Ko e hāte u fai? He ʻoku toʻo ʻiate au ʻae tauhi ʻe heʻeku ʻeiki: ʻe ʻikai te u faʻa keli; pea ʻoku ou māʻi he kole.’
Kuo pau hoku loto ki he meʻa te u fai, koeʻuhi ke nau maʻu au ki honau ngaahi fale, ʻoka tukuangeau ʻi he tauhi.’
“Pea ne ui ʻae kau fakatau koloa kotoa pēʻe heʻene ʻeiki, ʻo ne pehēki he ʻuluaki, ‘ʻOku fiha nai ʻae meʻa ʻoku teʻeki te ke totongi ai ki heʻeku ʻeiki?’
Pea pehēʻe ia, ‘Ko e puha fua ʻe teau ʻoe lolo.’Pea ne pehēkiate ia, ‘Toʻo hoʻo tohi, pea ke nofo ke vave, ʻo tohi ai ko e nimangofulu.’

Pea pehēʻe ia ki he taha kehe, ‘Pea ʻoku fiha ʻa e meʻa ʻoku teʻeki te ke totongi ʻe koe?’Pea pehēʻe ia, ‘Ko e puha fua ʻe teau ʻoe uite.’Pea ne pehēkiate ia, ‘Toʻo hoʻo tohi, ʻo tohi ai ko e valungofulu.’
Pea fakamālōʻae ʻeiki ki he tauhi koloa taʻefaitotonu, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene fai fakapotopoto: he ʻoku poto hake ʻae fānau ʻa māmani ʻi honau toʻutangata, ʻi he fānau ʻae maama.
“Pea ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, “Ngaohi kiate kimoutoluʻaki ʻae koloa taʻemāʻoniʻoni ʻae ngaahi kāinga; koeʻuhi, ʻoka mou ka mate, kenau maʻu ʻakimoutoluki he ngaahi nofoʻanga taʻengata.
Ko ia ʻoku angatonu ʻi he meʻa siʻi, ʻoku angatonu foki ia ʻi he meʻa lahi; pea ko ia ʻoku taʻeangatonu ʻi he meʻa siʻi, ʻoku taʻeangatonu ia ʻi he meʻa lahi.
Ko ia kapau naʻe ʻikai te mou angatonu ʻi he koloa taʻemāʻoniʻoni, Ko hai ʻe tuku ʻa ekoloamoʻoni ke mou tauhi?
Pea kapau naʻe ʻikai te mou angatonu ʻi he meʻa ʻae taha kehe, Ko hai ʻe foaki kiate kimoutoluʻae meʻa ʻoku ʻamoutolu?

¶“ʻOku ʻikai ha tamaioʻeiki te ne faʻa tauhi ʻae ʻeiki ʻe toko ua: koeʻuhi ʻe fehiʻa ia ki he tokotaha, kae ʻofa ki he tokotaha; pe pikitai ki he tokotaha, kae manuki ki he tokotaha. ʻE ʻikai siʻi te mou faʻa tauhi ʻae ʻOtua mo e koloa.”
Pea ko e kau Fālesi foki naʻe manumanu, ne nau fanongo ki he ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pē: pea naʻa nau taukae kiate ia.

Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko kimoutolueni ʻoku mou fakatonuhia ʻakimoutoluʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai ka ʻoku ʻilo ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa homou loto: he ko ia ʻoku lelei lahi ki he kakai, ʻoku fakalielia ia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua.
“Naʻe ai ʻae fono mo e kau palōfita ʻo aʻu kia Sione: pea talu mei ai mo e malangaʻaki ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, pea ʻoku ului ki ai ʻae kakai kotoa pē.
Pea ʻoku faingofua hake ke mole ʻae langi mo māmani, ʻi he mole ha kupuʻi lea ʻe taha ʻoe fono.
“Ko ia ʻoku ne tukuangehono ʻunoho, kae mali mo ha taha, ʻoku tono fefine ia: pea ko ia ʻoku ne mali mo ia kuo tukuangemei hono ʻunoho, ʻoku tono fefine ia.
¶“Naʻe ai ha tangata koloaʻia, naʻa ne ʻai ʻae kofu kulokula mo e tupenumahuʻinga, pea kai ʻe ia ʻae meʻa lelei ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē:
Pea naʻe ai ha tangata paea, ko Lasalosi hono hingoa, naʻe fakatokoto ia ʻi hono matapā, kuo tofu ʻi he papala,
‌ʻO ne holi ke fafanga ʻaki ia ʻae momoʻi meʻakai naʻe ngangana mei he keinangaʻanga ʻae tangata maʻumeʻa: pea naʻe haʻu foki ʻae fanga kulī, ʻo ʻemo hono papala.
Pea pehē, naʻe mate ʻae tangata paea, pea fua ia ʻe he kau ʻāngelo ki he fatafata ʻo ʻEpalahame: pea mate foki ʻae tangata maʻumeʻa, pea tanu ia;
Pea hanga hake ia hono mata ʻi heli, ʻoku ongosia ia, pea ne mamata kia ʻEpalahame ʻi he mamaʻo ʻaupito, mo Lasalosi ʻi hono fatafata.
“Pea tangi ia, ʻo pehē, ‘ʻE tamai ko ʻEpalahame, ke ke ʻofa mai kiate au, pea fekau ʻa Lasalosi ke ne ʻai hono muʻa tuhu ki he vai, mo fakamomoko hoku ʻelelo: he ʻoku ou feinga ʻi he afi ni.’
Ka naʻe pehēʻe ʻEpalahame, ‘Foha, ke ke manatu naʻa ke maʻu hoʻo ngaahi meʻa lelei ʻi hoʻo moʻui, pea naʻe ʻia Lasalosi foki ʻae ngaahi meʻa kovi; ka ko eni, ʻoku fiemālie ia, ka kuo ke feinga koe.

Kaeʻumaʻāeni kotoa pē, ʻoku ai ʻae fuʻu vanu lahi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo kimautolumo kimoutolu: ko ia ʻe ʻikai lava atu ʻakinautoluʻoku fie ʻalu ʻi heni kiate kimoutolu; pea ʻe ʻikai faʻa haʻu kiate kimautoluʻakinautoluʻoku fie haʻu mei hena.’
“Pea toki pehēʻe ia, ‘Ko ia ʻoku ou kole ai kiate koe, ʻe tamai, ke ke fekau ia ki he fale ʻo ʻeku tamai:
He ʻoku toko nima hoku kāinga koeʻuhi ke ne valokiʻi ʻakinautolu, telia naʻa nau haʻu foki ki he potu fakamamahi ni.’
Pea pehēʻe ʻEpalahame kiate ia, ‘ʻOku nau maʻu ʻa Mōsese mo e kau palōfita; tuku ke nau fanongo ki ai.’
Pea pehēʻe ia, ‘ʻE ʻikai, ʻe tamai ko ʻEpalahame, ka ʻoka ʻalu ha taha mei he mate kiate kinautolu, te nau fakatomala.’
Pea pehēmai ʻe ia kiate ia, ‘Kapau ʻe ʻikai te nau fanongo kia Mōsese mo e kau palōfita, ʻe ʻikai te nau tui ʻo kapau ʻe toetuʻu ha taha mei he mate.’|”
17: PEA toki pehēʻe ia ki he kau ākonga, “ʻE ʻikai mafai ke taʻofi ʻae hoko ʻoe ngaahi fakahala: ka ʻe malaʻia ia ʻoku hoko mei ai ia!”
‌ʻOku lelei kiate ia ʻoka ne taupungaʻi ʻaki ia ʻae maka momosi ʻi hono kia, pea līki he moana, ʻi heʻene fakahalaʻi ha tokotaha ʻiate kinautoluni ʻoku siʻi.
¶Mou vakai kiate kimoutolu: “Kapau ʻe fai angahala kiate koe ʻe ho kāinga, valoki ia; pea kapau ʻe fakatomala, fakamolemole ia.
Pea kapau ʻe fai angahala ʻe ia kiate koe ʻo liunga fitu ʻi ha ʻaho, kae tafoki ia kiate koe ʻo liunga fitu ʻi ha ʻaho, mo pehēʻe ia, ‘ʻOku ou fakatomala;’ke ke fakamolemole ia.”
Pea pehēʻe he kau ʻaposetolo ki he ʻEiki, “Fakalahi ʻemau tui.”

Pea pehēʻe he ʻEiki, “Ka ne mou maʻu ʻae tui ke tatau mo e foʻi tengaʻi musita, te mou lea ki he ʻakau ko e sukamino ni, ‘Ke mataʻaki fuʻu hake koe, pea tōkoe ʻi he tahi;’pea ʻe talangofua ia kiate kimoutolu.
Ka ko hai ʻiate kimoutoluʻoku ai ʻene tamaioʻeiki, ʻoku keli pe tauhimanu, ʻe pehēleva ki ai, ʻoka haʻu ia mei he ngoue, ‘Haʻu koe ʻo nofo hifo ke kai?’
Kae ʻikai pehēmuʻa ki ai, ‘Teuteu haku ʻohomohe, pea ke nonoʻo koe, ʻo tauhi au, kaeʻoua ke u kai mo inu; pea hili ia te ke toki kai koe mo inu?’
‌ʻOku fakafetaʻi ʻe ia ki he tamaioʻeiki ko ia, koeʻuhi ko ʻene fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa kuo fekau kiate ia? ʻOku ou pehēʻoku ʻikai.
Pea ke pehēfoki ʻakimoutolu, ʻoka ʻosi hono fai ʻoe meʻa kotoa pēkuo fekau kiate kimoutolu, mou pehē, ‘Ko e kau tamaioʻeiki taʻeʻaonga ʻakimautolu: kuo mau fai ʻaia naʻe totonu pe ke mau fai.’|”
¶Pea pehē, ʻi heʻene ʻalu ki Selūsalema, naʻe fononga atu ia ʻi Samēlia mo Kāleli.
Pea ʻi heʻene hūki he potu kakai ʻe taha, naʻe fakafetaulakikiate ia ʻae kau tangata kilia ʻe toko hongofulu, pea nau tutuʻu mamaʻo atu:
Pea naʻa nau kalanga leʻo lahi, ʻo pehē, “Sisu, ʻEiki, ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate kimautolu.”
Pea ʻi heʻene mamata, naʻa ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Mou ō, ʻo fakahāʻakimoutoluki he kau taulaʻeiki.”Pea pehē, ʻi heʻenau ʻalu naʻe fakamaʻa ʻakinautolu.
Pea naʻe foki mai honau tokotaha, ʻi heʻene mamata kuo fakamoʻui ia, ʻo ne fakamālōʻaki ʻae leʻo lahi ki he ʻOtua,
‌ʻO fakafoʻohifo ia ki hono vaʻe, ʻi he fakafetaʻi kiate ia: ka ko e Samēlia ia.
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange, “ʻIkai naʻe fakamaʻa ʻae toko hongofulu? Ka kofaʻāʻae toko hiva?
‌ʻOku ʻikai ʻiloa ke foki mai ha taha ke fakamālōki he ʻOtua, ka ko e muli ni pe.”
Pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Tuʻu hake, pea ke ʻalu: kuo fakamoʻui koe ʻe hoʻo tui.”
¶Pea ʻi he ʻeke ʻae kau Fālesi kiate ia, pe ʻe hoko ʻafēʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua, naʻe leaange ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ʻo pehē, “ʻOku ʻikai hoko ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua mo e fakaongoongoaki ai:
Pea ʻe ʻikai te nau pehē, ‘Vakai heni!’pe, ‘Vakai hena!’He ko eni, ʻoku ʻiate kimoutoluʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
Pea pehēʻe ia ki he kau ākonga, “ʻE hoko mai ʻae ngaahi ʻaho, te mou holi ai ke mamata ki ha ʻaho ʻe taha ʻoe Foha ʻoe tangata, ka ʻe ʻikai te mou mamata ki ai.
Pea ka nau ka pehēkiate kimoutolu, ‘Vakai heni;’pe, ‘Vakai hena:’ʻoua naʻa ʻalu atu, pe muimuiki ai.
He ʻoku hangēko e ʻasi mai ʻae ʻuhilamei he potu langi ʻe taha, pea ulo ʻo aʻu ki he potu langi ʻe taha, ʻe pehēfoki ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ʻi hono ʻaho.
Ka ʻe tomuʻa kātaki ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa lahi, pea ʻe liʻaki ia ʻe he toʻutangata ni.
Pea hangēko e fai ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Noa, ʻe pehēfoki ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe Foha ʻoe tangata.
Naʻa nau kai, mo inu, naʻa nau mali ʻunoho, pea foaki ke mali, ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho naʻe hūai ʻa Noa ki he vaka, pea ʻoho mai ʻae vai, ʻo fakaʻauha ʻakinautolukotoa pē.
Pea hangēfoki ko e fai ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Lote, naʻa nau kai, mo inu, naʻa nau fefakatauʻaki, naʻa nau tōngoue, pea nau langa fale;
Ka ʻi he ʻaho ko ia naʻe ʻalu atu ai ʻa Lote ʻi Sotoma, naʻe ʻuha afi mo e maka vela mei he langi, ʻo fakaʻauha ʻakinautolukotoa pē.
‌ʻE pehēpe foki ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fakahāai ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata.
“Pea ko ia ia ʻe ʻi he tuʻa fale ʻi he ʻaho ko ia, ka ʻoku ʻi loto fale ʻene meʻa, ke ʻoua naʻa ʻalu hifo ia ko hono ʻave: pea ko ia ʻe ʻi he ngoue, ke ʻoua foki naʻa liu mai.
Manatuʻi ʻae ʻunohoʻo Lote.
Ko ia ia ʻe kalofaki ʻene moʻui, ʻe mole ia ʻiate ia; ka ko ia ia ʻe tukuʻene moʻuiʻe maʻu ʻe ia ia.
‌ʻOku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻI he pōko ia ʻe ai ʻae tangata ʻe toko ua ʻi he mohenga pe taha; ʻe ʻave ʻae tokotaha, ka ʻe tuku ʻae tokotaha.
‌ʻE fakataha ʻae fefine ʻe toko ua ʻo momosi; ʻe ʻave ʻae tokotaha, ka ʻe tuku ʻae tokotaha.
‌ʻE ai ʻae tangata ʻe toko ua ʻi he ngoue ko e tokotaha ʻe ʻave, ka ʻe tuku ʻae tokotaha.”
Pea naʻa nau leaange, ʻo pehēkiate ia, “ʻEiki, kofaʻāia?”Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻIlonga ʻae potu ʻe ʻi ai ʻae ʻangaʻanga, ʻe kātoa ki ai ʻae fanga ʻikale.”
18: PEA naʻa ne fakahākiate kinautoluʻi he fakatātā, ʻoku lelei ke lotu maʻuaipēʻae kakai, pea ʻoua naʻa fiu;
‌ʻO ne pehē, “Naʻe ʻi he kolo ʻe taha ʻae fakamaau, naʻe ʻikai manavahēki he ʻOtua, pe tokanga ki he tangata.
Pea naʻe ʻi he kolo ko ia ʻae fefine kuo mate hono ʻunoho; pea haʻu ia ki ai, ʻo ne pehē, ‘Fakamaau au mo totongi totonu ki hoku fili.’
Pea naʻe ʻikai tokanga leva ia ki ai: kae toki fakakaukau ia,ʻo pehē, ‘ʻOku ʻikai pe te u manavahēki he ʻOtua, pe tokanga ki he tangata;
Ka koeʻuhi ʻi he fakafiuʻi au ʻe he fefine ni kuo mate hono ʻunoho, te u fakamaauʻi ia, telia ʻi heʻene faʻa haʻu te ne fakakinaʻi au.’|”
Pea pehēʻe he ʻEiki, “Fanongo ki he lea ʻae fakamaau taʻeangatonu.
Pea ʻe ʻikai fakamaau ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa hono kakai ʻoʻona kuo fili, ʻaia ʻoku tangi kiate ia ʻi he ʻaho mo e pō, ʻo kapau ʻe fakatuotuai ia kiate kinautolu?
‌ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, ʻE fakamaau vave ʻe ia ʻakinautolu. Ka ʻi he haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata, te ne ʻilo ʻae tui ʻi he fonua?”
Pea naʻa ne lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātāni ki he niʻihi naʻa nau falala kiate kinautolukuo nau māʻoniʻoni, mo nau manukiʻi ʻae kakai kehe:
“Naʻe ʻalu hake ʻae ongo tangata ki he falelotu lahi ke lotu; ko e tokotaha ko e Fālesi, pea ko e tānaki tukuhau ʻae tokotaha.

Naʻe tuʻu atu pe ʻae Fālesi, pea lotu, ʻo pehē, ‘ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku ou fakafetaʻi kiate koe, ʻoku ʻikai te u hangēko e kau tangata kehe, ke fakamālohi, mo taʻeangatonu, mo tono fefine, pe hangēko e tānaki tukuhau ni.
‌ʻOku liunga ua ʻeku ʻaukai ʻi he uike, pea ʻoku ou ʻatu ʻae tukuhau ʻi heʻeku meʻa fulipē.’
Ka naʻe tuʻu mamaʻo atu ʻae tānaki tukuhau, pea ʻikai faʻa hanga hake hono mata ki he langi, ka naʻe si fatafata ia, mo pehē, ‘ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke ʻaloʻofa mai kiate au ko e angahala.’

‌ʻOku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, naʻe ʻalu hifo ʻae tangata ni ki hono fale kuo fakatonuhia ia, ka ʻikai pehēʻae tokotaha: he ko ia kotoa pēʻoku ne hiki hake ia, ʻe fakavaivaiʻi ia; pea ko ia ʻoku ne fakavaivaiʻi ia, ʻe hiki hake ia.”
Pea naʻa nau ʻomi foki kiate ia ʻae tamaiki iiki, koeʻuhi ke ne ala kiate kinautolu: ka ʻi he mamata ki ai ʻae kau ākonga, naʻa nau lolomi ʻakinautolu.
Ka naʻe ui ʻe Sisu ke nau haʻu, ʻo ne pehē, “Tuku pe ʻae tamaiki iiki ke haʻu kiate au, pea ʻoua naʻa taʻofi ʻakinautolu: he ʻoku ʻoe kakai pehēʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.
Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, Ko ia ia ʻe ʻikai te ne maʻu ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua ʻo hangēko e tamasiʻi siʻi ʻe ʻikai ʻaupitohūia ki ai.”
Pea toki fehuʻi ʻae matāpule ʻe taha kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki lelei, ko e hāte u fai ke u hoko ai ki he moʻui taʻehili?”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Ko e hākuo ke ui ai au ko e lelei? Ko e tokotaha pe ʻoku lelei, ʻaia ko e ʻOtua.
‌ʻOku ke ʻilo ʻae ngaahi fekau, ‘ʻOua naʻa ke tono fefine,’‘ʻOua naʻa ke fakapō,’‘ʻOua naʻa ke kaihaʻa,’‘ʻOua naʻa ke fakamoʻoni loi,’‘Fakaʻapaʻapa ki hoʻo tamai mo hoʻo faʻē.’|”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Kuo u fai eni kotoa pētalu ʻeku siʻi.”

Pea kuo fanongo ʻa Sisu ki he ngaahi lea ni, pea ne pehēkiate ia, “Ko e meʻa ʻe taha ʻoku ke kei hala ai: fakatau ʻaia kotoa pēʻoku ʻaʻau, ʻo tufakiki he masiva, pea te ke maʻu ʻae ʻene koloa ʻi he langi: pea ke haʻu, ʻo muimuiʻiate au.”
Pea kuo fanongo ia ki ai, naʻa ne mamahi ʻaupito: he naʻe lahi ʻene koloa.

Pea kuo mamata ʻa Sisu kuo mamahi ʻaupitoia, pea ne pehē, “ʻE faingataʻa ʻaupitokiate kinautoluʻoku koloaʻia ke hūki he He ʻoku faingofua hake ʻae hūʻae kāmeli ʻi he avaʻi hui, ʻi he hūʻae tangata koloaʻia ki he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
He ʻoku faingofua hake ʻae hūʻae kāmeli ʻi he avaʻi hui, ʻi he hūʻae tangata koloaʻia ki he puleʻanga ʻae ʻOtua!
Pea ko kinautolunaʻe fanongo naʻa nau fepehēʻaki, “Pea ko hai ʻe moʻui?”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻikai mafai ʻe he tangata, ʻoku mafai ia ʻe he ʻOtua.”
Pea toki pehēʻe Pita, “Vakai, kuo mau liaki ʻae meʻa kotoa pē, ʻo muimuiʻiate koe.”

Pea ne pehe kiate kinautolu, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, “ʻOku ʻikai ha tangata kuo liʻaki ʻe ia ai fale, pea ʻae mātuʻa, pe ko e ngaahi kāinga, pe ko e ʻunoho, pe ʻae fānau, koeʻuhi ko e puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua,
Ka te ne maʻu ʻo lahi ʻaupitohake ʻi he moʻui ni, pea ʻi he maama ʻe haʻu ʻae moʻui taʻengata.”
¶Pea ne omi ʻae toko hongofulu ma toko ua, ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Vakai, ʻoku tau ʻalu hake ki Selūsalema, pea ʻe fakamoʻoni ki he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻaia kotoa pēkuo tohi ʻe he kau palōfita.
He koeʻuhi ʻe tukuangeia ki he Senitaile, pea ʻe manukiʻi ia, mo fai meʻa kovi kiate ia, mo ʻaʻanu ki ai:
Pea te nau kauʻimaea mo tāmateʻi ia: pea ʻi hono ʻaho tolu ʻe toetuʻu ia.”
Ka naʻe ʻikai te nau ʻilo ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni; pea naʻe puli ʻiate kinautoluʻae lea ni, ʻo ʻikai te nau ʻilo ʻae ngaahi meʻa kuo lea ʻaki.
¶Pea pehē, ʻi heʻene ofi atu ki Seliko, naʻe nofo ʻi he veʻehala ʻae tangata kui ʻo kole:
Pea fanongo ia ki he ʻalu ange ʻae fononga, pea fehuʻi ia ki hono ʻuhinga.
Pea naʻa nau tala kiate ia, “Ko Sisu ʻo Nāsaleti”ʻoku ʻalu ange.
Pea kalanga ia, ʻo pehē, “Sisu, Foha ʻo Tevita, ʻaloʻofa mai kiate au.”
Pea ko kinautolunaʻe muʻomuʻa naʻa nau lolomi ia, ke tuku ʻene longoaʻa: ka naʻe ʻāsili ai ʻene kalanga, “Foha ʻo Tevita, ʻaloʻofa mai kiate au.”
Pea tuʻu ʻa Sisu, ʻo fekau ke ʻomi ia kiate ia: pea kuo ʻunu mai ia ʻo ofi, pea ne fehuʻi ange kiate ia,
‌ʻO pehē, “Ko e hāho loto ke u fai kiate koe?”Pea pehēʻe ia, “ʻEiki, ke ʻāhoku mata.”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Ke ʻāho mata: kuo fakamoʻui koe ʻe hoʻo tui.”
Pea ʻāfakafokifāpe ia, ʻo muimuiʻiate ia, pea fakamālōki he ʻOtua: pea ʻi he mamata ki ai ʻae kakai kotoa pē, naʻa nau fakamālōki he ʻOtua.
19: PEA naʻe fononga atuʻa Sisuʻi Seliko, ʻo ʻalu ai.
Pea vakai, ko e tangata ko Sakiasi hono hingoa, ko e matāpule ia ʻi he kau tānaki tukuhau, pea naʻe koloaʻia ia.
Naʻe holi ia ke mamata pe ko e tangata ʻoku fēfēʻa Sisu; ka naʻe ʻikai mafai ia koeʻuhi ko e kakai, he ko e pukupukuia.
Pea naʻe lele muʻomuʻa ia, ʻo kaka ʻi he ʻakau ko e sukamino, ke mamata kiate ia: koeʻuhi ʻe ʻalu ange ai ia.
Pea kuo hoko ʻa Sisu ki he potu, naʻa ne sio hake, ʻo mamata kiate ia, pea ne pehēki ai, “Sakiasi, ʻalu hifo ke vave, he te u nofo ʻi ho fale ʻi he ʻaho ni.”
Pea fakavave ia, ʻo ʻalu hifo, ʻo ne tali ia ʻi he fiefia.
Pea kuo nau mamata ki ai, pea nau lāunga kotoa pē, ʻo pehē, “Kuo ʻalu ia ke nofo mo e tangata angahala.”

Pea tuʻu hake ʻa Sakiasi, ʻo ne pehēki he “ʻEiki; ʻEiki, vakai, ʻoku ou foaki hono vaeua ʻo ʻeku koloa ki he masiva; pea kapau ne u maʻu ha meʻa ʻi he lohiakiʻi ha taha, ʻoku ou totongi ʻo liunga fākiate ia.”
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate ia, “Kuo hoko ʻi he ʻaho ni ʻae fakamoʻui ki he fale ni, koeʻuhi ko e foha foki ia ʻo ʻEpalahame.
He kuo haʻu ʻae Foha ʻoe tangata ke kumi mo fakamoʻui ʻaia kuo mole.”
Pea ʻi heʻenau fanongo ki he ngaahi meʻa ni, naʻa ne toe lea ʻaki ʻe ia ʻae fakatātā, koeʻuhi kuo ofi ia ki Selūsalema, peako e meʻaʻi heʻenau mahalo ʻe hoko leva ʻae puleʻanga, ʻoe ʻOtua.
Ko ia ne ne pehēai, “Naʻe ʻalu ʻae ʻeiki ʻe tokotaha ki he fonua mamaʻo, ke maʻu moʻona ʻae puleʻanga, pea toki liliu mai.
Pea ne ui ʻae toko hongofulu ʻo ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki, ʻo ne tuku kiate kinautoluʻae mina ʻe hongofulu, mo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, ‘Ngāueʻaki eni kaeʻoua ke u haʻu.’
Ka naʻe fehiʻa ʻa hono kakai kiate ia, ʻonau kouna ʻae talafekau ke ʻalu, mo pehē, ‘ʻE ʻikai te mau maʻu ʻae tangata ni ke puleʻi ʻakimautolu.’

“Pea pehē, ʻi heʻene liu mai, kuo ne maʻu ʻae puleʻanga, pea toki fekau ʻe ia ke ui mai ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki ko ia, ʻaia naʻa ne tuku ki ai ʻae paʻanga, koeʻuhi ke ne ʻilo pe ko e hākuo maʻu ʻe he tangata taki taha ʻi heʻene fakatau.
Pea haʻu ʻae ʻuluaki, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, kuo maʻu ʻaki ʻa hoʻo mina ʻae mina ʻe hongofulu.’
Pea ne pehēkiate ia, ‘Mālō, ko e tamaioʻeiki lelei koe;’ko e meʻa ʻi hoʻo angatonu ʻi he meʻa siʻi, maʻu ʻe koe ʻae pule ki he kolo ʻe hongofulu.
Pea haʻu hono toko ua, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, kuo maʻu ʻaki ʻa hoʻo mina ʻae mina ʻe nima’
Pea naʻe pehēfoki kiate ia, ‘Ke ke puleʻi foki ʻae kolo ʻe nima.’
Pea haʻu ʻae tokotaha, ʻo ne pehē, ‘ʻEiki, vakai, ko hoʻo mina, ʻaia kuo u tauhi, ʻo kofuʻaki ia ʻae holoholo.
He naʻaku manavahēkiate koe, koeʻuhi ko e tangata faingataʻa koe: ʻoku ke toʻo hake ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te ke tuku hifo, mo tuʻusi ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te ke tūtuuʻi.’

Pea pehēʻe ia kiate ia, ‘Mei ho ngutu ʻoʻou te u fakamaau koe, ʻae tamaioʻeiki angakovi. Naʻa ke ʻilo ko e tangata faingataʻa au, ʻoku ou toʻo hake ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te u tuku hifo, mo tuʻusi ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te u tūtuuʻi:
Ko e hāia naʻe ʻikai ai te ke tuku ʻeku paʻanga ki he tukuʻanga koloa, koeʻuhi ʻi heʻeku haʻu te u maʻu ia mo hono tupu?’
Pea ne pehēkiate kinautolunaʻe tutuʻu ʻi ai, ‘Toʻo ʻiate ia ʻae mina, ʻo atu kiate ia ʻoku hongofulu ʻene mina.’
(Pea nau pehēkiate ia, ‘ʻEiki, ʻoku hongofulu ʻene mina.’)
He ʻoku ou pehēkiate kimoutolu, ‘Ko ia fulipēʻoku ne maʻu, ʻe foaki kiate ia; pea ko ia ʻoku ʻikai te ne maʻu, ʻe toʻo meiate ia ʻaia ʻoku ne maʻu.
Ka ko kinautoluni ko hoku ngaahi fili, naʻe ʻikai te nau lelei ke u puleʻi ʻakinautolu, ʻomi ki heni, pea tāmateʻi ʻi hoku ʻao.’|”
¶Pea kuo hili ʻene lea pehē, pea muʻomuʻa ia, ʻo fononga atu ki Selūsalema.
Pea pehē, ʻi heʻene haʻu ʻo ofi ki Petefesi mo Pētani, ki he moʻunga ʻoku ui ko ʻOlive, ne ne fekau ʻene ongo ākonga ʻe toko ua.
‌ʻO pehē, “Mo ōki he potu kakai ʻoku hangatonu mai; pea ʻi hoʻomo hūki ai te mo ʻilo ʻae ʻuhikiʻi ʻasi kuo noʻotaki, ʻoku teʻeki heka ai ha tangata: vete ia, ʻo taki mai.”
Pea kapau ʻe ʻeke ʻe ha taha kiate kimoua, ‘Ko e hāʻoku mo vete ai ia?’Te mo pehēkiateia, ‘Koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻaonga ia ki he ʻEiki.’|”
Pea naʻa na ōʻakinaua naʻe fekau, ʻo na ʻilo ʻo hangēko ia ne ne fakahākiate kinaua.
Pea ʻi heʻena vete ʻae ʻuhikiʻi ʻasi, naʻe pehēʻekinautoluʻoku ʻanautoluia kiate kinaua, “Ko e hāʻoku mo vete ai ʻae ʻuhikiʻi ʻasi?”
Pea na pehē, “ʻOku ʻaonga ia ki he ʻEiki.”
Pea naʻa na taki ia kia Sisu: pea na ʻai hona kofu ki he ʻuhikiʻi ʻasi, ʻo na fakaheka ki ai ʻa Sisu.
Pea ʻi heʻenau ō, naʻa nau folahi honau ngaahi kofu ʻi he hala.

Pea kuo haʻu ia ʻo ofi, ʻi he tahifohifo ʻoe moʻunga ko ʻOlive, pea kamata fiefia mo fakamālōʻae kau ākonga kotoa pēki he ʻOtua ʻaki ʻae leʻo lahi, koeʻuhi ko e ngaahi ngāue lahi kotoa pēkuo nau mamata ki ai;
‌ʻO pehē, “|‘ʻOku monūʻia ʻae Tuʻi ʻoku hāʻele mai ʻi he huafa ʻo Sihova:’Ke fiemālie ʻi he langi, pea fakamālōfungani lahi ʻi ʻolunga.”
Pea ko e Fālesi niʻihi ʻi he kakai naʻa nau pehēkiate ia, “ʻEiki, lolomi hoʻo kau ākonga.”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu, Kapau ʻe fakalongo pēʻakinautoluni, ʻe kalanga leva ʻae ngaahi maka.”
¶Pea kuo haʻu ia ʻo ofi, pea vakai ia ki he kolo, pea tangi ai,
‌ʻo pehē, “Taumaiānaʻa ke ʻilo, ʻio, ʻe koe, ʻi ho ʻaho ko eni, ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻoku kau ki hoʻo fiemālie! Ka ko eni kuo fufūia mei ho mata.
Koeʻuhi ʻe hoko ʻae ngaahi ʻaho kiate koe, ʻe tanu puke ai ʻa ho ngaahi fili, ʻo takatakai koe, mo kāpui koe, pea tāpuni ko e mei he potu kotoa pē.
Pea ʻe holoki hifo ko e ʻo aʻu ki he kelekele, mo hoʻo fānau ʻiate koe; pea ʻe ʻikai te nau tuku ʻiate koe ha makakuo fokotuʻuki ha maka; koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai te ke ʻilo ʻae kuongaʻo ho ʻaʻahi ʻanga.”
Pea naʻe hūia ki he falelotu lahi, ʻo ne kamata kapusi kituʻa ʻakinautolunaʻe fefakatauʻaki ai;
‌ʻo ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Kuo tohi, ‘Ko hoku fale ko e falelotu:’ka kuo mou ngaohi ia ‘ko e ʻana ʻoe kau kaihaʻa.’|”
Pea naʻe ako ia ʻi he falelotu lahi ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē. Ka naʻe holi ke tāmateʻi ia ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi mo e kau matāpule ʻoe kakai.
Ka naʻe ʻikai te nau ʻilo pe ko e hāte nau fai: he kuo tokanga lahi ʻae kakai kotoa pēke nau fanongo kiate ia.
20: PEA pehē, ko eʻahoʻe taha ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia, ʻi heʻene akonaki ki he kakai ʻi he falelotu lahi, mo malangaʻaki ʻae ongoongolelei, naʻe haʻu ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi pea mo e mātuʻa,
Mo nau lea kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “Talamai kiate kimautolupe ko e pule fēʻoku ke fai ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni? Pea ko hai ia ne ne tuku ʻae pule ni kiate koe?”
Pea lea ia, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Te u fehuʻi foki kiate kimoutoluha meʻa ʻe taha; pea tala mai kiate au:
Ko e papitaiso ʻa Sione, naʻe mei he langi ia, pe mei he tangata?”
Pea nau fealēleaʻaki, ʻo pehē, “Kapau te tau pehē, ‘Mei he langi;’te ne pehēmai, ‘Ko e hānaʻe ʻikai ai te mou tui kiate ia?’
Pea kapau te tau pehē, ‘Mei he tangata;’ʻe lisingi ʻaki ʻae maka ʻakitautoluʻe he kakai kotoa pē: he ʻoku nau ʻilo pau ko e palōfita ʻa Sione.”
Pea naʻa nau pehēange, kuo ʻikai te nau ʻilo pe naʻe mei fēia.
Pea pehēʻe Sisu kiate kinautolu, “Pea ʻe ʻikai te u tala kiate kimoutolupe ko e pule fēʻoku ou fai ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni.”
Pea naʻa ne kamata lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātāni ki he kakai; “Ko e tangata ʻe tokotaha naʻa ne tōʻae ngoue vaine, ʻo ne tuku ia ki he kau tauhi ngoue, pea fononga mamaʻo ia ʻo fuoloaai.

Pea hokosia ʻae toʻukai, pea ne fekau ʻae tamaioʻeiki ki he kau tauhi ngoue, koeʻuhi ke nau ʻomi kiate ia ha fua ʻoe ngoue vaine: ka naʻe teʻia ia ʻe he kau tauhi ngoue, ʻonau kapusi ia taʻehaʻanemeʻa.
Pea toe fekau ʻe ia ʻae tamaioʻeiki ʻe taha: pea naʻa nau teʻia foki ia, pea lahi ʻenau fai kovikiate ia, mo nau kapusi taʻehaʻanemeʻa.
Pea toe fekau ʻe ia ʻa hono toko tolu: pea naʻa nau teʻia foki ia, ʻonau līiakituaʻā.
Pea toki pehēʻe he ʻeiki ʻoe ngoue vaine, ‘Ko e hāte u fai? Te u fekau atu hoku foha ʻofaʻanga: heiʻilo ka nau ka mamata ai te nau fakaʻapaʻapa kiate ia.’
Ka kuo mamata ki ai ʻae kau tauhi ngoue, pea nau fealēleaʻaki, ʻo pehē, ‘Ko eni ʻae foha hoko: haʻu ke tau tāmateʻi ia, kae ʻatautoluʻae tofiʻa.’
Pea naʻa nau līia kituaʻāngoue vaine, ʻo tāmateʻiia. “Pea ko e hāʻe fai ʻe he ʻeiki ʻoe ngoue vaine kiate kinautolu?
‌ʻE haʻu ia ʻo fakaʻauha ʻae kau tauhi ngoue ko ia, pea tuku ʻae ngoue ki he kakai kehe.”Pea ʻi heʻenau fanongoai, naʻa nau pehē, “Ke ʻoua ʻaupito.”

Pea vakai atu ʻe ia kiate kinautolu, ʻo ne pehē, “Ka ko e hāeni kuo tohi,
‘Ko e maka naʻe liʻaki ʻe he kau tufunga,
kuo hoko ia ko e funganimaka tuliki?’

Ko ia ia ʻe tōki he maka ko ia, ʻe mafesifesi ai ia;
ka ko ia ʻe tōki ai ia, ʻe momosi ia ʻo efu.”

¶Pea naʻe holi ʻae kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi ʻi he feituʻulaʻāpe ko ia ke nau puke ia; ka naʻa nau manavahēki he kakai: he naʻa nau ʻilo kuo ne lea ʻaki ʻae fakatātāni kiate kinautolu.
Pea naʻa nau lamasiia, ʻonau fekau atu ʻae kau mataki ke nau fai fakafieangatonu, koeʻuhi ke nau femioekina ia ʻi heʻene lea, ka nau tukuangeai ia ki he mālohi mo e pule ʻae pule.
Pea naʻa nau fehuʻi kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻoku mau ʻilo ʻoku ke lea mo ako totonu, pea ʻoku ʻikai te ke fai filifilimānako, ka ʻoku ke akonaki ʻaki ʻae hala ʻoe ʻOtua ʻi he moʻoni.
‌ʻOku ngofua ke mau ʻatu ʻae tukuhau kia Sisa, pe ʻikai?”
Ka naʻe ʻilo ʻe ia ʻenau kākā, pea ne pehēkiate kinautolu, “Ko e hāʻoku mou ʻahiʻahiʻi ai au?”
Fakahāmai ʻae tenali. “Ko e mata mo e tohi ʻa hai ʻoku ʻi ai?”Pea nau lea, ʻo pehēange, “ʻA Sisa.”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Ko ia ʻatu kia Sisa ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻa Sisa, pea ki he ʻOtua ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻae ʻOtua.”
Pea naʻe ʻikai te nau faʻa femioekina ia, ʻi heʻene ngaahi lea ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai: pea naʻa nau ofo ʻi heʻene lea, mo nau fakalongo pe.
¶Pea naʻe toki haʻu ʻae niʻihi ʻoe Satusi, ʻakinautoluʻoku pehēʻoku ʻikai ha toetuʻu; ʻonau fehuʻi kiate ia,

“ʻo pehē, ʻEiki, naʻe tohi ʻe Mōsese kiate kimautolu, “Kapau ʻe mate ʻae tokoua ʻo ha tangata, ka ʻoku ai hono ʻunoho, pea mate ia taʻehaʻanefānau, ke maʻu ʻe hono tokoua ʻa hono ʻunoho, ʻo fakatupu ʻae hako ki hono tokoua.
Pea naʻe ai ʻae kāinga ʻe toko fitu: pea maʻu ʻe he ʻuluaki ʻae ʻunoho, pea mate ia taʻehaʻanefānau.
Pea maʻu ia ʻe he toko ua ko hono ʻunoho, pea mate ia taʻehaʻanefānau.
Pea maʻu ia ʻe hono toko tolu; pea pehēpe ōaʻu ki hono toko fitu: ka naʻa nau mate taʻehaʻanaufānau.
Pea mate fakamui foki ʻae fefine.
Ko ia ʻi he toetuʻu ko e ʻunohoʻo hai ia ʻiate kinautolu? He naʻe maʻu ia ʻe he toko fitu ko honau ʻunoho.”
Pea lea ʻa Sisu, ʻo pehēange kiate kinautolu, “Ko e fānau ʻa māmani ʻoku mali pea foaki ke mali:
Ka ko kinautoluʻe ʻaonga ke maʻu ʻae mama ko ia, mo e toetuʻu mei he mate, ʻe ʻikai te nau fakamaau pe foaki ke fakamaʻu:
Pea ʻe ʻikai te nau toe mate: he ko e fānau ʻae ʻOtua ʻakinautoluʻo hangēko e kau ʻāngelo; mo e fānau ʻoe toetuʻu.
Ka ko e fokotuʻu ʻoe mate, naʻe fakahāiaʻe Mōsese, mei he ʻuluʻakau, ʻi heʻene ui ʻae ʻEiki ‘ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻEpalahame, mo e ʻOtua ʻo ʻAisake, mo e ʻOtua ʻo Sēkope.’
He ʻoku ʻikai ko e ʻOtua ia ʻoe mate, ka ko e moʻui: he ʻoku moʻui kotoa pēkiate ia.”
¶Pea leaange ʻae niʻihi ʻoe kau tangata tohi, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, kuo ke lea totonu.”
Pea hili ia naʻe ʻikai te nau faʻa fai mo ha fehuʻi kiate ia.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻOku fēfēʻenau lau ko Kalaisi ko e foha ʻo Tevita?

Kae pehēʻe Tevita ʻi he tohi ʻoe ngaahi Saame,
‘Naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova ki hoku ʻEiki,
Nofo koe ki hoku nima toʻomataʻu,
Kaeʻoua ke u ngaohi ho ngaahi fili ko ho tuʻungavaʻe.”|’
Ko ia naʻe ui ia ʻe Tevita ko e ‘ʻEiki,’pea ko hono foha fēfēia?”
¶Pea toki pehēʻe ia ki heʻene kau ākonga, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai kotoa pē,

“Vakai ki he kau tangata tohi, ʻakinautoluʻoku nau manako ke ʻalu mo e kofu fakatōtōlofa, mo nau leleiʻia ʻi he fetapa ʻi he ngaahi potu fakatau, mo e nofoʻanga māʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi falelotu, mo e potu lelei ʻi he ngaahi kātoanga;
‌ʻOku nau faʻao ʻae ngaahi fale ʻoe kau fefine kuo mate honau ʻunoho, mo fai fakalōloa ʻae ngaahi lotu ʻi he kākā: ʻe maʻu ʻekinautoluni ʻae malaʻia lahi.”
21: PEA vakai atu ʻe ia, ʻo ne mamata ki he līʻe he kakai koloaʻia ʻenau meʻa foaki ki he tukuʻanga koloa.
Pea mamata foki ʻe ia ki he fefine masiva, kuo mate hono ʻunoho, ʻoku ne līki ai ʻae kihiʻi paʻanga ʻe ua.
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ko e fefine ni kuo mate hono ʻunohomo paea, kuo ne līki ai ʻo lahi hake ʻiate kinautolukotoa pē:
He kuo līʻekinautoluni kotoa pēki ai ʻae ngaahi meʻa foaki ki he ʻOtua, mei heʻenau koloa lahi: ka kuo līʻe ia ki ai, mei heʻene masiva, ʻa ʻene moʻui kotoa pē.”
¶Pea ʻi he lea ʻae niʻihi ki he falelotu lahi, ki hono teungaʻaki ʻae ngaahi maka lelei mo e ngaahi meʻa foaki, ne pehēʻe ia,
“Ko e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku mou mamata ki ai ni, ʻe hoko ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻe ʻikai mahili ai ha maka ki ha maka, ka ʻe laku kotoa pēki lalo.”
Pea naʻa nau fehuʻi kiate ia, ʻo pehē, “ʻEiki, ʻe hoko afe ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni? Pea ko e hāʻae fakaʻilonga ʻoka hoko ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni?”
Pea pehēʻe ia, “Vakai, telia naʻa kākaaʻi ʻakimoutolu: koeʻuhi ʻe haʻu ʻae tokolahi ʻi hoku hingoa ʻonau pehē, ‘Ko au ia;’pea ‘ʻOku ofi mai ʻae ʻaho:’ko ia ʻoua naʻa mou muimuikiate kinautolu.
Ka ʻoka mou ka fanongo ki he ngaahi tau mo e ngaahi maveuveu, ʻoua naʻa mou ilifia: koeʻuhi ʻe tomuʻa hoko ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni; ka ʻe ʻikai vave ʻae ngataʻanga.”
Pea toki pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “ʻE tuʻu hake ʻae kakai ki he kakai, mo e puleʻanga ki he puleʻanga;
Pea ʻe hoko ʻae ngaahi mofuike lahi ʻi he potu kehekehe, mo e honge, mo e ngaahi mahaki lahi; pea ʻe hāmai mei he langi ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakailifia mo e ngaahi fakaʻilonga lahi.

Kae teʻeki ai ke hoko eni, te nau pukea ʻakimoutolu, mo fakatangaʻi, mo tukuangeʻakimoutoluki he ngaahi falelotu, mo e ngaahi fale fakapōpula, ʻonau ʻomi ʻakimoutoluki he ʻao ʻoe ngaahi tuʻi mo e pule, koeʻuhi ko hoku hingoa.
Pea ʻe hoko ia ko e fakamoʻoni kiate kimoutolu.
Ko ia ke fakapapau homou loto, ke ʻoua naʻa tomuʻa fakakaukau ʻaia te mou tali ʻaki:
He te u foaki kiate kimoutoluʻae ngutu mo e poto, ʻe ʻikai faʻa tali pe taʻofia ʻe homou ngaahi fili kotoa pē.
Ka ʻe lavakiʻi ʻakimoutoluʻe he mātuʻa, mo e tokoua, mo e kāinga, mo e kaumeʻa; pea te nau tāmateʻi homou niʻihi.
Pea ʻe fehiʻanekina ʻakimoutoluʻi he kakai kotoa pēkoeʻuhi ko hoku hingoa.
Ka ʻe ʻikai mole ha tuʻoni louʻulu ʻi homou ʻulu.
Mou maʻu ʻi hoʻomou faʻa kātaki ʻa homou laumālie.
“Pea ʻoka mou ka mamata ki he kāpui ʻo Selūsalema ʻaki ʻae ngaahi matatau, mou toki ʻilo kuo ofi hono fakaʻauha.
Pea tuku ke toki feholaki ai ki he ngaahi moʻunga ʻakinautoluʻoku ʻi Siutea; pea ko kinautoluʻoku ʻi kolo ke nau ʻalu atu; pea ʻoua naʻa hūki ai ʻakinautoluʻoku nofo ʻi he tukuʻuta.
He ko e ‘ngaahi ʻaho eni ʻoe totongi,’koeʻuhi ke fakamoʻoni ʻae meʻa kotoa pēkuo tohi.
Ka ʻe malaʻia ʻakinautoluʻe feitama, mo kinautoluʻe toutama, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ko ia! Koeʻuhi ʻe ai ʻae mamahi lahi ki he fonua, mo e houhau ki he kakai ni.
Pea ʻe tōʻakinautoluʻi he mata ʻoe heletā, pea ʻe taki pōpula ki he puleʻanga kotoa pē: pea ʻe malaki hifo ʻa Selūsalema ʻe he kakai Senitaile, kaeʻoua ke kakato ʻae kuongaʻoe kakai Senitaile.
¶“Pea ʻe ai ʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga ʻi he laʻā, mo e māhina, mo e ngaahi fetuʻu; pea ʻe ʻi he māmani ʻae mamahi ʻoe ngaahi kakai, mo e puputuʻu, koeʻuhi ko e ʻuʻulu ʻae tahi mo e ngaahi peau:
Ka ʻe mole ʻae loto ʻoe kakai ʻi he manavahē, mo tuʻotuʻatamaki ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻe hoko ki māmani: koeʻuhi ʻe ngalulululuʻae ngaahi mālohi ʻoe langi.
Pea te nau toki mamata ki he Foha ʻoe tangata ʻoku haʻu ʻi he ngaahi ʻao, mo e mālohi mo e nāunau lahi.
Pea ʻi he kamata hoko mai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, mou sio hake, pea hanga hake homou ʻulu; he ʻoku ofi mai homou huhuʻi.”
Pea naʻe lea ʻaki ʻe ia ʻae fakatātākiate kinautolu; “Vakai ki he ʻakau ko e fiki, pea mo e ngaahi ʻakau kotoa pē;
‌ʻOka tupu hono muka, ʻoku mou mamata, pea mou ʻilo ai ʻoku ofi mai ʻae faʻahitaʻu mafana.
Pea ʻe pehēfoki ʻakimoutolu, ʻoka mou ka mamata ki he hoko ʻoe ngaahi meʻa ni, mou ʻilo ʻoku ofi mai ʻae puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.
“Ko e moʻoni ʻoku ou tala kiate kimoutolu, ʻE ʻikai mole ʻae toʻutangata ni, kaeʻoua ke fakamoʻoni kotoa pē.
‌ʻE mole ʻae langi mo māmani; ka ʻe ʻikai mole ʻa ʻeku ngaahi lea.
¶“Kae vakai kiate kimoutolu, telia naʻa ʻiloange kuo taʻomia homou loto ʻi he kai fekinaki, mo e kona, mo e tokanga ki he moʻui ni, pea hoko fakafokifāai ʻae ʻaho ko ia kiate kimoutolu.
Koeʻuhi ʻe hoko ia ʻo hangēko e hele kiate kinautolukotoa pēʻoku nau nofo ʻi he funga ʻo māmani fulipē.
Ko ia mou leʻo, pea lotu maʻuaipē, koeʻuhi ke mou ʻaonga ke hao mei he ngaahi meʻa ni kotoa pēʻe hoko, pea ke tutuʻu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe Foha ʻoe tangata.”
Pea naʻe ako ia ʻi he ʻaho ʻi he falelotu lahi; pea ʻi he pō, naʻa ne ʻalu kituaʻāʻo nofo ʻi he moʻunga ʻoku ui ko ʻOlive.
Pea naʻe haʻu hengihengi ʻae kakai kotoa pēkiate ia ʻi he falelotu lahi, ke nau fanongo kiate ia.
22: PEA naʻe ofi mai ʻae kātoanga ʻoe mātaʻemeʻafakatupu, ʻaia ʻoku ui ko e Lakaatu.
Pea naʻe fifili ʻe he kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau tangata tohi pe fēfeeʻi ʻenau tāmateʻi ia; ka naʻa nau manavahēki he kakai.
¶Pea hūai ʻa Sētane kia Siutasinaʻe hingoa ko ʻIsikaliote, ko e taha ia ʻi he toko hongofulu ma toko ua.
Pea ʻalu ai ia, ʻonau alea mo e kau taulaʻeiki lahi mo e kau matāpule, pe fēfēʻene lavakiʻi ia kiate kinautolu.
Pea naʻa nau fiefia, ʻo alea fakapapau ke ʻatu ha paʻanga kiate ia.
Pea loto ia ki ai ʻo ne lamasi ke tuʻumālie ʻene lavaki ia kiate kinautoluʻi he ʻikai ʻi ai ha kakai.
¶Pea hokosia ʻae ʻaho ʻoe mātaʻemeʻafakatupu, ʻaia ʻoku totonu ke tāmateʻi ai ʻa efeilaulauʻoe Lakaatu.
Pea fekauʻi ʻe ia ʻa Pita mo Sione, ʻo pehē, “Mo ō, ʻo teuteu ʻa efeilaulauʻoe Lakaatu maʻatautolu, koeʻuhi ke tau kai.”
Pea naʻa na pehēkiate ia, “Ko e potu fēʻoku ke loto ke ma teuteu ai?”
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinaua, “Vakai, ʻi hoʻomo hūki he kolo, te mo fetaulakimo e tangata ʻoku ne fua ʻae hina vai; mo muimuiʻiate ia ki he fale ʻe hūia ki ai.
Pea mo pehēki he ʻeiki ʻoe fale, ‘ʻOku pehēmai ʻae ʻEiki kiate koe, “Kofaʻāia ʻae potu te mau kai ai ʻa efeilaulauʻoe Lakaatu mo ʻeku kau ākonga?”|’
Pea ʻe fakahāʻe ia kiate kimoua ʻae potu lahi ʻi ʻolunga kuo teuʻi: pea mo teuteu ai.”
Pea naʻa na ō, ʻo na ʻilo ʻo hangēko ʻene lea kiate kinaua; pea naʻa na teuteu ʻa efeilaulau ʻoeLakaatu.
Pea kuo hokosia ʻae feituʻu efiafi, pea nofo hifo ia, mo e kau ʻaposetolo ʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ua.
Pea pehēʻe ia kiate kinautolu, “Kuo u holi ʻi he holi lahi, ke tau kai mo kimoutoluʻa efeilaulauʻoe Lakaatu ni ʻi he teʻeki ai te u mate.
He ʻoku ou tala atu kiate kimoutolu. ʻE ʻikai te u toe kai ia, kaeʻoua ke fakamoʻoni ia ʻi he puleʻanga ʻoe ʻOtua.”
